question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of Mathematics department subjects offered in the fall term that are not variable units, grouped by academic year and department, and what is the highest such count for any department in each year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects, MAX(num_subjects) AS max_num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, are not variable units, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are not the current term, have a term status indicator of 'P', are offered by the Mathematics department, and are full term subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_DURATION = 'Full Term Subject' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are not the current term, have a term status indicator of 'P', and are offered by the Mathematics department.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each academic year, classify the year as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the enrolled_variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all years, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if it is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Show the academic year, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, and the variance_category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Show the academic year and these two statistics.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each school, list the department name, school name, subject code description, and the number of subjects offered by degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, and include a grand total of subjects per school in the format (null, school name, null, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUM(inner_cte.num_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte.num_subjects) > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects they offered, including the department name, the school name, and the subject code description, for departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, and are not the 'Political Science' department (Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject title offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department with a total number of units greater than 0, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department, what is the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject? Additionally, for each department name, provide a grand total variance across all its subject titles in the format (department name, null, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(inner_cte.record_count_variance) AS total_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte.record_count_variance) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For each subject title, what is the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject, considering only subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, with a total number of units greater than 0, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department?
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each organization, what is the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only for organizations that are not 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'? Additionally, for each result, show the corresponding HR organization unit title and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean DESC;

question: For each academic year, show the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the total number of Mathematics subjects offered in those terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS subject_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subject_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each type of space usage in the Stata building (excluding usage types that include 'STORAGE'), what is the name of the space usage and the highest variance of the square footage of rooms used for that purpose in any building room, considering only rooms with more than 10 square feet? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS variance_square_footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM ) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, MAX(variance_square_footage) AS highest_variance_square_footage FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE;
domain_knowledge: "exclude usage types that include 'STORAGE'" is predicated by "TABLE.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'"
sub_questions: For each type of space usage, what is the name of the space usage and the variance of the square footage of rooms used for that purpose in the Stata building, considering only rooms with more than 10 square feet and excluding usage types that include 'STORAGE'?
sub_sqls: SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS variance_square_footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and indicate whether the department's average total units is at least 10% higher than the overall average (label as 'HIGH_AVERAGE'), at least 10% lower (label as 'LOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, what is the average, minimum, and maximum total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, only including subjects offered by the School of Engineering, and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Political Science department? Also, for each department, indicate whether the average total units is above 10 ('ABOVE_AVERAGE'), below 6 ('BELOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, only including subjects offered by the School of Engineering, and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Political Science department?
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ;

question: How many subjects offered in 2021 that are not for graduate credit, are listed as undergraduate in the course catalog, are in the Mathematics department, and are also offered by the School of Science? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS undergrad_subjects_2021 FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.HGN_CODE = c.HGN_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND c.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES = 'U' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS undergrad_subjects_2021_science FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.HGN_CODE = c.HGN_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND c.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES = 'U' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science';
sub_questions: How many subjects offered in 2021 that are not for graduate credit, are listed as undergraduate in the course catalog, and are in the Mathematics department?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS undergrad_subjects_2021 FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.HGN_CODE = c.HGN_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND c.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES = 'U' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For students whose year is 'G' and whose department is degree-granting and is 'Political Science', show their full name, email address, department name, subject code, and subject code description, and for each department, also show the total number of such students in that department. Only include students whose department code is '17'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_students_in_department FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For students whose year is 'G' and whose department is degree-granting and is 'Political Science', show their full name, email address, department name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by full name, including the subject code and subject code description for each student's department, and only include students whose department code is '17'.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'

question: For each academic year, list the academic year description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per academic term in that year for the Mathematics department (Course 18), and classify each year as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if it is at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ), year_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ys.units_range, ys.units_variance, ys.units_stddev, CASE WHEN ys.units_stddev > avg_stats.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ys.units_stddev < avg_stats.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM year_stats ys CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(units_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM year_stats ) avg_stats ORDER BY ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units offered per academic term in that year for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: WITH term_units AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev FROM term_units GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department, and which departments have an average enrollment greater than the overall average for all degree-granting departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and only including the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term and are from the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each department, show the same statistics, and for each academic year and department, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (academic year, department, null, total units statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_units_variance, rr.total_units_stddev FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units of all subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term and are from the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the academic year description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, indicate whether the average total units for that year is at least 10% greater than the overall average (label as 'HIGH_AVERAGE'), at least 10% less than the overall average (label as 'LOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN icte.avg_total_units > overall.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN icte.avg_total_units < overall.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) overall ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, as well as the school name and the total number of subjects in the department for that term. Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department, what is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_academic_year, sum_total_units FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: What is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and belong to the Mathematics department, considering only library reserve material details with material status 'U'?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding Chemistry and Biology), what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, along with the department's full name, the school name, and the number of unique subjects offered by the department, considering only departments that offer more than 5 unique subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students, subj_counts.num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) subj_counts ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subj_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE subj_counts.num_unique_subjects > 5;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '101' and '103'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('101', '103')"

question: For each floor in the Stata building (building 32), what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage, for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, with a largest room square footage greater than 100, and also display the total number of rooms on that floor that meet these criteria? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = ( SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' ) ) SELECT ic.FLOOR_NAME, ic.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, ic.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, cnt.Total_Rooms_On_Floor FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT sd.FLOOR_KEY, COUNT(*) AS Total_Rooms_On_Floor FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.FLOOR_KEY ) cnt ON ic.FLOOR_KEY = cnt.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY ic.FLOOR_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"
sub_questions: For each floor, what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage, for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, with a largest room square footage greater than 100, and only for rooms in the Stata building (building 32)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = ( SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' ) ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME;

question: For each school, provide the school's full name and, among its degree-granting departments (excluding the Biology department), report the maximum and minimum variance of CIP program codes among their degree-granting courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(cip_code_variance) AS max_cip_code_variance, MIN(cip_code_variance) AS min_cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department's full name and calculate the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses, considering only departments that grant degrees and courses that are degree-granting, but exclude the Biology department (Course 7) from the results.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

question: For each department, list the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree-granting, and excluding 'Political Science' (Course 17)), but only include those departments where the average enrollment is greater than the overall average enrollment across all such departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_enrollment, ic.enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS overall_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) oa ON ic.avg_enrollment > oa.overall_avg_enrollment ORDER BY ic.enrollment_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree-granting, and only include departments that are not 'Political Science' (Course 17)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the Mathematics school, what is the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students? Show the department name and the highest number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and assign row numbers within each department name group ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each academic building at MIT, give the building name and the highest average area of rooms located on floors with an access level of 2, grouped by floor. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, ff.FLOOR, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, ff.FLOOR ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, MAX(avg_room_area) AS highest_avg_room_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME;
sub_questions: For each academic building at MIT, give the building name and calculate the average and variance of the area of rooms located on floors with an access level of 2.
sub_sqls: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_room_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS var_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_NAME

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees), as well as the school name and department phone number. Only include the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18).

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding 'NIE') in the Mathematics department (Course 18), what are the minimum total units and average lecture units for subjects where the total units are between 6 and 15 or the lecture units are at least 3, and only include those departments where the average lecture units for these subjects is greater than the overall average lecture units for such subjects across all departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sdo ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 15 OR ccso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3) AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE != 'NIE' AND sdo.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.min_total_units, icte.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte WHERE icte.avg_lecture_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sdo ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 15 OR ccso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3) AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE != 'NIE' AND sdo.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) ;
sub_questions: What are the minimum total units and average lecture units for each department, considering only subjects where the total units are between 6 and 15 or the lecture units are at least 3, and only including departments whose department code is not 'NIE' and that are degree-granting, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sdo ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 15 OR ccso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3) AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE != 'NIE' AND sdo.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a non-null subject title, are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and have at least one associated library reserve material? For each academic year, also include a grand total row for all such subjects in the format of (null, null, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.variance_total_units FROM ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP ) ic WHERE ic.variance_total_units IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a non-null subject title, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the top 10 academic years by the number of subjects offered in the fall term by the Mathematics department, also provide the start and end dates of each term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: List the top 10 academic years by the number of subjects offered in the fall term by the Mathematics department, including the academic year description and the term description.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department, and for each department, what is the subject with the highest enrollment and its enrollment count? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, max_subj.SUBJECT_TITLE AS highest_enrolled_subject, max_subj.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) max_subj ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = max_subj.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_subj.SUBJECT_TITLE, max_subj.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and only including the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable, the organization is not 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and the department hierarchy level 3 name is 'School of Engineering', provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_organizations, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh ON fo.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' GROUP BY mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT icte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.num_organizations, icte.min_organization_number FROM inner_cte icte JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh2 ON icte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = mdh2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME WHERE mdh2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME = 'School of Engineering'
domain_knowledge: "except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"
sub_questions: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization is not 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', give the number of organizations and the minimum organization number.
sub_sqls: SELECT mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_organizations, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh ON fo.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' GROUP BY mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the minimum number of enrolled students in Chemistry department subjects offered in '2019FA' with course materials and more than 0 enrolled students, calculated in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, inner_cte.window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, offering department name, school name, department full name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department name, and only include courses that have course materials.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school, and also include the total number of unique subject codes per school. Only include the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school, but only include the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC;

question: For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, provide the number of unique subject titles, the minimum total units, and indicate whether the minimum total units is above, below, or equal to the average total units for that department and subject code this year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_units_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.num_unique_subject_titles, i.min_total_units, a.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.min_total_units < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'EQUAL_TO_AVERAGE' END AS min_units_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_cte a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, give the number of unique subject titles and the minimum total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only years with more than 10 subjects), and for each subject in those years, what is the subject id, its total units, and the deviation of its total units from the average total units for that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10 ) , avg_units_per_year AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.stddev_total_units, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_per_year a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID ;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the standard deviation of the total units of all subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department, considering only years with more than 10 subjects?
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10 ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of graduate students in degree-granting departments, display each department's name, total graduate student count, the school it belongs to, the most common course description among its graduate students, and the count of students in that course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_graduate_students, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, cdc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS Most_Common_Course, cdc.Student_Count FROM ( SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_graduate_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS Student_Count, @rank := IF(@current_dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, @current_dept := sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_dept := '') vars WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, Student_Count DESC ) cdc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cdc.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_graduate_students DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each DLC, what is the DLC key, DLC name, the number of unique organizations, and the total number of assignable organizations, considering only DLCs that have at least one assignable organization, whose DLC name contains the word 'Office', and that are not the biology department? Additionally, for each such DLC, what is the average organization level of its assignable organizations? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) != LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME ) SELECT i.DLC_KEY, i.DLC_NAME, i.organization_count, i.assignable_organization_count, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_assignable_org_level FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON i.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY i.DLC_KEY, i.DLC_NAME, i.organization_count, i.assignable_organization_count;
domain_knowledge: "Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"
sub_questions: For each DLC, what is the DLC key, DLC name, the number of unique organizations, and the total number of assignable organizations, considering only DLCs that have at least one assignable organization, whose DLC name contains the word 'Office', and that are not the biology department?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) != LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME;

question: For all buildings on the MIT site that are academic buildings with more than 50 rooms (according to the building history) and are specifically the Ray and Maria Stata Center, list each floor's number, the total assignable area on that floor, and the total non-assignable area, ordered by floor number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS num_floors FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32') ) SELECT ff.FLOOR, SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area, SUM(ff.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_non_assignable_area FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32') GROUP BY ff.FLOOR ORDER BY ff.FLOOR;
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"
sub_questions: How many floors are there in buildings that are located on the MIT site, have more than 50 rooms according to the building history, and are academic buildings, specifically in the Ray and Maria Stata Center?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS num_floors FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32');

question: For each DLC in the history department, provide the DLC name, the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC (excluding organizations '138' and '250' and only considering non-null organization numbers and DLC keys), and classify each DLC as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such DLCs, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if the variance is at least 20% less than the average variance, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fodk.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_organization_number, VARIANCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS var_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY fodk.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(var_organization_number) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DLC_KEY, i.DLC_NAME, i.avg_organization_number, i.var_organization_number, CASE WHEN i.var_organization_number > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.var_organization_number < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark v;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"
sub_questions: For each DLC in the history department, give the DLC name and calculate the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, considering only organizations that have a non-null organization number and a non-null DLC key, and excluding organizations '138' and '250'.
sub_sqls: SELECT fodk.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_organization_number, VARIANCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS var_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY fodk.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME

question: For each postal code in Cambridge, list the building name, building number, floor number, assignable area, and the total assignable area for all academic Maclaurin Buildings in that postal code. Also, include a grand total of assignable area for all such buildings across all postal codes. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_NAME, t2.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.FLOOR, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, t0.POSTAL_CODE FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t0 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t2.BUILDING_NAME = 'MACLAURIN BUILDINGS (3)' ) SELECT POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, FLOOR, ASSIGNABLE_AREA, SUM(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY POSTAL_CODE) AS total_assignable_area_per_postal_code FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS POSTAL_CODE, NULL AS BUILDING_NAME, NULL AS BUILDING_NUMBER, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA, SUM(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area_per_postal_code FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For buildings located in the city of CAMBRIDGE with a non-zero assignable area on their floors, and that are academic buildings, show the building name, building number, floor number, assignable area, building address postal code, and assign row numbers within each postal code group ordered by building number. Additionally, restrict the results to buildings that are Maclaurin Buildings.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.BUILDING_NAME, t2.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.FLOOR, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, t0.POSTAL_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.POSTAL_CODE ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t0 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t2.BUILDING_NAME = 'MACLAURIN BUILDINGS (3)'

question: For all rooms with an area greater than 400 in the Stata building, show the room key, building room, area, the subject title and academic year of each course meeting in that room that is offered by the Computer Science department, and also include the department name and the rank of each room within its building (ordered by room key). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR
