question: For each organization, what is the highest HR department code (old) among its associated HR org units, what is the HR department name, and what is the corresponding HR org unit title, considering only organizations whose highest HR department code (old) is greater than 500000, and excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS max_hr_dept_code_old, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 500000 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.max_hr_dept_code_old, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.max_hr_dept_code_old = hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD;
sub_questions: For each organization, what is the highest HR department code (old) among its associated HR org units, and what is the HR department name, considering only organizations whose highest HR department code (old) is greater than 500000, and excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'?
sub_sqls: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS max_hr_dept_code_old, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 500000;

question: For each department that grants degrees, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and only include those departments whose average total units is above the overall average total units across all degree-granting departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs ) o ON i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg ORDER BY i.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with more than 0 total units, and specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each organization whose organization level is 5 and is not 'ADMISSIONS', show the organization name, description, the corresponding space unit name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the space unit name, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. Then, from these results, return only those organizations whose organization name starts with the letter 'C'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND t0.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE 'C%';
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

question: For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting and has a course level of 'G', show the course description, department name, school name, and the dense rank over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name. Additionally, for each administrative department name, include a grand total of the number of such courses in the format of (null, null, null, administrative department name, total courses). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), CourseTotals AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.admin_dept_dense_rank, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, ct.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, ct.total_courses FROM CourseTotals ct ORDER BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION
sub_questions: Show the course description, department name, and school name for each course in the Mathematics department, along with dense ranks over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name, for courses that are degree granting, have a course level of 'G', and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ;

question: For each organization that has a non-null description, belongs to the 'Standard Hierarchy' type, is not the 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and where the department is 'Political Science' (Course 17), show the organization name, department name, department code, department hierarchy level 2 name, and the total number of organizations in the same department, along with dense ranks partitioned by department long name ordered by department long name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_orgs_in_department FROM inner_cte;

question: For each degree-granting department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (with more than 0 total units), along with the department's full name and the number of such subjects per department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, subj_count.subject_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s2 ON d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subj_count ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with more than 0 total units, and specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For students whose department is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6), show their MIT ID, full name, employee type, email address, department name, student year, and assign row numbers within each employee type group ordered by MIT ID. Additionally, only include those whose employee type is 'Student'. For each such student, also show the total number of students in 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.MIT_ID, t0.FULL_NAME, t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE ORDER BY t0.MIT_ID) AS window_column FROM SE_PERSON t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.FULL_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT i.MIT_ID, i.FULL_NAME, i.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.window_column, s.total_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_students FROM SE_PERSON t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.FULL_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) s ON 1=1;

question: For rooms with an area greater than 100 and an access level of 1, in the Stata building, show the building room identifier, the room's area, the organization name, the building number, and the building's postal code, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building number from the building address, excluding rooms belonging to the department of facilities. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fba.BUILDING_NUMBER FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 100 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fba.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES' ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.POSTAL_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER;
domain_knowledge: "department of facilities" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DP OF FACILITIES'"

question: List the department code, department name, school name, subject code, subject code description, and the total number of unique courses and total units for each degree-granting department with a department budget code above 100000, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_unique_courses, ic.total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code above 100000, and is not the Political Science department, give the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, and the total number of units for all those courses, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

question: For each floor in the Fairchild Building, provide the floor number, the building's long name, and calculate the range and variance of the area of rooms located on that floor, considering only rooms with an access level of 1 or 2, and only include floors in academic buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36' ) SELECT f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(i.AREA) - MIN(i.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(i.AREA) AS area_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f ON i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG
sub_questions: For each building, provide the building's long name and calculate the range and variance of the area of rooms located in that building, considering only rooms with an access level of 1 or 2, and only include buildings that are academic buildings and are the Fairchild Building.
sub_sqls: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG

question: For each department (excluding Political Science), list the department name, the number of graduate students, and the number of unique graduate-level courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS graduate_student_count, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.graduate_student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS num_graduate_courses FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.graduate_student_count ORDER BY inner_cte.graduate_student_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of graduate students, showing the department name and the count of graduate students in each department, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17) from the results.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS graduate_student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY graduate_student_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject offered by degree-granting departments with a non-null subject code description in the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the subject title, total units, department name, and school name, along with the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code. Additionally, include the subject code and subject code description for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.

sub_questions: List the subject title, total units, department name, and school name for each subject offered, along with dense ranks over the department code ordered by department code, for subjects offered by departments that are degree granting, have a non-null subject code description, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the number of enrolled students, the subject title, the academic year, the term code, and the dense rank over the offering department code (ordered by the offering department code), but only for terms where the number of enrolled students is greater than 0, the term status indicator is 'P', and the course has materials. Additionally, only include results for subjects where the number of enrolled students is above the average number of enrolled students for Chemistry subjects in the same academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t1.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) avg_cte ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avg_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_cte.avg_enrolled
sub_questions: Show the number of enrolled students, the subject title, the academic year, and the term code for each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), along with dense ranks over the offering department code ordered by the offering department code, for terms where the number of enrolled students is greater than 0, the term status indicator is 'P', and only include courses with materials.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t1.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

question: For each academic year and department, what is the average, minimum, and maximum of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, for each such group, what is the deviation of the average total units from the overall average total units for all such Mathematics subjects in the current term? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, (AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) overall GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, overall.avg_total_units ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For all subjects offered in the academic year 2024 by the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its term description group ordered by subject code, but only include those terms where at least 3 Mathematics subjects are offered in 2024. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), TermCounts AS ( SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TermCounts tc ON ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = tc.TERM_DESCRIPTION;
sub_questions: For all subjects offered in the academic year 2024 by the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its term description group ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for all degree-granting courses with non-null total units, and also show the difference between each course's total units and the department's average total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, (ic.TOTAL_UNITS - ds.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for all courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a non-null total units value, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year after 2015, how many subject materials with status 'EO' were offered for subjects with more than 5 total units by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units_math, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units_math FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: Count how many subject materials with status 'EO' were offered in academic years after 2015, for which the corresponding subject had more than 5 total units, and which were offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units_math FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each department, provide the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department), as well as the school name and the department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and provide both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each organization, provide the organization name, the average number of supervisees per supervisor for all supervisors in that organization who have at least one supervisee, and the deviation of this average from the overall average number of supervisees per supervisor across all organizations (excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS' and 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' AND ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES >= 1 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, (inner_cte.avg_supervisees - overall.avg_all_supervisees) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_all_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' AND ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES >= 1 ) overall;
domain_knowledge: "except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')"
"except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')"
sub_questions: For each organization, give the organization name and the coefficient of variation of the number of supervisees per supervisor for all supervisors in that organization who have at least one supervisee, but only include organizations that are not 'ADMISSIONS'. Also, only include organizations whose name is not 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'.
sub_sqls: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) / AVG(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES)) AS coeff_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' AND ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES >= 1 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) > 0

question: Among all departments, which are the top 5 departments with the highest average office phone number among graduate students (student year 'G') who have a non-null office phone number? For each of these departments, show the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of office phone numbers, and the full name and office phone number of the graduate student in that department with the highest office phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_office_phone, icte.stddev_office_phone, msd.FULL_NAME AS Top_Student, msd.OFFICE_PHONE AS Top_Office_Phone FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.FULL_NAME, msd.OFFICE_PHONE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL ) msd ON icte.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = ( SELECT MAX(msd2.OFFICE_PHONE) FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd2 WHERE msd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd2.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY icte.avg_office_phone DESC LIMIT 5;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the average and standard deviation of the office phone numbers of students in that department, considering only students whose student year is 'G', who have a non-null office phone number, and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC;

question: For subjects in the current academic term that are in the Political Science department (Course 17), show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the maximum total units within each school, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_CODE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_CODE) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For subjects in the current academic term that are in the Political Science department (Course 17), show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school, ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'

question: For organizations whose organization name contains 'Facilities', and that are not organizations '138' or '250', show their organization IDs, the dense rank of their HR department names (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by HR department code), and for each, also show the corresponding HR department name long and the HR org unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE '%Facilities%' AND t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_ID, inner_cte.window_column, t3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t3 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID;
