sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

question: For each IAP activity that is not cancelled and is offered in a non-summer term, what is the highest number of distinct Mathematics subject titles offered in the same academic term as that activity? Show the IAP activity title and the highest such count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ata.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ata.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE;
sub_questions: List the top 10 IAP activities by the number of subjects offered in the same academic term, showing the IAP activity title and the count of distinct subject titles offered in that term, for activities that are not cancelled, are offered in a term that is not the summer term, and where the subjects are from the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: From the top 5 departments with the highest average total units for letter graded subjects offered this year, display each department's name, average total units, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the subject with the highest total units in that department, along with its subject title and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , subject_ranks AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ic.SUBJECT_CODE) AS rn FROM inner_cte ic ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, sr.SUBJECT_CODE AS top_subject_code, sr.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, sr.TOTAL_UNITS AS top_subject_total_units FROM dept_stats ds LEFT JOIN subject_ranks sr ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sr.rn = 1 ORDER BY ds.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry), what is the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and only include those departments where the average number of enrolled students is greater than the overall average across all subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED )
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in Mathematics (Course 18) courses that are offered in the current term, have more than zero enrolled students, and have available course materials. Additionally, for each academic year, indicate whether the enrolled_range is at least 50% greater than the enrolled_variance ('HIGH_SPREAD'), at least 50% less than the enrolled_variance ('LOW_SPREAD'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_SPREAD'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range > inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SPREAD' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SPREAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SPREAD' END AS spread_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year, and calculate the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the current term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18) with available course materials.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area" at the "School of Science" level, excluding the Biology department, show the department name, department code, organization name, organization ID, and the maximum average organization number within each department code group, ordered by organization sort, and exclude organizations with IDs '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, AVG(t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_CODE ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_SORT) AS avg_org_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME = 'School of Science' AND LOWER(t0.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') AND t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT DLC_NAME, DLC_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_ID, MAX(avg_org_number) AS max_avg_org_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME, DLC_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_ID
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
sub_questions: For each department in the "Provost Area" at the "School of Science" level, excluding the Biology department, show the department name, department code, organization name, organization ID, and the average organization number within each department code group ordered by organization sort, and exclude organizations with IDs '138' and '250'.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, AVG(t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_CODE ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_SORT) AS avg_org_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME = 'School of Science' AND LOWER(t0.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') AND t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')

question: For each academic year, what is the highest total number of lecture units in a single regular term for all subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS term_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(term_lecture_units) AS highest_term_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only those academic years where the total lecture units are more than one standard deviation above the mean total lecture units across all academic years?
sub_sqls: SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) t );

question: For each DLC whose name contains 'Office' and is not the biology department, what is the DLC key, DLC name, the number of unique organizations, the total number of assignable organizations, and whether the DLC is 'LARGE' (more than 5 assignable organizations), 'SMALL' (less than 3 assignable organizations), or 'MEDIUM' (otherwise)? Only include DLCs with at least one assignable organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) != LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.assignable_organization_count, CASE WHEN inner_cte.assignable_organization_count > 5 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN inner_cte.assignable_organization_count < 3 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END AS dlc_size_category FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.assignable_organization_count >= 1;
domain_knowledge: "Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"
sub_questions: For each DLC, what is the DLC key, DLC name, the number of unique organizations, and the total number of assignable organizations, considering only DLCs that have at least one assignable organization, whose DLC name contains the word 'Office', and that are not the biology department?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) != LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering that are degree-granting, show the subject title, the total number of units, and the maximum number of units among all such subjects offered by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Course 6). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER () AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte;
domain_knowledge: "Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
"Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
sub_questions: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, that are degree-granting, show the subject title and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units, and restrict the results to subjects offered by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Course 6).
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management, Course 15), what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, what is the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and what is the full name of the department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = icte.max_enrollment ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, what is the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and restrict the results to only degree-granting departments and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15)?
sub_sqls: WITH dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_enroll dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ORDER BY dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated material record, but only include courses from the Chemistry department (Course 5). Also, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, average, variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated material record, but only include courses from the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each school, list its name, the number of degree-granting departments (excluding the Biology department), and for each department in the school, provide the department name along with the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered in the 2022 academic year. For each school, include a grand total row for all its departments in the format of (school name, null, total departments, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.num_departments, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptCounts dc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dc.SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT dc.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL, dc.num_departments, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM DeptCounts dc ) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics), what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0), and what is the deviation of each course's total units from the department's average total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, (ic.TOTAL_UNITS - ds.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.total_units_variance DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the corresponding school name and department code, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting, but exclude the departments of Mathematics and Chemistry. Sort the results by variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting, but exclude the departments of Mathematics and Chemistry.
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each organization and its corresponding HR department where the organization is assignable, the HR organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', the organization is not 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and the organization is in the 'Provost Area' top-level HR hierarchy, provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number, but exclude organizations with IDs '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number FROM inner_cte ic JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h2 ON ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE h2.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area';
domain_knowledge: "except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')"
"exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

sub_questions: For each organization and its corresponding HR department where the organization is assignable, the HR organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', and the organization is not 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number, but exclude organizations with IDs '138' and '250'.
sub_sqls: SELECT f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects with more than zero total units and offered by the Mathematics department), and also include the average number of enrolled students in those subjects for each year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects with more than zero total units and offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

question: For each building, what is the building name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area across its historical records, considering only buildings with more than 3 historical records, where the building type is 'ACADEMIC', and excluding the Brown Building, and only include those buildings where the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of assignable area is greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such buildings? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, assignable_area_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE assignable_area_stddev > (SELECT AVG(assignable_area_stddev) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC;
sub_questions: For each building, what is the building name and the standard deviation of the assignable area across its historical records, considering only buildings with more than 3 historical records, where the building type is 'ACADEMIC', and excluding the Brown Building?
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC;

question: For each organization that belongs to departments under the 'Provost Area' in the department hierarchy (excluding organizations '138' and '250' and only including assignable organizations), provide the organization ID, organization name, the minimum organization level among all such organizations, and the total number of assignable organizations in this group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS min_org_level, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE) AS total_assignable FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_ID, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte.min_org_level, cte.total_assignable FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN inner_cte cte ON 1=1 WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250');
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
sub_questions: What is the minimum organization level and the total number of assignable organizations for organizations that belong to departments under the 'Provost Area' in the department hierarchy, excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only including organizations that are assignable?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS min_org_level, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE) AS total_assignable FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')

question: For each school, list the top 5 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science, Course 17) by the number of subjects they offered in the 2022 academic year, showing the school name, department name, and subject count. Also, for each school, include a grand total of subjects offered by all its degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) in 2022, with the department name as null and the total subject count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, showing each department's name and the count of subjects, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17) from the results and only include departments that grant degrees.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year after 2000, what is the academic year description, and what are the highest and lowest total units of subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only subjects with more than 0 total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2000 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year after 2000, what is the academic year description, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, that are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department offering a course, what is the department name, the geometric mean of the total units for courses that have at least one enrolled student, a non-null ISBN in their course materials, and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department, and whether the geometric mean is at least 10% higher than the overall average geometric mean (label as 'HIGH_GEOMEAN'), at least 10% lower (label as 'LOW_GEOMEAN'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, overall.avg_geomean, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units > overall.avg_geomean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_GEOMEAN' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units < overall.avg_geomean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_GEOMEAN' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS geomean_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geomean FROM inner_cte ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units DESC;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each department offering a course, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units for courses that have at least one enrolled student, a non-null ISBN in their course materials, and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department?
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and only include those departments where the average number of enrolled students is greater than the overall average number of enrolled students across all subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED );

question: For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department. Also, include the department phone number. Sort the results by school name and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the highest student office phone number, the full name of the student with that phone number, and the department's full name and budget code, considering only departments that grant degrees, where the highest office phone number is greater than 1000000000, and excluding the Political Science department (Course 17)? Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, inner_cte.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = inner_cte.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the highest student office phone number and the full name of the student with that phone number, considering only departments that grant degrees, where the highest office phone number is greater than 1000000000, and excluding the Political Science department (Course 17)?
sub_sqls: WITH MaxPhones AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mp.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME FROM MaxPhones mp JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = mp.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each building in Cambridge, MA, show the building key, building name, building type, the number of historical records, the total assignable area across all historical records, and the average number of rooms per historical record, considering only buildings with more than 1 room, with a non-null building name, and that are academic buildings. Additionally, only include buildings that are not the Stata building (building key 32). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_record_count, SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND a.STATE = 'MA' AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 1 AND b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE ) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area;

Additionally, only include buildings that are not the Stata building (building key 32).

question: For each organization, what is the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only for organizations that are not 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'? Also, for each result, show the corresponding HR organization unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree-granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, the running sum of department budget codes within each school (ordered by department code), and whether the department's budget code is above average, below average, or average compared to other Mathematics departments in the same school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_budget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.running_sum_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > a.avg_budget_code THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < a.avg_budget_code THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_budget a ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = a.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject code where the department is degree-granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, and the running sum of department budget codes within each school, ordered by department code.

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are marked as current in the term parameter table, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, for each academic year, indicate whether the maximum total units for a Mathematics subject in that year is at least 20% greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in that year ('HIGH_UNIT_YEAR'), at least 20% less than the average ('LOW_UNIT_YEAR'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT_YEAR'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.max_units > inner_cte.avg_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT_YEAR' WHEN inner_cte.max_units < inner_cte.avg_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_UNIT_YEAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT_YEAR' END AS unit_year_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC;

question: Among the top 5 subject titles with the highest variance in tip detail record counts (for subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, with total units greater than 0, and excluding Chemistry), show each subject's title, the variance of its tip detail record counts, the total number of units for the subject, and the department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.record_count_variance, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ic.record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 5;

sub_sqls: SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department), and include the department phone number for Mathematics. Sort the results by units range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_range DESC;

question: Show the department names, subject codes, subject code descriptions, undergraduate level, the total number of undergraduate courses per department, and the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects, considering only departments that are degree granting and only including the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS undergraduate_level, Total_Courses.Total_Undergrad_Courses, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Undergrad_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and only including the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For the top 3 degree-granting departments (excluding Management) that offer the most distinct courses, what are their department codes, department names, and the corresponding administrative department names? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3;
sub_questions: Which are the top 3 departments that offer the most distinct courses, are degree-granting, and have department codes, department names, and the corresponding administrative department names, excluding the Management department?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3;

question: For each academic year, what is the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, for each academic year, show the difference between the maximum number of enrolled students in a course and the average number of enrolled students for that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled, (MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS max_minus_avg FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY max_minus_avg DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Show the academic year and these two statistics.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees and whose name is 'Mathematics', what is the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers, across all academic terms, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS highest_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees, but only include departments whose name is 'Mathematics' (i.e., Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic term that is marked as the current term and is in the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the term code, term description, academic year, the number of subjects offered, the total subject enrollment number for that term, and the deviation of the total subject enrollment from the average total subject enrollment for all current terms in the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), avg_enrollment_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.total_enrollment, (i.total_enrollment - a.avg_total_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment_cte a;
sub_questions: For each academic term that is marked as the current term and is in the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the term code, term description, academic year, and the number of subjects offered along with the total subject enrollment number for that term.
sub_sqls: SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic term parameter, provide the term description and, for each Mathematics subject offered this year in the corresponding effective term, list the subject number, subject title, and total units. Additionally, for each term, include a grand total row showing the average and variance of total units for all such subjects in that term (with nulls for subject number and title). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT academic_term_parameter, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY academic_term_parameter, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL) OR (SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NULL AND SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL) ORDER BY academic_term_parameter, SUBJECT_NUMBER
sub_questions: For each academic term parameter, provide the term description from ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER and calculate the average and variance of the total units of all subjects offered in the corresponding effective term, considering only subjects that are offered this year and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department in the academic term with the term code '2019FA', list the department name, the total number of subjects in that department, and the average total units for its subjects. For each department, also include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, total subjects, average total units). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DepartmentStats AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_subjects, ds.avg_total_units FROM DepartmentStats ds UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ds.total_subjects) AS total_subjects, AVG(ds.avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM DepartmentStats ds ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For subjects in the academic term with the term code '2019FA' that are in the Mathematics department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, total units, and the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID).
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics) that has a non-null department full name, and is associated with an administrative department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, along with the administrative department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_cip_program_code, ic.range_cip_program_code, ic.var_cip_program_code, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, but only include departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department full name, and exclude the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and also display the maximum number of enrolled students among these subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER () AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material with a material status of 'U', and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department. Also, include the school name for each department by joining with the school information. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.enrollment_stddev DESC;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material, a material status of 'U', and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department (i.e., Course 5 or Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) in the term '2019FA' that has course materials, provide the subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, the department name, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department in that term), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: List the subject title, number of enrolled students, and the responsible faculty name for each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) in the term '2019FA', where the subject has course materials, along with a dense rank over the department name, ordered by department name.

question: From the top 10 degree-granting courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), display each course's name, course description, department name, school name, the program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table for each category code group, and the course with the highest minimum warehouse load date in each category code group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY min_warehouse_load_date DESC) as rn FROM inner_cte ) ic WHERE ic.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE LIMIT 10;
