sub_sqls: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3;

question: Among the top 5 departments with the highest average number of enrolled students in their offered subjects (considering only degree-granting departments and excluding Chemistry and Biology), show each department's code, full name, school name, average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, as well as the name of the school with the most subjects offered by that department and the count of such subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students, sso.Most_Offered_School, sso.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Offered_School, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) sso ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(Subject_Count) AS Max_Subjects FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) t GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) maxs ON sso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = maxs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sso.Subject_Count = maxs.Max_Subjects ORDER BY ic.avg_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each department, give the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses in that department that have at least one course material assigned, but only include the Chemistry and Biology departments. Also, for each department, indicate whether the department's average total units is at least 10% greater than the overall average (label as 'HIGH_AVERAGE'), at least 10% less than the overall average (label as 'LOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) o ORDER BY i.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each school, list the school name and the total number of unique courses offered by departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, are not the Biology department (Course 7), and where the total number of courses offered by the department is greater than the average number of courses offered per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE total_courses > ( SELECT AVG(dept_course_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE) AS dept_course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) sub ) GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each school, give the school name and calculate the total number of courses offered by departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, and are not the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, what is the name of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and what is the department's full name? Restrict the results to only degree-granting departments and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrollment, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, what is the name of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and restrict the results to only degree-granting departments and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15)?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0;

question: For each school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by each department in that school, considering only departments that grant degrees and courses with more than 0 total units, and for each department, what is the deviation of each course's total units from the department's average total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc.SUBJECT_ID, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC;
sub_questions: For each school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by each department in that school, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with more than 0 total units, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form? List the department name and the count, and indicate whether the department is a 'TOP_PROVIDER' (at least 20 subjects), 'ACTIVE_PROVIDER' (at least 10 but less than 20 subjects), or 'LOW_PROVIDER' (less than 10 subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 20 THEN 'TOP_PROVIDER' WHEN COUNT(*) >= 10 THEN 'ACTIVE_PROVIDER' ELSE 'LOW_PROVIDER' END AS provider_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: How many subjects offered in the 2022 academic year are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form and are offered by the Political Science department?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science';

question: For each organization, provide the organization name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of supervisees per supervisor for all supervisors in that organization who have at least one supervisee, and the total square footage assigned to those supervisors. Only include organizations that are not 'ADMISSIONS' and whose name is not 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) / AVG(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES)) AS coeff_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' AND ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES >= 1 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.coeff_of_variation, SUM(ssu.SQFT) AS total_sqft FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES WHERE ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES >= 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.coeff_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: From the top 10 departments (excluding "Political Science") in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools with the highest total course units (where the total units for the department is greater than 1000), display each department's name, total units, the course with the highest units in that department, and the number of units for that course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, cc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Course_Title, cc.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Course_Units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_units DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the total number of units for courses in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools, where the total units for the department is greater than 1000, and restrict the results to departments that are not "Political Science" (Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000;

question: For each department that is degree granting, not the Chemistry department (Course 5), and has offered more than 5 subjects, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, and the number of graduate students in that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than 5 subjects, are degree granting, and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List the academic year, department, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, and the earliest term start date for each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 10 and the department is Chemistry, but only include subjects that are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 10 and the department is Chemistry, give the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered, but only include subjects that are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology departments.
sub_sqls: SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: List the organization, HR department name, the corresponding HR organization unit title, and the total number of assignable organizations per HR department where the HR organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', the organization is not 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and the organization ID is not '138' or '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ic.organization_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

"exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
