question: For each degree-granting department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and for each department, which subject had the highest enrollment? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, max_sub.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_enrollment, max_sub.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_with_max_enrollment, max_sub.max_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE ) max_sub ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = max_sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = max_sub.max_enrollment GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_sub.SUBJECT_ID, max_sub.SUBJECT_TITLE, max_sub.max_enrollment ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in both the library and TIP systems in 2019, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in the library offering, the subject title from the library, the department name from TIP, and the school name from the library, for subjects where the maximum number of enrolled students in the library is greater than 5, and where the department name from TIP is 'Chemistry' (i.e., Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS library_subject_title, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS tip_department_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING max_num_enrolled_students > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, inner_cte.max_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.library_subject_title, inner_cte.tip_department_name, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS library_school_name FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT AND lso.SUBJECT_TITLE = inner_cte.library_subject_title ORDER BY inner_cte.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT;

question: For each student in the MIT student directory whose department is '6' (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their full name, email address, department name, the corresponding SIS admin department name, the average department code within each department code group, and their student year, ordered by the student's full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME) AS avg_department_code FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_department_code, msd.STUDENT_YEAR FROM inner_cte JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.FULL_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), where at least 60% of those subjects are undergraduate-level (HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate'), considering only those academic years where the total lecture units are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total lecture units across all academic years? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.HGN_DESC, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), YearlyTotals AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ), YearlyUndergradCounts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(CASE WHEN HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN 1 END) AS undergrad_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ), FilteredYears AS ( SELECT yt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yt.total_lecture_units, yuc.undergrad_count, yuc.total_count FROM YearlyTotals yt JOIN YearlyUndergradCounts yuc ON yt.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yuc.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE CASE WHEN yuc.total_count > 0 THEN (1.0 * yuc.undergrad_count / yuc.total_count) ELSE 0 END >= 0.6 ) SELECT fy.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fy.total_lecture_units FROM FilteredYears fy WHERE fy.total_lecture_units > ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM YearlyTotals ) ;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only those academic years where the total lecture units are more than one standard deviation above the mean total lecture units across all academic years?
sub_sqls: SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) t );

question: For each student year, provide the student year, the average, range, and variance of department budget codes for students in that year, but only include students whose department code matches both an academic department and an administrative department, and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18) and whose department is also degree-granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.avg_budget, inner_cte.budget_range, inner_cte.budget_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY inner_cte.budget_range DESC;

question: For each department, what is the average, minimum, and maximum total units of courses offered by that department this year, considering only courses with a non-null total units value and belonging to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, for each course, provide the course number, course description, and the deviation of its total units from the department's average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.COURSE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE AS course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.min_total_units, dept_stats.max_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - dept_stats.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are offered this year, have a non-null total units value, and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, provide the department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department), provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, and for each subject, also include the subject title and total units. Only include departments that have at least one subject offered in 2022FA. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_range, ic.enrolled_variance, ic.enrolled_stddev, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND cso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ;
domain_knowledge: "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6'"
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department (Course 6).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department, give the department name and the total number of units for all subjects in the course catalog that are offered in the fall term and are part of a degree-granting program, and only include departments where this total is greater than the average total units for all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM inner_cte );
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of units for all subjects in the course catalog that are offered in the fall term, are part of a degree-granting program, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the maximum subject enrollment number for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school in the 2022 academic year, but only include schools where all departments grant degrees and exclude any school that contains the Biology department (Course 7). For each school, also include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (school name, null, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) , SchoolStats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , SchoolRollup AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, total_subjects FROM SchoolStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, total_subjects WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ) SELECT sr.SCHOOL_NAME, sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sr.avg_total_units, sr.var_total_units, sr.total_subjects FROM SchoolRollup sr ORDER BY sr.SCHOOL_NAME, sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department in Spring 2016, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, school name, course description, department name, subject code, the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject ID, and also include the total number of Chemistry subjects offered in Spring 2016. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ENROLLED FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLED, total_subjects.Total_Chemistry_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Chemistry_Subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ) AS total_subjects ON 1=1;
sub_questions: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department in Spring 2016, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, school name, course description, department name, subject code, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

question: For each program in the Political Science department that is degree granting, has a non-null department name, and is in Course 17, show the program title, category title, course description, department name, and the average CIP version for each school as a benchmark. Also, indicate whether the program's CIP version is 'HIGH_VERSION' (at least 10% greater than the school average), 'LOW_VERSION' (at least 10% less than the school average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME, CIP.VERSION FROM CIP JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17' ) , school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(VERSION) AS avg_version FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_version AS school_avg_version, CASE WHEN i.VERSION > s.avg_version * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VERSION' WHEN i.VERSION < s.avg_version * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VERSION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS version_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: Show the program title, category title, course description, and department name for each program in the Political Science department, along with dense ranks over the school name ordered by school name, for programs that are degree granting and have a non-null department name, and are in Course 17.
sub_sqls: SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME) AS window_column FROM CIP JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17'

question: For each school, list the school name, the department name, and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by each department in that school, considering only degree-granting departments, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5). For each school, also include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (school name, null, total statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING (DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL OR (DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL)) ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: Show the school name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school (excluding subjects from the "Biology" department), and for each such school, list the department names and the total number of unique subjects offered by each department. Only include schools that have a department named "Political Science". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH schools_with_ps AS ( SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ), subject_units AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subjects.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN ( SELECT sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso2.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_subjects ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each school, give the school name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school, but only include schools that have a department named "Political Science" and exclude subjects offered by the "Biology" department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: WITH schools_with_ps AS ( SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ), subject_units AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

question: For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry and only including degree-granting departments), list the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and the number of unique subjects offered by that department, but only include departments where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled ORDER BY ic.total_enrolled DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total number of units greater than 1, in the Political Science department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school name group, and for each school name, report the maximum running sum of total units among its subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER ( PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_sum_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(running_sum_total_units) AS max_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total number of units greater than 1, in the Political Science department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school name group, ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject offered in the 'Engineering' school with total units greater than 0, and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department (Course 6), show the subject title, total units, department name, course description, and the number of subjects per offer department code, but only include offer department codes that have more than 5 such subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) dept_counts ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE;
domain_knowledge: "Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
"Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
sub_questions: Show the subject title, total units, department name, and course description for each subject, along with dense ranks over the offer department code ordered by offer department code, for subjects offered in the 'Engineering' school, with total units greater than 0, and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department (Course 6).
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

question: For each department that grants degrees and is in the School of Science, what is the department name, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and the total number of such subjects? Only include departments with at least 5 such subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and only for departments that grant degrees, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: For each building in CAMBRIDGE that is used as a residence (excluding buildings named "Ashdown"), what is the maximum number of rooms recorded in its building history for any fiscal period? Show the building number from the address, the address purpose, the city, the postal code, the building name, the building type, the building use, the building's gross area, and the maximum number of rooms from the building history, ordered by building key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, MIN(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS MIN_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' ) SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, EXT_GROSS_AREA, MAX(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS MAX_NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, EXT_GROSS_AREA ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "used as a residence" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'"
sub_questions: For building addresses in the city of CAMBRIDGE, that are used as a residence, show the building number from the address, the address purpose, the city, the postal code, the building name, the building type, the building use, the building's gross area, the fiscal period from the building history, the number of rooms from the building history, and the minimum assignable area from the building history over each building key group, ordered by building key, and exclude buildings named "Ashdown".
sub_sqls: SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, MIN(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS MIN_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering with a course level of 'G', offered by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course description, department name, program title, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, but only include those courses where the program's category code is 11. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.PROGRAM_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM CIP t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.PROGRAM_CODE = t1.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.PROGRAM_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN CIP t2 ON inner_cte.PROGRAM_TITLE = t2.PROGRAM_TITLE WHERE t2.CATEGORY_CODE = 11;
domain_knowledge: "Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
sub_questions: For courses in the School of Engineering with a course level of 'G', offered by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course description, department name, program title, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description. Only include courses that are degree-granting.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.PROGRAM_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM CIP t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.PROGRAM_CODE = t1.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

question: From the top 10 schools with the highest average total units for Mathematics (Course 18) courses, display each school's name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for those courses, as well as the department in that school with the highest average total units for degree-granting departments and courses with more than 0 total units, and the average total units for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, dmax.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, dmax.avg_total_units AS Top_Department_Avg_Units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dmax ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dmax.SCHOOL_NAME AND dmax.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by each department in that school, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with more than 0 total units, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each city, among buildings used as residences (excluding the Stata building), what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area for each building (considering only buildings with a nonzero average assignable area), and for each city, which building has the highest average assignable area? Provide the city name, the building name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for that building, and the average assignable area. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING avg_assignable_area > 0 ) SELECT ic.CITY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, ic.stddev_assignable_area / ic.avg_assignable_area AS coefficient_of_variation, ic.avg_assignable_area FROM ( SELECT CITY, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, avg_assignable_area, stddev_assignable_area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CITY ORDER BY avg_assignable_area DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ic.rn = 1;
domain_knowledge: "used as a residence" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'"
sub_questions: For each city, give the city name and the coefficient of variation of the assignable area of buildings located in that city, considering only buildings with a nonzero average assignable area and only including buildings that are used as a residence and are not the Stata building.
sub_sqls: WITH building_stats AS ( SELECT fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING avg_assignable_area > 0 ) SELECT CITY, STDDEV(avg_assignable_area) / AVG(avg_assignable_area) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM building_stats GROUP BY CITY;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects that are offered in the Fall term, have at least 1 enrolled student, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and also show the difference between the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for each year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, (inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students - inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students) AS avg_minus_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects that are offered in the Fall term, have at least 1 enrolled student, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and where the department is degree granting, but exclude the Mathematics department (Course 18). Then, for each school, show the school name and the highest average number of enrolled students per department (as calculated previously) among its departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_enrolled_students) AS highest_avg_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and where the department is degree granting, but exclude the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department in the "Provost Area" (excluding "Political Science"), what is the maximum organization number and the name of the associated space unit, considering only those departments where the maximum organization number is greater than 50000? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_organization_number, su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 AND mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT department, max_organization_number, space_unit_name FROM inner_cte WHERE max_organization_number > 50000 ORDER BY department;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum organization number and the name of the space unit associated with that department, considering only departments in the "Provost Area" with a maximum organization number greater than 50000, and excluding the "Political Science" department (Course 17)?
sub_sqls: SELECT mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_organization_number, su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 AND mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY mdh.DLC_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in each academic year for terms that are regular terms and for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and for each academic year, which subject had the highest total units, and what is its subject title? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, cso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_with_max_units, cso.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.SUBJECT_ID, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = ( SELECT MAX(cso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = cso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND cso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in each academic year for terms that are regular terms and for subjects offered by the Mathematics department?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Biology department), which offers graduate-level courses, what is the average number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and which subjects have an enrollment above this departmental average? Please provide the department name, subject title, and the number of enrolled students for these subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses that are at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology department? Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, and the variance of enrolled students.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each IAP activity offered in the 2021 January term that is associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, what is the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, along with the activity title, the term description, and the subject title of the subject with the maximum lecture units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, MAX(CASE WHEN LECTURE_UNITS = (SELECT MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) FROM inner_cte ic2 WHERE ic2.ACTIVITY_TITLE = inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND ic2.TERM_DESCRIPTION = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) THEN SUBJECT_TITLE ELSE NULL END) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;
sub_questions: For each IAP activity offered in the 2021 January term that is associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, what is the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, along with the activity title and the term description?
sub_sqls: SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;

question: For each academic year, what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, the term description for the corresponding term, and the subject short title, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.max_total_units AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, and what is the term description for the corresponding term, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

question: For rooms in the Stata building (building 32) in buildings with an access level of 2, show the room key, building key, floor, major use description, area, and the average area over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the floor's sort sequence and ordered by the room's area, but only include rooms whose area is greater than the average area for their floor. Exclude rooms whose major use description includes 'STORAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA, ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' ) SELECT i.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, i.FLOOR, i.MAJOR_USE_DESC, i.AREA, AVG(i.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ORDER BY i.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_area_window FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, AVG(AREA) AS avg_floor_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ) favg ON i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE = favg.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE WHERE i.AREA > favg.avg_floor_area ORDER BY i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, i.AREA;
domain_knowledge: "exclude usage types that include 'STORAGE'" is predicated by "TABLE.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'"
sub_questions: For rooms in the Stata building (building 32) in buildings with an access level of 2, show the room key, building key, floor, major use description, area, and the average area over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the floor's sort sequence and ordered by the room's area, but exclude rooms whose major use description includes 'STORAGE'.
sub_sqls: SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA, AVG(fr.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ORDER BY fr.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_area_window FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' ORDER BY ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, fr.AREA;

question: For each course and its department where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique course descriptions and the minimum CIP program code, and also include the school name and the department's full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.course_description_count, ic.min_cip_program_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each course and its department where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique course descriptions and the minimum CIP program code.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Biology, Course 7) with the highest average total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, display each department's name, its average and variance of total units, the subject with the highest total units in that department for 2022, and the total units of that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the subject title from the library subject offered table, the offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group, and the responsible faculty name from the library subject offered table. Do not repeat the master subject ID if it is the same as the previous row. Order the results by master subject ID and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE) = MASTER_SUBJECT_ID THEN NULL ELSE MASTER_SUBJECT_ID END AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the subject title from the library subject offered table, the offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group, ordered by master subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ORDER BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each type of space usage, provide the space usage name, the building room name, and calculate the average, range, and variance of the room square footage for all rooms with a room counter of 1 that are located in the Stata building. For each space usage, include a grand total for all rooms of that usage type in the format of (space usage, null, total statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_COUNTER = 1 AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 ) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_square_footage, MAX(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) - MIN(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_range, VARIANCE(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME
sub_questions: For each type of space usage, provide the space usage name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the room square footage for all rooms with a room counter of 1 that are located in the Stata building.
sub_sqls: SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_square_footage, MAX(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) - MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_range, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_variance FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_COUNTER = 1 AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY square_footage_range DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science), that has at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, list the department name, the total count of unique subject titles, and the total number of enrolled students across all their subjects. Show only the top 10 departments by the number of unique subject titles. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered, including the department name and the total count of unique subject titles, for departments that are degree granting, have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, and exclude the Political Science department (Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: List the minimum room square footage, the total number of rooms, and the most common building component for all spaces used as research centers in the Stata building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS min_square_footage, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_rooms, sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT ) SELECT min_square_footage, total_rooms, BUILDING_COMPONENT FROM inner_cte WHERE total_rooms = ( SELECT MAX(total_rooms) FROM inner_cte );
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"
sub_questions: What is the minimum room square footage and the total number of rooms for all spaces used as research centers in the Stata building?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS min_square_footage, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32;

question: For each organization whose organization level is 5 and is not 'ADMISSIONS', show the organization name, description, the corresponding space unit name, and the total number of space units associated with each organization, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND t0.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(SPACE_UNIT) OVER (PARTITION BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS total_space_units FROM inner_cte;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
sub_questions: For each organization whose organization level is 5 and is not 'ADMISSIONS', show the organization name, description, the corresponding space unit name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the space unit name, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND t0.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')

question: For each academic building, provide the building's long name, the floor number, and calculate the range and variance of the area of rooms located on each floor of that building, considering only rooms with an access level of 1 or 2, and only include buildings that are the Fairchild Building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR;
sub_questions: For each building, provide the building's long name and calculate the range and variance of the area of rooms located in that building, considering only rooms with an access level of 1 or 2, and only include buildings that are academic buildings and are the Fairchild Building.
sub_sqls: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' by departments that are degree granting and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students, and the full name of the department offering the subject. Only include courses with materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' by departments that are degree granting and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students, and only include courses with materials.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ;

question: For each building type and campus sector, what is the building type name, campus sector, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of rooms in building history records for buildings of that type and sector, considering only buildings at MIT and excluding buildings named "Ashdown House"? Include subtotals for each building type (the corresponding campus sector field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all building types (the corresponding campus sector field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the building type if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by building type and campus sector. Do not return any rounded answers.
