sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR AS campus_sector, VARIANCE(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building_type_name) OVER (ORDER BY building_type_sort, campus_sector_sort) = building_type_name THEN NULL ELSE building_type_name END AS building_type_name, campus_sector, num_of_rooms_variance, num_of_rooms_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE building_type_name END AS building_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE campus_sector END AS campus_sector, CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE campus_sector END AS campus_sector_sort, building_type_name, VARIANCE(num_of_rooms_variance) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(num_of_rooms_stddev) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY building_type_name, campus_sector WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY building_type_sort, campus_sector_sort;
sub_questions: For each building type, what is the building type name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the number of rooms in building history records for buildings of that type, considering only buildings at MIT and excluding buildings named "Ashdown House"?
sub_sqls: SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, VARIANCE(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department of Engineering or Science (or the Department of Mathematics), and indicate whether the department is a 'LARGE_DEPARTMENT' (if the total enrolled students is at least 50% greater than the average total enrolled students across these departments), a 'SMALL_DEPARTMENT' (if at least 30% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only include departments that grant degrees. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students >= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 1.5 THEN 'LARGE_DEPARTMENT' WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students <= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 0.7 THEN 'SMALL_DEPARTMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_size_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled_students) AS avg_total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department of Engineering or Science, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 20, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and to the Department of Mathematics.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20;

question: For each floor in the Stata building (building 32), what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage, for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, where the largest room square footage is greater than 100, and also provide the floor name and room name only if the floor has more than 2 rooms with square footage greater than 100? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = ( SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' ) ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT sd.FLOOR_KEY, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.FLOOR_KEY ) SELECT icte.FLOOR_NAME, icte.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, icte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN RoomCounts rc ON icte.FLOOR_KEY = rc.FLOOR_KEY WHERE rc.ROOM_COUNT > 2 ORDER BY icte.FLOOR_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"
sub_questions: For each floor, what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage, for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, with a largest room square footage greater than 100, and only for rooms in the Stata building (building 32)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = ( SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' ) ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME;

question: For each academic building at MIT, give the building key, the total assignable area across all its historical records, and the building's long name, considering only those buildings whose total assignable area is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total assignable area for all buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH total_assignable AS ( SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fbh.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = fb.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(total_assignable_area) AS mean_assignable, STDDEV(total_assignable_area) AS stddev_assignable FROM total_assignable ) SELECT ta.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ta.total_assignable_area FROM total_assignable ta CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE ta.total_assignable_area > s.mean_assignable + s.stddev_assignable ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_assignable_area, fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ;
sub_questions: For each building at MIT, give the building key and the total assignable area across all its historical records, considering only those buildings whose total assignable area is more than one standard deviation above the mean total assignable area for all buildings, and only include buildings that are academic buildings.
sub_sqls: WITH total_assignable AS ( SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fbh.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = fb.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(total_assignable_area) AS mean_assignable, STDDEV(total_assignable_area) AS stddev_assignable FROM total_assignable ) SELECT ta.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ta.total_assignable_area FROM total_assignable ta CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE ta.total_assignable_area > s.mean_assignable + s.stddev_assignable ;

question: For each degree-granting department with a department budget code greater than 100000, excluding the Mathematics and Physics departments, list the department name, total clearing cost collector, and the department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_clearing_cost_collector, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total clearing cost collector for departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, are not the Mathematics department, and are not the Physics department.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology, Course 7), give the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, the average total units for that department as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 10% greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if it is at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in each term of that year, considering only terms that are regular terms, are not in the future, and where the subjects are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each term, what is the most common grade type among these Mathematics subjects and how many subjects have that grade type? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, gt.Most_Common_Grade_Type, gt.Grade_Type_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE AS Most_Common_Grade_Type, COUNT(*) AS Grade_Type_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE HAVING COUNT(*) = ( SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND at2.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE AND at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at2.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso2.GRADE_TYPE ) sub ) ) gt ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = gt.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = gt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ic.TERM_CODE = gt.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in each term of that year, considering only terms that are regular terms, are not in the future, and where the subjects are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department, list the department name, the number of graduate students named Zoe whose department is degree-granting and offers at least one course with more than 6 total units, the school name, and the department phone number. Include a subtotal row for all departments (the department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total row (the department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, num_zoe_grad_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_zoe_grad_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN inner_cte ON msd.DEPARTMENT = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT AND msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS = inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dept_sort;
sub_questions: How many graduate students named Zoe are in the MIT student directory whose department is degree-granting, who are in departments that offer at least one course with more than 6 total units, and whose department is Political Science?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_zoe_grad_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, term description, and the number of subjects per term. For each department and academic year, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (null, department name, academic year, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), SubjectCounts AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects FROM SubjectCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN TERM_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_subjects FROM RollupResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION ;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mechanical Engineering), provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, and also include the total number of administrative departments linked to each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_admin_departments FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, but only for departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Mechanical Engineering department (Course 2).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a non-null department name, are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and have at least one required textbook (TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ')? Also, include the number of such subjects per academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE) GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a non-null department name, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average total units for all courses offered by that school, the average total units for all courses in the same department as each course, and classify each course as 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' if its total units are at least 10% greater than the department average, 'BELOW_AVERAGE' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only include schools that do not offer courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), schools_with_math AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), department_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG WHERE TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_units, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.dept_avg_units, CASE WHEN ic.TOTAL_UNITS > da.dept_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ic.TOTAL_UNITS < da.dept_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN schools_with_math swm ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = swm.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN department_avg da ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE swm.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.dept_avg_units, ic.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For each school, give the school name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for all courses offered by that school, but only include schools that do not offer courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: WITH school_course_stats AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), schools_with_math AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT scs.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(scs.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(scs.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM school_course_stats scs LEFT JOIN schools_with_math swm ON scs.SCHOOL_NAME = swm.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE swm.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scs.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME ;

question: For each school, show the school name and the highest dense rank of administrative department names among all degree-granting graduate-level courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(admin_dept_dense_rank) AS highest_admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: Show the course description, department name, and school name for each course in the Mathematics department, along with dense ranks over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name, for courses that are degree granting, have a course level of 'G', and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ;

question: For each department offering a course, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student, have a material status of 'RQ', are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department, and also have a corresponding library reserve material with a material status of 'U'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.department = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each department offering a course, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student, have a material status of 'RQ', and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department?
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the full department name, but restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 10 schools with the highest average total units for subjects offered by departments in that school (considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department), display each school's name, average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, as well as the department within that school with the highest number of such subjects and the count of those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ict.SCHOOL_NAME, ict.avg_total_units, ict.var_total_units, ict.stddev_total_units, ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) ict LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON ict.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_stats.SCHOOL_NAME AND ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ict.avg_total_units DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.COURSE = scd.COURSE

question: For each organization and HR department, excluding organizations with IDs '138' and '250', provide the organization name, HR department name, the average and variance of the HR department IDs for all associated HR org units that are not part of the Cambridge-MIT Institute. Include subtotals for each organization (the corresponding HR department name is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all organizations (the corresponding HR department name is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the organization name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by organization name and HR department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(organization_name) OVER (ORDER BY org_sort, dept_sort) = organization_name THEN NULL ELSE organization_name END AS organization_name, hr_department_name, avg_department_id, department_id_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE organization_name END AS org_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE hr_department_name END AS hr_department_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE hr_department_name END AS dept_sort, organization_name, AVG(HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS avg_department_id, VARIANCE(HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS department_id_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY organization_name, hr_department_name WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY org_sort, dept_sort;

question: For the top 5 academic buildings at MIT with the highest number of floors that have at least one room, provide each building's long name, the total number of such floors, the range and variance of the assignable area of these floors, and the floor with the largest assignable area along with its assignable area. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH floors_with_rooms AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR ), academic_buildings AS ( SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fwr.FLOOR, fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM academic_buildings ab JOIN floors_with_rooms fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), floor_stats AS ( SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, COUNT(*) AS num_floors, MAX(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ), max_floor AS ( SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FLOOR AS max_assignable_area_floor, ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS max_assignable_area FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS max_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) m ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA = m.max_area ) SELECT fs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fs.num_floors, fs.assignable_area_range, fs.assignable_area_variance, mf.max_assignable_area_floor, mf.max_assignable_area FROM floor_stats fs LEFT JOIN max_floor mf ON fs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = mf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fs.num_floors DESC LIMIT 5;
sub_questions: For each academic building at MIT, give the building's long name and calculate the range and variance of the assignable area of its floors that have at least one room.
sub_sqls: WITH floors_with_rooms AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR ), academic_buildings AS ( SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM academic_buildings ab JOIN floors_with_rooms fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ORDER BY ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ;

question: For each administrative department and academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department in that year, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with total units greater than 0, and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department (Course 2)? Also, include the school name and department phone number for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each administrative department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with total units greater than 0, and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department (Course 2)?

question: From the top 10 schools with the highest average CIP program codes for degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), display each school's name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes, the department with the most degree-granting courses in that school, and the count of such courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, STDDEV(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_cip_code, ic.cip_code_stddev, dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dmc.Course_Count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_cip_code, cip_code_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_cip_code DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dmc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dmc.SCHOOL_NAME AND dmc.Course_Count = ( SELECT MAX(sub.Course_Count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s2 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c2 ON s2.SUBJECT_CODE = c2.COURSE WHERE c2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s2.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) ORDER BY ic.avg_cip_code DESC;
sub_questions: For each school, give the school name and find the average and standard deviation of the CIP program codes for degree-granting courses offered by departments in that school, but only include courses from the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, STDDEV(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_stddev DESC;

question: For each department, what is the minimum total units and average lecture units for subjects where the total units are between 6 and 15 or the lecture units are at least 3, only including departments whose department code is not 'NIE' and that are degree-granting, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Then, for each department, what is the highest average lecture units among these departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sdo ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 15 OR ccso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3) AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE != 'NIE' AND sdo.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(avg_lecture_units) AS highest_avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: What are the minimum total units and average lecture units for each department, considering only subjects where the total units are between 6 and 15 or the lecture units are at least 3, and only including departments whose department code is not 'NIE' and that are degree-granting, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sdo ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 15 OR ccso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3) AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE != 'NIE' AND sdo.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

question: For each academic building at MIT, show the building name, the total number of rooms with access level 1 or 2, and the average and variance of the area of those rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, r.AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN inner_cte ic ON b.BUILDING_NAME = ic.BUILDING_NAME WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY total_rooms DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic building at MIT, give the building name and calculate the average and variance of the area of its rooms for rooms with an access level of 1 or 2.
sub_sqls: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

question: For each department that offered at least one tip subject in the term '2019FA', what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered by that department, and what is the total number of library subjects offered by that department in that term? Only include departments that offered at least 5 library subjects in '2019FA'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_library_subjects FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have at least one tip subject offered in the term '2019FA', and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2019FA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, the full department name, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group, ordered by the offering department name, and only include courses with materials. Additionally, for each subject title, include a grand total of enrolled students across all offering departments in the format of (subject title, null, null, null, total enrolled students). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, rr.window_column, rr.total_enrolled FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ;
