question: For each DLC key and major organization, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key and major organization, considering only DLC keys and major organizations that are not null, organizations that have a non-null organization name, and excluding organizations with the name 'ADMISSIONS'? Include subtotals for each DLC key (the corresponding DLC key field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all DLC keys (the corresponding DLC key field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the DLC key if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by DLC key and major organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, fo.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fdlk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fo.MAJOR_ORG IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY, fo.MAJOR_ORG ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dlc_key) OVER (ORDER BY dlc_key_sort, dlc_key, major_org_sort) = dlc_key THEN NULL ELSE dlc_key END AS dlc_key, major_org, org_count_range, org_count_variance, org_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 1 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dlc_key END AS dlc_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 0 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 1 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE dlc_key END AS dlc_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 0 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE major_org END AS major_org_sort, major_org, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dlc_key, major_org WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dlc_key_sort, major_org_sort;
domain_knowledge: "Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"
sub_questions: For each DLC key, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key, considering only DLC keys that are not null, organizations that have a non-null organization name, and excluding organizations with the name 'ADMISSIONS'?
sub_sqls: SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC;

question: For each department hierarchy, what is the department hierarchy name, the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations within that hierarchy (considering only organizations that have a non-null description and excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'), and whether the average organization number is at least 10% higher or lower than the overall average across all hierarchies? Classify each as 'HIGH_AVG_ORG_NUMBER', 'LOW_AVG_ORG_NUMBER', or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.avg_org_number, i.org_number_variance, CASE WHEN i.avg_org_number > o.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVG_ORG_NUMBER' WHEN i.avg_org_number < o.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVG_ORG_NUMBER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_org_number_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_org_number) AS overall_avg FROM inner_cte ) o ORDER BY i.org_number_variance DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"
sub_questions: For each department hierarchy, what is the department hierarchy name, and what are the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations within that hierarchy, considering only organizations that have a non-null description and excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'?
sub_sqls: SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;

question: Show the department names from the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program (excluding Chemistry), the number of unique subjects they offered, and for each, the corresponding term code and the number of subjects offered in the same term in the TIP subject offerings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tip ON so.TERM_CODE = tip.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.num_subjects_offered, tip_counts.num_tip_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT tip.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tip.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tip GROUP BY tip.TERM_CODE ) tip_counts ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = tip_counts.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.num_subjects_offered DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: List the top 10 department names from the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, along with the number of subjects they offered, for departments that also had at least one subject offered in the same term in the TIP subject offerings, but exclude the Chemistry department.
sub_sqls: SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tip ON so.TERM_CODE = tip.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC LIMIT 10

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the term description for each term included? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, aca.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, aca.TERM_CODE HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, aca.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and departments that are degree granting, but excluding the Chemistry department), and the number of graduate students in that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and departments that are degree granting, but excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each HGN code in the Political Science department, what is the department name, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table, for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units, and only include those where the subject is also present in the SUBJECT_OFFERED table for the same year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ) SELECT i.HGN_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_lecture_units, i.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON i.HGN_CODE = so.HGN_CODE AND so.TERM_CODE LIKE '2012%'
sub_questions: For each HGN code in the Political Science department, what is the department name, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table, for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units?
sub_sqls: SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the highest variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department across all terms, considering only degree-granting courses and excluding the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LSO.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LSO.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_students_variance) AS highest_enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_students_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department during the term '2014FA', considering only degree-granting courses and excluding the Chemistry department?
sub_sqls: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program in 2012, what is the average total number of units for subjects with a cluster type of "SWE: School-Wide Electives", and how does each department's average compare to the overall average? Classify each department as 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' if its average is at least 10% higher than the overall average, 'BELOW_AVERAGE' if at least 10% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE LIKE '2012%' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) , overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.avg_units, o.overall_avg_units, CASE WHEN d.avg_units > o.overall_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN d.avg_units < o.overall_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_performance FROM dept_avg d CROSS JOIN overall_avg o;
sub_questions: How many subjects offered in 2012 as part of the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, in the Chemistry department, had a cluster type of "SWE: School-Wide Electives" and a total number of units greater than 6?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS swe_electives_over_6_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE LIKE '2012%' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry';

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering with a non-null budget code, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department budget code, and what is the corresponding administrative department name? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the standard deviation of the department budget code, and what is the corresponding administrative department name, considering only departments that are degree granting, have a non-null budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms, show the building name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, along with the total assignable area of the building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.area_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each building at MIT, provide the building name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, considering only academic buildings with more than 10 rooms.
sub_sqls: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and for Mathematics (Course 18) subjects offered in terms where the material status is 'U', what is the geometric mean of the total units, and how does this geometric mean deviate from the average geometric mean across all academic years? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.geometric_mean_total_units, (i.geometric_mean_total_units - s.avg_geometric_mean) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) s ON 1=1 ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the material status is 'U' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the minimum, maximum, and average number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have at least one TIP material, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, AVG(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have at least one TIP material, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: WITH tip_counts AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ), per_year_stats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) - MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS range_tip_materials, VARIANCE(tc.num_tip_materials) AS var_tip_materials, STDDEV(tc.num_tip_materials) AS stddev_tip_materials FROM tip_counts tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, range_tip_materials, var_tip_materials, stddev_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that have a non-null subject title, belong to degree-granting departments, and are offered in the current academic year, show the department full name, subject title, subject code description, school name, and the total number of such courses per department. Only include departments with at least 5 such courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_course_counts.total_courses FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) dept_course_counts ON ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = dept_course_counts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME
sub_questions: Show the department full name, subject title, subject code description, and school name, along with dense ranks over department code ordered by department code, for courses that have a non-null subject title, belong to departments that grant degrees, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

question: For each building type, what is the building type name, the geometric mean of the area of rooms (AREA) in buildings of that type (considering only rooms with area greater than 0 and buildings with more than 0 rooms), and the total number of rooms per building type, only including buildings that are academic buildings and are located at MIT? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, EXP(AVG(LOG(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ) SELECT inner_cte.building_type_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_area, Total_Rooms.total_rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ) AS Total_Rooms ON inner_cte.building_type_name = Total_Rooms.building_type_name;
sub_questions: For each building type, what is the building type name and the geometric mean of the area of rooms (AREA) in buildings of that type, considering only rooms with area greater than 0 and buildings with more than 0 rooms, and only including buildings that are academic buildings and are located at MIT?
sub_sqls: SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, EXP(AVG(LOG(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ;

question: For each IAP activity offered in the 2021 January term that is associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, show the activity title, the term description, the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, and the total number of such Mathematics subjects per activity. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(inner_cte.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_math_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(inner_cte.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;
sub_questions: For each IAP activity offered in the 2021 January term that is associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, what is the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, along with the activity title and the term description?
sub_sqls: SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;

question: For each department that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021, excluding the Chemistry department, list the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and for each subject, show the subject code, subject code description, and the course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects_offered, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY inner_cte.num_subjects_offered DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021, excluding the Chemistry department, provide the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each school, among the departments (excluding the Political Science department), which department has the highest variance in subject codes, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the subject codes for that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Department_With_Highest_Subject_Code_Variance, stats.subject_code_variance, stats.subject_code_stddev FROM ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SIGNED)) AS subject_code_variance, STDDEV(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SIGNED)) AS subject_code_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ssc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) stats JOIN inner_cte ic ON stats.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME AND stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(subject_code_variance) AS max_variance FROM ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SIGNED)) AS subject_code_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ssc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) maxvar ON stats.SCHOOL_NAME = maxvar.SCHOOL_NAME AND stats.subject_code_variance = maxvar.max_variance ORDER BY stats.SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each school, what is the variance and standard deviation of the department budget codes for departments in that school, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_variance, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting, has a course level of 'G', and is offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the course description, department name, school name, and the administrative department name, but only include those courses where the course's CIP program code is greater than the average CIP program code for all degree granting graduate-level courses in the Mathematics department. Also, include a dense rank over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), avg_cip AS ( SELECT AVG(CAST(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cip a WHERE i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > a.avg_cip;
sub_questions: Show the course description, department name, and school name for each course in the Mathematics department, along with dense ranks over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name, for courses that are degree granting, have a course level of 'G', and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments (excluding 'Mathematics'), and also include the total number of courses offered by each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(icte.subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, but only include departments other than 'Mathematics' (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC;

question: For each school, what is the name of the school and the variance of the CIP program code for all courses that are degree granting, have a non-null department name, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each school, provide a grand total variance across all such courses, regardless of department, in the format of (school name, null, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , rollup_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each school, what is the name of the school and the variance of the CIP program code for all courses that are degree granting, have a non-null department name, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the highest total subject enrollment number in any Mathematics (Course 18) subject for that year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the total subject enrollment number is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the range, variance, and standard deviation of total subject enrollment numbers per academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P', the total subject enrollment number is greater than 0, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: List the department names, subject IDs, subject titles, and for each, provide the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

question: For each subject title offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department with a total number of units greater than 0, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department, what is the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject, and what is the average number of enrolled students for those subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.record_count_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each subject title, what is the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject, considering only subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, with a total number of units greater than 0, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department?
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each department and school, list the department name, school name, whether the courses are degree granting, the number of undergraduate courses in that department and school, and include a grand total for all undergraduate courses per department and school in the format of (department name, school name, null, total courses). Only consider courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18) with course level 'U'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, SUM(num_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_courses) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING;
sub_questions: Which department name and school name have the highest number of courses, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a course level of 'U', and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry) that offered at least one subject in the 2021FA term, what is the maximum total units among its offered subjects, the department's full name, and for each such subject, what is the subject code, subject title, and the responsible faculty name? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID ;
sub_questions: For each department that offered at least one subject in the 2021FA term, what is the maximum total units among its offered subjects, and what is the department's full name, considering only degree-granting departments and excluding the Chemistry department?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the total number of courses offered by departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, and are not the Biology department (Course 7), as well as the average department budget code for those departments in each school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.total_courses, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.total_courses ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each school, give the school name and calculate the total number of courses offered by departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, and are not the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the highest average ASCII value of course numbers among its degree-granting departments, excluding the School of Science. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME != 'School of Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_course_number_ascii) AS highest_avg_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

question: For each subject code in the Political Science department, what is the subject code description, the geometric mean of the number of students in each department associated with that subject code (considering only degree-granting departments), and the total number of unique student years represented among those students? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_students DESC;
sub_questions: For each subject code in the Political Science department, what is the subject code description and the geometric mean of the number of students in each department associated with that subject code, considering only departments that are degree granting?
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_students DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department except Chemistry (Course 5), show the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and the corresponding administrative department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each building name, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms in that building, considering only rooms with an access level of 1, buildings located on the MIT site, and only including academic buildings? Additionally, exclude buildings named "Ashdown". For each building, also show the total number of such rooms and indicate whether the building is a 'LARGE_BUILDING' (more than 50 rooms) or 'SMALL_BUILDING' (50 rooms or fewer). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 50 THEN 'LARGE_BUILDING' ELSE 'SMALL_BUILDING' END AS building_size_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev ORDER BY ic.area_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each building name, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the area of rooms in that building, considering only rooms with an access level of 1, buildings located on the MIT site, and only including academic buildings? Additionally, exclude buildings named "Ashdown".
sub_sqls: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, and the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name, but only include those students whose department's full name is longer than the average department full name length across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE LENGTH(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) > ( SELECT AVG(LENGTH(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME)) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT )
