question: List the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units, and the corresponding SIS subject code and subject code description for each department and course level where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), considering only degree-granting courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.COURSE_LEVEL = c.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON c.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each program category, give the category title and calculate the range and variance of the number of unique courses (by course code) associated with each four-digit program title, considering only programs that are degree granting and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Also, for each category, report the average number of unique courses per four-digit program title under the same conditions. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE) AS num_courses FROM CIP c JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE ) SELECT CATEGORY_TITLE, MAX(num_courses) - MIN(num_courses) AS course_count_range, VARIANCE(num_courses) AS course_count_variance, AVG(num_courses) AS avg_courses_per_four_digit_program FROM inner_cte GROUP BY CATEGORY_TITLE ORDER BY course_count_range DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT c.CATEGORY_TITLE, MAX(course_counts.num_courses) - MIN(course_counts.num_courses) AS course_count_range, VARIANCE(course_counts.num_courses) AS course_count_variance FROM CIP c JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT c2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.COURSE) AS num_courses FROM CIP c2 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s2 ON c2.PROGRAM_CODE = s2.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE ) course_counts ON c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE = course_counts.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE ORDER BY course_count_range DESC;

question: For each school, give the school name and the average total units for all courses offered by that school, but only include schools that do not offer courses in the Physics department (Course 8). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) , schools_with_physics AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Physics' ) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_total_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN schools_with_physics swp ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = swp.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE swp.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each school, give the school name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for all courses offered by that school, but only include schools that do not offer courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: WITH school_course_stats AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), schools_with_math AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT scs.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(scs.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(scs.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM school_course_stats scs LEFT JOIN schools_with_math swm ON scs.SCHOOL_NAME = swm.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE swm.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scs.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME ;

question: From the set of students whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6) and whose first name is 'Kevin', show for each student their full name, email address, student year, the department's full name, the course description, the course level, and, for each course, the number of other students in the same department and year who are enrolled in courses at the same level, ordered by the student's last name. question: For each building type, show the building type name and the average, range, and variance of the number of rooms in building history records for buildings of that type that are located on the MIT site and are owned, but exclude buildings that are classified as residential. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE, FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_TYPE, AVG(ic.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms, MAX(ic.NUM_OF_ROOMS) - MIN(ic.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.BUILDING_TYPE = fb.BUILDING_TYPE WHERE fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY num_rooms_range DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and classify the department as 'HIGH_UNIT' if its average total units is at least 10% greater than the overall average, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. question: For each department that offered a subject, provide the department name and the total number of enrolled students in subjects during terms in the academic year 2021 or later, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to the Chemistry and Biology departments. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department and school, what is the number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and which department and school has the highest such number? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, num_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE num_courses = ( SELECT MAX(num_courses) FROM inner_cte );
sub_questions: Which department name and school name have the highest number of courses, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a course level of 'U', and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each building, what is the building name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area across its historical records, and the average non-assignable area across its historical records, considering only buildings with more than 3 historical records, with a nonzero assignable area, and that are academic buildings? Additionally, restrict the results to buildings at MIT. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, h.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev, AVG(NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_non_assignable_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC;
sub_questions: For each building, what is the building name and the standard deviation of the assignable area across its historical records, considering only buildings with more than 3 historical records, with a nonzero assignable area, and that are academic buildings? Additionally, restrict the results to buildings at MIT.
sub_sqls: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC;

question: Show the minimum total units, the sum of lecture units, and the number of unique subjects for letter graded Mathematics department (Course 18) subjects offered in the Spring Term 2021, along with the department name and term description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.sum_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT a.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED a JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL b ON a.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND a.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.sum_lecture_units;
sub_questions: What is the minimum total units and the sum of lecture units for subjects offered in the Spring Term 2021 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each academic year and school, provide the academic year description, school name, and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18). For each academic year, include a grand total for all schools in the format of (academic year, academic year description, null, total range, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND (SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL OR (SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND COUNT(*) > 0)) ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, SCHOOL_NAME
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department, provide the department name, the maximum, minimum, and average number of enrolled students in its offered subjects that have at least one associated course material (excluding those with 'NM' status), but only include the Chemistry and Biology departments (i.e., Course 5 and Course 7). Also, indicate whether the department's average enrollment is above or below 20 students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled, MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 20 THEN 'ABOVE_20' ELSE '20_OR_BELOW' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in its offered subjects that have at least one associated course material, but only include the Chemistry and Biology departments (i.e., Course 5 and Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: From the top 5 departments (excluding Mathematics) with the highest total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during non-current terms, display each department's name, the total number of enrolled students, the subject with the highest enrollment in that department, and the number of students enrolled in that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_enroll.total_enrolled AS Department_Total_Enrolled, subj_enroll.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, subj_enroll.subject_enrolled AS Top_Subject_Enrolled FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC LIMIT 5 ) dept_enroll LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, total_enrolled AS subject_enrolled FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, total_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) subj_enroll ON dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_enroll.total_enrolled DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not the current term, where the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10.
sub_sqls: SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10;

question: For each organization, provide the organization name and the highest average HR department code (old) among its associated HR org units, considering only organizations that are assignable, have a non-null HR department code, and are not the 'ADMISSIONS' organization. Additionally, exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(avg_dept_code) AS highest_avg_dept_code FROM ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ) subquery GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_dept_code DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
sub_questions: For each organization, provide the organization name and calculate the average and variance of the HR department codes for its associated HR org units, considering only organizations that are assignable, have a non-null HR department code, and are not the 'ADMISSIONS' organization. Additionally, exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'.
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS dept_code_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY dept_code_variance DESC;

question: Show the department names, the number of organizations associated with each, and the total number of unique organization descriptions per department, considering only departments that belong to the 'Standard Hierarchy', have a non-null description in their organizations, and excluding organizations with IDs '138' and '250'. Only include departments whose name is 'Political Science' (i.e., Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d ON f.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, COUNT(DISTINCT f.DESCRIPTION) AS unique_org_descriptions FROM inner_cte JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON inner_cte.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d ON f.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count ORDER BY inner_cte.organization_count DESC LIMIT 10;
