sub_questions: List the top 10 department names along with the number of organizations associated with each, considering only departments that belong to the 'Standard Hierarchy', have a non-null description in their organizations, and excluding organizations with IDs '138' and '250'. Additionally, only include departments whose name is 'Political Science' (i.e., Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d ON f.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY organization_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each organization, show the organization name, organization ID, department name, department code, department long name, and the maximum HR organization unit ID for each organization considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by organization ID, but only for departments whose name is "Political Science" (Course 17), and exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. Additionally, for each such result, show the corresponding HR organization unit title and the school/area name from the HR_ORG_UNIT table. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MAX(t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_hr_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NOT NULL AND t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, i.max_hr_org_unit_id, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON i.max_hr_org_unit_id = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
sub_questions: For each organization, show the organization name, organization ID, department name, department code, department long name, and the maximum HR organization unit ID for each organization considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by organization ID, but only for departments whose name is "Political Science" (Course 17), and exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MAX(t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NOT NULL AND t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')

question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, and assign row numbers within each department name group ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and assign row numbers within each department name group ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each academic building, provide the building's long name, the floor number, and calculate the range and variance of the area of rooms located on that floor, considering only rooms with an access level of 1 or 2, and only include floors where the total assignable area is greater than 5000. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 5000
sub_questions: For each building, provide the building's long name and calculate the range and variance of the area of rooms located in that building, considering only rooms with an access level of 1 or 2, and only include buildings that are academic buildings and are the Fairchild Building.
sub_sqls: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG

question: For each building type, show the building type name, the average, range, and variance of the number of rooms in building history records for buildings of that type that are located on the MIT site (excluding residential buildings), and also include the total assignable area for each building type. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE, AVG(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms, MAX(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) - MIN(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_TYPE, inner_cte.avg_num_rooms, inner_cte.num_rooms_range, inner_cte.num_rooms_variance, SUM(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING ON inner_cte.BUILDING_TYPE = FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY inner_cte.BUILDING_TYPE, inner_cte.avg_num_rooms, inner_cte.num_rooms_range, inner_cte.num_rooms_variance ORDER BY total_assignable_area DESC;
sub_questions: For each building type, show the building type name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of rooms in building history records for buildings of that type that are located on the MIT site, but exclude buildings that are classified as residential.
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE, AVG(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms, MAX(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) - MIN(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY num_rooms_range DESC;

question: For each building address in the city of Cambridge, show the building number, address purpose, city, state, postal code, the building name, building type, building use, the maximum number of rooms from the building history for the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by building key, and also show the difference between this maximum number of rooms and the average number of rooms for all academic buildings in Cambridge. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, GREATEST( fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0) ) AS max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' ), avg_rooms_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' ) SELECT i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, i.CITY, i.STATE, i.POSTAL_CODE, i.BUILDING_NAME, i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_USE, i.max_num_of_rooms_3rows, (i.max_num_of_rooms_3rows - a.avg_num_of_rooms) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_rooms_cte a ORDER BY i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, i.FISCAL_PERIOD;
domain_knowledge: "Cambridge" is a city in Massachusetts and is the primary location of MIT's campus, so filtering by t0.CITY = 'Cambridge' is a reasonable external constraint.
sub_questions: For each building address in the city of Cambridge, show the building number, address purpose, city, state, postal code, the building name, building type, building use, and the maximum number of rooms from the building history for the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by building key, but only include buildings that are academic buildings.
sub_sqls: WITH building_hist_stats AS ( SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, GREATEST( fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0) ) AS max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' ) SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, STATE, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM building_hist_stats ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FISCAL_PERIOD;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and have a subject enrollment number greater than the average subject enrollment number for that department and academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department, list the department name, subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, and the total number of unique courses offered by that department and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code
sub_questions: For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year and department, list the academic year, department name, and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous', but only for the Mathematics department (Course 18). For each academic year, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (academic year, null, total units). Only include those rows where the total number of units is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all such combinations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_units) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_units) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units FROM RollupResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, give the academic year, department name, and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous', but only for the Mathematics department (Course 18), and only include those academic year and department combinations where the total number of units is more than one standard deviation above the mean total units across all such combinations.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t );

question: For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) that have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, what is the highest number of unique subject titles they have offered in a single term? Provide the department name and the highest such count for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered, including the department name and the total count of unique subject titles, for departments that are degree granting, have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, and exclude the Political Science department (Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the highest average total units for subjects offered in current or previous terms by each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are current or previous terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms, provide the building name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, along with the total assignable area and the year the building was built. Sort the results by the range of room areas in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each building at MIT, provide the building name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, considering only academic buildings with more than 10 rooms.
sub_sqls: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics) with a non-null department full name, show the department name, the average CIP program code for its courses, the range and variance of CIP program codes, and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% higher than the average variance across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(var_cip_program_code) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_cip_program_code, i.range_cip_program_code, i.var_cip_program_code, CASE WHEN i.var_cip_program_code > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.var_cip_program_code < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark v;
sub_questions: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, but only include departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department full name, and exclude the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each organization that has a non-null description, belongs to the 'Standard Hierarchy' type, is not the 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and where the department is 'Political Science' (Course 17), show the organization name, department name, department code, department hierarchy level 2 name, and the maximum dense rank (partitioned by department long name and ordered by department long name) across all such organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS max_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')"
sub_questions: Show the organization name, department name, department code, and department hierarchy level 2 name for each organization, along with dense ranks partitioned by department long name ordered by department long name, for organizations that have a non-null description, belong to the 'Standard Hierarchy' type, are not the 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and where the department is 'Political Science' (Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'

question: For each organization, what is the organization name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department codes (HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) among its associated HR org units, and the number of unique HR department names among those org units, considering only organizations that have more than 3 associated HR org units, and excluding organizations '138' and '250' as well as any organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS unique_hr_department_names FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.dept_code_stddev DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
sub_questions: For each organization, what is the organization name and the standard deviation of the department codes (HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) among its associated HR org units, considering only organizations that have more than 3 associated HR org units, and excluding organizations '138' and '250' as well as any organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'?
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY dept_code_stddev DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding 'Political Science'), what is the average total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and how does this average compare to the overall average total units for all degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science') in 2022? Provide the department name, the department's average total units, and the deviation from the overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.dept_avg_units, (d.dept_avg_units - o.overall_avg_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM dept_avg d CROSS JOIN overall_avg o;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the 'Political Science' department.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

question: For each building and department, what is the building key, department name, the number of courses, average total units, the minimum and maximum total units of courses held in rooms of that building, considering only courses that are offered this year and have more than 0 total units? Include subtotals for each building (the corresponding building field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all buildings (the corresponding building field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the building key if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by building and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, building, dept_sort) = building THEN NULL ELSE building END AS building, dept, course_count, avg_total_units, min_total_units, max_total_units FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS course_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY building_sort, dept_sort;
sub_questions: For each building, what is the building key and what are both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses held in rooms of that building, considering only courses that are offered this year, have more than 0 total units, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only subjects from terms with a term status indicator of 'P' and with total units greater than 0, and for each subject, indicate whether its total units are at least 10% greater than the academic year's average ('HIGH_UNIT'), at least 10% less than the average ('LOW_UNIT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) , year_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, y.avg_total_units, y.var_total_units, y.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > y.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < y.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN year_stats y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only subjects from terms with a term status indicator of 'P' and with total units greater than 0?
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: Among departments in the School of Engineering that grant degrees (excluding the Department of Management), which departments have a total student enrollment in their offered courses greater than 50, and for each such department, what is the most popular course (by enrollment) they offer and its enrollment count? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Popular_Course, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Course_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 WHERE t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15).
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

question: For each faculty organization with a faculty organization key greater than 100, except organizations '101' and '103', and only for DLCs whose name is 'Political Science', show the faculty organization key, the associated department or lab center (DLC) key, the DLC name, the average faculty organization key within each DLC key group, and the highest department hierarchy level 2 name for each DLC, ordered by faculty organization key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.DLC_KEY, t0.DLC_NAME, AVG(t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY > 100 AND t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY NOT IN ('101', '103') AND t0.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.window_column, MAX(mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME) AS max_level_2_name FROM inner_cte icte JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh ON icte.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.window_column ORDER BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
domain_knowledge: "except organizations '101' and '103'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('101', '103')"
sub_questions: For each faculty organization with a faculty organization key greater than 100, except organizations '101' and '103', show the faculty organization key, the associated department or lab center (DLC) key, the DLC name, and the average faculty organization key within each DLC key group, but only for DLCs whose name is 'Political Science', ordered by faculty organization key.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.DLC_KEY, t0.DLC_NAME, AVG(t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY > 100 AND t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY NOT IN ('101', '103') AND t0.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department), what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and what is the average subject enrollment for those subjects? Only include departments with more than one subject in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each DLC name, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers among organizations associated with that DLC, considering only organizations that have a non-null organization number, are assignable, and are in the history department, excluding organizations '138' and '250'? Additionally, for each DLC, what is the total number of organizations meeting these criteria, and what percentage of these organizations have an organization number greater than 50000? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, o.ORGANIZATION_ID FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT ic.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_orgs_over_50000 FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"
sub_questions: For each DLC name, what is the variance and standard deviation of the organization numbers among organizations associated with that DLC, considering only organizations that have a non-null organization number, are assignable, and are in the history department, excluding organizations '138' and '250'?
sub_sqls: SELECT o.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than the average number of enrolled students for that department, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled;
sub_questions: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, Course 6), provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, along with the school name and department phone number. Only include departments that offered at least one subject in 2022FA. Sort the results by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6'"
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department (Course 6).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each result, include the school name and the department phone number. Sort the results by variance in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department or lab center (DLC) whose name is 'Political Science', show the DLC key, the DLC name, and the highest average faculty organization key among all faculty organizations with a faculty organization key greater than 100, except organizations '101' and '103', grouped by DLC key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.DLC_KEY, t0.DLC_NAME, AVG(t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY > 100 AND t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY NOT IN ('101', '103') AND t0.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT DLC_KEY, DLC_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_avg_fclt_org_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_KEY, DLC_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "except organizations '101' and '103'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('101', '103')"
sub_questions: For each faculty organization with a faculty organization key greater than 100, except organizations '101' and '103', show the faculty organization key, the associated department or lab center (DLC) key, the DLC name, and the average faculty organization key within each DLC key group, but only for DLCs whose name is 'Political Science', ordered by faculty organization key.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.DLC_KEY, t0.DLC_NAME, AVG(t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY > 100 AND t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY NOT IN ('101', '103') AND t0.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

question: For each department and school, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are offered this year, have a non-null total units value, and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, provide the department name and school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are offered this year, have a non-null total units value, and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, provide the department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each HASS attribute, what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year by the Political Science department, along with the HASS attribute's description as shown on the form and the description in the bulletin? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, a.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE a ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = a.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, a.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM ) SELECT ic.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, ic.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, a.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE a ON ic.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = a.HASS_ATTRIBUTE ORDER BY ic.units_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each HASS attribute, what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year by the Political Science department, along with the HASS attribute's description as shown on the form?
sub_sqls: SELECT c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, a.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE a ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = a.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, a.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM ORDER BY units_range DESC;

question: For each school, list the school name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school, but only include schools that have a department named "Political Science" and exclude subjects offered by the "Biology" department (Course 7). Additionally, for each school, show the number of unique departments (excluding Biology) that offer subjects, and include a grand total row for all schools in the format (null, overall coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), overall department count). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH schools_with_ps AS ( SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ), subject_units AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, coefficient_of_variation, department_count FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count FROM ( SELECT su.TOTAL_UNITS, su.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ( SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) su ) overall
sub_questions: For each school, give the school name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school, but only include schools that have a department named "Political Science" and exclude subjects offered by the "Biology" department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: WITH schools_with_ps AS ( SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ), subject_units AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

question: For each Mathematics department subject that is offered in the fall term and has a material status of 'U', what is the subject id, the minimum number of lecture units, the total sum of total units, and the deviation of its lecture units from the average lecture units of all such subjects? Please use data from the library reserve material details, academic terms, and course catalog subject offered tables. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(ic.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, (ic.LECTURE_UNITS - avg_lecture.avg_lecture_units) AS deviation_from_avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte ) avg_lecture ON 1=1 GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, avg_lecture.avg_lecture_units;
sub_questions: What is the minimum number of lecture units and the total sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a material status of 'U', and are in the Mathematics department? Please use data from the library reserve material details, academic terms, and course catalog subject offered tables.
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each department in the current academic term, what is the maximum subject enrollment number, the term start date, and the total number of subjects offered by the department, considering only departments where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5 and the department is Mathematics? Additionally, for each term start date, include a grand total of all subjects offered across all departments in the format of (null, term start date, null, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ), subject_counts AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_START_DATE, ic.max_enrollment, sc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN subject_counts sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.TERM_START_DATE = sc.TERM_START_DATE UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS max_enrollment, SUM(sc.total_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM subject_counts sc GROUP BY sc.TERM_START_DATE ORDER BY TERM_START_DATE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department in the current academic term, what is the maximum subject enrollment number and the term start date, considering only departments where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5 and the department is Mathematics?
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, and also include the total number of Chemistry subjects offered in '2014FA'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Chemistry.Total_Chemistry_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_Chemistry_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ) AS Total_Chemistry ON 1=1;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, but only include subjects where the offer department name is 'Chemistry'.
