sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t );

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and for subjects offered in the fall term by the Mathematics department (Course 18) that are not variable units, what is the average total units for that year, and for each subject in that year, what is the deviation of its total units from the average? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, a.avg_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID ;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, are not variable units, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, and the offering school name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department. Also, include the total number of such Mathematics subjects in the term, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Math_Subjects.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Math_Subjects ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Math_Subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department, what is the minimum department number, the average CIP program code, and whether the average CIP program code is 'HIGH_CIP' (at least 10% greater than 120000), 'LOW_CIP' (at least 10% less than 120000), or 'AVERAGE', considering only departments where the department number is between 5 and 22 or the CIP program code is at least 110102, and the school code is 'E' or 'Z', excluding Chemistry and Biology departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT, MIN(scd.DEPARTMENT) AS min_department_number, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ( (scd.DEPARTMENT BETWEEN 5 AND 22) OR (scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE >= 110102) ) AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE IN ('E', 'Z') AND scd.DEPARTMENT NOT IN (5, 7) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT, inner_cte.min_department_number, inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code > 120000 * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code < 120000 * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS cip_category FROM inner_cte;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: What are the minimum department number and average CIP program code for each department, where department numbers are between 5 and 22 or CIP program codes are at least 110102, and school codes are 'E' or 'Z', excluding departments of Chemistry and Biology?
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT, MIN(scd.DEPARTMENT) AS min_department_number, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ( (scd.DEPARTMENT BETWEEN 5 AND 22) OR (scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE >= 110102) ) AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE IN ('E', 'Z') AND scd.DEPARTMENT NOT IN (5, 7) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT;

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, and the department is either Chemistry or Biology, provide the count of subjects, the minimum start date of the term, and the term description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.department, ic.academic_year, ic.subject_count, ic.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.academic_year ORDER BY ic.department, ic.academic_year;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, and the department is either Chemistry or Biology, provide the count of subjects and the minimum start date of the term.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry), what is the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year, and only include those departments where the average enrollment is greater than 20? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > 20 ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', and excluding organizations with ORGANIZATION_ID '138' and '250', what is the highest number of organizations found for any department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name combination, and what is the minimum organization number for that combination? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT MAX(organization_count) AS highest_organization_count, MIN(min_organization_number) AS min_organization_number FROM inner_cte;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
sub_questions: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', and excluding organizations with ORGANIZATION_ID '138' and '250', give the number of organizations and the minimum organization number.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units of all Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with more than zero total units, and the number of library reserve materials associated with those subjects in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS NUM_LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATERIALS FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units of all subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero total units, and are in the Mathematics department?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each course in the 'Political Science' department at the graduate level where the subject code description is not null, list the subject code description, subject department name, subject school name, course description, course department name, course school name, course level, and also show the number of courses in the same school as that course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 WHERE scd2.SCHOOL_NAME = inner_cte.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME AND scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' ) AS num_courses_in_same_school FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: List the subject code description, department name, and school name from the subject code table, and the course description, department name, school name, and the course level, along with dense ranks over the course level ordered by course level, for courses where the subject code description is not null, the course level is 'G', and the department name is 'Political Science' (Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and list only those academic years where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units for all such subjects across all years. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) overall ON inner_cte.avg_total_units > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: From the top 10 subject codes and department names in the Mathematics department (where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year) with the highest number of unique subject titles, display each subject code, department name, the number of unique subject titles, the minimum total units, and the subject title with the highest total units along with its total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_unique_subject_titles, ic.min_total_units, stc.max_subject_title, stc.max_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_subject_title, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) ) stc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = stc.SUBJECT_CODE AND stc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.num_unique_subject_titles DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, give the number of unique subject titles and the minimum total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that grants degrees and is not the Biology department (Course 7), and for each subject with a non-null subject code description, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and what is the average number of enrolled students per subject? Please provide the department name, the variance, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the average number of enrolled students, ordered by variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7)? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each building name, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms in that building, considering only rooms with an access level of 1, buildings located on the MIT site, and only including academic buildings (excluding buildings named "Ashdown")? Additionally, for each building, what is the most common major use description among its rooms, and how many rooms have that major use? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' ) , stats_cte AS ( SELECT BUILDING_NAME, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(AREA) AS area_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME ) , major_use_counts AS ( SELECT BUILDING_NAME, MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS use_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, MAJOR_USE_DESC ) , ranked_major_use AS ( SELECT m.BUILDING_NAME, m.MAJOR_USE_DESC, m.use_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY m.use_count DESC) AS rn FROM major_use_counts m ) SELECT s.BUILDING_NAME, s.avg_area, s.area_variance, s.area_stddev, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS most_common_major_use, r.use_count AS major_use_room_count FROM stats_cte s LEFT JOIN ranked_major_use r ON s.BUILDING_NAME = r.BUILDING_NAME AND r.rn = 1 ORDER BY s.area_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each building name, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the area of rooms in that building, considering only rooms with an access level of 1, buildings located on the MIT site, and only including academic buildings? Additionally, exclude buildings named "Ashdown".
sub_sqls: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and indicate whether the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 20% greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such academic years), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN cte.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coeff_var * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN cte.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coeff_var * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coeff_var FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Physics department), in the 2022FA term, provide the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered, and also include the average number of enrolled students in those courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name, both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department (Course 8).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management), provide the department name, the total number of students enrolled in its courses, the average enrollment across all Engineering departments that grant degrees (excluding Management), and classify each department as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its total enrollment is at least 10% higher than the average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only include departments where the total enrollment is greater than 50. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enroll FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment, a.avg_enroll, CASE WHEN i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enroll * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrollment < a.avg_enroll * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15).
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, school name, the minimum department budget code over each school name group, and the department phone number, ordered by school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
"Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '6'"
sub_questions: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, school name, and the minimum department budget code over each school name group, ordered by school name.
sub_sqls: SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each room in the Stata building with a square footage greater than 100 and used as "RESEARCH CENTER", provide the room number, its square footage, and the difference between its square footage and the average square footage of all "RESEARCH CENTER" rooms in the Stata building with square footage greater than 100. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL JOIN SPACE_USAGE ON SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND SPACE_DETAIL.BUILDING_KEY = 32 ) SELECT inner_cte.ROOM_NUMBER, inner_cte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, (inner_cte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE - avg_stats.avg_sqft) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats;
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"
sub_questions: Count how many rooms with a square footage greater than 100 are used as "RESEARCH CENTER" and are located in the Stata building.
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS research_center_large_rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL JOIN SPACE_USAGE ON SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND SPACE_DETAIL.BUILDING_KEY = 32;

question: For each department, list the department name, the average and variance of the total units for all degree-granting courses with non-null total units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and for each department, also display the course with the highest total units, including its course number and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, ic2.COURSE AS course_with_max_units, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.COURSE, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for all courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a non-null total units value, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: From the top 10 academic years with the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only years with more than 5 subjects offered, and only including subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department), display each academic year's description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and the subject with the highest enrollment in that year, along with its subject title and number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) ls ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ls.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year, considering only years with more than 5 subjects offered, and only including subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ;

question: For the top 5 departments (from Chemistry and Biology) with the highest total number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material and are offered in the term '2009SP', display each department's name, the total number of enrolled students, the course with the highest enrollment in that department, and the number of students enrolled in that course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Course_Title, c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Course_Enrollment FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC LIMIT 5 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i1.SUBJECT_TITLE, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i1 JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) i2 ON i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = i2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enrolled ) c ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_enrolled DESC;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material and are offered in the term '2009SP', considering only departments where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10, and restrict the results to the Chemistry and Biology departments (i.e., only include departments 'Chemistry' and 'Biology').
sub_sqls: SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10;

question: For each administrative department, give the administrative department name, the average total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average, but only include departments whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each administrative department, give the administrative department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, but only include departments whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2).
sub_sqls: SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each school, list the school name, department name, and the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). For each school, also include a grand total for all such graduate students in the format of (school name, null, total students). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_graduate_students) AS total_graduate_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_graduate_students) > 0 ) SELECT rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_graduate_students FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each organization, what is the organization name, its department code, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to it, considering only organizations with more than 5 rooms, and excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5 ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS dept_code, i.area_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;
sub_questions: For each organization, what is the organization name and the standard deviation of the area of rooms assigned to it, considering only organizations with more than 5 rooms, and excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'?
sub_sqls: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5;

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the minimum CIP program code and the total number of degree-granting courses, and which school has the most such courses in that department, along with the count of those courses? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS total_degree_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_cip_code, ic.total_degree_courses, sc.SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, sc.Course_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS Course_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME ) sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: What is the minimum CIP program code and the total number of degree-granting courses for each department that is degree-granting, considering only courses that are also degree-granting, and only for the Mathematics department?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS total_degree_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year and department, provide the academic year description, department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only terms with a term status indicator of 'P', subjects with total units greater than 0, and only for departments that have at least one subject offered in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and both the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only terms with a term status indicator of 'P', subjects with total units greater than 0, and only for subjects in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry, Course 5), what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, and for each such department, also list the number of subjects offered and the average number of enrolled students per subject? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '2008%' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department's name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department, what is the department's full name, and for each subject code in that department, what are the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses that are degree granting, have a non-null CIP program code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? For each department, also include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (department code, department full name, null, total range, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, scd.COURSE, scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), SubjectStats AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(ic.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(ic.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(ic.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUM(cip_code_range) AS total_cip_code_range, SUM(cip_code_variance) AS total_cip_code_variance FROM SubjectStats GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(cip_code_range) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, total_cip_code_range, total_cip_code_variance FROM RollupResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department's full name, and what are the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses that are degree granting, have a non-null CIP program code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

question: Among the top 10 departments with the highest variance in total units of courses offered (considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Mathematics department), display each department's name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and the course with the highest total units in that department along with its subject code and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE AS highest_units_subject_code, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ccc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS = ( SELECT MAX(ccc2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc2 WHERE ccc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccc2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: From the top 10 departments in the 'Engineering' school (excluding 'Political Science'), ranked by the range of total units for their subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), display each department's name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, as well as the subject within that department that has the highest total units and the value of those units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev, top_subject.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, top_subject.max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) top_subject ON stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_subject.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stats.total_units_range DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, offered in the 'Engineering' school, and excluding the 'Political Science' department (Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: From the top 10 departments (excluding 'Political Science') with the highest average number of enrolled students in their degree-granting subjects (where each subject has more than 0 enrolled students), display each department's name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, the subject with the highest enrollment in that department, and the number of students enrolled in that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ic1 ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ORDER BY avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree-granting, and only include departments that are not 'Political Science' (Course 17)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: Show the department name, academic year, the count of subjects, the minimum start date of the term, and the term description for each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, and the department is either Chemistry or Biology. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.department, inner_cte.academic_year, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.academic_year ORDER BY inner_cte.department, inner_cte.academic_year;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
