question: For each school, what is the maximum CIP program code among its degree-granting departments' courses, and what is the full name of the school, for schools that have at least one department with a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000 and do not include the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS max_cip_code, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and what is the full name of the department, for departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000;

question: For each school, list the school name, the number of degree-granting departments in that school (excluding the Political Science department), and for each department in the school, provide the department name and the average number of students per student year in that department. For each school, include a grand total row with the school name, total number of degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), and null for department name and average students per year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ), SchoolDeptCounts AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_degree_granting_departments FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolDeptStats AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_students_per_year FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SchoolDeptCounts sdc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sdc.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, num_degree_granting_departments, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year FROM SchoolDeptStats UNION ALL SELECT sdc.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_students_per_year FROM SchoolDeptCounts sdc ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of students per student year in that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department (Course 17).
sub_sqls: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year, range_students_per_year, var_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department and subject code in the Political Science department where the responsible faculty member's office is not null, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum office phone number of the responsible faculty member. Additionally, for each responsible faculty member, list their full name and email address, and include a grand total for each department and subject code in the format of (department, subject code, null, null, total unique subjects, min office phone). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(e.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND e.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, SUM(num_unique_subjects) AS total_unique_subjects, MIN(min_office_phone) AS min_office_phone FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_unique_subjects) > 0 ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, ed.FULL_NAME AS responsible_faculty_full_name, ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS responsible_faculty_email, rr.total_unique_subjects, rr.min_office_phone FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON rr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, responsible_faculty_full_name ;
sub_questions: For each department and subject code in the Political Science department where the responsible faculty member's office is not null, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum office phone number of the responsible faculty member.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(e.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND e.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE ;

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED and the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY, where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21, and the department is in the School of Science? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science';
sub_questions: What are the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED and the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY for each department, where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21, and the department is degree granting, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: Show the subject titles, department names, term descriptions, and the total number of letter graded Mathematics subjects offered in the academic year 2022, assigning row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, Total_Subjects.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Subjects ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered, the full name of the department, and the name of the associated administrative department (if any), considering only the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the coefficient of variation of the number of subjects offered, and what is the full name of the department, considering only departments that are degree-granting and including only the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV_POP(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per subject in that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and also include the number of unique courses and the school name for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units offered per subject in that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and departments that grant degrees, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: Among the top 5 academic years with the highest variance in the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the 'Engineering' school during terms with a term status indicator of 'P', excluding subjects offered by the Chemistry department and only including courses with materials, display each academic year's description, the variance, and the department with the highest total enrolled students in that year, along with the total enrolled students for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.enrolled_students_variance, dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Top_Dept, dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students FROM (SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC LIMIT 5) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Total_Enrolled_Students, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY SUM(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the 'Engineering' school during terms with a term status indicator of 'P', excluding subjects offered by the Chemistry department and only including courses with materials?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, and what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)? Additionally, for each department, include the total number of such courses in 2019 (with more than 5 enrolled students), and provide a grand total row for all included departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ), CourseCounts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM_COURSES FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cc.NUM_COURSES FROM inner_cte ic JOIN CourseCounts cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT 'Grand Total', NULL, NULL, SUM(NUM_COURSES) FROM CourseCounts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, and what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree granting and has only degree granting courses, excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, and, if the department is Political Science (Course 17), also give the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting? List the department name, average CIP program code, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of CIP program code, average total units, total units range, and total units variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), PoliticalScienceUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '17' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.stddev_cip_program_code, psu.avg_total_units, psu.total_units_range, psu.total_units_variance FROM DeptCIPStats dcs LEFT JOIN PoliticalScienceUnits psu ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = psu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the average and standard deviation of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and courses that are degree granting, and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting, but only include departments whose name is 'Political Science' (i.e., Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '17' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department, which is degree granting, show the department code, department name, the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY (where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21), and also show, for 2019, the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by the department (where the maximum is greater than 5) and the name of the responsible faculty member for that course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolledUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptMaxEnrolledFaculty AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT deu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, deu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deu.min_num_enrolled_students, deu.avg_total_units, dmef.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dmef.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptEnrolledUnits deu JOIN DeptMaxEnrolledFaculty dmef ON deu.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmef.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY deu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: What are the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED and the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY for each department, where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21, and the department is degree granting, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, and what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, school name, the minimum department budget code over each school name group, and the geometric mean of the total units of subjects offered by departments in that school (considering only subjects with more than zero total units and that are offered this year, and only for departments that are degree-granting and not the Department of Management (Course 15)), ordered by school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH StudentInfo AS ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolUnitsGeoMean AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sgm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM StudentInfo si JOIN SchoolUnitsGeoMean sgm ON si.SCHOOL_NAME = sgm.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY si.SCHOOL_NAME;

Show the school name and the geometric mean.

question: For each department that is not "Political Science" (Course 17), has a total number of units for courses in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools greater than 1000, and is a degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry), provide the department name, the total number of units for its courses, the average number of students enrolled in its subjects (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), the range of enrolled students, and the variance of enrolled students, listing the results in descending order of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000 ), dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.total_units, de.avg_enrolled, de.range_enrolled, de.var_enrolled FROM dept_units du JOIN dept_enrollment de ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY du.total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the total number of units for courses in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools, where the total units for the department is greater than 1000, and restrict the results to departments that are not "Political Science" (Course 17).

For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of students enrolled in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each student in the Political Science department whose department is Course 17, show the student's full name, their department name, the corresponding school name, the SIS administrative department name, the dense rank of the student's year (ordered by student year), and, for their department, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024 and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units, and excluding the Physics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_max_units_final AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ), polsci_students AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT ps.FULL_NAME, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.student_year_rank, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM polsci_students ps LEFT JOIN dept_max_units_final dmu ON ps.DEPARTMENT = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ps.FULL_NAME, dmu.SUBJECT_TITLE ;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting, excluding the Physics department, what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units?

Show the full name of each student in the Political Science department, their department name, the corresponding school name, and the SIS administrative department name, along with dense ranks over the student's year, ordered by student year, and only include students whose department is Course 17.
sub_sqls: WITH dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and not Chemistry (Course 5), provide the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department that have at least one enrolled student, have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and are from the Chemistry or Biology departments. List the results in order by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev FROM DepartmentUnits du LEFT JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStats des ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY du.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and assign row numbers within each department name group ordered by subject code, along with the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with more than zero total units, as well as the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term that are letter graded. Present the results in order of academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), UnitsRangeVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, urv.units_range, urv.units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cov JOIN UnitsRangeVariance urv ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year and each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) in that year, what are the academic year, academic year description, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered that year (considering only subjects offered this year and in regular terms), and for each subject, what are the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term code, term description, term start date, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_variance, ays.total_units_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows FROM AcademicYearStats ays JOIN MathSubjects ms ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.TERM_CODE;

SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the department code, department name, the number of library subjects offered, the total number of students enrolled in TIP subjects for 2020FA (for departments with at least 5 students enrolled in TIP subjects in 2020FA), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees). Include all available information for the department, even if some columns are not applicable. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptTipLibrary AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_library_subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_tip_enrollment FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 5 ), CombinedDept AS ( SELECT dtl.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dtl.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtl.num_library_subjects, dtl.total_tip_enrollment, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptTipLibrary dtl LEFT JOIN DeptVariation dv ON dtl.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS num_library_subjects, NULL AS total_tip_enrollment, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptVariation dv LEFT JOIN DeptTipLibrary dtl ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtl.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dtl.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year where the Mathematics department (Course 18) offered subjects in terms marked as the current term, what are the academic year, academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all such subjects, the average total units, and the variance of total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term that are not variable units? List the results ordered by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CoefficientOfVariationByYear AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AvgAndVarByYear AS ( SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, avgvar.avg_total_units, avgvar.var_total_units FROM CoefficientOfVariationByYear cov JOIN AvgAndVarByYear avgvar ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avgvar.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department offering a subject that has at least one enrolled student, has required course materials, and is offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department, give the department name, the average of the total units for such subjects, the range of total units, the variance of total units, and the geometric mean of the clearing cost collector values for that department (considering only departments where the clearing cost collector is greater than zero and excluding the Mathematics department). Show the department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, and geometric mean in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptClearingCost AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.avg_total_units, dss.total_units_range, dss.total_units_variance, dcc.geometric_mean FROM DeptSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptClearingCost dcc ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each department offering a subject, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student, have required course materials, and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department (i.e., Course 5 or Course 7).

For each department, what is the geometric mean of the clearing cost collector values for that department, considering only departments where the clearing cost collector is greater than zero, and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Show the department name and the geometric mean.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

question: For each academic year, show the academic year, the minimum academic year, the average total units for Political Science courses (where academic years are between 2000 and 2020 or total units are at least 6, and total units are between 1 and 12, and the department is Political Science), the average of the maximum enrollment, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up and are offered by the Department of Mathematics (Course 18), using only activities that have a non-null maximum enrollment. Only include academic years present in both sets of results. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PoliticalScienceStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR ss.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), IAPMathStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ps.min_academic_year, ps.avg_total_units, ims.avg_max_enrollment, ims.stddev_max_enrollment FROM PoliticalScienceStats ps JOIN IAPMathStats ims ON ps.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ims.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ps.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: What are the minimum academic year and average total units for each academic year, for Political Science courses, where academic years are between 2000 and 2020 or total units are at least 6, and total units are between 1 and 12, and the department is Political Science?

For each academic year, provide the academic year and calculate the average and standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up, using only activities that have a non-null maximum enrollment and are offered by the Department of Mathematics (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR ss.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) by number of unique courses offered, provide the department name, the school name, the count of unique course numbers, and, for each department, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, excluding departments that are 'Chemistry' (Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopDepartments AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY course_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), EngineeringEnrollment AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.SCHOOL_NAME, td.course_count, ee.total_enrolled FROM TopDepartments td JOIN EngineeringEnrollment ee ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ee.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of unique courses they offer, including only departments that are degree-granting and are not the Political Science department, showing the department name from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, the school name from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, and the count of unique course numbers from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, but only include departments that are not 'Chemistry' (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY course_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

question: List, for the Mathematics department (Course 18), all subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students, showing the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and row number within each department name group ordered by subject code, as well as, for the Mathematics department, the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10. For each row, indicate whether it is a 'Subject' or 'Department' result in the Reason column. The columns should be: subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, row number, total number of subject enrollments, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, NULL AS total_enrollments, 'Subject' AS Reason FROM Subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, s2.total_enrollments, 'Department' AS Reason FROM Subq2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, total_enrollments, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and assign row numbers within each department name group ordered by subject code.

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term, where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10, only for the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10;

question: For each subject code in the Mathematics department (Course 18) where the department is degree granting, provide the department name, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, department code, the range of total units, and the variance of total units for letter graded subjects offered this year in the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptSubjectCodeStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dscs.SUBJECT_CODE, dscs.subject_code_count, dscs.min_dept_budget_code, dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM DeptSubjectCodeStats dscs JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dscs.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code.

For each department, provide the department name and department code, and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered this year, considering only subjects that are letter graded and belong to the Mathematics department.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: List, for each department, the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, school name, and dense rank over the department code ordered by department code for each subject offered with more than 0 enrolled students in degree-granting Mathematics departments, as well as the department name, maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, and the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5 and only including departments of Mathematics and Chemistry. The results should include all these columns in the following order: department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, school name, dense rank, maximum number of enrolled students, and responsible faculty name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: List the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and school name for each subject offered, along with dense ranks over the department code ordered by department code, for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in departments that grant degrees, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, and what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)?
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code above 100000, is not the Political Science department (Course 17), and either has department code '6' or '15' or at least one graduate student, list the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, the minimum department code among its students, and the average student year (numerically, with G=5, 4=4, 3=3, etc.), excluding the Economics and Political Science departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStudentStats AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG( CASE WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' THEN 5 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '4' THEN 4 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '3' THEN 3 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '2' THEN 2 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ( sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6' OR sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15' OR msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' ) AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Economics' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.num_unique_courses, dcs.total_units, dss.MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC FROM DeptCourseStats dcs JOIN DeptStudentStats dss ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: What are the minimum department code and average student year (numerically, with G=5, 4=4, 3=3, etc.) for each department, where department codes are either '6' or '15', or the student year is 'G', and the department is degree granting, excluding the Economics department?

For each department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code above 100000, and is not the Political Science department, give the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, and the total number of units for all those courses, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG( CASE WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' THEN 5 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '4' THEN 4 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '3' THEN 3 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '2' THEN 2 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ( sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6' OR sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15' OR msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' ) AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Economics' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', and who are of employee type 'Student', show their first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, school name, the minimum department budget code over each school name group, MIT ID, and the running sum of MIT IDs within each student year group ordered by MIT ID, ordered by school name, student year, and MIT ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH student_dept_info AS ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, msd.FULL_NAME FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), student_running_sum AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID ) SELECT sdi.FIRST_NAME, sdi.LAST_NAME, sdi.EMAIL_ADDRESS, sdi.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdi.STUDENT_YEAR, sdi.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sdi.SCHOOL_NAME, sdi.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, srs.MIT_ID, srs.running_sum_mit_id FROM student_dept_info sdi JOIN student_running_sum srs ON sdi.FULL_NAME = srs.FULL_NAME AND sdi.DEPARTMENT_NAME = srs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sdi.STUDENT_YEAR = srs.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sdi.SCHOOL_NAME, sdi.STUDENT_YEAR, srs.MIT_ID;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and not named 'Political Science', what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the School of Engineering in the 2021FA term (excluding the Department of Management, Course 15), and the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment? List the department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), maximum enrollment, and subject title in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units_cv AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_units_cv dcv LEFT JOIN dept_max_enroll dme ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, what is the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and restrict the results to only degree-granting departments and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15)?

WITH dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_enroll dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ORDER BY dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For students whose employee type is 'Student', who are in department 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their MIT ID, full name, department name, student year, the running sum of MIT IDs within each student year group ordered by MIT ID, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms in their department (excluding 'Mathematics'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH student_info AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID ), dept_units_variation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT si.MIT_ID, si.FULL_NAME, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation FROM student_info si LEFT JOIN dept_units_variation duv ON si.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.MIT_ID;
