question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5) that has course materials and is in a regular term with more than 5 enrolled students, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key, the number of reserved course materials, and the minimum academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubjectChemistryStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), SubjectReserveStats AS ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_CODE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.max_enrolled_students, r.num_reserved_materials, r.min_academic_year FROM SubjectChemistryStats s JOIN SubjectReserveStats r ON s.SUBJECT_TITLE = r.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = r.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key, but only include subjects that have course materials.

For each subject title and offering department name in terms that are regular, have more than 5 enrolled students, and are offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), give the number of reserved course materials and the minimum academic year, considering only courses with materials.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department that grants degrees, excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5) and the Physics department, provide the department name, the range and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the full name of the corresponding administrative department, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_max_units_subject AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_range, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmus.max_total_units, dmus.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_enrollment_stats des JOIN dept_max_units_subject dmus ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmus.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name, the range and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and what is the full name of the corresponding administrative department, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5)?

For each department that is degree-granting, excluding the Physics department, what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics), what is the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, and for each associated Chemistry tip detail record, what are the tip material key, tip material status key, term code (formatted as YYYYTT), subject ID, subject title, offer department name, and the maximum total units for each tip detail considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by tip subject offered key, only including Chemistry tip details where the total units are greater than 0 and the tip material status key is not 'NM'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptClearingStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC ), ChemistryTipDetails AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, ctd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ctd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ctd.TERM_CODE, ctd.SUBJECT_ID, ctd.SUBJECT_TITLE, ctd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ctd.max_total_units FROM DeptClearingStats dcs JOIN ChemistryTipDetails ctd ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ctd.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
domain_knowledge: "TABLE.TERM_CODE" is formatted as "YYYYTT" where "YYYY" is the year and "TT" is the term. Terms can be "FA", "JA", "SP", and "SU" for fall, IAP, spring, and summer
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each tip detail record in the Chemistry department, provide the tip material key, tip material status key, term code (formatted as YYYYTT), subject ID, and the subject title, offer department name, and the maximum total units for each tip detail considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by tip subject offered key, only including records where the total units are greater than 0 and the tip material status key is not 'NM'.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department), what is the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, and what is the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry) in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6? The results should show the department name, enrolled range, enrolled variance, enrolled standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and total enrolled students (from the School of Engineering, if available) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), engineering_enrollment AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, ee.total_enrolled FROM dept_enrollment_stats des LEFT JOIN engineering_enrollment ee ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ee.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6'"
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department (Course 6).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, but only include departments that are not 'Chemistry' (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), which has more than 5 subjects offered in the 2022FA term, show the department name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, along with, for each subject offered by the Mathematics department in the 2005FA term with more than 0 enrolled students, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the row number assigned within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title. Present the results ordered by the number of enrolled students (descending) and then by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.enrolled_stddev, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, considering only departments that have more than 5 subjects offered in the 2022FA term, and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For each administrative department whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2), show the administrative department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, the department name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in regular academic terms (excluding 'Mathematics'), where the administrative department and department names match. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AdminDeptStats AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ads.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ads.coefficient_of_variation AS admin_dept_coefficient_of_variation, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.coefficient_of_variation AS dept_coefficient_of_variation FROM AdminDeptStats ads JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON UPPER(ads.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = UPPER(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) JOIN DeptStats ds ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ads.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5) that has course materials, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key. Additionally, include the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the same department (if the department grants degrees, has subjects with a non-null subject code description, and is not the Biology department). Present the results with the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, maximum number of enrolled students, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ChemSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_enrolled_students, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM ChemSubjects c LEFT JOIN DeptStats d ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE;

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

question: For each department in the School of Engineering during the 2019FA term, where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department is greater than 100, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students, the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department, and the name of the subject with that maximum enrollment. Exclude the Political Science department (department code '17'), restrict to degree-granting departments, and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MaxEnrollmentPerDept AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.total_enrollment, mepd.max_enrollment, mepd.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN MaxEnrollmentPerDept mepd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mepd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE dss.total_enrollment > 100 ORDER BY dss.total_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, what is the name of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and restrict the results to only degree-granting departments and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15)?

For each department, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering during the 2019FA term, but exclude the Political Science department (department code '17').
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

question: For each subject in the Mathematics department (Course 18) offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded), the subject code, the subject number, and the running sum of subject codes within the department, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2022.window_column FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms2022 ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department that is not 'Chemistry' (Course 5) and is in the School of Engineering, and for which the total units for the department's subjects is greater than 6, and which is also among the top 10 degree-granting departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects (excluding Political Science, Course 17, and only including departments with at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students), provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the department, and the count of unique student full names for students named "Zoe" enrolled in their subjects, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolled AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopZoeDepts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students FROM DeptEnrolled d JOIN TopZoeDepts t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, but only include departments that are not 'Chemistry' (Course 5).

sub_sqls: SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), the range of the total units, and the variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), RangeAndVariance AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cv.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, rv.total_units_range, rv.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cv JOIN RangeAndVariance rv ON cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = rv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

question: For organizations with a major organization key of 230 and in the Political Science department, and for each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS' and does not have organization IDs '138' or '250', show the organization name, department name, DLC key, row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by organization name, the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, and the normalized organization count (number of organizations divided by minimum organization number, rounded), ordered by normalized organization count descending.
sql: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DLC_KEY, s1.window_column, s2.organization_count, s2.min_organization_number, ROUND(s2.organization_count / NULLIF(s2.min_organization_number, 0), 2) AS normalized_org_count FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY AND s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY normalized_org_count DESC

question: For each department, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms where the term status indicator is 'P' (restricted to the Chemistry department and only if the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms (excluding the Mathematics department), showing the department name, total enrolled students, and coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolledChemistry AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ), DeptUnitsVariation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT d1.department_name, d1.total_enrolled_students, d2.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptEnrolledChemistry d1 JOIN DeptUnitsVariation d2 ON d1.department_name = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.total_enrolled_students DESC, d2.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the School of Engineering in 2019 by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, provide the subject ID, subject title, the department name, the number of enrolled students who are in their graduate year and whose department is degree-granting, as well as the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Biology department). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH eng_eecs_grad_enrollment_2019 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT eee.SUBJECT_ID, eee.SUBJECT_TITLE, eee.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eee.num_enrolled_grad_students, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM eng_eecs_grad_enrollment_2019 eee LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON eee.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, and the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by the Mathematics department (considering only courses with total units greater than zero and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department), but only include results where the geometric mean of total units for the department is greater than 8. List the columns in the order: subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, maximum total units for 3 rows, and geometric mean total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ), DepartmentGeometricMean AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows, dgm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM MathSubjects ms JOIN DepartmentGeometricMean dgm ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dgm.geometric_mean_total_units > 8 ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.TERM_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department except Chemistry (Course 5), provide the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, and for each subject offered by the Mathematics department in the 2022 academic year with a maximum total units greater than 6, list the subject title, the maximum total units for that subject, and the department name from the course catalog. The results are shown for departments that appear in both sets, with the columns in the following order: department name, total units range, total units variance, subject title, maximum total units, and department name from the course catalog. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjectUnits AS ( SELECT cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, msu.SUBJECT_TITLE, msu.max_total_units, msu.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name FROM DeptUnitsStats dus JOIN MathSubjectUnits msu ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msu.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msu.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, along with the subject title, total units, and dense rank over the department code ordered by department code for each subject offered by the Mathematics department, ordered by department name and dense rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.avg_dept_budget_code, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.TOTAL_UNITS, sq2.window_column FROM Subquery1 sq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.window_column

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total subject enrollment numbers per academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P', the total subject enrollment number is greater than 0, and the department is Mathematics), as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have at least one TIP material, and are in the Mathematics department). List the results in order of academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), TipStats AS ( WITH tip_counts AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ), per_year_stats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) - MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS range_tip_materials, VARIANCE(tc.num_tip_materials) AS var_tip_materials, STDDEV(tc.num_tip_materials) AS stddev_tip_materials FROM tip_counts tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, range_tip_materials, var_tip_materials, stddev_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.enrollment_range, e.enrollment_variance, e.enrollment_stddev, t.range_tip_materials, t.var_tip_materials, t.stddev_tip_materials FROM EnrollmentStats e JOIN TipStats t ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY e.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the range, variance, and standard deviation of total subject enrollment numbers per academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P', the total subject enrollment number is greater than 0, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18).

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have at least one TIP material, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH tip_counts AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ), per_year_stats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) - MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS range_tip_materials, VARIANCE(tc.num_tip_materials) AS var_tip_materials, STDDEV(tc.num_tip_materials) AS stddev_tip_materials FROM tip_counts tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, range_tip_materials, var_tip_materials, stddev_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0 and the department is either Chemistry or Biology, and where the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and where the department is degree granting, but excluding the Mathematics department) is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, count of subjects, minimum start date of the term, average number of enrolled students, range of enrolled students, and variance of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dys.department, dys.academic_year, dys.subject_count, dys.min_term_start_date, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM DeptYearSubjectStats dys JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON dys.department = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE des.avg_enrolled_students > 10 ORDER BY dys.department, dys.academic_year;

question: For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), give the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year (only including departments with more than one subject), and for each program in the Political Science department (Course 17) that is degree granting and has a non-null department name, also give the program title, category title, course description, and the dense rank over the school name ordered by school name, where the department name matches Political Science. List the results ordered by department name and dense rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), dept_cv AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), polsci_programs AS ( SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME) AS window_column FROM CIP JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17' ) SELECT pcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pcv.coefficient_of_variation, pp.PROGRAM_TITLE, pp.CATEGORY_TITLE, pp.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, pp.window_column FROM dept_cv pcv JOIN polsci_programs pp ON pcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = pp.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY pcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pp.window_column;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

question: For each department that is degree-granting, is not Biology (Course 7) or Chemistry (Course 5), and offered at least one subject in the 2021FA term, list the department name, the department's full name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the maximum total units among its offered subjects in 2021FA, and calculate the normalized average-to-maximum-units ratio (average total units in 2022 divided by maximum total units in 2021FA, rounded to two decimals), ordering the results by this ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH DeptUnits2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptMaxUnits2021FA AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.range_total_units, d1.var_total_units, d2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, ROUND(d1.avg_total_units / NULLIF(d2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, 0), 2) AS normalized_avg_to_max_units_ratio FROM DeptUnits2022 d1 JOIN DeptMaxUnits2021FA d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_avg_to_max_units_ratio DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department except the Biology department (Course 7), give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and for each student in the Political Science department (Course 17), show the student's full name, the corresponding school name, the SIS administrative department name, and the dense rank of the student over student year, ordered by department name and student year rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), Department_CV AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), Political_Science_Students AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, pss.FULL_NAME, pss.SCHOOL_NAME, pss.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank FROM Department_CV dcv JOIN Political_Science_Students pss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = pss.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank;

SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR;

question: For each degree-granting department except 'Political Science', provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and, if the department is Mathematics (Course 18), also provide the subject code, the number of subject codes, and the minimum department budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), MathSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, mss.SUBJECT_CODE, mss.subject_code_count, mss.min_dept_budget_code FROM DeptUnitsCV dcv LEFT JOIN MathSubjectStats mss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department that is degree granting and is not the Biology department, what is the department name, the variance of the number of students in each student year for that department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, and, for the Mathematics department and each academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, the academic year, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units offered? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathSubjectStats AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.variance_num_students, dss.stddev_num_students, mss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mss.num_unique_subjects, mss.min_total_units FROM DepartmentStudentStats dss LEFT JOIN MathSubjectStats mss ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

List the department code, department name, admin department name, range of number of subjects per term, variance of number of subjects per term, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of number of subjects per term, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), top3_depts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t3.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.range_num_subjects, dss.variance_num_subjects, dss.stddev_num_subjects FROM top3_depts t3 JOIN dept_subject_stats dss ON t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP', and are not the Chemistry department.

question: For each department that is degree-granting, is not the Biology department (Course 7) or the Department of Political Science (Course 17), offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, and offered subjects in 2022, provide the department name, department full name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, the number of subjects offered in the School of Engineering in 2021, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnits2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EngDeptSubjects2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.var_total_units, d2.subject_count, d2.total_enrollment FROM DeptUnits2022 d1 JOIN EngDeptSubjects2021 d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments), what is the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the graduate-level subjects offered by that department, as well as the average, range, and variance of the number of students enrolled in all subjects (with at least one enrolled student) offered by that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolledStatsGrad AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptEnrolledStatsAll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d2.avg_enrolled, d2.range_enrolled, d2.var_enrolled FROM DeptEnrolledStatsGrad d1 JOIN DeptEnrolledStatsAll d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d1.enrolled_range DESC, d2.avg_enrolled DESC;

question: For each academic year, show the academic year, academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with more than zero total units, the range of the number of enrolled students in Mathematics courses offered in the fall term with more than zero enrolled students, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in those courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cov JOIN EnrolledStats es ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department except Chemistry, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, and for each such department in Mathematics (Course 18) with subjects of 12 total units, also show the subject code, subject title, department name, department full name, course description, course level, school name, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_dept_name, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept FROM DeptUnitsStats dus LEFT JOIN MathSubjects ms ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE;

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that are degree-granting, show the subject code, subject title, department name, department full name, course description, course level, school name, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department code.

SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and excluding the Biology department), and for students whose department code is '6', who are in the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, and whose first name is 'Benedict', what are their first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, and the minimum department code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name? Show the department name, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), first name, last name, email address, student department name, student year, and window column, for departments matching the students' department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH department_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), benedict_students AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict' ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, bs.FIRST_NAME, bs.LAST_NAME, bs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, bs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS STUDENT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, bs.STUDENT_YEAR, bs.window_column FROM department_enrollment_stats des JOIN benedict_students bs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = bs.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year since 2010 in which Mathematics subjects were offered in regular terms starting after January 1, 2010, and also offered in the fall term with a non-null subject title, what is the academic year, the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects in those regular terms, the academic year description, and the variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with a non-null subject title? List the academic year, total units range, total units variance, academic year description, and variance of total units for the fall term in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathUnitsStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathFallUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.total_units_range, mfs.total_units_variance, mfuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfuv.variance_total_units FROM MathUnitsStats mfs JOIN MathFallUnitsVariance mfuv ON mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mfuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that start after January 1, 2010 and are regular terms, specifically for subjects in the Mathematics department?

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a non-null subject title, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
