SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course, course description, department name, school name, the rank of each course within its department ordered by course, and the total number of units for the department, but only include courses from departments whose total units are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all degree-granting departments except for department code '7' (Biology). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EngineeringEECS_Courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), HighUnitDepartments AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT eec.COURSE, eec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eec.SCHOOL_NAME, eec.window_column, hud.total_units FROM EngineeringEECS_Courses eec JOIN HighUnitDepartments hud ON eec.DEPARTMENT = hud.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY eec.COURSE;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, and for each department that is degree granting and not the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject code description, mathematics department name, school name, the average department budget code within each school, the non-mathematics department name, the average clearing cost collector value, the variance of the clearing cost collector values, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values, ordered by mathematics department name and by the variance of the clearing cost collector values in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathSubjectStats AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), NonMathDeptAdminStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC ) SELECT mss.SUBJECT_CODE, mss.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, mss.SCHOOL_NAME, mss.avg_dept_budget_code, nmdas.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS non_math_department_name, nmdas.avg_clearing_cost_collector, nmdas.clearing_cost_collector_variance, nmdas.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM MathSubjectStats mss CROSS JOIN NonMathDeptAdminStats nmdas ORDER BY mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, nmdas.clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, ordered by department name.

For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

question: List, for each department, the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department (considering only departments and courses that are degree granting and excluding the Mathematics department), and for each student in the Political Science department (Course 17), their full name, department name, corresponding school name, SIS administrative department name, and dense rank over the student's year, combining these results into a single list with all columns in the order: department name, average CIP program code, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of CIP program code, full name, school name, SIS administrative department name, and student year rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), PoliSciStudents AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.stddev_cip_program_code, NULL AS FULL_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS student_year_rank FROM DeptCIPStats dcs UNION ALL SELECT pss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_cip_program_code, NULL AS stddev_cip_program_code, pss.FULL_NAME, pss.SCHOOL_NAME, pss.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank FROM PoliSciStudents pss ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, FULL_NAME

Show the full name of each student in the Political Science department, their department name, the corresponding school name, and the SIS administrative department name, along with dense ranks over the student's year, ordered by student year, and only include students whose department is Course 17.

SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), list for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within the department, along with the total number of graduate students in the department whose department is degree granting and whose student year is 'G'. Also, include the department name and total number of such graduate students even if there are no matching subjects, showing NULL for subject code, subject number, and running sum in that case. Order the results by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubjectUnits AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), GraduateStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT su.SUBJECT_CODE, su.SUBJECT_NUMBER, su.DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.window_column, gs.total_graduate_students FROM SubjectUnits su LEFT JOIN GraduateStudents gs ON su.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, gs.total_graduate_students FROM GraduateStudents gs WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SubjectUnits su WHERE su.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department, ordered by subject code.

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the average department budget code is at least 100000 and the average total units for subjects offered is greater than 6, give the department code, the department name, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, the average total units for subjects offered, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered, ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolledBudget AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.min_num_enrolled_students, d1.avg_dept_budget_code, d2.avg_total_units, d2.stddev_total_units FROM DeptEnrolledBudget d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d1.avg_dept_budget_code >= 100000 AND d2.avg_total_units > 6 ORDER BY d2.stddev_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each department give the department code, the department name, the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are Mathematics (Course 18)?

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List, for each department, the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term (only including departments that grant degrees and excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department), as well as the department name and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6 (excluding the Chemistry department), along with the reason for inclusion ('DeptStats' for the first set and 'EngrEnrolled' for the second set). Show the columns in this order: department name, enrolled range, enrolled variance, enrolled standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total enrolled, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EngrEnrolled AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), CombinedDept AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_range, d.enrolled_variance, d.enrolled_stddev, NULL AS total_enrolled, 'DeptStats' AS Reason FROM DeptStats d UNION ALL SELECT e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, NULL AS enrolled_stddev, e.total_enrolled, 'EngrEnrolled' AS Reason FROM EngrEnrolled e ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, enrolled_stddev, total_enrolled, Reason FROM CombinedDept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, but only include departments that are not 'Chemistry' (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), for each subject grade type where the subject is offered in the current academic year and is letter graded, provide the department name, the grade type, the number of subjects, the minimum total units, and the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students and only for departments that grant degrees). List the results ordered by the number of subjects (descending), then by geometric mean enrollment (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.GRADE_TYPE, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, des.geometric_mean_enrollment FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dss.subject_count DESC, des.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: For each department and subject grade type where the subject is offered in the current academic year, is letter graded, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of subjects and the minimum total units.

For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and only for departments that grant degrees, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: For each school that has at least one department named "Political Science" or "Mathematics", what is the name of the school, the variance of the CIP program code for all degree-granting Mathematics courses with a non-null department name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by departments in that school, excluding any courses from the Chemistry department? Present the school name, the variance of the CIP program code, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH math_cip_variance AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_variance DESC ), schools_with_target_depts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Political Science', 'Mathematics') ), school_course_units AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ) SELECT mcv.SCHOOL_NAME, mcv.cip_code_variance, scu_stats.coefficient_of_variation FROM math_cip_variance mcv JOIN ( SELECT scu.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(scu.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(scu.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM school_course_units scu WHERE scu.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_target_depts) GROUP BY scu.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scu.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) scu_stats ON mcv.SCHOOL_NAME = scu_stats.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY mcv.cip_code_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each school, what is the name of the school and the variance of the CIP program code for all courses that are degree granting, have a non-null department name, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each school, give the school name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for all courses offered by departments in that school, but only include schools that have at least one department named "Political Science" or "Mathematics", and exclude any courses from the Chemistry department.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_variance DESC;

WITH schools_with_target_depts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Political Science', 'Mathematics') ), school_course_units AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ) SELECT scu.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(scu.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(scu.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM school_course_units scu WHERE scu.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_target_depts) GROUP BY scu.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scu.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

question: For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and for each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5) in term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students and with course materials, show the subject title, offering department name, school name, department full name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by department name, where the department code matches between the two sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), dept_cv AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), chemistry_courses AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.coefficient_of_variation, cc.SUBJECT_TITLE, cc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, cc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cc.window_column FROM dept_cv dc JOIN chemistry_courses cc ON dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cc.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, offering department name, school name, department full name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department name, and only include courses that have course materials.
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

question: For each HGN code in the Political Science department, list the HGN code, department name, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, the subject title from the subject offered table for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units, as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that are degree granting, but excluding the Biology department). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PoliticalScienceLectureStats AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT psls.HGN_CODE, psls.DEPARTMENT_NAME, psls.max_lecture_units, psls.SUBJECT_TITLE, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.stddev_enrolled_students FROM PoliticalScienceLectureStats psls JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON psls.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY psls.HGN_CODE, psls.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each HGN code in the Political Science department, what is the department name, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table, for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units?

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that are degree granting, but exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms for their department, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentVariation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT e.FIRST_NAME, e.LAST_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.STUDENT_YEAR, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, d.coefficient_of_variation FROM EECSStudents e JOIN DepartmentVariation d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
domain_knowledge: "Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
"Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '6'"
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, and the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the Mathematics department (considering only years with more than 10 subjects that have course materials and courses with a nonzero amount of enrolled students), the range of total units, and the variance of total units for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department). List the results in descending order of the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.enrolled_stddev, u.total_units_range, u.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStddev e JOIN UnitsStats u ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY e.enrolled_stddev DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description and the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the Mathematics department, considering only years with more than 10 subjects that have course materials and courses with a nonzero amount of enrolled students.

For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes per course offered by that department (considering only degree-granting courses in Mathematics), and what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department in the 2022 academic year (considering only if the department has more than five subjects offered in 2022, is degree-granting, and is not Chemistry)? Show the department name, subject code count range, subject code count variance, subject code count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH math_subject_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC ), dept_units_stddev AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ) SELECT mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mss.subject_count_range, mss.subject_count_variance, mss.subject_count_stddev, dus.total_units_stddev FROM math_subject_stats mss LEFT JOIN dept_units_stddev dus ON mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of unique subject codes per course offered by that department, considering only degree-granting courses in the Mathematics department?

For each department, what is the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have more than five subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and only including departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department? Show the department name and the calculated standard deviation, ordered from highest to lowest standard deviation.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC;

For the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, only include departments that have offered more than five subjects with subject enrollment number greater than zero, and restrict to the Mathematics department (Course 18). sql: WITH DeptStddev AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), TopDeptStudents AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ( d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' OR d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8' ) GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedDeptInfo AS ( SELECT tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tds.SCHOOL_NAME, tds.student_count, ds.stddev_total_units FROM TopDeptStudents tds LEFT JOIN DeptStddev ds ON tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, student_count, stddev_total_units FROM CombinedDeptInfo ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree-granting and are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course number, course description, department name, the sum of CIP program codes within each school code group, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments (excluding 'Mathematics'), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes, ordered by course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EngEECS_Courses AS ( SELECT t2.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t2.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), Dept_Subject_Stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ) SELECT e.COURSE_NUMBER, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, d.avg_subject_codes, d.stddev_subject_codes FROM EngEECS_Courses e JOIN Dept_Subject_Stats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.COURSE_NUMBER;

sql: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.LECTURE_UNITS, s1.LAB_UNITS, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.GRADE_TYPE, s1.GRADE_RULE, s1.min_total_units_by_dept, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID

sql: WITH MathCourseStats AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathYearStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.SUBJECT_TITLE, mcs.TOTAL_UNITS, mcs.GRADE_TYPE, mcs.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mys.variance_total_units, mys.stddev_total_units FROM MathCourseStats mcs JOIN MathYearStats mys ON mcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology) that is the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, the average department budget code within each school, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, including only departments with more than one subject with non-null total units, ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), coefficient_variation AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), math_dept_info AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.avg_dept_budget_code, c.coefficient_of_variation FROM coefficient_variation c JOIN math_dept_info m ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18) that is degree-granting, what is the department code, department name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of students in that department, and the total number of subject codes associated with the department, considering only if the Mathematics department has a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean across all degree-granting departments except Biology (Course 7)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjectCodeCounts AS ( WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.num_unique_courses, mds.num_students, dscc.subject_code_count FROM MathDeptStats mds LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCodeCounts dscc ON mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dscc.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: List, for all departments that are either degree granting with a department budget code greater than 100000 and not named Mathematics or Physics, or degree granting with at least one course having a CIP program code greater than 0 and not being Mathematics (Course 18), the department name, the total clearing cost collector (if applicable), the geometric mean of CIP program codes (if applicable), and the reason for inclusion ('ClearingCost' for departments included due to clearing cost collector, 'GeometricMeanCIP' for departments included due to geometric mean of CIP program codes). Show the department name, total clearing cost collector, geometric mean of CIP program codes, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ClearingCostDepartments AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), GeometricMeanDepartments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDepartments AS ( SELECT ccd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccd.total_clearing_cost_collector, NULL AS geometric_mean_cip, 'ClearingCost' AS Reason FROM ClearingCostDepartments ccd UNION ALL SELECT gmd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_clearing_cost_collector, gmd.geometric_mean_cip, 'GeometricMeanCIP' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDepartments gmd ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepartments ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total clearing cost collector for departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, are not the Mathematics department, and are not the Physics department.

For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of CIP program codes for all courses in that department where the department is degree granting, the CIP program code is greater than 0, and the department is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_cip DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, the range of the total units of courses offered by the Mathematics department (considering only courses that are offered this year and have a non-null total units value), the variance of the total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubjectCodes AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.window_column, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance, du.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectCodes sc JOIN DepartmentUnits du ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.window_column
sub_questions: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code.

For each department, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are offered this year, have a non-null total units value, and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, provide the department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: Which three degree-granting departments (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, department code '6') have the highest number of courses listed in the course catalog, and for each, what are their department codes, department names, the number of courses, and the geometric mean of CIP program codes for all courses in that department (excluding the Mathematics department, department code '18', and only including courses with CIP program code greater than 0)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopDepartmentsByCourses AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 3 ), DepartmentGeometricMeanCIP AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_cip DESC ) SELECT tdbc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tdbc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdbc.num_courses, dgmc.geometric_mean_cip FROM TopDepartmentsByCourses tdbc JOIN DepartmentGeometricMeanCIP dgmc ON tdbc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dgmc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY tdbc.num_courses DESC, dgmc.geometric_mean_cip DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_cip DESC;

question: List, for all departments that either (a) are degree-granting and offer more than five subjects or are the Mathematics department, or (b) are degree-granting, are not the Biology department, and have a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean across all departments, the department code, department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (if applicable), the total number of subject codes associated with the department (if applicable), and the reason for inclusion ('Stddev' for the first group and 'CodeCount' for the second group), showing the department code, department name, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, subject code count, and reason in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DeptCodeCounts AS ( WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.stddev_total_units, NULL AS subject_code_count, 'Stddev' AS Reason FROM DeptStddev d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS stddev_total_units, d2.subject_code_count, 'CodeCount' AS Reason FROM DeptCodeCounts d2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, stddev_total_units, subject_code_count, Reason FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that offer more than five subjects, are degree granting, and specifically include the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, what is the total number of subject codes associated with it, considering only departments that have a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation above the mean across all departments, and only including departments that are degree-granting and are not the Biology department (Course 7)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each school, what is the school name, the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), the average of the department budget codes for the Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry departments in that school, and the variance of the department budget codes for those departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME ), AvgAndVarianceBudget AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ) SELECT g.SCHOOL_NAME, g.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, a.avg_budget, a.budget_variance FROM GeometricMeanDeptBudget g JOIN AvgAndVarianceBudget a ON g.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY g.SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each school, what is the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17)?

For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school, but only include the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.
sub_sqls: SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC;

question: For each student in the Political Science department whose department is Course 17, show the student's full name, department name, school name, SIS administrative department name, and their dense rank over student year (ordered by student year), along with the maximum total units of any subject offered by the Political Science department in 2024 (excluding Physics and non-degree-granting departments), and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units. List the results ordered by student year rank, student full name, and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_max_subjects AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ), polsci_students AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT ps.FULL_NAME, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.student_year_rank, dms.max_total_units, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM polsci_students ps JOIN dept_max_subjects dms ON ps.DEPARTMENT = dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ps.student_year_rank, ps.FULL_NAME, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting, excluding the Physics department, what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units?

Show the full name of each student in the Political Science department, their department name, the corresponding school name, and the SIS administrative department name, along with dense ranks over the student's year, ordered by student year, and only include students whose department is Course 17.
sub_sqls: WITH dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR;

question: For each program in the Political Science department that is degree granting, has a non-null department name, and is in Course 17, show the program title, category title, course description, department name, and the dense rank over the school name ordered by school name. Additionally, for the same department, provide the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, considering only departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Chemistry department. The columns should be shown in the following order: program title, category title, course description, department name, dense rank, average total units, and variance of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME) AS window_column, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT FROM CIP JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT subq1.PROGRAM_TITLE, subq1.CATEGORY_TITLE, subq1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_total_units, subq2.var_total_units FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE
sub_questions: Show the program title, category title, course description, and department name for each program in the Political Science department, along with dense ranks over the school name ordered by school name, for programs that are degree granting and have a non-null department name, and are in Course 17.

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department.

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5) that have course materials, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code, the subject code, the subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.window_column AS min_enrolled_by_code FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code, and only include courses with materials.

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by subject code, and only include courses with materials.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects offered by that department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, and, for the Mathematics department in the current term (if the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10), the total number of subject enrollments, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments? sql: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), MathEnrollments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, m.total_enrollments FROM DeptEnrolledStats d LEFT JOIN MathEnrollments m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.enrolled_students_variance DESC;
