question: For each administrative department, give the administrative department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with total units greater than 0, and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department), as well as the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, where the department is degree granting, and excluding the Mathematics department). List the administrative department name, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average enrolled students, range of enrolled students, and variance of enrolled students, in that order, and order the results by total units variance in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each administrative department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with total units greater than 0, and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department (Course 2)?

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and where the department is degree granting, but exclude the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each organization whose organization level is 5, is not 'ADMISSIONS', and whose organization ID is not '138' or '250', show the organization name, description, the corresponding space unit name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the space unit name, the number of organizations for each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the minimum organization number, excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. The columns should be shown in the following order: organization name, description, space unit, window row number, organization count, and minimum organization number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH OrgSpaceWindow AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t0.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND t0.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ), OrgDlcStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ows.DESCRIPTION, ows.SPACE_UNIT, ows.window_column, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number FROM OrgSpaceWindow ows JOIN OrgDlcStats ods ON ows.DLC_KEY = ods.DLC_KEY AND ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ows.SPACE_UNIT;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"
sub_questions: For each organization whose organization level is 5 and is not 'ADMISSIONS', show the organization name, description, the corresponding space unit name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the space unit name, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'.

For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND t0.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')

SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting and not from the Mathematics department, where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the course's department during the 2019FA term is greater than 100, what are the course, the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, the department name of the course, the department code, the department full name, the number of subjects offered by the department, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department? List the results ordered by total enrollment in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CourseMaxCIP AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT cmc.COURSE, cmc.max_cip_program_code, cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrollment FROM CourseMaxCIP cmc JOIN DepartmentSubjectEnrollment dse ON cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dse.total_enrollment > 100 ORDER BY dse.total_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, and what is the department name of the course, excluding courses from the Mathematics department?

For each department, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering during the 2019FA term, but exclude the Political Science department (department code '17').
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year in the Mathematics department, the average of the total units, and the variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with non-null subject titles? List the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean record count, average total units, and variance of total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH GeometricMeanRecordCount AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AvgVarTotalUnits AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gm.geometric_mean_record_count, av.avg_total_units, av.var_total_units FROM GeometricMeanRecordCount gm JOIN AvgVarTotalUnits av ON gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = av.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = av.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a non-null subject title, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, provide the course number, course description, subject title, number of times offered, the department name, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopMathCourses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ), MathDeptUnitsStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdu.total_units_stddev FROM TopMathCourses tmc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tmc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MathDeptUnitsStddev mdu ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: What are the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, and for each, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, and the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG?

For each department, provide the department name and the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5

question: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses, along with the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students and departments whose name is not null). List the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units, average enrollment, enrollment range, and enrollment variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_LEVEL, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_total_units, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_range, des.enrollment_variance FROM DeptCourseStats dcs JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.COURSE_LEVEL;
sub_questions: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students, departments whose name is not null, and only include departments whose name is 'Mathematics' (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

question: For students whose first name is 'Peter' and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show their last name, email address, student year, department name, school name, and the minimum department budget code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name, along with the department full name, subject title, subject code description, school name for the course, and the dense rank over department code ordered by department code for courses that have a non-null subject title, belong to departments that grant degrees, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). List the last name, email address, student year, department name, school name, student window minimum department budget code, department full name, subject title, subject code description, course school name, and course window dense rank, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH StudentInfo AS ( SELECT t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Peter' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), CourseInfo AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.window_column AS student_window_min_dept_budget_code, ci.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ci.SUBJECT_TITLE, ci.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ci.SCHOOL_NAME AS course_school_name, ci.window_column AS course_window_dense_rank FROM StudentInfo si JOIN CourseInfo ci ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ci.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY si.LAST_NAME, ci.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For students whose first name is 'Peter' and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show their last name, email address, student year, department name, school name, and the minimum department budget code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name.

Show the department full name, subject title, subject code description, and school name, along with dense ranks over department code ordered by department code, for courses that have a non-null subject title, belong to departments that grant degrees, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Peter' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the department name, the average total units for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, the range of total units, the variance of total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for degree-granting departments, and the ratio of average total units to standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (rounded to two decimal places), considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptUnitsVarianceStddev AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev, ROUND(d1.avg_total_units / NULLIF(d2.total_units_stddev, 0), 2) AS avg_units_to_stddev_ratio FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptUnitsVarianceStddev d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_units_to_stddev_ratio DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with more than zero total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: List, for each department, the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in Chemistry courses with at least one associated material record, and the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by degree-granting departments (excluding Biology) in the 2022 academic year. For each row, indicate the reason for inclusion as either 'ChemistryEnrollment' or 'DegreeDeptUnits'. The columns should be: department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, average total units, variance of total units, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ChemistryEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DegreeDeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, 'ChemistryEnrollment' AS Reason FROM ChemistryEnrollmentStats UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, NULL, avg_total_units, var_total_units, 'DegreeDeptUnits' AS Reason FROM DegreeDeptUnitStats ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, avg_total_units, var_total_units, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated material record, but only include courses from the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', and excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250', provide the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, the average HR department code for its associated HR org units, and the variance of the HR department codes, listing the DLC key, organization name, organization count, minimum organization number, average department code, and department code variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH OrgDLCStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgHRStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS dept_code_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ods.DLC_KEY, ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number, ohs.avg_dept_code, ohs.dept_code_variance FROM OrgDLCStats ods JOIN OrgHRStats ohs ON ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohs.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ods.organization_count DESC, ohs.dept_code_variance DESC;

sub_questions: For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'.

For each organization, provide the organization name and calculate the average and variance of the HR department codes for its associated HR org units, considering only organizations that are assignable, have a non-null HR department code, and are not the 'ADMISSIONS' organization. Additionally, exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS dept_code_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY dept_code_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the average of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department, where the variance is calculated only for regular terms with a term status of 'Previous'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), VarianceUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, v.total_units_variance FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN VarianceUnits v ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = v.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.stddev_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, what is the description of the academic year and the variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, have a term status of 'Previous', and are offered by the Mathematics department?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each building, what is the building name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area across its historical records (considering only buildings with more than 3 historical records, where the building type is 'ACADEMIC', and excluding the Brown Building), as well as the average and variance of the area of its rooms (for academic buildings and specifically including the Stata building), listing the building name, assignable area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average room area, and variance of room area in that order? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AssignableAreaStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC ), RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT fbh.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS var_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' OR fbh.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' GROUP BY fbh.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT aas.BUILDING_NAME, aas.assignable_area_stddev, ras.avg_area, ras.var_area FROM AssignableAreaStddev aas JOIN RoomAreaStats ras ON aas.BUILDING_NAME = ras.BUILDING_NAME
sub_questions: For each building, what is the building name and the standard deviation of the assignable area across its historical records, considering only buildings with more than 3 historical records, where the building type is 'ACADEMIC', and excluding the Brown Building?

For each building, give the building name and calculate the average and variance of the area of its rooms, but only for buildings that are academic buildings and specifically include the Stata building.
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC;

SELECT fbh.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS var_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' OR fbh.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' GROUP BY fbh.BUILDING_NAME

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department), and for the Mathematics department, also include the academic year and the number of subjects offered in the top 10 academic years with the highest number of subjects offered in the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_fall_subjects AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.subject_count FROM dept_units_stats dus LEFT JOIN math_fall_subjects mfs ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mfs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5).

List the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years with the highest number of subjects offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) and excluding subjects offered by the Department of Physics, provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, the total number of lecture units, as well as the range and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered this year in the Mathematics department. List the results ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ), MathDeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, mds.total_units_range, mds.total_units_variance FROM MathSubjects2022 ms JOIN MathDeptUnitsStats mds ON ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18), provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of lecture units, but exclude subjects offered by the Department of Physics.

For each department, provide the department name and department code, and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered this year, considering only subjects that are letter graded and belong to the Mathematics department.

question: For the Chemistry department, list the department name, the total number of reserved library materials for courses in the Engineering or Science schools (only for Chemistry and only for courses that have materials, with a total reserved materials count greater than 10), and for each subject offered by Chemistry that has course materials, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptReservedMaterials AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10 ), ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT drm.department_name, drm.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students FROM DeptReservedMaterials drm JOIN ChemistrySubjects cs ON drm.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY drm.total_reserved_materials DESC, cs.max_enrolled_students DESC

question: For all rooms with an area greater than 400 in the Stata building, show the room key, building room, area, the subject title of the course meeting in that room that is offered by the Computer Science department, the academic year, the rank of each room within its building (ordered by room key), and for the corresponding academic year, also show the academic year description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that academic year for terms that are regular terms and for subjects offered by the Mathematics department. sql: WITH AcademicYearMathStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), StataLargeCSRooms AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT s.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, s.BUILDING_ROOM, s.AREA, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.window_column, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.total_units_range, a.total_units_variance, a.total_units_stddev FROM StataLargeCSRooms s JOIN AcademicYearMathStats a ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.FCLT_ROOM_KEY;

question: List all Mathematics subjects that are either (1) offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, showing the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, subject ID, and term code, or (2) offered in the academic year 2022 with at least one associated TIP material, showing the subject title, subject ID, term code, term description, and the rank of each subject within its term ordered by subject ID. For each row, also include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('2024_12Units' for the first group and '2022_WithTIP' for the second group). The columns should be: subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, department rank, subject ID, term code, TIP term description, TIP term rank, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subjects2024 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subjects2022WithTIP AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s2024.SUBJECT_CODE, s2024.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2024.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2024.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2024.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2024.window_column, s2024.SUBJECT_ID, s2024.TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TIP_window_column, '2024_12Units' AS Reason FROM Subjects2024 s2024 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2022.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column, s2022.SUBJECT_ID, s2022.TERM_CODE, s2022.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2022.window_column AS TIP_window_column, '2022_WithTIP' AS Reason FROM Subjects2022WithTIP s2022 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_window_column, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject number, subject title, department name, SIS admin department name, rank within each SIS admin department name group ordered by subject number, and also include the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by the Mathematics department (considering only courses with a non-null total units value and departments that grant degrees). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS rank_in_sis_admin_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ), CombinedMathInfo AS ( SELECT ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.rank_in_sis_admin_dept, ds.variance_total_units, ds.stddev_total_units FROM MathSubjects ms JOIN DeptStats ds ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedMathInfo ORDER BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_NUMBER;

sql: WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.window_column FROM DeptStats d JOIN MathSubjects2022 m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 10 and the department is Chemistry, show the academic year, department name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, the academic year description, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), but only include subjects that are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ChemistryDeptStats AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.subject_count, c.min_total_units, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.avg_total_units, m.stddev_total_units FROM ChemistryDeptStats c JOIN MathDeptStats m ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

sub_questions: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 10 and the department is Chemistry, give the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered, but only include subjects that are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology departments.

For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, along with the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in degree-granting Mathematics courses with more than zero enrolled students, where the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) are shown for the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column, mes.avg_enrollment, mes.enrollment_stddev FROM math_subjects_2022 ms LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_stats mes ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mes.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: List, for each department, the department name, the average and variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (for departments that grant degrees, excluding Political Science), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers (excluding Chemistry), along with the reason for inclusion ('Avg/Var' for average and variance, 'CoeffVar' for coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). The columns should be: department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptCoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_enrollment, d1.enrollment_variance, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, 'Avg/Var' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollmentStats d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, d2.coefficient_of_variation, 'CoeffVar' AS Reason FROM DeptCoefficientOfVariation d2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each department name and course level in the Mathematics department, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10 and the subjects are degree-granting courses, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum total units among those subjects, the department code, the range and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered this year, and calculate the course count per unit range (course count divided by total units range, rounded) and the minimum total units per unit variance (minimum total units divided by total units variance, rounded). List the results ordered by course count per unit range in descending order.
sql: WITH DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_LEVEL, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_total_units, dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, ROUND(dcs.course_count / NULLIF(dus.total_units_range, 0), 2) AS course_count_per_unit_range, ROUND(dcs.min_total_units / NULLIF(dus.total_units_variance, 0), 2) AS min_units_per_unit_variance FROM DeptCourseStats dcs JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY course_count_per_unit_range DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees, is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), and has a non-null department full name, and for which the maximum CIP program code among its courses is greater than 120000, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and the full department name? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptCIPMax AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.cip_program_code_variance, dcs.cip_program_code_stddev, dcm.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, dcm.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM DeptCIPStats dcs JOIN DeptCIPMax dcm ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcm.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a non-null department full name, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, what is the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and what is the full department name, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, and the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name, along with the subject title, total units, subject department name, course description, and the dense rank over the offer department code ordered by offer department code for each subject offered in the 'Engineering' school with total units greater than 0 and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department (Course 6), where the student's department matches the subject's offer department code. Present the columns in the following order: first name, last name, department name, student year, department full name, administrative department name, average department phone number (windowed), subject title, total units, subject department name, course description, and dense rank (windowed). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubjectDetails AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), StudentDepartmentDetails AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT sd.FIRST_NAME, sd.LAST_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.window_column AS student_window_column, sbd.SUBJECT_TITLE, sbd.TOTAL_UNITS, sbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sbd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sbd.window_column AS subject_window_column FROM StudentDepartmentDetails sd JOIN SubjectDetails sbd ON sd.DEPARTMENT = sbd.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY sd.FIRST_NAME, sbd.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and not the Biology department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and for subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering that are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Course 6), what is the subject ID, subject title, department full name, and the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), showing only subjects from degree-granting courses? Present the department name and geometric mean of enrolled students, followed by the subject ID, subject title, department full name, and subject rank in department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH department_geometric_mean AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), eecs_subjects AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT egm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, egm.geometric_mean_enrolled_students, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.subject_rank_in_department FROM department_geometric_mean egm JOIN eecs_subjects es ON egm.DEPARTMENT_CODE = es.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
