question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the 'Engineering' school during terms with a term status indicator of 'P' (excluding subjects offered by the Chemistry department and only including courses with materials), and for the Mathematics department in the same academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, what is the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered? Provide the academic year, academic year description, enrolled students variance, department name, number of unique subjects, and minimum total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EngineeringVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ev.enrolled_students_variance, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.num_unique_subjects, ms.min_total_units FROM EngineeringVariance ev JOIN MathDeptStats ms ON ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the 'Engineering' school during terms with a term status indicator of 'P', excluding subjects offered by the Chemistry department and only including courses with materials?

For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, along with the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for that subject if it is offered in the fall term and has library reserve material details with material status 'U'. List the results in order by subject code and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows, c.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ), MathFallLibraryAgg AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, ccso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows, mfla.min_academic_year, mfla.sum_total_units FROM MathSubjects ms LEFT JOIN MathFallLibraryAgg mfla ON ms.SUBJECT_ID = mfla.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code.

What is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and belong to the Mathematics department, considering only library reserve material details with material status 'U'?
sub_sqls: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ;

SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each department, show the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the 'Political Science' department), as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous', the material status is not 'NM', and the department is Mathematics (Course 18). The average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) columns will only be populated for the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON ss.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, mds.avg_total_units, mds.var_total_units, mds.stddev_total_units FROM DeptCoeffVar dcv LEFT JOIN MathDeptStats mds ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the 'Political Science' department.

For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous', the material status is not 'NM', and the department is Mathematics (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON ss.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and department where the total number of units for all Mathematics subjects offered in terms with term status 'Previous' is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all such combinations, show the academic year, department name, total units, and for all Mathematics course subjects in the catalog offered this year in that academic year and department, show the subject code, subject number, responsible faculty's full name, Moira list member, and the average office phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the responsible faculty's last name and ordered by the subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH math_units_stats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), math_subjects_faculty AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER ( PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mus.total_units, msf.SUBJECT_CODE, msf.SUBJECT_NUMBER, msf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, msf.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, msf.AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW FROM math_units_stats mus JOIN math_subjects_faculty msf ON mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR = msf.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msf.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msf.SUBJECT_CODE
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, give the academic year, department name, and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous', but only for the Mathematics department (Course 18), and only include those academic year and department combinations where the total number of units is more than one standard deviation above the mean total units across all such combinations.

For all course subjects in the catalog where the department code is 18 (Mathematics), the department name is 'Mathematics', and the subject is offered this year, show the subject code, subject number, department name, responsible faculty's full name, Moira list member, and the average office phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the responsible faculty's last name and ordered by the subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t );

SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER ( PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the total number of graduate students in the Mathematics department whose department is degree granting and whose student year is 'G', and calculate the normalized running sum rounded (the running sum of subject codes divided by the total number of graduate students in the Mathematics department), ordered by the normalized running sum in descending order.
sql: WITH SubjectUnits AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), GraduateStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT su.SUBJECT_CODE, su.SUBJECT_NUMBER, su.DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.window_column, gs.total_graduate_students, ROUND(su.window_column / NULLIF(gs.total_graduate_students, 0), 2) AS normalized_running_sum FROM SubjectUnits su JOIN GraduateStudents gs ON su.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_running_sum DESC;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department, ordered by subject code.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each floor in the Stata building (building 32), what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24 with a largest room square footage greater than 100, and for each space unit on that floor with a room square footage greater than 10, what are the building room name, room number, room square footage, and the average room square footage within the floor? List the results showing floor name, largest room name, largest room square footage, building room name, room number, room square footage, and average room square footage per floor, ordered by floor name and room square footage. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH largest_room_per_floor AS ( SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = ( SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' ) ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME ), room_and_avg_per_floor AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE ) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR FROM largest_room_per_floor lrf JOIN room_and_avg_per_floor raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE;
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"
sub_questions: For each floor, what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage, for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, with a largest room square footage greater than 100, and only for rooms in the Stata building (building 32)?

For each space unit in the Stata building with a room square footage greater than 10, show the building room name, room number, room square footage, floor name, and the average room square footage within each floor, ordered by room square footage.
sub_sqls: SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = ( SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' ) ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME;

SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE;

question: For each subject title that is both offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department (with total units greater than 0 and not from the Chemistry department) and is a Mathematics subject offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, give the subject title, the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject, the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubjectRecordCountVariance AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), MathSubjectsWindowed AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.record_count_variance, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.window_column FROM SubjectRecordCountVariance s JOIN MathSubjectsWindowed m ON s.SUBJECT_TITLE = m.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s.record_count_variance DESC
sub_questions: For each subject title, what is the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject, considering only subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, with a total number of units greater than 0, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department?

For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: List, for each department, the department name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department (for departments that have offered more than 5 subjects, are degree granting, and are not the Chemistry department), and for subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students by the Mathematics department, the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Show all these columns in the following order: department name, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, subject title, number of enrolled students, and window row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.stddev_total_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column FROM DeptStddev d UNION ALL SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS stddev_total_units, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.window_column FROM MathSubjects m ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than 5 subjects, are degree granting, and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5)?

For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each degree-granting department except Physics (Course 8), provide the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term, and for each Chemistry subject offered by that department in the 2017JA term, show the subject title, offer department code, offer department name, department full name, and the average number of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by the number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5' ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.variance_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.avg_enrolled FROM DeptUnitsStats dus JOIN ChemistrySubjects cs ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name, both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department (Course 8).

For each subject offered in the term 2017JA by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, offer department code, offer department name, department full name, and the average number of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by the number of enrolled students, but only include subjects that are Chemistry courses.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5'

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes per course offered by that department (considering only degree-granting courses), and for each subject code in Mathematics where the department is degree granting, what are the subject code, subject code description, school name, and the average department budget code within each school? List the results showing the department name, subject count range, subject count variance, subject count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), subject code, subject code description, school name, and average department budget code in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH department_subject_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC ), math_subject_codes AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count_range, dss.subject_count_variance, dss.subject_count_stddev, msc.SUBJECT_CODE, msc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, msc.SCHOOL_NAME, msc.avg_dept_budget_code FROM department_subject_stats dss CROSS JOIN math_subject_codes msc;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of unique subject codes per course offered by that department, considering only degree-granting courses in the Mathematics department?

For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, ordered by department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For the Mathematics department, which is degree-granting, what are the department code, department name, the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY (where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (excluding Political Science and only including degree-granting departments)? List the department code, department name, minimum number of enrolled students, average total units, and coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.min_num_enrolled_students, s1.avg_total_units, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: What are the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED and the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY for each department, where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21, and the department is degree granting, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) and excluding subjects offered by the Department of Physics, provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of lecture units for each subject, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses for which a responsible faculty member is also a member of a Moira list, considering only courses offered this year and only for the Mathematics department. The results should list the subject ID, subject title, department name, number of enrolled students, lecture units, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ), math_units_stats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, mus.avg_total_units, mus.total_units_variance, mus.total_units_stddev FROM math_subjects_2022 ms LEFT JOIN math_units_stats mus ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses (considering only courses that are offered in the current term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are in the Mathematics department with available course materials), as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department. Present the results ordered by the enrolled student range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH enrolled_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), units_stats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, us.avg_total_units, us.stddev_total_units FROM enrolled_stats es JOIN units_stats us ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name, the range and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the full name of the corresponding administrative department, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5) and the Physics department (Course 8). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DepartmentUnitsVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_range, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.coefficient_of_variation FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des JOIN DepartmentUnitsVariation duv ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each graduate-level, degree-granting course offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the course description, department name, school name, administrative department name, and the dense rank over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name. sql: WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), MathDeptUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.SCHOOL_NAME, mc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.admin_dept_dense_rank, mdu.total_units_range, mdu.total_units_variance FROM MathCourses mc JOIN MathDeptUnits mdu ON mc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND mc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mdu.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each department that grants degrees, considering only graduate-level courses and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and, if the department is Mathematics, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in its subjects (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student)? sql: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), MathCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, mcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptEnrolledStats des LEFT JOIN MathCoeffVar mcv ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology and Chemistry), give the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year (only including departments with more than one subject in that year), as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 total units). List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), coefficient_of_variation_by_dept AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.coefficient_of_variation, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM coefficient_of_variation_by_dept c JOIN dept_stats d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;
