question: For the top 10 departments by the number of unique courses they offer (excluding the Political Science and Mathematics departments, and only including degree-granting departments belonging to a school with a non-null name), provide for each department: the department name, school name, total number of unique courses offered, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments (excluding Mathematics), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments (excluding Mathematics). List the results in order of total number of unique courses offered, descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, course_subjects.DEPARTMENT FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, course_subjects.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), TopDeptCourses AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdc.SCHOOL_NAME, tdc.total_courses, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes FROM TopDeptCourses tdc LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectStats dss ON tdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY tdc.total_courses DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, but only include departments other than 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

List the top 10 departments by the number of unique courses they offer, including the department name, school name, and the total number of courses, but only for departments that are degree granting, belong to a school with a non-null name, and are not the Political Science department (Course 17).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), display the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and, if the department is Mathematics, also display the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in Mathematics subjects offered during non-summer fall terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_fall_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.stddev_enrolled_students, mfes.avg_enrollment, mfes.enrollment_range, mfes.enrollment_variance FROM dept_enrollment_stats des LEFT JOIN math_fall_enrollment_stats mfes ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mfes.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that are degree granting, but exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, and the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subject_running_sum AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_grad_students AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT srs.SUBJECT_CODE, srs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, srs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, srs.window_column, mgs.total_graduate_students FROM subject_running_sum srs LEFT JOIN math_grad_students mgs ON srs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY srs.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department, ordered by subject code.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for each of these, also provide the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by the same department in the 2022 academic year, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Biology department (Course 7). The columns should be: subject title, department name, term description, window column, average units, and units variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH math_letter_graded AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT mlg.SUBJECT_TITLE, mlg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mlg.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mlg.window_column, dus.avg_units, dus.units_variance FROM math_letter_graded mlg JOIN dept_units_stats dus ON mlg.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, has offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP', is not the Chemistry department, and is not the Biology department (Course 7), give the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year. List the department name, range of number of subjects, variance of number of subjects, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of number of subjects, and coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.range_num_subjects, dss.variance_num_subjects, dss.stddev_num_subjects, dus.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP', and are not the Chemistry department.

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each of the Chemistry and Biology departments, what is the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in its offered subjects that have at least one associated course material, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (only including degree-granting departments and excluding the Physics department)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_units_variation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, duv.coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_enrollment_stats des LEFT JOIN dept_units_variation duv ON des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in its offered subjects that have at least one associated course material, but only include the Chemistry and Biology departments (i.e., Course 5 and Course 7).

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department (Course 8).
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in each academic year for terms that are regular terms and for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and for each of the three academic terms with the highest number of Mathematics subjects offered, what is the term code, the term description, and the academic year description of the term? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), TopMathTerms AS ( SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_range, ays.total_units_variance, ays.total_units_stddev, tmt.TERM_CODE, tmt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tmt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS TERM_ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM AcademicYearStats ays JOIN TopMathTerms tmt ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = tmt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ays.total_units_range DESC, tmt.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in each academic year for terms that are regular terms and for subjects offered by the Mathematics department?
Which three academic terms had the highest number of subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and for each, what is the term code, the term description, and the academic year description?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3;

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the title of the subject with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term (where the department is degree granting and the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), the maximum number of enrolled students, and for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, what is the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH max_enrollment_math AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ), math_2024_12units AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT mem.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mem.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, mem.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, m12.SUBJECT_CODE, m12.SUBJECT_TITLE AS UNITS12_SUBJECT_TITLE, m12.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS UNITS12_DEPARTMENT_NAME, m12.SCHOOL_NAME, m12.window_column FROM max_enrollment_math mem JOIN math_2024_12units m12 ON mem.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m12.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term, and what is the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, considering only departments that are degree granting, where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department name and school name where the student year is 'G' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department, provide the department name, school name, number of students, minimum office phone number, subject code, subject number, and the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2022.window_column FROM DeptStudentStats dss JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms2022 ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department name and school name where the student year is 'G' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), give the number of students and the minimum office phone number.

For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department, ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each academic year, show the academic year, academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in regular terms that start after January 1, 2010, as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in regular terms, listing the columns in the following order: academic year, academic year description, total units range (for terms after January 1, 2010), total units variance (for terms after January 1, 2010), average total units (for all regular terms), range of total units (for all regular terms), and variance of total units (for all regular terms). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AcademicYearUnitsRangeVariance AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), AcademicYearUnitsStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ayurv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayurv.total_units_range, ayurv.total_units_variance, ays.avg_total_units, ays.range_total_units, ays.var_total_units FROM AcademicYearUnitsRangeVariance ayurv JOIN AcademicYearUnitsStats ays ON ayurv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ayurv.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that start after January 1, 2010 and are regular terms, specifically for subjects in the Mathematics department?

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each degree-granting department named Mathematics that appears among the top 10 departments by number of students, show the department name, its corresponding administrative department name, the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, the school name, and the count of students in the department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptAdminStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), TopDeptStudentCounts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ( d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' OR d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8' ) GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, tds.SCHOOL_NAME, tds.student_count FROM DeptAdminStats das JOIN TopDeptStudentCounts tds ON das.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY tds.student_count DESC;
sub_questions: For each department and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of departments and the minimum department budget code.

List the top 10 departments by the number of students, showing the department name, school name, and the count of students in each department, for departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department name, and are either the Mathematics department or the Physics department.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ( d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' OR d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8' ) GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), which is degree granting, give the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0), as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students). List the department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, variance of number of enrolled students, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CourseUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), EnrolledStudentsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.avg_total_units, c.total_units_range, c.total_units_variance, e.variance_num_enrolled_students, e.stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM CourseUnitsStats c JOIN EnrolledStudentsStats e ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students and departments that grant degrees, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0 and departments that are degree granting), along with, for each course level, the number of unique students and the minimum CIP program code among their courses. List the columns in the following order: department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, course level, student count, and minimum CIP program code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s2.COURSE_LEVEL, s2.student_count, s2.min_cip_code FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique students and the minimum CIP program code among their courses.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each academic year with more than 10 Mathematics subjects that have course materials and a nonzero number of enrolled students, list the academic year, the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in Mathematics subjects, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics subjects, and the normalized enrollment variation (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students divided by coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units), ordered by normalized enrollment variation in descending order.
sql: WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.enrolled_stddev, cv.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(es.enrolled_stddev / NULLIF(cv.coefficient_of_variation, 0), 2) AS normalized_enrollment_variation FROM EnrolledStddev es JOIN CoefficientOfVariation cv ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY normalized_enrollment_variation DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in terms within that year, but only include subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description and the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the Mathematics department, considering only years with more than 10 subjects that have course materials and courses with a nonzero amount of enrolled students.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), which is degree granting, what are the department code, department name, the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY (where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21), as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH min_enrolled_and_avg_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT meaud.DEPARTMENT_CODE, meaud.DEPARTMENT_NAME, meaud.min_num_enrolled_students, meaud.avg_total_units, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev FROM min_enrolled_and_avg_units meaud JOIN enrollment_stats es ON meaud.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: What are the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED and the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY for each department, where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21, and the department is degree granting, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting and not from the Mathematics department, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, what is the department name of the course, and what are the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Biology department and only including departments that grant degrees)? List the course, maximum CIP program code, department name, average total units, and variance of total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EngineeringCourseCIP AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ecc.COURSE, ecc.max_cip_program_code, ecc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units FROM EngineeringCourseCIP ecc JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON ecc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ecc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ecc.COURSE
sub_questions: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, and what is the department name of the course, excluding courses from the Mathematics department?

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: Show the full name of each student in the Political Science department, their department name, the corresponding school name, and the SIS administrative department name, along with dense ranks over the student's year (ordered by student year), and for each, provide the average, range, and variance of the number of students enrolled in subjects offered by the Political Science department (considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and excluding the Chemistry department). Present the results in the order of student year rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PoliticalScienceStudents AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank, msd.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT pss.FULL_NAME, pss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.SCHOOL_NAME, pss.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank, des.avg_enrolled, des.range_enrolled, des.var_enrolled FROM PoliticalScienceStudents pss LEFT JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON pss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY pss.student_year_rank;
sub_questions: Show the full name of each student in the Political Science department, their department name, the corresponding school name, and the SIS administrative department name, along with dense ranks over the student's year, ordered by student year, and only include students whose department is Course 17.

For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of students enrolled in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year and for each department (Chemistry or Biology) in that year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, what is the academic year, academic year description, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term that are not variable units, the department name, the count of subjects in that department and year, the minimum start date of the term, and the normalized variance per subject (variance of total units divided by subject count, rounded to two decimals), listing the columns in this order: academic year, academic year description, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, department, subject count, minimum term start date, and normalized variance per subject?
sql: WITH MathUnitsStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), ChemBioSubjects AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.variance_total_units, m.stddev_total_units, c.department, c.subject_count, c.min_term_start_date, ROUND(m.variance_total_units / NULLIF(c.subject_count, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance_per_subject FROM MathUnitsStats m JOIN ChemBioSubjects c ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.academic_year ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.department

sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, and the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by the Mathematics department (considering only courses with total units greater than zero and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department). List the results ordered by subject code and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ), DeptGeomMean AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows, dgmt.geometric_mean_total_units FROM MathSubjects ms JOIN DeptGeomMean dgmt ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgmt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code.

For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than zero, and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department?
sub_sqls: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year, have total units greater than zero, and are in the Mathematics department), ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.LECTURE_UNITS, s1.LAB_UNITS, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.GRADE_TYPE, s1.GRADE_RULE, s1.min_total_units_by_dept, s2.geometric_mean_total_units FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department code.

For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, have total units greater than zero, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, the average number of enrolled students and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in courses with at least one reserved library material with material status 'U' and offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department. Only include subjects where the offer department name is 'Chemistry'. Present the columns in the following order: subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, offer department name, windowed minimum enrolled students, average enrollment, and enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC

question: For each department in the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department code, department's full name, the range and variance of CIP program codes among its degree-granting courses with non-null CIP program codes, the department name, the number of library subjects offered, and the total number of students enrolled in TIP subjects for departments that had at least 5 students enrolled in TIP subjects in 2020FA? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DepartmentTIPLibraryStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_library_subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_tip_enrollment FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 5 ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, dtls.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtls.num_library_subjects, dtls.total_tip_enrollment FROM DepartmentCIPStats dcs JOIN DepartmentTIPLibraryStats dtls ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dtls.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department's full name, and what are the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses that are degree granting, have a non-null CIP program code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
