SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_library_subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_tip_enrollment FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 5;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term is greater than 100, give the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, courses that have more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments. The columns should be: department name, total number of enrolled students, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentEnrollment AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrolled, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentEnrollment de JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, courses that have more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department except the Biology department (Course 7), give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and for each such department also show, if available, the subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, and the row number within the department (ordered by subject code) for subjects in the Mathematics department with a total of 12 units offered in the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentVariation AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, ms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ms.window_column FROM DepartmentVariation dv LEFT JOIN MathSubjects ms ON dv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For subjects in the course catalog with a total of 12 units, offered in the fall term, and in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For the Mathematics department, list the department name, the subject title with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term (where the department is degree granting and the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), the maximum number of enrolled students, the subject code, the school name, and the rank within each school name group (ordered by subject code) for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units. Show all columns in the order: department name, subject title, maximum number of enrolled students, subject code, school name, and rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MaxEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ), MathSubjects2024 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), CombinedMath AS ( SELECT me.DEPARTMENT_NAME, me.SUBJECT_TITLE, me.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.window_column FROM MaxEnrollment me JOIN MathSubjects2024 ms ON me.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedMath ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term, and what is the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, considering only departments that are degree granting, where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0 and departments that are degree granting), and what are the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Biology department and considering only degree-granting departments)? List the department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, average total units in 2022, and variance of total units in 2022, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH math_course_units_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), dept_subject_units_2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT mcu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcu.avg_total_units, mcu.total_units_range, mcu.total_units_variance, dsu.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_2022, dsu.var_total_units AS var_total_units_2022 FROM math_course_units_stats mcu JOIN dept_subject_units_2022 dsu ON mcu.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsu.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) considering only years with more than five activities, the range of the total number of students enrolled in Mathematics subjects during regular terms with more than 0 enrolled students, and the variance of the total number of students enrolled in those subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH IAPMaxEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT iap.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, iap.stddev_max_enrollment, mes.enrollment_range, mes.enrollment_variance FROM IAPMaxEnrollmentStats iap JOIN MathEnrollmentStats mes ON iap.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mes.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY iap.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only years with more than five activities, and what is the corresponding academic year description?

For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total number of students enrolled in subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) during that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and terms that are regular terms.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department that is degree-granting in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry) and where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department is greater than 100, and where the department is not Mathematics, give the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, listing the results in order of decreasing total number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolled AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), DeptUnitsCV AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrolled, du.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptEnrolled de JOIN DeptUnitsCV du ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY de.total_enrolled DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

question: For each department that is either Chemistry or Biology, give the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in its offered subjects that have at least one associated course material, and also provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded and in degree-granting departments (excluding Biology). List the columns in the following order: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, average total units, total units range, and total units variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.enrolled_range, s1.enrolled_variance, s2.avg_total_units, s2.range_total_units, s2.var_total_units FROM Subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in its offered subjects that have at least one associated course material, but only include the Chemistry and Biology departments (i.e., Course 5 and Course 7).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) by the number of unique subject titles offered with at least one enrolled student, show the department name, the total count of unique subject titles, and, if the department is Mathematics, also show the average, range, and variance of the department budget code for all subject codes associated with Mathematics. List the results ordered by the total count of unique subject titles in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopDepartments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), MathBudgetStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY budget_range DESC ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.subject_count, mbs.avg_budget, mbs.budget_range, mbs.budget_variance FROM TopDepartments td LEFT JOIN MathBudgetStats mbs ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY td.subject_count DESC;
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered, including the department name and the total count of unique subject titles, for departments that are degree granting, have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, and exclude the Political Science department (Course 17).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the department budget code for all subject codes associated with that department where the department is degree granting, but only include departments whose name is 'Mathematics'.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY budget_range DESC;

question: For each academic year and department where the total number of units for all Mathematics subjects offered in terms with term status 'Previous' is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all such combinations, list the academic year, department name, total number of units, the academic year description, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for Mathematics subjects in that academic year that had at least one required or optional material. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathUnitsStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), MathMaterialStats AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mus.total_units, mms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mms.avg_total_units, mms.stddev_total_units FROM MathUnitsStats mus JOIN MathMaterialStats mms ON mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mus.total_units DESC, mms.stddev_total_units DESC
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, give the academic year, department name, and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous', but only for the Mathematics department (Course 18), and only include those academic year and department combinations where the total number of units is more than one standard deviation above the mean total units across all such combinations.

For each academic year, what is the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects in the Mathematics department that had at least one required or optional material, including the academic year description?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t );

SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), provide the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year. Additionally, for the Mathematics department, include the course level, the number of unique courses, and the minimum CIP program code for each course level. The results should display the department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), course level, course count, and minimum CIP program code, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), coefficient_variation AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), math_courses AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv.coefficient_of_variation, mc.COURSE_LEVEL, mc.course_count, mc.min_cip_code FROM coefficient_variation cv LEFT JOIN math_courses mc ON cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.COURSE_LEVEL;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code.
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding Chemistry and Biology), what are the department code, department full name, school name, average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and, for the Mathematics department (Course 18), the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, school name, and dense rank over the department code ordered by department code for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.avg_enrolled_students, ds.var_enrolled_students, ds.stddev_enrolled_students, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_school_name, ms.window_column FROM DeptStats ds LEFT JOIN MathSubjects ms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE

sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, along with the department's full name and the school name, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments?

List the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and school name for each subject offered, along with dense ranks over the department code ordered by department code, for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in departments that grant degrees, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME

SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) but excluding subjects offered by the Department of Physics, provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of lecture units for the subject, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by the Mathematics department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ) SELECT mes.SUBJECT_ID, mes.SUBJECT_TITLE, mes.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mes.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mes.LECTURE_UNITS, des.enrolled_students_range, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM MathSubjects2022 mes JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON mes.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mes.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, mes.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18), provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of lecture units, but exclude subjects offered by the Department of Physics.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in regular terms that start after January 1, 2010, as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s2.avg_total_units, s2.range_total_units, s2.var_total_units FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that start after January 1, 2010 and are regular terms, specifically for subjects in the Mathematics department?

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the administrative department whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2) in the academic year 2024, and for each department that is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18) and offers subjects in regular academic terms, give the administrative department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that administrative department in 2024, the department name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in regular academic terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AdminDeptCov AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptCov AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT adc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, adc.coefficient_of_variation AS admin_dept_coefficient_of_variation, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.coefficient_of_variation AS dept_coefficient_of_variation FROM AdminDeptCov adc CROSS JOIN DeptCov dc;
sub_questions: For each administrative department, give the administrative department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, but only include departments whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2).

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with at least one enrolled student), as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded). List the department name, average enrolled students, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.avg_enrolled_students, e.range_enrolled_students, e.var_enrolled_students, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM EnrolledStats e JOIN UnitsStats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and restricting the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and provide both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH SubjectCodeStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev, dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.subject_code_count_variance, s.subject_code_count_stddev, u.total_units_range, u.total_units_variance FROM SubjectCodeStats s JOIN UnitsStats u ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.subject_code_count_variance DESC;

question: For each organization, show the organization name, organization ID, department name, department code, department long name, and the maximum HR organization unit ID for each organization considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by organization ID, but only for departments whose name is "Political Science" (Course 17), and exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. Also, for each such organization, show the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms if the organization has more than 5 rooms, is associated with a non-null DLC key, and is not the 'ADMISSIONS' department or the 'Political Science' department; otherwise, show null for the area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). The columns should be shown in the following order: organization name, organization ID, department name, department code, department long name, maximum HR organization unit ID, and area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). sql: WITH OrgPoliticalScienceMaxUnit AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MAX(t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NOT NULL AND t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ), DepartmentRoomAreaStddev AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC ) SELECT o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o1.ORGANIZATION_ID, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o1.MAX_HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, d2.area_stddev FROM OrgPoliticalScienceMaxUnit o1 LEFT JOIN DepartmentRoomAreaStddev d2 ON o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = d2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY o1.ORGANIZATION_ID;

question: For each department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that are degree granting, but excluding the Political Science department), as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments (considering only degree-granting departments and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department). sql: WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentClearingCostStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_range, des.enrollment_variance, dccs.clearing_cost_collector_range, dccs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dccs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des JOIN DepartmentClearingCostStats dccs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrollment_range DESC, dccs.clearing_cost_collector_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that have more than 0 total units and are offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P', as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in terms that started after January 1, 2000 and are in the Mathematics department. Include all academic years that appear in either calculation, and show the academic year, academic year description, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), AvgStddevTotalUnits AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_START_DATE > '2000-01-01' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units FROM CoefficientOfVariation c LEFT JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnits a ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units FROM AvgStddevTotalUnits a LEFT JOIN CoefficientOfVariation c ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, provide for each the course number, course description, and subject title, along with the offer count, and for each student named Peter in the Mathematics department, show their last name, email address, student year, department name, school name, and the minimum department budget code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name. sql: WITH TopMathCourses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ), MathPeters AS ( SELECT t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Peter' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, mp.LAST_NAME, mp.EMAIL_ADDRESS, mp.STUDENT_YEAR, mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mp.SCHOOL_NAME, mp.window_column FROM TopMathCourses tmc JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON tmc.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN MathPeters mp ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mp.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY tmc.offer_count DESC, mp.LAST_NAME

sql: WITH DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), SchoolMathUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, smus.SCHOOL_NAME, smus.avg_total_units, smus.total_units_variance, smus.total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentEnrolledStats des JOIN SchoolMathUnitsStats smus ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = smus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrolled_range DESC
