SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON ss.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021, excluding the Chemistry department, provide the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and, if the department is a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering with more than 100 total enrolled students in its subjects, also include the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_subjects_2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), eng_dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds21.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds21.SCHOOL_NAME, ds21.num_subjects_offered, ds21.total_enrolled_students, ede.total_enrolled FROM dept_subjects_2021 ds21 LEFT JOIN eng_dept_enrollment ede ON ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ede.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds21.num_subjects_offered DESC, ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021, excluding the Chemistry department, provide the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), which is degree-granting, what are the department code, department name, department full name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered, the range of total units, the variance of total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for courses offered this year with non-null total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentSubjectVariation AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT dsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsv.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dsv.coefficient_of_variation, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentSubjectVariation dsv JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the coefficient of variation of the number of subjects offered, and what is the full name of the department, considering only departments that are degree-granting and including only the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are offered this year, have a non-null total units value, and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, provide the department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV_POP(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department that is degree granting, not the Chemistry department, and has offered more than 5 subjects, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, and, if the department is Mathematics, also provide the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of letter graded subjects offered this year in Mathematics (Course 18)? List the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the variance of total units (for Mathematics), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (for Mathematics), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), MathVarianceStddev AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.stddev_total_units, m.total_units_variance, m.total_units_stddev FROM DeptStddev d LEFT JOIN MathVarianceStddev m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than 5 subjects, are degree granting, and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5)?

question: For each department that is both the Mathematics department and a degree-granting department (excluding Biology, Course 7), and for each academic year, show the department name as math_department_name, the academic year, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department that are not for graduate credit and are offered in regular terms (as math_avg_total_units, math_total_units_variance, math_total_units_stddev), and also show the department name as degree_department_name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (as degree_avg_total_units, degree_var_total_units). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE so.HGN_CODE = 'N' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DegreeDeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, mds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mds.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, mds.total_units_variance AS math_total_units_variance, mds.total_units_stddev AS math_total_units_stddev, dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS degree_department_name, dds.avg_total_units AS degree_avg_total_units, dds.var_total_units AS degree_var_total_units FROM MathDeptStats mds JOIN DegreeDeptStats dds ON mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mds.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department and academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, considering only subjects that are not for graduate credit and are offered in regular terms?

question: For each department, list the department name, the range and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and the full name of the corresponding administrative department (for all departments that grant degrees except Chemistry), as well as, for the Mathematics department (Course 18), the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and indicate the reason for inclusion as either 'General' or 'Mathematics'. The columns should be: department name, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, administrative department name, variance of enrolled students (Mathematics), standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students (Mathematics), and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_students_range, ds.enrolled_students_variance, ds.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS variance_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS stddev_num_enrolled_students, 'General' AS Reason FROM DeptStats ds UNION ALL SELECT ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS enrolled_students_range, NULL AS enrolled_students_variance, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.variance_num_enrolled_students, ms.stddev_num_enrolled_students, 'Mathematics' AS Reason FROM MathStats ms ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each department name and school name in the Mathematics department (Course 18) where the student year is 'G', list the department name, school name, number of students, minimum office phone number, and for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 units in Mathematics, show the subject code, subject number, and the running sum of subject codes within the department, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2022.window_column FROM DepartmentStudentStats dss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms2022 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms2022.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: List, for each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, and for each department that is degree granting and not the Mathematics department (Course 18), the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments. Indicate the source of each row as either 'MathematicsSubject' or 'NonMathDeptStats'. Show the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), NonMathDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.avg_dept_budget_code, NULL AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, NULL AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, NULL AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, 'MathematicsSubject' AS Source FROM MathSubjects m UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, n.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS avg_dept_budget_code, n.avg_clearing_cost_collector, n.clearing_cost_collector_variance, n.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, 'NonMathDeptStats' AS Source FROM NonMathDeptStats n ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each student in the MIT student directory whose department is '6' (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their full name, email address, department name, the corresponding SIS admin department name, the average department code within each department code group, the department name from the degree-granting departments (excluding Mathematics), and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all degree-granting courses in that department, ordered by the student's full name. sql: WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME) AS avg_department_code, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT e.FULL_NAME, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.avg_department_code, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_cip_department_name, d.avg_cip_program_code, d.stddev_cip_program_code FROM EECSStudents e JOIN DeptCIPStats d ON e.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.FULL_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree granting and not the Biology department, and that also offers Chemistry courses with at least one library reserve material in terms with a term status indicator of 'P', provide the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, and the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in Chemistry courses with at least one library reserve material and offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P', in that order. sql: WITH ChemistryCourseStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.variance_num_students, d.stddev_num_students, c.avg_enrolled_students, c.var_enrolled_students, c.stddev_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentStudentStats d JOIN ChemistryCourseStats c ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department offering courses, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in Chemistry courses that have at least one library reserve material and are offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P'?

For each department, what is the department name and both the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year for that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department?
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and is the Mathematics department (Course 18), what are the department code, department name, department full name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered, the average clearing cost collector value, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for its associated administrative department, excluding the Political Science department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentSubjectVariation AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DepartmentClearingCostStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsv.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dsv.coefficient_of_variation, dccs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dccs.stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM DepartmentSubjectVariation dsv JOIN DepartmentClearingCostStats dccs ON dsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the coefficient of variation of the number of subjects offered, and what is the full name of the department, considering only departments that are degree-granting and including only the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, provide the department name and the average and standard deviation of the clearing cost collector values for its associated administrative department, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Political Science department.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV_POP(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250', and for each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms, provide the DLC key, organization name, number of organizations, minimum organization number, building name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), BuildingRoomStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC ) SELECT os.DLC_KEY, os.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev FROM OrgStats os JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON os.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats brs ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"
sub_questions: For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'.
For each building at MIT, provide the building name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, considering only academic buildings with more than 10 rooms.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), show the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, and, if the department is Mathematics, also show for each of its subjects with total units equal to 12 in 2024 the subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and the row number of the subject within the Mathematics department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_cv AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.window_column FROM dept_cv dcv LEFT JOIN math_subjects ms ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 in the Mathematics department, show the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code. Only include subjects from the Mathematics department.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18) in the 2022FA term, considering only departments that have more than 5 subjects offered, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, and for each subject code in this department that is degree-granting, what are the subject code, subject code description, and the running sum of department budget codes within each school, ordered by department code? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), MathSubjectCodes AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_stddev, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, m.running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM DeptEnrolledStddev d JOIN MathSubjectCodes m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.enrolled_stddev DESC, m.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, considering only departments that have more than 5 subjects offered in the 2022FA term, and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each subject code where the department is degree-granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, and the running sum of department budget codes within each school, ordered by department code.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department (considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department), as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for its associated administrative department (including only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Political Science department)? Provide the academic year, department name, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, average clearing cost collector, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of clearing cost collector, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units_variance, s1.total_units_stddev, s2.avg_clearing_cost_collector, s2.stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, provide the department name and the average and standard deviation of the clearing cost collector values for its associated administrative department, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Political Science department.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and department where the total number of units for all Mathematics subjects offered in terms with term status 'Previous' is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all such combinations, provide the academic year, department name, total units, the academic year description, and the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered this year and are in regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TotalUnitsAboveStddev AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), YearlyUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.total_units, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, y.total_units_variance, y.total_units_stddev FROM TotalUnitsAboveStddev t JOIN YearlyUnitsStats y ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, give the academic year, department name, and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous', but only for the Mathematics department (Course 18), and only include those academic year and department combinations where the total number of units is more than one standard deviation above the mean total units across all such combinations.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are regular terms, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t );

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each organization and associated academic building (excluding organizations '138' and '250', and organizations named 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST', and buildings named 'Ashdown House'), what is the organization name, the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, the building's full name, the building's postal code, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms (only including buildings with average room area greater than zero)? List the organization name, geometric mean, building full name, postal code, and coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH OrgGeoMean AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), BuildingRoomCV AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ) SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, brcv.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, brcv.POSTAL_CODE, brcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM OrgGeoMean ogm JOIN BuildingRoomCV brcv ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = brcv.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ogm.geometric_mean DESC, brcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

sub_questions: For each organization, what is the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only for organizations that are not 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'? Show the organization name and the geometric mean.

For each building that is an academic building, what is the coefficient of variation of the area of its rooms, and what is the building's full name and postal code? Only include buildings whose name is not "Ashdown House".
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: Show the subject title, total units, department name, course description, and dense rank over the offer department code ordered by offer department code for each subject offered in the 'Engineering' school with total units greater than 0 and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department (Course 6), along with the first name, last name, department name, student year, corresponding department's full name, administrative department name, and the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name, for students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', where the subject's offer department code matches the student's department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subject_summary AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), student_summary AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ss.window_column AS subject_window_rank, st.FIRST_NAME, st.LAST_NAME, st.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS student_department_name, st.STUDENT_YEAR, st.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, st.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, st.window_column AS student_window_avg_phone FROM subject_summary ss JOIN student_summary st ON ss.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = st.DEPARTMENT;

"Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"

sub_questions: Show the subject title, total units, department name, and course description for each subject, along with dense ranks over the offer department code ordered by offer department code, for subjects offered in the 'Engineering' school, with total units greater than 0, and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department (Course 6).

For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, and the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

question: For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', and excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250', provide the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, the average HR department code for its associated HR org units, and the variance of the HR department codes, ordered by the number of organizations (descending) and then by the variance of the HR department codes (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH OrgDlcStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgHrStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS dept_code_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ods.DLC_KEY, ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number, ohs.avg_dept_code, ohs.dept_code_variance FROM OrgDlcStats ods JOIN OrgHrStats ohs ON ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohs.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ods.organization_count DESC, ohs.dept_code_variance DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

sub_questions: For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'.

For each organization, provide the organization name and calculate the average and variance of the HR department codes for its associated HR org units, considering only organizations that are assignable, have a non-null HR department code, and are not the 'ADMISSIONS' organization. Additionally, exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS dept_code_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY dept_code_variance DESC;

question: For each department that offers a course and is degree granting (excluding Chemistry department/Course 5), and that is either Chemistry or Biology and has at least one course with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ', what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department? List the department name, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average total units, range of total units, and variance of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), DeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, es.enrolled_variance, es.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN DeptUnitStats dus ON es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For each department that offers a course, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, considering only courses that have at least one enrolled student, have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and are from the Chemistry or Biology departments?

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics department subjects (from terms with a term status indicator of 'P' and total units greater than 0), the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total subject enrollment numbers per academic year (from terms with a term status indicator of 'P', subject enrollment number greater than 0, and department Mathematics), the average total units divided by the enrollment range (rounded), and the enrollment variance divided by the total units variance (rounded).
sql: WITH TotalUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), EnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tus.avg_total_units, tus.var_total_units, tus.stddev_total_units, es.enrollment_range, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev, ROUND(tus.avg_total_units / NULLIF(es.enrollment_range, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_enrollment_range, ROUND(es.enrollment_variance / NULLIF(tus.var_total_units, 0), 2) AS enrollment_variance_to_units_variance_ratio FROM EnrollmentStats es JOIN TotalUnitsStats tus ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY avg_units_per_enrollment_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only subjects from terms with a term status indicator of 'P' and with total units greater than 0?

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the range, variance, and standard deviation of total subject enrollment numbers per academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P', the total subject enrollment number is greater than 0, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting (excluding Chemistry and only those with more than 100 enrolled students in their subjects), display the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms (excluding Mathematics). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), dept_units_cv AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrolled, du.coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_enrollment de JOIN dept_units_cv du ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY de.total_enrolled DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

question: For the top 10 departments by the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Political Science department and including only departments that grant degrees), display each department's name, the count of subjects, and, if the department is Mathematics, also show the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students with a non-null office phone number). List the results in descending order of subject count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH top_departments AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), math_office_phone_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.subject_count, mos.avg_office_phone, mos.stddev_office_phone FROM top_departments td LEFT JOIN math_office_phone_stats mos ON td.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mos.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY td.subject_count DESC;
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, showing each department's name and the count of subjects, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17) from the results and only include departments that grant degrees.

For each department, provide the department name and the average and standard deviation of the office phone numbers of students in that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, students who have a non-null office phone number, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC;

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials for the Mathematics department, considering only records where the material status is 'U' and the term status indicator is 'P' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentVariation AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathSubjects ms JOIN DepartmentVariation dv ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials, considering only records where the material status is 'U', the term status indicator is 'P', and the department is Mathematics (Course 18).

SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ;

question: For the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, provide the course number, course description, subject title, the number of times each course was offered, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopMathCourses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ), MathDeptStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, mds.total_units_stddev FROM TopMathCourses tmc JOIN MathDeptStddev mds ON mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY tmc.offer_count DESC, tmc.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each department that is degree granting and either offers more than five subjects or is the Mathematics department, and is also either the Chemistry or Biology department with at least one course with enrolled students and required course materials, list the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.stddev_total_units, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev FROM DeptUnitsStddev dus JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the number of students in the Mathematics department, and the total number of unique student years represented among those students, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathSubjects2024 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathDeptStudents AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedMathInfo AS ( SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept, mds.student_count, mds.unique_student_years FROM MathSubjects2024 ms JOIN MathDeptStudents mds ON ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedMathInfo ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the average number of students enrolled in Mathematics department courses offered in the fall term with at least 1 enrolled student, the variance of enrolled students in those courses, the variance of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with more than 0 total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of those subjects? sql: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT u.ACADEMIC_YEAR, u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.avg_enrolled, e.enrolled_variance, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM UnitsStats u JOIN EnrolledStats e ON u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY u.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
