question: For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7) that has more than one subject in the most recent academic year, list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and the normalized coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by the average units in 2022, rounded to four decimal places), ordered by normalized coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending.
sql: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), coefficient_variation AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), avg_variance_2022 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv.coefficient_of_variation, av.avg_units, av.units_variance, ROUND(cv.coefficient_of_variation / NULLIF(av.avg_units, 0), 4) AS normalized_coefficient FROM coefficient_variation cv JOIN avg_variance_2022 av ON cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = av.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY normalized_coefficient DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC;

question: List, for each department that is degree-granting and either (a) is not Biology (Course 7) and has more than one subject with non-null total units in the most recent academic year, or (b) is not Mathematics (Course 18) and has at least one course with a non-null CIP program code and a non-null department full name, the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, the variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department. Show the department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), CIP program code variance, and CIP program code standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsCV AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dcs.cip_program_code_variance, dcs.cip_program_code_stddev FROM DeptUnitsCV dcv LEFT JOIN DeptCIPStats dcs ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE UNION ALL SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dcs.cip_program_code_variance, dcs.cip_program_code_stddev FROM DeptCIPStats dcs LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsCV dcv ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, what is the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a non-null department full name, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18) with more than 100 total enrolled students in subjects offered in the 2021FA or 2022FA term, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the top 10 subject titles by number of materials offered (in regular academic terms), the total count of materials for each subject, and calculate the ratio of materials per enrolled student (rounded), ordering the results by this ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), TopMaterials AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrolled, tm.SUBJECT_TITLE, tm.material_count, ROUND(tm.material_count / NULLIF(de.total_enrolled, 0), 2) AS Material_Per_Enrolled_Student FROM DeptEnrollment de JOIN TopMaterials tm ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Material_Per_Enrolled_Student DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

List the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered, including the subject title, department name, and the total count of materials, for subjects in regular academic terms that are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department (excluding 'Mathematics' (Course 18)), display the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for degree-granting subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and, if the department is Chemistry (Course 5), also show the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50. Show the results ordered by the range of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), chemistry_enrollment AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, c.total_enrolled_students FROM dept_units_stats d LEFT JOIN chemistry_enrollment c ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.department_name ORDER BY d.total_units_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms where the term status indicator is 'P', the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ;

question: List, for each department, the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that are degree granting, but excluding the Biology department), as well as, for the Mathematics department, the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during non-summer fall terms. For each row, include a reason for inclusion ('General' for the general department statistics and 'MathFall' for the Mathematics fall term statistics). The columns should be: department name, average enrolled students, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, average enrollment (for Mathematics fall terms), enrollment range (for Mathematics fall terms), enrollment variance (for Mathematics fall terms), and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathFallStats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.stddev_enrolled_students, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_range, NULL AS enrollment_variance, 'General' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrolledStats d UNION ALL SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, NULL, m.avg_enrollment, m.enrollment_range, m.enrollment_variance, 'MathFall' AS Reason FROM MathFallStats m ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that are degree granting, but exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

question: For graduate-level, degree-granting courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table that are offered by the Mathematics department, show the course, course description, department name, program title from CIP, category title from CIP, and assign row numbers within each school name group ordered by course, along with the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department this year with total units greater than zero. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH GraduateMathCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.PROGRAM_TITLE, t0.CATEGORY_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.COURSE) AS window_column FROM CIP t0 INNER JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.PROGRAM_CODE = t1.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE t1.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathDeptGeometricMean AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT gmc.COURSE, gmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmc.PROGRAM_TITLE, gmc.CATEGORY_TITLE, gmc.window_column, mdgm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM GraduateMathCourses gmc JOIN MathDeptGeometricMean mdgm ON gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY gmc.COURSE;
sub_questions: For graduate-level, degree-granting courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table that are offered by the Mathematics department, show the course, course description, department name, program title from CIP, category title from CIP, and assign row numbers within each school name group ordered by course.

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with more than 0 total units, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of TIP materials per Mathematics subject offered in the fall term with at least one TIP material. List the columns in the following order: academic year, academic year description, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), range of TIP materials per subject, variance of TIP materials per subject, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of TIP materials per subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TotalUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), tip_counts AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ), per_year_stats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) - MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS range_tip_materials, VARIANCE(tc.num_tip_materials) AS var_tip_materials, STDDEV(tc.num_tip_materials) AS stddev_tip_materials FROM tip_counts tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tus.total_units_variance, tus.total_units_stddev, pys.range_tip_materials, pys.var_tip_materials, pys.stddev_tip_materials FROM TotalUnitsStats tus JOIN per_year_stats pys ON tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR = pys.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = pys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have at least one TIP material, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH tip_counts AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ), per_year_stats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) - MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS range_tip_materials, VARIANCE(tc.num_tip_materials) AS var_tip_materials, STDDEV(tc.num_tip_materials) AS stddev_tip_materials FROM tip_counts tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, range_tip_materials, var_tip_materials, stddev_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year and each academic term in that year, what are the academic year, academic year description, the average, range, and variance of the total units for Mathematics department subjects offered in regular terms in that year, as well as the term code, minimum academic year, and average total units for each academic term in the Mathematics department where the academic year is between 2000 and 2020 or the total units are at least 6, and the total units are between 1 and 12? List the results in the order of academic year and term code, and include the columns: academic year, academic year description, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, term code, minimum academic year, and average total units for the term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH academic_year_stats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), term_min_year_avg_units AS ( SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND ( a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.range_total_units, ays.var_total_units, tmu.TERM_CODE, tmu.min_academic_year, tmu.avg_total_units AS term_avg_total_units FROM academic_year_stats ays JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN term_min_year_avg_units tmu ON at.TERM_CODE = tmu.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tmu.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only regular terms and only subjects from the Mathematics department (Course 18).

What are the minimum academic year and average total units for each academic term in the Mathematics department, where the academic year is between 2000 and 2020 or the total units are at least 6, and the total units are between 1 and 12?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND ( a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department. Additionally, for the offering department, show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department. Show the subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, window row number, variance of number of students, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of number of students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.variance_num_students, s2.stddev_num_students FROM Sub1 s1 LEFT JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.

For each department, what is the department name and both the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year for that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department?
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree granting and offers more than five subjects or is the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the geometric mean of the clearing cost collector values for that department (if available, considering only departments where the clearing cost collector is greater than zero and excluding Mathematics)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH StddevUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), GeometricMeanCost AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean FROM StddevUnits s LEFT JOIN GeometricMeanCost g ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that offer more than five subjects, are degree granting, and specifically include the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, what is the geometric mean of the clearing cost collector values for that department, considering only departments where the clearing cost collector is greater than zero, and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Show the department name and the geometric mean.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

question: For the department and school with the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18), what are the department name, school name, number of such courses, and for each letter-graded subject offered this academic year in that department, what is the grade type, the number of subjects, and the minimum total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptWithMostCourses AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1 ), MathLetterGradedSubjects AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.num_courses, m.GRADE_TYPE, m.subject_count, m.min_total_units FROM DeptWithMostCourses d JOIN MathLetterGradedSubjects m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: Which department name and school name have the highest number of courses, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a course level of 'U', and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department and subject grade type where the subject is offered in the current academic year, is letter graded, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of subjects and the minimum total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, is not the Biology department (Course 7), and has a total number of subject codes greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean across all departments, and is also not the Mathematics department (Course 18), display the department code, department name, total number of subject codes, the average clearing cost collector value, the variance of the clearing cost collector, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector for all associated administrative departments, ordering the results by the total number of subject codes in descending order and then by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ), filtered_depts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ), admin_dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT f.DEPARTMENT_CODE, f.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.subject_code_count, a.avg_clearing_cost_collector, a.clearing_cost_collector_variance, a.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM filtered_depts f JOIN admin_dept_stats a ON f.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY f.subject_code_count DESC, f.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the total number of subject codes associated with it, considering only departments that have a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation above the mean across all departments, and only including departments that are degree-granting and are not the Biology department (Course 7)?

For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees, is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, and offers more than five subjects or is the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the maximum CIP program code among its courses, the full name of the department, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department? List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MaxCipDepartments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ), DeptSubjectStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT mcd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcd.max_cip_code, mcd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.stddev_total_units FROM MaxCipDepartments mcd JOIN DeptSubjectStddev ds ON mcd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mcd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and what is the full name of the department, for departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that offer more than five subjects, are degree granting, and specifically include the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that grants degrees, excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department (Course 6) and the Political Science department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, as well as the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department. List the department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), UnitVariation AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, es.enrolled_stddev, uv.coefficient_of_variation FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN UnitVariation uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = uv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the material status is 'U' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one associated course material and are offered by the Biology department (Course 7)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathUnits AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), BioVariation AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mu.geometric_mean_total_units, bv.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathUnits mu JOIN BioVariation bv ON mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = bv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

sql: WITH MathRegularTerms AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathIAPActivities AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT mrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mrt.avg_total_units, mrt.stddev_total_units, mia.avg_max_enrollment, mia.stddev_max_enrollment, ROUND(mrt.avg_total_units / NULLIF(mia.avg_max_enrollment, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_max_enrollment_ratio FROM MathRegularTerms mrt JOIN MathIAPActivities mia ON mrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mia.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY avg_units_per_max_enrollment_ratio DESC;

Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DeptCoeffVar dcv JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_units_variance AS year_total_units_variance, subq1.total_units_stddev AS year_total_units_stddev, subq2.total_units_range AS dept_total_units_range, subq2.total_units_variance AS dept_total_units_variance, subq2.total_units_stddev AS dept_total_units_stddev FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the subject title from the library subject offered table, the offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group. sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_TERM_CODE, s1.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, s1.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, s1.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.enrolled_range, s2.enrolled_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each combination of DLC key and organization name (where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, the organization name is not 'ADMISSIONS', and the organization ID is not '138' or '250') and each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms, provide the DLC key, organization name, number of organizations, minimum organization number, building name, the range of room areas, the variance of room areas, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of room areas, with the columns in this order: DLC key, organization name, organization count, minimum organization number, building name, area range, area variance, and area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH OrgDlcStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), BuildingRoomStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC ) SELECT ods.DLC_KEY, ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev FROM OrgDlcStats ods CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats brs;
