question: For each subject in the Mathematics department that was offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units and also offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students, show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the subject title, the term description, and the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubjectStats2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), LibrarySubjectStats2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT s2022.SUBJECT_CODE, s2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2022.window_column, l2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, l2014.TERM_DESCRIPTION, l2014.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM SubjectStats2022 s2022 JOIN LibrarySubjectStats2014FA l2014 ON s2022.SUBJECT_ID = l2014.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2022.SUBJECT_CODE, l2014.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department, ordered by subject code.

For each subject offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department, show the subject ID, subject title, the term description, the department name from the course catalog, and the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department, list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Chemistry department), as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only departments that are degree-granting, courses with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments). Show the department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average total units, total units variance, and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DeptCoeffVar dcv JOIN DeptUnitStats dus ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, courses that have more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department in Spring 2016, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, school name, course description, department name, subject code, the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject ID, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the Chemistry department (considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department). List the results in order by subject title and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, cs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.SUBJECT_CODE, cs.max_enrolled_students, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM ChemistrySubjects cs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON cs.join_dept_name = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department in Spring 2016, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, school name, course description, department name, subject code, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject ID.

For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7)? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) (considering only years with more than five activities), the academic year description, the range of the total number of students enrolled in Mathematics subjects during regular terms with more than 0 enrolled students, and the variance of the total number of students enrolled in those subjects, with all columns reported in this order: academic year, academic year description, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of maximum IAP enrollment, enrollment range, and enrollment variance? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.stddev_max_enrollment, s2.enrollment_range, s2.enrollment_variance FROM Subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only years with more than five activities, and what is the corresponding academic year description?

For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total number of students enrolled in subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) during that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and terms that are regular terms.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each academic year that is the minimum academic year among those with Mathematics department subjects offered in the fall term and associated with library reserve material details with material status 'U', provide the academic year, academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in that year (considering only those with more than 0 total units and offered in the fall term), as well as the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for such subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH YearlyMathStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MinYearSumUnits AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT yms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yms.total_units_variance, yms.total_units_stddev, mysu.min_academic_year, mysu.sum_total_units FROM YearlyMathStats yms JOIN MinYearSumUnits mysu ON yms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mysu.min_academic_year ORDER BY yms.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

What is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and belong to the Mathematics department, considering only library reserve material details with material status 'U'?
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the department name, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, the range of total units for letter graded subjects offered this year in Mathematics (Course 18), and the variance of total units for those subjects, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), subject_units_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM dept_subject_stats dss LEFT JOIN subject_units_stats sus ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME -- Both subqueries are filtered to Mathematics (Course 18), so DEPARTMENT_CODE is '18' AND sus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ORDER BY dss.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code.

For each department, provide the department name and department code, and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered this year, considering only subjects that are letter graded and belong to the Mathematics department.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one reserved library material and a material status of 'U' offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department, and calculate the normalized enrollment ratio (the number of enrolled students in the library subject divided by the average enrollment for the department, rounded to two decimal places). List the results in descending order of normalized enrollment ratio.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev, ROUND(s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s2.avg_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_enrollment_ratio FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_enrollment_ratio DESC;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, but only include subjects where the offer department name is 'Chemistry'.

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material, a material status of 'U', and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department (i.e., Course 5 or Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each academic year where both (1) there are subjects offered by departments in the 'Engineering' school during terms with a term status indicator of 'P', excluding subjects offered by the Chemistry department and only including courses with materials, and (2) the Mathematics department has subjects with enrollment greater than 10, provide the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in those Engineering subjects, the Mathematics department name, the number of unique Mathematics subjects, the minimum total units offered in Mathematics, and calculate the variance of enrolled students divided by the number of unique Mathematics subjects (rounded), ordered by this ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH EngineeringYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), MathDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ev.enrolled_students_variance, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.num_unique_subjects, ms.min_total_units, ROUND(ev.enrolled_students_variance / NULLIF(ms.num_unique_subjects, 0), 2) AS variance_per_unique_subject FROM EngineeringYearVariance ev JOIN MathDeptSubjects ms ON ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY variance_per_unique_subject DESC
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the 'Engineering' school during terms with a term status indicator of 'P', excluding subjects offered by the Chemistry department and only including courses with materials?

For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department, show the department name, the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and only for departments that grant degrees and are not the Department of Management), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter-graded subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (only for degree-granting departments and excluding the Biology department). List the department name, total enrollment, average total units, range of total units, and variance of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), DeptUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollment, du.avg_total_units, du.range_total_units, du.var_total_units FROM DeptEnrollment de JOIN DeptUnits du ON de.DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY de.total_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department that is degree granting, is not the Chemistry department (Course 5), and has at least 100 total enrolled students in its offered subjects, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the department, and, if the department is Mathematics, also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students per undergraduate course in that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ), MathCourseStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(course_student_count) - MIN(course_student_count) AS student_count_range, VARIANCE(course_student_count) AS student_count_variance, STDDEV(course_student_count) AS student_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS course_student_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT ) course_stats ON scd.DEPARTMENT = course_stats.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE = course_stats.COURSE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY student_count_range DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.total_enrolled_students, mcs.student_count_range, mcs.student_count_variance, mcs.student_count_stddev FROM DeptEnrolledStats des LEFT JOIN MathCourseStats mcs ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.total_enrolled_students DESC, mcs.student_count_range DESC
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments that are degree granting, have at least 100 total enrolled students, and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, give the department name and provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of students per course in that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and courses that are undergraduate level, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(course_student_count) - MIN(course_student_count) AS student_count_range, VARIANCE(course_student_count) AS student_count_variance, STDDEV(course_student_count) AS student_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS course_student_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT ) course_stats ON scd.DEPARTMENT = course_stats.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE = course_stats.COURSE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count_range DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees, is not the Biology department (Course 7), and is not the Chemistry department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with a non-null subject code description), the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than zero), and the ratio of the enrolled students variance to the geometric mean of total units (rounded to two decimal places)? List the department name, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), geometric mean total units, and the variance to geometric mean units ratio, in that order, sorted by the ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), UnitsGeomMean AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev, u.geometric_mean_total_units, ROUND(e.enrolled_students_variance / NULLIF(u.geometric_mean_total_units, 0), 2) AS variance_to_geom_mean_units_ratio FROM EnrolledStats e JOIN UnitsGeomMean u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY variance_to_geom_mean_units_ratio DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7)? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation.

For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than zero, and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics department subjects from terms with a term status indicator of 'P' and total units greater than 0, the average, range, and variance of the total units for Mathematics department subjects from regular terms, and calculate the ratio of the average total units from terms with status 'P' to the average total units from regular terms, rounded to two decimal places. Present the results ordered by this ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_status_p, s1.var_total_units AS var_total_units_status_p, s1.stddev_total_units AS stddev_total_units_status_p, s2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_regular, s2.range_total_units, s2.var_total_units AS var_total_units_regular, ROUND(s1.avg_total_units / NULLIF(s2.avg_total_units, 0), 2) AS ratio_avg_units_status_p_to_regular FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ratio_avg_units_status_p_to_regular DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only subjects from terms with a term status indicator of 'P' and with total units greater than 0?

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years with the highest number of subjects offered (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department), what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, and what is the term description for the corresponding term, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units? List the department name, academic year, subject count, highest total units, and term description, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MaxUnitsPerYear AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopDepartments AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, td.subject_count, mu.max_total_units, mu.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM TopDepartments td JOIN MaxUnitsPerYear mu ON td.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, and what is the term description for the corresponding term, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units?

List the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years with the highest number of subjects offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, as well as the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the year 2022. Only include departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department full name, and exclude the Mathematics department (Course 18) and the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code, duv.total_units_variance FROM DeptCIPStats dcs JOIN DeptUnitsVariance duv ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, but only include departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department full name, and exclude the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the year 2022, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each administrative department that grants degrees (excluding Mechanical Engineering), show the administrative department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0), and for each subject in the course catalog with a total of 12 units, offered in the fall term, and in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, and the row number within each department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), MathFall12Units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, mfsu.SUBJECT_CODE, mfsu.SUBJECT_NUMBER, mfsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mfsu.SUBJECT_TITLE, mfsu.TOTAL_UNITS, mfsu.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, mfsu.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, mfsu.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, mfsu.window_column FROM DeptUnitsStats dus JOIN MathFall12Units mfsu ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mfsu.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mfsu.window_column;

question: For each subject offered in the 'Engineering' school with total units greater than 0 and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department, list the subject title, total units, department name, course description, and the dense rank over the offer department code ordered by offer department code. Additionally, for each such subject, provide the average and variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, considering only departments that are degree granting and excluding the Mathematics department. Present the results ordered by the variance of the course number ASCII values in descending order and then by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.avg_course_number_ascii, s2.var_course_number_ascii FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.join_department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.var_course_number_ascii DESC, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For the Mathematics department, which department name and school name have the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses, and for each letter-graded subject type offered in the current academic year in that department, provide the department name, school name, number of such courses, grade type, number of subjects, and the minimum total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptCourseCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1 ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ) SELECT dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.SCHOOL_NAME, dcc.num_courses, dss.GRADE_TYPE, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptCourseCounts dcc JOIN DeptSubjectStats dss ON dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.GRADE_TYPE;

question: For each department that grants degrees and is either in the School of Engineering or Science or is the Department of Mathematics, where the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department is greater than 20, and for which there are letter graded Mathematics subjects offered this year with department code 18, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department, the department code, the range and variance of the total units for these subjects, and calculate the ratio of total enrolled students to the range of total units rounded to two decimal places, ordering the results by this ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolled AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20 ), MathUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrolled_students, mu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mu.total_units_range, mu.total_units_variance, ROUND(de.total_enrolled_students / NULLIF(mu.total_units_range, 0), 2) AS enrolled_per_unit_range FROM DeptEnrolled de JOIN MathUnits mu ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_per_unit_range DESC;

question: For each department (excluding 'Mathematics' (Course 18)) that offered at least one subject in the 2021FA term and is a degree-granting department other than Chemistry, display the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022FA term, along with the department's full name and the maximum total units among its offered subjects in the 2021FA term. Show the results ordered by the range of total units in 2022FA descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_2022fa_stats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT != '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), dept_2021fa_max AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d22.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d22.avg_total_units, d22.total_units_range, d22.total_units_variance, d21.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d21.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_2022fa_stats d22 JOIN dept_2021fa_max d21 ON d22.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d21.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d22.total_units_range DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the total number of enrolled students in both library and tip subjects for terms in 2014FA or 2017JA is greater than 10, give the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects, the variance of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentTotalEnrolled AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND tso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev FROM DepartmentTotalEnrolled dte JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year (excluding the Biology department, Course 7), the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, Course 6), but only include departments that are degree-granting. Present the columns in the following order: department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), enrolled range, enrolled variance, and enrolled standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev FROM DeptUnitsCV dcv JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each Mathematics department where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, give the department code, the department name, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department. List the results ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptVariation AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.min_num_enrolled_students, mds.avg_dept_budget_code, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathDeptStats mds JOIN DeptVariation dv ON mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: List the top 10 department names, the number of associated administrative departments, the average of the total units, and the variance of the total units for all courses offered by each department, considering only departments and courses that are degree granting, have a non-null department budget code and non-null total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). sql: WITH AdminDeptCounts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), CourseStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT adc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, adc.admin_dept_count, cs.avg_total_units, cs.total_units_variance FROM AdminDeptCounts adc JOIN CourseStats cs ON adc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, has offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP' (excluding Chemistry), and also offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021 (excluding the Department of Political Science, Course 17), provide the department code, department name, department full name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, the number of subjects offered in the School of Engineering in 2021, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), eng_dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ede.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dss.range_num_subjects, dss.variance_num_subjects, dss.stddev_num_subjects, ede.subject_count, ede.total_enrollment FROM dept_subject_stats dss JOIN eng_dept_enrollment ede ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ede.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), MathSubjects2005FA AS ( SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance FROM MathSubjects2005FA ms JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_TITLE;

sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, mds.min_num_enrolled_students, mds.avg_dept_budget_code FROM DeptUnitsStats dus LEFT JOIN MathDeptStats mds ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

List the course, the maximum CIP program code, the department name, the average total units, and the variance of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EngCourses AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DeptUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ec.COURSE, ec.max_cip_program_code, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.var_total_units FROM EngCourses ec LEFT JOIN DeptUnits du ON ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME
