Additionally, for each such department, list the number of distinct courses offered in the most recent academic year available.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY END AS SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, CASE WHEN GROUPING(COURSE) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COURSE END AS COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_units) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, COURSE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ) GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units

question: For each Mathematics department (Course 18) that has a minimum number of enrolled students between 1 and 10 or a department budget code of at least 90000, and a department budget code between 90000 and 200000, list the department code, department name, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, the most common course number offered by that department (with the count of offerings for that course number), and for each subject offered in 2022 that is printed in the bulletin and whose total units exceed the average total units for Mathematics subjects offered in 2022, provide the subject title, total units, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_dept_budget_code, cno.MOST_COMMON_COURSE_NUMBER, cno.COURSE_OFFER_COUNT FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER AS MOST_COMMON_COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(*) AS COURSE_OFFER_COUNT FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER ) cno ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cno.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cno.COURSE_OFFER_COUNT = ( SELECT MAX(sub.COURSE_OFFER_COUNT) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS COURSE_OFFER_COUNT FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd2.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd2.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 AND sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cno.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY tso2.COURSE_NUMBER ) sub ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.row_num_window, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(c2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2 WHERE c2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c2.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) a ON 1=1 WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.min_num_enrolled_students, s1.avg_dept_budget_code, s1.MOST_COMMON_COURSE_NUMBER, s1.COURSE_OFFER_COUNT, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.row_num_window FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_dept_budget_code, cno.MOST_COMMON_COURSE_NUMBER, cno.COURSE_OFFER_COUNT FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER AS MOST_COMMON_COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(*) AS COURSE_OFFER_COUNT FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER ) cno ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cno.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cno.COURSE_OFFER_COUNT = ( SELECT MAX(sub.COURSE_OFFER_COUNT) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS COURSE_OFFER_COUNT FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd2.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd2.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 AND sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cno.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY tso2.COURSE_NUMBER ) sub ) ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.row_num_window FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(c2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2 WHERE c2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c2.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) a ON 1=1 WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry and only including degree-granting departments) where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department is greater than 100, what is the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the number of unique subjects offered by that department, the maximum CIP program code among its courses (only for departments that are not Mathematics and have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000), the department's full name, and the phone number of its corresponding administrative department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH eng_dept_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled ORDER BY ic.total_enrolled DESC ), deg_granting_dept_cip AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ede.total_enrolled, ede.num_unique_subjects, dgd.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, dgd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dgd.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM eng_dept_enrollment ede JOIN deg_granting_dept_cip dgd ON ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry, Course 5) and for each academic year and school where the school matches the department's school, list the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the department's school name, the department phone number, the academic year, the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year and school (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte1.stddev_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_stats AS ( SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte2 icte GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_enrolled_students, ds.stddev_enrolled_students, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.total_units_range, ms.total_units_variance FROM dept_stats ds JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN math_stats ms ON ds.SCHOOL_NAME = ms.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.SCHOOL_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each department and term, provide the department name, term, average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in that term, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments. Also, include subtotals for each department across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments and terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Additionally, for each department, include the total number of units for courses in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools (where the total units for the department is greater than 1000 and the department is not "Political Science") and the number of distinct courses offered in the most recent academic year available. Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department and term. The columns returned are: department, term, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, total units for Engineering/Non-MIT, and number of courses in the latest year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, term_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, term, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, term_sort ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ) GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units ) SELECT s1.department, s1.term, s1.avg_total_units, s1.range_total_units, s1.var_total_units, s2.total_units, s2.num_courses_latest_year FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.department = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.department, s1.term

question: For each school among the top 10 by total number of unique courses (excluding Political Science), list the school name, the number of unique degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), the total number of unique courses offered by those departments, and for each department in that school (excluding Mathematics and Chemistry and only considering degree-granting subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the department code. Sort the results by the total number of courses in descending order for schools, and by variance of total units in descending order for departments within each school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SchoolStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10 ), DepartmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.num_departments, ss.total_courses, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SchoolStats ss JOIN DepartmentStats ds ON ss.SCHOOL_NAME = ds.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ss.total_courses DESC, ds.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term is greater than 100, provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the number of unique subjects offered in those terms, the department's full name, the maximum total units among its offered subjects in the 2021FA term, and for each such subject, the subject code, subject title, total units, and the responsible faculty name, where the subject has the maximum total units among Mathematics subjects offered in 2021FA. sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_enrolled, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject code in the Political Science department, what is the subject code, subject code description, the geometric mean of the number of students in each degree-granting department associated with that subject code, and the total number of students across all such departments for each subject code, as well as, for each subject code and subject code description, the full name, email address, department name, school name, and window column (row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by full name) for each graduate student in the Political Science department with department code '17'? Also include a grand total row with null for the subject code and description, and the total number of students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.geometric_mean_students, s1.total_students, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC = s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.FULL_NAME
sub_questions: For each subject code in the Political Science department, what is the subject code description and the geometric mean of the number of students in each department associated with that subject code, considering only departments that are degree granting?

For students whose year is 'G' and whose department is degree-granting and is 'Political Science', show their full name, email address, department name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by full name, including the subject code and subject code description for each student's department, and only include students whose department code is '17'.

For each subject code in the Political Science department, what is the subject code description, the geometric mean of the number of students in each department associated with that subject code (considering only degree-granting departments), and the total number of students across all such departments for each subject code? For each subject code, also include a grand total row with null for the subject code and description, and the total number of students.

For students whose year is 'G' and whose department is degree-granting and is 'Political Science', show their full name, email address, department name, subject code, and subject code description, and also include the school name of their department. Assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by full name, and only include students whose department code is '17'.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_students DESC;

SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List, for each department, either (a) the department name, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered by that department (only for departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average and considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), or (b) for the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, the department name, school name, subject code description, and the highest number of students ever enrolled in a single subject offered by each department. For each row, include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('UnitsStats' for the first case and 'TopEngineering' for the second). The columns should be: department name, school name, subject code description, highest single subject enrollment, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, NULL AS highest_single_subject_enrollment, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.highest_single_subject_enrollment, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, 'TopEngineering' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects they offered, including the department name, the school name, and the subject code description, for departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, and are not the 'Political Science' department (Course 17).

For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and restrict the results to departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units across all departments.

For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, list the department name, school name, subject code description, and the highest number of students ever enrolled in a single subject offered by each department.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department whose code is '18' (Mathematics) that offered at least 5 subjects in term 2019FA and is also among the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science, Course 17) with at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students and at least one student named "Zoe" enrolled, list the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, the number of subjects offered, the count of unique student full names for students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects, the total number of subjects offered by the department with more than 0 enrolled students, and the average number of unique "Zoe" students per subject (rounded), in that order, ordered by the average number of unique "Zoe" students per subject descending.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) >= 5 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.unique_students, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_with_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.unique_students ORDER BY ic.unique_students DESC, num_subjects_with_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_num_enrolled_students, s1.num_subjects_offered, s2.unique_students, s2.num_subjects_with_enrollment, ROUND(CAST(s2.unique_students AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(s1.num_subjects_offered, 0), 2) AS avg_zoe_students_per_subject FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_zoe_students_per_subject DESC;
sub_questions: For each department that grants degrees, what is the department name and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the term 2019FA, restricted to departments whose department code is '18' (Mathematics)?

List the top 10 degree-granting departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects, showing the department name and the count of unique student full names, for departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students and are not the Political Science department (Course 17).

For each degree-granting department whose code is '18' (Mathematics), and for subjects offered by that department in the term 2019FA, what is the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the number of subjects offered, restricted to departments that offered at least 5 subjects in that term?

For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science, Course 17) that have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, show the department name, the count of unique student full names for students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects, and the total number of subjects offered by each department with more than 0 enrolled students.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) >= 5;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.unique_students, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_with_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.unique_students ORDER BY ic.unique_students DESC, num_subjects_with_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each school, provide the school name and the highest average total units for degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), grouped by course level, considering only courses with a non-null total units value, and for each subject offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, and the department phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. Only include subjects where the offer school name matches the school name from the first part. Order the results by the highest average total units descending, then by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL ) subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.highest_avg_total_units, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, subq2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.highest_avg_total_units DESC, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that school, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a non-null total units value, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, ordered by the subject title.

For each school, provide the school name and the highest average total units for degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), grouped by course level (undergraduate or graduate), considering only courses with a non-null total units value.

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, and also include the department phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. Order the results by the subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL ) subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department and school in Mathematics (Course 18), list the department code, department name, school name, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, the geometric mean of the total units of subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero total units and at least one enrolled student), and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, and only for departments that grant degrees. Do not repeat the department code if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by school name and department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE END AS department_code, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units ) SELECT s1.department_code, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.min_num_enrolled_students, s1.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.geometric_mean_total_units, s2.avg_enrolled_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.department_code

question: For each degree-granting department that is the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department code, department name, the number of students in that department, the total number of unique student years represented among those students, the average number of students per unique student year, and for each undergraduate course in that department, what is the course name, its CIP program code, the average CIP program code for all undergraduate courses in the department, and whether the course is classified as 'HIGH_CIP' (at least 10% greater than the department average), 'LOW_CIP' (at least 10% less than the department average), or 'AVERAGE'? List the columns in the following order: department code, department name, number of students, number of unique student years, average number of students per unique student year, course name, CIP program code, average CIP program code for the department, and CIP category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_students AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.student_count, inner_cte1.unique_student_years, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.unique_student_years > 0 THEN inner_cte1.student_count * 1.0 / inner_cte1.unique_student_years ELSE NULL END AS avg_students_per_year FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE, c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), dept_benchmark AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.student_count, ms.unique_student_years, ms.avg_students_per_year, ic2.COURSE, ic2.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, db.avg_cip_code, CASE WHEN ic2.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > db.avg_cip_code * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN ic2.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE < db.avg_cip_code * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS cip_category FROM math_students ms JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN dept_benchmark db ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = db.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic2.COURSE

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the highest number of times any course has been offered, and for that course, provide the department name, course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, the maximum offer count, the department code, the number of students in the department, the total number of unique student years represented among those students, and the average number of students per unique student year? List the results ordered by the maximum offer count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentMaxCourseOffers AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(offer_count) AS max_offer_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathematicsStudentStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.student_count, inner_cte2.unique_student_years, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.unique_student_years > 0 THEN inner_cte2.student_count * 1.0 / inner_cte2.unique_student_years ELSE NULL END AS avg_students_per_year FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmc.COURSE_NUMBER, dmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, dmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, dmc.max_offer_count, mss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mss.student_count, mss.unique_student_years, mss.avg_students_per_year FROM DepartmentMaxCourseOffers dmc JOIN MathematicsStudentStats mss ON dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dmc.max_offer_count DESC;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one associated course material and are offered by the Biology department (Course 7), the total number of such Biology subjects offered in that year, the number of Mathematics (Course 18) subjects offered that year, and the deviation of this count from the average number of Mathematics subjects offered per academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH bio_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ), math_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.num_subjects, (inner_cte.num_subjects - avg_counts.avg_num_subjects) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(num_subjects) AS avg_num_subjects FROM inner_cte ) avg_counts ) SELECT bio_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, bio_stats.coefficient_of_variation, bio_stats.total_subjects_offered, math_stats.num_subjects, math_stats.deviation_from_avg FROM bio_stats JOIN math_stats ON bio_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = math_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY bio_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.num_subjects, (inner_cte.num_subjects - avg_counts.avg_num_subjects) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(num_subjects) AS avg_num_subjects FROM inner_cte ) avg_counts ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department and subject code, list the department name, subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, and the total number of unique courses offered by that department and subject code, along with the average of the range of enrolled students per subject (where each subject has at least one associated course material and the department is Chemistry or Biology), grouped by department. The average of the range of enrolled students per subject will be shown for Chemistry and Biology departments, and will be null for other departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(enrolled_range) AS avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_course_count, s2.avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: List, for the Mathematics department, (1) for each academic year, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled, along with the academic year description and a grand total for all activities in the format of (department name, null, total variance and stddev), and (2) for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, the term description (not repeated if the same as the previous row), department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, the school name, and the total number of subjects in the department for that term. The results are combined in a single table, with columns in the order: department name, academic year description, total variance, total stddev, term description, subject code, subject number, subject title, subject rank in department, school name, and subject count in department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), SubjectDetails AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte2.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON inner_cte2.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_variance, rr.total_stddev, NULL AS term_description, NULL AS subject_code, NULL AS subject_number, NULL AS subject_title, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS school_name, NULL AS subject_count_in_dept FROM RollupResults rr UNION ALL SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS total_variance, NULL AS total_stddev, sd.term_description, sd.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sd.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.subject_count_in_dept FROM SubjectDetails sd ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, term_description, subject_code;

sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_variance, rr.total_stddev FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department) that is also a Mathematics department (Course 18) with at least two subjects in the most recent academic year, show the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, the subject codes, and subject code descriptions for the subjects included in the calculation, as well as the minimum department budget code, average total units, and the most common course description among subjects where the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000 or the total units are at least 6, and the total units are between 6 and 21. List the columns in the following order: department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), subject code, subject code description, minimum department budget code, average total units, and most common course description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000) OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) ) AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 21 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.min_dept_budget_code, ic.avg_total_units, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS desc_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000) OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) ) AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 21 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ) scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND scd.rn = 1 ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte2.min_dept_budget_code, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE;
