sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000) OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) ) AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 21 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000) OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) ) AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 21 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.min_dept_budget_code, ic.avg_total_units, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS desc_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000) OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) ) AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 21 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ) scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND scd.rn = 1 ;

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering except Biology (Course 7) and Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, the highest and minimum number of enrolled students in any single subject offered by that department, and the total number of degree-granting courses for that department? Provide the department name, average enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, highest number of enrolled students, minimum number of enrolled students, and total number of degree-granting courses, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN scd.COURSE END) AS total_degree_granting_courses, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.total_degree_granting_courses FROM inner_cte ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s1.var_enrolled_students, s1.max_enrolled_students, s2.min_num_enrolled_students, s2.total_degree_granting_courses FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year and department where the total number of units for all Mathematics subjects offered in 'Previous' terms is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean (and only for the Mathematics department), show the academic year, department name, total number of units, and the number of unique Mathematics subjects offered in those terms. Additionally, for each such academic year, list the Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term (that are not variable units) whose total number of units is greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in that year, showing the subject id and total units for each such subject. The results are ordered by academic year and subject id. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.SUBJECT_ID, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), avg_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS AS SUBJECT_TOTAL_UNITS FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, give the academic year, department name, and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous', but only for the Mathematics department (Course 18), and only include those academic year and department combinations where the total number of units is more than one standard deviation above the mean total units across all such combinations.

For each academic year, what is the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, are not variable units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Show the academic year and these statistics.

For each academic year and department, give the academic year, department name, and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous', but only for the Mathematics department (Course 18), and only include those academic year and department combinations where the total number of units is more than one standard deviation above the mean total units across all such combinations. Additionally, for each such combination, list the number of unique Mathematics subjects offered in those terms.

For each academic year, which Mathematics (Course 18) subjects offered in the fall term (that are not variable units) have a total number of units greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in that year? Show the academic year, subject id, and total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t );

SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.SUBJECT_ID, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each degree-granting department that is not the Mathematics department (Course 18) and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, and whose average total units for subjects offered in the academic year 2022 and also listed in the CIS course catalog is greater than the overall average total units for all such subjects, what is the department's name, the maximum CIP program code among its courses, the department's full name, the phone number of its corresponding administrative department, and the average total units for its subjects (in that order)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.avg_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.avg_total_units DESC
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and what is the full department name, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, provide the department's name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, but only include departments that are Mathematics (Course 18).

For each degree-granting department that is not the Mathematics department (Course 18) and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, what is the department's full name and the phone number of its corresponding administrative department?

For each department, provide the department's name and the average total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, but only include departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units for all such subjects.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each course offered by a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department), where the total units for the course's catalog subjects is greater than the average total units for all such courses in the 2007 academic year, what is the course key, course name, department name, the number of catalog subjects, the total units for those subjects, and for the corresponding department, what is the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH course_stats AS ( SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), filtered_courses AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, total_units FROM course_stats WHERE total_units > (SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM course_stats) ), dept_unit_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT fc.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, fc.COURSE, fc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fc.subject_count, fc.total_units, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM filtered_courses fc JOIN dept_unit_stats dus ON fc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY fc.total_units DESC;

sub_questions: For each course offered by a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering, except for the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, what is the course key, course name, department name, and the number of catalog subjects and the total units for those subjects in the 2007 academic year?

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each course offered by a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department), what is the course key, course name, department name, the number of catalog subjects, the total units for those subjects, and only include those courses where the total units for those subjects is greater than the average total units for all such courses in the 2007 academic year?

For each department, what is the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, and what is the highest average total units among all departments?
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units > (SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM inner_cte);

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT *, MAX(avg_total_units) OVER () AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each school and department (including a grand total per school), what is the school name, department name, the variance of the CIP program code for all degree-granting courses with a non-null department name in the Mathematics department (Course 18), the geometric mean of the total units of subjects offered by departments in that school (considering only subjects with more than zero total units and that are offered this year, and only for departments that are degree-granting and not the Department of Management), the overall average geometric mean across all schools, and whether the school's geometric mean is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 5% greater than the overall average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 5% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), rollup_cte1 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte1 UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte1_with_school AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte2_with_school AS ( SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, s.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units > s.avg_geometric_mean * 1.05 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units < s.avg_geometric_mean * 0.95 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS comparison_to_average FROM inner_cte2 i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte2) s ) SELECT cte1_with_school.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1_with_school.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1_with_school.cip_code_variance, cte2_with_school.geometric_mean_total_units, cte2_with_school.avg_geometric_mean, cte2_with_school.comparison_to_average FROM cte1_with_school JOIN cte2_with_school ON cte1_with_school.SCHOOL_NAME = cte2_with_school.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cte1_with_school.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1_with_school.DEPARTMENT_NAME

For each school, show the school name, its geometric mean, the overall average geometric mean, and whether the school's geometric mean is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 5% greater than the overall average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 5% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , rollup_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, s.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units > s.avg_geometric_mean * 1.05 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units < s.avg_geometric_mean * 0.95 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS comparison_to_average FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) s ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: Show the department name, subject code, subject code description, undergraduate level, the total number of undergraduate courses per department, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, and the corresponding administrative department name if available, considering only departments that are degree granting and only including the Mathematics department (Course 18), and where the minimum number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000. List the results ordered by the variance of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS undergraduate_level, Total_Courses.Total_Undergrad_Courses, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Undergrad_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.undergraduate_level, s1.Total_Undergrad_Courses, s1.avg_enrollment, s1.enrollment_variance, s1.enrollment_stddev, s2.min_num_enrolled_students, s2.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.enrollment_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and only including the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

What are the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code for each department, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department is degree granting, specifically for the Political Science department?

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS undergraduate_level, Total_Courses.Total_Undergrad_Courses, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Undergrad_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

question: For students whose department code is '6', who are in the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, and whose first name is 'Benedict', show the student's first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the minimum department code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name, the corresponding SIS admin department name, and for each, the department code, department name, administrative department name, and the total number of undergraduate courses offered by the top 3 degree-granting departments (excluding Management) that offer the most distinct courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH student_info AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict' ), top_departments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3 ), top_departments_undergrad_courses AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.COURSE) AS num_undergrad_courses FROM top_departments ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_undergrad_courses DESC ) SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.window_column, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS student_admin_department_name, tduc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tduc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department_name, tduc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_admin_department_name, tduc.num_undergrad_courses FROM student_info si JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = si.DEPARTMENT JOIN top_departments_undergrad_courses tduc ON tduc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = si.DEPARTMENT;

sub_sqls: SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict'

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict' ) SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.COURSE) AS num_undergrad_courses FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_undergrad_courses DESC;

question: For each school, list the school name, the number of degree-granting departments in that school (excluding the Political Science department), and for each department in the school, provide the department name, the average number of students per student year in that department, the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year, have total units greater than zero, and are in the Mathematics department), the average geometric mean across all such departments, and whether the department is a 'HIGH_UNIT_DEPT' (if its geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average geometric mean across all such departments), 'LOW_UNIT_DEPT' (if at least 10% less), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. For each school, include a grand total row with the school name, total number of degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), and null for department name, average students per year, geometric mean of total units, average geometric mean, and unit category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_stats ), SchoolDeptCounts AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_degree_granting_departments FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolDeptStats AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_students_per_year, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SchoolDeptCounts sdc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sdc.SCHOOL_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptGeomMeanStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units, avg_stats.avg_geom_mean, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units > avg_stats.avg_geom_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT_DEPT' WHEN inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units < avg_stats.avg_geom_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT_DEPT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte2 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte2 ) avg_stats ) SELECT sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.num_degree_granting_departments, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sds.avg_students_per_year, dgs.geometric_mean_total_units, dgs.avg_geom_mean, dgs.unit_category FROM SchoolDeptStats sds LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN DeptGeomMeanStats dgs ON sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT sdc.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_students_per_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_total_units, NULL AS avg_geom_mean, NULL AS unit_category FROM SchoolDeptCounts sdc ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

sub_sqls: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year, range_students_per_year, var_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ), SchoolDeptCounts AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_degree_granting_departments FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolDeptStats AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_students_per_year FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SchoolDeptCounts sdc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sdc.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, num_degree_granting_departments, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year FROM SchoolDeptStats UNION ALL SELECT sdc.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_students_per_year FROM SchoolDeptCounts sdc ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, avg_stats.avg_geom_mean, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units > avg_stats.avg_geom_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT_DEPT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units < avg_stats.avg_geom_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT_DEPT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name, the school name, whether the department is degree granting, and for their department also show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, the average total units for that department as a benchmark, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such departments, and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 10% greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if it is at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH student_info AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), dept_variability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.coefficient_of_variation, d.avg_total_units, d.benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, d.variability_category FROM student_info s JOIN dept_variability d ON s.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics), show the department name, the department's full name, the school name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, and for each student whose employee type is 'Student', who is in department 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' and whose department matches the current department, show their MIT ID, full name, student department name, student year, and whether their MIT ID is above, below, or equal to the average MIT ID for their student year group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ic.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, msd.DEPARTMENT FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), avg_mit_id_per_year AS ( SELECT STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(MIT_ID) AS avg_mit_id FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.MIT_ID, i.FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT, CASE WHEN i.MIT_ID > a.avg_mit_id THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.MIT_ID < a.avg_mit_id THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS mit_id_category FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN avg_mit_id_per_year a ON i.STUDENT_YEAR = a.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.avg_clearing_cost_collector, c1.clearing_cost_collector_variance, c1.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, c2.MIT_ID, c2.FULL_NAME, c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS STUDENT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, c2.STUDENT_YEAR, c2.mit_id_category FROM cte1 c1 JOIN cte2 c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c2.STUDENT_YEAR, c2.MIT_ID;

For students whose employee type is 'Student', who are in department 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their MIT ID, full name, department name, student year, and whether their MIT ID is above the average MIT ID for their student year group ('ABOVE_AVERAGE'), below it ('BELOW_AVERAGE'), or average (otherwise).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ic.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) , avg_mit_id_per_year AS ( SELECT STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(MIT_ID) AS avg_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT i.MIT_ID, i.FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.STUDENT_YEAR, CASE WHEN i.MIT_ID > a.avg_mit_id THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.MIT_ID < a.avg_mit_id THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS mit_id_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_mit_id_per_year a ON i.STUDENT_YEAR = a.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.MIT_ID;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department's name, the range and variance of the number of students in each subject code offered by that department (considering only subject codes that belong to a school with a non-null name), the department's school name, whether the department is degree granting, the total number of graduate students in the department (where the department is degree granting and student year is 'G'), and indicate whether the department is a 'LARGE_GRAD_PROGRAM' (at least 20 graduate students), 'SMALL_GRAD_PROGRAM' (fewer than 5 graduate students), or 'MEDIUM_GRAD_PROGRAM' (otherwise). Present the columns in the following order: department name, subject count range, subject count variance, school name, is degree granting, total graduate students, and grad program size. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.subject_count_range, inner_cte1.subject_count_variance, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.total_graduate_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.total_graduate_students >= 20 THEN 'LARGE_GRAD_PROGRAM' WHEN inner_cte2.total_graduate_students < 5 THEN 'SMALL_GRAD_PROGRAM' ELSE 'MEDIUM_GRAD_PROGRAM' END AS grad_program_size FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.subject_count_range, cte1.subject_count_variance, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, cte2.total_graduate_students, cte2.grad_program_size FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.subject_count_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_graduate_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_graduate_students >= 20 THEN 'LARGE_GRAD_PROGRAM' WHEN inner_cte.total_graduate_students < 5 THEN 'SMALL_GRAD_PROGRAM' ELSE 'MEDIUM_GRAD_PROGRAM' END AS grad_program_size FROM inner_cte;

question: List, for each department, either (a) the department's full name, the range and variance of the total units for degree-granting Mathematics department courses offered in the 2008 academic year along with the long course description for each course (with the reason 'Math 2008 Stats'), or (b) the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units) where the average total units is greater than the overall average across all departments (with the reason 'High Avg Units'). Show the columns in the following order: department name, total units range, total units variance, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, long course description, and reason for inclusion. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = 18 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, 'Math 2008 Stats' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, 'High Avg Units' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting and has a course level of 'G', and where the Mathematics department is among the top 10 departments with the highest total subject units offered (considering only degree-granting departments with at least one subject code description), show the course description, department name, school name, the administrative department name, the dense rank of the administrative department name (ordered by the administrative department name), the total number of such courses per administrative department, the total units offered by the department, the subject with the highest units in that department, and the units for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte_1 AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), math_courses AS ( SELECT inner_cte_1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte_1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte_1.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte_1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte_1.admin_dept_dense_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte_1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_courses_per_admin_dept, inner_cte_1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte_1 ), inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS Total_Units_Offered, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY Total_Units_Offered DESC LIMIT 10 ), subj_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL ), top10_departments AS ( SELECT dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Units_Offered, dept_stats.SCHOOL_NAME, subj_stats.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject, subj_stats.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Units, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_stats LEFT JOIN subj_stats ON dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND subj_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Units_Offered DESC ) SELECT mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.SCHOOL_NAME, mc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.admin_dept_dense_rank, mc.total_courses_per_admin_dept, t10.Total_Units_Offered, t10.Top_Subject, t10.Top_Subject_Units FROM math_courses mc JOIN top10_departments t10 ON mc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t10.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t10.Total_Units_Offered DESC;

question: For each department and school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units, and specifically for the Mathematics department), as well as the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, and the total number of such courses in 2019 with more than 5 enrolled students (including only the Mathematics and Chemistry departments)? sql: WITH math_fall_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, enrolled_variance DESC ), engineering_max_units_courses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE ) SELECT mfe.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfe.avg_enrolled, mfe.enrolled_variance, emu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, emu.max_total_units, emu.SUBJECT_CODE, emu.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, emu.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM math_fall_enrollment_stats mfe CROSS JOIN engineering_max_units_courses emu;

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.department = d.department ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), subq2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' ) ) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year;

sql: WITH DepartmentVariation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_cv ), EngineeringMechEngDept AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_cv ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.min_cip_program_code, inner_cte.total_departments, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) AS Total_Courses ON inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department that (1) offers subjects in the fall term with library reserve material details with material status 'U', and (2) is a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management, Course 15) with a maximum total units of any course offered in the 2008 academic year greater than the average maximum total units across all such departments, list the department name, the minimum academic year for the fall term library reserve subjects, the sum of total units for those subjects, the maximum total units of any course offered by that department in 2008, the subject code of that course, and the normalized units ratio (sum of total units for fall term library reserve subjects divided by the maximum total units in 2008 for that department, rounded to two decimal places), ordered by normalized units ratio descending.
sql: WITH Subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_academic_year, sum_total_units FROM inner_cte ), Subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_total_units, SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE max_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(max_total_units) FROM inner_cte ) ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.min_academic_year, s1.sum_total_units, s2.max_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, ROUND(s1.sum_total_units / NULLIF(s2.max_total_units, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Units_Ratio FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Normalized_Units_Ratio DESC;
