sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, enrolled_variance DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10 ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.stddev_total_units, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_math_subjects_in_library_reserve FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS stddev_total_units, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS num_math_subjects_in_library_reserve, s1.avg_enrolled, s1.enrolled_variance, 'EnrollmentStats' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.num_math_subjects_in_library_reserve, NULL AS avg_enrolled, NULL AS enrolled_variance, 'UnitsAndLibraryStats' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_YEAR, stddev_total_units, TERM_DESCRIPTION, num_math_subjects_in_library_reserve, avg_enrolled, enrolled_variance, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, Source;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the average and variance of the number of students enrolled in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have at least 1 enrolled student, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Please provide the academic year description, the average number of enrolled students, and the variance of enrolled students.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the standard deviation of the total units of all subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department, considering only years with more than 10 subjects?

For each academic year, what is the average and variance of the number of students enrolled in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have at least 1 enrolled student, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each academic year, provide a grand total row showing the overall average and variance across all such courses in all years.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the standard deviation of the total units of all subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only years with more than 10 subjects), and the number of Mathematics subjects in the library reserve for that year? Also, include the term description for each academic year.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10 ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, enrolled_variance DESC ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10 ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.stddev_total_units, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_math_subjects_in_library_reserve FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION

question: For each department in the School of Science that is named 'Mathematics', what is the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of graduate students in that department who have a non-null office phone number and are in Course 18, along with the school name and department phone number, the department code, the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, and the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY, where the department is degree-granting and the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science' ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.avg_office_phone, subq1.stddev_office_phone, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, subq2.min_num_enrolled_students, subq2.avg_total_units FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.stddev_office_phone DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_office_phone DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science';

question: For each academic year and department, provide the academic year, academic year description, department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are marked as current in the term parameter table, the full name of the department (if it is a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering excluding the Department of Management, Course 15), the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, and the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment. Also, include subtotals for each academic year (with the department field as 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all years (with the department field as 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ), AcademicYearDeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance, year_sort, dept_sort FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EngineeringDeptMaxEnrollment AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = icte.max_enrollment ) SELECT aydus.academic_year, aydus.academic_year_desc, aydus.dept, aydus.units_range, aydus.units_variance, edm.DEPT_FULL_NAME, edm.max_enrollment, edm.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM AcademicYearDeptUnitsStats aydus LEFT JOIN ( SELECT edme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edme.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS DEPT_FULL_NAME, edme.max_enrollment, edme.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM EngineeringDeptMaxEnrollment edme ) edm ON aydus.dept = edm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY aydus.year_sort, aydus.dept_sort;

For each academic year and department, provide the academic year, academic year description, department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are marked as current in the term parameter table. sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_range DESC;

WITH dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_enroll dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ORDER BY dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = icte.max_enrollment ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and for each of the Chemistry and Biology departments, provide the academic year, the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up (using only activities with a non-null maximum enrollment), the maximum, minimum, and average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the department that have at least one associated course material (excluding those with 'NM' status), and indicate whether the department's average enrollment is above or below 20 students. For each academic year, also include a grand total for all departments in the format of (academic year, null, total statistics), but only include rows where the department is Chemistry or Biology. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled, MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 20 THEN 'ABOVE_20' ELSE '20_OR_BELOW' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_max_enrollment, s1.stddev_max_enrollment, s2.max_enrolled, s2.min_enrolled, s2.avg_enrolled, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

For each academic year, provide the academic year, the department name, and calculate the average and standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up, using only activities that have a non-null maximum enrollment. For each academic year, also include a grand total for all departments in the format of (academic year, null, total statistics).

For each department, provide the department name, the maximum, minimum, and average number of enrolled students in its offered subjects that have at least one associated course material (excluding those with 'NM' status), but only include the Chemistry and Biology departments (i.e., Course 5 and Course 7). Also, indicate whether the department's average enrollment is above or below 20 students.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled, MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 20 THEN 'ABOVE_20' ELSE '20_OR_BELOW' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry) where the average number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department is greater than the overall average for such departments, provide the department name, the average number of enrolled students per subject, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and indicate whether the department's average total units is at least 10% higher than the overall average (labeled as 'HIGH_AVERAGE'), at least 10% lower (labeled as 'LOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE', listing the columns in the following order: department name, average enrolled students per subject, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and average category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH eng_dept_avg_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (inner_cte.total_enrolled * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count) AS avg_enrolled_per_subject FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.total_enrolled * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count) > ( SELECT SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) * 1.0 / COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' ) ), dept_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.avg_enrolled_per_subject, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, d.average_category FROM eng_dept_avg_enrollment e JOIN dept_units_stats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o;

question: For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 (only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Political Science department), the department phone number, and the average total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022 that are also listed in the CIS course catalog (only including departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average for such subjects). Additionally, calculate the normalized range (range divided by average total units, rounded to two decimals) and normalized variance (variance divided by average total units, rounded to two decimals). List the columns in this order: department name, school name, units range, units variance, department phone number, average total units, normalized range, and normalized variance. Sort the results by school name and department name.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.units_range, s1.units_variance, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.avg_total_units, ROUND(s1.units_range / NULLIF(s2.avg_total_units, 0), 2) AS normalized_range, ROUND(s1.units_variance / NULLIF(s2.avg_total_units, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH student_cte AS ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), student_with_phone AS ( SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM student_cte inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_cip_stats_cte AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_cip_program_code, ic.range_cip_program_code, ic.var_cip_program_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT swp.FIRST_NAME, swp.LAST_NAME, swp.EMAIL_ADDRESS, swp.DEPARTMENT_NAME, swp.STUDENT_YEAR, swp.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, swp.SCHOOL_NAME, swp.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, swp.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code FROM student_with_phone swp LEFT JOIN dept_cip_stats_cte dcs ON swp.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND swp.SCHOOL_NAME = dcs.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY swp.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For degree-granting courses in the School of Engineering that are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show for each department the department name, the highest sum of CIP program codes within each school code group, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, the average total units for that department as a benchmark, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such departments, and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 10% greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if it is at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t2.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_cip_sum, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.highest_cip_sum, subq2.coefficient_of_variation, subq2.avg_total_units, subq2.benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, subq2.variability_category FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t2.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_cip_sum FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, provide the school name, department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2016SP term and that are offered this year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (school name, null, null, null, total average, total range, total variance). For each department, also include the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year, and the total number of unique courses offered by that department, but only for degree-granting departments excluding Biology. List the columns in the following order: school name, department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, variance of number of students, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of number of students, and total number of unique courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, MAX(range_total_units) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(var_total_units) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ), DeptStudentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, dss.variance_num_students, dss.stddev_num_students, dss.total_courses FROM DeptUnitsStats dus LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptStudentStats dss ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each degree-granting department, what are the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code (where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000), the corresponding administrative department name if available, and, for the Mathematics department (Course 18) with total enrolled students greater than 100 in the 2021FA or 2022FA term, the department name, the total number of enrolled students, and the corresponding school name? sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), cte1 AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte1 icte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrolled, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.min_num_enrolled_students, cte1.avg_dept_budget_code, cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.total_enrolled, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN cte2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department, provide either (a) the department name, department code, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, and the difference between this average and the average total units for subjects offered by the same department in the 2021 academic year (excluding Chemistry), or (b) the department name, department code, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered in the 2022FA term, and the average number of enrolled students in those courses (excluding Physics). Also, include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('UnitsStats' for the first case and 'UnitsAndEnrollmentStats' for the second case). Show the columns in the following order: department name, department code, average total units for 2022, variance of total units for 2022, difference from 2021 average, variance of total units in 2022FA, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in 2022FA, average enrollment in 2022FA, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2022, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022, inner_cte.var_total_units_2022, (inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022 - prev.avg_total_units_2021) AS avg_diff_from_2021 FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2021 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) prev ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = prev.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units ), CombinedDepartments AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.avg_total_units_2022, s1.var_total_units_2022, s1.avg_diff_from_2021, NULL AS variance_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, NULL AS avg_enrollment, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS avg_total_units_2022, NULL AS var_total_units_2022, NULL AS avg_diff_from_2021, s2.variance_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.avg_enrollment, 'UnitsAndEnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_total_units_2022, var_total_units_2022, avg_diff_from_2021, variance_total_units, stddev_total_units, avg_enrollment, Reason FROM CombinedDepartments ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry), provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, and also show the difference between this average and the average total units for subjects offered by the same department in the 2021 academic year.

For each degree-granting department (excluding the Physics department), in the 2022FA term, provide the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered, and also include the average number of enrolled students in those courses.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2022, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022, inner_cte.var_total_units_2022, (inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022 - prev.avg_total_units_2021) AS avg_diff_from_2021 FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2021 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) prev ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = prev.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units

question: For each department and course in the Mathematics department, list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials (considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department), the average subject enrollment number for those subjects, the department code (not repeated if the same as the previous row), the course, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code (where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are degree-granting and specifically for the Mathematics department), the course description, and the school name for each course. Only include results where the average total units is greater than zero. Sort the table by department name, department code, and course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE END AS department_code, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER AS course, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.COURSE_NUMBER = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.COURSE = tso.COURSE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.coefficient_of_variation, s1.avg_subject_enrollment, s2.department_code, s2.course, s2.min_num_enrolled_students, s2.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.department_code, s2.course;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials, considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department code, department name, and the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are degree-granting and specifically for the Mathematics department?

For each department, list the department name, the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials (considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department), and the average subject enrollment number for those subjects. Only include results where the average total units is greater than zero.

For each department and course, provide the department code, department name, course, the minimum number of enrolled students, and the average department budget code where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are degree-granting and specifically for the Mathematics department. Also, include the course description and the school name for each course. Do not repeat the department code if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department code and course.
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE END AS department_code, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER AS course, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.COURSE_NUMBER = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.COURSE = tso.COURSE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each department that offers courses with at least one reserved library material with a material status of 'U' and is either the Chemistry or Biology department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those courses, and the school name for each department. Additionally, for each such department, list for each school the school name, department name, and the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). For each school, also include a grand total for all such graduate students in the format of (school name, null, total students). The columns should be: department name, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), school name, graduate school name, graduate department name, and total graduate students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 i LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY i.enrollment_stddev DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_graduate_students) AS total_graduate_students, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_graduate_students) > 0 ) SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, des.school_name, rr.SCHOOL_NAME AS grad_school_name, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS grad_department_name, rr.total_graduate_students FROM dept_enrollment_stats des LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON des.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN RollupResults rr ON sd.SCHOOL_NAME = rr.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material, a material status of 'U', and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department (i.e., Course 5 or Course 7).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material with a material status of 'U', and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department. Also, include the school name for each department by joining with the school information.

For each school, list the school name, department name, and the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). sub_sqls: SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.enrollment_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_graduate_students) AS total_graduate_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_graduate_students) > 0 ) SELECT rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_graduate_students FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the highest number of times any course has been offered, and for that course, provide the department name, course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, and the maximum offer count; also, provide the department code, the number of students in the department, the total number of unique student years represented among those students, and the average number of students per unique student year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), department_max_offers AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(offer_count) AS max_offer_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_department_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.student_count, inner_cte2.unique_student_years, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.unique_student_years > 0 THEN inner_cte2.student_count * 1.0 / inner_cte2.unique_student_years ELSE NULL END AS avg_students_per_year FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT dmo.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmo.COURSE_NUMBER, dmo.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, dmo.SUBJECT_TITLE, dmo.max_offer_count, mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.student_count, mds.unique_student_years, mds.avg_students_per_year FROM department_max_offers dmo JOIN math_department_stats mds ON dmo.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: What are the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, and for each, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, and the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG?

For each department that grants degrees and is the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department code, department name, the number of students in that department, and the total number of unique student years represented among those students?

For each department, what is the highest number of times any course has been offered, and for that course, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, and the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG?

For each degree-granting department that is the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department code, department name, the number of students in that department, the total number of unique student years represented among those students, and the average number of students per unique student year?
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(offer_count) AS max_offer_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.student_count, inner_cte.unique_student_years, CASE WHEN inner_cte.unique_student_years > 0 THEN inner_cte.student_count * 1.0 / inner_cte.unique_student_years ELSE NULL END AS avg_students_per_year FROM inner_cte;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are printed in the bulletin and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, but only include those subjects whose total units exceed the average total units for Mathematics subjects offered in 2022 and printed in the bulletin. For each such subject, also provide the total number of enrolled students in Mathematics subjects offered in the 2021FA or 2022FA term (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100) and the number of unique Mathematics subjects offered in those terms. Present the columns in the following order: subject title, department name, total units, row number window, total enrolled students, and number of unique subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window, c.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.row_num_window, i.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(c2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2 WHERE c2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c2.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) a ON 1=1 WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.row_num_window, s2.total_enrolled, s2.num_unique_subjects FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the subject code and subject title of the Mathematics subject with the highest total units offered in the fall term for that year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) in years with more than five activities, the department phone number, and the school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) ccso ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ccso.rn = 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.stddev_max_enrollment, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.total_units_variance, subq1.total_units_stddev, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.stddev_max_enrollment, subq2.department_phone, subq2.school_name FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department that is degree granting, not the Chemistry department (Course 5), and has offered more than 5 subjects, and that is also the Mathematics department (Course 18) which in academic year 2024 offered subjects with a total of 12 units and at least 2 such subjects in a school, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, the number of graduate students in that department, the subject code, subject title, department name of the subject, school name, and for each school, the number of such subjects offered in that school? List the results ordered by department name, school name, and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), DepartmentStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.stddev_total_units, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathSubjectsBySchool AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.subject_count, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) sc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sc.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.stddev_total_units, ds.num_grad_students, msbs.SUBJECT_CODE, msbs.SUBJECT_TITLE, msbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, msbs.SCHOOL_NAME, msbs.subject_count FROM DepartmentStats ds JOIN MathSubjectsBySchool msbs ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msbs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msbs.SCHOOL_NAME, msbs.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit, offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department, show the department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for any such subject in each department, subject ID, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID, along with, for courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, the course, course description, school name, the rank of each course within its department ordered by course, and also include the department's full name from the department table.
