sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t2 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_enrollment, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.COURSE, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.window_column AS course_rank_in_dept, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.COURSE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t2 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that grants degrees, offers graduate-level courses, and is not the Biology or Chemistry department, and whose administrative department name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2), what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the variance category (whether 'HIGH_VARIANCE', 'LOW_VARIANCE', or 'AVERAGE'), the administrative department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, and the department phone number? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), variance_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1) avg_stats ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), admin_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vs.enrolled_students_variance, vs.enrolled_students_stddev, vs.variance_category, ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ast.coefficient_of_variation, ast.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM variance_stats vs JOIN admin_stats ast ON vs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY vs.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses that are at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments?

For each administrative department, give the administrative department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, but only include departments whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2).

For each department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees, courses at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments), and whether the department is a 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such departments), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'?

sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department and school, list the department name, school name, whether the courses are degree granting, the total number of undergraduate courses in that department and school (including a grand total per department and school in the format of (department name, school name, null, total courses)), and for each department and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, include the number of departments and the minimum department budget code, but only if the minimum department budget code is greater than the average department budget code for all degree granting departments. Show the department name, school name, whether the courses are degree granting, total undergraduate courses, administrative department name, department count, and minimum department budget code, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte_courses AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING ), math_courses_summary AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, SUM(num_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte_courses GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_courses) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING ), inner_cte_dept AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_budget AS ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), math_dept_budget_summary AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.department_count, i.min_budget_code FROM inner_cte_dept i, avg_budget a WHERE i.min_budget_code > a.avg_budget_code ) SELECT mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME, mcs.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, mcs.total_courses, mdbs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdbs.department_count, mdbs.min_budget_code FROM math_courses_summary mcs LEFT JOIN math_dept_budget_summary mdbs ON mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: Which department name and school name have the highest number of courses, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a course level of 'U', and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of departments and the minimum department budget code.

Only consider courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18) with course level 'U'.

sub_sqls: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, SUM(num_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_courses) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_budget AS ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.department_count, i.min_budget_code FROM inner_cte i, avg_budget a WHERE i.min_budget_code > a.avg_budget_code;

question: For each of the top 10 departments in the 'Engineering' school (excluding 'Political Science'), ranked by the range of total units for their subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), display the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the subject within that department with the highest total units and the value of those units, and for each such department, show all rooms in the Stata building with area greater than 400 where a course offered by that department meets, including the room key, building room, area, the subject title and academic year of the course meeting in that room, the department name of the course, and the rank of the room within its building (ordered by room key). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev, top_subject.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, top_subject.max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) top_subject ON stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_subject.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stats.total_units_range DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_units_range, subq1.total_units_variance, subq1.total_units_stddev, subq1.subject_with_max_units, subq1.max_total_units, subq2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, subq2.BUILDING_ROOM, subq2.AREA, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS ROOM_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.total_units_range DESC, subq2.window_column;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev, top_subject.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, top_subject.max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) top_subject ON stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_subject.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stats.total_units_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year and department in Mathematics, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department (considering only subjects offered in the current term, with more than 0 total units, and with subject enrollment number greater than the average for that department and year), and for those departments, what are the department code, corresponding administrative department name, the graduate level of courses, and the total number of distinct courses per department, for all degree-granting departments except the Management department? Present the results as academic year, department name, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), department code, administrative department name, graduate level, and number of distinct courses, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_units_stats AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_courses AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses ) SELECT mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mus.total_units_variance, mus.total_units_stddev, dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.GRADUATE_LEVEL, dc.num_distinct_courses FROM math_units_stats mus JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_courses dc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mus.total_units_variance DESC, dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dc.GRADUATE_LEVEL;
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

Which are the top 3 departments that offer the most distinct courses, are degree-granting, and have department codes, department names, and the corresponding administrative department names, excluding the Management department?

For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and have a subject enrollment number greater than the average subject enrollment number for that department and academic year?

List the department codes, department names, corresponding administrative department names, the graduate level of courses, and the total number of distinct courses per department for all degree-granting departments except the Management department.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses;

question: For the Mathematics department, which offers more than five courses, what are the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for its courses, the school name, the average total units for subjects offered by the department, the range and variance of total units, and whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_UNIT', 'LOW_UNIT', or 'AVERAGE' based on whether its average total units is at least 10% greater than, at least 10% less than, or within 10% of the overall average for degree-granting departments (excluding Chemistry and only including subjects with more than 0 total units)? List the results in order of standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.units_stddev, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units, CASE WHEN ic.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte2 ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' ) oa ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.units_stddev, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.range_total_units, s2.var_total_units, s2.unit_category FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.units_stddev DESC;

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and classify the department as 'HIGH_UNIT' if its average total units is at least 10% greater than the overall average, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only include departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY units_stddev DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.units_stddev, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.units_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units, CASE WHEN ic.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' ) oa;

question: For each degree-granting department except Political Science (Course 17), show the department name, the number of unique student years in that department, each student year, the number of students, and the average, range, and variance of the number of students per student year in that department. Also, for the top 10 subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit, offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department, show the department name, subject ID, subject title, term description, the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), and the number of enrolled students for each subject. The results are combined in a single list, with columns: department name, number of unique student years, student year, number of students, average number of students per year, range of students per year, variance of students per year, subject ID, subject title, term description, subject rank in department, and number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS num_student_years, AVG(num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(num_students) - MIN(num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_student_years, ic.STUDENT_YEAR, ic.num_students, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID ), subq2 AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_student_years, s1.STUDENT_YEAR, s1.num_students, s1.avg_students_per_year, s1.range_students_per_year, s1.var_students_per_year, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS num_student_years, NULL AS STUDENT_YEAR, NULL AS num_students, NULL AS avg_students_per_year, NULL AS range_students_per_year, NULL AS var_students_per_year, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, STUDENT_YEAR;

sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of students per student year in that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department (Course 17).

For subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit, offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID.

For each degree-granting department except Political Science (Course 17), show the department name, the number of unique student years in that department, and for each student year, the number of students, along with the average, range, and variance of the number of students per student year in that department.

From the top 10 subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit, offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department, show each subject's ID, title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), and the number of enrolled students for each subject.
sub_sqls: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year, range_students_per_year, var_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS num_student_years, AVG(num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(num_students) - MIN(num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_student_years, ic.STUDENT_YEAR, ic.num_students, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.STUDENT_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10;

question: List, for each result, the source of the record (either 'MaxUnitsSubject' for subjects with the maximum total units in each degree-granting department except Physics in 2024, or 'MathSubjects' for subjects offered by degree-granting departments in Mathematics with a non-null subject code description), the department name, the maximum total units (for MaxUnitsSubject) or total units (for MathSubjects), the subject title, the school name, the dense rank over department code (for MathSubjects, otherwise null), the subject code (for MathSubjects, otherwise null), and the subject code description (for MathSubjects, otherwise null). Results are ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = icte.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT 'MaxUnitsSubject' AS Source, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_total_units, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'MathSubjects' AS Source, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM Subquery2 s2 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting, excluding the Physics department, what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units?

List the subject title, total units, department name, and school name for each subject offered, along with dense ranks over the department code ordered by department code, for subjects offered by departments that are degree granting, have a non-null subject code description, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each degree-granting department (excluding the Physics department), what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, the subject title for that subject, and the name of the school the department belongs to, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units?

For each subject offered by degree-granting departments with a non-null subject code description in the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the subject title, total units, department name, and school name, along with the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code. sub_sqls: WITH dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = icte.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each subject offered in the School of Engineering in 2019 by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, provide the subject ID, subject title, the department name, the number of enrolled graduate students whose department is degree-granting, the total number of enrolled students in the subject, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, the variance of CIP program codes for all courses in that department (excluding Mathematics and only for departments with a non-null department full name), and the school name for each department, with the results ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_enrolled_grad_students, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' LIMIT 1 ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_cip_program_code, ic.range_cip_program_code, ic.var_cip_program_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_enrolled_grad_students, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.avg_cip_program_code, s2.range_cip_program_code, s2.var_cip_program_code, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each school, provide the school name and the highest average total units for degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), grouped by course level (undergraduate or graduate), considering only courses with a non-null total units value, along with, for each subject offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, and the department phone number. List the school name, highest average total units, subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, average number of enrolled students in the window, and department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL ) subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ), subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.highest_avg_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subquery1 s1 CROSS JOIN subquery2 s2;

sub_sqls: SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL ) subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department name and subject title offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department with a total number of units greater than 0, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department, and for each building and floor, what are the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject, the number of rooms on that floor with an area greater than 500 and whose major use description does not include 'STORAGE', and the total area of such rooms? Additionally, for each department name, provide a grand total variance across all its subject titles in the format (department name, null, total variance), and for each building, include a grand total for all floors in the format of (building key, null, total rooms, total area). Present the results as (department name, subject title, total record count variance, building key, floor, number of rooms, total area) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(inner_cte1.record_count_variance) AS total_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte1.record_count_variance) IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, fr.AREA, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.AREA > 500 AND (fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IS NULL OR fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR, COUNT(FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms, SUM(AREA) AS total_area FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 0 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.total_record_count_variance, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FLOOR, s2.num_rooms, s2.total_area FROM Subquery1 s1 CROSS JOIN Subquery2 s2 ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FLOOR

sub_questions: For each subject title, what is the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject, considering only subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, with a total number of units greater than 0, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department?

For rooms with an area greater than 500 in the Stata building, excluding rooms whose major use description includes 'STORAGE', show the room key, building key, floor number, major use description, and the rank of each room within its building ordered by room key.

sub_sqls: SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_rank_in_building FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.AREA > 500 AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND (fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IS NULL OR fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') ORDER BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, room_rank_in_building;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(inner_cte.record_count_variance) AS total_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte.record_count_variance) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, fr.AREA, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.AREA > 500 AND (fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IS NULL OR fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') ) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR, COUNT(FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms, SUM(AREA) AS total_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 0 ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR

question: For each department that offers courses with at least one reserved library material with a material status of 'U' and is either the Chemistry or Biology department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those courses, and the school name for each department. sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 i LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY i.enrollment_stddev DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_graduate_students) AS total_graduate_students, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_graduate_students) > 0 ) SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, des.school_name, rr.SCHOOL_NAME AS grad_school_name, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS grad_department_name, rr.total_graduate_students FROM dept_enrollment_stats des LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON des.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN RollupResults rr ON sd.SCHOOL_NAME = rr.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_max_enrollment, s1.stddev_max_enrollment, s2.enrolled_students_variance, s2.enrolled_students_stddev, question: Show the first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the minimum department code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name, and the corresponding SIS admin department name for students whose department code is '6', who are in the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, and whose first name is 'Benedict', along with the department code, department name, SIS admin department name, and the total number of undergraduate courses offered by each of the top 3 degree-granting departments (excluding Management) that offer the most distinct courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH student_info AS ( SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT FROM ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict' ) inner_cte JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT ), top_departments AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.COURSE) AS num_undergrad_courses FROM ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3 ) ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_undergrad_courses DESC ) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.window_column, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.num_undergrad_courses FROM student_info s CROSS JOIN top_departments t;

question: For each academic year and for each department, what is the academic year, academic year description, department name, and the total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects offered in current terms, and for each of the top 10 schools with the highest average CIP program codes for degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department, what is the school name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes, the department with the most degree-granting courses in that school, and the count of such courses, where the department name matches the most prominent department in the school? Also include a grand total for all departments for each academic year in the format of (academic year, academic year description, null, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, STDDEV(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_cip_code, ic.cip_code_stddev, dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dmc.Course_Count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_cip_code, cip_code_stddev FROM inner_cte2 ORDER BY avg_cip_code DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dmc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dmc.SCHOOL_NAME AND dmc.Course_Count = ( SELECT MAX(sub.Course_Count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s2 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c2 ON s2.SUBJECT_CODE = c2.COURSE WHERE c2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s2.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) ORDER BY ic.avg_cip_code DESC ) SELECT c1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.total_coefficient_of_variation, c2.SCHOOL_NAME, c2.avg_cip_code, c2.cip_code_stddev, c2.Most_Prominent_Department, c2.Course_Count FROM cte1 c1 JOIN cte2 c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c2.Most_Prominent_Department ORDER BY c1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c2.avg_cip_code DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, STDDEV(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, STDDEV(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_cip_code, ic.cip_code_stddev, dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dmc.Course_Count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_cip_code, cip_code_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_cip_code DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dmc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dmc.SCHOOL_NAME AND dmc.Course_Count = ( SELECT MAX(sub.Course_Count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s2 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c2 ON s2.SUBJECT_CODE = c2.COURSE WHERE c2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s2.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) ORDER BY ic.avg_cip_code DESC;

question: For the three degree-granting departments (excluding Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) with the highest number of courses listed in the course catalog, what are their department codes, department names, associated school names, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by each department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and excluding Chemistry), and the number of graduate students in each department (only including departments with at least one graduate student)? sql: WITH dept_units_grad AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 ), top3_dept_courses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t3.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.stddev_total_units, d1.num_grad_students FROM top3_dept_courses t3 LEFT JOIN dept_units_grad d1 ON t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte1.stddev_enrolled_students, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 100 ), AcademicYearMathSubjects AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.total_units, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.stddev_enrolled_students, des.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, aym.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, aym.total_units, aym.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS MATH_DEPARTMENT_NAME, aym.SUBJECT_CODE, aym.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des JOIN AcademicYearMathSubjects aym ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = aym.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, aym.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, aym.SUBJECT_CODE;
