sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND (SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL OR (SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND COUNT(*) > 0)) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, aca.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, aca.TERM_CODE HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, aca.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s2.coefficient_of_variation, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each degree-granting department in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Biology, Mathematics, and Physics departments, and only including those with a department budget code greater than 100000), provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects, the school name, the department phone number, and the total clearing cost collector for the department. sql: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentUnitsEnriched AS ( SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), SchoolClearingCostStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT due.DEPARTMENT_NAME, due.avg_total_units, due.range_total_units, due.var_total_units, due.SCHOOL_NAME, due.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sccs.total_clearing_cost_collector FROM DepartmentUnitsEnriched due LEFT JOIN SchoolClearingCostStats sccs ON due.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY due.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH dept_max_avg_org AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, AVG(t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_CODE ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_SORT) AS avg_org_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME = 'School of Science' AND LOWER(t0.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') AND t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT DLC_NAME, DLC_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_ID, MAX(avg_org_number) AS max_avg_org_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME, DLC_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_ID ), org_area_stddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5 ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS dept_code, i.area_stddev, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT d.DLC_NAME, d.DLC_CODE, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_ID, d.max_avg_org_number, o.area_stddev FROM dept_max_avg_org d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON d.ORGANIZATION_ID = fo.ORGANIZATION_ID JOIN org_area_stddev o ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY d.DLC_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME

sql: WITH TopDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC LIMIT 10 ), EngineeringDepartments2021FA AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS num_courses_offered, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_courses_offered, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.num_courses_offered > 0 THEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students * 1.0 / inner_cte.num_courses_offered ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrolled_students_per_course FROM inner_cte ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term, ed.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ed.num_courses_offered, ed.total_enrolled_students, ed.avg_enrolled_students_per_course FROM TopDepartments td JOIN EngineeringDepartments2021FA ed ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY td.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC, ed.num_courses_offered DESC;

'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects, sub_sqls: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit, offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department, show the department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for any such subject in the department, subject ID, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID, and for courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course, course description, school name, the rank of each course within its department ordered by course, and also include the department's full name from the department table, for each combination where the department name matches, listing the columns in the following order: department name, maximum enrollment, subject ID, subject title, term description, subject rank in department, course, course description, school name, course rank in department, and department full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), subq1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.COURSE, inner_cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t2 ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_enrollment, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.COURSE, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.COURSE;

question: List, for each degree-granting department, either (1) the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and the total number of subjects offered by that department if the department is Mathematics (Course 18), or (2) the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and the name of the school to which the department belongs if the department is not Biology (Course 7). Also, include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('Mathematics Units' for Mathematics and 'Non-Biology Enrollment' for all other degree-granting departments except Biology). The columns should be: department name, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, total number of subjects, average enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, school name, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, dept_subjects.subject_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_subjects ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, subject_count, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS var_enrolled_students, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, 'Mathematics Units' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS subject_count, avg_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students, SCHOOL_NAME, 'Non-Biology Enrollment' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department and school, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students and departments that grant degrees), the average variance across all such departments, whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_VARIANCE', 'LOW_VARIANCE', or 'AVERAGE' (based on the variance being at least 20% greater or less than the average), the school name, the subject code description, and the total number of subjects offered by degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, including grand totals per school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(variance_num_enrolled_students) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1 ), DepartmentVarianceStats AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.variance_num_enrolled_students, i.stddev_num_enrolled_students, v.avg_variance, CASE WHEN i.variance_num_enrolled_students > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.variance_num_enrolled_students < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte1 i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark v ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUM(inner_cte2.num_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte2.num_subjects) > 0 ) SELECT dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dvs.variance_num_enrolled_students, dvs.stddev_num_enrolled_students, dvs.avg_variance, dvs.variance_category, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dss.total_subjects FROM DepartmentVarianceStats dvs JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC

For each department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students and departments that grant degrees), and whether the department is a 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such departments), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'?

For each school, list the department name, school name, subject code description, and the number of subjects offered by degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, and include a grand total of subjects per school in the format (null, school name, null, total subjects).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(variance_num_enrolled_students) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.variance_num_enrolled_students, i.stddev_num_enrolled_students, v.avg_variance, CASE WHEN i.variance_num_enrolled_students > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.variance_num_enrolled_students < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark v;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUM(inner_cte.num_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte.num_subjects) > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and the rank within each school name group ordered by subject code, but only include those subjects whose total units exceed the average total units for their respective school. Additionally, for the Mathematics department, also show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department), as well as the number of subjects that are Communication Intensive (i.e., have a non-null COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE), with these statistics included for each subject in the result. Present the columns in the following order: subject code, subject title, department name, school name, rank within school, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and number of Communication Intensive subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM ( SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccso.COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL THEN ic.SUBJECT_CODE END) AS comm_intensive_subject_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY comm_intensive_subject_count DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.comm_intensive_subject_count FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code.

For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and for each such department, also provide the number of subjects that are Communication Intensive (i.e., have a non-null COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE), sorted by the number of Communication Intensive subjects in descending order?
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM ( SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccso.COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL THEN ic.SUBJECT_CODE END) AS comm_intensive_subject_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY comm_intensive_subject_count DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry and Political Science, and only those with a non-null department name), list the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the full name of the corresponding administrative department, the total number of distinct subjects offered by that department, the variance of the number of graduate students in that department, the average number of graduate students as a benchmark, and whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_VARIANCE', 'LOW_VARIANCE', or 'AVERAGE' based on the variance compared to the benchmark. The columns should be listed in the following order: department name, enrolled students range, enrolled students variance, administrative department name, total subjects, variance of graduate students, benchmark, and variance category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_subject_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subj_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subj_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_grad_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students, avg_counts.avg_grad_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students > avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students < avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(grad_counts.student_count) AS avg_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.enrolled_students_range, dss.enrolled_students_variance, dss.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.total_subjects, dgs.variance_of_grad_students, dgs.benchmark, dgs.variance_category FROM dept_subject_stats dss JOIN dept_grad_stats dgs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name, the range and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and what is the full name of the corresponding administrative department, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5)?

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subj_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subj_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students, avg_counts.avg_grad_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students > avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students < avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(grad_counts.student_count) AS avg_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers is greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all departments, what is the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and for each academic year, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up (using only activities with non-null maximum enrollment), grouped by department and academic year? List the department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), academic year, average maximum enrollment, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of maximum enrollment in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH department_cv AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM ( SELECT (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) inner_cte2) ), iap_activity_stats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.coefficient_of_variation, ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ias.avg_max_enrollment, ias.stddev_max_enrollment FROM department_cv dc JOIN iap_activity_stats ias ON dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ias.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte);

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, list the department name, school name, subject code description, the total number of subjects they offered, and the average number of enrolled students per subject, and for each such department, show the full names, email addresses, student years, department full names, course descriptions, course levels, the minimum course level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's last name, and the corresponding subject code and subject code description for each course taken by students named 'Kevin' in 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ), KevinStudents AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.COURSE, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6' ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON inner_cte.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.SCHOOL_NAME, td.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, td.num_subjects, td.avg_enrollment, ks.FULL_NAME, ks.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ks.STUDENT_YEAR, ks.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ks.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ks.COURSE_LEVEL, ks.window_column, ks.SUBJECT_CODE, ks.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TopDepartments td JOIN KevinStudents ks ON td.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ks.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ks.FULL_NAME;

question: For the top 3 most frequently appearing Mathematics subjects in the TIP_DETAIL table, what is the highest subject enrollment number each has ever had, along with the subject ID, subject title, and the academic year description of the term in which that enrollment occurred? For each of these academic years, also provide the academic year, the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in regular terms. List the subject ID, subject title, academic year description, highest enrollment, academic year, total units range, and total units variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 3 ), TopMathSubjects AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON ss.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT tms.SUBJECT_ID, tms.SUBJECT_TITLE, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.highest_enrollment, dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM TopMathSubjects tms JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY tms.SUBJECT_ID, dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON ss.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average, range, and variance of the department budget codes for departments in that school that are degree-granting and have at least one subject code associated with them, excluding the 'Political Science' department, along with the subject title, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students descending, the full name of the offering department, and the school name for subjects offered in the term '2019FA' by the Chemistry department that have course materials, where the school name matches between the two sets of results. The columns should be: school name, average department budget code, maximum range of department budget code, average variance of department budget code, subject title, dense rank of number of enrolled students, department full name, and subject's school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS range_dept_budget_code, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS var_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_dept_budget_code) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(ic.range_dept_budget_code) AS max_range_dept_budget_code, AVG(ic.var_dept_budget_code) AS avg_var_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.dense_rank_num_enrolled, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.avg_dept_budget_code, s1.max_range_dept_budget_code, s1.avg_var_dept_budget_code, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.dense_rank_num_enrolled, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME;

sql: WITH max_units_by_dept AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ), kevin_eecs_students AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6' ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the number of subject codes it offers, the average subject code count across all degree-granting departments, the deviation of Mathematics from this average, the department code, the full name of the department, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered, and the name of the associated administrative department (if any)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), mathematics_subject_codes AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count AS mathematics_subject_code_count, AVG(i.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, (m.subj_count - AVG(i.subj_count)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN inner_cte1 m ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), mathematics_variation AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msc.mathematics_subject_code_count, msc.avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, msc.deviation_from_avg, mv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mv.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, mv.coefficient_of_variation, mv.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM mathematics_subject_codes msc JOIN mathematics_variation mv ON msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY msc.deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, provide the number of unique subject titles, the minimum total units, the average total units, and indicate whether the minimum total units is above, below, or equal to the average total units for that department and subject code this year. Additionally, for the Mathematics department, also provide the variance of the number of graduate students in that department, the average number of graduate students as a benchmark, and whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_VARIANCE', 'LOW_VARIANCE', or 'AVERAGE' in terms of graduate student count variance, considering only departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department name, and are not the Political Science department (Course 17). The columns should be: subject code, department name, number of unique subject titles, minimum total units, average total units, minimum units category, variance of graduate students, benchmark, and variance category, in that order. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_units_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.num_unique_subject_titles, i.min_total_units, a.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.min_total_units < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'EQUAL_TO_AVERAGE' END AS min_units_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_cte a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), grad_var_inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), grad_var_avg_counts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(grad_counts.student_count) AS avg_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), department_grad_variance AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students, avg_counts.avg_grad_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students > avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students < avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM grad_var_inner_cte inner_cte JOIN grad_var_avg_counts avg_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.num_unique_subject_titles, ms.min_total_units, ms.avg_total_units, ms.min_units_category, dgv.variance_of_grad_students, dgv.benchmark, dgv.variance_category FROM math_subjects ms JOIN department_grad_variance dgv ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE;

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte1.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.avg_enrolled_students, cte1.var_enrolled_students, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.FIRST_NAME, ic2.LAST_NAME, ic2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS STUDENT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.STUDENT_YEAR, ic2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic2.SCHOOL_NAME AS STUDENT_SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM cte1 JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.FIRST_NAME, ic2.LAST_NAME;

For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and the name of the school to which the department belongs.

For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, school name, the minimum department budget code over each school name group, and the department phone number, ordered by school name.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, department name, and total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects offered in current terms (including a grand total for all departments as a row with null department name), and for each academic year, what is the maximum number of total units for any subject offered by the Mathematics department where the maximum is greater than 9, along with the corresponding term description and subject title? For each row, also include a column indicating the reason for inclusion as either 'CoefficientOfVariation' or 'MaxTotalUnits'. The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, department name, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), maximum total units, term description, subject title, and reason for inclusion. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING max_total_units > 9 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.max_total_units, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = ic.max_total_units AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS max_total_units, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, 'CoefficientOfVariation' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, 'Mathematics' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_coefficient_of_variation, s2.max_total_units, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, 'MaxTotalUnits' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each academic year, what is the maximum number of total units for any subject offered in that year, and what is the corresponding term description, only considering subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) and only including academic years where the maximum total units is greater than 9?

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and for each department, what is the coefficient of variation of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table? For each academic year, also include a grand total for all departments in the format of (academic year, academic year description, null, total coefficient of variation).

sub_sqls: SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH max_units_per_year AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING max_total_units > 9 ) SELECT muy.ACADEMIC_YEAR, muy.max_total_units, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM max_units_per_year muy JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = muy.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = muy.max_total_units AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY muy.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING max_total_units > 9 ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.max_total_units, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = ic.max_total_units AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the Mathematics department, where the total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the average total enrolled students across all departments, provide the department code, department name, total number of enrolled students, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the department in the most recent academic year (for departments with more than one subject), and for each such subject, list the subject code and subject code description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units ) SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.total_enrolled_students, (STDDEV(ic2.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ic2.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte1 ic1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON ic2.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.total_enrolled_students, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department code and the total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered by that department, considering only those departments where the total number of enrolled students is more than one standard deviation above the average total enrolled students across all departments, and restrict your answer to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, provide the department code, department name, and the total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered by that department, considering only those departments where the total number of enrolled students is more than one standard deviation above the average total enrolled students across all departments, and restrict your answer to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department), show the department name, the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year (for departments with more than one subject), and for each such department, list the subject codes and subject code descriptions for the subjects included in the calculation.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t );

WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte;

WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the number of subject codes offered, the average subject code count across all degree-granting departments, the deviation of Mathematics from this average, the department code, the full name of the department, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered, and the name of the associated administrative department (if any)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), mathematics_subject_codes AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count AS mathematics_subject_code_count, AVG(i.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, (m.subj_count - AVG(i.subj_count)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN inner_cte1 m ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), mathematics_variation AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msc.mathematics_subject_code_count, msc.avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, msc.deviation_from_avg, mv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mv.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, mv.coefficient_of_variation, mv.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM mathematics_subject_codes msc JOIN mathematics_variation mv ON msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
