Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation of subject code counts per department.

For each department, what is the coefficient of variation of the number of subjects offered, and what is the full name of the department, considering only departments that are degree-granting and including only the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each degree-granting department, what is the average number of subject codes offered, and how does the number of subject codes offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) deviate from this average? sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV_POP(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count AS mathematics_subject_code_count, AVG(i.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, (m.subj_count - AVG(i.subj_count)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN inner_cte m ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV_POP(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Chemistry and Management departments), provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0), the number of unique subject codes associated with each department, the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and the full name of the department. List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units ), EngDeptMaxEnroll AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = icte.max_enrollment ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.var_total_units, d.num_unique_subject_codes, e.max_enrollment, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM DeptUnits d JOIN EngDeptMaxEnroll e ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = e.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, what is the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and restrict the results to only degree-granting departments and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15)?

For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Chemistry department), and also include the number of unique subject codes associated with each department.

For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management, Course 15), what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, what is the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and what is the full name of the department?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_enroll dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ORDER BY dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = icte.max_enrollment ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department, for each academic year, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled, including the academic year description and a grand total for all activities (with department name, null, total variance and stddev)? Additionally, for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the term description (not repeated if the same as the previous row), department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code. Present all these columns in the following order: department name, academic year description, total variance, total stddev, term description, subject department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, and subject rank in department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_variance, rr.total_stddev, CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subject_department_name, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM RollupResults rr JOIN inner_cte2 ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the variance and standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department, considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled? Also, provide the academic year description.

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code.

For each academic year, what is the variance and standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department, considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled? Also, provide the academic year description, and for each department, include a grand total for all activities in the format of (department name, null, total variance and stddev).

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, as well as the school name and the total number of subjects in the department for that term. Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_variance, rr.total_stddev FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department with a department budget code above 100000, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), that also offers a Mathematics subject in 2022 with 12 total units where the number of enrolled students in that subject is greater than the average for its HGN code group, list the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, the subject code of the course with the highest number of total units in that department and that course's total units, as well as the subject title, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code for the Mathematics subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DegreeGrantingDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE AS max_units_subject_code, c.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_subject_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c1.SUBJECT_CODE, c1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c1.TOTAL_UNITS = c2.max_units ) c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE ) a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ) SELECT dgd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dgd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgd.SCHOOL_NAME, dgd.num_unique_courses, dgd.total_units, dgd.max_units_subject_code, dgd.max_subject_total_units, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ms.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM DegreeGrantingDepartments dgd JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms ON dgd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dgd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code above 100000, and is not the Political Science department, give the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, and the total number of units for all those courses, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17).

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, ordered by the subject title.

For each degree-granting department with a department budget code above 100000, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), list the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, and the subject code of the course with the highest number of total units in that department, along with that course's total units.

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, but only include those records where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average number of enrolled students for their HGN code group.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE AS max_units_subject_code, c.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_subject_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c1.SUBJECT_CODE, c1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c1.TOTAL_UNITS = c2.max_units ) c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE ) a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For all degree-granting graduate-level courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), show each course's description, department name, school name, and the administrative department name, along with the total number of such courses per administrative department and the dense rank of each administrative department by the number of courses (ordered from highest to lowest). Additionally, for each such course, include the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the same department, but only if the department's average number of enrolled students is greater than the overall average across all subjects (excluding Chemistry). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathGradCourses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, adc.Course_Count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY adc.Course_Count DESC) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) adc ON ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = adc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), HighAvgEnrollmentDepts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ) SELECT mgc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mgc.SCHOOL_NAME, mgc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mgc.Course_Count, mgc.admin_dept_dense_rank, hae.avg_enrolled_students, hae.stddev_enrolled_students FROM MathGradCourses mgc JOIN HighAvgEnrollmentDepts hae ON mgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mgc.Course_Count DESC, mgc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic building at MIT and each of its floors with total assignable area greater than 5000 and at least one room with access level 1 or 2, provide the building's long name, the floor number, the range and variance of the area of rooms on that floor (considering only rooms with access level 1 or 2), the range and variance of the assignable area of its floors that have at least one room, and the total number of rooms in the building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 5000 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH floors_with_rooms AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR ), academic_buildings AS ( SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM academic_buildings ab JOIN floors_with_rooms fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, s1.FLOOR, s1.area_range, s1.area_variance, s2.assignable_area_range, s2.assignable_area_variance, s2.total_room_count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = s2.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AND s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, s1.FLOOR

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 5000

WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH floors_with_rooms AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR ), academic_buildings AS ( SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM academic_buildings ab JOIN floors_with_rooms fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry) that has at least one graduate student, what is the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the number of graduate students in that department, and for each subject offered by that department in the Mathematics department with a non-null subject code description, what is the subject title, total units, school name, the dense rank over department code ordered by department code, and whether the total units for the subject are 'HIGH_UNIT' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for that department), 'LOW_UNIT' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'? List the results in order by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units_grad_students AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects_unit_category AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dugs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dugs.avg_total_units, dugs.stddev_total_units, dugs.num_grad_students, msuc.SUBJECT_TITLE, msuc.TOTAL_UNITS, msuc.SCHOOL_NAME, msuc.window_column, msuc.unit_category FROM dept_units_grad_students dugs JOIN math_subjects_unit_category msuc ON dugs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msuc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dugs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msuc.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

sql: WITH math_courses_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' ), avg_units AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units ORDER BY i.TOTAL_UNITS DESC ), dept_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT *, MAX(avg_total_units) OVER () AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.highest_avg_total_units, mca.SUBJECT_CODE, mca.TOTAL_UNITS AS MATH_COURSE_TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units_stats dus LEFT JOIN math_courses_above_avg mca ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mca.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mca.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' ) , avg_units AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units ORDER BY i.TOTAL_UNITS DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT *, MAX(avg_total_units) OVER () AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), school_dept_stats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ) t ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND math_subjects ms ON sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s1.avg_enrollment, s2.min_num_enrolled_students, s2.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROUND(s1.avg_enrollment / NULLIF(s2.min_num_enrolled_students, 0), 2) AS enrollment_to_min_ratio FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrollment_to_min_ratio DESC ;

question: For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, list the department name, school name, subject code description, the total number of subjects they offered, and the average number of enrolled students per subject, and for each such department, show the full names, email addresses, student years, department full names, course descriptions, course levels, the minimum course level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's last name, and the corresponding subject code and subject code description for each course taken by students named 'Kevin' in 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6), where the subject code description matches the department's subject code description. sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), top_departments AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6' ), kevin_courses AS ( SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON inner_cte.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.SCHOOL_NAME, td.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, td.num_subjects, td.avg_enrollment, kc.FULL_NAME, kc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, kc.STUDENT_YEAR, kc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, kc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, kc.COURSE_LEVEL, kc.window_column, kc.SUBJECT_CODE, kc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM top_departments td JOIN kevin_courses kc ON td.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC = kc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AND td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE = kc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) ORDER BY td.num_subjects DESC, kc.FULL_NAME;

sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects they offered, including the department name, the school name, and the subject code description, for departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, and are not the 'Political Science' department (Course 17).

For students whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6), and whose first name is 'Kevin', show their full name, email address, student year, the department's full name, the course description, the course level, and the minimum course level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's last name.

For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, list the department name, school name, subject code description, the total number of subjects they offered, and the average number of enrolled students per subject.

Show the full names, email addresses, student years, department full names, course descriptions, course levels, and the minimum course level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's last name, for students whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6) and whose first name is 'Kevin', along with the corresponding subject code and subject code description for each course.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6' ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON inner_cte.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each department (excluding Political Science, Course 17) that is both in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools with a total number of course units greater than 1000 and is a degree-granting department with at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students and among the top 10 by number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled, list the department name, the total number of units for courses, the number of distinct courses offered in the most recent academic year, the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects, the average number of unique students named "Zoe" per department as a benchmark, the enrollment category ('HIGH_ENROLLMENT', 'LOW_ENROLLMENT', or 'AVERAGE'), the ratio of the number of distinct courses in the latest year to the number of unique students named "Zoe" (rounded), and the ratio of total units to the number of unique students named "Zoe" (rounded). Order the results by the ratio of courses per Zoe student in descending order.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ) GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.unique_students, avg_stats.avg_unique_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.unique_students > avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.unique_students < avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(unique_students) AS avg_unique_students FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units, s1.num_courses_latest_year, s2.unique_students, s2.benchmark, s2.enrollment_category, ROUND(s1.num_courses_latest_year / NULLIF(s2.unique_students, 0), 2) AS Courses_Per_Zoe_Student, ROUND(s1.total_units / NULLIF(s2.unique_students, 0), 2) AS Units_Per_Zoe_Student FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Courses_Per_Zoe_Student DESC
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the total number of units for courses in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools, where the total units for the department is greater than 1000, and restrict the results to departments that are not "Political Science" (Course 17).

List the top 10 degree-granting departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects, showing the department name and the count of unique student full names, for departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students and are not the Political Science department (Course 17).

For each department, provide the department name and the total number of units for courses in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools, where the total units for the department is greater than 1000, and restrict the results to departments that are not "Political Science" (Course 17). Additionally, for each such department, list the number of distinct courses offered in the most recent academic year available.

For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science, Course 17) that offers at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, show the department name, the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects, the average number of unique students named "Zoe" per department as a benchmark, and categorize each department as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% more than the average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. List the top 10 departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe".
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ) GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.unique_students, avg_stats.avg_unique_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.unique_students > avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.unique_students < avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(unique_students) AS avg_unique_students FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_students DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees), as well as the school name and department phone number. Additionally, include the department's full name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the department, and the number of unique subjects offered by the department, considering only departments that grant degrees (excluding Chemistry and Biology) and that offer more than 5 unique subjects. List the columns in the following order: department name, range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students per subject, school name, department phone number, department full name, average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and number of unique subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students, subj_counts.num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) subj_counts ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subj_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE subj_counts.num_unique_subjects > 5 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.enrolled_students_range, s1.enrolled_students_variance, s1.enrolled_students_stddev, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.var_enrolled_students, s2.stddev_enrolled_students, s2.num_unique_subjects FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students, subj_counts.num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) subj_counts ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subj_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE subj_counts.num_unique_subjects > 5;

question: For each academic year and school, and for each department (other than Chemistry) that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021 in that school, provide the academic year, academic year description, school name, the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in that year and school (excluding current terms and subjects with 0 units), the department code, department name, number of subjects offered by the department in 2021, total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the subject with the highest enrollment in 2021 (including its subject title and number of enrolled students). sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.num_subjects_offered, ic.total_enrolled_students, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE AS highest_enrolled_subject_title, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS highest_enrolled_subject_students FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS rn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' ) sos ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.rn = 1 ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.num_subjects_offered, s2.total_enrolled_students, s2.highest_enrolled_subject_title, s2.highest_enrolled_subject_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each subject code in the Political Science department, what is the subject code, subject code description, the geometric mean of the number of students in each degree-granting department associated with that subject code, and the total number of students across all such departments for each subject code, along with, for each department and school associated with those subject codes, the department name, school name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting (excluding 'Mathematics' departments), and the department phone number? sql: WITH PoliticalScienceSubjectStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.SCHOOL_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance, du.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM PoliticalScienceSubjectStats ps JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ps.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats du ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.SCHOOL_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance, du.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, du.SCHOOL_NAME, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), subject_code_stats AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' ), student_info AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.FULL_NAME, inner_cte2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.geometric_mean_students, s.total_students, si.FULL_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.window_column FROM subject_code_stats s LEFT JOIN student_info si ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = si.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, si.FULL_NAME

question: For each academic year in which the Mathematics department offered more than 5 subjects in regular terms, show the academic year, the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects, and the school that offered the most such subjects (with the count of subjects from that school). For each such year, also show all rooms in the Stata building (area greater than 400) where a Computer Science course met in that year, including the room key, building room, area, the subject title of the Computer Science course meeting in that room, the academic year of the Computer Science course, the rank of the room within its building (ordered by room key), and whether the room is a 'LARGE_ROOM' (area at least 500), 'MEDIUM_ROOM' (area between 400 and 500), or 'SMALL_ROOM' (area less than 400). List the columns in the following order: academic year, academic year description, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, most prominent school, school subject count, room key, building room, area, Computer Science subject title, Computer Science course academic year, room rank, and room size category. sql: WITH math_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ic.stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units, ic.SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, ic.subject_count AS School_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(subject_count) AS max_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) ranked ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ranked.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.subject_count = ranked.max_subject_count WHERE ( SELECT SUM(subject_count) FROM inner_cte ic2 WHERE ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) > 5 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), cs_rooms AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN inner_cte.AREA >= 500 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN inner_cte.AREA >= 400 AND inner_cte.AREA < 500 THEN 'MEDIUM_ROOM' ELSE 'SMALL_ROOM' END AS cs_rooms.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, cs_rooms.BUILDING_ROOM, cs_rooms.AREA, cs_rooms.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs_rooms.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS CS_ROOM_ACADEMIC_YEAR, cs_rooms.window_column, cs_rooms.room_size_category FROM sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) > 5;

SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ic.stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units, ic.SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, ic.subject_count AS School_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(subject_count) AS max_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) ranked ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ranked.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.subject_count = ranked.max_subject_count WHERE ( SELECT SUM(subject_count) FROM inner_cte ic2 WHERE ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) > 5 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN inner_cte.AREA >= 500 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN inner_cte.AREA >= 400 AND inner_cte.AREA < 500 THEN 'MEDIUM_ROOM' ELSE 'SMALL_ROOM' END AS room_size_category FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding 'Chemistry') where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in terms with total units greater than 6 is above the average across all such departments, and for each such department that also grants degrees, is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), and whose maximum CIP program code among its courses is greater than 120000, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the department's full name, the maximum CIP program code, the corresponding SIS subject code, the subject code description, and the graduate level for each course with that maximum CIP program code. The results are ordered by the total number of enrolled students (descending) and then by maximum CIP program code (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte1 WHERE total_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM inner_cte1 ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.max_cip_code, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte2 icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = icte.max_cip_code JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.total_enrolled, cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte2.max_cip_code, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte2.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.total_enrolled DESC, cte2.max_cip_code DESC
