SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte WHERE total_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM inner_cte );

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.max_cip_code, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = icte.max_cip_code JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department, Course 7) in schools that have more than five degree-granting departments or in the School of Science, list the department name, school name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, the department phone number, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school. Sort the results by school name and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH school_stddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(ic.stddev_total_units) AS school_stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) > 5 OR ic.SCHOOL_NAME = 'School of Science' ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ), dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.var_total_units, ds.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, ss.school_stddev_total_units FROM dept_stats ds JOIN school_stddev ss ON ds.SCHOOL_NAME = ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List all departments that either (1) in the 2022 academic year are degree-granting and not Biology, providing the department name, department code, average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects, along with the school name and department phone number, or (2) offered subjects in the 2019FA term as degree-granting departments in the School of Engineering (excluding Political Science), providing the department name, department code, and the number of subjects offered. For each result, include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('DeptStats' for the first case and 'EngSubjects' for the second). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.range_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), EngSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.avg_total_units, d.range_total_units, d.var_total_units, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, NULL AS num_subjects, 'DeptStats' AS Reason FROM DeptStats d UNION ALL SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, e.num_subjects, 'EngSubjects' AS Reason FROM EngSubjects e ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that has degree-granting courses with non-null CIP program codes and at least one subject in the Mathematics department (Course 18) offered in academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units and with more enrolled students than the average for their HGN code group, list the department code, department full name, the range and variance of CIP program codes among its degree-granting courses with non-null CIP program codes, the count of distinct subject codes for those courses, the subject title, department name, subject's department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code. The columns should be shown in this order: department code, department full name, CIP code range, CIP code variance, count of distinct subject codes, subject title, department name, subject's department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in the window. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.cip_code_range, i.cip_code_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS distinct_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.cip_code_range, i.cip_code_variance ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sub_questions: For each department, what is the department's full name, and what are the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses that are degree granting, have a non-null CIP program code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, ordered by the subject title.

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME

SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.cip_code_range, i.cip_code_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS distinct_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.cip_code_range, i.cip_code_variance

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE ) a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department that is either Chemistry or Biology, and for subjects offered in the 2019FA term that have at least one associated course material, list the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in its offered subjects, the department's average total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding Political Science and only for degree-granting departments), and the deviation of this average from the overall average total units for all degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) in 2022. Present the columns in the following order: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, department average total units, and deviation from overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.enrolled_range, s1.enrolled_variance, d.dept_avg_units, (d.dept_avg_units - o.overall_avg_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_avg d ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

For each degree-granting department (excluding 'Political Science'), what is the average total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and how does this average compare to the overall average total units for all degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science') in 2022? Provide the department name, the department's average total units, and the deviation from the overall average.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.dept_avg_units, (d.dept_avg_units - o.overall_avg_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM dept_avg d CROSS JOIN overall_avg o;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), the earliest and latest term start dates for those regular terms in that academic year, the total number of Mathematics subjects offered with more than 0 enrolled students in regular terms, and for each such subject, show the subject ID, subject title, the subject enrollment number, and the deviation of its enrollment from the average enrollment of Mathematics subjects in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date, MAX(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathSubjectEnrollment AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(i.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS num_math_subjects, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, (i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - a.avg_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, ays.earliest_term_start_date, ays.latest_term_start_date, mse.num_math_subjects, mse.SUBJECT_ID, mse.SUBJECT_TITLE, mse.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, mse.deviation_from_avg FROM AcademicYearStats ays JOIN MathSubjectEnrollment mse ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mse.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mse.SUBJECT_ID

For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total number of students enrolled in subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) during that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and terms that are regular terms.

sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date, MAX(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) , avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(i.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS num_math_subjects, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, (i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - a.avg_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management and the Department of Physics) that is among the top 10 by number of unique subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, the subject code of that course, the full name of the department, the school name, the number of unique subjects offered in 2022, and the average number of enrolled students per subject for that department? List the results ordered by the number of unique subjects offered (descending), then by the maximum total units (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_per_subject, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_total_units, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.avg_enrolled_students_per_subject FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s2.subject_count DESC, s1.max_total_units DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_per_subject FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department (excluding Chemistry) that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021, list the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and for each subject, show the subject code, subject code description, and the course number. Additionally, for each of the top 10 subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit, offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department, show the subject ID, subject title, term description, the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), and the number of enrolled students for each subject. The results are shown for all combinations where the department and subject information can be joined. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_subjects_2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ), dept_subjects_2021_expanded AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects_offered, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM dept_subjects_2021 inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ), top10_eecs_1unit AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID ) ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10 ) SELECT dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.SCHOOL_NAME, dse.num_subjects_offered, dse.total_enrolled_students, dse.SUBJECT_CODE, dse.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dse.COURSE_NUMBER, t10.SUBJECT_ID, t10.SUBJECT_TITLE, t10.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t10.subject_rank_in_dept, t10.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS t10_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM dept_subjects_2021_expanded dse JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN top10_eecs_1unit t10 ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = t10.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY dse.num_subjects_offered DESC, dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.SUBJECT_CODE, t10.subject_rank_in_dept;

question: From the top 10 schools with the highest average total units for subjects offered by departments in that school (considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department), display each school's name, average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, as well as the department within that school with the highest number of such subjects and the count of those subjects, and for the department and school, also display the subject code with the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in Mathematics and the count of such courses. The columns should be: school name, average total units, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, most prominent department, subject count, subject code with highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in Mathematics, and the count of such courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1_top10 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte1 ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ), cte2_top1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.avg_total_units, t1.var_total_units, t1.stddev_total_units, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, ds.Subject_Count, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.subject_course_count FROM cte1_top10 t1 LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds ON t1.SCHOOL_NAME = ds.SCHOOL_NAME AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN cte2_top1 t2 ON t1.SCHOOL_NAME = t2.SCHOOL_NAME AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.avg_total_units DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ict.SCHOOL_NAME, ict.avg_total_units, ict.var_total_units, ict.stddev_total_units, ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) ict LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON ict.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_stats.SCHOOL_NAME AND ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ict.avg_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, not the Political Science or Chemistry department, and has offered more than five subjects in the School of Engineering, what is the department name, the average, minimum, and maximum total units for subjects offered by that department (from School of Engineering), the average units category (whether the average total units is above 10, below 6, or otherwise), the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the number of graduate students in that department? List the columns in the following order: department name, average total units (from School of Engineering), minimum total units, maximum total units, average units category, average total units (from all subjects with more than 0 units), standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and number of graduate students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.avg_total_units, subq1.min_total_units, subq1.max_total_units, subq1.avg_units_category, subq2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_subq2, subq2.stddev_total_units, subq2.num_grad_students FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE

sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: Show the subject titles, department names, term descriptions, the total number of letter graded Mathematics subjects offered in the academic year 2022, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by each degree-granting Mathematics department in the term 2019FA, and the subject code and subject code description for those subjects, for subjects where the department code and department name match in both sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, Total_Subjects.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Subjects ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, tso.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_num_enrolled_students, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.Total_Subjects, s1.window_column, s2.variance_num_enrolled_students, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, Total_Subjects.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Subjects ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and school, provide the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one associated course material and are offered by the Biology department (Course 7), the total number of such subjects offered that year, the school name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per academic term in that year for the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte1.num_subjects, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.units_range, cte2.units_variance, cte2.units_stddev FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry except for Chemistry and Biology), provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, the difference between this average and the average total units for subjects offered by the same department in the 2021 academic year, the total number of enrolled students in subjects during terms in the academic year 2021 or later, and the number of unique subjects offered by the department in that period, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50. Restrict the results to the Chemistry and Biology departments, and present the columns in the following order: department name, average total units for 2022, variance of total units for 2022, difference from 2021 average, total enrolled students, and number of unique subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2022, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022, inner_cte.var_total_units_2022, (inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022 - prev.avg_total_units_2021) AS avg_diff_from_2021 FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2021 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) prev ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = prev.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2021 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ic.total_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2021 GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ic.total_enrolled_students ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units_2022, s1.var_total_units_2022, s1.avg_diff_from_2021, s2.total_enrolled_students, s2.num_unique_subjects FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptGeoMeanEnroll AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units ) SELECT r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.total_units, d.geometric_mean_total_units, d.avg_enrolled_students FROM RollupResults r LEFT JOIN DeptGeoMeanEnroll d ON r.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, question: For each department that is degree granting, has a department budget code greater than 100000, is not the Mathematics department, and is not the Physics department, and that also offers more than five subjects or is the Mathematics department, list the department name, the corresponding SIS admin department name, the department budget code, the total clearing cost collector, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the school name, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, inner_cte1.total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte1 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, cte1.total_clearing_cost_collector, cte2.stddev_total_units, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: Show, for all departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, and are not the Mathematics or Physics departments, the department name, their corresponding SIS admin department name, the department budget code, and the total clearing cost collector. sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, inner_cte.total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DeptSchoolRollup AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, subject_count FROM DeptSchoolRollup ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, s1.total_clearing_cost_collector, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS subject_count, 'DegreeGrantingDept' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, NULL AS total_clearing_cost_collector, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.subject_count, 'MathSubjects2024' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, total_clearing_cost_collector, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, subject_count, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each subject code in the Political Science department, what is the subject code, subject code description, the geometric mean of the number of students in each degree-granting department associated with that subject code, and the total number of students across all such departments for each subject code? For each subject code, also include a grand total row with null for the subject code and description, and the total number of students. Additionally, for each department and school, provide the department name, school name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting (excluding departments named 'Mathematics' or with department code '18'), and include the department phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. Present all these columns in the following order: subject code, subject code description, geometric mean of students, total number of students, department name, school name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, and department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.geometric_mean_students, s1.total_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE AND sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), along with the academic year description, the department phone number, and the school name, and also provide the highest average number of enrolled students per department (excluding Chemistry and considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with at least one enrolled student) among departments in the same school as the Mathematics department? List the results ordered by the variance of maximum enrollment in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.max_enrollment_variance, ic.max_enrollment_stddev, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_enrolled) AS highest_avg_enrolled_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.max_enrollment_variance, s1.max_enrollment_stddev, s1.department_phone, s1.school_name, s2.highest_avg_enrolled_per_dept FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.school_name = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.max_enrollment_variance DESC

sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_enrolled) AS highest_avg_enrolled_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the master subject ID (not repeated if the same as the previous row), subject title from the library subject offered table, offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group, the responsible faculty name from the library subject offered table, the school name from the SIS subject code table (joined via course number), and for each school, the department name and the variance of the CIP program code for all degree-granting courses with non-null department name in the Mathematics department, as well as the grand total variance across all such courses (with department name null). Order the results by master subject ID, subject title, and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE) = MASTER_SUBJECT_ID THEN NULL ELSE MASTER_SUBJECT_ID END AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), rollup_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, subq1.TIP_TERM_CODE, subq1.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.cip_code_variance FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON subq1.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN subq2 ON ssc.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each degree-granting department except the Physics department and Biology (Course 7), what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, the subject title for that subject, the name of the responsible faculty member for that subject, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, the average total units for that department as a benchmark, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such departments, and the variability category (classified as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise), considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = icte.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_total_units, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.coefficient_of_variation, s2.avg_total_units, s2.benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, s2.variability_category FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME;
