List the subject titles, their corresponding department names, and the variance of the record count for tip details associated with each subject, considering only subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, with a total number of units greater than 0, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.record_count_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each of the top 10 degree-granting departments with the highest number of graduate students, where the department is not Mathematics and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, display the department's name, total graduate student count, the school it belongs to, the most common course description among its graduate students, the count of students in that course, the maximum CIP program code among its courses, the department's full name, and the phone number of its corresponding administrative department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_graduate_students, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, cdc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS Most_Common_Course, cdc.Student_Count, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_graduate_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS Student_Count, @rank := IF(@current_dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, @current_dept := sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_dept := '') vars WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, Student_Count DESC ) cdc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cdc.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_graduate_students DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_graduate_students, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.Most_Common_Course, s1.Student_Count, s2.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, what is the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and what is the full department name, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

From the top 10 departments with the highest number of graduate students in degree-granting departments, display each department's name, total graduate student count, the school it belongs to, the most common course description among its graduate students, and the count of students in that course.

For each degree-granting department that is not the Mathematics department (Course 18) and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, what is the department's full name and the phone number of its corresponding administrative department?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_graduate_students, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, cdc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS Most_Common_Course, cdc.Student_Count FROM ( SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_graduate_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS Student_Count, @rank := IF(@current_dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, @current_dept := sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_dept := '') vars WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, Student_Count DESC ) cdc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cdc.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_graduate_students DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers is greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all departments, and specifically for the Mathematics department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code between 90000 and 200000, and where the number of enrolled students in its subjects is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the department code, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, and for each course in that department, the course number and course description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH coefficient_variation_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), filtered_cv_departments AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM coefficient_variation_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM coefficient_variation_cte) ), math_dept_courses AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT fcvd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fcvd.coefficient_of_variation, mdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mdc.min_num_enrolled_students, mdc.avg_dept_budget_code, scd.COURSE AS COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM filtered_cv_departments fcvd JOIN math_dept_courses mdc ON fcvd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON mdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers, considering only the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, give the department code, department name, and the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are degree-granting and specifically for the Mathematics department?

For each department, what is the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers, but only include departments where this coefficient of variation is greater than the average coefficient of variation across all departments?

For each department, show the department code, department name, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, and for each course in that department, show the course number and course description, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are degree-granting and specifically for the Mathematics department.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte);

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, scd.COURSE AS COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT

question: For each school, list the school name, the total number of unique courses offered by departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, are not the Biology department (Course 7), and where the total number of courses offered by the department is greater than the average number of courses offered per department; the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school (excluding the Political Science department); and the average number of subject codes per department in that school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ), school_total_courses AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 WHERE total_courses > ( SELECT AVG(dept_course_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE) AS dept_course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) sub ) GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ), school_budget_subject_stats AS ( SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, AVG(dept_subject_counts.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM inner_cte2 i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_subject_counts ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_subject_counts.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT stc.SCHOOL_NAME, stc.total_courses, sbs.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, sbs.avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM school_total_courses stc JOIN school_budget_subject_stats sbs ON stc.SCHOOL_NAME = sbs.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stc.SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each school, give the school name and calculate the total number of courses offered by departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, and are not the Biology department (Course 7).
For each school, what is the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17)?

For each school, list the school name and the total number of unique courses offered by departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, are not the Biology department (Course 7), and where the total number of courses offered by the department is greater than the average number of courses offered per department.

For each school, what is the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school (excluding the Political Science department), and what is the average number of subject codes per department in that school?
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE total_courses > ( SELECT AVG(dept_course_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE) AS dept_course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) sub ) GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, AVG(dept_subject_counts.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_subject_counts ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_subject_counts.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, provide the number of unique subject titles, the minimum total units, the average total units for that department and subject code this year, indicate whether the minimum total units is above, below, or equal to the average total units, and also include the highest number of total units among subjects offered by that degree-granting department in 2022. List the results in order by subject code and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1_inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq1_avg_units_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.num_unique_subject_titles, i.min_total_units, a.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.min_total_units < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'EQUAL_TO_AVERAGE' END AS min_units_category FROM subq1_inner_cte i JOIN subq1_avg_units_cte a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2_inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM subq2_inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_unique_subject_titles, s1.min_total_units, s1.avg_total_units, s1.min_units_category, s2.highest_total_units FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, give the number of unique subject titles and the minimum total units.
How many subjects offered in 2022 by departments that are degree-granting and are in the Mathematics department had more than 6 total units?

For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, provide the number of unique subject titles, the minimum total units, and indicate whether the minimum total units is above, below, or equal to the average total units for that department and subject code this year.
For each degree-granting department in the Mathematics department, what is the highest number of total units among subjects they offered in 2022?
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 6;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_units_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.num_unique_subject_titles, i.min_total_units, a.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.min_total_units < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'EQUAL_TO_AVERAGE' END AS min_units_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_cte a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department (excluding Chemistry) that is degree-granting and has at least one course with total units greater than 0, and for each subject offered in 2019 by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science in the School of Engineering, show the department name, the average and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department, the number of unique subject codes associated with the department, the subject ID, the subject title, the number of enrolled graduate students in the subject whose department is degree-granting, and the total number of enrolled students in the subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), eecs_subjects_2019 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.num_enrolled_grad_students, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' LIMIT 1 ) ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, dus.num_unique_subject_codes, es19.SUBJECT_ID, es19.SUBJECT_TITLE, es19.num_enrolled_grad_students, es19.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN eecs_subjects_2019 es19 ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = es19.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es19.SUBJECT_ID;

sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each subject offered in the School of Engineering in 2019 by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, provide the subject ID, subject title, the department name, and the number of enrolled students who are in their graduate year and whose department is degree-granting.

For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Chemistry department), and also include the number of unique subject codes associated with each department.

For each subject offered in the School of Engineering in 2019 by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, provide the subject ID, subject title, the department name, the number of enrolled graduate students whose department is degree-granting, and the total number of enrolled students in the subject.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_enrolled_grad_students, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' LIMIT 1 );

question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students in the Mathematics department (Course 18) whose total units in a given academic year are greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in that academic year, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject code, the responsible faculty name, the academic year description, the total units, and the units per enrolled student (rounded, calculated as total units divided by number of enrolled students), ordered by academic year description and subject code.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROUND(s2.TOTAL_UNITS / NULLIF(s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0), 2) AS Units_Per_Enrolled_Student FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics and Political Science) with a non-null department full name, show the department name, the average CIP program code for its courses, the range and variance of CIP program codes, classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% higher than the average variance across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise, and also show the number of graduate students and the number of unique graduate-level courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_cip_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(var_cip_program_code) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_cip_program_code, i.range_cip_program_code, i.var_cip_program_code, CASE WHEN i.var_cip_program_code > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.var_cip_program_code < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark v ), grad_dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS graduate_student_count, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.graduate_student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS num_graduate_courses, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.graduate_student_count, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code, dcs.variance_category, gds.graduate_student_count, gds.num_graduate_courses FROM dept_cip_stats dcs JOIN grad_dept_stats gds ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = gds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(var_cip_program_code) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_cip_program_code, i.range_cip_program_code, i.var_cip_program_code, CASE WHEN i.var_cip_program_code > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.var_cip_program_code < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark v;

question: For each degree-granting department that is Mathematics (Course 18) and has at least one term (not the current term) in which the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the department is greater than 10, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per subject in that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the number of unique courses, the school name, and the highest total number of enrolled students in any such term. List the columns in the following order: department name, total units range, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), number of unique courses, school name, and highest term enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), HighestEnrollment AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled) AS highest_term_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DegreeDeptStats AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_units_range, de.total_units_variance, de.total_units_stddev, de.num_unique_courses, de.SCHOOL_NAME, he.highest_term_enrollment FROM DegreeDeptStats de JOIN HighestEnrollment he ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = he.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units offered per subject in that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and departments that grant degrees, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18).

sub_sqls: SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled) AS highest_term_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and specifically for the Mathematics department, where the number of enrolled students in any subject offered is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, show the department code, department name, the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered, and for each subject title in that department offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department with a total number of units greater than 0 and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department, show the subject title, the subject's department name, and the variance of the record count for tip details associated with each subject. The results are ordered by the variance of the record count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.record_count_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.highest_num_enrolled_students, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.record_count_variance FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq2.record_count_variance DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.record_count_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department whose name is 'Mathematics', what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subject codes offered by that department, the average subject code count per department, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects (only including results where the average number of enrolled students is greater than 10)? Please provide the department name, the variance, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the average subject code count per department, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the average number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev, AVG(inner_cte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation HAVING AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.subject_code_count_variance, s1.subject_code_count_stddev, s1.avg_subject_code_count, s2.coefficient_of_variation, s2.avg_enrolled_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.subject_code_count_variance DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev, AVG(inner_cte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation HAVING AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) but not in the Department of Physics, show the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials (considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department), the average subject enrollment number for those subjects, the subject ID, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the total number of lecture units, and the name of the responsible faculty member. Results are included only where the average total units for the department is greater than zero, and are ordered by the number of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON i.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.coefficient_of_variation, s1.avg_subject_enrollment, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.LECTURE_UNITS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) in the academic year 2022 that is printed in the bulletin, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees), the school name, the department phone number, the subject title, the total units for the subject, and the difference between the total units of the subject and the average total units for Mathematics subjects in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subquery1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), avg_units AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 ), subquery2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_units, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 i CROSS JOIN avg_units a ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.enrolled_students_range, s1.enrolled_students_variance, s1.enrolled_students_stddev, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.deviation_from_avg_units FROM subquery1 s1 JOIN subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_units AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_units FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_units a;

question: For each department named "Political Science" (Course 17), show the school name, department name, subject code, subject code description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per department within each school, the number of letter-graded subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and the subject with the highest total units (including its subject number and total units), considering only departments that are degree-granting and not Biology (Course 7). sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS dept_subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) stats ON d.SCHOOL_CODE = stats.SCHOOL_CODE AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND d.SCHOOL_CODE = sc.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(inner_cte.dept_subject_count) - MIN(inner_cte.dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_letter_graded_subjects, ic2.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS subject_with_max_units, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, TOTAL_UNITS FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC, SUBJECT_NUMBER ASC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.subject_count_range, s1.subject_count_variance, s1.subject_count_stddev, s2.num_letter_graded_subjects, s2.subject_with_max_units, s2.max_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.range_total_units, cte2.var_total_units, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE;

sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_enrolled_grad_students, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' LIMIT 1 ) ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_enrolled_grad_students, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.var_enrolled_students, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID;
