Also, for each department, indicate whether the average total units is above 10 ('ABOVE_AVERAGE'), below 6 ('BELOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'.

For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry and only including degree-granting departments), provide the department name and the average number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department, but only include departments where this average is greater than the overall average number of enrolled students per subject in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry and only including degree-granting departments).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (inner_cte.total_enrolled * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count) AS avg_enrolled_per_subject FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.total_enrolled * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count) > ( SELECT SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) * 1.0 / COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' );

question: For each degree-granting department with a department budget code above 100000, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), list the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, and the subject code of the course with the highest number of total units in that department along with that course's total units. Also, for each such department, provide the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in its degree-granting courses with more than zero enrolled students, and indicate whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (average enrollment at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE'. The columns should be: department code, department name, school name, number of unique courses, total units, subject code with highest total units, that course's total units, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH degree_dept_courses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE AS max_units_subject_code, c.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_subject_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c1.SUBJECT_CODE, c1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c1.TOTAL_UNITS = c2.max_units ) c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs ) overall ) SELECT ddc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ddc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ddc.SCHOOL_NAME, ddc.num_unique_courses, ddc.total_units, ddc.max_units_subject_code, ddc.max_subject_total_units, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, des.enrollment_category FROM degree_dept_courses ddc JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON ddc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ddc.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code above 100000, and is not the Political Science department, give the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, and the total number of units for all those courses, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17).

For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are degree-granting, have more than zero enrolled students, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each degree-granting department with a department budget code above 100000, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), list the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, and the subject code of the course with the highest number of total units in that department, along with that course's total units.

For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in degree-granting courses with more than zero enrolled students, and indicate whether the department is a 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' department (average enrollment at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE'.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE AS max_units_subject_code, c.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_subject_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c1.SUBJECT_CODE, c1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c1.TOTAL_UNITS = c2.max_units ) c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Biology, Course 7) with the highest average total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, list each department's name, its average and variance of total units, the subject with the highest total units in that department for 2022, and the total units of that subject. Additionally, for each row, include the number of subject codes for the Mathematics department, the average subject code count across all degree-granting departments, and the deviation of Mathematics from this average, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), mathematics_stats AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count AS mathematics_subject_code_count, AVG(i.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, (m.subj_count - AVG(i.subj_count)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN inner_cte1 m ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), top_subjects AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.avg_total_units, ic2.var_total_units, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ts.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units, ms.mathematics_subject_code_count, ms.avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, ms.deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte2 ic2 LEFT JOIN top_subjects ts ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ts.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ts.rn = 1 CROSS JOIN mathematics_stats ms ORDER BY ic2.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of subject codes offered by that department, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation of subject code counts per department.

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each degree-granting department, what is the average number of subject codes offered, and how does the number of subject codes offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) deviate from this average? Please provide the department name, the number of subject codes for Mathematics, the average subject code count across all degree-granting departments, and the deviation of Mathematics from this average.

From the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Biology, Course 7) with the highest average total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, display each department's name, its average and variance of total units, the subject with the highest total units in that department for 2022, and the total units of that subject.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count AS mathematics_subject_code_count, AVG(i.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, (m.subj_count - AVG(i.subj_count)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN inner_cte m ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and, for each school, the number of such subjects offered in that school (only including schools where at least 2 such subjects are offered), and also show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with a non-null total units value and only for degree-granting departments), and only include results where the department name and school name match in both sets of criteria. List the columns in the following order: subject code, subject title, department name, school name, subject count, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.subject_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) sc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sc.SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s2.variance_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code.

For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with a non-null total units value and departments that grant degrees, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and, for each school, the number of such subjects offered in that school. Only include schools where at least 2 such subjects are offered.

For each department that grants degrees, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with a non-null total units value, and also show the school name for each department?
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.subject_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) sc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and is not Chemistry (Course 5) or Biology (Course 7), provide the department name, the average total units for subjects offered by that department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units as a benchmark, the variability category of the department (classified as 'CONSISTENT' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is less than or equal to 10% of the average, 'VARIABLE' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than or equal to 30% of the average, or 'MODERATE' otherwise), the average number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, the variance of the number of enrolled students, and the name of the school to which the department belongs. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units_variability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) <= 0.1 * NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) THEN 'CONSISTENT' WHEN STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) >= 0.3 * NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) THEN 'VARIABLE' ELSE 'MODERATE' END AS variability_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.avg_total_units, duv.stddev_total_units, duv.variability_category, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, des.SCHOOL_NAME FROM dept_units_variability duv JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, provide the department name, the average total units for subjects offered by that department, the standard deviation of total units as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'CONSISTENT' if the standard deviation is less than or equal to 10% of the average, 'VARIABLE' if the standard deviation is greater than or equal to 30% of the average, or 'MODERATE' otherwise. Only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and the name of the school to which the department belongs.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) <= 0.1 * NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) THEN 'CONSISTENT' WHEN STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) >= 0.3 * NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) THEN 'VARIABLE' ELSE 'MODERATE' END AS variability_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year in which the maximum total units offered per academic term in the Mathematics department (Course 18) was greater than the average maximum total units per term across all academic years, provide the academic year description, its maximum total units per term, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all Mathematics subjects offered in terms marked as current in the term parameter table, and the total number of such Mathematics subjects per academic year. List the academic year description, maximum total units per term, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and total number of Mathematics subjects, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ), year_max_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) AS max_units_per_term FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, max_units_per_term FROM year_max_units WHERE max_units_per_term > (SELECT AVG(max_units_per_term) FROM year_max_units) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), subj_count AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, subj_count.total_subjects FROM inner_cte2 JOIN subj_count ON inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subj_count.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.max_units_per_term, s2.coefficient_of_variation, s2.total_subjects FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department in the 2022 academic year except the Biology department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects, the school name, the department phone number, and for each school, the subject code and the total number of subject codes for the Mathematics department (including a grand total per school in the format of school name, null, total subject codes). sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.avg_total_units, inner_cte1.range_total_units, inner_cte1.var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), SubjectCodeCounts AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUM(subject_code_count) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeCounts GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_code_count) > 0 ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, rr.total_subject_codes FROM DepartmentStats ds LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN RollupResults rr ON ds.SCHOOL_NAME = rr.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each subject offered in the Mathematics department (Course 18) with more than 0 enrolled students, in departments that grant degrees, and where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average for that department, list the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, school name, the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code, the subject code, subject code description, the running sum of department budget codes within each school (ordered by department code), and whether the department's budget code is above average, below average, or average compared to other Mathematics departments in the same school. sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ), filtered_subjects AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), avg_budget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE ), budget_info AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.running_sum_dept_budget_code, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > a.avg_budget_code THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < a.avg_budget_code THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN avg_budget a ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = a.SCHOOL_CODE ) SELECT f.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.SUBJECT_TITLE, f.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, f.SCHOOL_NAME, f.window_column, b.SUBJECT_CODE, b.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, b.running_sum_dept_budget_code, b.budget_category FROM filtered_subjects f JOIN budget_info b ON f.DEPARTMENT_CODE = b.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY f.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, b.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the subject code and subject title of the Mathematics subject with the highest total units offered in the fall term for that year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) in years with more than five activities, and the corresponding department phone number and school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH math_fall_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) ccso ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ccso.rn = 1 ), math_iap_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.stddev_max_enrollment, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfs.total_units_variance, mfs.total_units_stddev, mfs.SUBJECT_CODE, mfs.SUBJECT_TITLE, mies.stddev_max_enrollment, mies.department_phone, mies.school_name FROM math_fall_stats mfs LEFT JOIN math_iap_enrollment_stats mies ON mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mies.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

For each academic year, what is the standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only years with more than five activities, and what is the corresponding academic year description, along with the department phone number and the school name?
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) ccso ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ccso.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.stddev_max_enrollment, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each result, include the school name, the department phone number, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department), and the number of graduate students in that department. Sort the results by variance in descending order and then by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1_enriched AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.total_units_variance, inner_cte1.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2_enriched AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 OR ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ) SELECT cte1_enriched.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1_enriched.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1_enriched.total_units_variance, cte1_enriched.total_units_stddev, cte1_enriched.school_name, cte1_enriched.department_phone, cte2_enriched.avg_total_units, cte2_enriched.var_total_units, cte2_enriched.stddev_total_units, cte2_enriched.num_grad_students FROM cte1_enriched JOIN cte2_enriched ON cte1_enriched.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2_enriched.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1_enriched.total_units_variance DESC, cte1_enriched.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics) where the maximum CIP program code among its courses is greater than 120000, what is the department name, the maximum CIP program code, the full department name, the department's phone number, and the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH hass_elective_counts AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), max_cip_program AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT mcp.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcp.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, mcp.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, hec.num_hass_elective_subjects FROM max_cip_program mcp LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON mcp.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN hass_elective_counts hec ON mcp.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hec.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE mcp.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 ORDER BY mcp.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Physics department) that also has subjects in the Mathematics department with a non-null subject code description, what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, the subject title for that subject, the name of the school the department belongs to, the subject title in Mathematics, the total units for that Mathematics subject, the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code, the subject code, and the subject code description for each Mathematics subject? sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = icte.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_total_units, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_units_subject_title, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS math_subject_title, s2.TOTAL_UNITS AS math_total_units, s2.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology and Political Science) that has at least one subject code associated with it, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, the school name, the department phone number, the average department budget code, the maximum range of department budget codes, and the average variance of department budget codes? List the results in order by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS range_dept_budget_code, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS var_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_dept_budget_code) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(ic.range_dept_budget_code) AS max_range_dept_budget_code, AVG(ic.var_dept_budget_code) AS avg_var_dept_budget_code, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_num_students, s1.stddev_num_students, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.max_range_dept_budget_code, s2.avg_var_dept_budget_code FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and both the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year for that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department?

For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the department budget codes for departments in that school, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the 'Political Science' department.

For each department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year for that department, the school name, and the department phone number, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department?

For each school, provide the school name and the average, range, and variance of the department budget codes for departments in that school that are degree-granting and have at least one subject code associated with them, excluding the 'Political Science' department.
sub_sqls: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS range_dept_budget_code, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS var_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS range_dept_budget_code, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS var_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_dept_budget_code) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(ic.range_dept_budget_code) AS max_range_dept_budget_code, AVG(ic.var_dept_budget_code) AS avg_var_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each school among the top 10 by total number of unique courses (excluding Political Science and only including schools with a non-null name), list the school name, the number of unique degree-granting departments, and the total number of unique courses offered by those departments. For each department in these schools (excluding Mathematics and Chemistry, and only considering degree-granting subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), also provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the department's school name, and the department code. Sort the results by the total number of courses in descending order by school, and within each school by variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH school_department_courses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10 ), department_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT sdc.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_departments, sdc.total_courses, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.SCHOOL_NAME AS department_school_name, dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM school_department_courses sdc JOIN department_units_stats dus ON sdc.SCHOOL_NAME = dus.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sdc.total_courses DESC, dus.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of unique courses they offer, including the department name, school name, and the total number of courses, but only for departments that are degree granting, belong to a school with a non-null name, and are not the Political Science department (Course 17).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting, but exclude the departments of Mathematics and Chemistry.

For each school, list the school name, the number of unique degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), and the total number of unique courses offered by those departments. Only include schools with a non-null name. Sort the results by the total number of courses in descending order, and show the top 10 schools.

For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the corresponding school name and department code, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting, but exclude the departments of Mathematics and Chemistry. Sort the results by variance of total units in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology) that is also an administrative department named 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2) in the School of Engineering with total enrolled students in its subjects greater than 100 and above the average for all administrative departments in the School of Engineering, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year, the total number of unique courses offered by that department, the administrative department name, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department? List the results in order by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = '2' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte2 WHERE total_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_table ) ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_num_students, s1.stddev_num_students, s1.total_courses, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.total_enrolled FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN subq2 s2 ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and both the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year for that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department?

For each administrative department, give the administrative department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to administrative departments whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2).

For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology), what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year, and the total number of unique courses offered by that department?

For each administrative department, give the administrative department name and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to administrative departments whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2). Additionally, only include results where the total number of enrolled students is greater than the average total number of enrolled students across all administrative departments in the School of Engineering.
sub_sqls: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = '2' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = '2' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte WHERE total_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_table );

question: For each school, display the school's name, the maximum and minimum variance of CIP program codes among its degree-granting departments (excluding Biology), and for each of its degree-granting departments with a department budget code greater than 100000 (excluding Mathematics and Physics), provide the department name and the total clearing cost collector. List the results by school name and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(cip_code_variance) AS max_cip_code_variance, MIN(cip_code_variance) AS min_cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_clearing_cost_collector, ic.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic ) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.max_cip_code_variance, s1.min_cip_code_variance, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.total_clearing_cost_collector FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department's full name and calculate the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses, considering only departments that grant degrees and courses that are degree-granting, but exclude the Biology department (Course 7) from the results.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total clearing cost collector for departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, are not the Mathematics department, and are not the Physics department.

For each school, provide the school's full name and, among its degree-granting departments (excluding the Biology department), report the maximum and minimum variance of CIP program codes among their degree-granting courses.

For each degree-granting department with a department budget code greater than 100000, excluding the Mathematics and Physics departments, provide the department name, the total clearing cost collector, and the department's school name.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(cip_code_variance) AS max_cip_code_variance, MIN(cip_code_variance) AS min_cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_clearing_cost_collector, ic.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18) in the 2008 academic year, what is the department's full name, the range and variance of the total units for its degree-granting courses, the long course description for each course, the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in the department and school, and the number of unique subject codes associated with those courses? List the department's full name, total units range, total units variance, long course description, number of courses, and number of unique subject codes, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = 18 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.SCHOOL_NAME = i.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = c.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_courses ORDER BY i.num_courses DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, s2.num_courses, s2.num_subject_codes FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME;
