sub_questions: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, that are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Course 6), show the subject ID, subject title, department name, department full name, and the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), but only include subjects from degree-granting courses.

For students whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6), and whose first name is 'Kevin', show their full name, email address, student year, the department's full name, the course description, the course level, and the minimum course level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's last name.

For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, that are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Course 6), show the subject ID, subject title, department name, department full name, the course description, and the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), but only include subjects from degree-granting courses.

From the set of students whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6) and whose first name is 'Kevin', show for each student their full name, email address, student year, the department's full name, the course description, the course level, and, for each course, the number of other students in the same department and year who are enrolled in courses at the same level, ordered by the student's last name.
sub_sqls: SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID;

SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, ic.subject_rank_in_department FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6' ) SELECT icte.FULL_NAME, icte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.window_column, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = icte.STUDENT_YEAR AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = icte.COURSE_LEVEL ) AS num_students_same_level FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.FULL_NAME;

question: For each student year and department, provide the student year, department name, the average, range, and variance of department budget codes for students in that year and department (including subtotals for each student year and a grand total across all years), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0), and the highest average total units among all departments. Only include students whose department code matches both an academic department and an administrative department, and who are in a degree-granting department. Do not repeat the student year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by student year and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH student_dept_budget_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(student_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, student_year, dept_sort) = student_year THEN NULL ELSE student_year END AS student_year, department_name, avg_budget, budget_range, budget_variance, department_code FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS student_year, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance, MAX(DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort ), dept_subject_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT *, MAX(avg_total_units) OVER () AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT sdbs.student_year, sdbs.department_name, sdbs.avg_budget, sdbs.budget_range, sdbs.budget_variance, dsu.avg_total_units, dsu.total_units_range, dsu.total_units_variance, dsu.highest_avg_total_units FROM student_dept_budget_stats sdbs LEFT JOIN dept_subject_units_stats dsu ON sdbs.department_name = dsu.department_name AND sdbs.department_code = dsu.department_code ORDER BY sdbs.student_year, sdbs.department_name
sub_questions: For each student year, give the student year and calculate the average, range, and variance of department budget codes for students in that year, considering only students whose department code matches both an academic department and an administrative department, and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each student year and department, provide the student year, department name, the average, range, and variance of department budget codes for students in that year and department, considering only students whose department code matches both an academic department and an administrative department, and who are in a degree-granting department. Include subtotals for each student year (the corresponding student year field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all years (the corresponding student year field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the student year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by student year and department name.

For each department, what is the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, and what is the highest average total units among all departments?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY budget_range DESC;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(student_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, student_year, dept_sort) = student_year THEN NULL ELSE student_year END AS student_year, department_name, avg_budget, budget_range, budget_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS student_year, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT *, MAX(avg_total_units) OVER () AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by degree-granting departments in that school in the 2022 academic year (excluding any subjects from the Biology department), and for each subject offered in both the library and TIP systems in 2019 where the maximum number of enrolled students in the library is greater than 5 and the department name from TIP is 'Chemistry', also provide the subject's master subject ID, the maximum number of enrolled students in the library, the subject title from the library, the department name from TIP, and the school name from the library, for cases where the school name matches between the two datasets. List the columns in the following order: school name, average units, units variance, master subject ID, maximum number of enrolled students in the library, library subject title, TIP department name, and library school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SchoolUnitsStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ), ChemistryLibrarySubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS library_subject_title, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS tip_department_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING max_num_enrolled_students > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, inner_cte.max_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.library_subject_title, inner_cte.tip_department_name, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS library_school_name FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT AND lso.SUBJECT_TITLE = inner_cte.library_subject_title ORDER BY inner_cte.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT ) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.avg_units, s.units_variance, c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, c.max_num_enrolled_students, c.library_subject_title, c.tip_department_name, c.library_school_name FROM SchoolUnitsStats s JOIN ChemistryLibrarySubjects c ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = c.library_school_name ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS library_subject_title, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS tip_department_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING max_num_enrolled_students > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, inner_cte.max_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.library_subject_title, inner_cte.tip_department_name, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS library_school_name FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT AND lso.SUBJECT_TITLE = inner_cte.library_subject_title ORDER BY inner_cte.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT;

question: For each department (excluding Mathematics and Chemistry), what is the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting), the corresponding school name and department code, and for each matching school, what is the school name, department name, average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school in the 2022 academic year (only including schools where all departments grant degrees and excluding any school that contains the Biology department), as well as the total number of subjects for each school and department combination (including grand totals for all subjects in each school)? Present the results with the department name, department average total units, department variance of total units, department's school name, department code, school name, school department name, school average total units, school variance of total units, and total subjects, in that order, sorted by the department variance of total units in descending order, then by school name and school department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ), school_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ), SchoolStats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), SchoolRollup AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, total_subjects FROM SchoolStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, total_subjects WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ) SELECT sr.SCHOOL_NAME, sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sr.avg_total_units, sr.var_total_units, sr.total_subjects FROM SchoolRollup sr ORDER BY sr.SCHOOL_NAME, sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.SCHOOL_NAME AS department_school_name, ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS school_department_name, ss.avg_total_units AS school_avg_total_units, ss.var_total_units AS school_var_total_units, ss.total_subjects FROM dept_stats ds LEFT JOIN school_stats ss ON ds.SCHOOL_NAME = ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ds.total_units_variance DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) , SchoolStats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , SchoolRollup AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, total_subjects FROM SchoolStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, total_subjects WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ) SELECT sr.SCHOOL_NAME, sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sr.avg_total_units, sr.var_total_units, sr.total_subjects FROM SchoolRollup sr ORDER BY sr.SCHOOL_NAME, sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management) where the total number of students enrolled in its courses is greater than 50, provide the department name, the total number of students enrolled in its courses, the average enrollment across all Engineering departments that grant degrees (excluding Management), and classify each department as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its total enrollment is at least 10% higher than the average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Also, for each such department, provide the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students and departments that grant degrees), the average variance across all such departments, and whether the department is a 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such departments), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Present the results with the columns: department name, total enrollment, average enrollment, enrollment category, variance of number of enrolled students, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of number of enrolled students, average variance, and variance category, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enroll FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(variance_num_enrolled_students) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.total_enrollment, a.avg_enroll, CASE WHEN i1.total_enrollment > a.avg_enroll * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i1.total_enrollment < a.avg_enroll * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, i2.variance_num_enrolled_students, i2.stddev_num_enrolled_students, vb.avg_variance, CASE WHEN i2.variance_num_enrolled_students > vb.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i2.variance_num_enrolled_students < vb.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte1 i1 JOIN avg_enrollment a ON 1=1 JOIN inner_cte2 i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN variance_benchmark vb ON 1=1 ORDER BY i1.total_enrollment DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enroll FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment, a.avg_enroll, CASE WHEN i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enroll * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrollment < a.avg_enroll * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(variance_num_enrolled_students) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.variance_num_enrolled_students, i.stddev_num_enrolled_students, v.avg_variance, CASE WHEN i.variance_num_enrolled_students > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.variance_num_enrolled_students < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark v;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics, provide the department name, academic year, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of students in that department, and the total number of students with a non-null office phone number. Additionally, for each academic year, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, academic year, total unique subjects, minimum total units, average office phone, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of office phone, student count). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), rollup_cte1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_unique_subjects) AS total_unique_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_unique_subjects) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r1.total_unique_subjects, r1.min_total_units, ic2.avg_office_phone, ic2.stddev_office_phone, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count FROM rollup_cte1 r1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL OR (r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND r1.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r1.total_unique_subjects, r1.min_total_units, ic2.avg_office_phone, ic2.stddev_office_phone ORDER BY r1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) , rollup_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_unique_subjects) AS total_unique_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_unique_subjects) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_unique_subjects, min_total_units FROM rollup_cte WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL OR (DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department where the total number of units for all subjects in the course catalog that are offered in the fall term and are part of a degree-granting program is greater than the average total units for all departments, and where the average number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department is greater than the overall average for all degree-granting departments, list the department name, the total number of units, the average enrollment, the enrollment variance, the enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and calculate the ratio of total units to average enrollment rounded to two decimal places, ordering the results by this ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH DeptTotalUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units > (SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM inner_cte) ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtu.total_units, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev, ROUND(dtu.total_units / NULLIF(des.avg_enrollment, 0), 2) AS Units_per_Avg_Enrollment FROM DeptTotalUnits dtu JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Units_per_Avg_Enrollment DESC;

question: For each department that is the Mathematics department (Course 18) and whose average total units for subjects offered is greater than the overall average total units across all departments (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), provide the department's name, the range and variance of the number of students in each subject code offered by that department (considering only subject codes that belong to a school with a non-null name), the department's school name, whether the department is degree granting, the average total units for subjects offered by that department, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for those subjects. List the results in order of the range of the number of students in each subject code in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count_range, inner_cte.subject_count_variance, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.subject_count_range, s1.subject_count_variance, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.subject_count_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each academic year and school, provide the academic year, academic year description, school name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the highest total number of lecture units in a single regular term for all Mathematics subjects in that academic year. For each academic year, include a grand total for all schools in the format of (academic year, academic year description, null, total range, total variance, highest term lecture units). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND (SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL OR (SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND COUNT(*) > 0)) ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS term_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(term_lecture_units) AS highest_term_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s2.highest_term_lecture_units FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SCHOOL_NAME

sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) t );

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND (SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL OR (SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND COUNT(*) > 0)) ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS term_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(term_lecture_units) AS highest_term_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each school, list the top 5 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science, Course 17) by the number of subjects they offered in the 2022 academic year, showing the school name, department name, and subject count. Also, for each school, include a grand total of subjects offered by all its degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) in 2022, with the department name as null and the total subject count. For each department in the School of Engineering that appears in this list, also show the highest student office phone number, the full name of the student with that phone number, and the email address of that student, considering only departments that grant degrees, where the highest office phone number is greater than 1000000000, and excluding the Political Science department (Course 17). The columns should be: school name, department name, subject count, highest student office phone number, full name of the student with that phone number, and email address of that student, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EngDeptMaxPhone AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = ic.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ), TopDeptSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT tds.SCHOOL_NAME, tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tds.subject_count, edm.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, edm.FULL_NAME, edm.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM TopDeptSubjects tds LEFT JOIN EngDeptMaxPhone edm ON tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND tds.SCHOOL_NAME = edm.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY tds.SCHOOL_NAME, tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: WITH MaxPhones AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mp.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME FROM MaxPhones mp JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = mp.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = ic.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department) where the average number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department is greater than the overall average number of enrolled students across all subjects, provide the department name, the total units for each degree-granting course with non-null total units, the average and variance of the total units for all such courses, the difference between each course's total units and the department's average total units, and also provide the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department. List the results ordered by department name and, within each department, by the difference between each course's total units and the department's average total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, (ic.TOTAL_UNITS - ds.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_enrolled_students > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_total_units, s1.total_units_variance, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.var_enrolled_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.deviation_from_avg DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for all courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a non-null total units value, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for all degree-granting courses with non-null total units, and also show the difference between each course's total units and the department's average total units.

For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and only include those departments where the average number of enrolled students is greater than the overall average number of enrolled students across all subjects.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, (ic.TOTAL_UNITS - ds.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED );

question: For each of the top 10 departments (excluding 'Political Science') with the highest average number of enrolled students in their degree-granting subjects (where each subject has more than 0 enrolled students), display the department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, the subject with the highest enrollment in that department, and the number of students enrolled in that subject. For each such department, also show all subjects offered in the academic year 2024 in the Mathematics department (Course 18) with a total of 12 units whose total units exceed the average total units for their respective school, including the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and the rank within each school name group ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ic1 ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ORDER BY avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10 ), math_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM ( SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.top_subject_title, d.top_subject_enrollment, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.window_column FROM dept_enrollment_stats d JOIN math_subjects m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree-granting, and only include departments that are not 'Political Science' (Course 17)?

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code.

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ic1 ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ORDER BY avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM ( SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units;

question: For the top 5 departments in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry and Biology) with the highest average total units for subjects offered during the Fall 2016 term, provide each department's name, its average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the subject with the highest total units in that department and its total units, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, and the total number of administrative departments linked to each department, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DegreeGrantingDeptAdminStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_admin_departments FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Top5EngDeptsByUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016FA' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, smax.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_units, smax.max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5 ) icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016FA' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') AND (sos.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) IN ( SELECT MAX(sos2.TOTAL_UNITS), scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos2.TERM_CODE = '2016FA' AND sos2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) ) smax ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = smax.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics), show the department name, the department's full name, school name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, and for each student whose employee type is 'Student', who is in department 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' and whose department matches the current department, show their MIT ID, full name, student department name, student year, and whether their MIT ID is above, below, or equal to the average MIT ID for their student year group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ic.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, msd.DEPARTMENT FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), avg_mit_id_per_year AS ( SELECT STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(MIT_ID) AS avg_mit_id FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR ), student_stats AS ( SELECT i.MIT_ID, i.FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.STUDENT_YEAR, CASE WHEN i.MIT_ID > a.avg_mit_id THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.MIT_ID < a.avg_mit_id THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS mit_id_category, i.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN avg_mit_id_per_year a ON i.STUDENT_YEAR = a.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ds.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ds.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, ss.MIT_ID, ss.FULL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS STUDENT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.STUDENT_YEAR, ss.mit_id_category FROM dept_stats ds JOIN student_stats ss ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.STUDENT_YEAR, ss.MIT_ID;

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ic.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) , avg_mit_id_per_year AS ( SELECT STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(MIT_ID) AS avg_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT i.MIT_ID, i.FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.STUDENT_YEAR, CASE WHEN i.MIT_ID > a.avg_mit_id THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.MIT_ID < a.avg_mit_id THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS mit_id_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_mit_id_per_year a ON i.STUDENT_YEAR = a.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.MIT_ID;

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding Political Science, Course 17) that offered subjects in the term 2019FA, display the department code, department name, the number of subjects offered, the administrative department name, the average total units, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units of courses offered by that administrative department (only for courses with total units greater than 0 and excluding Mechanical Engineering), and the total number of such courses per administrative department, ordered by the number of subjects offered (descending) and then by the variance of total units (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_course_counts ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_course_counts.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_subjects, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.Total_Courses FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN subq2 s2 ON s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.num_subjects DESC, s2.total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_course_counts ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_course_counts.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year with more than 5 Mathematics department subjects offered in the fall term, what is the academic year, the academic year description, for each Mathematics fall subject in that year, what is the subject id, subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the deviation of that number from the average number of enrolled students in Mathematics fall subjects for that year, and for the same year, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in terms within that year, and is this standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) at least 20% higher than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years ('HIGH_VARIABILITY'), at least 20% lower ('LOW_VARIABILITY'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'? sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - ic.avg_num_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_avg FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte ic ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_units_stddev > avg_stats.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.total_units_stddev < avg_stats.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_units_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.variability_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_ID ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - ic.avg_num_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_avg FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte ic ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ;

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the minimum CIP program code, the total number of degree-granting courses, the school with the most such courses in that department and the count of those courses, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department, and for each department, the subject with the highest enrollment and its enrollment count? List the department name, minimum CIP program code, total number of degree-granting courses, most prominent school, course count, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), highest enrolled subject, and highest enrollment, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DegreeCourses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS total_degree_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_cip_code, ic.total_degree_courses, sc.SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, sc.Course_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS Course_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME ) sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sc.rn = 1 ), EnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, max_subj.SUBJECT_TITLE AS highest_enrolled_subject, max_subj.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) max_subj ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = max_subj.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_subj.SUBJECT_TITLE, max_subj.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ) SELECT dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.min_cip_code, dc.total_degree_courses, dc.Most_Prominent_School, dc.Course_Count, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev, es.highest_enrolled_subject, es.highest_enrollment FROM DegreeCourses dc LEFT JOIN EnrollmentStats es ON dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
