sub_questions: For each building, what is the building key and what are both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses held in rooms of that building, considering only courses that are offered this year, have more than 0 total units, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 10 and the department is Chemistry, give the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered, but only include subjects that are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology departments.

For each building and department, what is the building key, department name, the number of courses, average total units, the minimum and maximum total units of courses held in rooms of that building, considering only courses that are offered this year and have more than 0 total units? Include subtotals for each building (the corresponding building field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all buildings (the corresponding building field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the building key if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by building and department.

For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 10 and the department is Chemistry, give the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered, but only include results where the minimum total units is greater than the overall minimum total units for all subjects offered by Chemistry or Biology departments.
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, building, dept_sort) = building THEN NULL ELSE building END AS building, dept, course_count, avg_total_units, min_total_units, max_total_units FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS course_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY building_sort, dept_sort;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > ( SELECT MIN(s2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s2 WHERE s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') );

question: For each degree-granting department whose code is '18' (Mathematics) that offered at least 5 subjects in the term 2019FA, and for each subject offered by that department at the graduate level (excluding Biology), where the subject's enrollment is above the departmental average for graduate-level subjects, what is the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, the number of subjects offered, the subject title, and the number of enrolled students? Please provide the department name, variance of number of enrolled students, number of subjects offered, subject title, and number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) >= 5 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_num_enrolled_students, s1.num_subjects_offered, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) >= 5;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics and Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) with a non-null department full name and at least one subject offered in the 2022FA term, show the department name, the average CIP program code for its courses, the range and variance of CIP program codes, and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% higher than the average variance across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Also, for each subject offered by the department in 2022FA, provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject, along with the subject title and total units. Present the columns in the following order: department name, average CIP program code, range of CIP program codes, variance of CIP program codes, variance category, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, subject title, and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(var_cip_program_code) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1 ), variance_stats AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_cip_program_code, i.range_cip_program_code, i.var_cip_program_code, CASE WHEN i.var_cip_program_code > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.var_cip_program_code < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte1 i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark v ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_range, ic.enrolled_variance, ic.enrolled_stddev, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND cso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vs.avg_cip_program_code, vs.range_cip_program_code, vs.var_cip_program_code, vs.variance_category, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, es.enrolled_stddev, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS FROM variance_stats vs JOIN enrollment_stats es ON vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each school and each of its degree-granting departments, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), what is the school's geometric mean of the department budget codes for its degree-granting departments, the count of unique subject codes associated with those departments, the department name, and the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with a non-null total units value)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_subject_code_count, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.variance_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry) that has at least one graduate student, what is the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the number of graduate students in that department, and for each subject in the Mathematics department with a non-null subject code description, what is the subject title, total units, school name, the dense rank over department code ordered by department code, and whether the total units for the subject are 'HIGH_UNIT' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for that department), 'LOW_UNIT' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'? Only include departments that have at least one graduate student and subjects offered by the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 ), math_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered by the department is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the average total enrolled students across all departments, provide the department code, department name, the total number of enrolled students, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the full department name. sql: WITH total_enrolled_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ), coefficient_variation_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT tec.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tec.total_enrolled_students, cvc.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM total_enrolled_cte tec JOIN coefficient_variation_cte cvc ON tec.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cvc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each department and academic year where the department grants degrees and the average total units per subject is greater than the overall average total units per subject across all degree-granting departments, what is the department name, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled, and including a grand total for all activities in the format of (department name, null, total variance and stddev)), and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per subject in that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units)? sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_variance, rr.total_stddev, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev FROM RollupResults rr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_stats ds ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ds.avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte2) ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d ON f.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ) SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MAX(f.ORGANIZATION_ID) AS max_organization_id FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d ON f.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY organization_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS max_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME ) SELECT s1.DLC_NAME, s1.organization_count, s1.max_organization_id, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, s2.max_dense_rank FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DLC_NAME = s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department that grants degrees and where the average total units per subject is greater than the overall average total units per subject across all degree-granting departments, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per subject in that department. For each of these departments, also show, for each of the top 5 subject titles with the highest variance in tip detail record counts (for subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, with total units greater than 0, and excluding Chemistry), the subject title, the variance of its tip detail record counts, the total number of units for the subject, and the department name of the subject. The columns should be: department name, total units range, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), subject title, record count variance, total units for the subject, and subject department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM dept_stats WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte1 ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), top_subjects AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.record_count_variance, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ic.record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.record_count_variance, ts.TOTAL_UNITS, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM dept_units_stats dus CROSS JOIN top_subjects ts;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units offered per subject in that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and departments that grant degrees, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each subject title, what is the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject, considering only subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, with a total number of units greater than 0, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department?

For each department that grants degrees, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units offered per subject in that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), but only include departments where the average total units per subject is greater than the overall average total units per subject across all degree-granting departments.

Among the top 5 subject titles with the highest variance in tip detail record counts (for subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, with total units greater than 0, and excluding Chemistry), show each subject's title, the variance of its tip detail record counts, the total number of units for the subject, and the department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM dept_stats WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte ) ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.record_count_variance, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ic.record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, the name of the school to which the department belongs, and the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.avg_enrolled_students, ic2.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic1.num_hass_elective_subjects FROM inner_cte2 ic2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte1 ic1 ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: How many subjects offered in the 2022 academic year are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form and are offered by the Political Science department?

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
For each department, what is the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form?

For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and the name of the school to which the department belongs.
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science';

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_hass_elective_subjects FROM inner_cte;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each of the top 10 schools (with non-null name), list the school name, the number of unique degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), the total number of unique courses offered by those departments, and for each top degree-granting department (excluding Political Science and Course 17) that has offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, show the department name, subject code description, and the highest number of students ever enrolled in a single subject offered by each department. Results are sorted by the total number of courses in descending order, and within each school by the highest single subject enrollment in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolSummary AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptEngineeringSummary AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.num_departments, ss.total_courses, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, des.highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM SchoolSummary ss JOIN DeptEngineeringSummary des ON ss.SCHOOL_NAME = des.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ss.total_courses DESC, des.highest_single_subject_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of unique courses they offer, including the department name, school name, and the total number of courses, but only for departments that are degree granting, belong to a school with a non-null name, and are not the Political Science department (Course 17).

List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects they offered, including the department name, the school name, and the subject code description, for departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, and are not the 'Political Science' department (Course 17).

For each school, list the school name, the number of unique degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), and the total number of unique courses offered by those departments. Only include schools with a non-null name. Sort the results by the total number of courses in descending order, and show the top 10 schools.

For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, list the department name, school name, subject code description, and the highest number of students ever enrolled in a single subject offered by each department.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (but not in the Department of Physics), list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials (considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department), the average subject enrollment number for those subjects, the subject ID, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the total number of lecture units, and the name of the responsible faculty member. Only include results where the average total units is greater than zero. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON i.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte1.avg_subject_enrollment, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte2.LECTURE_UNITS, cte2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte2.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials, considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18), provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of lecture units, but exclude subjects offered by the Department of Physics.

For each department, list the department name, the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials (considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department), and the average subject enrollment number for those subjects. Only include results where the average total units is greater than zero.

For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) but not in the Department of Physics, provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, the total number of lecture units, and the name of the responsible faculty member.
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON i.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022;

question: For each department (excluding Chemistry and Biology) that is degree granting and offers at least one subject with more than zero enrolled students, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the total number of subjects offered by each department. Additionally, for the Mathematics department in each academic year in the current term, show the average, minimum, and maximum of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in that year, and the deviation of the average total units from the overall average total units for all such Mathematics subjects in the current term. Present the columns in the following order: department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, number of subjects offered, academic year, Mathematics average total units, Mathematics minimum total units, Mathematics maximum total units, and deviation from overall Mathematics average total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, (AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) overall GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, overall.avg_total_units ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units, ds.num_subjects_offered, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, ms.min_total_units, ms.max_total_units, ms.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM dept_stats ds LEFT JOIN math_stats ms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each school that does not offer courses in the Physics department (Course 8), and for each administrative department and academic year within that school (considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with total units greater than 0, and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department), list the school name, the average total units for all courses offered by that school, the administrative department name, the academic year, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department in that year, the school name for the department, and the department phone number. sql: WITH school_avg_units AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), schools_with_physics AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Physics' ) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_total_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN schools_with_physics swp ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = swp.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE swp.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), dept_year_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.average_total_units, d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, d.SCHOOL_NAME AS DEPT_SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM school_avg_units s JOIN dept_year_stats d ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: WITH school_course_stats AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), schools_with_math AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT scs.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(scs.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(scs.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM school_course_stats scs LEFT JOIN schools_with_math swm ON scs.SCHOOL_NAME = swm.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE swm.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scs.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) , schools_with_physics AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Physics' ) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_total_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN schools_with_physics swp ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = swp.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE swp.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science) that offered at least one subject in the 2016SP term and is offering subjects this year, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for those subjects, the subject title with the highest total units in that department along with its total units, the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code (where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000), and the corresponding administrative department name if available. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_units_subject_title, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.range_total_units, s1.var_total_units, s1.max_units_subject_title, s1.max_total_units, s2.min_num_enrolled_students, s2.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For all undergraduate subjects in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that are degree granting, offered this year, and letter graded, show the department name, subject code, subject code description, undergraduate level, the total number of undergraduate courses per department, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects, subject number, subject title, academic year, term code, term description, the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, and the academic year description, with all columns listed in this order. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS undergraduate_level, Total_Courses.Total_Undergrad_Courses, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Undergrad_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY question: For each school, for the top 5 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science, Course 17) by the number of subjects they offered in the 2022 academic year, and for the grand total of subjects offered by all its degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) in 2022 (with the department name as null), list the school name, department name, subject count, and the geometric mean of the clearing cost collector values for all departments in that school (excluding the School of Science), considering only departments where the clearing cost collector is greater than zero and the department is not Mathematics. The geometric mean is shown for each school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH geometric_mean_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM inner_cte WHERE SCHOOL_NAME != 'School of Science' GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), subject_count_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT scc.SCHOOL_NAME, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scc.subject_count, gmc.geometric_mean FROM subject_count_cte scc LEFT JOIN geometric_mean_cte gmc ON scc.SCHOOL_NAME = gmc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scc.SCHOOL_NAME, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), DepartmentHighestEnrollment AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled) AS highest_term_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), DepartmentYearUnitsStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dyus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dyus.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dyus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dyus.total_units_variance, dyus.total_units_stddev, dhe.highest_term_enrollment FROM DepartmentYearUnitsStats dyus JOIN DepartmentHighestEnrollment dhe ON dyus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dhe.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dyus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dyus.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_units_range, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_units_range, total_units_variance WITH ROLLUP HAVING total_units_range IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department where the total number of units for all subjects in the course catalog that are offered in the fall term and are part of a degree-granting program is greater than the average total units for all departments, and for each subject offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 in the Mathematics department, give the department name, the total units for all such subjects in the department, the department code, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units for the subject, the row number within the department ordered by subject code, and the deviation of the subject's total units from the average total units of all Mathematics subjects offered in 2024. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), dept_units_above_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE total_units > (SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM inner_cte1) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_avg AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dua.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dua.total_units, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - m.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM dept_units_above_avg dua JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dua.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte2 i ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN math_avg m ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dua.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column;

sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0;

SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM inner_cte );

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_avg AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - m.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN math_avg m ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each academic year and each department, what is the academic year, academic year description, department name, and the total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects offered in terms marked as the current term in the term parameter table, including a grand total for all departments per academic year (with department name as null)? Additionally, for each academic year, what is the maximum number of total units for any subject offered by the Mathematics department in that year, and what are the corresponding term description and subject title, only including academic years where the maximum total units is greater than 9? List the academic year, academic year description, department name, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), maximum total units for Mathematics, term description, and subject title, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING max_total_units > 9 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.max_total_units, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = ic.max_total_units AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE ) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.total_coefficient_of_variation, cte2.max_total_units, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each academic year, what is the maximum number of total units for any subject offered in that year, and what is the corresponding term description, only considering subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) and only including academic years where the maximum total units is greater than 9?
