WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o;

WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, spt.TERM_CODE, spt.num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) ), ranked_terms AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_subjects, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.num_subjects DESC, icte.TERM_CODE) AS term_rank FROM inner_cte icte ), agg_stats AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(icte.num_subjects) - MIN(icte.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(icte.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(icte.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.range_num_subjects, a.variance_num_subjects, a.stddev_num_subjects, r.TERM_CODE AS term_with_most_subjects, r.num_subjects AS num_subjects_in_term FROM agg_stats a JOIN ranked_terms r ON a.DEPARTMENT_CODE = r.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND r.term_rank = 1 ORDER BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), which is degree-granting, what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered, the full name of the department, the name of the associated administrative department (if any), the academic year, the number of unique subjects with enrollment greater than 10, the minimum total units offered, and the latest term end date for those subjects? List the results ordered by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DegreeDeptStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte1.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, at.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ), MathDeptYearStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte2.min_total_units, MAX(at.TERM_END_DATE) AS latest_term_end_date FROM inner_cte2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte2.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte2.min_total_units ) SELECT dds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dds.coefficient_of_variation, dds.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mdys.num_unique_subjects, mdys.min_total_units, mdys.latest_term_end_date FROM DegreeDeptStats dds JOIN MathDeptYearStats mdys ON dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdys.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mdys.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV_POP(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV_POP(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, at.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units, MAX(at.TERM_END_DATE) AS latest_term_end_date FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units

question: For the top 10 subject codes and department names in the Mathematics department (where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year) with the highest number of unique subject titles, what are the subject code, department name, number of unique subject titles, minimum total units, the subject title with the highest total units and its total units, as well as the department code and the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered for the Mathematics department (where the department is degree-granting, the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH top_math_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_unique_subject_titles, ic.min_total_units, stc.max_subject_title, stc.max_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_subject_title, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) ) stc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = stc.SUBJECT_CODE AND stc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.num_unique_subject_titles DESC LIMIT 10 ), math_dept_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT tms.SUBJECT_CODE, tms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tms.num_unique_subject_titles, tms.min_total_units, tms.max_subject_title, tms.max_total_units, mde.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mde.highest_num_enrolled_students FROM top_math_subjects tms LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN math_dept_enrollment mde ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mde.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_unique_subject_titles, ic.min_total_units, stc.max_subject_title, stc.max_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_subject_title, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) ) stc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = stc.SUBJECT_CODE AND stc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.num_unique_subject_titles DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and department in the Mathematics department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department (considering only subjects offered in the current term, with more than 0 total units, and with a subject enrollment number greater than the average for that department and year), and for subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, what is the subject title, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code (only including records where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average for their HGN code group)? List the academic year, department name, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), subject title, department full name, offer school name, and average number of enrolled students in the window, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, i.HGN_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE ) a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units_variance, s1.total_units_stddev, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.total_units_variance DESC, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, ordered by the subject title.

For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and have a subject enrollment number greater than the average subject enrollment number for that department and academic year?

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, but only include those records where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average number of enrolled students for their HGN code group.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE ) a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term, the number of unique subjects offered by that department in those terms (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100), the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (excluding Chemistry, Course 5, and only for degree-granting departments), along with the department's school name and department phone number. Present the results in the order: department name, total enrolled, number of unique subjects, average enrolled students, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, school name, and department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte2.stddev_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_enrolled, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.stddev_enrolled_students, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term, and the number of unique subjects offered by that department in those terms, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry, Course 5), list the department name, the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, along with the department's school name and department phone number.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each school, what is the maximum CIP program code among its degree-granting departments' courses (excluding the Mathematics department), the full name of the school, and whether the maximum CIP program code is considered 'HIGH_CIP' (greater than 150000), 'LOW_CIP' (less than 130000), or 'MEDIUM_CIP' (otherwise), along with the department name, school name, subject code, and number of degree-granting undergraduate courses for the subject code with the highest number of such courses in the Mathematics department for that school (if any)? List the school name, school name in commencement book, maximum CIP program code, CIP category, department name, school name for Mathematics, subject code, and subject course count, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SchoolCIP AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS school_max_cip_code, CASE WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) > 150000 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) < 130000 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CIP' END AS cip_category, i.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, i.SCHOOL_CODE ), MathDeptTopSubject AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, sc.school_max_cip_code, sc.cip_category, mdts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdts.SCHOOL_NAME AS MATH_SCHOOL_NAME, mdts.SUBJECT_CODE, mdts.subject_course_count FROM SchoolCIP sc LEFT JOIN MathDeptTopSubject mdts ON sc.SCHOOL_NAME = mdts.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sc.SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and what is the full name of the department, for departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

Which department name, school name, and subject code have the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000;

SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS school_max_cip_code, CASE WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) > 150000 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) < 130000 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CIP' END AS cip_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each department and each subject code in the Political Science department associated with that department, what is the department name, the average number of enrolled students in its degree-granting courses (excluding Chemistry) during the term '2014FA', the difference between the maximum and minimum number of enrolled students in those courses, the subject code, the subject code description, the geometric mean of the number of students in each department associated with that subject code (considering only degree-granting departments), and the total number of unique student years represented among those students? Show the results ordered by the difference between the maximum and minimum number of enrolled students in descending order, then by the geometric mean of students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, (MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS enrolled_students_range FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), PoliticalScienceSubjectStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.enrolled_students_range, pss.SUBJECT_CODE, pss.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, pss.geometric_mean_students, pss.unique_student_years FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN PoliticalScienceSubjectStats pss ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = pss.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY des.enrolled_students_range DESC, pss.geometric_mean_students DESC;

SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_students DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, (MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS enrolled_students_range FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_students DESC;

question: For each school, what is the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school (excluding the Political Science department), the count of unique subject codes associated with those departments, and for each department in the school that grants degrees and is the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department full name, subject title, subject code description, and the total number of such courses per department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ) SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, subq1.unique_subject_code_count, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq2.total_courses FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE

Show the department full name, subject title, subject code description, and school name, along with dense ranks over department code ordered by department code, for courses that have a non-null subject title, belong to departments that grant degrees, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department that grants degrees, show the department full name, subject title, subject code description, and school name for courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that have a non-null subject title, and also include the total number of such courses per department.

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Physics department and the Department of Political Science, Course 17) that both (1) offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021 with total enrolled students greater than the average across such departments, and (2) in 2024 offered at least one subject with more than 9 total units, what is the department name, department code, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, the subject title for that subject, the name of the school the department belongs to, the department full name, the number of subjects offered in the School of Engineering in 2021, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects? List the results in order by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = icte.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE total_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) FROM inner_cte ) ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.max_total_units, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.total_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting, excluding the Physics department, what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units?

For each department that is degree-granting, offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, and is not the Department of Political Science (Course 17), provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects.

For each degree-granting department (excluding the Physics department), what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, the subject title for that subject, and the name of the school the department belongs to, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units?

For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021 (excluding the Department of Political Science, Course 17), provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and only include those departments where the total number of enrolled students is greater than the average total enrollment across all such departments.
sub_sqls: WITH dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = icte.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE total_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) FROM inner_cte );

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subject codes offered by that department, and what is the average subject code count per department? Additionally, for the Mathematics department, what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), and what is the average number of enrolled students in those subjects (only if the average is greater than 10)? Please provide the department name, the variance, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the average subject code count per department, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (for Mathematics), and the average number of enrolled students (for Mathematics), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subject_code_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev, AVG(inner_cte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC ), math_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation HAVING AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.subject_code_count_variance, scs.subject_code_count_stddev, scs.avg_subject_code_count, mes.coefficient_of_variation, mes.avg_enrolled_students FROM subject_code_stats scs LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_stats mes ON scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mes.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY scs.subject_code_count_variance DESC;

For each department that grants degrees and whose name is 'Mathematics', list the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), and also include the average number of enrolled students in those subjects. Only include results where the average number of enrolled students is greater than 10.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev, AVG(inner_cte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation HAVING AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ;

question: For each department where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers is greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all departments, what is the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and for the Mathematics department (if it is among these), what is its department code, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, and for each course in that department, the course number and course description, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, and the department is degree-granting? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH coefficient_of_variation_departments AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) inner_cte) ), mathematics_department_courses AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, scd.COURSE AS COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT cod.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cod.coefficient_of_variation, mdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mdc.min_num_enrolled_students, mdc.avg_dept_budget_code, mdc.COURSE_NUMBER, mdc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM coefficient_of_variation_departments cod LEFT JOIN mathematics_department_courses mdc ON cod.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte);

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, scd.COURSE AS COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT

question: For each combination of academic year, academic year description, department (with subtotals and grand total as described), and each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms, provide the academic year, academic year description, department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in current terms, the building name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, the total assignable area, and the year the building was built. Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the results by academic year, department, and the range of room areas in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ), cte_subject_units AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ), SubjectUnitsStats AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM cte_subject_units tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ), BuildingRoomStats AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC ) SELECT s.academic_year, s.academic_year_desc, s.dept, s.units_range, s.units_variance, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.area_range, b.area_variance, b.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM SubjectUnitsStats s CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats b ORDER BY s.academic_year, s.dept, b.area_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are marked as current in the term parameter table, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).
For each building at MIT, provide the building name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, considering only academic buildings with more than 10 rooms.

For each academic year and department, provide the academic year, academic year description, department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are marked as current in the term parameter table. Also, include subtotals for each academic year (with the department field as 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all years (with the department field as 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and department.

For each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms, provide the building name, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, along with the total assignable area and the year the building was built. Sort the results by the range of room areas in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_range DESC;

SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC;

question: For each department and school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units, and specifically for the Mathematics department), as well as the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, and the total number of such courses in 2019 with more than 5 enrolled students (considering only the Mathematics and Chemistry departments)? Additionally, for each school, include a grand total row for all departments in the format of (Grand Total, school name, average, variance, stddev, null, null, total number of such courses). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(avg_total_units) IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ), CourseCounts2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM_COURSES FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.avg_total_units, rr.total_units_variance, rr.total_units_stddev, ic2.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cc2.NUM_COURSES FROM RollupResults1 rr LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN CourseCounts2 cc2 ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT 'Grand Total', rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.avg_total_units, rr.total_units_variance, rr.total_units_stddev, NULL, NULL, SUM(cc2.NUM_COURSES) FROM RollupResults1 rr LEFT JOIN CourseCounts2 cc2 ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc2.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.avg_total_units, rr.total_units_variance, rr.total_units_stddev ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with more than 0 total units, and specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, and what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)?

Additionally, for each department, include the total number of such courses in 2019 (with more than 5 enrolled students), and provide a grand total row for all included departments.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(avg_total_units) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.avg_total_units, rr.total_units_variance, rr.total_units_stddev FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ), CourseCounts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM_COURSES FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cc.NUM_COURSES FROM inner_cte ic JOIN CourseCounts cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT 'Grand Total', NULL, NULL, SUM(NUM_COURSES) FROM CourseCounts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each degree-granting department that is Chemistry or Biology, list the department name, subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, the total number of unique courses offered by that department and subject code, and the average of the range of enrolled students per subject (where each subject has at least one associated course material), only including departments where the average of the range of enrolled students per subject is greater than 0. Present the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(enrolled_range) AS avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_course_count, s2.avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE s2.avg_enrolled_range_per_subject > 0 ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

sub_questions: For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code.

For each department (only Chemistry and Biology), what is the average of the range of enrolled students per subject (where each subject has at least one associated course material), grouped by department?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
