WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(enrolled_range) AS avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department that is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials (considering only records where the material status is 'U' and the term status indicator is 'P'), indicate whether the coefficient is 'HIGH_VARIATION' (at least 20% greater than the average coefficient across all departments), 'LOW_VARIATION' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE', and also provide the school name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Biology department), as well as the department phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. Sort the results by school name, department name, and coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), avg_coeff AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient FROM inner_cte1 ), variation_by_dept AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_coefficient * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIATION' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < a.avg_coefficient * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte1 i CROSS JOIN avg_coeff a ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT vbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vbd.coefficient_of_variation, vbd.variation_category, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.avg_total_units, ic2.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM variation_by_dept vbd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON vbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON vbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, vbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vbd.coefficient_of_variation DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials, considering only records where the material status is 'U', the term status indicator is 'P', and the department is Mathematics (Course 18).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials, and indicate whether the coefficient is 'HIGH_VARIATION' (at least 20% greater than the average coefficient across all departments), 'LOW_VARIATION' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE', considering only records where the material status is 'U', the term status indicator is 'P', and the department is Mathematics (Course 18).

For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Also, include the department phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. Sort the results by school name and department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) , avg_coeff AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_coefficient * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIATION' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < a.avg_coefficient * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_coeff a ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each school and department, list the school name, department name, average total units, range of total units, and variance of total units for degree-granting subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18), and include a grand total for all departments in each school (with department name as null). Also, for each department in the School of Engineering (excluding Management) that grants degrees and has a total student enrollment in its offered courses greater than 50, list the department name, total enrollment, the most popular course by enrollment, and its enrollment count. For each result, indicate the reason for inclusion as either 'UnitsStats' or 'EnrollmentStats'. The columns should be: school name, department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, total enrollment, most popular course, course enrollment, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.total_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Popular_Course, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Course_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 WHERE t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, NULL AS total_enrollment, NULL AS Most_Popular_Course, NULL AS Course_Enrollment, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Engineering' AS SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, s2.total_enrollment, s2.Most_Popular_Course, s2.Course_Enrollment, 'EnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_enrollment, Most_Popular_Course, Course_Enrollment, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15).

For each school, list the school name, the department name, and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Among departments in the School of Engineering that grant degrees (excluding the Department of Management), which departments have a total student enrollment in their offered courses greater than 50, and for each such department, what is the most popular course (by enrollment) they offer and its enrollment count?
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Popular_Course, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Course_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 WHERE t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management) that both (1) has a subject in 2019FA with the maximum number of enrolled students among its subjects and (2) has an average total units for subjects offered in academic year 2022 (and also listed in the CIS course catalog) greater than the overall average for all such subjects, list the department name, the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in 2019FA, the name of the subject with that maximum enrollment, the department's full name, and the average total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH max_enrollment_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrollment, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), avg_units_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.max_enrollment, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, a.avg_total_units FROM max_enrollment_cte m JOIN avg_units_cte a ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY a.avg_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, what is the name of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and restrict the results to only degree-granting departments and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15)?

For each department, provide the department's name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, but only include departments that are Mathematics (Course 18).

For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, what is the name of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and what is the department's full name? Restrict the results to only degree-granting departments and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15).

For each department, provide the department's name and the average total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, but only include departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units for all such subjects.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrollment, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department, which department name, school name, and subject code have the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses, and for each such subject code, list the subject ID and subject title, along with the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during non-summer fall terms, ordered by enrollment range in descending order? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_course_count, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_range, s2.enrollment_variance FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN subq2 s2 ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.enrollment_range DESC;
sub_questions: Which department name and school name have the highest number of courses, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a course level of 'U', and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
Which department name, school name, and subject code have the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

List the department names, subject IDs, subject titles, and for each, provide the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

question: For each department, provide the school name, department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2016SP term and that are offered this year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (school name, null, null, null, total average, total range, total variance). For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding 'Chemistry'), also include the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, and the total number of such subjects offered by the department. For each department, also include a grand total row showing the total enrolled students and total subjects across all departments (with department name as null). The columns are: school name, department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, total enrolled students, and total subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), DepartmentStats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte1 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, MAX(range_total_units) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(var_total_units) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND su.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, dc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCounts dc ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, SUM(total_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM RollupResults GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_enrolled) > 0 ) SELECT ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units, des.total_enrolled, des.total_subjects FROM DepartmentStats ds LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ds.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME LEFT JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON ( (ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OR (ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL AND ds.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') ) ORDER BY ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2016SP term and that are offered this year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, but only include departments that are not 'Chemistry' (Course 5).

For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2016SP term and that are offered this year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (school name, null, null, null, total average, total range, total variance).

For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding 'Chemistry'), list the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, and the total number of such subjects offered by the department. For each department, also include a grand total row showing the total enrolled students and total subjects across all departments (with department name as null).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, MAX(range_total_units) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(var_total_units) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND su.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, dc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCounts dc ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, SUM(total_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM RollupResults GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_enrolled) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of graduate students in that department (considering only students with a non-null office phone number), the school name, the department phone number, and for each academic year, the academic year, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up (using only activities with a non-null maximum enrollment), grouped by department and academic year? List the results ordered by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_office_phone, s1.stddev_office_phone, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.avg_max_enrollment, s2.stddev_max_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the average and standard deviation of the office phone numbers of students in that department, considering only students whose student year is 'G', who have a non-null office phone number, and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each academic year, provide the academic year and calculate the average and standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up, using only activities that have a non-null maximum enrollment and are offered by the Department of Mathematics (Course 18).

For each department, what is the department name, the average and standard deviation of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students whose student year is 'G', who have a non-null office phone number, and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)), along with the school name and department phone number?

For each academic year, list the academic year, the department name, and calculate the average and standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up, using only activities that have a non-null maximum enrollment, grouped by department and academic year.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_office_phone DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), which is degree-granting, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), the average number of enrolled students in those subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, and for each course in that department, the course number and course description, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000? List the results by course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_num_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_num_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, scd.COURSE AS COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.variance_num_enrolled_students, subq1.stddev_num_enrolled_students, subq1.avg_num_enrolled_students, subq2.min_num_enrolled_students, subq2.avg_dept_budget_code, subq2.COURSE_NUMBER, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subq2.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, not the Political Science or Chemistry department, and has offered more than five subjects in the School of Engineering, display the department name, the average, minimum, and maximum total units for subjects offered by that department (from School of Engineering subjects), the average units category (whether the average total units is above 10, below 6, or otherwise), the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and excluding Chemistry), and the number of graduate students in that department. Show the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.avg_total_units, subq1.min_total_units, subq1.max_total_units, subq1.avg_units_category, subq2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_subq2, subq2.stddev_total_units, subq2.num_grad_students FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department with a department budget code greater than 100000, excluding the Mathematics and Physics departments, and for each academic term parameter, list the department name, total clearing cost collector, the department phone number, the academic term parameter, the term description, the subject number, the subject title, the average total units, and the variance of total units for each Mathematics subject offered this year in the corresponding effective term. Additionally, for each term, include a grand total row showing the average and variance of total units for all such subjects in that term (with nulls for subject number and title). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_clearing_cost_collector, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT academic_term_parameter, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY academic_term_parameter, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL) OR (SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NULL AND SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL) ORDER BY academic_term_parameter, SUBJECT_NUMBER ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_clearing_cost_collector, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.academic_term_parameter, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.avg_total_units, s2.var_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN subq2 s2 ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = s2.academic_term_parameter ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.academic_term_parameter, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT academic_term_parameter, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY academic_term_parameter, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL) OR (SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NULL AND SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL) ORDER BY academic_term_parameter, SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For each school, provide the school name and, for each department in that school that is degree-granting and not 'Political Science', list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the subject codes' lengths for subjects offered by that department, and for each course in the department that is in the School of Engineering, is degree granting, and is in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course, course description, the rank of the course within its department ordered by course, and the graduate level. For each school, also include a grand total for all departments in the format of (school name, null, averages for all departments, nulls for course columns). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ), SubjectStats AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LENGTH(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_length FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subject_code_length) AS avg_subject_code_length, MAX(subject_code_length) - MIN(subject_code_length) AS range_subject_code_length, VARIANCE(subject_code_length) AS var_subject_code_length FROM SubjectStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.COURSE, inner_cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte2.COURSE = scd.COURSE ) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_subject_code_length, s1.range_subject_code_length, s1.var_subject_code_length, s2.COURSE, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, department full name, school name, and the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in 2019 (only if the maximum is greater than 10), and for each of the top 10 Chemistry department (Course 5) subjects with the highest number of enrolled students in terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the course has materials, what is the subject title, number of enrolled students, academic year, term code, and the most represented offering school among those subjects along with the count of subjects from that school? List the department information first, followed by the Chemistry subject information for each combination. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t1.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_CODE, sc.Most_Represented_School, sc.Subject_Count, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Represented_School, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY Subject_Count DESC LIMIT 1 ) sc ON ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = sc.Most_Represented_School ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ) SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c2.SUBJECT_TITLE, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS CHEM_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c2.TERM_CODE, c2.Most_Represented_School, c2.Subject_Count FROM cte1 c1 CROSS JOIN cte2 c2 ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, Course 6) and is either the Chemistry or Biology department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, the school name, the department phone number, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses in that department that have at least one course material assigned, and the total number of such courses in each department. Only include departments that offered at least one subject in 2022FA. Sort the results by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_range, inner_cte1.enrolled_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DepartmentCourseMaterialStats AS ( SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, des.SCHOOL_NAME, des.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, dcm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dcm.avg_total_units, dcm.stddev_total_units, dcm.num_courses FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des JOIN DepartmentCourseMaterialStats dcm ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, is not Political Science or Chemistry, and where the average total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2016SP term and also offered this year is greater than 9, and the average number of students enrolled in subjects offered by that department (with at least one enrolled student) is greater than 20, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in 2016SP and also offered this year, the number of unique subject titles offered in 2016SP and also offered this year, the average, range, and variance of the number of students enrolled in subjects offered by that department, and the total number of subjects offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, inner_cte.range_enrolled, inner_cte.var_enrolled, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, inner_cte.range_enrolled, inner_cte.var_enrolled ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.avg_total_units, subq1.range_total_units, subq1.var_total_units, subq1.num_unique_subject_titles, subq2.avg_enrolled, subq2.range_enrolled, subq2.var_enrolled, subq2.total_subjects_offered FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE subq1.avg_total_units > 9 AND subq2.avg_enrolled > 20 ORDER BY subq2.avg_enrolled DESC;

For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of students enrolled in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5).
