JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, inner_cte1.TIP_TERM_CODE, inner_cte1.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, inner_cte1.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, inner_cte1.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS NUM_SUBJECTS_PER_DEPT FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_counts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(grad_counts.student_count) AS avg_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.variance_of_grad_students, avg_counts.avg_grad_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.variance_of_grad_students > avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte2.variance_of_grad_students < avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte2 JOIN avg_counts ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, cte1.TIP_TERM_CODE, cte1.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, cte1.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, cte1.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, cte1.NUM_SUBJECTS_PER_DEPT, cte2.variance_of_grad_students, cte2.benchmark, cte2.variance_category FROM cte1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN cte2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0 and the department is either Chemistry or Biology, and where for the same department and academic year the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 10 and the department is Chemistry (but only including subjects offered by Chemistry or Biology), show the department name, academic year, the count of subjects (from the first condition), the minimum start date of the term, the term description, the number of unique subjects (from the second condition), the minimum total units offered, and the earliest term start date. The columns should be shown in this order: department name, academic year, count of subjects (from the first condition), minimum start date of the term, term description, number of unique subjects (from the second condition), minimum total units offered, and earliest term start date. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.department, inner_cte1.academic_year, inner_cte1.subject_count, inner_cte1.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte1.academic_year ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units ) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count AS s1_subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.subject_count AS s2_subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.earliest_term_start_date FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.department = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

question: For each academic building at MIT that is owned by MIT (excluding the Stata building), and for each fiscal period, provide the building name, the fiscal period, the total area of rooms used for "RESIDENT" or "LABS" purposes (considering only buildings with a total room area greater than 1000), the running sum of assignable area within each campus sector, and the building's external gross area. Only include buildings classified as academic buildings and owned by MIT. Order the results by fiscal period and building name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH BuildingRoomArea AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000 ), BuildingPeriods AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(bp.total_room_area) AS total_room_area, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingPeriods bp GROUP BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(bp.total_room_area) > 0 ), AcademicBuildingArea AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ) SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bra.BUILDING_NAME, bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.total_room_area, aba.running_assignable_area, aba.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM BuildingRoomArea bra JOIN AcademicBuildingArea aba ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = aba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bra.FISCAL_PERIOD = aba.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE bra.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.BUILDING_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING total_room_area > 1000 ;

SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000 ), BuildingPeriods AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(bp.total_room_area) AS total_room_area FROM BuildingPeriods bp GROUP BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(bp.total_room_area) > 0 ORDER BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ) SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD;

question: For each department that grants degrees and whose name is 'Mathematics', what is the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers across all academic terms (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials (considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department, and only where the average total units is greater than zero), and the average subject enrollment number for those subjects? List the department name, the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for reserved library materials, and the average subject enrollment number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), cte1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS highest_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.highest_coefficient_of_variation, cte2.coefficient_of_variation AS library_total_units_coefficient_of_variation, cte2.avg_subject_enrollment FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees, but only include departments whose name is 'Mathematics' (i.e., Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials, considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department that grants degrees and whose name is 'Mathematics', what is the highest coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers, across all academic terms, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student?

For each department, list the department name, the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials (considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department), and the average subject enrollment number for those subjects. Only include results where the average total units is greater than zero.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS highest_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each school, list its name, the department name, the number of degree-granting departments (excluding the Biology department), the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered in the 2022 academic year for each department, and for the Mathematics department in each school, also include for each academic year the academic year and its description along with the variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with non-null subject title and at least one associated library reserve material. For each school, include a grand total row for all its departments in the format of (school name, null, total departments, null, null, null, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.num_departments, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN DeptCounts dc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dc.SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL, dc.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL, dc.num_departments, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM DeptCounts dc ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), MathVarianceRollup AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.variance_total_units FROM ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP ) ic WHERE ic.variance_total_units IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.num_departments, rr.avg_total_units, rr.range_total_units, rr.var_total_units, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mv.variance_total_units FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MathVarianceRollup mv ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.num_departments, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptCounts dc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dc.SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT dc.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL, dc.num_departments, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM DeptCounts dc ) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.variance_total_units FROM ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP ) ic WHERE ic.variance_total_units IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology), what is the department name, the variance of the number of students in each student year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year, and the total number of unique courses offered by that department, along with the administrative department name and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering where the administrative department name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2), the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and the total number of enrolled students is greater than the average total number of enrolled students across all administrative departments in the School of Engineering? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH degree_dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), admin_dept_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = '2' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte WHERE total_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_table ) ) SELECT dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dds.variance_num_students, dds.stddev_num_students, dds.total_courses, ade.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ade.total_enrolled FROM degree_dept_stats dds CROSS JOIN admin_dept_enrollment ade;

For each administrative department, give the administrative department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to administrative departments whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2).

sub_sqls: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = '2' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = '2' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte WHERE total_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_table );

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology and Mathematics) that offers subjects in the academic year 2024 and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, provide the department's full name, the maximum, minimum, and average total units for subjects offered by that department in 2024, the department name, the maximum CIP program code, and the phone number of its corresponding administrative department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.max_total_units, s1.min_total_units, s1.avg_total_units, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department's full name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, what is the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and what is the full department name, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, provide the department's full name and the maximum, minimum, and average total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each degree-granting department that is not the Mathematics department (Course 18) and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, what is the department's full name and the phone number of its corresponding administrative department?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each school and each degree-granting department in that school (excluding the Mathematics and Political Science departments), provide the school name, the number of degree-granting departments in the school (excluding Political Science), the department name, the average and variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers (only for departments where the average ASCII value is greater than the overall average across all degree-granting departments excluding Mathematics), and the average number of students per student year in that department. The columns should be: school name, number of degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), department name, average ASCII value of course numbers, variance of ASCII values of course numbers, and average students per year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_course_number_ascii, var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_course_number_ascii > ( SELECT AVG(avg_course_number_ascii) FROM inner_cte1 ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ), SchoolDeptCounts AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_degree_granting_departments FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolDeptStats AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_students_per_year FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SchoolDeptCounts sdc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sdc.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.num_degree_granting_departments, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.avg_course_number_ascii, sq1.var_course_number_ascii, sds.avg_students_per_year FROM SchoolDeptStats sds JOIN Subquery1 sq1 ON sds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of students per student year in that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department (Course 17).

For each degree-granting department (excluding the Mathematics department), provide the department name, the average and variance of the ASCII values of its subject codes' course numbers, but only include those departments where the average ASCII value is greater than the overall average ASCII value across all degree-granting departments (excluding Mathematics).

For each school, list the school name, the number of degree-granting departments in that school (excluding the Political Science department), and for each department in the school, provide the department name and the average number of students per student year in that department. For each school, include a grand total row with the school name, total number of degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), and null for department name and average students per year.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year, range_students_per_year, var_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_course_number_ascii, var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_course_number_ascii > ( SELECT AVG(avg_course_number_ascii) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ), SchoolDeptCounts AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_degree_granting_departments FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolDeptStats AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_students_per_year FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SchoolDeptCounts sdc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sdc.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, num_degree_granting_departments, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year FROM SchoolDeptStats UNION ALL SELECT sdc.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_students_per_year FROM SchoolDeptCounts sdc ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, Course 6), provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, the school name, the department phone number, and, for each department and school, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments). Only include departments that offered at least one subject in 2022FA. Sort the results by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_range, inner_cte1.enrolled_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), school_dept_unit_stats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ) t ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.enrolled_stddev, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sds.avg_total_units, sds.range_total_units, sds.var_total_units FROM dept_stats ds LEFT JOIN school_dept_unit_stats sds ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ds.SCHOOL_NAME = sds.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

Only include departments that offered at least one subject in 2022FA. Sort the results by department name.

For each school, list its name, the department name, and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments. sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each Mathematics department subject, list the subject ID, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average lecture units, and the total number of terms offered for each subject (for subjects where the number of enrolled students is between 2 and 10 or the academic year is at least 2020, and the term start date is between '01-JAN-20' and '31-DEC-22'), and include a grand total row showing the overall minimum number of enrolled students, average lecture units, and total terms across all subjects. Additionally, for each subject, include the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department), and the number of graduate students in that department, as well as a grand total for all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.TERM_CODE) AS total_terms FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 2 AND 10) OR (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2020) ) AND a.TERM_START_DATE BETWEEN '01-JAN-20' AND '31-DEC-22' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_ID ), math_subjects AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_num_enrolled_students, avg_lecture_units, total_terms FROM inner_cte1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(min_num_enrolled_students) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(avg_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units, SUM(total_terms) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 OR ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.min_num_enrolled_students, ms.avg_lecture_units, ms.total_terms, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.var_total_units, ds.stddev_total_units, ds.num_grad_students FROM math_subjects ms LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ms.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_ID, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each subject, give the subject ID, the minimum number of enrolled students and the average lecture units for each subject in the Mathematics department, for subjects where the number of enrolled students is between 2 and 10 or the academic year is at least 2020, and the term start date is between '01-JAN-20' and '31-DEC-22'.

For each Mathematics department subject, list the subject ID, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average lecture units, and the total number of terms offered for each subject, for subjects where the number of enrolled students is between 2 and 10 or the academic year is at least 2020, and the term start date is between '01-JAN-20' and '31-DEC-22'. Additionally, for each subject, include a grand total row showing the overall minimum number of enrolled students, average lecture units, and total terms across all subjects.

sub_sqls: SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 2 AND 10) OR (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2020) ) AND a.TERM_START_DATE BETWEEN '01-JAN-20' AND '31-DEC-22' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_ID;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.TERM_CODE) AS total_terms FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 2 AND 10) OR (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2020) ) AND a.TERM_START_DATE BETWEEN '01-JAN-20' AND '31-DEC-22' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_num_enrolled_students, avg_lecture_units, total_terms FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(min_num_enrolled_students) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(avg_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units, SUM(total_terms) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 OR ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each school, provide either (1) the school name and the highest average total units for degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), or (2) for each department that grants degrees, the school name, department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with a non-null total units value. Indicate the reason for inclusion as 'MathHighestAvgTotalUnits' for the first case and 'DeptVarianceStddev' for the second case. List the columns in the following order: school name, department name, highest average total units, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and reason for inclusion. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL ) subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_avg_total_units, NULL AS variance_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, 'MathHighestAvgTotalUnits' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS highest_avg_total_units, s2.variance_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, 'DeptVarianceStddev' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, highest_avg_total_units, variance_total_units, stddev_total_units, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, Reason, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL ) subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each school, provide the school's name, the maximum and minimum variance of CIP program codes among its degree-granting departments (excluding the Biology department), and for each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting and in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at the graduate level, show the course, course description, department name, school name, and the rank of each course within its department ordered by course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(cip_code_variance) AS max_cip_code_variance, MIN(cip_code_variance) AS min_cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE COURSE IN ( SELECT COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' ) ) SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.max_cip_code_variance, subq1.min_cip_code_variance, subq2.COURSE, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each school and each of its departments (including a grand total for all departments in the school), what is the geometric mean of the total units of subjects offered by departments in that school (considering only subjects with more than zero total units and that are offered this year, and only for departments that are degree-granting and not the Department of Management), the overall average geometric mean across all schools, whether the school's geometric mean is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 5% greater than the overall average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 5% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise, and for each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students)? Show the school name, its geometric mean, the overall average geometric mean, the comparison to average, the department name (or null for the school total), the average enrollment, the enrollment variance, and the enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SchoolGeometricMean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, s.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units > s.avg_geometric_mean * 1.05 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units < s.avg_geometric_mean * 0.95 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS comparison_to_average FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) s ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sgm.SCHOOL_NAME, sgm.geometric_mean_total_units, sgm.avg_geometric_mean, sgm.comparison_to_average, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev FROM SchoolGeometricMean sgm JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON sgm.SCHOOL_NAME = des.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sgm.SCHOOL_NAME, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and the name of the school to which the department belongs, along with the first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, department full name, school name, the minimum department budget code over each school name group, and the department phone number for students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', where the department code matches, ordered by school name, student last name, and student first name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), eecs_students AS ( SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, des.SCHOOL_NAME, es.FIRST_NAME, es.LAST_NAME, es.EMAIL_ADDRESS, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS EECS_DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.STUDENT_YEAR, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.SCHOOL_NAME AS EECS_SCHOOL_NAME, es.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, es.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM dept_enrollment_stats des JOIN eecs_students es ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = es.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.SCHOOL_NAME, es.LAST_NAME, es.FIRST_NAME;

question: For each department and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of departments, the minimum department budget code (but only include those results where the minimum department budget code is greater than the average department budget code for all degree granting departments), the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (if available), and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects in 2022 (if available). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_budget AS ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ), avg_enrolled AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.department_count, i1.min_budget_code, i2.coefficient_of_variation, ae.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 i1 JOIN avg_budget ab ON i1.min_budget_code > ab.avg_budget_code LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN avg_enrolled ae ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ae.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_budget AS ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.department_count, i.min_budget_code FROM inner_cte i, avg_budget a WHERE i.min_budget_code > a.avg_budget_code;

question: For each department that is degree granting, has a non-null department budget code, and is not the Biology department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the total number of unique subjects offered by the department, the department code, the school name, the administrative department name, the average department budget code within each school, and indicate whether the department's budget code is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 10% greater than the school average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 10% less than the school average), or 'AVERAGE'. Order the results by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students ), dept_budget_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ), school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > s.avg_dept_budget_code * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < s.avg_dept_budget_code * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_enrolled_students, d1.stddev_enrolled_students, d1.num_unique_subjects, d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d2.SCHOOL_NAME, d2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.avg_dept_budget_code, d2.budget_category FROM dept_enrollment_stats d1 JOIN dept_budget_stats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code, the number of unique subject codes associated with those courses, the range and variance of the number of students in each subject code offered by that department (considering only subject codes that belong to a school with a non-null name), and also include the department's school name and whether the department is degree granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_cip_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_cip_code ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count_range, inner_cte.subject_count_variance, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count_range DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_cip_code, s1.subject_code_count, s2.subject_count_range, s2.subject_count_variance, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_cip_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_cip_code;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count_range, inner_cte.subject_count_variance, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count_range DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department except Biology, what is the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the total number of unique subjects offered by the department, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, the school name, and the department phone number? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s1.stddev_enrolled_students, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.variance_num_students, s2.stddev_num_students, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
