sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = 18 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department where the average total units for subjects offered (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units) is greater than the overall average total units across all departments, and for each academic year in which that department is the Mathematics department and has subjects offered in the current term with more than 0 total units, list the department name, the average total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the academic year, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in that year and department, the school name, and the department phone number. Order the results by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (descending), then by the variance of total units (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.school_name, s2.department_phone FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.stddev_total_units DESC, s2.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and restrict the results to departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units across all departments.

For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each result, include the school name and the department phone number. Sort the results by variance in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department that (1) has more than 5 rooms, (2) is associated with a non-null DLC key, (3) is not the 'ADMISSIONS' or 'Political Science' department, and (4) is among the top 3 organizations by number of distinct HR organizational units (excluding organizations '138' and '250' and only including those whose DLC name is 'Biology'), display the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, the department's DLC name, the number of distinct HR organizational units, and the total number of unique HR department names per organization, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH area_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.area_stddev DESC ), hr_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3 ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_hr_departments, fo.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.num_hr_org_units DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, a.area_stddev, a.DLC_NAME, h.num_hr_org_units, h.num_hr_departments FROM area_stats a JOIN hr_stats h ON a.ORGANIZATION_NAME = h.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND a.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME AND a.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY h.num_hr_org_units DESC, a.area_stddev DESC;

sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, considering only departments that have more than 5 rooms, are associated with a non-null DLC key, and are not the 'ADMISSIONS' department or the 'Political Science' department?

Which are the top 3 organizations (by organization name) that are associated with the highest number of HR organizational units, what are their organization names and DLC names, and exclude organizations '138' and '250' that are not relevant to the analysis? Additionally, only include organizations whose DLC name is 'Biology'.

For each department, what is the department name, the standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, and the department's DLC name, considering only departments that have more than 5 rooms, are associated with a non-null DLC key, and are not the 'ADMISSIONS' department or the 'Political Science' department?

Show the organization names, their DLC names, the number of distinct HR organizational units, and the total number of unique HR department names per organization, for the top 3 organizations (by number of HR organizational units), excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only including organizations whose DLC name is 'Biology'.
sub_sqls: SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC;

SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.area_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3 ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_hr_departments FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units ORDER BY icte.num_hr_org_units DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each of the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school and whose average total units for subjects offered (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units) is greater than the overall average total units across all departments, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the school name, the subject code description, and the highest number of students ever enrolled in a single subject offered by each department. Order the results by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentsWithHighAvgUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT dwhau.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dwhau.avg_total_units, dwhau.stddev_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM DepartmentsWithHighAvgUnits dwhau JOIN inner_cte2 icte ON dwhau.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY dwhau.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dwhau.avg_total_units, dwhau.stddev_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY dwhau.stddev_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects they offered, including the department name, the school name, and the subject code description, for departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, and are not the 'Political Science' department (Course 17).

For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and restrict the results to departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units across all departments.

For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, list the department name, school name, subject code description, and the highest number of students ever enrolled in a single subject offered by each department.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC;

question: For Chemistry department course offerings in the term '2017JA' that have materials, show the responsible faculty name, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, material status key, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the subject ID from the TIP_DETAIL table, as well as the grand total of enrolled students for all their Chemistry courses with materials in that term for each responsible faculty. Additionally, for each course, show the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, the average department budget code within each school, and indicate whether the department's budget code is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE', 'BELOW_AVERAGE', or 'AVERAGE', considering only degree granting departments with a non-null department budget code. Present the results ordered by responsible faculty name, subject title, and department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH chemistry_courses_with_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY td.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS min_enrolled_students_window, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, min_enrolled_students_window, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS total_enrolled_by_faculty FROM inner_cte ORDER BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE ), degree_granting_departments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ), school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > s.avg_dept_budget_code * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < s.avg_dept_budget_code * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, c.min_enrolled_students_window, c.total_enrolled_by_faculty, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_dept_budget_code, d.budget_category FROM chemistry_courses_with_materials c JOIN degree_granting_departments d ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For course offerings in the term '2017JA' from the Chemistry department, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, number of enrolled students, material status key, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the subject ID from the TIP_DETAIL table, but only include courses that have materials.

For each department, show the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, and the average department budget code within each school, ordered by department code, for departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For course offerings in the term '2017JA' from the Chemistry department, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, number of enrolled students, material status key, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the subject ID from the TIP_DETAIL table, but only include courses that have materials. Additionally, for each responsible faculty, include a grand total of enrolled students for all their Chemistry courses with materials in that term.

For each department that is degree granting and has a non-null department budget code, show the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, the average department budget code within each school, and indicate whether the department's budget code is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 10% greater than the school average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 10% less than the school average), or 'AVERAGE'. Order the results by department code.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY td.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS min_enrolled_students_window FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY td.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS min_enrolled_students_window FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, min_enrolled_students_window, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS total_enrolled_by_faculty FROM inner_cte ORDER BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ), school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > s.avg_dept_budget_code * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < s.avg_dept_budget_code * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: Show the first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the minimum department code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name, and the corresponding SIS admin department name for students whose department code is '6', who are in the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, and whose first name is 'Benedict', along with the department code, department name, administrative department name, and the total number of undergraduate courses offered by the top 3 degree-granting departments (excluding Management) that offer the most distinct courses, for each matching student and top department pair. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict' ), cte_students AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte1.LAST_NAME, inner_cte1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte1.window_column, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3 ), cte_top_departments AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.COURSE) AS num_undergrad_courses FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_undergrad_courses DESC ) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.window_column, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS TOP_DEPT_NAME, t.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS TOP_ADMIN_DEPT_NAME, t.num_undergrad_courses FROM cte_students s JOIN cte_top_departments t ON s.DEPARTMENT = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

sub_questions: For students whose department code is '6', who are in the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, and whose first name is 'Benedict', show their first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, and the minimum department code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name.

Which are the top 3 departments that offer the most distinct courses, are degree-granting, and have department codes, department names, and the corresponding administrative department names, excluding the Management department?

Show the first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the minimum department code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name, and the corresponding SIS admin department name for students whose department code is '6', who are in the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, and whose first name is 'Benedict'.

Which are the top 3 degree-granting departments (excluding Management) that offer the most distinct courses, and for each, what is the department code, department name, administrative department name, and the total number of courses offered at the undergraduate level?
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict'

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict' ) SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.COURSE) AS num_undergrad_courses FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_undergrad_courses DESC;

question: For each administrative department in the School of Engineering, specifically for the Mechanical Engineering department, list the administrative department name, the corresponding department code, the minimum CIP program code, the total number of degree-granting departments for courses, and the total number of such courses per administrative department. For each such course, also provide the school name, the average total units for all courses offered by that school, the department name, the average total units for all courses in the same department as the course, and classify the course as 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' if its total units are at least 10% greater than the department average, 'BELOW_AVERAGE' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise, considering only schools that do not offer courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18). The columns should be shown in the following order: administrative department name, department code, minimum CIP program code, total number of degree-granting departments, total number of such courses per administrative department, school name, average total units for all courses in the school, department name, average total units for all courses in the department, and the unit category. WITH school_course_stats AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), schools_with_math AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT scs.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(scs.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(scs.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM school_course_stats scs LEFT JOIN schools_with_math swm ON scs.SCHOOL_NAME = swm.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE swm.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scs.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME ;

question: For each department that grants degrees, is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, what are the department name, the maximum CIP program code among its courses, the full name of the department, the school name, the department name as it appears in course offerings with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ' offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in such courses? sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_cip_code, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ), dept_match AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_cip_code, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.enrolled_variance FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT dmatch.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmatch.max_cip_code, dmatch.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dmatch.SCHOOL_NAME, dmatch.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dmatch.enrolled_variance FROM dept_match dmatch WHERE dmatch.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL OR dmatch.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department that is letter graded and offered this year in a regular term, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code. Also, for the Mathematics department, include the variance of the number of graduate students in the department, the average number of graduate students as a benchmark, and whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_VARIANCE', 'LOW_VARIANCE', or 'AVERAGE' based on the variance compared to the benchmark. sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE ), cte_math_subjects AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.max_total_units_3rows FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte_dept_variance AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.variance_of_grad_students, avg_counts.avg_grad_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.variance_of_grad_students > avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte2.variance_of_grad_students < avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte2 JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(grad_counts.student_count) AS avg_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_counts ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.TERM_CODE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.max_total_units_3rows, d.variance_of_grad_students, d.benchmark, WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.max_total_units_3rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.TERM_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students, avg_counts.avg_grad_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students > avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.variance_of_grad_students < avg_counts.avg_grad_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(grad_counts.student_count) AS avg_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For students whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6), and whose first name is 'Kevin', show their full name, email address, student year, the department's full name, the course description, the course level, the minimum course level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's last name, the department's school name, and the department's budget code, along with, for each matching department, the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, and the corresponding SIS subject code and subject code description for each course. The columns should be shown in the following order: full name, email address, student year, department full name, course description, course level, windowed minimum course level, school name, department budget code, department name, CIP program code variance, CIP program code standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), SIS subject code, and subject code description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6' ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.FULL_NAME, inner_cte1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte1.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte1.window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.cip_program_code_variance, inner_cte2.cip_program_code_stddev, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT cte1.FULL_NAME, cte1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, cte1.STUDENT_YEAR, cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cte1.COURSE_LEVEL, cte1.window_column, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.cip_program_code_variance, cte2.cip_program_code_stddev, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that grants degrees and has courses with a non-null subject title, show the department full name, subject title, subject code description, school name, the total number of such courses per department, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) AS total_courses, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_courses, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), give the department name, the total number of enrolled students in both library and tip subjects for terms in 2014FA or 2017JA, the average number of enrolled students per subject (across both library and tip subjects), and for each academic year, the academic year, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up (using only activities with a non-null maximum enrollment), where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10. Present the results for each academic year in order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND tso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled, ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_count) FROM ( SELECT lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS enrolled_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso WHERE lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18' AND lso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') UNION ALL SELECT tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18' AND tso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') ) all_subjects ) AS avg_enrolled_per_subject FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_enrolled, s1.avg_enrolled_per_subject, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.avg_max_enrollment, s2.stddev_max_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.max_total_units_3rows FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolStats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte2 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, AVG(total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, AVG(total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.TERM_CODE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.max_total_units_3rows, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SCHOOL_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_total_units, s.total_units_variance, s.total_units_stddev FROM MathSubjects m JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON m.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SchoolStats s ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.TERM_CODE, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the highest maximum academic year among its degree-granting courses offered this year (where the maximum is taken over each course and the next two courses in alphabetical order), the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects with more than 0 total units, and the department phone number? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_academic_year FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_max_academic_year AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(max_academic_year) AS highest_max_academic_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_units_variation AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT mmaa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mmaa.highest_max_academic_year, muv.coefficient_of_variation, muv.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM math_max_academic_year mmaa JOIN math_units_variation muv ON mmaa.DEPARTMENT_NAME = muv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_academic_year FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(max_academic_year) AS highest_max_academic_year FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department), the department that offered the most subjects in that academic year and the count of subjects they offered, and for that department, also show the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department during the term '2014FA' (considering only degree-granting courses and excluding the Chemistry department, and only including departments where this variance is greater than the average variance across all departments). The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, total units range, total units variance, most offered department, subject count, department name, and enrolled students variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AcademicYearStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, dept.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Offered_Department, dept.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept.dept_rank = 1 ), DepartmentVarianceStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_cte ON icte.enrolled_students_variance > avg_cte.avg_variance ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_range, ays.total_units_variance, ays.Most_Offered_Department, ays.Subject_Count, dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dvs.enrolled_students_variance FROM AcademicYearStats ays JOIN DepartmentVarianceStats dvs ON ays.Most_Offered_Department = dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dvs.enrolled_students_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, list the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department), and also show the department that offered the most subjects in that academic year along with the count of subjects they offered.

sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, dept.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Offered_Department, dept.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_cte ON icte.enrolled_students_variance > avg_cte.avg_variance ORDER BY icte.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department that (1) offered courses in the School of Engineering in the 2021FA term, is degree-granting, and is not the Management department (code '15'), and (2) is an administrative department that grants degrees, offered courses with total units greater than 0 (excluding Mechanical Engineering), and for each academic year, provide the department code, department name, the number of distinct courses offered, the total number of enrolled students in those courses, the average number of enrolled students per course, the academic year, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department in that year, as well as the school name and department phone number. List the columns in this order: department code, department name, number of distinct courses offered, total number of enrolled students, average number of enrolled students per course, academic year, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), school name, and department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS num_courses_offered, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.num_courses_offered, inner_cte1.total_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.num_courses_offered > 0 THEN inner_cte1.total_enrolled_students * 1.0 / inner_cte1.num_courses_offered ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrolled_students_per_course FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), cte2 AS ( SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.num_courses_offered, cte1.total_enrolled_students, cte1.avg_enrolled_students_per_course, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.total_units_variance, cte2.total_units_stddev, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

Also, include the school name and department phone number for each department.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS num_courses_offered, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS num_courses_offered, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_courses_offered, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.num_courses_offered > 0 THEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students * 1.0 / inner_cte.num_courses_offered ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrolled_students_per_course FROM inner_cte;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that grants degrees and is the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the department full name, subject title, subject code description, and school name for courses that have a non-null subject title, along with the total number of such courses per department. Also, for the same department, show the department name and the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year whose total units are above the average total units for that department in that year. The results include the department full name, subject title, subject code description, school name, total number of such courses, department name, and number of subjects above average total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_above_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects_above_avg DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_courses, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.num_subjects_above_avg FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
