sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), SubjectCounts AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects FROM SubjectCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN TERM_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_subjects FROM RollupResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 OR ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department, Course 7) that also has a coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms (excluding Mathematics) above the average for such departments, display the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all degree-granting departments (excluding Biology) in 2024, whether the department's coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in 2024 is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE', 'BELOW_AVERAGE', or 'AVERAGE' compared to the overall average, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_cv ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), avg_cv AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_cv a ON 1=1 WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_cv ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.coefficient_of_variation AS cv_2024, s1.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS avg_cv_2024, s1.variation_category, s2.coefficient_of_variation AS cv_regular_terms FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

Also, indicate whether the department's coefficient of variation is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE', 'BELOW_AVERAGE', or 'AVERAGE' compared to the overall average.

For each department, list the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18) and where the coefficient of variation exceeds the average coefficient of variation across all such departments.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_cv ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), avg_cv AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_cv a ON 1=1 WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_cv;

question: For each degree-granting department that is not the Mathematics department (Course 18) and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, and whose average total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and also listed in the CIS course catalog is greater than the overall average total units for all such subjects, what is the department's name, the maximum CIP program code among its courses, the department's full name, the phone number of its corresponding administrative department, and the average total units for its subjects in 2022? List the results in descending order of average total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.avg_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.avg_total_units DESC
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and what is the full department name, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry, Biology, and Political Science) where the average total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 total units) is greater than the overall average total units across all such courses, and where the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree-granting) is greater than the overall average enrollment across all such departments, give the department name, the average total units, the variance of total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the average enrollment, and the variance of enrollment, ordered by the variance of total units (descending) and then by the variance of enrollment (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_enrollment, ic.enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS overall_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) oa ON ic.avg_enrollment > oa.overall_avg_enrollment ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC, des.enrollment_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, courses that have more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments?

For each department, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree-granting, and only include departments that are not 'Political Science' (Course 17)?

For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry and Biology), what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 total units), and which of these departments have an average total units greater than the overall average total units across all such courses?

For each department, list the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree-granting, and excluding 'Political Science' (Course 17)), but only include those departments where the average enrollment is greater than the overall average enrollment across all such departments.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_enrollment, ic.enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS overall_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) oa ON ic.avg_enrollment > oa.overall_avg_enrollment ORDER BY ic.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department, either (1) list each subject code and department name where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, along with the number of unique subject titles, the minimum total units, and the school name, or (2) list the department name, the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term, and the department phone number, where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10. For each row, also include a reason for inclusion ('SubjectStats' for subject statistics and 'EnrollmentStats' for enrollment statistics). The columns should be: subject code, department name, number of unique subject titles, minimum total units, total enrollments, school name, department phone number, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_unique_subject_titles, s1.min_total_units, NULL AS total_enrollments, NULL AS school_name, NULL AS department_phone_number, 'SubjectStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS num_unique_subject_titles, NULL AS min_total_units, s2.total_enrollments, NULL AS school_name, NULL AS department_phone_number, 'EnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_unique_subject_titles, min_total_units, total_enrollments, Reason FROM CombinedResults ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_unique_subject_titles, ic.min_total_units, ic.total_enrollments, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number, ic.Reason FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.Reason, ic.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, give the number of unique subject titles and the minimum total units.

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term, where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10, only for the Mathematics department (Course 18).

List, for the Mathematics department, either (1) each subject code and department name where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, along with the number of unique subject titles and the minimum total units, or (2) the department name and the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10. For each row, also include a reason for inclusion ('SubjectStats' for subject statistics and 'EnrollmentStats' for enrollment statistics). The columns should be: subject code, department name, number of unique subject titles, minimum total units, total enrollments, and reason, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_unique_subject_titles, s1.min_total_units, NULL AS total_enrollments, 'SubjectStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS num_unique_subject_titles, NULL AS min_total_units, s2.total_enrollments, 'EnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_unique_subject_titles, min_total_units, total_enrollments, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason, SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department that offers more than five subjects or is the Mathematics department, and is not the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, and the average number of lecture units for those subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptTotalUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtu.stddev_total_units, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev FROM DeptTotalUnitsStats dtu JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.stddev_total_units, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.enrolled_stddev, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.stddev_total_units, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.enrolled_stddev ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that offer more than five subjects, are degree granting, and specifically include the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department (Course 6).

For each department that is degree granting, offers more than five subjects or is the Mathematics department, and is not the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, what is the department name, the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH DeptTotalUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtu.stddev_total_units, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev FROM DeptTotalUnitsStats dtu JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses, along with the subject title from the course catalog, the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, the responsible faculty name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title for subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department. Also, indicate whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 20% greater than the average for Mathematics in 2005FA), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ), math_subjects_2005fa AS ( SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), math_avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, ms2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFERING_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ms2.window_column, CASE WHEN ms2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ma.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN ms2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < ma.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte icte JOIN math_subjects_2005fa ms2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms2.DEPARTMENT_NAME CROSS JOIN math_avg_enrollment ma
sub_questions: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses.

For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title from the course catalog, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.

For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses, along with the subject title from the course catalog, the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title for subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

WITH math_course_summary AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ), math_subjects_2005fa AS ( SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.course_count, mcs.min_total_units, ms2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFERING_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms2.window_column FROM math_course_summary mcs JOIN math_subjects_2005fa ms2 ON mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: List the department names, their corresponding SIS subject codes, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in degree-granting subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_questions: For each department, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree-granting, and only include departments that are not 'Political Science' (Course 17)?

For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), provide the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, term code, material status key, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject ID, and only include subjects that are also offered by the Biology department.

For each department (excluding 'Political Science'), what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in degree-granting subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, and for each subject offered by the Chemistry department that is also offered by the Biology department, what is the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, term code, material status key, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject ID? Present the department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, term code, material status key, and maximum enrollment in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')

WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), ChemBioSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrollment, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME_FOR_JOIN FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, cbs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cbs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cbs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cbs.TERM_CODE, cbs.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cbs.max_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN ChemBioSubjects cbs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cbs.DEPT_NAME_FOR_JOIN

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and the number of graduate students in each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.GRADUATE_LEVEL, i.Total_Courses, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS Num_Graduate_Students FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.GRADUATE_LEVEL, i.Total_Courses ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department?

For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, considering only departments that have more than 5 subjects offered in the 2022FA term, and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what are the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by the department (considering only degree-granting departments, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding Chemistry), and the standard deviation of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects (considering only if the department has more than 5 subjects offered in the 2022FA term)? List the department name, average total units, variance of total units, standard deviation of total units, and standard deviation of enrolled students, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.var_total_units, d1.stddev_total_units, d2.enrolled_stddev FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN MathEnrolledStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department that grants degrees except for the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department (Course 6), and for each term, provide the term, department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in that term, as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of graduate students in the Mathematics department (Course 18) who have a non-null office phone number. List the term, department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average office phone number, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of office phone number, in that order. Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), MathematicsGradStudentPhones AS ( SELECT AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_CODE THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_CODE END AS term, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev, mgsp.avg_office_phone, mgsp.stddev_office_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MathematicsGradStudentPhones mgsp ON 1=1 ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC;

WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), MathematicsGradStudentPhones AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, mgsp.avg_office_phone, mgsp.stddev_office_phone FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des LEFT JOIN MathematicsGradStudentPhones mgsp ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgsp.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what are the department name, department code, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subject codes offered by the department, the range and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered this year, and whether the department is a "HIGH_VARIANCE" department (if the subject code count variance is at least 10% greater than the average variance across all degree-granting departments), "LOW_VARIANCE" (if at least 10% less), or "AVERAGE"? Please provide the department name, department code, subject code count variance, subject code count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total units range, total units variance, and variance category, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectCodeStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC ), DeptSubjectUnitsStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dscs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dscs.subject_code_count_variance, dscs.subject_code_count_stddev, dsu.total_units_range, dsu.total_units_variance FROM DeptSubjectCodeStats dscs JOIN DeptSubjectUnitsStats dsu ON dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND dscs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsu.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dscs.subject_code_count_variance DESC ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(var_stats.subject_code_count_variance) AS avg_variance FROM ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) var_stats ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.subject_code_count_variance, icte.subject_code_count_stddev, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN icte.subject_code_count_variance > vb.avg_variance * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN icte.subject_code_count_variance < vb.avg_variance * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark vb;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of subject codes offered by that department, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation of subject code counts per department.

For each department, provide the department name and department code, and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered this year, considering only subjects that are letter graded and belong to the Mathematics department.

For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what are the department name, department code, the variance and standard deviation of the number of subject codes offered by the department, as well as the range and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered this year? Please provide the department name, department code, subject code count variance, subject code count standard deviation, total units range, and total units variance, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC;

SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH DeptSubjectCodeStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC ), DeptSubjectUnitsStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dscs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dscs.subject_code_count_variance, dscs.subject_code_count_stddev, dsu.total_units_range, dsu.total_units_variance FROM DeptSubjectCodeStats dscs JOIN DeptSubjectUnitsStats dsu ON dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND dscs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsu.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dscs.subject_code_count_variance DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded, where the department is degree-granting and not Biology. Additionally, for each such Mathematics subject in 2022, list the subject ID and subject title. List the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for Mathematics, the average, range, and variance of total units for Mathematics in 2022 letter-graded, degree-granting, non-Biology subjects, and for each such subject, its subject ID and title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dept_stats.avg_total_units AS dept_avg_total_units_2022, dept_stats.range_total_units, dept_stats.var_total_units, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ORDER BY ccso.SUBJECT_ID;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH math_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT math_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, math_stats.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, math_stats.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dept_stats.avg_total_units AS dept_avg_total_units_2022, dept_stats.range_total_units, dept_stats.var_total_units FROM math_stats LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON math_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department, show the subject ID, subject title, the term description, the department name from the course catalog, the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID, the total number of graduate students in degree-granting Mathematics departments whose student year is 'G', and for each subject, also include the course description long and the school name from the course description table. Do not repeat the subject ID if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by subject ID and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GraduateMathStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathSubjects2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.running_sum_enrolled_students, gms.total_graduate_students FROM MathSubjects2014FA ms JOIN GraduateMathStudents gms ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID END AS SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.running_sum_enrolled_students, inner_cte.total_graduate_students, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH GraduateMathStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathSubjects2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.running_sum_enrolled_students, gms.total_graduate_students FROM MathSubjects2014FA ms JOIN GraduateMathStudents gms ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each administrative department whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2), display the administrative department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, the department name, the average of the total units for courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Chemistry department), the variance of the total units for those courses, and the number of unique subject codes associated with that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_course_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subject_code_count AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_total_units, dcs.var_total_units, scc.num_subject_codes FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_course_stats dcs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN subject_code_count scc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_grad_students_2024 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_math_grad_students FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, mgs.num_math_grad_students FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN math_grad_students_2024 mgs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH dept_units_cv_2024 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_units_stats_2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY units_range DESC ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, mus.units_range, mus.units_variance FROM dept_units_cv_2024 dcv LEFT JOIN math_units_stats_2022 mus ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 10 Mathematics courses that are degree granting and offered this year, display each course's description, department name, school name, course level, subject title, total units, grade type, and the maximum academic year for each course considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by course in alphabetical order, as well as the department (other than Mathematics) with the highest maximum total units among its courses (where that maximum is greater than 6), the maximum total units, and the name of the school that department belongs to. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DeptMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), DeptMaxRanked AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dmu.max_total_units DESC) AS rn FROM DeptMaxUnits dmu ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.GRADE_TYPE, ic.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, dmr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OTHER_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmr.max_total_units, dmr.SCHOOL_NAME AS OTHER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN DeptMaxRanked dmr WHERE dmr.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.COURSE LIMIT 10;

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DeptMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.SCHOOL_NAME, mc.COURSE_LEVEL, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.TOTAL_UNITS, mc.GRADE_TYPE, mc.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OTHER_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME AS OTHER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM MathCourses mc CROSS JOIN DeptMaxUnits dmu;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science), list the department name, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students). Additionally, for the Mathematics department, include the academic year, the number of subjects offered in the fall term for the top 10 academic years with the highest number of subjects offered, and for each of those years, list the titles of the subjects offered in the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ), TopMathSubjectsByYear AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), MathFallSubjects AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccs.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_range, icte.enrollment_variance, tmsby.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tmsby.subject_count, mfs.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN TopMathSubjectsByYear tmsby ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tmsby.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MathFallSubjects mfs ON tmsby.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mfs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND tmsby.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.enrollment_range DESC, tmsby.subject_count DESC, mfs.SUBJECT_TITLE ;
