SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t );

WITH eng_eecs_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), high_unit_departments AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT eec.COURSE, eec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eec.SCHOOL_NAME, eec.window_column, hud.total_units FROM eng_eecs_courses eec JOIN high_unit_departments hud ON eec.DEPARTMENT = hud.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY eec.COURSE;

question: For each department that is not 'Chemistry' (Course 5) and is among the top 10 degree-granting departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects (where the department has at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students and is not the Political Science department), give the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, the count of unique student full names for students named "Zoe", and the department's school name and department phone number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrolled AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopZoeDepts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students FROM DeptEnrolled d JOIN TopZoeDepts t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled, inner_cte.unique_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, but only include departments that are not 'Chemistry' (Course 5).

List the top 10 degree-granting departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects, showing the department name and the count of unique student full names, for departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students and are not the Political Science department (Course 17).

For each department that is not 'Chemistry' (Course 5) and is among the top 10 degree-granting departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects (where the department has at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students and is not the Political Science department), give the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, and the count of unique student full names for students named "Zoe", in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH DeptEnrolled AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopZoeDepts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students FROM DeptEnrolled d JOIN TopZoeDepts t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of subjects offered, the average number of equivalent subjects, the school name, department phone number, and the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in that term (considering only subjects offered this year and with more than 9 total units, excluding the Physics department). Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, AVG( CASE WHEN EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH(EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')) END ) AS avgeqisub FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avgeqisub, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, dmu.max_total_units FROM inner_cte tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cso.TERM_CODE, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 AND sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY cso.TERM_CODE, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dmu ON tbltmp.term = dmu.TERM_CODE AND tbltmp.dept = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;
sub_questions: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, ordered by department name.

For each department that is degree-granting, excluding the Physics department, what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units?

For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the average department budget code within each school, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024 (considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units and excluding the Physics department), and the subject title for that subject, ordered by department name, subject code, and subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptMaxUnitsSubjects AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.avg_dept_budget_code, dmus.max_total_units, dmus.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM MathSubjects ms JOIN DeptMaxUnitsSubjects dmus ON ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, dmus.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the department name, department code, and for each subject offered by that department with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, show the subject id, subject title, and total units, but only include subjects where the total units exceed the average total units for Mathematics subjects (with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0). Also, include the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code for the Mathematics department (where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), AvgUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptEnrolledBudget AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, deb.min_num_enrolled_students, deb.avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte i JOIN AvgUnits a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptEnrolledBudget deb ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = deb.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units ORDER BY i.TOTAL_UNITS DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department give the department code, the department name, the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are Mathematics (Course 18)?

For the Mathematics department (Course 18), give the department name, department code, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0), as well as the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code (where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000). Present the results in the order of decreasing range of total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptEnrolledBudget AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deb.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, deb.min_num_enrolled_students, deb.avg_dept_budget_code FROM DeptUnitsStats dus JOIN DeptEnrolledBudget deb ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = deb.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, and the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name. Additionally, for each subject offered in the 'Engineering' school with total units greater than 0 and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department (Course 6), where the student's department matches the subject's offer department code, show the subject title, total units, subject department name, course description, and the dense rank over the offer department code ordered by offer department code. Finally, for each such subject, include the corresponding department's school name and whether the total units are 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 12), 'LOW_LOAD' (at most 6), or 'MEDIUM_LOAD' (otherwise). Present the columns in the following order: first name, last name, department name, student year, department full name, administrative department name, average department phone number (windowed), subject title, total units, subject department name, course description, dense rank (windowed), department school name, and subject load category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.FIRST_NAME, sd.LAST_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.window_column AS student_window_column, sbd.SUBJECT_TITLE, sbd.TOTAL_UNITS, sbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sbd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sbd.window_column AS subject_window_column, sbd.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) sd JOIN ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) sbd ON sd.DEPARTMENT = sbd.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.student_window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.subject_window_column, d.SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS >= 12 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS <= 6 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'MEDIUM_LOAD' END AS SUBJECT_LOAD_CATEGORY FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: Show the full name, department name, school name, SIS administrative department name, student year dense rank (ordered by student year), the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by their department in the most recent academic year (for degree-granting departments except Biology), and the total number of distinct courses offered by their department, for each student in the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), department_cv AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), political_science_students AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT ps.FULL_NAME, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.student_year_rank, dc.DEPT_CV FROM political_science_students ps LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, coefficient_of_variation AS DEPT_CV FROM department_cv ) dc ON ps.DEPARTMENT = dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.student_year_rank, icte.DEPT_CV, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.student_year_rank, icte.FULL_NAME;

question: For each student in the Political Science department (Course 17), show the student's full name, their department name, the corresponding school name, the SIS administrative department name, the student's dense rank over student year (ordered by student year), the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by their department in the most recent academic year (only for departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Biology department), and the deviation of the average total units for their department from the overall average total units across all degree-granting departments (excluding Biology) in the most recent academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), department_cv AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM dept_units ), political_science_students AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT ps.FULL_NAME, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.student_year_rank, dc.coefficient_of_variation AS dept_cv, (dc.avg_total_units - oa.overall_avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM political_science_students ps LEFT JOIN department_cv dc ON ps.DEPARTMENT = dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ps.student_year_rank, ps.FULL_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For the top 10 subject titles offered by the Chemistry department that have at least one enrolled student and at least one course material record, display each subject's title, the department name, the number of course materials assigned, the name of each degree-granting department (excluding Physics) whose department code matches the Chemistry subject's offering department, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING num_course_materials > 0 ORDER BY num_course_materials DESC, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE LIMIT 10 ), dept_cv AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_subject_count AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.num_course_materials, dept_cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEGREE_DEPT_NAME, dept_cv.coefficient_of_variation, dept_subject_count.num_subjects_2022 FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_cv ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN dept_subject_count ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_subject_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.num_course_materials DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: List the top 10 subject titles offered by the Chemistry department along with their department names and the number of course materials assigned to each, for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and at least one course material record.

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department (Course 8).

For the top 10 subject titles offered by the Chemistry department that have at least one enrolled student and at least one course material record, display each subject's title, the department name, the number of course materials assigned, the name of each degree-granting department (excluding Physics) whose department code matches the Chemistry subject's offering department, and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING num_course_materials > 0 ORDER BY num_course_materials DESC, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE LIMIT 10;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH chem_top10 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING num_course_materials > 0 ORDER BY num_course_materials DESC, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE LIMIT 10 ), dept_cv AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT chem_top10.SUBJECT_TITLE, chem_top10.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, chem_top10.num_course_materials, dept_cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEGREE_DEPT_NAME, dept_cv.coefficient_of_variation FROM chem_top10 LEFT JOIN dept_cv ON chem_top10.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY chem_top10.num_course_materials DESC, chem_top10.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For the top 10 Mathematics departments (Course 18) with the highest number of associated administrative departments, and for each, show the department's name, the number of associated administrative departments, the department code, the number of library subjects offered, the total number of students enrolled in TIP subjects for departments that had at least 5 students enrolled in TIP subjects in 2020FA, and the total number of unique responsible faculty who taught TIP subjects in 2020FA. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_tip_library AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_library_subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_tip_enrollment FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 5 ), faculty_counts AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS num_unique_faculty FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.admin_dept_count, dtl.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dtl.num_library_subjects, dtl.total_tip_enrollment, fc.num_unique_faculty FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_tip_library dtl ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtl.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN faculty_counts fc ON dtl.DEPARTMENT_CODE = fc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY icte.admin_dept_count DESC, dtl.total_tip_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: List the top 10 department names along with the number of associated administrative departments, considering only departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, what is the department code, department name, the number of library subjects offered, and the total number of students enrolled in TIP subjects for departments that had at least 5 students enrolled in TIP subjects in 2020FA, limited to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

From the top 10 Mathematics departments (Course 18) with the highest number of associated administrative departments, display each department's name, the number of associated administrative departments, the department code, the number of library subjects offered, and the total number of students enrolled in TIP subjects for departments that had at least 5 students enrolled in TIP subjects in 2020FA.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_library_subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_tip_enrollment FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 5;

WITH admin_dept_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_tip_library AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_library_subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_tip_enrollment FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 5 ) SELECT adc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, adc.admin_dept_count, dtl.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dtl.num_library_subjects, dtl.total_tip_enrollment FROM admin_dept_counts adc JOIN dept_tip_library dtl ON adc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtl.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY adc.admin_dept_count DESC, dtl.total_tip_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, list the department code, department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, and the reason for inclusion ('UnitsStats' for departments that are degree granting, not Chemistry or Biology, and have subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and 'MathStats' for Mathematics departments with number of enrolled students between 1 and 10 or department budget code at least 90000, and department budget code between 90000 and 200000). Additionally, only include departments whose names also appear in the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. Show the columns in the order: department code, department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, NULL AS min_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS avg_dept_budget_code, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats dus UNION ALL SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, mds.min_num_enrolled_students, mds.avg_dept_budget_code, 'MathStats' AS Reason FROM MathDeptStats mds ) SELECT cds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.avg_total_units, cds.range_total_units, cds.var_total_units, cds.min_num_enrolled_students, cds.avg_dept_budget_code, cds.Reason FROM CombinedDeptStats cds ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.range_total_units, icte.var_total_units, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, icte.Reason FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.Reason;

sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments.

For each department give the department code, the department name, the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are Mathematics (Course 18)?

List, for each department, the department code, department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, and the reason for inclusion ('UnitsStats' for departments that are degree granting, not Chemistry or Biology, and have subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and 'MathStats' for Mathematics departments with number of enrolled students between 1 and 10 or department budget code at least 90000, and department budget code between 90000 and 200000). The columns should be shown in the order: department code, department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, and reason.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, NULL AS min_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS avg_dept_budget_code, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats dus UNION ALL SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, mds.min_num_enrolled_students, mds.avg_dept_budget_code, 'MathStats' AS Reason FROM MathDeptStats mds ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units, min_num_enrolled_students, avg_dept_budget_code, Reason FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the subject title with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), the maximum number of enrolled students, the subject code, the subject title, the school name, and the rank within each school name group ordered by subject code for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, along with the responsible faculty name for each 2024 subject? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, m.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE_2024, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte m JOIN ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) s ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.window_column, s.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term, and what is the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, considering only departments that are degree granting, where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code.

For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the subject title with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), the maximum number of enrolled students, the subject code, the subject title, the school name, and the rank within each school name group ordered by subject code for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH MaxEnrollmentPerDepartment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ), MathSubjects2024 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, m.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE_2024, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column FROM MaxEnrollmentPerDepartment m JOIN MathSubjects2024 s ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.window_column, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by the Mathematics department (Course 18), which is a degree-granting department and not the Department of Physics, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by the Mathematics department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), as well as the subject ID, subject title, the number of enrolled students, the total number of lecture units for each subject, and the course description for the department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_range, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.enrolled_students_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ) ms ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by the Mathematics department (Course 18), which is a degree-granting department and not the Department of Physics, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by the Mathematics department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), as well as the subject ID, subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of lecture units for each subject.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_range, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.LECTURE_UNITS FROM dept_enrollment_stats des JOIN math_subjects_2022 ms ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school (excluding the Political Science department), the average and variance of the department budget codes for the Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry departments in that school, and classify the school as 'HIGH_BUDGET' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_BUDGET' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME ), AvgAndVarianceBudget AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ) SELECT g.SCHOOL_NAME, g.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, a.avg_budget, a.budget_variance FROM GeometricMeanDeptBudget g JOIN AvgAndVarianceBudget a ON g.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY g.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, avg_budget, budget_variance, CASE WHEN geometric_mean_dept_budget_code > avg_budget * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_BUDGET' WHEN geometric_mean_dept_budget_code < avg_budget * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_BUDGET' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte;

WITH GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME ), AvgAndVarianceBudget AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ) SELECT g.SCHOOL_NAME, g.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, a.avg_budget, a.budget_variance FROM GeometricMeanDeptBudget g JOIN AvgAndVarianceBudget a ON g.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY g.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department except the Biology department (Course 7), show the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and for each student in the Political Science department (Course 17), display the student's full name, the corresponding school name, the SIS administrative department name, the dense rank of the student over student year, and the number of subjects offered by the student's department in the most recent academic year. Order the results by department name and student year rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), Department_CV AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), Political_Science_Students AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, pss.FULL_NAME, pss.SCHOOL_NAME, pss.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank, pss.DEPARTMENT FROM Department_CV dcv JOIN Political_Science_Students pss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = pss.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.student_year_rank, sub_count.subjects_offered FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_offered FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs WHERE ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) sub_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT = sub_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.student_year_rank;

Show the full name of each student in the Political Science department, their department name, the corresponding school name, and the SIS administrative department name, along with dense ranks over the student's year, ordered by student year, and only include students whose department is Course 17.

For each degree-granting department except the Biology department (Course 7), give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and for each student in the Political Science department (Course 17), show the student's full name, the corresponding school name, the SIS administrative department name, and the dense rank of the student over student year, ordered by department name and student year rank.
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR;

WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), Department_CV AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), Political_Science_Students AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, pss.FULL_NAME, pss.SCHOOL_NAME, pss.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank FROM Department_CV dcv JOIN Political_Science_Students pss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = pss.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Biology department), what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), and for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, what are the subject code, subject number, subject title, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, the school name, and the department phone number? Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name and subject rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.window_column) = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte d JOIN ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.window_column;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7)?

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code.

For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Biology department), what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), and for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, what are the subject code, subject number, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code?
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.window_column FROM DeptStats d JOIN MathSubjects m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.window_column;

question: For each organization (excluding organizations '138' and '250', and those not named 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'), and for each academic building (excluding buildings named "Ashdown House") associated with that organization, what is the organization name, the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, the building's full name, the building's postal code, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms (only including buildings where the average room area is greater than zero), and the total number of rooms in the building? Show the organization name, geometric mean, building full name, postal code, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and number of rooms, ordered by geometric mean descending and then coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, abs.POSTAL_CODE, abs.coefficient_of_variation, abs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) ogm JOIN ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ) abs ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = abs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.POSTAL_CODE, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH OrgGeometricMean AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), AcademicBuildingStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ) SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, abs.POSTAL_CODE, abs.coefficient_of_variation FROM OrgGeometricMean ogm JOIN AcademicBuildingStats abs ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = abs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ogm.geometric_mean DESC, abs.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department (excluding Political Science and Chemistry) that grants degrees and offers at least two subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, list the department name, the average number of enrolled students in its subjects, the variance of the number of enrolled students, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, the normalized variance (variance divided by average, rounded to two decimals), the school name, and the department phone number. Order the results by normalized variance in descending order.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dc.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(des.enrollment_variance / NULLIF(des.avg_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN DeptCoeffVar dc ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.normalized_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.normalized_variance DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;
