For each Mathematics department that has a minimum number of enrolled students between 1 and 10 or a department budget code of at least 90000, and a department budget code between 90000 and 200000, show the department code, the department name, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, where the department is degree granting, and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments), with the columns shown in this order: department code, department name, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, total units range, total units variance, and total units standard deviation.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH DeptMathStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dms.min_num_enrolled_students, dms.avg_dept_budget_code, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DeptMathStats dms JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For graduate students whose department is degree granting and who are in the Mathematics department, show the department name, department full name, student full name, and student email address, along with dense ranks over the school code ordered by school code. Also, for their department, include the range and variance of CIP program codes among its degree granting courses with non-null CIP program code in the Mathematics department. Additionally, show the subject code and subject code description for all subject codes associated with the Mathematics department. List the results ordered by school code dense rank, student full name, and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.department_full_name, ic.student_full_name, ic.student_email_address, ic.school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.school_code_dense_rank, ic.student_full_name, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE
sub_questions: Show the department name, department full name, student full name, and student email address, along with dense ranks over the school code, ordered by school code, for students whose student year is 'G', whose department is degree granting, and who are in the Mathematics department.

For each department, what is the department's full name, and what are the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses that are degree granting, have a non-null CIP program code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For graduate students whose department is degree granting and who are in the Mathematics department, show the department name, department full name, student full name, and student email address, along with dense ranks over the school code ordered by school code. Also, for their department, include the range and variance of CIP program codes among its degree granting courses with non-null CIP program code in the Mathematics department. List the results ordered by school code dense rank and student full name.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18';

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME

WITH StudentInfo AS ( SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT si.department_name, si.department_full_name, si.student_full_name, si.student_email_address, si.school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM StudentInfo si JOIN DepartmentCIPStats dcs ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY si.school_code_dense_rank, si.student_full_name

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and, for the Mathematics department, also display the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during non-summer fall terms. List the results in descending order of total courses per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , math_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, mes.avg_enrollment, mes.enrollment_range, mes.enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_stats mes ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mes.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.Total_Courses DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department of Engineering or Science, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 20, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and to the Department of Mathematics.

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department that grants degrees and is either in the School of Engineering or Science, or is the Department of Mathematics, and where the total number of enrolled students in its courses is greater than 20, display the department name, the total number of enrolled students in its courses, and, if the department is Mathematics, also show the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during non-summer fall terms in the Mathematics department. List the results in descending order of total enrolled students.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

WITH dept_total_enrollment AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20 ), math_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, mes.avg_enrollment, mes.enrollment_range, mes.enrollment_variance FROM dept_total_enrollment dte LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_stats mes ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mes.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dte.total_enrolled_students DESC;

question: From the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Chemistry) that have offered the most subjects in the School of Engineering in 2021 (excluding the Department of Political Science, Course 17), display each department's code, name, full name, the number of subjects offered in the School of Engineering in 2021, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the term in which the department offered the highest number of subjects (with the count for that term). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, t.term_code_with_max_subjects, t.max_subjects_in_term FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TERM_CODE AS term_code_with_max_subjects, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS max_subjects_in_term FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) = ( SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(s2.SUBJECT_ID) AS cnt FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s2 WHERE s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s2.TERM_CODE ) x ) ) t ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP', and are not the Chemistry department.

For each department that is degree-granting, offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, and is not the Department of Political Science (Course 17), provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects.

For each department that is degree-granting, has offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP' (excluding Chemistry), and also offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021 (excluding the Department of Political Science, Course 17), provide the department code, department name, department full name, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, the number of subjects offered in the School of Engineering in 2021, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. List the results ordered by department name.
sub_sqls: WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), eng_dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ede.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dss.range_num_subjects, dss.variance_num_subjects, dss.stddev_num_subjects, ede.subject_count, ede.total_enrollment FROM dept_subject_stats dss JOIN eng_dept_enrollment ede ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ede.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year in the Mathematics department where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, the average total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term that are not variable units, the variance of these total units, and the maximum subject enrollment number for Mathematics subjects in the spring term. Show the results ordered by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.num_unique_subjects, icte.min_total_units, mfall.avg_total_units, mfall.var_total_units, mspring.max_spring_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) mfall ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mfall.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ( SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_spring_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) mspring ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mspring.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathFallUnitsStats AS ( SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.num_unique_subjects, d.min_total_units, m.avg_total_units, m.var_total_units FROM DeptYearSubjectStats d JOIN MathFallUnitsStats m ON d.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY d.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each degree-granting department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and for each subject code in each department, what is the number of students and the minimum student year? Additionally, for each department, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (department name, null, total students, minimum student year). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), SubjectStudentStats AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS min_student_year FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUM(student_count) AS total_students, MIN(min_student_year) AS min_student_year FROM SubjectStudentStats GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(student_count) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, rr.total_students, rr.min_student_year FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN inner_cte ic ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE ;

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), SubjectStudentStats AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS min_student_year FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, sss.SUBJECT_CODE, sss.student_count, sss.min_student_year FROM DeptUnitsStats dus JOIN SubjectStudentStats sss ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each term and department that offers a course and is degree granting (excluding Chemistry department/Course 5), and that is either Chemistry or Biology and has at least one course with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ', list the term, department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department in that term, as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in that term. Also include the school name and department phone number. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT sos.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sos.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT es.TERM_CODE, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, es.enrolled_variance, es.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN DeptUnitStats dus ON es.TERM_CODE = dus.TERM_CODE AND es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, enrolled_variance, enrolled_stddev, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS dept_sort, OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept, VARIANCE(enrolled_variance) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(enrolled_stddev) AS enrolled_stddev, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, MAX(range_total_units) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(var_total_units) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC;

WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), DeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, es.enrolled_variance, es.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN DeptUnitStats dus ON es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department in the School of Science, list the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that grant degrees). For each result, include a reason for inclusion ('AvgStddev' for average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), 'VarianceStddev' for variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Also, include the school name and department phone number for each department. Show the department name, school name, department phone number, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and the reason, in that order. Sort the results by department name and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS department_phone, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'AvgStddev' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS department_phone, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, 'VarianceStddev' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, cs.avg_total_units, cs.stddev_total_units, cs.total_units_variance, cs.total_units_stddev, cs.Reason FROM CombinedStats cs LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, department_phone, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, Reason FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

For each result, include a reason for inclusion ('AvgStddev' for average and standard deviation, 'VarianceStddev' for variance and standard deviation). sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'AvgStddev' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, 'VarianceStddev' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each department that is degree granting, not Chemistry, and has offered more than 5 subjects, and for which the department is also the Political Science department (Course 17), what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, the administrative department name, the academic department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in the academic year 2024, the name of the subject with that maximum total units, and the email addresses of all students in that department, only including results where the maximum total units is greater than 9? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), PoliticalScienceMaxUnits AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS administrative_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS academic_department, t.max_total_units, t.subject_title_with_max_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC), ',', 1 ) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.max_total_units > 9 ) SELECT dsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsd.stddev_total_units, psmu.administrative_department, psmu.academic_department, psmu.max_total_units, psmu.subject_title_with_max_units, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM DeptStddev dsd JOIN PoliticalScienceMaxUnits psmu ON dsd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = psmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON dsd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, and the department is either Chemistry or Biology, provide the department, academic year, count of subjects, and the minimum start date of the term. Additionally, for each department and academic year, include the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and belong to the Mathematics department, considering only library reserve material details with material status 'U'. Also, for each such Mathematics subject, include the earliest term start date from the ACADEMIC_TERMS table. The columns should be: department, academic year, subject count, minimum term start date, minimum academic year for Mathematics fall term subjects with library material status 'U', sum of total units for those Mathematics subjects, and the earliest term start date for those Mathematics subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathFallUnits AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_math_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, m.min_academic_year, m.sum_total_units, m.earliest_math_term_start_date FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN MathFallUnits m;

question: For each degree-granting department except Chemistry, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year. Additionally, for each such department in Mathematics (Course 18) with subjects offered in 2022 with a total of 12 units, also show the subject code, subject title, department name, department full name, course description, course level, school name, and the minimum total units value over each department code group. Finally, for each department, include a grand total row for the average and variance of total units (with nulls for the other columns), ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(var_total_units) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT rs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rs.avg_total_units, rs.var_total_units, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept FROM RollupStats rs LEFT JOIN math_subjects_2022 ms ON rs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY rs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE ;

WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept FROM dept_units_stats dus LEFT JOIN math_subjects_2022 ms ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: Show the academic year, department name, total number of units for all subjects offered in terms with term status 'Previous' where the department is Mathematics and the total units is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean, along with the subject codes and subject code descriptions for those subjects, and the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GraduateMathStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), HighUnitMathYears AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ) SELECT h.ACADEMIC_YEAR, h.DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.total_units, g.total_graduate_students FROM HighUnitMathYears h JOIN GraduateMathStudents g ON h.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.total_graduate_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.total_graduate_students ;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t );

WITH GraduateMathStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), HighUnitMathYears AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ) SELECT h.ACADEMIC_YEAR, h.DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.total_units, g.total_graduate_students FROM HighUnitMathYears h JOIN GraduateMathStudents g ON h.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each graduate student whose department is degree-granting and is 'Political Science' with department code '17', show their full name, email address, department name, subject code, subject code description, and their row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by full name. Additionally, for the administrative department corresponding to their department, show the administrative department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with total units greater than 0, and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department. Also, include the school name and the administrative department phone number for each student. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), PoliticalScienceStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' ) SELECT ps.FULL_NAME, ps.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.window_column, dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM PoliticalScienceStudents ps JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON ps.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ps.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ps.FULL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte;

WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), PoliticalScienceStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' ) SELECT ps.FULL_NAME, ps.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.window_column, dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM PoliticalScienceStudents ps JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON ps.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ps.FULL_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, the average number of enrolled students and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in courses with at least one reserved library material with material status 'U' and offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department, and the total number of reserved library materials with status 'U' for each subject. Only include subjects where the offer department name is 'Chemistry'. Present the columns in the following order: subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, offer department name, windowed minimum enrolled students, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and total reserved materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, l.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq3 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS total_reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY l.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_stddev, COALESCE(subq3.total_reserved_materials, 0) AS total_reserved_materials FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subq2 ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN subq3 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = subq3.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC

Only include subjects where the offer department name is 'Chemistry'. Present the columns in the following order: subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, offer department name, windowed minimum enrolled students, average enrollment, and enrollment standard deviation.
sub_sqls: SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and, for the 'Chemistry' department, also display the total number of enrolled students in Chemistry subjects offered during terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.GRADUATE_LEVEL, i.Total_Courses, ce.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) ce ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ce.department_name ;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms where the term status indicator is 'P', the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department (excluding 'Mathematics' (Course 18)), display the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for degree-granting subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and, if the department is Chemistry (Course 5), also show the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50. Show the results ordered by the range of total units in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ;

WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), chemistry_enrollment AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, c.total_enrolled_students FROM dept_units_stats d LEFT JOIN chemistry_enrollment c ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.department_name ORDER BY d.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each school, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of CIP program codes among all degree-granting courses offered by departments in that school, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18), and for each department name and school name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, what is the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions? Additionally, for each such school, what is the total number of subject codes associated with the Mathematics department? Please provide the school name, variance of CIP program code, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of CIP program code, department name, number of unique courses, minimum CIP program code, and the total number of subject codes, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH school_cip_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_program_code_variance DESC ), math_dept_course_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.cip_program_code_variance, s.cip_program_code_stddev, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.course_count, m.min_cip_code FROM school_cip_stats s JOIN math_dept_course_stats m ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = m.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.cip_program_code_variance, inner_cte.cip_program_code_stddev, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.course_count, inner_cte.min_cip_code, COALESCE(subj.subject_code_count, 0) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ) subj ON inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME = subj.SCHOOL_NAME;

For each school, what is the variance and standard deviation of CIP program codes among all degree-granting courses offered by departments in that school, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18), and for each department name and school name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, what is the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions? Please provide the school name, variance of CIP program code, standard deviation of CIP program code, department name, number of unique courses, and minimum CIP program code, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_program_code_variance DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH school_cip_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_program_code_variance DESC ), math_dept_course_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.cip_program_code_variance, s.cip_program_code_stddev, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.course_count, m.min_cip_code FROM school_cip_stats s JOIN math_dept_course_stats m ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = m.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the department name, department code, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, the average total units for subjects offered by the department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0), the range of total units, the variance of total units, the school name, and the department phone number, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000. Present the results ordered by the range of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptEnrolledBudget AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d2.min_num_enrolled_students, d2.avg_dept_budget_code, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptEnrolledBudget d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.total_units_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptEnrolledBudget AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d2.min_num_enrolled_students, d2.avg_dept_budget_code, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptEnrolledBudget d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, and the school name of the offering department. For each department, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (null, null, department name, null, variance, stddev, school name). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(sc.num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts sc GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_with_school AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, ds.variance_num_students, ds.stddev_num_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, s.variance_num_students, s.stddev_num_students, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM subject_with_school s GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.window_column, s.variance_num_students, s.stddev_num_students, s.SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING (s.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL) OR (s.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NULL) ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE ;
