sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), subq2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.variance_num_students, s2.stddev_num_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For the Mathematics department, show the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers, the subject grade type, the number of subjects, the minimum total units, and the names of responsible faculty, considering only subjects that are letter graded and offered in the current academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Dept_CV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Dept_Grade_Stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dgs.GRADE_TYPE, dgs.subject_count, dgs.min_total_units FROM Dept_CV dcv JOIN Dept_Grade_Stats dgs ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.GRADE_TYPE, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.GRADE_TYPE, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE;

WITH Dept_CV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Dept_Grade_Stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dgs.GRADE_TYPE, dgs.subject_count, dgs.min_total_units FROM Dept_CV dcv JOIN Dept_Grade_Stats dgs ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the administrative department whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2) in the academic year 2024, and for each department that is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18) and offers subjects in regular academic terms, give the administrative department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that administrative department in 2024, the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in regular academic terms, and the number of subjects offered by that department in regular academic terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation AS admin_dept_coefficient_of_variation, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation AS dept_coefficient_of_variation, d.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) d;

sub_sqls: SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

WITH AdminDeptCov AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptCov AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT adc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, adc.coefficient_of_variation AS admin_dept_coefficient_of_variation, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.coefficient_of_variation AS dept_coefficient_of_variation FROM AdminDeptCov adc CROSS JOIN DeptCov dc;

t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.max_total_units_3rows FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER = s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.window_column LIMIT 5 ), term_counts AS ( SELECT t.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), max_term AS ( SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_count FROM term_counts ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.max_total_units_3rows, mt.TERM_CODE AS max_subjects_term_code, mt.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS max_subjects_term_description, mt.subject_count AS max_subjects_count FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN max_term mt ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, question: For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting and offered this year, show the course description, department name, school name, course level, subject title, total units, grade type, and the maximum academic year for each course considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by course in alphabetical order. Additionally, for each such course, provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code for the department and subject code where the department is Mathematics (Course 18) and is degree granting. Also, include the department full name and the subject code description for each course. Present the results with the columns in the following order: course description, department name, department full name, school name, course level, subject title, subject code description, total units, grade type, maximum academic year, number of subject codes, and minimum department budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.COURSE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.GRADE_TYPE, ic.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, mds.subject_code_count, mds.min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MathDeptSubjectStats mds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = mds.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department that offers a course and is degree granting (excluding Chemistry department/Course 5), and that is either Chemistry or Biology and has at least one course with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ', what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department? Additionally, for each such department, what is the total number of unique subjects offered and the maximum number of enrolled students in any single course? List the department name, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, total unique subjects, and maximum enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, dus.total_unique_subjects, dus.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_unique_subjects, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dus ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), DeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, es.enrolled_variance, es.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN DeptUnitStats dus ON es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For students whose employee type is 'Student', who are in department 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their MIT ID, full name, department name, student year, the running sum of MIT IDs within each student year group ordered by MIT ID, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms for their department (excluding 'Mathematics'), and the highest total units of any subject offered in regular academic terms for their department (excluding 'Mathematics'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID ), DepartmentUnitVariation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), DepartmentMaxUnits AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation, dmu.max_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentUnitVariation duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DepartmentMaxUnits dmu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.MIT_ID;

For students whose employee type is 'Student', who are in department 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their MIT ID, full name, department name, student year, the running sum of MIT IDs within each student year group ordered by MIT ID, and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms for their department (excluding 'Mathematics').
sub_sqls: SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

WITH StudentRunningSum AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID ), DepartmentUnitVariation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT srs.MIT_ID, srs.FULL_NAME, srs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, srs.STUDENT_YEAR, srs.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation FROM StudentRunningSum srs JOIN DepartmentUnitVariation duv ON srs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY srs.STUDENT_YEAR, srs.MIT_ID;

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by the Mathematics department (considering only courses with total units greater than zero and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department), and indicate whether the maximum total units for 3 rows is at least 20% greater than the department's geometric mean ('ABOVE_BENCHMARK'), at least 20% less ('BELOW_BENCHMARK'), or otherwise 'WITHIN_RANGE'. Only include results where the geometric mean of total units for the department is greater than 8. List the columns in the order: subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, maximum total units for 3 rows, geometric mean total units, and the benchmark comparison. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ), DepartmentGeometricMean AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows, dgm.geometric_mean_total_units, CASE WHEN ms.max_total_units_3rows > dgm.geometric_mean_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' WHEN ms.max_total_units_3rows < dgm.geometric_mean_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_BENCHMARK' ELSE 'WITHIN_RANGE' END AS benchmark_comparison FROM inner_cte ms JOIN DepartmentGeometricMean dgm ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dgm.geometric_mean_total_units > 8 ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code.

For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than zero, and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department?

For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, and the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by the Mathematics department (considering only courses with total units greater than zero and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department), but only include results where the geometric mean of total units for the department is greater than 8. List the columns in the order: subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, maximum total units for 3 rows, and geometric mean total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ), DepartmentGeometricMean AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows, dgm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM MathSubjects ms JOIN DepartmentGeometricMean dgm ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dgm.geometric_mean_total_units > 8 ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.TERM_CODE;

question: From the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Chemistry) with the highest average total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, display each department's name, average and variance of total units, and for each such department in Mathematics (Course 18) with subjects offered in 2022 with a total of 12 units, also show the subject code, subject title, department name, department full name, course description, course level, school name, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by average total units descending and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.var_total_units, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept FROM ( SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME LIMIT 10 ) icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) ms ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.avg_total_units DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department.

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that are degree-granting, show the subject code, subject title, department name, department full name, course description, course level, school name, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department code.

For each degree-granting department except Chemistry, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, and for each such department in Mathematics (Course 18) with subjects offered in 2022 with a total of 12 units, also show the subject code, subject title, department name, department full name, course description, course level, school name, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department name and subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept FROM dept_units_stats dus LEFT JOIN math_subjects_2022 ms ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) and excluding subjects offered by the Department of Physics, provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, the total number of lecture units, and, for each responsible faculty member, the number of subjects they are responsible for in the Mathematics department in 2022. For each faculty member, also include a grand total for all subjects they are responsible for in the format of (faculty name, null, total subjects). List the results in order of faculty name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ), FacultySubjectCounts AS ( SELECT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUBJECT_ID ), FacultyTotals AS ( SELECT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ) SELECT isc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, isc.SUBJECT_ID, ict.SUBJECT_TITLE, ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ict.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ict.LECTURE_UNITS, isc.subject_count FROM FacultySubjectCounts isc JOIN inner_cte ict ON isc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = ict.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AND isc.SUBJECT_ID = ict.SUBJECT_ID UNION ALL SELECT ft.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ft.SUBJECT_ID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, ft.total_subjects FROM FacultyTotals ft ORDER BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUBJECT_ID ;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18), provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of lecture units, but exclude subjects offered by the Department of Physics.

For each department, provide the department name and department code, and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered this year, considering only subjects that are letter graded and belong to the Mathematics department.

For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) and excluding subjects offered by the Department of Physics, provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, the total number of lecture units, as well as the range and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered this year in the Mathematics department. List the results in order of subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'

SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ), MathDeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, mds.total_units_range, mds.total_units_variance FROM MathSubjects2022 ms JOIN MathDeptUnitStats mds ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with more than zero total units, the average, range, and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in current or previous terms, and also include a grand total row for all academic years (with null for academic year and academic year description) showing the overall coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average, range, and variance. List the academic year, academic year description, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average total units, total units range, and total units variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_range, us.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cov JOIN UnitsStats us ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ccso.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) OR atp.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') ) ;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are current or previous terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, give the academic year, academic year description, the coefficient of variation of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with more than zero total units, and also provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in current or previous terms. List the academic year, academic year description, coefficient of variation, average total units, total units range, and total units variance in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_range, us.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cov JOIN UnitsStats us ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, academic year description, the average, range, and variance of total units for Mathematics subjects in regular terms, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the current term, and also include the maximum and minimum total units for Mathematics subjects in regular terms. The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, maximum total units, minimum total units, variance of total units for current term, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for current term, and reason for inclusion ('Yearly' for yearly statistics and 'CurrentTerm' for current term statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) , CurrentYearMathStats AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) , CombinedMathStats AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_total_units, i.range_total_units, i.var_total_units, i.max_total_units, i.min_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'Yearly' AS Reason FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, NULL AS max_total_units, NULL AS min_total_units, c.total_units_variance, c.total_units_stddev, 'CurrentTerm' AS Reason FROM CurrentYearMathStats c ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units, max_total_units, min_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, Reason FROM CombinedMathStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason;

The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, variance of total units for current term, standard deviation of total units for current term, and reason.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH YearlyMathStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), CurrentYearMathStats AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), CombinedMathStats AS ( SELECT y.ACADEMIC_YEAR, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, y.avg_total_units, y.range_total_units, y.var_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'Yearly' AS Reason FROM YearlyMathStats y UNION ALL SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, c.total_units_variance, c.total_units_stddev, 'CurrentTerm' AS Reason FROM CurrentYearMathStats c ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, Reason FROM CombinedMathStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason;

question: For the Physics department (Course 8), list the department name, the average, range, and variance of CIP program codes for all undergraduate courses offered by that department (where the department is degree granting), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0). Show the department name, average CIP program code, CIP program code range, CIP program code variance, average total units, total units range, and total units variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Physics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_cip_code, i.cip_code_range, i.cip_code_variance, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_range, u.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Physics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) u ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

Show the department name, average CIP program code, CIP program code range, CIP program code variance, average total units, total units range, and total units variance, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH CIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ), UnitStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.avg_cip_code, c.cip_code_range, c.cip_code_variance, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_range, u.total_units_variance FROM CIPStats c JOIN UnitStats u ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree granting and offers more than five subjects or is the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the geometric mean of the clearing cost collector values for that department (if available, considering only departments where the clearing cost collector is greater than zero and excluding Mathematics), and the number of unique course descriptions associated with that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), GeometricMeanCost AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), CourseDescriptionCount AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS num_course_descriptions FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean, c.num_course_descriptions FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN GeometricMeanCost g ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN CourseDescriptionCount c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH StddevUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), GeometricMeanCost AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean FROM StddevUnits s LEFT JOIN GeometricMeanCost g ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For the top 10 departments by number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Political Science and Biology departments, and only including departments that grant degrees), provide each department's name, the count of subjects offered, the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022, and the name of the school to which the department belongs. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Top10DeptSubjectCount AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.subject_count, d.total_units_variance FROM Top10DeptSubjectCount t JOIN DeptUnitsVariance d ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '9' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y';

WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Top10DeptSubjectCount AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.subject_count, d.total_units_variance FROM Top10DeptSubjectCount t JOIN DeptUnitsVariance d ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science and Chemistry), list the department name, the average number of enrolled students in its subjects (where the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), the variance of enrolled students, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, but also include, for each school, a grand total row (with null for department name) showing the average, variance, and coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for all degree-granting departments in that school (excluding Political Science and Chemistry), only for cases where the average enrollment is greater than 30 and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is less than 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DepartmentCoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dcov.coefficient_of_variation FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des JOIN DepartmentCoefficientOfVariation dcov ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcov.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE des.avg_enrollment > 30 AND dcov.coefficient_of_variation < 1 ORDER BY des.SCHOOL_NAME, des.enrollment_variance DESC ) , SchoolRollup AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_variance, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, coefficient_of_variation FROM SchoolRollup ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DepartmentCoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dcov.coefficient_of_variation FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des JOIN DepartmentCoefficientOfVariation dcov ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcov.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE des.avg_enrollment > 30 AND dcov.coefficient_of_variation < 1 ORDER BY des.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: List each department's name, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code description, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and, for the Mathematics department, also include the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for its subjects (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, mus.avg_total_units, mus.total_units_variance, mus.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) mus ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, mus.avg_total_units, mus.total_units_variance, mus.total_units_stddev FROM DeptEnrolledStats des LEFT JOIN MathUnitsStats mus ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all degree-granting courses in that department (excluding the Mathematics department), and for each subject offered by departments in the School of Engineering that are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Course 6), show the subject ID, subject title, department name, department full name, the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), and the current number of enrolled students. Additionally, indicate whether the number of enrolled students for each subject is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 20% greater than the average enrollment for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Show all these columns in the following order: department name, average CIP program code, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of CIP program code, subject ID, subject title, department full name, subject rank in department, number of enrolled students, and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EECSSubjects AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ), EECSDeptAvgEnroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EECSSubjectsWithCategory AS ( SELECT es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.subject_rank_in_department, es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ed.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < ed.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM EECSSubjects es JOIN EECSDeptAvgEnroll ed ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_cip_program_code, icte.stddev_cip_program_code, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS subject_rank_in_department, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte icte UNION ALL SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_cip_program_code, NULL AS stddev_cip_program_code, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.subject_rank_in_department, es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, es.enrollment_category FROM EECSSubjectsWithCategory es ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_cip_program_code, stddev_cip_program_code, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_rank_in_department, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, enrollment_category FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID;

WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EECSSubjects AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.stddev_cip_program_code, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS subject_rank_in_department FROM DeptCIPStats dcs UNION ALL SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_cip_program_code, NULL AS stddev_cip_program_code, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.subject_rank_in_department FROM EECSSubjects es ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_cip_program_code, stddev_cip_program_code, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_rank_in_department FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department that grants degrees, is not the Biology department (Course 7), and is not the Chemistry department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with a non-null subject code description), the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than zero), and the average number of enrolled students in the subject offerings (again, only for subjects with a non-null subject code description)? Please provide the department name, the variance, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the geometric mean of total units, and the average number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), AvgEnrolled AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, gm.geometric_mean_total_units, ae.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN GeometricMeanUnits gm ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = gm.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN AvgEnrolled ae ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ae.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ae.DEPARTMENT_CODE
