WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_students_variance, es.enrolled_students_stddev, gm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN GeometricMeanUnits gm ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = gm.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in Mathematics courses that are offered in the current term, have more than zero enrolled students, and have available course materials, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all Mathematics subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects offered in the current term). Additionally, for each department, include the department name, the total number of Mathematics subjects offered in the current term for that department, and a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, null, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), RollupDeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM DeptSubjectCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_subjects) > 0 ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.enrolled_range, i.enrolled_variance, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.total_subjects FROM inner_cte i JOIN UnitsStats u ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN RollupDeptCounts r ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = r.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each degree-granting department except Mathematics, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and, if the department is Chemistry, also provide the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in Chemistry courses that have at least one associated material record, along with the total number of such Chemistry courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ChemDeptStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_chem_courses_with_material FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.range_enrolled_students, d.var_enrolled_students, c.avg_enrollment, c.enrollment_variance, c.num_chem_courses_with_material FROM DeptEnrollmentStats d LEFT JOIN ChemDeptStats c ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department that grants degrees, is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, what is the department name, the maximum CIP program code, and the full name of the department, and for each subject in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department, what is the subject ID, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of the subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID, and the number of enrolled students in that subject offering? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_max_cip AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ), eng_eecs_subjects AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmc.max_cip_code, dmc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ees.SUBJECT_ID, ees.SUBJECT_TITLE, ees.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ees.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ees.subject_rank_in_dept FROM dept_max_cip dmc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN eng_eecs_subjects ees ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ees.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_cip_code, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID

question: For the top 10 academic years in which the Mathematics department offered the highest number of subjects in the fall term, show the department name, academic year, number of subjects offered, and for the Mathematics department, also show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes per course offered by that department (considering only degree-granting courses), as well as the total number of degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department in those years. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentSubjectCodeStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC ), TopSubjectsByDepartmentYear AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.subject_count, d.subject_count_range, d.subject_count_variance, d.subject_count_stddev FROM TopSubjectsByDepartmentYear t JOIN DepartmentSubjectCodeStats d ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t.subject_count DESC, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.subject_count_range, icte.subject_count_variance, icte.subject_count_stddev, dg_course_counts.total_degree_granting_courses FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_degree_granting_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dg_course_counts ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dg_course_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH DepartmentSubjectCodeStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC ), TopSubjectsByDepartmentYear AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.subject_count, d.subject_count_range, d.subject_count_variance, d.subject_count_stddev FROM TopSubjectsByDepartmentYear t JOIN DepartmentSubjectCodeStats d ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t.subject_count DESC, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each department that is not 'Chemistry' (Course 5) and is among the top 10 degree-granting departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects (where the department has at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students and is not the Political Science department), give the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, the count of unique student full names for students named "Zoe", and the maximum number of enrolled students in a single subject offered by that department, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrolled AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopZoeDepts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students FROM DeptEnrolled d JOIN TopZoeDepts t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, ic.unique_students, MAX(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrolled_in_subject FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = su.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, ic.unique_students;

WITH DeptEnrolled AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopZoeDepts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students FROM DeptEnrolled d JOIN TopZoeDepts t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject code in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that is degree-granting and offered by a department with more than 5 subjects in the 2022FA term, and for which the subject is offered in the 2022FA term, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, the subject code, the subject code description, the subject title, and the running sum of department budget codes within each school, ordered by subject code? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_stddev, msc.SUBJECT_CODE, msc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, msc.running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte des JOIN ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER ( PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) msc ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.SUBJECT_CODE = msc.SUBJECT_CODE AND cso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ORDER BY msc.SUBJECT_CODE;

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH dept_enroll_stddev AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), math_subject_codes AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_stddev, msc.SUBJECT_CODE, msc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, msc.running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM dept_enroll_stddev des JOIN math_subject_codes msc ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY msc.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years with the highest number of subjects offered (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department), what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, and what is the term description for the corresponding term, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units? Additionally, for each of these department-year pairs, what is the number of unique subject titles offered in that year by the Mathematics department with more than 6 total units? List the department name, academic year, subject count, highest total units, term description, and the count of unique subject titles with more than 6 units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MaxUnitsPerYear AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopDepartments AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, td.subject_count, mu.max_total_units, mu.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM TopDepartments td JOIN MaxUnitsPerYear mu ON td.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.max_total_units, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COALESCE(stc.unique_subject_titles, 0) AS unique_subject_titles_with_gt6_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_subject_titles FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) stc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = stc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

WITH MaxUnitsPerYear AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopDepartments AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, td.subject_count, mu.max_total_units, mu.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM TopDepartments td JOIN MaxUnitsPerYear mu ON td.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and is not the Chemistry department, what is the department name, the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than zero), and, if the department is Chemistry or Biology, also give the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and required course materials, as well as the number of such subjects and the sum of their total units? List the department name, geometric mean of total units, average total units, total units range, total units variance, subject count, and total units sum in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjectUnitStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.geometric_mean_total_units, dsu.avg_total_units, dsu.total_units_range, dsu.total_units_variance, dsu.subject_count, dsu.total_units_sum FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectUnitStats dsu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsu.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjectUnitStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, dsu.avg_total_units, dsu.total_units_range, dsu.total_units_variance FROM GeometricMeanUnits gmu LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectUnitStats dsu ON gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsu.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, excluding the Physics department, what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, the subject title for that subject (considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units), and, if the department is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' in the School of Engineering and has more than 5 subjects, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, as well as the number of students enrolled in the subject with the maximum total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_max_units_subjects AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ), eecs_stddev_units AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SUBJECT_TITLE, esu.stddev_total_units, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM dept_max_units_subjects dmu LEFT JOIN eecs_stddev_units esu ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esu.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ss.SUBJECT_TITLE = dmu.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of letter-graded subjects offered in the current academic year, display each department's name, the total number of such subjects, the minimum total units among these subjects, the department's full name, and the maximum total units among all subjects offered by that department in the 2021FA term, considering only degree-granting departments and excluding the Chemistry department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dmu.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) dmu ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH MathLetterGrades AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ), DeptMaxUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT mlg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mlg.GRADE_TYPE, mlg.subject_count, mlg.min_total_units, dmu.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dmu.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM MathLetterGrades mlg JOIN DeptMaxUnits dmu ON mlg.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mlg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mlg.GRADE_TYPE;

question: Show the department names, school names, the number of graduate students, the minimum office phone number, and for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 units in Mathematics, display the subject code, subject number, subject title, and the total number of such subjects per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.student_count, icte.min_office_phone, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, subj_count.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Total_Subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) subj_count ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cso.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2022.window_column FROM DepartmentStudentStats dss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms2022 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms2022.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department, list the department name, the range and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the full name of the corresponding administrative department, and the total number of subjects offered by that department (for all departments that grant degrees except Chemistry). Additionally, for the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), the total number of such subjects, and indicate the reason for inclusion as either 'General' or 'Mathematics'. The columns should be: department name, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, administrative department name, total subjects, variance of enrolled students (Mathematics), standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students (Mathematics), total subjects (Mathematics), and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_math FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_students_range, ds.enrolled_students_variance, ds.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_subjects, NULL AS variance_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS stddev_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS total_subjects_math, 'General' AS Reason FROM DeptStats ds UNION ALL SELECT ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS enrolled_students_range, NULL AS enrolled_students_variance, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_subjects, ms.variance_num_enrolled_students, ms.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ms.total_subjects_math, 'Mathematics' AS Reason FROM MathStats ms ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_range, enrolled_students_variance, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_subjects, variance_num_enrolled_students, stddev_num_enrolled_students, total_subjects_math, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each department, list the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department (for degree-granting departments, subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and restricted to the Mathematics department), as well as the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (for degree-granting departments excluding Political Science). For each department, also include the total number of unique subjects offered by that department (for degree-granting departments), and for each department and subject, include a subtotal of the total units for that subject. Show all results, with the department name, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total subjects, subject id, and subject total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptVarianceStddev AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptCoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjectUnitSubtotals AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS subject_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.total_units_variance, d1.total_units_stddev, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS total_subjects, NULL AS subject_id, NULL AS subject_total_units FROM DeptVarianceStddev d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, d2.coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS total_subjects, NULL AS subject_id, NULL AS subject_total_units FROM DeptCoefficientOfVariation d2 UNION ALL SELECT d3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, d3.total_subjects, NULL AS subject_id, NULL AS subject_total_units FROM DeptSubjectCounts d3 UNION ALL SELECT d4.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS total_subjects, d4.SUBJECT_ID, d4.subject_total_units FROM DeptSubjectUnitSubtotals d4 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_id ;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and provide both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department.

List, for each department, the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department (for degree-granting departments, subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and restricted to the Mathematics department), as well as the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (for degree-granting departments excluding Political Science). Show all results, with the department name, variance, standard deviation, and coefficient of variation, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

WITH DeptVarianceStddev AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptCoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.total_units_variance, d1.total_units_stddev, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptVarianceStddev d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, d2.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptCoefficientOfVariation d2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, along with the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019 (if any, and only if the maximum is greater than 5 and the department is Mathematics or Chemistry), the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, and the maximum number of enrolled students in any TIP course offered by that department in 2019 (if any, and only if the maximum is greater than 5 and the department is Mathematics or Chemistry), and the name of the responsible faculty member for that TIP course. List the results ordered by school name and rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tip_subq.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS_TIP, tip_subq.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME_TIP FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS_TIP, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME_TIP FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) tip_subq ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tip_subq.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the average of the total number of units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year in the Mathematics department with at least 6 total units, what are the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, along with the subject title and the responsible faculty name for each subject? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, ms2.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subject_department_name, ms2.window_column, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) ms2 LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ms2.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022

For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the average of the total number of units, and the standard deviation of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year in the Mathematics department with at least 6 total units, what are the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH math_units_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mus.avg_total_units, mus.stddev_total_units, ms2.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subject_department_name, ms2.window_column FROM math_units_stats mus CROSS JOIN math_subjects_2022 ms2;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of degree-granting courses (excluding the Mathematics department), display each department's name, the total number of degree-granting courses, the average CIP program code for those courses, and, for each subject offered by these departments, show the subject ID, subject title, and the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), including only subjects from degree-granting courses. Show all these columns in the following order: department name, total degree-granting courses, average CIP program code, subject ID, subject title, and subject rank in department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_degree_courses, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_degree_courses DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptSubjects AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_degree_courses, icte.avg_cip_program_code, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS subject_rank_in_department FROM inner_cte icte UNION ALL SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_degree_courses, NULL AS avg_cip_program_code, ds.SUBJECT_ID, ds.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.subject_rank_in_department FROM DeptSubjects ds WHERE ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_degree_courses, avg_cip_program_code, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, subject_rank_in_department FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID;
