List, for each department, the department name, the average and standard deviation of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department (considering only departments and courses that are degree granting and excluding the Mathematics department), and for subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering that are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Course 6), the subject ID, subject title, department name, department full name, and the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), including only subjects from degree-granting courses. Show all these columns in the following order: department name, average CIP program code, standard deviation of CIP program code, subject ID, subject title, department full name, and subject rank in department.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EECSSubjects AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.stddev_cip_program_code, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS subject_rank_in_department FROM DeptCIPStats dcs UNION ALL SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_cip_program_code, NULL AS stddev_cip_program_code, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.subject_rank_in_department FROM EECSSubjects es ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_cip_program_code, stddev_cip_program_code, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_rank_in_department FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID;

question: Among the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding the Biology department, Course 7, and the Mathematics department, Course 18) with the highest total number of subject codes, what are each department's code, name, total number of subject codes, average clearing cost collector, variance of clearing cost collector, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of clearing cost collector for all associated administrative departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_code_count, dcs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM ( SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' ORDER BY subject_code_count DESC, DEPARTMENT_CODE LIMIT 10 ) ic JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.subject_code_count DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the total number of subject codes associated with it, considering only departments that have a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation above the mean across all departments, and only including departments that are degree-granting and are not the Biology department (Course 7)?

For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department, Course 7, and the Mathematics department, Course 18) that has a total number of subject codes greater than one standard deviation above the mean across all departments, what are the department code, department name, total number of subject codes, average clearing cost collector, variance of clearing cost collector, and standard deviation of clearing cost collector for all associated administrative departments? List the results ordered by total number of subject codes descending, then department code.
sub_sqls: WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ), FilteredDepartments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ), DeptClearingCostStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT f.DEPARTMENT_CODE, f.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.subject_code_count, dcs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM FilteredDepartments f JOIN DeptClearingCostStats dcs ON f.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY f.subject_code_count DESC, f.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each of the three departments (excluding Mathematics) with the highest number of associated subject codes, what are their department codes, department names, corresponding admin department names, and the average office phone number of their graduate students, considering only departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP', and are not the Chemistry department? List the department code, department name, admin department name, and average graduate student office phone number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), top3_depts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t3.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM top3_depts t3 WHERE t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_grad_student_office_phone FROM inner_cte icte JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP', and are not the Chemistry department.

Which three departments, excluding the Mathematics department, have the highest number of associated subject codes, and what are their department codes, department names, and corresponding admin department names? (Exclude Mathematics, i.e., Course 18.)

For each of the three departments (excluding Mathematics) with the highest number of associated subject codes, what are their department codes, department names, corresponding admin department names, and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP', and are not the Chemistry department? List the department code, department name, admin department name, range of number of subjects per term, variance of number of subjects per term, and standard deviation of number of subjects per term, in that order.
sub_sqls: WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) DESC LIMIT 3;

WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), top3_depts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t3.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.range_num_subjects, dss.variance_num_subjects, dss.stddev_num_subjects FROM top3_depts t3 JOIN dept_subject_stats dss ON t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 10 academic years with the highest number of Mathematics department subjects offered, display each academic year description, the total number of Mathematics subjects offered, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for those subjects, the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for those IAP activities. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.subject_count, ic.coefficient_of_variation, iap_stats.max_enrollment_variance, iap_stats.max_enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) iap_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = iap_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in terms within that year, but only include subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, what is the variance and standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department, considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled? Also, provide the academic year description.

For each academic year, list the academic year description, the coefficient of variation of the total units for Mathematics department subjects offered in terms within that year, the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), and the standard deviation of the maximum enrollment for those IAP activities.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), IAPMaxEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.coefficient_of_variation, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev FROM CoefficientOfVariation c LEFT JOIN IAPMaxEnrollmentStats i ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.coefficient_of_variation, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAPMaxEnrollmentStats i LEFT JOIN CoefficientOfVariation c ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting and offered this year, show the course description, department name, school name, course level, subject title, total units, grade type, the maximum academic year for each course considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by course in alphabetical order, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects with more than zero total units offered in that academic year, and the number of enrolled students for the corresponding subject in the same term, where the course's academic year and subject id match the statistics and enrollment data. Present the columns in the following order: course description, department name, school name, course level, subject title, total units, grade type, maximum academic year, academic year description, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathYearStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.GRADE_TYPE, icte.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mys.variance_total_units, mys.stddev_total_units, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte JOIN MathYearStats mys ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID AND icte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;
sub_questions: For each course in the Mathematics department, show the course description, department name, school name, course level, subject title, total units, grade type, and the maximum academic year for each course considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by course in alphabetical order, only including courses that are degree granting and are offered this year.

For each academic year, give the academic year description and both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects with more than zero total units and offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting and offered this year, show the course description, department name, school name, course level, subject title, total units, grade type, and the maximum academic year for each course considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by course in alphabetical order, along with the academic year description, the variance of the total units, and the standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that academic year (considering only subjects with more than zero total units and offered by the Mathematics department), where the course's academic year matches the academic year in the statistics. Present the columns in the following order: course description, department name, school name, course level, subject title, total units, grade type, maximum academic year, academic year description, variance of total units, and standard deviation of total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

WITH MathCourseStats AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathYearStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.SUBJECT_TITLE, mcs.TOTAL_UNITS, mcs.GRADE_TYPE, mcs.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mys.variance_total_units, mys.stddev_total_units FROM MathCourseStats mcs JOIN MathYearStats mys ON mcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the department name, the average total units for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, the range of total units, the variance of total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for degree-granting departments, and the ratio of average total units to standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (rounded to two decimal places), but only for subjects whose total units exceed the average total units for all Mathematics subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptUnitsVarianceStddev AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev, ROUND(d1.avg_total_units / NULLIF(d2.total_units_stddev, 0), 2) AS avg_units_to_stddev_ratio FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptUnitsVarianceStddev d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_units_to_stddev_ratio DESC ), MathAvgUnits AS ( SELECT AVG(SOS.TOTAL_UNITS) AS math_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT SD JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY SOS ON SD.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SOS.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SD.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SD.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND SOS.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SOS.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, inner_cte.avg_units_to_stddev_ratio FROM inner_cte, MathAvgUnits, SIS_DEPARTMENT SD JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY SOS ON SD.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SOS.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SD.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SD.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND SOS.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SOS.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SOS.TOTAL_UNITS > MathAvgUnits.math_avg_units GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, inner_cte.avg_units_to_stddev_ratio ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_units_to_stddev_ratio DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with more than zero total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the department name, the average total units for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, the range of total units, the variance of total units, the standard deviation of total units for degree-granting departments, and the ratio of average total units to standard deviation of total units (rounded to two decimal places), considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptUnitsVarianceStddev AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev, ROUND(d1.avg_total_units / NULLIF(d2.total_units_stddev, 0), 2) AS avg_units_to_stddev_ratio FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptUnitsVarianceStddev d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_units_to_stddev_ratio DESC;

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, what is the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the department name, and the deviation of enrolled students from the average number of enrolled students for that department (considering only departments that grant degrees, courses at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology department)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_stats.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_stats ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses that are at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology department? Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, and the variance of enrolled students.

For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title from the course catalog, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.

For each subject offered by the Mathematics department in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, what is the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the department name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, the range of enrolled students, and the variance of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees, courses at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology department)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), MathSubjects2005FA AS ( SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance FROM MathSubjects2005FA ms JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For the top 10 departments with the highest number of subjects offered, display each department's code, name, total subject count, the subject with the highest total units in that department, and the total units for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_max_units AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, smu.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Max_Units_Subject, smu.TOTAL_UNITS AS Max_Subject_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN subject_max_units smu ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = smu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND smu.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that offer more than five subjects, are degree granting, and specifically include the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, what is the total number of subject codes associated with it, considering only departments that have a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation above the mean across all departments, and only including departments that are degree-granting and are not the Biology department (Course 7)?

List, for all departments that either (a) are degree-granting and offer more than five subjects or are the Mathematics department, or (b) are degree-granting, are not the Biology department, and have a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation above the mean across all departments, the department code, department name, the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (if applicable), the total number of subject codes associated with the department (if applicable), and the reason for inclusion ('Stddev' for the first group and 'CodeCount' for the second group), showing the department code, department name, standard deviation of total units, subject code count, and reason in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH DeptStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DeptCodeCounts AS ( WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.stddev_total_units, NULL AS subject_code_count, 'Stddev' AS Reason FROM DeptStddev d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS stddev_total_units, d2.subject_code_count, 'CodeCount' AS Reason FROM DeptCodeCounts d2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, stddev_total_units, subject_code_count, Reason FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, along with the subject title, total units, dense rank over the department code ordered by department code, and the number of subjects offered by the department, for each subject offered by the Mathematics department, ordered by department name and dense rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, dept_subject_counts.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sos2.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_subject_counts ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column

List the subject title, total units, department name, and school name for each subject offered, along with dense ranks over the department code ordered by department code, for subjects offered by departments that are degree granting, have a non-null subject code description, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, along with the subject title, total units, and dense rank over the department code ordered by department code for each subject offered by the Mathematics department, ordered by department name and dense rank.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.avg_dept_budget_code, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.TOTAL_UNITS, sq2.window_column FROM Subquery1 sq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.window_column

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the average department budget code within each school, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024 (excluding Physics), the subject title for that subject, and the number of subjects offered by that department in 2024 with more than 9 total units (excluding Physics), considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units, ordered by department name, subject code, and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subject_count AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.max_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sc.num_subjects FROM inner_cte s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN subject_count sc ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.max_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For the Physics department, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, considering only degree-granting departments and excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department (Course 6). Additionally, report the average total units for Physics subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Physics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.avg_total_units, dccs.clearing_cost_collector_range, dccs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dccs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dccs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DepartmentUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentClearingCostStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dccs.clearing_cost_collector_range, dccs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dccs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM DepartmentUnitsCV dcv JOIN DepartmentClearingCostStats dccs ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, show the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average department budget code, and the number of graduate students in that department (where the minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, and number of graduate students are only included for the Mathematics department where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000), but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). List the department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, and number of graduate students in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), MathematicsEnrollmentBudget AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathematicsGradStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_grad_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, meb.min_num_enrolled_students, meb.avg_dept_budget_code, mgs.num_grad_students FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN MathematicsEnrollmentBudget meb ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = meb.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MathematicsGradStudents mgs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DepartmentUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathematicsEnrollmentBudget AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duc.coefficient_of_variation, meb.min_num_enrolled_students, meb.avg_dept_budget_code FROM DepartmentUnitsCV duc LEFT JOIN MathematicsEnrollmentBudget meb ON duc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = meb.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) and excluding subjects offered by the Department of Physics, provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of lecture units for each subject, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses for which a responsible faculty member is also a member of a Moira list, considering only courses offered this year and only for the Mathematics department. Additionally, for each subject, include the full name and email address of the responsible faculty member if they are also a member of a Moira list. The results should list the subject ID, subject title, department name, number of enrolled students, lecture units, average total units, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, responsible faculty full name, and responsible faculty email address, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ), math_units_stats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), faculty_moira AS ( SELECT ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, mus.avg_total_units, mus.total_units_variance, mus.total_units_stddev, fm.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, fm.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN math_units_stats mus ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN faculty_moira fm ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = fm.SUBJECT_ID;

SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' ), math_units_stats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, mus.avg_total_units, mus.total_units_variance, mus.total_units_stddev FROM math_subjects_2022 ms LEFT JOIN math_units_stats mus ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), CourseStats AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS num_12_unit_subjects_2024, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2024 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column, cs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.admin_dept_dense_rank, ds.num_12_unit_subjects_2024, ds.avg_total_units_2024 FROM inner_cte icte JOIN CourseStats cs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DeptStats ds ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE, cs.admin_dept_dense_rank;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS student_dept_full_name FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.avg_enrolled_students, ds.var_enrolled_students, ds.stddev_enrolled_students, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS student_dept_full_name FROM DeptStats ds UNION ALL SELECT ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS var_enrolled_students, NULL AS stddev_enrolled_students, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.window_column, ms.student_dept_full_name FROM MathSubjects ms ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of Chemistry subjects with at least one enrolled student and at least one course material record, the average number of course materials per subject, the school name, and the department phone number. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avg_materials, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, AVG(num_course_materials) AS avg_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

WITH ChemSubjects AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials, tso.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID HAVING num_course_materials > 0 ORDER BY num_course_materials DESC, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE LIMIT 10 ), DeptVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.num_course_materials, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM ChemSubjects cs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptVariation dv ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.enrolled_stddev, cov.coefficient_of_variation FROM EnrolledStddev es JOIN CoefficientOfVariation cov ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.enrolled_stddev, icte.coefficient_of_variation, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ata.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.enrolled_stddev, icte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
