sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH SubjectUnits AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), GraduateStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT su.SUBJECT_CODE, su.SUBJECT_NUMBER, su.DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.window_column, gs.total_graduate_students, ROUND(su.window_column / NULLIF(gs.total_graduate_students, 0), 2) AS normalized_running_sum FROM SubjectUnits su JOIN GraduateStudents gs ON su.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_running_sum DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry and Mathematics), what is the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the full name of the corresponding administrative department, the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), and the total number of unique subjects offered by that department? List the columns in this order: department name, enrolled students range, enrolled students variance, administrative department full name, average course number ASCII value, variance of course number ASCII value, and total unique subjects offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptCourseNumStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_range, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii, des.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DeptEnrollStats des JOIN DeptCourseNumStats dcs ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_range, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_course_number_ascii, icte.var_course_number_ascii, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_unique_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_range, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_course_number_ascii, icte.var_course_number_ascii ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name, the range and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and what is the full name of the corresponding administrative department, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5)?

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department that grants degrees, excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5) and the Mathematics department (Course 18), give the department name, the range and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the full name of the corresponding administrative department, the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), listing the columns in this order: department name, enrolled students range, enrolled students variance, administrative department full name, average course number ASCII value, and variance of course number ASCII value.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

WITH DeptEnrollStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptCourseNumStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_range, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii FROM DeptEnrollStats des JOIN DeptCourseNumStats dcs ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the School of Engineering in 2019 by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, provide the subject ID, subject title, the department name, the number of enrolled students who are in their graduate year and whose department is degree-granting, as well as the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Biology department), and also include the total number of unique graduate students enrolled in any subject offered by the same department in 2019. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_grad_student_count_2019 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_grad_students_2019 FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.num_enrolled_grad_students, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, dgs.total_grad_students_2019 FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN dept_grad_student_count_2019 dgs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Physics department (Course 8), provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, considering only if the department is degree-granting and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Physics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, a.clearing_cost_collector_range, a.clearing_cost_collector_variance, a.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) a ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Chemistry department, and also include the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not the current term for the Mathematics department where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10. Additionally, for each such department, provide the number of unique academic years in which subjects from that department have been offered since 2010. List the department name, average total units, variance of total units, total enrolled students (for Mathematics only), and the count of unique academic years since 2010. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathDeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), DeptYearCounts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS unique_years_since_2010 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2010 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, mde.total_enrolled, dyc.unique_years_since_2010 FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN MathDeptEnrollment mde ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mde.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptYearCounts dyc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dyc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the average number of students enrolled in fall-term Mathematics courses with at least 1 enrolled student, the variance of enrolled students in those Mathematics courses, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in Biology subjects that have at least one associated course material, and the maximum number of enrolled students in Management courses offered in the spring term? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, b.coefficient_of_variation, mgt.max_enrolled_management FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) b ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_management FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) mgt ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = mgt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_variance DESC, b.coefficient_of_variation DESC, mgt.max_enrolled_management DESC;

WITH MathStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), BioStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.avg_enrolled, m.enrolled_variance, b.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathStats m JOIN BioStats b ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY m.enrolled_variance DESC, b.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each program in the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department that is degree granting, has a non-null department name, and is in Course 6, show the program title, category title, course description, department name, and the dense rank over the school name ordered by school name. Also, for the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, provide the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, excluding the Chemistry department. List the program title, category title, course description, department name, dense rank, average total units, and variance of total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME) AS window_column, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT FROM CIP JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '6' ) , DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.PROGRAM_TITLE, inner_cte.CATEGORY_TITLE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.PROGRAM_TITLE;

question: For each department, show the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials (considering only regular terms and only for the Mathematics department), the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term (including only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department), and the average total units of subjects offered by that department in 2022FA. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH LibraryReserveStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT lrs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lrs.coefficient_of_variation, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev FROM LibraryReserveStats lrs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON lrs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY lrs.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.enrolled_stddev, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2022FA FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.enrolled_stddev ORDER BY icte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all Mathematics subjects offered in current terms, the average total units, the range of total units, the variance of total units for Mathematics subjects offered in current or previous terms, and the number of Mathematics subjects offered in the Fall term of each academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), UnitsStatistics AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_range, us.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cov JOIN UnitsStatistics us ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, COALESCE(fall_count.num_fall_subjects, 0) AS num_fall_math_subjects FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_fall_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE WHERE sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND aca.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) fall_count ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = fall_count.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = fall_count.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the School of Engineering in 2019 by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, provide the subject ID, subject title, the department name, the number of enrolled students who are in their graduate year and whose department is degree-granting, as well as, for each department and school, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department and school (only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Biology department). For each department and school, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (department name, school name, null, null, null, average, variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), DepartmentSchoolEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT dses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dses.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS WITH SubjectGradEnrollment AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT sge.SUBJECT_ID, sge.SUBJECT_TITLE, sge.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sge.num_enrolled_grad_students, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM SubjectGradEnrollment sge JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON sge.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sge.DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sge.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the geometric mean of CIP program codes for all courses in that department where the department is degree granting, the CIP program code is greater than 0, and the department is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student, have required course materials, are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department, and have a course number that starts with '7' or '5'? The results should include the department name, geometric mean of CIP program codes, average total units, total units range, and total units variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanCIP AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_cip DESC ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND ( tso.COURSE_NUMBER LIKE '7%' OR tso.COURSE_NUMBER LIKE '5%' ) GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmc.geometric_mean_cip, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM GeometricMeanCIP gmc LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each degree-granting department with department code '18' (Mathematics), what is the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the term 2019FA, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year (excluding Biology department), and the number of unique subject codes offered by that department in 2024? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), coefficient_variation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), subject_code_count AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_num_enrolled_students, cv.coefficient_of_variation, scc.num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN coefficient_variation cv ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN subject_code_count scc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrollment, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS lowest_enrollment, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_dept_budget_code ORDER BY highest_enrollment DESC;

List the columns in the following order: department code, department name, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, average enrollment, enrollment range, and enrollment variance.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.min_num_enrolled_students, ds.avg_dept_budget_code, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_range, es.enrollment_variance FROM DeptStats ds JOIN EnrollmentStats es ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with a non-null total units value and departments that grant degrees). Additionally, include the total number of unique subjects offered by the department and the total number of unique courses in the course catalog for that department. Present the results in the following order: department name, average total units for subjects, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects, variance of total units for courses, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for courses, number of unique subjects, and number of unique courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), course_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_count AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), course_count AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units AS stddev_total_units_subjects, cs.variance_total_units, cs.stddev_total_units AS stddev_total_units_courses, sc.num_unique_subjects, cc.num_unique_courses FROM inner_cte i JOIN course_stats cs ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subject_count sc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN course_count cc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the average and standard deviation of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), as well as the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with a non-null total units value and departments that grant degrees). Present the results in the following order: department name, average total units for subjects, standard deviation of total units for subjects, variance of total units for courses, and standard deviation of total units for courses.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units AS stddev_total_units_subjects, s2.variance_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units AS stddev_total_units_courses FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department and its corresponding administrative department name, where the department is degree granting, list the department name, the administrative department name, the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, the academic year, the number of subjects offered in the fall term, and the number of undergraduate and graduate subjects offered in the fall term, considering the top 10 academic years with the highest number of subjects offered in the fall term. For each academic year, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (department name, administrative department name, null, null, academic year, total subjects, total undergraduate subjects, total graduate subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentAdminStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopSubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, tso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.subject_count FROM DepartmentAdminStats das JOIN TopSubjectOfferings tso ON das.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tso.subject_count DESC, das.department_count DESC ), SubjectTypeCounts AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(CASE WHEN ccs.HGN_CODE = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undergraduate_subjects, SUM(CASE WHEN ccs.HGN_CODE = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS graduate_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccs.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.department_count, ic.min_budget_code, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, stc.undergraduate_subjects, stc.graduate_subjects FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SubjectTypeCounts stc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = stc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = stc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, department_count, min_budget_code, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, SUM(undergraduate_subjects) AS total_undergraduate_subjects, SUM(graduate_subjects) AS total_graduate_subjects FROM RollupResults GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, department_count, min_budget_code, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, total_subjects DESC ;
sub_questions: For each department and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of departments and the minimum department budget code.

List the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years with the highest number of subjects offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For the Mathematics department and its corresponding administrative department name, where the department is degree granting, list the department name, the administrative department name, the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, the academic year, and the number of subjects offered in the fall term, considering the top 10 academic years with the highest number of subjects offered in the fall term.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH DepartmentAdminStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopSubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, tso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.subject_count FROM DepartmentAdminStats das JOIN TopSubjectOfferings tso ON das.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tso.subject_count DESC, das.department_count DESC;

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting and not from the Mathematics department, where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the course's department during the 2019FA term is greater than 100, what are the course, the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, the department name of the course, the department code, the department full name, the number of subjects offered by the department, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and for each department, a grand total of enrolled students across all its courses (in the format of department code, department name, null, null, null, null, grand total)? List the results ordered by department code and then by total enrollment in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CourseMaxCIP AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT cmc.COURSE, cmc.max_cip_program_code, cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrollment FROM CourseMaxCIP cmc JOIN DepartmentSubjectEnrollment dse ON cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dse.total_enrollment > 100 ) , DepartmentTotals AS ( SELECT dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS max_cip_program_code, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, SUM(dse.total_enrollment) AS total_enrollment FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dse GROUP BY dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.max_cip_program_code, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS max_cip_program_code, dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, dt.total_enrollment FROM DepartmentTotals dt ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, total_enrollment DESC
sub_questions: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, and what is the department name of the course, excluding courses from the Mathematics department?

For each department, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering during the 2019FA term, but exclude the Political Science department (department code '17').

For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting and not from the Mathematics department, where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the course's department during the 2019FA term is greater than 100, what are the course, the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, the department name of the course, the department code, the department full name, the number of subjects offered by the department, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department? List the results ordered by total enrollment in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

WITH CourseMaxCIP AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT cmc.COURSE, cmc.max_cip_program_code, cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrollment FROM CourseMaxCIP cmc JOIN DepartmentSubjectEnrollment dse ON cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dse.total_enrollment > 100 ORDER BY dse.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for its subjects in regular terms that are not the current term, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (considering only departments that have more than five subjects offered in 2022, are degree-granting, and are not the Chemistry department)? Additionally, for these departments, what is the average number of lecture units for their subjects offered in 2022? Show the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for regular non-current terms, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for 2022, and the average lecture units for 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptStddev2022 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), DeptAvgLectureUnits2022 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units_2022 FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dsd.total_units_stddev AS dept_stddev_2022, dalu.avg_lecture_units_2022 FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN DeptStddev2022 dsd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptAvgLectureUnits2022 dalu ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dalu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC;

WITH MathDeptStddev AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptStddev2022 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dsd.total_units_stddev AS dept_stddev_2022 FROM MathDeptStddev mds LEFT JOIN DeptStddev2022 dsd ON mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each Mathematics department, show the department code, department name, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, where the department is degree granting, and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments), and for each department code and department name, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (department code, department name, null, null, total units range, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS min_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(dus.total_units_range) AS total_units_range, MAX(dus.total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, MAX(dus.total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM DeptUnitsStats dus GROUP BY dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT COALESCE(ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, COALESCE(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_dept_budget_code, COALESCE(dus.total_units_range, rr.total_units_range) AS total_units_range, COALESCE(dus.total_units_variance, rr.total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, COALESCE(dus.total_units_stddev, rr.total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE RIGHT JOIN RollupResults rr ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COALESCE(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME), ic.min_num_enrolled_students;

question: For each degree-granting department that is not the Political Science department, what are the department code, department name, the number of unique subject codes it offers, the average clearing cost collector value, and the deviation of the average clearing cost collector value from the overall average clearing cost collector value across all degree-granting departments? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_subject_codes, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.num_subject_codes, icte.avg_clearing_cost_collector, (icte.avg_clearing_cost_collector - overall.avg_all_dept_clearing_cost) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_clearing_cost_collector) AS avg_all_dept_clearing_cost FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_avgs ) overall ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH DepartmentSubjectVariation AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV_POP(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DepartmentClearingCostStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsv.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dsv.coefficient_of_variation, dccs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dccs.stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM DepartmentSubjectVariation dsv JOIN DepartmentClearingCostStats dccs ON dsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), LibraryReserveStats AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS count_unique_subjects FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, lrs.min_academic_year, lrs.sum_total_units, lrs.count_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN LibraryReserveStats lrs WHERE icte.total_units_variance > 0 AND lrs.sum_total_units > 0 AND lrs.count_unique_subjects >= 1 ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

List the columns in the following order: academic year, academic year description, variance of total units, standard deviation of total units, minimum academic year, and sum of total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

WITH AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), LibraryReserveStats AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_variance, ays.total_units_stddev, lrs.min_academic_year, lrs.sum_total_units FROM AcademicYearStats ays CROSS JOIN LibraryReserveStats lrs WHERE ays.total_units_variance > 0 AND lrs.sum_total_units > 0 ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the Chemistry department, display the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms where the term status indicator is 'P' (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50), and for each subject offered by the Chemistry department in those terms, show the subject id, subject title, and the deviation of its total units from the average total units of all Chemistry subjects offered in regular academic terms (excluding Mathematics department). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ), chem_units_avg AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.total_enrolled_students, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, (ss.TOTAL_UNITS - cua.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.department_name = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID AND tso.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN chem_units_avg cua ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cua.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms where the term status indicator is 'P', the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For the Chemistry department, display the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms where the term status indicator is 'P' (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50), and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms (excluding Mathematics department).
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

WITH dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ), dept_units_cv AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT de.department_name, de.total_enrolled_students, du.coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_enrollment de LEFT JOIN dept_units_cv du ON de.department_name = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics, Chemistry, and Biology), provide the department name, the average and variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 total units), and the number of graduate students (student year 'G') in that department. List the columns in the following order: department name, average course number ASCII, variance of course number ASCII, average total units, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and graduate student count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCourseNumberStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ), DeptCourseUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.avg_course_number_ascii, d1.var_course_number_ascii, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev FROM DeptCourseNumberStats d1 JOIN DeptCourseUnitsStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_course_number_ascii, ic.var_course_number_ascii, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, COALESCE(gsc.grad_student_count, 0) AS grad_student_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS grad_student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) gsc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH DeptCourseNumberStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ), DeptCourseUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_course_number_ascii, d1.var_course_number_ascii, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev FROM DeptCourseNumberStats d1 JOIN DeptCourseUnitsStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each department that is degree granting, has a non-null department full name, and is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), and for each HGN code in the Political Science department for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, the HGN code, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, the subject title from the subject offered table, and the number of enrolled students in that subject, ordered by department name and HGN code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code, ph.HGN_CODE, ph.max_lecture_units, ph.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dcs JOIN (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ) ph ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ph.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code, inner_cte.range_cip_program_code, inner_cte.var_cip_program_code, inner_cte.HGN_CODE, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON so.SUBJECT_TITLE = inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HGN_CODE;
