For each department that is degree granting, has a non-null department full name, and is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), and for each HGN code in the Political Science department for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, the HGN code, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table, ordered by department name and HGN code.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2;

WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), PoliSciHGN AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code, ph.HGN_CODE, ph.max_lecture_units, ph.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM DeptCIPStats dcs JOIN PoliSciHGN ph ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ph.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ph.HGN_CODE;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for the Mathematics department, the number of subjects offered in the Library Subject Offered table during terms that are not the current term and have more than 5 enrolled students (null for other departments). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ) , Total_Courses AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , Math_Library_Subjects AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS Math_Library_Subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, tc.Total_Courses, mls.Math_Library_Subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Total_Courses tc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN Math_Library_Subjects mls ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mls.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10;

WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathDeptTotalEnrolled AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.stddev_enrolled_students, m.total_enrolled FROM DeptEnrolledStats d LEFT JOIN MathDeptTotalEnrolled m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), which is degree granting, give the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0), as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and also include the average number of enrolled students in those subjects. List the department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, variance of number of enrolled students, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of number of enrolled students, and average number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, dse.variance_num_enrolled_students, dse.stddev_num_enrolled_students, dse.avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dse ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH DepartmentCourseUnits AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcu.avg_total_units, dcu.total_units_range, dcu.total_units_variance, dse.variance_num_enrolled_students, dse.stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentCourseUnits dcu JOIN DepartmentSubjectEnrollment dse ON dcu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcu.total_units_range DESC;

question: For the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Chemistry department, provide the course number, course description, subject title, number of times offered, the department name, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Chemistry department (considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ), ChemDeptUnitsStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.offer_count, mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdu.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ChemDeptUnitsStddev mdu ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: What are the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, and for each, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, and the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG?

For each department, provide the department name and the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5

WITH TopMathCourses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ), MathDeptUnitsStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdu.total_units_stddev FROM TopMathCourses tmc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tmc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MathDeptUnitsStddev mdu ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Biology department), what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the graduate-level subjects offered by that department, and for subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students by the Mathematics department, what is the subject title from the course catalog, the number of enrolled students, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, and the course description from the course description table? Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the window row number, and the course description, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the window row number, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), MathSubjectsWindow AS ( SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, msw.SUBJECT_TITLE, msw.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, msw.window_column FROM DeptEnrolledStats des JOIN MathSubjectsWindow msw ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msw.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department that grants degrees and is not the Biology department, show the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with a non-null subject code description), and for each such department, also show the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in library courses offered by that department (considering only library courses with more than 0 enrolled students and departments whose name is not null). Present the department name, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average library enrollment, library enrollment range, and library enrollment variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_library_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

WITH SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), CourseEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.enrolled_students_variance, ses.enrolled_students_stddev, ces.avg_enrollment, ces.enrollment_range, ces.enrollment_variance FROM SubjectEnrollmentStats ses JOIN CourseEnrollmentStats ces ON ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ces.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ses.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ces.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ses.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year in the Mathematics department, as well as the range and variance of the total units for all Mathematics subjects offered in terms marked as the current term in that academic year, and the maximum number of lecture units among those Mathematics subjects in the current term? MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) urv ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, MAX(CSO.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ATA ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ATA.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ATA.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ATP ON ATA.TERM_CODE = ATP.TERM_CODE AND ATP.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CSO ON CSO.TERM_CODE = ATA.TERM_CODE AND CSO.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

WITH GeometricMeanRecordCount AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), UnitsRangeVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, urv.units_range, urv.units_variance FROM GeometricMeanRecordCount gmr JOIN UnitsRangeVariance urv ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmr.geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

question: For each department that is both (a) an Engineering department (excluding Chemistry) with more than 6 total units in its subjects and (b) among the top 10 degree-granting departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects (excluding Political Science), list the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the School of Engineering in terms where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, the count of unique student full names for students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects, and the total number of subjects offered by the department in the School of Engineering. Show the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopZoeStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptSubjectCount AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students, s.num_subjects FROM inner_cte d JOIN TopZoeStudents t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCount s ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

WITH DeptEnrolledEngineering AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopZoeStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students FROM DeptEnrolledEngineering d JOIN TopZoeStudents t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For students whose employee type is 'Student', who are in department 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their MIT ID, full name, department name, student year, the running sum of MIT IDs within each student year group ordered by MIT ID, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms in their department (excluding 'Mathematics'), and the average lecture units for subjects offered in regular academic terms in their department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID ) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation, alu.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 0 ) alu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = alu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.MIT_ID;

WITH student_info AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID ), dept_units_variation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT si.MIT_ID, si.FULL_NAME, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation FROM student_info si LEFT JOIN dept_units_variation duv ON si.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.MIT_ID;

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting and not from the Mathematics department, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, what is the department name of the course, what are the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Biology department and only including departments that grant degrees), and what is the total number of subjects offered by that department in 2022? List the course, maximum CIP program code, department name, average total units, variance of total units, and subject count in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.COURSE, icte.max_cip_program_code, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, dus.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE

sql: WITH ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS min_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5' ), DepartmentUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DepartmentEnrolledAvg AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_2022 FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_ID, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.min_enrolled_students, duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dea.avg_enrolled_students_2022 FROM ChemistrySubjects cs JOIN DepartmentUnitsVariance duv ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentEnrolledAvg dea ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dea.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, duv.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees and is not the Political Science department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for its associated administrative department, as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in degree-granting courses with more than zero enrolled students offered by that department, but only for departments in the School of Engineering. List the department name, average clearing cost collector, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of clearing cost collector, average enrollment, and enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), EngEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_clearing_cost_collector, icte.stddev_clearing_cost_collector, ee.avg_enrollment, ee.enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN EngEnrollment ee ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ee.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

WITH DeptClearingCost AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcc.stddev_clearing_cost_collector, me.avg_enrollment, me.enrollment_stddev FROM DeptClearingCost dcc LEFT JOIN MathEnrollment me ON dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = me.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department that is degree granting and is not the Biology department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, and, if the department is Mathematics, for each academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, what is the academic year, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, and the number of distinct subject codes offered by the Mathematics department in that academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), department_student_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects_stats AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.variance_num_students, dss.stddev_num_students, mss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mss.num_unique_subjects, mss.min_total_units FROM department_student_stats dss LEFT JOIN math_subjects_stats mss ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_students, inner_cte.stddev_num_students, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units, msc.num_distinct_subject_codes FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_distinct_subject_codes FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) msc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = msc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for its subjects in regular terms that are not the current term, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (considering only departments that have more than five subjects offered in 2022, are degree-granting, and are not the Chemistry department)? Additionally, for each subject in the Mathematics department, show the subject ID and the number of times it was offered in 2022. Show the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for regular non-current terms, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for 2022, the subject ID, and the count of offerings in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptStddev2022 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ), MathSubjectOfferings2022 AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS offerings_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dsd.total_units_stddev AS dept_stddev_2022, mso.SUBJECT_ID, mso.offerings_2022 FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DeptStddev2022 dsd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MathSubjectOfferings2022 mso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mso.SUBJECT_ID ;

sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC;

WITH MathDeptStddev AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptStddev2022 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dsd.total_units_stddev AS dept_stddev_2022 FROM MathDeptStddev mds LEFT JOIN DeptStddev2022 dsd ON mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Management department, show the department name, the title of the subject with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 15), the maximum number of enrolled students, and for each subject offered in the academic year 2024 that is also present in the CIS course catalog, display the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department code. sql: WITH max_enrollment_per_dept AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 15 ), management_subjects_2024 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT max_enrollment_per_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_enrollment_per_dept.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, max_enrollment_per_dept.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept FROM max_enrollment_per_dept JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON max_enrollment_per_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN management_subjects_2024 ms ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, is not the Chemistry department, and has more than five subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is only calculated for the Mathematics department, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), and the average number of enrolled students for the Mathematics department in 2022? Show the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the average number of enrolled students, ordered from highest to lowest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units_stddev, cov.coefficient_of_variation, avg_enrolled.avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) cov ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cov.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_enrolled ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_enrolled.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.total_units_stddev DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC;

WITH StdDevTotalUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), CoeffOfVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sdt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdt.total_units_stddev, cov.coefficient_of_variation FROM StdDevTotalUnits sdt LEFT JOIN CoeffOfVariation cov ON sdt.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cov.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sdt.total_units_stddev DESC;

question: For each student in the MIT student directory whose department is '6' (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their full name, email address, department name, the corresponding SIS admin department name, the average department code within each department code group, the department name from the degree-granting departments (excluding Mathematics), the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all degree-granting courses in that department, and the full department name from the SIS_DEPARTMENT table, ordered by the student's full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME) AS avg_department_code, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT e.FULL_NAME, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.avg_department_code, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_cip_department_name, d.avg_cip_program_code, d.stddev_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM EECSStudents e JOIN DeptCIPStats d ON e.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON e.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.FULL_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME) AS avg_department_code, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT e.FULL_NAME, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.avg_department_code, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_cip_department_name, d.avg_cip_program_code, d.stddev_cip_program_code FROM EECSStudents e JOIN DeptCIPStats d ON e.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.FULL_NAME;

question: For each department that is both degree-granting (excluding the Biology department) and is the Mathematics department, list the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, the average department budget code within each school, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and for each subject offered by that department in that year, include the subject id and subject title, but only include departments with more than one subject with non-null total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), coefficient_variation AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), math_dept_info AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mdi.SCHOOL_NAME, mdi.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdi.avg_dept_budget_code, cv.coefficient_of_variation FROM coefficient_variation cv JOIN math_dept_info mdi ON cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mdi.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, icte.coefficient_of_variation, ccs.SUBJECT_ID, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.SUBJECT_ID;
