question: For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding 'Chemistry'), show the department name, department full name, school name, the minimum department budget code over each school name group, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department where the total units for the subject are greater than 6. For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, null, school name, min budget code, total enrolled). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptEngineeringEnrollment AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE AND so.SUBJECT_ID = su.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND su.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, COALESCE(d.total_enrolled, 0) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptEngineeringEnrollment d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SUM(COALESCE(d.total_enrolled, 0)) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptEngineeringEnrollment d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EECSBenedictStudents AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.var_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS STUDENT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.window_column, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered FROM DeptUnitsStats d JOIN EECSBenedictStudents s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.var_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.window_column ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.FIRST_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses, along with the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students and departments whose name is not null). Additionally, for each course, show the course name, the minimum total units for that course, and whether its average enrollment is at least 20% higher than the department's average enrollment ('VERY_HIGH_ENROLLMENT'), at least 20% lower ('VERY_LOW_ENROLLMENT'), or otherwise 'TYPICAL_ENROLLMENT'. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, c.COURSE AS course_name, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS course_min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS course_avg_enrollment FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.COURSE = s.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, c.COURSE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_range, des.enrollment_variance, cs.course_name, cs.course_min_total_units, cs.course_avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN cs.course_avg_enrollment > des.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'VERY_HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN cs.course_avg_enrollment < des.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'VERY_LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'TYPICAL_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CourseStats cs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = cs.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY icte.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_name;

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

WITH DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_LEVEL, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_total_units, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_range, des.enrollment_variance FROM DeptCourseStats dcs JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each department that grants degrees, is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, and offers more than five subjects or is the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the maximum CIP program code among its courses, the full name of the department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the average number of lecture units for those subjects? List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT mcd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcd.max_cip_code, mcd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.stddev_total_units, mcd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ) mcd JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) ds ON mcd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.max_cip_code, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.max_cip_code, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and what is the full name of the department, for departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department that grants degrees, is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, and offers more than five subjects or is the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the maximum CIP program code among its courses, the full name of the department, and the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department? List the results ordered by department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH MaxCipDepartments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ), DeptSubjectStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT mcd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcd.max_cip_code, mcd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.stddev_total_units FROM MaxCipDepartments mcd JOIN DeptSubjectStddev ds ON mcd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mcd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 10 subjects offered by the Mathematics department in the term '2005FA' with the highest number of enrolled students (excluding the Biology department, considering only departments that grant degrees and graduate-level courses), display each subject's title, the number of enrolled students, the department name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and the department with the highest number of enrolled students in that subject along with the count of students from that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), MathSubjects2005FA AS ( SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance FROM MathSubjects2005FA ms JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, dmax.Most_Prominent_Department, dmax.Student_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, COUNT(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Student_Count, @rank := IF(@current_subject = ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, @current_subject := ms.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ms ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_subject := '') vars WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, Student_Count DESC ) dmax ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = dmax.SUBJECT_TITLE AND dmax.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0). Additionally, for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units in Mathematics, show the subject code, subject number, and the running sum of subject codes within the department, ordered by subject code. For these subjects, also include the subject title and the name of the responsible faculty member. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUM(cso.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY cso.SUBJECT_CODE;

sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.window_column FROM DeptStats d JOIN MathSubjects2022 m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each student whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name, and also include the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms for their department, but only for departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Additionally, for each such student, show the maximum lecture units among all subjects offered by their department in regular academic terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentVariation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT e.FIRST_NAME, e.LAST_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.STUDENT_YEAR, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, dv.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM EECSStudents e JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON e.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentVariation dv ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.FIRST_NAME ) SELECT icte.FIRST_NAME, icte.LAST_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.coefficient_of_variation, MAX(cso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY icte.FIRST_NAME, icte.LAST_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY icte.FIRST_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

WITH DepartmentVariation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT e.FIRST_NAME, e.LAST_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.STUDENT_YEAR, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM EECSStudents e JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON e.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentVariation dv ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.FIRST_NAME;

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting (excluding courses from the Mathematics department), what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, what is the department name of the course, what are the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (only including departments that grant degrees and excluding the Biology department), and what is the total number of distinct subject codes offered by that department in 2022? List the course, the maximum CIP program code, the department name, the average total units, the variance of total units, and the total number of subject codes, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DeptUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.max_cip_program_code, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.var_total_units, dsc.total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptUnits du ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCounts dsc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, and what is the department name of the course, excluding courses from the Mathematics department?

List the course, the maximum CIP program code, the department name, the average total units, and the variance of total units, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH EngCourses AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DeptUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ec.COURSE, ec.max_cip_program_code, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.var_total_units FROM EngCourses ec LEFT JOIN DeptUnits du ON ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: From the top 10 degree-granting departments in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry and Management/Course 15) that offered at least one subject in the 2016SP term, display each department's name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in 2021FA. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_subject AS ( SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_enroll dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.range_num_subjects, ds.variance_num_subjects, ds.stddev_num_subjects, dms.max_enrollment, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_stats ds JOIN dept_max_subject dms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.range_num_subjects, icte.variance_num_subjects, icte.stddev_num_subjects, icte.max_enrollment, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, COALESCE(sub_count.subjects_2021FA, 0) AS subjects_offered_2021FA FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_2021FA FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) sub_count ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sub_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10;

For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry and Management/Course 15) that offered at least one subject in the 2016SP term and is in the School of Engineering, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, and the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment.
sub_sqls: WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_enroll dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ORDER BY dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_subject AS ( SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_enroll dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.range_num_subjects, ds.variance_num_subjects, ds.stddev_num_subjects, dms.max_enrollment, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_stats ds JOIN dept_max_subject dms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the average total units and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for Mathematics subjects offered in regular terms, the variance of total units for Mathematics subjects offered in regular terms with a term status of 'Previous', and the average lecture units for Mathematics subjects in those terms. Present the results ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order, then by the variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), AcademicYearStats2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), AvgLectureUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, AcademicYearStats2.total_units_variance, AvgLectureUnits.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte JOIN AcademicYearStats2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = AcademicYearStats2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = AcademicYearStats2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN AvgLectureUnits ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = AvgLectureUnits.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = AvgLectureUnits.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC, AcademicYearStats2.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, what is the description of the academic year and the variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, have a term status of 'Previous', and are offered by the Mathematics department?

For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the average total units for Mathematics subjects offered in regular terms, the standard deviation of the total units for those subjects, and the variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in regular terms with a term status of 'Previous'. Present the results ordered by the standard deviation of total units in descending order, then by the variance of total units in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH AcademicYearStats1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), AcademicYearStats2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT ays1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays1.avg_total_units, ays1.stddev_total_units, ays2.total_units_variance FROM AcademicYearStats1 ays1 JOIN AcademicYearStats2 ays2 ON ays1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ays1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ays2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ays1.stddev_total_units DESC, ays2.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each subject code and subject number in the Mathematics department (Course 18) offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units, list the department name, school name, number of graduate students, minimum office phone number, the running sum of subject codes within the department, and the subject title, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.window_column FROM DeptStudentStats dss JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.student_count, icte.min_office_phone, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.window_column, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department name and school name where the student year is 'G' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), give the number of students and the minimum office phone number.

For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department, ordered by subject code.

For each subject code and subject number in the Mathematics department (Course 18) offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units, list the department name, school name, number of graduate students, minimum office phone number, and the running sum of subject codes within the department, ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH DeptStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.window_column FROM DeptStudentStats dss JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: List the department names, their corresponding subject codes, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, also show the range and variance of total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year (excluding Chemistry, Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte icte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department's name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).

What is the minimum CIP program code and the total number of departments for courses in the School of Engineering, considering only degree-granting departments, including the corresponding administrative department names, and specifically for the Mechanical Engineering department?

For each degree-granting department except Chemistry (Course 5), provide the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, and, if the department is in the School of Engineering and is Mechanical Engineering, also include the minimum CIP program code, the total number of departments, and the corresponding administrative department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), eng_mech_cip_stats AS ( SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, ecs.min_cip_program_code, ecs.total_departments, ecs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM dept_units_stats dus LEFT JOIN eng_mech_cip_stats ecs ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that are degree-granting, show the subject code, subject title, department name, department full name, course description, course level, school name, the minimum total units value over each department code group, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by the department (excluding Chemistry and considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and also include the long course description and the department's school code, ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.min_total_units_per_dept, dsv.coefficient_of_variation, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ) dsv ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that are degree-granting, show the subject code, subject title, department name, department full name, course description, course level, school name, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department code.

For each department except the Chemistry department, provide the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students.

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that are degree-granting, show the subject code, subject title, department name, department full name, course description, course level, school name, the minimum total units value over each department code group, and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by the department (excluding Chemistry and considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), ordered by department code.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ;

WITH MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptStudentVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, m.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, m.COURSE_LEVEL, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.min_total_units_per_dept, dsv.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathSubjects2022 m LEFT JOIN DeptStudentVariation dsv ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: Show the school names, the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in each school (excluding the Political Science department), the average and variance of the department budget codes for the Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry departments in each school, and for each of those departments, list the corresponding SIS subject code and subject code description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME ), AvgAndVarianceBudget AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ) SELECT g.SCHOOL_NAME, g.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, a.avg_budget, a.budget_variance FROM GeometricMeanDeptBudget g JOIN AvgAndVarianceBudget a ON g.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY g.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, icte.avg_budget, icte.budget_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry') ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each school, what is the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17)?

For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school, but only include the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.

For each school, what is the school name, the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), the average of the department budget codes for the Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry departments in that school, and the variance of the department budget codes for those departments?
sub_sqls: SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC;

WITH GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME ), AvgAndVarianceBudget AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ) SELECT g.SCHOOL_NAME, g.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, a.avg_budget, a.budget_variance FROM GeometricMeanDeptBudget g JOIN AvgAndVarianceBudget a ON g.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY g.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, and for each academic year, also show the academic year and academic year description and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that have more than 0 total units and are offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P'. Additionally, for each Chemistry subject, include the number of required TIP materials (where TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') for that subject in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ), math_units_variation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), required_materials_count AS ( SELECT t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS num_required_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.window_column, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, COALESCE(r.num_required_materials, 0) AS num_required_materials FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN math_units_variation m LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE = t.SUBJECT_TITLE LEFT JOIN required_materials_count r ON t.TERM_CODE = r.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = r.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, but only include subjects where the offer department name is 'Chemistry'.

For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that have more than 0 total units and are offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P'.

For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, and for each academic year, also show the academic year and academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that have more than 0 total units and are offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P'.
sub_sqls: SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH chemistry_subjects_2014fa AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ), math_units_variation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.window_column, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM chemistry_subjects_2014fa c CROSS JOIN math_units_variation m

question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5) that has course materials, show the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key, along with the minimum academic year and average total units for the corresponding academic term in the Mathematics department, where the academic year is between 2000 and 2020 or the total units are at least 6, and the total units are between 1 and 12. Also, include the term description and the first day of classes for each term from the academic terms table. The results are ordered by term code and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MathTermStats AS ( SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND ( a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE ), ChemistrySubjectStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats css JOIN MathTermStats mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.max_num_enrolled_students, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE

sub_sqls: SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND ( a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

WITH MathTermStats AS ( SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND ( a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE ), ChemistrySubjectStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats css JOIN MathTermStats mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE ORDER BY css.TERM_CODE, css.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: List the department names, course levels, subject codes, subject code descriptions, and the total number of unique courses per department and course level, for all degree-granting departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.course_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.COURSE = s.COURSE_NUMBER AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.SUBJECT_CODE ;

For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code.

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_LEVEL, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM DeptCourseStats dcs JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each degree-granting department, list the department name, the number of graduate students in the department, the most recent warehouse load date for those students, the range and variance of the number of graduate students in each subject code offered by the department (considering only subject codes that belong to a school with a non-null name). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MAX(msd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_student_load FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.student_count, icte.latest_student_load, ss.subject_count_range, ss.subject_count_variance FROM inner_cte icte JOIN subject_stats ss ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
