SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10

WITH DeptBudgetStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT dbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dbs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dbs.SCHOOL_NAME, dbs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dbs.avg_dept_budget_code, des.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, des.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM DeptBudgetStats dbs JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dbs.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department that is degree granting, is not the Chemistry department (Course 5), and has at least 100 total enrolled students in its offered subjects, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the department, and, for each course in the Mathematics department, provide the course number, the number of undergraduate students enrolled in that course, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students per undergraduate course in Mathematics. For each department, include a grand total for all Mathematics undergraduate courses in the format of (department name, total enrolled students, null, null, null, null, null, grand total). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ), MathCourseStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_undergrad_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE ), MathAggStats AS ( SELECT mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS num_undergrad_students, MAX(mcs.num_undergrad_students) - MIN(mcs.num_undergrad_students) AS student_count_range, VARIANCE(mcs.num_undergrad_students) AS student_count_variance, STDDEV(mcs.num_undergrad_students) AS student_count_stddev, SUM(mcs.num_undergrad_students) AS grand_total FROM MathCourseStats mcs GROUP BY mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathStatsUnion AS ( SELECT mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mcs.COURSE, mcs.num_undergrad_students, NULL AS student_count_range, NULL AS student_count_variance, NULL AS student_count_stddev, NULL AS grand_total FROM MathCourseStats mcs UNION ALL SELECT mas.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mas.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mas.COURSE, mas.num_undergrad_students, mas.student_count_range, mas.student_count_variance, mas.student_count_stddev, mas.grand_total FROM MathAggStats mas ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled_students, msu.COURSE, msu.num_undergrad_students, msu.student_count_range, msu.student_count_variance, msu.student_count_stddev, msu.grand_total FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN MathStatsUnion msu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msu.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.total_enrolled_students DESC, msu.COURSE
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments that are degree granting, have at least 100 total enrolled students, and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, give the department name and provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of students per course in that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and courses that are undergraduate level, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department that is degree granting, is not the Chemistry department (Course 5), and has at least 100 total enrolled students in its offered subjects, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the department, and, if the department is Mathematics, also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of students per undergraduate course in that department.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(course_student_count) - MIN(course_student_count) AS student_count_range, VARIANCE(course_student_count) AS student_count_variance, STDDEV(course_student_count) AS student_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS course_student_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT ) course_stats ON scd.DEPARTMENT = course_stats.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE = course_stats.COURSE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count_range DESC;

WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ), MathCourseStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(course_student_count) - MIN(course_student_count) AS student_count_range, VARIANCE(course_student_count) AS student_count_variance, STDDEV(course_student_count) AS student_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS course_student_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT ) course_stats ON scd.DEPARTMENT = course_stats.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE = course_stats.COURSE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY student_count_range DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.total_enrolled_students, mcs.student_count_range, mcs.student_count_variance, mcs.student_count_stddev FROM DeptEnrolledStats des LEFT JOIN MathCourseStats mcs ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.total_enrolled_students DESC, mcs.student_count_range DESC

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department), provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term. Additionally, for Chemistry and Biology departments and each academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, include the academic year, the count of subjects, and the minimum start date of the term. For each department and academic year, also include the total number of subjects offered in that year and the earliest term start date, regardless of enrollment. The results should be ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), chem_bio_subject_counts AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), dept_year_subject_totals AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_range, ic.enrolled_variance, ic.enrolled_stddev, dys.academic_year, dys.total_subjects, dys.earliest_term_start_date, cbs.subject_count, cbs.min_term_start_date FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN dept_year_subject_totals dys ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN chem_bio_subject_counts cbs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cbs.department AND dys.academic_year = cbs.academic_year ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dys.academic_year ;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), chem_bio_subject_counts AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, cbs.academic_year, cbs.subject_count, cbs.min_term_start_date FROM dept_enrollment_stats des LEFT JOIN chem_bio_subject_counts cbs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cbs.department ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cbs.academic_year ;

question: For each degree-granting department except Chemistry, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are also offered this year, and for each subject offered in 2022 by the Mathematics department where the maximum total units is greater than 6, show the subject title, the maximum number of total units, the school name, and the department phone number, including only those departments that match the Mathematics department in the course catalog. List the department name, average total units, variance of total units, subject title, maximum total units, school name, and department phone number in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, msmu.SUBJECT_TITLE, msmu.max_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte dus JOIN ( SELECT cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) msmu ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msmu.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting and not from the Mathematics department, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, what is the department name of the course, and for each department, what is the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Biology department and only including departments that grant degrees)? List the course, maximum CIP program code, department name, average total units, variance of total units, school name, and total subjects per school in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EngineeringCourseCIP AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT ecc.COURSE, ecc.max_cip_program_code, ecc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, dus.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.total_subjects FROM EngineeringCourseCIP ecc JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON ecc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SchoolSubjectCounts ssc ON dus.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY dus.SCHOOL_NAME, ecc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ecc.COURSE

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subject_summary AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), student_summary AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ss.window_column AS subject_window_rank, ss.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, st.FIRST_NAME, st.LAST_NAME, st.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS student_department_name, st.STUDENT_YEAR, st.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, st.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, st.window_column AS student_window_avg_phone FROM subject_summary ss JOIN student_summary st ON ss.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = st.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT student_year) AS distinct_student_years FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.range_num_subjects, dss.variance_num_subjects, dss.stddev_num_subjects, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.range_num_subjects, i.variance_num_subjects, i.stddev_num_subjects, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.range_num_subjects, i.variance_num_subjects, i.stddev_num_subjects, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department except the Biology department (Course 7), give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentVariation AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation, sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For subjects in the course catalog with a total of 12 units, offered in the fall term, and in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code.

For each degree-granting department except the Biology department (Course 7), give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and for each such department also show, if available, the subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, and the row number within the department (ordered by subject code) for subjects in the Mathematics department with a total of 12 units offered in the fall term.
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentVariation AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, ms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ms.window_column FROM DepartmentVariation dv LEFT JOIN MathSubjects ms ON dv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column

question: For each department that is both degree-granting (excluding Chemistry) and is the Mathematics department, provide the department name, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of units for all subjects in the course catalog that are offered in the fall term and are part of a degree-granting program in the Mathematics department, and the number of Mathematics subjects offered in the 2022FA term that are also offered this year. List the results in descending order of the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_stddev, m.total_units, ms.num_math_subjects FROM inner_cte d JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_math_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) ms ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.enrollment_stddev DESC;

For each department that is both degree-granting (excluding Chemistry) and is the Mathematics department, give the department name, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year, the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the total number of units for all subjects in the course catalog that are offered in the fall term and are part of a degree-granting program in the Mathematics department. List the results in descending order of the standard deviation of enrollment.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0;

WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ), MathDeptUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_stddev, m.total_units FROM DeptEnrollmentStats d JOIN MathDeptUnits m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each department that is degree-granting (excluding Biology/Course 7) and is either Mathematics or Chemistry, provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, as well as the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019 (where the maximum is greater than 5), the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, and the title of that course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, lso.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' OR lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ) lso ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.DEPARTMENT_CODE

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DeptAvgVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dav.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dav.avg_enrolled_students, dav.var_enrolled_students, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptAvgVar dav JOIN DeptMaxEnrolled2019 dme ON dav.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all Mathematics subjects offered in current terms, the average total units, the range of total units, the variance of total units for Mathematics subjects offered in current or previous terms, and the maximum lecture units for Mathematics subjects offered in current or previous terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), UnitsStatistics AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_range, us.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cov JOIN UnitsStatistics us ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, max_stats.max_lecture_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(sub.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) max_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = max_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = max_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are current or previous terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the coefficient of variation of the total units for all Mathematics subjects offered in current terms, the average total units, the range of total units, and the variance of total units for Mathematics subjects offered in current or previous terms.
sub_sqls: SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), UnitsStatistics AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_range, us.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cov JOIN UnitsStatistics us ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the subject title from the library subject offered table, the offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group. Additionally, for the department offering the subject, show the department name, the range of enrolled students, and the variance of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses that are at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology department. Also, for each such department, show the total number of graduate-level subjects offered by that department. Present the results ordered by subject title and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_TERM_CODE, icte.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_stats ds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, display the academic year description, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one material record and are offered by the Biology department, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per academic term in that year for the Mathematics department (Course 18). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH bio_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), math_units_stats AS ( WITH term_units AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev FROM term_units GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, b.avg_enrolled_students, b.var_enrolled_students, m.units_range, m.units_variance, m.units_stddev FROM bio_enrollment_stats b LEFT JOIN math_units_stats m ON b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ic.units_stddev, sd_math.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_school_name, ad_math.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS math_department_phone, sd_bio.SCHOOL_NAME AS bio_school_name FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd_math ON sd_math.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad_math ON sd_math.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad_math.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd_bio ON sd_bio.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Biology' ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (for departments that grant degrees, excluding Political Science), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers (excluding Chemistry), as well as the total number of subjects offered by each department (excluding Non-MIT departments). The columns should be: department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total subjects offered, and reason for inclusion ('Avg/Var' for average and variance, 'CoeffVar' for coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), 'TotalSubjects' for total subjects), in that order. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptCoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ), DeptTotalSubjects AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME <> 'Non-MIT' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_enrollment, d1.enrollment_variance, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS total_subjects_offered, 'Avg/Var' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollmentStats d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, d2.coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS total_subjects_offered, 'CoeffVar' AS Reason FROM DeptCoefficientOfVariation d2 UNION ALL SELECT d3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, d3.total_subjects_offered, 'TotalSubjects' AS Reason FROM DeptTotalSubjects d3 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), subject_units_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptSubjectRollup AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN subject_units_stats sus ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dsr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsr.SUBJECT_CODE, SUM(dsr.subject_code_count) AS subject_code_count, MIN(dsr.min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code, MAX(dsr.total_units_range) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(dsr.total_units_range) AS total_units_range_variance FROM DeptSubjectRollup dsr GROUP BY dsr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsr.SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(dsr.subject_code_count) > 0 ORDER BY dsr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsr.SUBJECT_CODE ;

question: For each degree-granting department that either (a) is not Biology (Course 7) and has more than one subject with non-null total units in the most recent academic year, or (b) is not Mathematics (Course 18) and has at least one course with a non-null CIP program code and a non-null department full name, list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, the variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, and the department's phone number (if available). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsCV AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dcs.cip_program_code_variance, dcs.cip_program_code_stddev FROM DeptUnitsCV WITH DeptUnitsCV AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dcs.cip_program_code_variance, dcs.cip_program_code_stddev FROM DeptUnitsCV dcv LEFT JOIN DeptCIPStats dcs ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE UNION ALL SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dcs.cip_program_code_variance, dcs.cip_program_code_stddev FROM DeptCIPStats dcs LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsCV dcv ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology, Course 7) in the most recent academic year that is also the Mathematics department (Course 18) and has a non-null department budget code, give the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, the average department budget code within each school (ordered by department code), the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (including only departments with more than one subject with non-null total units), and for each subject offered by that department in the most recent academic year, provide the subject id, subject title, and the deviation of its total units from the department's average total units. Order the results by department code and subject id. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), Department_CV AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), Math_Departments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, md.SCHOOL_NAME, md.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, md.avg_dept_budget_code, dc.coefficient_of_variation, dc.avg_total_units FROM Department_CV dc JOIN Math_Departments md ON dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = md.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = md.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_dept_budget_code, i.coefficient_of_variation, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, (s.TOTAL_UNITS - i.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) AND s.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_ID;

question: From the top 10 Mathematics department subjects in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units and also offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students, display each subject's code, number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the subject title, the term description, the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID, and the name of the responsible faculty member for the subject as listed in the library offerings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_enrolled_students, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY window_column DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics, Chemistry, and Biology), list the department name, the average and variance of the ASCII values of its subject codes' course numbers, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of its courses (considering only courses with more than 0 total units), and the number of students in that department according to the student directory. Show the columns in this order: department name, average course number ASCII, variance of course number ASCII, average total units, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and student count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCourseNumberStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptCourseUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.avg_course_number_ascii, d1.var_course_number_ascii, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev FROM DeptCourseNumberStats d1 JOIN DeptCourseUnitsStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_course_number_ascii, ic.var_course_number_ascii, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_course_number_ascii, ic.var_course_number_ascii, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count_range, icte.subject_count_variance, icte.subject_count_stddev, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one material record and are offered by the Biology department, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per academic term in that year for the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, for each academic year, indicate whether the average number of enrolled students in Biology is at least 10% greater than the average total units per term in Mathematics ('HIGH_ENROLLMENT'), at least 10% less ('LOW_ENROLLMENT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. List the columns in the following order: academic year description, average enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, range of total units per term, variance of total units per term, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units per term, and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Bio_Enrolled_Stats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), Math_Units_Stats AS ( WITH term_units AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev, AVG(total_units_per_term) AS avg_units_per_term FROM term_units GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, b.avg_enrolled_students, b.var_enrolled_students, m.units_range, m.units_variance, m.units_stddev, m.avg_units_per_term FROM Bio_Enrolled_Stats b JOIN Math_Units_Stats m ON b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, inner_cte.units_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students > inner_cte.avg_units_per_term * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students < inner_cte.avg_units_per_term * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the minimum total units of its subjects (from SUBJECT_SUMMARY) in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following departments ordered by department name. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, inner_cte.Total_Courses, ss_min_units.min_total_units_window FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER ( ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS min_total_units_window FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ) ss_min_units ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss_min_units.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Physics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte c LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats d ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.max_enrolled_students DESC, d.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS administrative_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS academic_department, t.max_total_units, t.subject_title_with_max_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC), ',', 1 ) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.max_total_units > 9 ), ClearingCostStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), SubjectCount2024 AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2024 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT m.administrative_department, m.academic_department, m.max_total_units, m.subject_title_with_max_units, c.avg_clearing_cost_collector, c.clearing_cost_collector_variance, c.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, s.num_subjects_2024 FROM inner_cte m JOIN ClearingCostStats c ON m.academic_department = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SubjectCount2024 s ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY m.administrative_department, m.academic_department;

question: For the Mathematics department and its corresponding administrative department name, where the department is degree granting, list the department name, the administrative department name, the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, the academic year, the number of subjects offered in the fall term, and the average number of lecture units for those subjects, considering the top 10 academic years with the highest number of subjects offered in the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentAdminStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopSubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, tso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.subject_count FROM DepartmentAdminStats das JOIN TopSubjectOfferings tso ON das.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tso.subject_count DESC, das.department_count DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.department_count, icte.min_budget_code, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.department_count, icte.min_budget_code, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.department_count DESC;

WITH DepartmentAdminStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopSubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, tso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.subject_count FROM DepartmentAdminStats das JOIN TopSubjectOfferings tso ON das.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tso.subject_count DESC, das.department_count DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the average of the total number of units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year in the Mathematics department with at least 6 total units, what are the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the school name, and the department phone number? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, ms2.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subject_department_name, ms2.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) ms2 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ms2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ;
