SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t );

WITH EngineeringEECS_Courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), HighUnitDepartments AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT eec.COURSE, eec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eec.SCHOOL_NAME, eec.window_column, hud.total_units FROM EngineeringEECS_Courses eec JOIN HighUnitDepartments hud ON eec.DEPARTMENT = hud.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY eec.COURSE;

question: For each department name and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is in the School of Engineering, provide the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, and the number of associated administrative departments, considering only departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department budget code, and are in the School of Engineering. List the department name, administrative department name, number of departments, minimum department budget code, and number of associated administrative departments in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopDepartmentAdmins AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.department_count, inner_cte.min_budget_code, tda.admin_dept_count FROM inner_cte JOIN TopDepartmentAdmins tda ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tda.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of departments and the minimum department budget code.

List the top 10 department names along with the number of associated administrative departments, considering only departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department name and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, and the number of associated administrative departments, considering only departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). List the department name, administrative department name, number of departments, minimum department budget code, and number of associated administrative departments in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH DepartmentAdminStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopDepartmentAdmins AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, tda.admin_dept_count FROM DepartmentAdminStats das JOIN TopDepartmentAdmins tda ON das.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tda.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For departments that are both degree-granting (excluding the Biology department, Course 7, and considering only the 2024 academic year) and are the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department in 2024, the average total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for those subjects, and the number of unique Mathematics students (from the MIT student directory) enrolled in those subjects in 2024. List the results in order by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathematicsUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), MathStudentCounts AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_math_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' AND sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, mus.avg_total_units, mus.stddev_total_units, msc.num_math_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN MathematicsUnitsStats mus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MathStudentCounts msc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For departments that are both degree-granting (excluding the Biology department, Course 7, and considering only the 2024 academic year) and are the Mathematics department (Course 18), give the department name, the coefficient of variation of the total units of subjects offered by that department in 2024, the average total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the standard deviation of the total units for those subjects. List the results in order by department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH DepartmentUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathematicsUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duc.coefficient_of_variation, mus.avg_total_units, mus.stddev_total_units FROM DepartmentUnitsCV duc JOIN MathematicsUnitsStats mus ON duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 10 academic years with the highest geometric mean of required course material record counts for Mathematics department subjects, display each academic year's description, the geometric mean of required material record counts, the average and variance of total units for Mathematics department subjects offered in the fall term with a non-null subject title, and the count of unique Mathematics department subjects that also have library reserve materials in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH geometric_mean_materials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), avg_var_units AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmm.geometric_mean_record_count, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM geometric_mean_materials gmm JOIN avg_var_units avu ON gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.geometric_mean_record_count, icte.avg_total_units, icte.var_total_units, COALESCE(lib.subjects_with_reserve, 0) AS num_subjects_with_library_reserve FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT atall.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_with_reserve FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL atall ON ccso.TERM_CODE = atall.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atall.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) lib ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = lib.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a non-null subject title, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year in the Mathematics department, the average of the total units, and the variance of the total units for Mathematics department subjects offered in the fall term with a non-null subject title in that year?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH geometric_mean_materials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), avg_var_units AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmm.geometric_mean_record_count, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM geometric_mean_materials gmm JOIN avg_var_units avu ON gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department that is degree granting, not the Chemistry department (Course 5), and has at least 100 total enrolled students in its offered subjects, give the department name, the total number of enrolled students, and for each subject offered by the Mathematics department in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled_students, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY icte.total_enrolled_students DESC, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments that are degree granting, have at least 100 total enrolled students, and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.

For each department that is degree granting, not the Chemistry department (Course 5), and has at least 100 total enrolled students in its offered subjects, give the department name, the total number of enrolled students, and for each subject offered by the Mathematics department in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH DepartmentEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ), MathSubjects2005FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.total_enrolled_students, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.window_column FROM DepartmentEnrolledStudents des JOIN MathSubjects2005FA ms ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY des.total_enrolled_students DESC, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each degree-granting department except Chemistry (Course 5), provide the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, and for each subject offered by the Mathematics department in the 2022 academic year with a maximum total units greater than 6, include the subject title, the maximum total units for that subject, the department name, and the responsible faculty name from the course catalog. Present the results ordered by department name, subject title, and responsible faculty name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME HAVING MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department's name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by the Mathematics department, what is the maximum number of total units for that subject, and what is the department name from the course catalog, considering only subjects where the maximum total units is greater than 6?

For each degree-granting department except Chemistry (Course 5), provide the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, and for each subject offered by the Mathematics department in the 2022 academic year with a maximum total units greater than 6, include the subject title, the maximum total units for that subject, and the department name from the course catalog. Present the results ordered by department name and subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, ms2022.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms2022.max_total_units, ms2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN math_subjects_2022 ms2022 ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms2022.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms2022.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department (ordered by subject code), the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term (restricted to departments that grant degrees and only including the Mathematics department), and the number of students enrolled in each subject in the 2022FA term. List the results ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), enrollment AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.TERM_CODE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, COALESCE(e.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_stats ds ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = e.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department, ordered by subject code.

For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term, restricted to departments that grant degrees and only including the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department (ordered by subject code), along with the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term (restricted to departments that grant degrees and only including the Mathematics department). List the results ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department that is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18) and is degree granting, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year. For each HGN code in the Political Science department, also include the HGN code, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units. Additionally, for each such HGN code and department, include a grand total row for all HGN codes in Political Science in the format of (department name, null, null, null, HGN code, total max lecture units, null). List the results in order of the total units range (descending) and then by maximum lecture units (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), PoliticalScienceHGNStats AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ), HGN_Rollup AS ( SELECT p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.HGN_CODE, MAX(p.max_lecture_units) AS total_max_lecture_units FROM PoliticalScienceHGNStats p GROUP BY p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.HGN_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING MAX(p.max_lecture_units) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, p.HGN_CODE, p.max_lecture_units, p.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte i JOIN PoliticalScienceHGNStats p ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = p.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, h.HGN_CODE, h.total_max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte i JOIN HGN_Rollup h ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE h.HGN_CODE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_units_range DESC, max_lecture_units DESC
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For each HGN code in the Political Science department, what is the department name, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table, for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units?

For each department that is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18) and is degree granting, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and for each HGN code in the Political Science department, also include the HGN code, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units. List the results in order of the total units range (descending) and then by maximum lecture units (descending).
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2;

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), PoliticalScienceHGNStats AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, p.HGN_CODE, p.max_lecture_units, p.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM DeptUnitsStats d JOIN PoliticalScienceHGNStats p ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = p.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_units_range DESC, p.max_lecture_units DESC

question: For each department that grants degrees, is not the Biology department (Course 7), and is not the Chemistry department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with a non-null subject code description), the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than zero), and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects? Please provide the department name, the variance, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the geometric mean of total units, and the average number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), AvgEnrolled AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_students_variance, es.enrolled_students_stddev, gm.geometric_mean_total_units, ae.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte es JOIN GeometricMeanUnits gm ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = gm.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN AvgEnrolled ae ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ae.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ae.DEPARTMENT_CODE
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7)? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation.

For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than zero, and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department?

For each department that grants degrees, is not the Biology department (Course 7), and is not the Chemistry department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with a non-null subject code description), and the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than zero)? Please provide the department name, the variance, the standard deviation, and the geometric mean of total units, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_students_variance, es.enrolled_students_stddev, gm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN GeometricMeanUnits gm ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = gm.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Physics department (Course 8) and the Chemistry department (Course 5)), provide the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term, the average and variance of the total units for all courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0), and indicate whether the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in 2022FA is at least 20% higher than the average total units (from all courses with units > 0) as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY', at least 20% lower as 'LOW_VARIABILITY', or otherwise 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'. Show the columns in this order: department name, variance of total units (2022FA), standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (2022FA), average total units (all courses with units > 0), variance of total units (all courses with units > 0), and the variability category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsVarianceStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptUnitsAvgVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.variance_total_units, dv.stddev_total_units, da.avg_total_units, da.var_total_units FROM DeptUnitsVarianceStddev dv JOIN DeptUnitsAvgVar da ON dv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = da.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY variability_category DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name, both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department (Course 8).

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department that is degree-granting, excluding the Physics department (Course 8) and the Chemistry department (Course 5), list the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term, the average and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0), and calculate the ratio of the standard deviation (from the 2022FA term) to the average total units (from all courses with total units greater than 0), rounded to two decimal places. Present the columns in the following order: department name, variance of total units (2022FA), standard deviation of total units (2022FA), average total units (all courses with units > 0), variance of total units (all courses with units > 0), and the ratio of standard deviation to average total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH DeptUnitsVarianceStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptUnitsAvgVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.variance_total_units, dv.stddev_total_units, da.avg_total_units, da.var_total_units, ROUND(dv.stddev_total_units / NULLIF(da.avg_total_units, 0), 2) AS stddev_to_avg_ratio FROM DeptUnitsVarianceStddev dv JOIN DeptUnitsAvgVar da ON dv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = da.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_to_avg_ratio DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the average department budget code within each school, the subject title, the total units, and whether the total units for the subject is 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in the same school), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE_LOAD' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.avg_dept_budget_code, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.TOTAL_UNITS, sq2.window_column FROM Subquery1 sq1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sq1.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SCHOOL_NAME = sq2.SCHOOL_NAME ), school_avg_units AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_dept_budget_code, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < s.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_LOAD' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg_units s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, ordered by department name.

List the subject title, total units, department name, and school name for each subject offered, along with dense ranks over the department code ordered by department code, for subjects offered by departments that are degree granting, have a non-null subject code description, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the average department budget code within each school, the subject title, the total units, and the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code for each subject offered by the Mathematics department with a non-null subject code description.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.avg_dept_budget_code, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.TOTAL_UNITS, sq2.window_column FROM Subquery1 sq1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sq1.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SCHOOL_NAME = sq2.SCHOOL_NAME

question: List the department names, subject codes, subject numbers, subject titles, academic years, and the total number of Mathematics department subjects that are letter graded and offered in the fall term, along with the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in these subjects (excluding summer terms). Present the results ordered by department name, subject code, and subject number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.SUBJECT_CODE, ccs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccs.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccs.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TotalSubjects.Total_Subjects, Stats.avg_enrollment, Stats.enrollment_range, Stats.enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS TotalSubjects ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = TotalSubjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Stats ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each subject offered by the Mathematics department, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, only for subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded.

For each subject offered by the Mathematics department that is offered this year and is letter graded, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code. Additionally, for the Mathematics department, include the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department. Present the results in order of subject code, subject number, and term code.
sub_sqls: SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE ;

WITH MathDeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.max_total_units_3rows, mdes.avg_enrollment, mdes.enrollment_range, mdes.enrollment_variance FROM MathSubjects ms JOIN MathDeptEnrollmentStats mdes ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdes.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.TERM_CODE;

question: For each student in the Political Science department (Course 17), show the student's full name, department name, school name, SIS administrative department name, and their dense rank over student year (ordered by student year). For each such student, also show the number of Political Science subjects they could take in 2024 (excluding Physics and non-degree-granting departments), grouped by whether the subject is offered in the Fall, Spring, or both terms, and the total number of units for each group. Include a grand total per student for all terms in the format (student info, null, total subjects, total units). List the results ordered by student year rank, student full name, and term group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) , SubjectTermGroup AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, CASE WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall & Spring' WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall' WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Spring' ELSE 'Other' END AS term_group, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, SUM(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, CASE WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall & Spring' WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall' WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Spring' ELSE 'Other' END ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT stg.term_group, SUM(stg.num_subjects) AS num_subjects, SUM(stg.total_units) AS total_units FROM SubjectTermGroup stg GROUP BY stg.term_group WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(stg.num_subjects) > 0 ) SELECT ic.FULL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.student_year_rank, rr.term_group, rr.num_subjects, rr.total_units FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN RollupResults rr ORDER BY ic.student_year_rank, ic.FULL_NAME, rr.term_group
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting, excluding the Physics department, what is the department name, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units?

Show the full name of each student in the Political Science department, their department name, the corresponding school name, and the SIS administrative department name, along with dense ranks over the student's year, ordered by student year, and only include students whose department is Course 17.
