For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name, and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms for their department, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

WITH DepartmentVariation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT e.FIRST_NAME, e.LAST_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.STUDENT_YEAR, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, d.coefficient_of_variation FROM EECSStudents e JOIN DepartmentVariation d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding Biology, Course 7, and only considering subjects with a non-null subject code description), what are the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and for each course number in that department, the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in library-offered courses with more than 0 enrolled students? Please provide the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in subjects, and for each course number, the average, range, and variance of enrolled students in library-offered courses, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.enrolled_students_stddev, lso.COURSE_NUMBER, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.enrolled_students_stddev, lso.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7)? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students, departments whose name is not null, and only include departments whose name is 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For each department that both grants degrees (excluding Biology, Course 7, and only considering subjects with a non-null subject code description) and is named 'Mathematics', what are the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students and departments whose name is not null)? Please provide the department name, the variance and standard deviation of enrolled students in subjects, and the average, range, and variance of enrolled students in courses, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), MathCourseStats AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.enrolled_students_variance, dss.enrolled_students_stddev, mcs.avg_enrollment, mcs.enrollment_range, mcs.enrollment_variance FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN MathCourseStats mcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and each term in that year, what are the academic year, academic year description, term code, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in that term (considering only regular terms, not in the future), as well as the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and terms that are not the current term), and the number of Mathematics subjects offered in each term? List the results as: academic year, academic year description, term code, term total units range, term total units variance, term total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), year total units range, year total units variance, and number of Mathematics subjects in the term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TermStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ), YearStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.total_units_range AS term_total_units_range, ts.total_units_variance AS term_total_units_variance, ts.total_units_stddev AS term_total_units_stddev, ys.total_units_range AS year_total_units_range, ys.total_units_variance AS year_total_units_variance FROM YearStats ys JOIN TermStats ts ON ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ts.TERM_CODE ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.term_total_units_range, icte.term_total_units_variance, icte.term_total_units_stddev, icte.year_total_units_range, icte.year_total_units_variance, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_math_subjects_in_term FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.term_total_units_range, icte.term_total_units_variance, icte.term_total_units_stddev, icte.year_total_units_range, icte.year_total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in each term of that year, considering only terms that are regular terms, are not in the future, and where the subjects are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year and each term in that year, what are the academic year, academic year description, term code, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in that term (considering only regular terms, not in the future), as well as the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and terms that are not the current term)? List the results as: academic year, academic year description, term code, term total units range, term total units variance, term total units standard deviation, year total units range, and year total units variance.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

WITH TermStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ), YearStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.total_units_range AS term_total_units_range, ts.total_units_variance AS term_total_units_variance, ts.total_units_stddev AS term_total_units_stddev, ys.total_units_range AS year_total_units_range, ys.total_units_variance AS year_total_units_variance FROM YearStats ys JOIN TermStats ts ON ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ts.TERM_CODE;

question: For each academic year in which the Mathematics department offered subjects in the current term, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department (considering only subjects offered in the current term with more than 0 total units), as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for the Mathematics department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and departments that grant degrees), and the full department name and school name for the Mathematics department? Present the results in the following order: academic year, department name, variance of total units for the year, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for the year, range of total units for the department, variance of total units for the department, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for the department, department full name, and school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_units_variance AS year_total_units_variance, subq1.total_units_stddev AS year_total_units_stddev, subq2.total_units_range AS dept_total_units_range, subq2.total_units_variance AS dept_total_units_variance, subq2.total_units_stddev AS dept_total_units_stddev FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) subq1 JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.year_total_units_variance, inner_cte.year_total_units_stddev, inner_cte.dept_total_units_range, inner_cte.dept_total_units_variance, inner_cte.dept_total_units_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all Mathematics subjects offered in current terms, the average total units, the range of total units, the variance of total units for Mathematics subjects offered in current or previous terms, and the earliest and latest term start dates for Mathematics subjects in those years. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), UnitsStatistics AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_range, us.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cov JOIN UnitsStatistics us ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date, MAX(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON cso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For the top 10 degree-granting departments by number of unique courses offered (excluding 'Political Science' and 'Mathematics'), show the department name, school name, total number of courses, the average number of unique subject codes per course, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes per course, and the most common course level (undergraduate or graduate) among their courses, considering only departments that belong to a school with a non-null name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), TopDeptCourses AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdc.SCHOOL_NAME, tdc.total_courses, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, tdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TopDeptCourses tdc JOIN DeptSubjectStats dss ON tdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY tdc.total_courses DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.total_courses, icte.avg_subject_codes, icte.stddev_subject_codes, cl_stats.most_common_course_level FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 END) >= COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 END) THEN 'Undergraduate' ELSE 'Graduate' END AS most_common_course_level FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd WHERE cd.DEPARTMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cd.DEPARTMENT ) cl_stats ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cl_stats.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY icte.total_courses DESC;

WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), TopDeptCourses AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdc.SCHOOL_NAME, tdc.total_courses, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes FROM TopDeptCourses tdc JOIN DeptSubjectStats dss ON tdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY tdc.total_courses DESC;

question: For each department that is degree granting, has a non-null department name, and is not the Political Science department (Course 17), and for each subject offered by that department in the Mathematics department (Course 18) with a non-null subject code description, list the department name, the variance of the number of students in that department who are in their graduate year, the subject title, the total units, the school name, the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code, and the subject code description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GradStudentVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT gsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gsv.variance_of_grad_students, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.window_column, ms.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM GradStudentVariance gsv JOIN MathSubjects ms ON gsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY gsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

For each department that is degree granting, has a non-null department name, and is not the Political Science department (Course 17), and for each subject offered by that department in the Mathematics department (Course 18) with a non-null subject code description, list the department name, the variance of the number of students in that department who are in their graduate year, the subject title, the total units, the school name, and the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH GradStudentVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT gsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gsv.variance_of_grad_students, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.window_column FROM GradStudentVariance gsv JOIN MathSubjects ms ON gsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY gsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column;

question: From the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Biology and Chemistry) with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year (only including departments with more than one subject in that year), display each department's name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 total units), as well as the subject offered by that department in the most recent year with the highest total units and its total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), coefficient_of_variation_by_dept AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.coefficient_of_variation, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM coefficient_of_variation_by_dept c JOIN dept_stats d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subject_max_units AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccs.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs WHERE ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_units, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_subject_total_units FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN subject_max_units s ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.rn = 1 ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology and Chemistry), give the department name, the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year (only including departments with more than one subject in that year), as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 total units). List the results ordered by department name.
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), coefficient_of_variation_by_dept AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.coefficient_of_variation, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM coefficient_of_variation_by_dept c JOIN dept_stats d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the top 10 departments by the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Political Science department and including only departments that grant degrees), display each department's name, the count of subjects, and, for each department, the number of students in that department with a non-null office phone number. Additionally, for the Mathematics department, also show the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of its students (considering only students with a non-null office phone number). List the results in descending order of subject count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), student_counts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS student_with_office_phone_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), math_office_phone_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, sc.student_with_office_phone_count, mos.avg_office_phone, mos.stddev_office_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN student_counts sc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN math_office_phone_stats mos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mos.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC;
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, showing each department's name and the count of subjects, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17) from the results and only include departments that grant degrees.

For each department, provide the department name and the average and standard deviation of the office phone numbers of students in that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, students who have a non-null office phone number, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For the top 10 departments by the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Political Science department and including only departments that grant degrees), display each department's name, the count of subjects, and, if the department is Mathematics, also show the average and standard deviation of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students with a non-null office phone number). List the results in descending order of subject count.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC;

WITH top_departments AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), math_office_phone_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.subject_count, mos.avg_office_phone, mos.stddev_office_phone FROM top_departments td LEFT JOIN math_office_phone_stats mos ON td.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mos.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY td.subject_count DESC;

question: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses, the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics courses (considering only departments that offer more than five courses), and the number of unique subject codes for Mathematics in the SIS_SUBJECT_CODE table. List the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and the number of unique subject codes, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.course_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, subq2.units_stddev, subq3.unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) subq2 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subq3 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq3.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses.

For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the total units for its courses, considering only departments that offer more than five courses, and only including the Mathematics department?

For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses, the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses, and the standard deviation of the total units for Mathematics courses (considering only departments that offer more than five courses). List the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units, and the standard deviation of total units, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY units_stddev DESC;

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ), subq2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY units_stddev DESC ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.COURSE_LEVEL, subq1.course_count, subq1.min_total_units, subq2.units_stddev FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with at least one enrolled student), as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded). For each subject, also include the subject title and the number of enrolled students. List the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, average enrolled students, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM inner_cte) AS avg_enrolled_students, (SELECT MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM inner_cte) AS range_enrolled_students, (SELECT VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM inner_cte) AS var_enrolled_students, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN UnitsStats u ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and restricting the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and provide both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with at least one enrolled student), as well as the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded). List the department name, average enrolled students, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, variance of total units, and standard deviation of total units, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.avg_enrolled_students, e.range_enrolled_students, e.var_enrolled_students, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM EnrolledStats e JOIN UnitsStats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded (only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Biology department), as well as the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students, departments whose name is not null, and only including departments whose name is 'Mathematics'). Additionally, for each such department, list the number of unique subject titles offered in 2022 that are letter graded. Present the columns in the following order: department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, average enrollment, enrollment range, enrollment variance, and number of unique subject titles. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.range_total_units, icte.var_total_units, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_range, des.enrollment_variance, st.num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) st ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = st.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department, give the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and only including the Mathematics and Physics departments), as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term (considering only degree-granting departments and excluding the Management department). List the columns in the following order: department name, enrolled students range, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_students_range, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev, u.variance_total_units, u.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte e JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: From the top 10 Mathematics department subjects in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units, show each subject's code, number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the subject title, the term description, and, for each subject, the library offer department with the highest number of enrolled students in the term "2014FA" (where more than 5 students are enrolled), along with that enrolled student count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Library_Offer_Dept, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Enrolled_Student_Count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS dept_rank FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ranked_lso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ranked_lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ranked_lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ranked_lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS WHERE ranked_lso.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER LIMIT 10;

SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For each academic year and department, show the academic year, department name, the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous' (restricted to the Mathematics department and only for those academic year and department combinations where the total number of units is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all such combinations), the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department (restricted to departments that grant degrees and to the Department of Mathematics or departments in the School of Engineering or Science, and only where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 20), and the number of unique subject titles offered by the department in those terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), DeptEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 20 ), DeptSubjectTitles AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units, des.total_enrolled_students, dst.num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents des ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptSubjectTitles dst ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dst.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dst.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t );

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20;

WITH AcademicYearDeptUnits AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), DeptEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20 ) SELECT aydu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aydu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, aydu.total_units, des.total_enrolled_students FROM AcademicYearDeptUnits aydu JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents des ON aydu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY aydu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aydu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest average total units for degree-granting subjects offered in the 2022 academic year (excluding Mathematics/Course 18), display each department's name, average total units, total units range, total units variance (all for 2022 degree-granting subjects), the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term (excluding Physics/Course 8), and the subject with the highest total units offered by that department in 2022. List the department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, variance of total units for 2022FA, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for 2022FA, subject title with highest total units, and its total units, in that order, and order the results by average total units in descending order, limiting to 10 results. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptMaxSubject AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT <> '18' ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, d.variance_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, m.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_highest_units, m.TOTAL_UNITS AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptUnitsVariance d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptMaxSubject m ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND m.rn = 1 ORDER BY i.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name, both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department (Course 8).

For each department where the average total units for degree-granting subjects offered in the 2022 academic year (excluding Mathematics/Course 18) is greater than 9 and the standard deviation of total units for courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term (excluding Physics/Course 8) is greater than 2, give the department name, the average total units, the range of total units, the variance of total units (all for 2022 degree-granting subjects), as well as the variance and standard deviation of total units for courses offered in 2022FA. List the department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, variance of total units for 2022FA, and standard deviation of total units for 2022FA, in that order, and order the results by the total units range in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance, d2.variance_total_units, d2.stddev_total_units FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptUnitsVariance d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d1.avg_total_units > 9 AND d2.stddev_total_units > 2 ORDER BY d1.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each subject offered by the Physics department (Course 8) that has course materials, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key. Additionally, for the Physics department, include the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5). Present the results with the columns in the following order: subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, maximum number of enrolled students, department name, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Physics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.max_enrolled_students, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE;

For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7)?
