SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathFallUnitsStats AS ( SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.num_unique_subjects, d.min_total_units, m.avg_total_units, m.var_total_units FROM DeptYearSubjectStats d JOIN MathFallUnitsStats m ON d.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY d.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each term and department, list the term, department name, the number of courses offered, average number of enrolled students, the school name, and department phone number. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sos.TERM_CODE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.COURSE_NUMBER) AS num_courses, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sos.TERM_CODE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, num_courses, avg_enrollment, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that grant degrees, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17).

For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that grant degrees, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, list the department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, total units variance, total units standard deviation, and the reason for inclusion ("Enrollment" for departments with average and variance of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, excluding Political Science and only including degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students; "Units" for the Mathematics department with variance and standard deviation of total units in subjects offered by that department, only including degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students). The columns should be: department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, total units variance, total units standard deviation, and reason.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), MathUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'Enrollment' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollmentStats d UNION ALL SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, m.total_units_variance, m.total_units_stddev, 'Units' AS Reason FROM MathUnitsStats m ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and the number of graduate students in each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS grad_student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, inner_cte.grad_student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: List the top 10 department names along with the number of students in each department and the most recent warehouse load date for those students, considering only departments that are degree granting, students whose year is 'G', and only include departments of Mathematics (Course 18).

For each department, provide the department's name and calculate the range and variance of the number of students in each subject code offered by that department, considering only subject codes that belong to a school with a non-null name, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

List the top 10 department names, the number of students in each department, the most recent warehouse load date for those students, the range of the number of students in each subject code offered by that department, and the variance of the number of students in each subject code, considering only departments that are degree granting, students whose year is 'G', and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18), and only subject codes that belong to a school with a non-null name.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MAX(msd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_student_load FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC;

WITH DeptStudentCounts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MAX(msd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_student_load FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.student_count, dsc.latest_student_load, dss.subject_count_range, dss.subject_count_variance FROM DeptStudentCounts dsc JOIN DeptSubjectStats dss ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology, Course 7) in the most recent academic year that is also the Mathematics department (Course 18) and has a non-null department budget code, give the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, the average department budget code within each school (ordered by department code), the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (including only departments with more than one subject with non-null total units), and the highest total units for any subject offered by that department in that year. Order the results by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), Department_CV AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), Math_Departments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, md.SCHOOL_NAME, md.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, md.avg_dept_budget_code, dc.coefficient_of_variation FROM Department_CV dc JOIN Math_Departments md ON dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = md.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = md.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, icte.coefficient_of_variation, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, icte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, show the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, and the average department budget code within each school, ordered by department code, for departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology, Course 7) in the most recent academic year that is also the Mathematics department (Course 18) and has a non-null department budget code, give the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, the average department budget code within each school (ordered by department code), and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, including only departments with more than one subject with non-null total units, ordered by department code.
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), Department_CV AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), Math_Departments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, md.SCHOOL_NAME, md.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, md.avg_dept_budget_code, dc.coefficient_of_variation FROM Department_CV dc JOIN Math_Departments md ON dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = md.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = md.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, but only include those subjects where the total units is greater than the average total units for all Mathematics subjects offered in 2024 and present in the CIS course catalog. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, SUBJECT_TITLE, LECTURE_UNITS, LAB_UNITS, TOTAL_UNITS, GRADE_TYPE, GRADE_RULE, min_total_units_by_dept FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER ;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department code.
For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code.

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the number of subject codes for each department and subject code where the department is degree granting and is Mathematics (Course 18), and the minimum department budget code, ordered by department code, subject code, and subject number.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH OfferedMathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathDeptSubjectCodeStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT oms.SUBJECT_ID, oms.SUBJECT_CODE, oms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, oms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, oms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, oms.SUBJECT_TITLE, oms.LECTURE_UNITS, oms.LAB_UNITS, oms.TOTAL_UNITS, oms.GRADE_TYPE, oms.GRADE_RULE, oms.min_total_units_by_dept, mds.subject_code_count, mds.min_dept_budget_code FROM OfferedMathSubjects oms JOIN MathDeptSubjectCodeStats mds ON oms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND oms.SUBJECT_CODE = mds.SUBJECT_CODE AND oms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY oms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, oms.SUBJECT_CODE, oms.SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: From the top 10 administrative departments (excluding Mechanical Engineering) with the highest average total units of courses offered (considering only courses with total units greater than 0), display each administrative department's name, average total units, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the department most represented in the subjects offered by that administrative department (excluding Mathematics), and the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), admin_dept_most_rep_dept AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, admrd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM admin_dept_most_rep_dept WHERE rn = 1 ) admrd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = admrd.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON admrd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each administrative department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with total units greater than 0, and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department (Course 2)?

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and where the department is degree granting, but exclude the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each administrative department that grants degrees (excluding Mechanical Engineering) and each corresponding department (excluding Mathematics), display the administrative department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0), the department name, and the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students). Show the results ordered by the variance of total units in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and, if the department is Mathematics, also include the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (considering only subjects with enrollment greater than zero and only if more than five such subjects were offered). Additionally, for each department, list the total number of subjects offered in 2022. List the department name, average total units, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (if available), and total number of subjects in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathDeptStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), DeptSubjectCount2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.var_total_units, mdsu.stddev_total_units, dsc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN MathDeptStddevUnits mdsu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCount2022 dsc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, what is the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, where the subject enrollment number is greater than zero, and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and, if the department is Mathematics, also include the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (considering only subjects with enrollment greater than zero and only if more than five such subjects were offered). List the department name, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation of total units (if available) in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ;

WITH DeptAvgVarUnits2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathDeptStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT davu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, davu.avg_total_units, davu.var_total_units, mdsu.stddev_total_units FROM DeptAvgVarUnits2022 davu LEFT JOIN MathDeptStddevUnits mdsu ON davu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY davu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department (excluding Chemistry), what is the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department during the term '2014FA' (considering only degree-granting courses), and, if the department is Mathematics (Course 18), also provide the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and degree-granting courses)? Additionally, for each department, show the corresponding SIS subject code and subject code description. List the results ordered by the variance of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance, m.avg_total_units, m.total_units_variance, m.total_units_stddev, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) m ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd2.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY icte.enrolled_students_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department during the term '2014FA', considering only degree-granting courses and excluding the Chemistry department?

For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree granting, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department (excluding Chemistry), what is the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department during the term '2014FA' (considering only degree-granting courses), and, if the department is Mathematics (Course 18), also provide the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and degree-granting courses)? List the results ordered by the variance of enrolled students in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), MathUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, m.avg_total_units, m.total_units_variance, m.total_units_stddev FROM DeptEnrolledVariance d LEFT JOIN MathUnitsStats m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding Political Science), provide the department name, the average and variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and, for Chemistry and Biology departments, also include the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ'. Additionally, include the school name and department phone number for each department. List the department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrolled variance from course materials, school name, and department phone number in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptMaterialVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, dmv.enrolled_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DeptMaterialVariance dmv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.enrollment_variance DESC, dmv.enrolled_variance DESC

sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that grant degrees, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17).

For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student, have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department?

For each department that grants degrees (excluding Political Science), provide the department name, the average and variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and, for Chemistry and Biology departments, also include the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ'. List the department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, and enrolled variance from course materials in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC;

WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptMaterialVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dmv.enrolled_variance FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des LEFT JOIN DeptMaterialVariance dmv ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrollment_variance DESC, dmv.enrolled_variance DESC

question: For each department, what is the highest total units for any subject offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded), and for each such subject, provide the department name, subject code, subject number, and the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t2.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, window_column ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within each department, ordered by subject code.

For each subject in the Mathematics department (Course 18) offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units, list the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded), the subject code, subject number, and the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.window_column FROM DeptStats d JOIN MathSubjects2022 m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department, list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the reason for inclusion ('TotalUnits' for coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for courses, 'EnrolledStudents' for coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of number of enrolled students in subjects), the school name, and the department phone number. Include only departments that are either degree-granting and not Physics (for total units), or are Mathematics and degree-granting with at least one enrolled student in a subject (for enrolled students). Sort the table by department name and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), DeptEnrolledCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedCV AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.coefficient_of_variation, 'TotalUnits' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsCV d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.coefficient_of_variation, 'EnrolledStudents' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrolledCV d2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation, Reason FROM CombinedCV ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.Reason, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.Reason;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for courses offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department.

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees, but only include departments whose name is 'Mathematics' (i.e., Course 18).

List the department name, the coefficient of variation, and the reason for inclusion ('TotalUnits' for coefficient of variation of total units for courses, 'EnrolledStudents' for coefficient of variation of number of enrolled students in subjects) for all departments that are either degree-granting and not Physics (for total units), or are Mathematics and degree-granting with at least one enrolled student in a subject (for enrolled students).
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH DeptUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), DeptEnrolledCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedCV AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.coefficient_of_variation, 'TotalUnits' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsCV d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.coefficient_of_variation, 'EnrolledStudents' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrolledCV d2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation, Reason FROM CombinedCV ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of unique subject codes offered in degree-granting courses, display each department's name, the total number of unique subject codes, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes per course, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_unique_subject_codes, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_unique_subject_codes DESC LIMIT 10 ), student_year_stats AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_unique_subject_codes, icte.subject_count_range, icte.subject_count_variance, icte.subject_count_stddev, sys.variance_num_students, sys.stddev_num_students FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN student_year_stats sys ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sys.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.total_unique_subject_codes DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of unique subject codes per course offered by that department, considering only degree-granting courses in the Mathematics department?

For each department, what is the department name and both the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year for that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department?

For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of unique subject codes per course offered by that department (considering only degree-granting courses in Mathematics), as well as the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year for that department (considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department)? List the department name, subject code count range, subject code count variance, subject code count standard deviation, variance of number of students per student year, and standard deviation of number of students per student year, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC;

WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH subject_code_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC ), student_year_stats AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.subject_count_range, s1.subject_count_variance, s1.subject_count_stddev, s2.variance_num_students, s2.stddev_num_students FROM subject_code_stats s1 LEFT JOIN student_year_stats s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each of the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, the number of times each course is offered, and for the department associated with each course, also provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and excluding the Chemistry department), and the total number of unique subjects offered by that department. List the results ordered by offer count descending, then by coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ), DeptStudentVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_unique_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.offer_count, dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsv.coefficient_of_variation, dsc.total_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DeptStudentVariation dsv ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptSubjectCounts dsc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.offer_count DESC, dsv.coefficient_of_variation DESC;
sub_questions: What are the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, and for each, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, and the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG?

For each department except the Chemistry department, provide the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students.

For each of the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, the number of times each course is offered, and for the department associated with each course, also provide the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and excluding the Chemistry department). List the results ordered by offer count descending, then by coefficient of variation descending.
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ;

WITH TopMathCourses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ), DeptStudentVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsv.coefficient_of_variation FROM TopMathCourses tmc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DeptStudentVariation dsv ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tmc.offer_count DESC, dsv.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, for each course and each term it was offered, display the course number, course description, subject title, number of times offered, department name, number of unique course descriptions for that course and department, the minimum CIP program code for that course and department, the term code, the term description, the school name, and the department phone number. Do not repeat the course number if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by course number and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH course_desc_stats AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), top_math_courses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code, scd.FROM_TERM, scd.FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM top_math_courses tmc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN course_desc_stats cds ON scd.COURSE = cds.COURSE AND cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code, scd.FROM_TERM, scd.FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.FROM_TERM ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(COURSE_NUMBER) OVER (ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, FROM_TERM) = COURSE_NUMBER THEN NULL ELSE COURSE_NUMBER END AS COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, offer_count, DEPARTMENT_NAME, course_description_count, min_cip_program_code, FROM_TERM, FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, FROM_TERM;
sub_questions: For each course and its department where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique course descriptions and the minimum CIP program code.

What are the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, and for each, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, and the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG?

For the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, display each course's number, course description, subject title, number of times offered, department name, number of unique course descriptions for that course and department, and the minimum CIP program code for that course and department.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3;

WITH course_desc_stats AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), top_math_courses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code FROM top_math_courses tmc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN course_desc_stats cds ON scd.COURSE = cds.COURSE AND cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code ORDER BY tmc.offer_count DESC;

question: For each department, list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials (for regular terms and only for the Mathematics department), the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term (only for departments that grant degrees and excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department), and, for each subject offered by the department in 2022FA, the subject title and the number of enrolled students. The columns should be shown in the following order: department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), enrolled range, enrolled variance, enrolled standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), subject title, subject enrollment, and reason for inclusion ('LibraryMathematics' for the library materials statistics, 'DepartmentEnrollmentStats' for the enrollment statistics, and 'SubjectEnrollmentDetail' for the subject-level details). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH LibraryMathematics AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), SubjectEnrollmentDetail AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' ), CombinedDepartmentStats AS ( SELECT lm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lm.coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, NULL AS enrolled_stddev, NULL AS subject_title, NULL AS subject_enrollment, 'LibraryMathematics' AS Reason FROM LibraryMathematics lm UNION ALL SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, NULL AS subject_title, NULL AS subject_enrollment, 'DepartmentEnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des UNION ALL SELECT sed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, NULL AS enrolled_stddev, sed.SUBJECT_TITLE, sed.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS subject_enrollment, 'SubjectEnrollmentDetail' AS Reason FROM SubjectEnrollmentDetail sed ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepartmentStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason, subject_title ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;
