SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE;

WITH ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) as max_enrolled_students, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ), AcademicTermStats AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE ) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cs.max_enrolled_students, ats.academic_term_parameter, ats.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ats.avg_total_units, ats.var_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjects cs JOIN AcademicTermStats ats ON cs.TERM_CODE = ats.academic_term_parameter

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school (only including the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry), and for each department in that school where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6 (excluding the Mathematics department), also provide the department name, the maximum total units, and the number of distinct courses offered by that department. List the results ordered by budget variance descending, then by maximum total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_budget, inner_cte.budget_variance, dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.num_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) dmu ON inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME = dmu.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.budget_variance DESC, dmu.max_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school, but only include the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.

For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, and what is the name of the school that department belongs to, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6, excluding the Mathematics department?

For each school, provide the school name, the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school (only including the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry), and for each department in that school where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6 (excluding the Mathematics department), also provide the department name and the maximum total units. List the results ordered by budget variance descending, then by maximum total units descending.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

WITH SchoolBudgetStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ), DepartmentMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT sbs.SCHOOL_NAME, sbs.avg_budget, sbs.budget_variance, dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units FROM SchoolBudgetStats sbs JOIN DepartmentMaxUnits dmu ON sbs.SCHOOL_NAME = dmu.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sbs.budget_variance DESC, dmu.max_total_units DESC;

question: For each school, list the school name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by degree-granting departments in that school (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 200, and the school is not 'Non-MIT'), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms (excluding the 'Mathematics' department). For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (school name, null, total enrolled, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Show the results ordered by total number of enrolled students descending, then by coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SchoolEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME <> 'Non-MIT' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), DeptUnitsVariation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.total_enrolled, v.coefficient_of_variation FROM SchoolEnrolledStats s JOIN DeptUnitsVariation v ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = v.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE s.total_enrolled > 0 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_enrolled) > 200 OR DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ) SELECT rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_enrolled, rr.coefficient_of_variation FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.total_enrolled DESC, rr.coefficient_of_variation DESC
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5).

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For each department, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and the department is degree-granting and not Chemistry), and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms (excluding Mathematics departments). Show the results ordered by total number of enrolled students descending, then by coefficient of variation descending.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), DeptUnitsVariation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrolled, v.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptEnrolledStats e JOIN DeptUnitsVariation v ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = v.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.total_enrolled DESC, v.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, list the course number, course description, subject title, number of times offered, department name, the number of unique course descriptions, the minimum CIP program code for each course, the school name, and the department phone number, where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CourseDescAgg AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopMathCourses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cda.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cda.course_description_count, cda.min_cip_program_code FROM TopMathCourses tmc JOIN CourseDescAgg cda ON tmc.COURSE_NUMBER = cda.COURSE AND cda.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY tmc.offer_count DESC ) SELECT icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.offer_count, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.course_description_count, icte.min_cip_program_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.offer_count DESC;
sub_questions: For each course and its department where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique course descriptions and the minimum CIP program code.

What are the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, and for each, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, and the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG?

For the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, list the course number, course description, subject title, number of times offered, department name, the number of unique course descriptions, and the minimum CIP program code for each course where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3;

WITH CourseDescAgg AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopMathCourses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cda.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cda.course_description_count, cda.min_cip_program_code FROM TopMathCourses tmc JOIN CourseDescAgg cda ON tmc.COURSE_NUMBER = cda.COURSE AND cda.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY tmc.offer_count DESC;

question: For each department that is degree granting and not the Biology department and that also offers Chemistry courses with at least one library reserve material in terms with a term status indicator of 'P', list the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, and for each Chemistry course with at least one library reserve material and offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P', list the course number, the number of enrolled students, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students in that course is above the average number of enrolled students for Chemistry courses with at least one library reserve material and offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ChemistryCourseStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.variance_num_students, d.stddev_num_students, c.avg_enrolled_students, c.var_enrolled_students, c.stddev_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentStudentStats d JOIN ChemistryCourseStats c ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), ChemistryCourseDetails AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.variance_num_students, i.stddev_num_students, cd.COURSE_NUMBER, cd.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN cd.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > i.avg_enrolled_students THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Not Above Average' END AS is_above_average FROM inner_cte i JOIN ChemistryCourseDetails cd ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department offering courses, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in Chemistry courses that have at least one library reserve material and are offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P'?

For each department, what is the department name and both the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year for that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department?

For each department that is degree granting and not the Biology department and that also offers Chemistry courses with at least one library reserve material in terms with a term status indicator of 'P', what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year for that department, and the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in Chemistry courses with at least one library reserve material and offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P'? List the department name, variance of number of students, standard deviation of number of students, average number of enrolled students in Chemistry courses, variance of enrolled students in Chemistry courses, and standard deviation of enrolled students in Chemistry courses, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH ChemistryCourseStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.variance_num_students, d.stddev_num_students, c.avg_enrolled_students, c.var_enrolled_students, c.stddev_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentStudentStats d JOIN ChemistryCourseStats c ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the Mathematics department (considering only years with more than 10 subjects that have course materials and courses with a nonzero amount of enrolled students), the average of the total units, the variance of the total units, and the maximum number of enrolled students for subjects offered in terms that are not the current term, have a term status indicator of 'P', and are offered by the Mathematics department. List the results ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in descending order, then by the variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStddev e JOIN UnitsStats u ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY e.enrolled_stddev DESC, u.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.enrolled_stddev, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ccso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE AND ccso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.enrolled_stddev, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.enrolled_stddev DESC, icte.total_units_variance DESC;

List the results ordered by the standard deviation of enrolled students in descending order, then by the variance of total units in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH EnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStddev e JOIN UnitsStats u ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY e.enrolled_stddev DESC, u.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department that is degree-granting (excluding Chemistry) and is the Mathematics department, provide the department name, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of units for all subjects in the course catalog that are offered in the fall term and are part of a degree-granting program, and the number of unique subject titles offered by the department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year. Only include departments where the average enrollment is greater than 0. List the department name, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total units, and subject count in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_stddev, mdu.total_units, subj_count.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) mdu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mdu.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) subj_count ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE icte.avg_enrollment > 0 ORDER BY icte.enrollment_stddev DESC;

For each department that is degree-granting (excluding Chemistry) and is the Mathematics department, give the department name, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year, the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the total number of units for all subjects in the course catalog that are offered in the fall term and are part of a degree-granting program, only including departments where the average enrollment is greater than 0. List the department name, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation, and total units in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0;

WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ), MathDeptUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, mdu.total_units FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN MathDeptUnits mdu ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mdu.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE des.avg_enrollment > 0 ORDER BY des.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term is greater than 100, list each subject's title, the number of enrolled students, the department name, and the total number of enrolled students in the department, ordered by the number of enrolled students in each subject in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte icte ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ORDER BY sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are Mathematics (Course 18).

For the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the department in the 2021FA or 2022FA term is greater than 100, give the department name, the total number of enrolled students, and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, listing the results in descending order of total enrolled students.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DepartmentTotalEnrolled AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), DepartmentCoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled, dcov.coefficient_of_variation FROM DepartmentTotalEnrolled dte JOIN DepartmentCoefficientOfVariation dcov ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcov.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dte.total_enrolled DESC;

question: For the Chemistry department, for each term, provide the term, department name, the average number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those courses, the maximum CIP program code among its courses (considering only departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department), and the full department name, in that order. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s1.stddev_enrolled_students, s2.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(TERM_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort) = TERM_CODE THEN NULL ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students, MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS TERM_CODE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS dept_sort, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrolled_students) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(stddev_enrolled_students) AS stddev_enrolled_students, MAX(MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, MAX(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s1.stddev_enrolled_students, s2.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For all departments that either (1) have a total number of subject codes greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean across all departments (considering only degree-granting departments and excluding the Biology department), or (2) are the Mathematics department and have the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered this year with total units greater than zero, and (3) are the Management department and have the arithmetic mean of the total units for subjects offered this year with total units greater than zero, list the department code, department name, total number of subject codes (if applicable), geometric mean of total units (if applicable), arithmetic mean of total units (if applicable), and the reason for inclusion ("HighSubjectCodeCount" for high subject code count, "MathGeometricMean" for the Mathematics department geometric mean, "MgmtArithmeticMean" for the Management department arithmetic mean). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ), DeptCodeCountsFiltered AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ), MathGeometricMean AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ), MgmtArithmeticMean AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS arithmetic_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY arithmetic_mean_total_units DESC ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count, NULL AS geometric_mean_total_units, NULL AS arithmetic_mean_total_units, 'HighSubjectCodeCount' AS Reason FROM DeptCodeCountsFiltered d UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS subject_code_count, m.geometric_mean_total_units, NULL AS arithmetic_mean_total_units, 'MathGeometricMean' AS Reason FROM MathGeometricMean m UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, mg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS subject_code_count, NULL AS geometric_mean_total_units, mg.arithmetic_mean_total_units, 'MgmtArithmeticMean' AS Reason FROM MgmtArithmeticMean mg ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_code_count, geometric_mean_total_units, arithmetic_mean_total_units, Reason FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the total number of subject codes associated with it, considering only departments that have a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation above the mean across all departments, and only including departments that are degree-granting and are not the Biology department (Course 7)?

For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, have total units greater than zero, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

List, for all departments that either (1) have a total number of subject codes greater than one standard deviation above the mean across all departments (considering only degree-granting departments and excluding the Biology department), or (2) are the Mathematics department and have the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered this year with total units greater than zero, the department code, department name, total number of subject codes (if applicable), geometric mean of total units (if applicable), and the reason for inclusion ("HighSubjectCodeCount" for high subject code count, "MathGeometricMean" for the Mathematics department geometric mean).
sub_sqls: WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ), DeptCodeCountsFiltered AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ), MathGeometricMean AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count, NULL AS geometric_mean_total_units, 'HighSubjectCodeCount' AS Reason FROM DeptCodeCountsFiltered d UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS subject_code_count, m.geometric_mean_total_units, 'MathGeometricMean' AS Reason FROM MathGeometricMean m ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_code_count, geometric_mean_total_units, Reason FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school (only including the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry), and for each department in that school where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6 (excluding the Mathematics department), also provide the department name and the maximum total units. Then, for each such department, list all courses offered by that department with total units equal to the department's maximum total units, including the course's subject number and subject title. List the results ordered by budget variance descending, then by maximum total units descending, then by subject number ascending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SchoolBudgetStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ), DepartmentMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT sbs.SCHOOL_NAME, sbs.avg_budget, sbs.budget_variance, dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SchoolBudgetStats sbs JOIN DepartmentMaxUnits dmu ON sbs.SCHOOL_NAME = dmu.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_budget, inner_cte.budget_variance, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.max_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.budget_variance DESC, inner_cte.max_total_units DESC, ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER ASC;
sub_questions: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school, but only include the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.

For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, and what is the name of the school that department belongs to, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6, excluding the Mathematics department?

For each school, provide the school name, the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school (only including the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry), and for each department in that school where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6 (excluding the Mathematics department), also provide the department name and the maximum total units. List the results ordered by budget variance descending, then by maximum total units descending.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

WITH SchoolBudgetStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ), DepartmentMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT sbs.SCHOOL_NAME, sbs.avg_budget, sbs.budget_variance, dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units FROM SchoolBudgetStats sbs JOIN DepartmentMaxUnits dmu ON sbs.SCHOOL_NAME = dmu.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sbs.budget_variance DESC, dmu.max_total_units DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department except for the Biology department (Course 7), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. List the department name, average enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, in that order, sorted by average enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.var_enrolled_students, stats.avg_total_units, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.avg_enrolled_students DESC
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree granting, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For departments that are degree-granting and are not the Biology department (Course 7), and for which the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. List the department name, average enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation of total units, in that order, sorted by average enrolled students in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathematicsUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, mus.avg_total_units, mus.total_units_variance, mus.total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des JOIN MathematicsUnitsStats mus ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.avg_enrolled_students DESC

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and the average number of enrolled students for each subject in the department, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and are not offered in the summer term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = tso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department give the department code, the department name, the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are Mathematics (Course 18)?

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department in the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department code, department name, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code (where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000), as well as the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department. List the columns in the following order: department code, department name, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, average enrollment, enrollment range, and enrollment variance.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.min_num_enrolled_students, ds.avg_dept_budget_code, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_range, es.enrollment_variance FROM DeptStats ds JOIN EnrollmentStats es ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and each term in that year, what are the academic year, academic year description, term code, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in that term (considering only regular terms, not in the future), as well as the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and terms that are not the current term), and for each term, what is the number of Mathematics subjects offered and the average total units per subject in that term? List the results as: academic year, academic year description, term code, term total units range, term total units variance, term total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), year total units range, year total units variance, number of math subjects in term, and average total units per math subject in term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TermStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ), YearStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.total_units_range AS term_total_units_range, ts.total_units_variance AS term_total_units_variance, ts.total_units_stddev AS term_total_units_stddev, ys.total_units_range AS year_total_units_range, ys.total_units_variance AS year_total_units_variance FROM YearStats ys JOIN TermStats ts ON ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ts.TERM_CODE ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.term_total_units_range, icte.term_total_units_variance, icte.term_total_units_stddev, icte.year_total_units_range, icte.year_total_units_variance, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_math_subjects_in_term, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_per_math_subject_in_term FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.term_total_units_range, icte.term_total_units_variance, icte.term_total_units_stddev, icte.year_total_units_range, icte.year_total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in each term of that year, considering only terms that are regular terms, are not in the future, and where the subjects are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year and each term in that year, what are the academic year, academic year description, term code, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of Mathematics subjects offered in that term (considering only regular terms, not in the future), as well as the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and terms that are not the current term)? List the results as: academic year, academic year description, term code, term total units range, term total units variance, term total units standard deviation, year total units range, and year total units variance.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

WITH TermStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ), YearStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.total_units_range AS term_total_units_range, ts.total_units_variance AS term_total_units_variance, ts.total_units_stddev AS term_total_units_stddev, ys.total_units_range AS year_total_units_range, ys.total_units_variance AS year_total_units_variance FROM YearStats ys JOIN TermStats ts ON ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ts.TERM_CODE;

question: For each student in the Political Science department whose department is Course 17, show the student's full name, department name, school name, SIS administrative department name, and their dense rank over student year (ordered by student year), along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by their department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department. For each department, also include a grand total row (with null for full name, department name, school name, SIS administrative department name, and student year rank) showing the overall average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for that department. Present the columns in the following order: full name, department name, school name, SIS administrative department name, student year rank, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank, msd.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), StudentWithStats AS ( SELECT ic.FULL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.student_year_rank, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s.FULL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.student_year_rank, s.avg_total_units, s.var_total_units, s.stddev_total_units FROM StudentWithStats s UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS FULL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS student_year_rank, s.avg_total_units, s.var_total_units, s.stddev_total_units FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM DeptUnitsStats WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) s ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, FULL_NAME ;

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), PoliSciStudents AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank, msd.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ps.FULL_NAME, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.student_year_rank, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM PoliSciStudents ps LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ps.FULL_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department (ordered by subject code), the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term (restricted to departments that grant degrees and only including the Mathematics department), as well as the school name and department phone number for the department. List the results ordered by subject code, and do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.window_column, stats.avg_total_units, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE;
