sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.variance_num_students, s2.stddev_num_students FROM Sub1 s1 LEFT JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting Mathematics department (Course 18) with a non-null department budget code, what is the department code, department name, the number of unique courses offered, the total number of students, the number of associated administrative departments, and the number of graduate students in that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_admin_dept_count AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), math_grad_student_count AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_unique_courses, ic.num_students, madc.admin_dept_count, mgsc.num_grad_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN math_admin_dept_count madc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = madc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN math_grad_student_count mgsc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting and is the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department code, department name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, and the total number of students in that department?

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH math_dept_summary AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_admin_dept_count AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.num_unique_courses, mds.num_students, madc.admin_dept_count FROM math_dept_summary mds JOIN math_admin_dept_count madc ON mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = madc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting and not in Mathematics (Course 18), as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term, and include the school name and department phone number for each department. Only include departments that are degree-granting and not Physics (Course 8). Present the columns in the following order: department name, school name, department phone number, average total units, total units range, total units variance, variance of total units in 2022FA, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in 2022FA. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptUnitsStats2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance, d2.variance_total_units, d2.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats2 d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d1.total_units_range DESC, d2.variance_total_units DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH DeptUnitsStats1 AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptUnitsStats2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance, d2.variance_total_units, d2.stddev_total_units FROM DeptUnitsStats1 d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats2 d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.total_units_range DESC, d2.variance_total_units DESC;

question: For the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Chemistry department, display each course's number, course description, subject title, number of times offered, department name, number of unique course descriptions for that course and department, and the minimum CIP program code for that course and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH course_desc_stats AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), top_chem_courses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT tcc.COURSE_NUMBER, tcc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tcc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tcc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code FROM top_chem_courses tcc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tcc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN course_desc_stats cds ON scd.COURSE = cds.COURSE AND cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tcc.COURSE_NUMBER, tcc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tcc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tcc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code ORDER BY tcc.offer_count DESC ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH course_desc_stats AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), top_math_courses AS ( SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code FROM top_math_courses tmc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN course_desc_stats cds ON scd.COURSE = cds.COURSE AND cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code ORDER BY tmc.offer_count DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that grants degrees, is not the Department of Management (Course 15) or the Political Science department, has more than 50 students enrolled in its courses, and has offered more than five subjects, display the department name, the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the graduate level(s) of courses in that department, ordering the results by total enrollment in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), dept_units_stddev AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.total_enrollment, du.stddev_total_units FROM dept_enrollment de JOIN dept_units_stddev du ON de.DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollment, icte.stddev_total_units, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollment, icte.stddev_total_units, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL ORDER BY icte.total_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15).

For each department, what is the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, only including subjects offered by the School of Engineering, and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Political Science department?

For each department in the School of Engineering that grants degrees, is not the Department of Management (Course 15) or the Political Science department, has more than 50 students enrolled in its courses, and has offered more than five subjects, display the department name, the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department, and the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, ordering the results by total enrollment in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ;

WITH dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), dept_units_stddev AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollment, du.stddev_total_units FROM dept_enrollment de JOIN dept_units_stddev du ON de.DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY de.total_enrollment DESC;

question: From the top 10 degree-granting Engineering courses (excluding those from the Mathematics department) with the highest maximum CIP program codes among their associated subject codes, display each course's name, its maximum CIP program code, the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Biology department and only including degree-granting departments), and the ratio of average to variance of total units (rounded to two decimal places), listing the results in descending order of this ratio.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.max_cip_program_code, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.var_total_units, ROUND(du.avg_total_units / NULLIF(du.var_total_units, 0), 2) AS avg_to_var_ratio FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DepartmentUnits du ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.max_cip_program_code DESC, avg_to_var_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, and what is the department name of the course, excluding courses from the Mathematics department?

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting and not from the Mathematics department, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, the department name of the course, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Biology department and only including degree-granting departments), and the ratio of average to variance of total units (rounded to two decimal places), listing the results in descending order of this ratio?
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH EngineeringCourses AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ec.COURSE, ec.max_cip_program_code, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.var_total_units, ROUND(du.avg_total_units / NULLIF(du.var_total_units, 0), 2) AS avg_to_var_ratio FROM EngineeringCourses ec JOIN DepartmentUnits du ON ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_to_var_ratio DESC;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each building where those courses are held this year, the building key, and the average total units of those courses in that building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_in_building FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ;
sub_questions: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, ordered by department name.

For each building, what is the building key and what are both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of courses held in rooms of that building, considering only courses that are offered this year, have more than 0 total units, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, and for each building where Mathematics courses (Course 18) are offered this year with more than 0 total units, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the average department budget code within each school, the building key, the variance of the total units of Mathematics courses held in rooms of that building, and the standard deviation of the total units of those courses, ordered by department name and descending variance of total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH SubjectCodes AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), BuildingStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.avg_dept_budget_code, bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.total_units_variance, bs.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectCodes sc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingStats bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, bs.total_units_variance DESC

question: For each graduate student in the Political Science department, where the department is degree granting, show their first name, last name, email address, department name, school name, and the maximum department budget code for each student considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by last name. Additionally, for each subject offered in the term '2016SP' with a total number of units greater than 1 in the Political Science department, show the subject ID, subject title, the running sum of total units within each school name group ordered by subject ID, and the corresponding subject code and subject code description. Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name, last name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, p.SUBJECT_ID) = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, p.SUBJECT_ID, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, p.running_sum_total_units, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte s JOIN ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT, sos.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) p ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = p.DEPARTMENT LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON p.COURSE_NUMBER = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY department_name, s.LAST_NAME, p.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each student in the Political Science department, show their first name, last name, email address, department name, school name, and the maximum department budget code for each student considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by last name, where the student year is 'G' and the department is degree granting.

For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total number of units greater than 1, in the Political Science department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school name group, ordered by subject ID.

For each graduate student in the Political Science department, where the department is degree granting, show their first name, last name, email address, department name, school name, and the maximum department budget code for each student considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by last name, along with, for each subject offered in the term '2016SP' with a total number of units greater than 1 in the Political Science department, the subject ID, subject title, and the running sum of total units within each school name group ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'

SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH PoliticalScienceStudents AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ), PoliticalScienceSubjects AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, p.SUBJECT_ID, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, p.running_sum_total_units FROM PoliticalScienceStudents s JOIN PoliticalScienceSubjects p ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = p.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY s.LAST_NAME, p.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses (considering only courses that are offered in the current term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are in the Mathematics department with available course materials), as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department. Additionally, include the school name and department phone number for the Mathematics department. Present the results ordered by the enrolled student range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH enrolled_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), units_stats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, us.avg_total_units, us.stddev_total_units FROM enrolled_stats es JOIN units_stats us ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year, and calculate the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the current term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18) with available course materials.

For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses (considering only courses that are offered in the current term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are in the Mathematics department with available course materials), as well as the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department. Present the results ordered by the enrolled student range in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH enrolled_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), units_stats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, us.avg_total_units, us.stddev_total_units FROM enrolled_stats es JOIN units_stats us ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics department subjects offered in terms within that year, the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), and the average total units of Mathematics department subjects offered in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), IAPMaxEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC ), AvgTotalUnits AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.coefficient_of_variation, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev, a.avg_total_units FROM CoefficientOfVariation c LEFT JOIN IAPMaxEnrollmentStats i ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN AvgTotalUnits a ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.coefficient_of_variation, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev, a.avg_total_units FROM IAPMaxEnrollmentStats i LEFT JOIN CoefficientOfVariation c ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN AvgTotalUnits a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), IAPMaxEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.coefficient_of_variation, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev FROM CoefficientOfVariation c LEFT JOIN IAPMaxEnrollmentStats i ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.coefficient_of_variation, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAPMaxEnrollmentStats i LEFT JOIN CoefficientOfVariation c ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department, list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department (excluding the Physics department), the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Biology department, Course 7), and the number of unique subject codes associated with that department, but only include departments that have at least one course and at least one subject offered in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentCourseVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dss.avg_total_units, dss.var_total_units FROM DepartmentCourseVariation dcv JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.avg_total_units, icte.var_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.avg_total_units, icte.var_total_units ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

WITH DepartmentCourseVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dss.avg_total_units, dss.var_total_units FROM DepartmentCourseVariation dcv JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List the department names, subject codes, subject code descriptions, graduate level, total number of courses per department, and for each department, also show the subject number, subject title, and total units for all subjects offered in the 2024 academic year, ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER;

For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, and for the Mathematics department, also show the department code, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and the row number within the department (ordered by subject code) for each subject offered in 2024 with total units equal to 12. List the columns in the following order: department name, coefficient of variation, department code, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and row number.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH DepartmentVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation, ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.window_column FROM DepartmentVariation dv LEFT JOIN MathSubjects ms ON dv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column;

question: For each department that is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18), is degree-granting, and is not 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2), provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects that have at least one associated tip material, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, and the average number of enrolled students for all subjects in the department. Only include departments that satisfy all these criteria. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.coefficient_of_variation, s2.clearing_cost_collector_range, s2.clearing_cost_collector_variance, s2.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM (SELECT ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) s1 JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.clearing_cost_collector_range, icte.clearing_cost_collector_variance, icte.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.clearing_cost_collector_range, icte.clearing_cost_collector_variance, icte.clearing_cost_collector_stddev
