sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH DeptYearStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dys.department, dys.academic_year, dys.subject_count, dys.min_term_start_date, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM DeptYearStats dys LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON dys.department = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dys.department, dys.academic_year

question: For each academic building on the MIT site (excluding the Brown Building) that has more than one floor, and for each organization (excluding 'ADMISSIONS') with more than 5 rooms assigned in that building, display the building name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area of its floors, the organization name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization, and the deviation of the building's current assignable area from its average historical assignable area. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH org_area_stddev AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5 ), building_floor_stats AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '39' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 1 ) SELECT bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev, bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM building_floor_stats bfs LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN org_area_stddev oas ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev, bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_assignable_area, ic.stddev_assignable_area, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_stddev, (fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA - COALESCE(hb.avg_hist_assignable_area, 0)) AS deviation_from_hist_avg FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_hist_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) hb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = hb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '39' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 1 ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_NAME ;

WITH org_area_stddev AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5 ), building_floor_stats AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '39' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 1 ) SELECT bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev FROM building_floor_stats bfs LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN org_area_stddev oas ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev ORDER BY bfs.BUILDING_NAME, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: From the top 10 graduate students in the Political Science department (from degree-granting departments) with the highest department budget codes, display each student's first name, last name, email address, department name, school name, the maximum department budget code for each student considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by last name, as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by their department (considering only degree-granting departments, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ), dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), ranked_students AS ( SELECT icte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY icte.max_dept_budget_code DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte icte ) SELECT rs.FIRST_NAME, rs.LAST_NAME, rs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, rs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rs.SCHOOL_NAME, rs.max_dept_budget_code, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units FROM ranked_students rs LEFT JOIN dept_subject_stats ds ON rs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE rs.rn <= 10 ORDER BY rs.max_dept_budget_code DESC

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH political_science_students AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ), dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ps.FIRST_NAME, ps.LAST_NAME, ps.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.max_dept_budget_code, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units FROM political_science_students ps LEFT JOIN dept_subject_stats ds ON ps.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department, and the full department description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ordered by department code and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept, mgs.total_graduate_students, ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ms JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) mgs ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, ic.LAB_UNITS, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.GRADE_TYPE, ic.GRADE_RULE, ic.min_total_units_by_dept, ic.total_graduate_students, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG AS department_description FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathGradStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept, mgs.total_graduate_students FROM MathSubjects ms JOIN MathGradStudents mgs ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department and subject grade type where the subject is offered in the current academic year, is letter graded, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the department name, the subject grade type, the number of subjects, the minimum total units, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department during the term '2014FA', and the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department during the same term, considering only degree-granting courses and excluding the Chemistry department. List the results ordered by the number of subjects in descending order, then by the variance of enrolled students in descending order, and then by the maximum number of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ), DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.GRADE_TYPE, m.subject_count, m.min_total_units, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte m LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledStats d ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.subject_count DESC, d.enrolled_students_variance DESC, d.max_enrolled_students DESC

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE;

SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

WITH MathLetterGradedStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.GRADE_TYPE, m.subject_count, m.min_total_units, d.enrolled_students_variance FROM MathLetterGradedStats m LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance d ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.subject_count DESC, d.enrolled_students_variance DESC

question: For the Mathematics department, which is degree granting, and for each school name, provide the department name, school name, the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code, the total number of units for all subjects in the course catalog that are offered in the fall term, the average number of units per course (rounded), and for each course, show the corresponding SIS subject code and subject code description.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TotalUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), CourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.course_count, cs.min_cip_code, tu.total_units, ROUND(tu.total_units / NULLIF(cs.course_count, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_course FROM CourseStats cs JOIN TotalUnits tu ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, icte.total_units, icte.avg_units_per_course, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, icte.total_units, icte.avg_units_per_course, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH TotalUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), CourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.course_count, cs.min_cip_code, tu.total_units, ROUND(tu.total_units / NULLIF(cs.course_count, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_course FROM CourseStats cs JOIN TotalUnits tu ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each organization, what is the organization name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to it (considering only organizations with more than 5 rooms and excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'), the average of the HR department codes for its associated HR org units, the variance of the HR department codes for its associated HR org units (considering only organizations that are assignable, have a non-null HR department code, are not the 'ADMISSIONS' organization, and do not have organization IDs '138' or '250'), and the maximum area of any room assigned to the organization? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5 ), OrgDeptCodeStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS dept_code_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.area_stddev, ods.avg_dept_code, ods.dept_code_variance FROM RoomAreaStats ras JOIN OrgDeptCodeStats ods ON ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.avg_dept_code, inner_cte.dept_code_variance, MAX(fr.AREA) AS max_room_area FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.avg_dept_code, inner_cte.dept_code_variance;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

WITH RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5 ), OrgDeptCodeStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS dept_code_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.area_stddev, ods.avg_dept_code, ods.dept_code_variance FROM RoomAreaStats ras JOIN OrgDeptCodeStats ods ON ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, is not the Chemistry department, and has more than five subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the deviation of the number of enrolled students in each subject from the average number of enrolled students for that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student)? Show the department name, subject id, total units, number of enrolled students, and the deviation from the department average, ordered from highest to lowest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS ), StdDevTotalUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), DeptAvgEnrolled AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 ), AvgEnrolledPerDept AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM DeptAvgEnrolled GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sdt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, d.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (d.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - a.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_avg_enrolled, sdt.total_units_stddev FROM StdDevTotalUnits sdt JOIN inner_cte ic ON sdt.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptAvgEnrolled d ON sdt.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN AvgEnrolledPerDept a ON sdt.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sdt.total_units_stddev DESC
sub_questions: For each department, what is the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have more than five subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and only including departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department? Show the department name and the calculated standard deviation, ordered from highest to lowest standard deviation.

For each department, what is the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department that is degree-granting, is not the Chemistry department, and has more than five subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, what is the department name, the standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (where the coefficient of variation is only calculated for the Mathematics department, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student)? Show the department name, the standard deviation of total units, and the coefficient of variation, ordered from highest to lowest standard deviation of total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH StdDevTotalUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), CoeffOfVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sdt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdt.total_units_stddev, cov.coefficient_of_variation FROM StdDevTotalUnits sdt LEFT JOIN CoeffOfVariation cov ON sdt.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cov.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sdt.total_units_stddev DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees and is not the Political Science department, and for each term, provide the department name, term, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for its associated administrative department, as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in degree-granting courses with more than zero enrolled students offered by that department in that term, but only for departments in the Mathematics department (Course 18). List the department name, term, average clearing cost collector, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of clearing cost collector, average enrollment, and enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments and terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department and term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptClearingCost AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, me.TERM_CODE, dcc.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcc.stddev_clearing_cost_collector, me.avg_enrollment, me.enrollment_stddev FROM DeptClearingCost dcc LEFT JOIN MathEnrollment me ON dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = me.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY department_name, term_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, term, avg_clearing_cost_collector, stddev_clearing_cost_collector, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(term_code) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS department_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(term_code) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(term_code) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE term_code END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(term_code) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE term_code END AS term_sort, department_name, term_code, AVG(avg_clearing_cost_collector) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(stddev_clearing_cost_collector) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(enrollment_stddev) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name, term_code WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY department_sort, term_sort;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

WITH DeptClearingCost AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcc.stddev_clearing_cost_collector, me.avg_enrollment, me.enrollment_stddev FROM DeptClearingCost dcc LEFT JOIN MathEnrollment me ON dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = me.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department that is degree granting, not the Chemistry department (Course 5), and has at least 100 total enrolled students in its offered subjects, give the department name, the total number of enrolled students, and for each subject offered by the Mathematics department in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title. For each department, also include a grand total for all Mathematics subjects in the format of (department name, total enrolled students, null, null, null, total enrolled in all Math subjects). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ), MathSubjects2005FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathSubjectsRollup AS ( SELECT ms.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ms.window_column, SUM(ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_math_subject_enrollment FROM MathSubjects2005FA ms GROUP BY ms.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ms.window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING (ms.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND SUM(ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) OR (ms.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL) ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled_students, msr.SUBJECT_TITLE, msr.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, msr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, msr.window_column, CASE WHEN msr.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL THEN msr.total_math_subject_enrollment ELSE NULL END AS total_math_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN MathSubjectsRollup msr ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msr.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY icte.total_enrolled_students DESC, msr.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department that is degree granting and has only degree granting courses, excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, and, if the department is Political Science (Course 17), also give the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting? Additionally, for the Political Science department, include the total number of such subjects. List the department name, average CIP program code, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of CIP program code, average total units, total units range, total units variance, and subject count, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), PoliticalScienceUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '17' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_cip_program_code, icte.stddev_cip_program_code, psu.avg_total_units, psu.total_units_range, psu.total_units_variance, psu.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN PoliticalScienceUnits psu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = psu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '17' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), PoliticalScienceUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '17' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.stddev_cip_program_code, psu.avg_total_units, psu.total_units_range, psu.total_units_variance FROM DeptCIPStats dcs LEFT JOIN PoliticalScienceUnits psu ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = psu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 10 departments (excluding Chemistry and Political Science) that offered the most subjects in 2021 and are degree-granting, show each department's code, name, school name, number of subjects offered, total enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of students per student year, the range and variance of students per student year, and the most common student year in that department along with the count of students in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjects2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds21.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds21.SCHOOL_NAME, ds21.num_subjects_offered, ds21.total_enrolled_students, dstat.avg_students_per_year, dstat.range_students_per_year, dstat.var_students_per_year FROM DeptSubjects2021 ds21 JOIN dept_stats dstat ON ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dstat.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds21.num_subjects_offered DESC, ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_subjects_offered, icte.total_enrolled_students, icte.avg_students_per_year, icte.range_students_per_year, icte.var_students_per_year, sc.STUDENT_YEAR AS Most_Common_Student_Year, sc.num_students AS Student_Year_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) sc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT AND sc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.num_subjects_offered DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year, range_students_per_year, var_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DeptSubjects2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds21.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds21.SCHOOL_NAME, ds21.num_subjects_offered, ds21.total_enrolled_students, dstat.avg_students_per_year, dstat.range_students_per_year, dstat.var_students_per_year FROM DeptSubjects2021 ds21 JOIN dept_stats dstat ON ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dstat.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds21.num_subjects_offered DESC, ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: From the top 10 subjects offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5) with the highest number of enrolled students, display each subject's title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, term code, material status key, the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject ID, and the department most represented among the responsible faculty for these subjects along with the count of subjects from that department. For each such subject, also provide the corresponding academic term parameter, the term description, the average total units, and the variance of total units of all subjects offered in the corresponding effective term, considering only subjects that are offered this year and are in the Mathematics department. The columns should be: subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, term code, material status key, maximum number of enrolled students, most prominent responsible faculty department, count of subjects from that department, academic term parameter, term description, average total units, and variance of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) as max_enrolled_students, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ), faculty_dept_counts AS ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.max_enrolled_students, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Responsible_Faculty_Department, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.max_enrolled_students, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), ranked_faculty_dept AS ( SELECT fdc.*, @rank := IF(@current_subject = fdc.SUBJECT_TITLE, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, @current_subject := fdc.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM (SELECT * FROM faculty_dept_counts ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE, Subject_Count DESC) fdc CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_subject := '') vars ), AcademicTermStats AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE ) SELECT rfd.SUBJECT_TITLE, rfd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rfd.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, rfd.TERM_CODE, rfd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rfd.max_enrolled_students, rfd.Most_Prominent_Responsible_Faculty_Department, rfd.Subject_Count, ats.academic_term_parameter, ats.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ats.avg_total_units, ats.var_total_units FROM ranked_faculty_dept rfd JOIN AcademicTermStats ats ON rfd.TERM_CODE = ats.academic_term_parameter WHERE rfd.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY rfd.max_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10;

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')

SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE;

WITH ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) as max_enrolled_students, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ), AcademicTermStats AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE ) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cs.max_enrolled_students, ats.academic_term_parameter, ats.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ats.avg_total_units, ats.var_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjects cs JOIN AcademicTermStats ats ON cs.TERM_CODE = ats.academic_term_parameter

question: For each department, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments with more than 5 subjects offered in the 'Engineering' school and excluding the 'Political Science' department), the average of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments (excluding the 'Mathematics' department), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments (excluding the 'Mathematics' department), and whether the department is a 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT_VARIANCE' (if the stddev of enrolled students is at least 20% greater than the average stddev across all such departments), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT_VARIANCE' (if at least 20% less), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_enrollment_stddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), dept_subject_code_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.stddev_num_enrolled_students, dscs.avg_subject_codes, dscs.stddev_subject_codes FROM dept_enrollment_stddev des JOIN dept_subject_code_stats dscs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), enrollment_variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(stddev_num_enrolled_students) AS avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_subject_codes, ic.stddev_subject_codes, CASE WHEN ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students > evb.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students < evb.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS enrollment_variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN enrollment_variance_benchmark evb;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments with more than 5 subjects offered in the 'Engineering' school, and excluding the 'Political Science' department (Course 17)?

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, but only include departments other than 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For each department, what is the department name, the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments with more than 5 subjects offered in the 'Engineering' school and excluding the 'Political Science' department), the average of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments (excluding the 'Mathematics' department), and the standard deviation of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments (excluding the 'Mathematics' department)?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC;

WITH dept_enrollment_stddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), dept_subject_code_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.stddev_num_enrolled_students, dscs.avg_subject_codes, dscs.stddev_subject_codes FROM dept_enrollment_stddev des JOIN dept_subject_code_stats dscs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List the department names, subject codes, subject code descriptions, graduate level, total number of courses per department, and for each department, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, inner_cte.Total_Courses, stats.avg_total_units, stats.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department.

For the Mathematics department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded, where the department is degree-granting and not Biology. List the department name, the average and standard deviation of total units for Mathematics, and the average, range, and variance of total units for Mathematics in 2022 letter-graded, degree-granting, non-Biology subjects, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH math_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT math_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, math_stats.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, math_stats.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dept_stats.avg_total_units AS dept_avg_total_units_2022, dept_stats.range_total_units, dept_stats.var_total_units FROM math_stats LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON math_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List the department names, their corresponding SIS subject codes, subject code descriptions, graduate level, total number of courses per department, and the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects for each degree-granting department (excluding Biology and Chemistry). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) des ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses that are at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments?

List the top 10 departments by the number of unique courses they offer, including only departments that are degree-granting and are not the Political Science department, showing the department name from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, the school name from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, and the count of unique course numbers from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.

For the top 10 departments by the number of unique courses they offer (excluding Political Science and including only degree-granting departments), what are the department name, school name, count of unique course numbers, variance of the number of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects offered by that department (excluding Biology and Chemistry), and the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in those subjects? List the results in order of course count descending and then department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY course_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), TopDeptCourses AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY course_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdc.SCHOOL_NAME, tdc.course_count, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM TopDeptCourses tdc LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON tdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tdc.course_count DESC, tdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For departments that are degree granting and have at least 15 graduate students, and where the department's school name is not null, provide the department name, the number of graduate students, the most recent warehouse load date for those students, the range and variance of the number of graduate students in each subject code offered by the department, and the name of the school the department belongs to. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MAX(msd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_student_load FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) >= 15 ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.student_count, ic.latest_student_load, dss.subject_count_range, dss.subject_count_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptSubjectStats dss ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: List the top 10 department names along with the number of students in each department and the most recent warehouse load date for those students, considering only departments that are degree granting, students whose year is 'G', and only include departments of Mathematics (Course 18).

For each department, provide the department's name and calculate the range and variance of the number of students in each subject code offered by that department, considering only subject codes that belong to a school with a non-null name, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18).

List the department name, the number of students in the department, the most recent warehouse load date for those students, the range of the number of students in each subject code offered by the department, and the variance of the number of students in each subject code, considering only departments that are degree granting, students whose year is 'G', and only include departments of Mathematics (Course 18), and only subject codes that belong to a school with a non-null name.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MAX(msd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_student_load FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC;

WITH DeptStudentCounts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MAX(msd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_student_load FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.student_count, dsc.latest_student_load, dss.subject_count_range, dss.subject_count_variance FROM DeptStudentCounts dsc JOIN DeptSubjectStats dss ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology and Chemistry), and for each term, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the graduate-level subjects offered by that department in that term, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects with more than 0 total units in that term? Please provide the term, department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, the range of total units, the variance of total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, in that order. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms and departments (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT sos.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY sos.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT e.TERM_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, u.total_units_range, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM EnrolledStats e JOIN UnitsStats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND e.TERM_CODE = u.TERM_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, MAX(enrolled_range) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(enrolled_variance) AS enrolled_variance, MAX(total_units_range) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;
