For subjects in the academic term with term code '2009SP', show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, but only include subjects from the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each subject in the Mathematics department (Course 18) offered in the academic term with term code '2009SP', show the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that have at least one tip subject offered in the term '2019FA'), the subject title, the total units, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.enrolled_students_variance, s1.enrolled_students_stddev, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year where the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total lecture units across all academic years, provide the academic year, the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department, the total number of lecture units for all such subjects, and the highest number of lecture units for a single Mathematics subject offered in a regular term that year, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AcademicYearUnitsStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), AcademicYearLectureUnits AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) t ) ) SELECT ayus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayus.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayus.total_units_range, ayus.total_units_variance, aylu.total_lecture_units FROM AcademicYearUnitsStats ayus JOIN AcademicYearLectureUnits aylu ON ayus.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aylu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ayus.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_lecture_units, MAX(ss.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units_single_subject FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_lecture_units ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, what is the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only those academic years where the total lecture units are more than one standard deviation above the mean total lecture units across all academic years?

For each academic year where the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department is more than one standard deviation above the mean total lecture units across all academic years, provide the academic year, the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department, and the total number of lecture units for all such subjects, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) t );

WITH AcademicYearUnitsStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), AcademicYearLectureUnits AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) t ) ) SELECT ayus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayus.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayus.total_units_range, ayus.total_units_variance, aylu.total_lecture_units FROM AcademicYearUnitsStats ayus JOIN AcademicYearLectureUnits aylu ON ayus.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aylu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ayus.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest total enrolled students in courses offered by the School of Engineering or School of Science (or the Department of Mathematics), display each department's name, total enrolled students, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department budget code, the corresponding administrative department name, and the most represented course in that department along with its enrolled student count, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a non-null budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20 ), DeptBudgetStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MostRepresentedCourse AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS course_enrolled_students, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled_students, dbs.dept_budget_code_stddev, dbs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mrc.COURSE_NUMBER AS Most_Represented_Course, mrc.course_enrolled_students AS Most_Represented_Course_Enrolled FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptBudgetStats dbs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MostRepresentedCourse mrc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mrc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND mrc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.total_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department of Engineering or Science, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 20, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and to the Department of Mathematics.

For each department, what is the standard deviation of the department budget code, and what is the corresponding administrative department name, considering only departments that are degree granting, have a non-null budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department, provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department of Engineering or Science (or the Department of Mathematics) where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 20, the standard deviation of the department budget code, and the corresponding administrative department name, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a non-null budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH EnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20 ), DeptBudgetStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.total_enrolled_students, dbs.dept_budget_code_stddev, dbs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM EnrolledStudents es JOIN DeptBudgetStats dbs ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry and Biology) that offers at least 5 subjects with more than 10 enrolled students, what are the department code, department full name, school name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in those subjects, and, for the Mathematics department (Course 18), the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, school name, and dense rank over the department code ordered by department code for subjects with more than 10 enrolled students? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) >= 5 ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.avg_enrolled_students, ds.var_enrolled_students, ds.stddev_enrolled_students, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_school_name, ms.window_column FROM DeptStats ds LEFT JOIN MathSubjects ms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE

List the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and school name for each subject offered, along with dense ranks over the department code ordered by department code, for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in departments that grant degrees, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18).

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME

SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.avg_enrolled_students, ds.var_enrolled_students, ds.stddev_enrolled_students, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_school_name, ms.window_column FROM DeptStats ds LEFT JOIN MathSubjects ms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for Mathematics subjects with library reserve materials (excluding summer and current terms), and the geometric mean of total units for Mathematics subjects with library reserve materials offered in the fall term with more than zero total units. Indicate the source of each row as either 'AvgStddev' or 'GeomMean'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), GeomMeanUnits AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), CombinedUnits AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, NULL AS geometric_mean_total_units, 'AvgStddev' AS Source FROM inner_cte a UNION ALL SELECT g.ACADEMIC_YEAR, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, g.GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS, 'GeomMean' AS Source FROM GeomMeanUnits g ) SELECT * FROM CombinedUnits ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Source;
sub_questions: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department in terms that are not summer terms and are currently not the current term.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units of all subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero total units, and are in the Mathematics department?

For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, average total units, standard deviation of total units, and geometric mean of total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, where the average and standard deviation are calculated for subjects offered in non-summer, non-current terms, and the geometric mean is calculated for subjects offered in the fall term with more than zero total units. Indicate the source of each row as either 'AvgStddev' or 'GeomMean'.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), GeomMeanUnits AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), CombinedUnits AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, NULL AS geometric_mean_total_units, 'AvgStddev' AS Source FROM AvgStddevUnits a UNION ALL SELECT g.ACADEMIC_YEAR, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, g.GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS, 'GeomMean' AS Source FROM GeomMeanUnits g ) SELECT * FROM CombinedUnits ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Source;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the maximum and minimum number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (for departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department), as well as the maximum and minimum total units of subjects offered by that department (for the Mathematics department only, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that grant degrees). For each row, also include the reason for inclusion ('EnrolledStats' for enrolled students statistics and 'UnitsStats' for total units statistics). Show the columns in this order: department name, max enrolled students, min enrolled students, max total units, min total units, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrolled_students, i.min_enrolled_students, NULL AS max_total_units, NULL AS min_total_units, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT u.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS max_enrolled_students, NULL AS min_enrolled_students, u.max_total_units, u.min_total_units, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM UnitsStats u ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_enrolled_students, min_enrolled_students, max_total_units, min_total_units, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7)? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation.

For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that grant degrees, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

List, for each department, the department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (for departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department), as well as the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered by that department (for the Mathematics department only, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that grant degrees). For each row, also include the reason for inclusion ('EnrolledStats' for enrolled students statistics and 'UnitsStats' for total units statistics). Show the columns in this order: department name, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation, total units variance, total units standard deviation, and reason.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM EnrolledStats e UNION ALL SELECT u.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS enrolled_students_variance, NULL AS enrolled_students_stddev, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM UnitsStats u ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance, enrolled_students_stddev, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18) that is degree-granting, what is the department code, department name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of students in that department, the total number of subject codes associated with the department, and the percentage of students in the department who are graduate students, considering only if the Mathematics department has a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean across all degree-granting departments except Biology (Course 7)?
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjectCodeCounts AS ( WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathGradStats AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS grad_student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.num_students, dscc.subject_code_count, CASE WHEN icte.num_students > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(mgs.grad_student_count, 0) * 100.0 / icte.num_students, 2) ELSE NULL END AS percent_grad_students FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCodeCounts dscc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dscc.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MathGradStats mgs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgs.DEPARTMENT ;

WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

WITH MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjectCodeCounts AS ( WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.num_unique_courses, mds.num_students, dscc.subject_code_count FROM MathDeptStats mds LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCodeCounts dscc ON mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dscc.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology and Chemistry), list the department name, department full name, the average number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, the variance of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, the maximum total units among its offered subjects in the 2021FA term, and the ratio of average enrolled students to the maximum total units (rounded to two decimal places). Additionally, for each department, provide the subject title of the subject with the maximum total units in 2021FA. Order the results by this ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, dus.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, ROUND(des.avg_enrolled_students / NULLIF(dus.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, 0), 2) AS avg_enrolled_per_max_unit FROM DeptEnrolledStats des JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.var_enrolled_students, icte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, icte.avg_enrolled_per_max_unit, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_units_2021FA FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = icte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY icte.avg_enrolled_per_max_unit DESC;

question: For each subject code in the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, what is the subject code, the subject code description, the geometric mean of the number of students in each department associated with that subject code (considering only departments that are degree granting), as well as the department name, the average, range, and variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department (only including departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department full name, and excluding the Chemistry department), showing the results in order of geometric mean of students descending and then department name? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_students DESC ) , DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentCIPStats dcs ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_students DESC, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_students DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH PoliticalScienceSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_students DESC ), DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT pss.SUBJECT_CODE, pss.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, pss.geometric_mean_students, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code FROM PoliticalScienceSubjects pss JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON pss.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentCIPStats dcs ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY pss.geometric_mean_students DESC, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding 'Political Science'), show the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and, for the Mathematics department, also display the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous' and the material status is not 'NM'. Additionally, for the Mathematics department, include the number of unique subjects offered in those terms and the maximum total units among those subjects. The average, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), subject count, and maximum total units columns will only be populated for the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON ss.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, mds.avg_total_units, mds.var_total_units, mds.stddev_total_units, mds.subject_count, mds.max_total_units FROM DeptCoeffVar dcv LEFT JOIN MathDeptStats mds ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, has a non-null department full name, is not the Biology department (Course 7), and is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year (only including departments with more than one subject with non-null total units), the variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, the school name, and the department phone number? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), department_units_cv AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), department_cip_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv.coefficient_of_variation, cs.cip_program_code_variance, cs.cip_program_code_stddev, cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM department_units_cv cv JOIN department_cip_stats cs ON cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.cip_program_code_variance, inner_cte.cip_program_code_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For each department, what is the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a non-null department full name, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)?

For each department that is degree-granting, has a non-null department full name, is not the Biology department (Course 7), and is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year (only including departments with more than one subject with non-null total units), the variance of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, and the standard deviation of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department?
sub_sqls: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), department_units_cv AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), department_cip_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv.coefficient_of_variation, cs.cip_program_code_variance, cs.cip_program_code_stddev FROM department_units_cv cv JOIN department_cip_stats cs ON cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021, excluding the Chemistry department, provide the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and, if the department is also an administrative department that grants degrees (excluding Mechanical Engineering), include the administrative department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0). Additionally, for each such department, report the highest number of enrolled students in any single subject offered by that department in 2021. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), AdminDeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptMaxEnrolledSubject2021 AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS max_enrolled_in_subject FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.num_subjects_offered, ic.total_enrolled_students, adcs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, adcs.avg_total_units, adcs.total_units_variance, adcs.total_units_stddev, dmes.max_enrolled_in_subject FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN AdminDeptCourseStats adcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = adcs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN DeptMaxEnrolledSubject2021 dmes ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmes.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY ic.num_subjects_offered DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021, excluding the Chemistry department, provide the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects.

For each administrative department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with total units greater than 0, and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department (Course 2)?

For each department that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021, excluding the Chemistry department, provide the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and, if the department is also an administrative department that grants degrees (excluding Mechanical Engineering), include the administrative department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH DeptSubjects2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), AdminDeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.num_subjects_offered, ds.total_enrolled_students, adcs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, adcs.avg_total_units, adcs.total_units_variance, adcs.total_units_stddev FROM DeptSubjects2021 ds LEFT JOIN AdminDeptCourseStats adcs ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = adcs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.num_subjects_offered DESC, ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, also provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for all subjects offered by that department in the current or previous terms. List the department name, subject code, subject code description, graduate level, total number of courses, average total units, total units range, and total units variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, stats.avg_total_units, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON cso.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are current or previous terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each academic year, give the academic year, academic year description, the coefficient of variation of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with more than zero total units, and also provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in current or previous terms. List the academic year, academic year description, coefficient of variation, average total units, total units range, and total units variance in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_range, us.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cov JOIN UnitsStats us ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), list all subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students, showing the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and row number within each department name group ordered by subject code. Additionally, for the Mathematics department, show the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10, and also include the average number of enrolled students per subject for the current term if the average is greater than 3. For each row, indicate whether it is a 'Subject', 'Department', or 'Department Average' result in the Reason column. The columns should be: subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, row number, total number of subject enrollments, average number of enrolled students, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), Subq3 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 3 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, NULL AS total_enrollments, NULL AS avg_enrolled, 'Subject' AS Reason FROM inner_cte s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, s2.total_enrollments, NULL AS avg_enrolled, 'Department' AS Reason FROM Subq2 s2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS total_enrollments, s3.avg_enrolled, 'Department Average' AS Reason FROM Subq3 s3 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, total_enrollments, avg_enrolled, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and assign row numbers within each department name group ordered by subject code.

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term, where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10, only for the Mathematics department (Course 18).

List, for the Mathematics department (Course 18), all subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students, showing the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and row number within each department name group ordered by subject code, as well as, for the Mathematics department, the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10. For each row, indicate whether it is a 'Subject' or 'Department' result in the Reason column. The columns should be: subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, row number, total number of subject enrollments, and reason for inclusion, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10;

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, NULL AS total_enrollments, 'Subject' AS Reason FROM Subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, s2.total_enrollments, 'Department' AS Reason FROM Subq2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, total_enrollments, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5) and the Political Science department), provide the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the full name of the corresponding administrative department, and, for each term in which the department offered subjects in 2016, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in that term and that are offered this year. For each department, also include a grand total for all terms in the format of (department name, ..., null, total units stats). List the results in order by department name and term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), UnitStatsByTerm AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '2016%' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.TERM_CODE ), RollupUnitStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, SUM(range_total_units) AS range_total_units, AVG(var_total_units) AS var_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM UnitStatsByTerm GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.enrolled_students_range, i.enrolled_students_variance, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.TERM_CODE, r.avg_total_units, r.range_total_units, r.var_total_units FROM RollupUnitStats r JOIN inner_cte i ON r.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.TERM_CODE ;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), UnitStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_students_range, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, u.avg_total_units, u.range_total_units, u.var_total_units FROM EnrolledStats e JOIN UnitStats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each course offered in the 2007 academic year by a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering, except for the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, display the course key, course name, department name, the number of catalog subjects and the total units for those subjects, as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments). Additionally, for each course, show the full department name and the school code. The results should be ordered by department name and course name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), course_stats AS ( SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cs.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, cs.COURSE, cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.subject_count, cs.total_units, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM course_stats cs LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
