sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE fr.AREA > 0 GROUP BY ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte ic WHERE UPPER(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE 'D%' AND ic.avg_area >= 100 ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_area DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the area of rooms assigned to employees in that department, considering only rooms with an area greater than 0? Show the department name and the geometric mean of room area.
sub_sqls: SELECT ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE fr.AREA > 0 GROUP BY ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_area DESC;

question: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), along with the total number of such subjects per department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in the year 2017?
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department, list the department name, the total number of courses offered by that department, the school name, and for each category code, the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table for courses in that department, ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.COURSE) AS total_courses, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE;
sub_questions: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, ordered by category code.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6

question: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017, along with the school name and department phone number? Only consider subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. Sort the results by variance in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.enrolled_students_variance, i.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.enrolled_students_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in the year 2017?
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each school, list its name, the department name, and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022. For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (school name, null, total range, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(units_range) AS units_range, VARIANCE(units_range) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022.
sub_sqls: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

question: For each department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name where the department hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy' and the organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', provide the number of unique facility organization keys, the minimum organization unit ID, and the most recent warehouse load date. Also, include subtotals for each department long name (the corresponding department long name field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department long name field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department long name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept_long) OVER (ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort) = dept_long THEN NULL ELSE dept_long END AS department_long_name, hier3_name, org_count, min_org_unit_id, max_load_date FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS hier3_sort, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS hier3_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS max_load_date FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort;
sub_questions: For each department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name where the department hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy' and the organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', give the number of unique facility organization keys and the minimum organization unit ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME;

question: For the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in terms from academic year 2014 or later, list the department name, the count of unique subject titles, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: List the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered, including the department name and the count of unique subject titles, for terms in the academic year 2014 or later.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic term in the academic year 2020, provide the term code, term description, the number of unique subjects offered, the total number of tip material records associated with that term, and indicate whether the total tip records for the term are 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 20% greater than the average across all 2020 terms), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_records FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2020 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_tip_records) AS avg_tip_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.subject_count, i.total_tip_records, CASE WHEN i.total_tip_records > a.avg_tip_records * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.total_tip_records < a.avg_tip_records * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS tip_record_status FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a;
sub_questions: For each academic term in the academic year 2020, provide the term code, term description, the number of unique subjects offered, and the total number of tip material records associated with that term.
sub_sqls: SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_records FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2020 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, what is the name of the school that department belongs to, and what is the subject code of the course with the maximum total units, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_total_units, i.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = i.max_total_units;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, and what is the name of the school that department belongs to, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6?
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

question: Among all instructors who have taught courses in the "18 - Mathematics" department and in the "Hayden" unit, list each instructor's MIT ID, the total number of distinct courses they have taught in that department and unit, and their dense rank among all such instructors based on the number of courses taught (with ties sharing the same rank), ordered from most to least courses taught. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.MIT_ID, t0.COURSE_NAME FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR t0 JOIN SE_PERSON t1 ON t0.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT = '18 - Mathematics' AND t0.UNIT = 'Hayden' ) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NAME) AS Num_Courses_Taught, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NAME) DESC) AS Instructor_Rank FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.MIT_ID ORDER BY Num_Courses_Taught DESC
sub_questions: For all courses in the "18 - Mathematics" department taught in the "Hayden" unit, show the instructor's MIT ID and the dense rank of each instructor considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the instructor's first name.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.MIT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR t0 JOIN SE_PERSON t1 ON t0.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT = '18 - Mathematics' AND t0.UNIT = 'Hayden'

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the cluster type description and the HGN code description for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER ( ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'
sub_questions: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0

question: For rooms with a square footage of 150, show the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, and, for each space unit code, the number of rooms with a square footage of 150, but only include space unit codes that have at least 2 such rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.ROOM_NUMBER, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, cnt.ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) cnt ON ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = cnt.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.BUILDING_ROOM;
sub_questions: For rooms with a square footage of 150, show the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, and rank within each space unit code group ordered by building room.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150

question: For each department and school, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students? Also, include subtotals for each school (the corresponding school field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all schools (the corresponding school field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the school name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by school and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(school_name) OVER (ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort) = school_name THEN NULL ELSE school_name END AS school_name, dept, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE school_name END AS school_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dept END AS dept_sort, dept, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(enrollment_variance) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(enrollment_stddev) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT school_name, department_name AS dept, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte ) base GROUP BY school_name, dept WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students?
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered, what is the subject id, the academic year, the number of enrolled students, and the deviation from the average number of enrolled students for that academic year, considering only terms that are not the current term? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_stats.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) avg_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered, considering only terms that are not the current term?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each academic term parameter, provide the term parameter name, the department name, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter and department, considering only terms that are regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ) SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic term parameter, provide the term parameter name and both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter, considering only terms that are regular terms.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For the top 10 building names with the highest number of historical records, list the building name, the number of historical records, the building type, and the campus sector. Do not repeat the building name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the number of historical records in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING f JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY GROUP BY f.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY hist_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.hist_count DESC, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME) = inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME END AS building_name, inner_cte.hist_count, f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.CAMPUS_SECTOR FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING f ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = f.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.hist_count DESC, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME;
sub_questions: Which are the top 10 building names with the highest number of historical records, and how many historical records does each have?
sub_sqls: SELECT f.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING f JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY GROUP BY f.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY hist_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, what is the description of the academic year, the department name, the average total units for all subjects offered by that department in terms that match that academic year and have a term status indicator of 'P', and the deviation of each department's average total units from the overall average total units for that academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.dept_avg_total_units, (inner_cte.dept_avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) overall ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = overall.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, deviation_from_overall_avg DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the description of the academic year and the variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that match that academic year and have a term status indicator of 'P'?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the average total units of courses offered by that department this year, and for each course in that department, what is the deviation of its total units from the department's average? Also, provide the department name and the course code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.total_units, d.avg_total_units, (i.total_units - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are offered this year and have a non-null total units value? Also, provide the department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each space unit, show the space unit name, the number of rooms assigned to it with an access level of at least 1, the average access level of those rooms as a benchmark, and categorize the space unit as 'HIGH_ACCESS' if its room count is at least 10% greater than the average room count across all space units, 'LOW_ACCESS' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(zr.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count, AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.ACCESS_LEVEL >= 1 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.room_count, icte.avg_access_level, CASE WHEN icte.room_count > (SELECT AVG(room_count) FROM inner_cte) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACCESS' WHEN icte.room_count < (SELECT AVG(room_count) FROM inner_cte) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACCESS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS access_category FROM inner_cte icte;
sub_questions: List the top 10 space units by the number of rooms assigned to them, showing the space unit name and the count of rooms, only including rooms with an access level of at least 1.
sub_sqls: SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(zr.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.ACCESS_LEVEL >= 1 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each administrative department, list the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students with a non-null office phone number), and also display the total number of such students in each department. Show only the top 5 departments with the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in office phone numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, COUNT(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.FULL_NAME) AS student_count FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT AND MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_office_phone DESC LIMIT 5;
sub_questions: For each administrative department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the office phone numbers of students in that department, considering only students who have a non-null office phone number.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, but only include courses where the department's budget code is greater than the average budget code of all Engineering school departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL )
sub_questions: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

question: For each term parameter, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of materials per subject for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date, and what is the deviation of each term's average materials per subject from the overall average across all such terms? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ) SELECT i.TERM_PARAMETER, i.avg_materials_per_subject, i.variance_materials_per_subject, i.stddev_materials_per_subject, (i.avg_materials_per_subject - (SELECT AVG(avg_materials_per_subject) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY i.variance_materials_per_subject DESC;
sub_questions: For each term parameter, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of materials per subject for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date?
sub_sqls: SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, and the fiscal year of the calendar date, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t1.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.CALENDAR_DATE
sub_questions: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'

question: For each academic year, show the total number of library reserve materials with material status key 'U', the number of unique tip material status keys, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the academic year, along with the earliest and latest term descriptions for that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserve_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS unique_tip_material_statuses, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_record_count, MIN(TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS earliest_term_description, MAX(TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS latest_term_description FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
sub_questions: For library reserve material details with material status key 'U', show the reserve catalog key, subject offered key, term code, the academic year, the term description, the tip material key, the tip material status key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the tip material status key and ordered by the academic year.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, and the subject description from the course catalog, and for each department, include a grand total of the number of such subjects in the format of (null, department name, null, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptTotals AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column, NULL AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column, d.total_subjects FROM DeptTotals d ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, and the subject description from the course catalog, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that is degree granting, list the department name, the number of courses in that department, and the dense rank of each department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code. For each school, include a grand total for all courses in the format of (null, school name, total courses). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentCourseCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, COUNT(*) AS course_count, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses FROM DepartmentCourseCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

question: From the top 10 departments and academic years with the highest number of non-repeatable-for-credit subjects offered in the fall term, display each department name, academic year, subject count, the subject with the highest enrollment in that group, and the enrollment number for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ) AS rn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) so ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = so.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = so.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND so.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: List the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years by the number of subjects offered, including only subjects that are not repeatable for credit and are offered in the fall term.
sub_sqls: SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For rooms on floor 2, show the building room, the organization name, the department name, and the dense rank of each room considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department name from HR_ORG_UNIT, but only include rooms where the access level is greater than the average access level for that floor. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.FLOOR, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), avg_access AS ( SELECT FLOOR, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD WHERE FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY FLOOR ) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_access a ON i.FLOOR = a.FLOOR WHERE i.ACCESS_LEVEL > a.avg_access;
sub_questions: For rooms on floor 2, show the building room, the organization name, and the dense rank of each room considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department name from HR_ORG_UNIT.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2

question: For each academic year, which subject offered in a non-current term had the highest number of enrolled students, and what was that number? Provide the academic year, subject title, and the number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' ) SELECT i1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i1.SUBJECT_TITLE, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) i2 ON i1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = i2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enrolled ORDER BY i1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered, considering only terms that are not the current term?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each term and activity title, list the term description, activity title, the number of associated course materials, the earliest course material key, and the latest course material key. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term description if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS earliest_material_key, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS latest_material_key FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, activity_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, activity_title, material_count, earliest_material_key, latest_material_key FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_DESCRIPTION) = 1 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_DESCRIPTION) = 0 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_DESCRIPTION) = 1 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_DESCRIPTION) = 0 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACTIVITY_TITLE END AS activity_sort, ACTIVITY_TITLE AS activity_title, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(earliest_material_key) AS earliest_material_key, MAX(latest_material_key) AS latest_material_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACTIVITY_TITLE WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, activity_sort;
sub_questions: Which are the top 10 activity titles with the highest number of associated course materials, including the activity title from IAP subject details, the term description from academic terms, and the count of course materials from TIP detail?
sub_sqls: SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school), and for each department, indicate whether the department's average total units is above, below, or within 10% of the overall average total units for all such subjects in the 'Engineering' school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , overall_stats AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ds.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN ds.avg_total_units > os.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ds.avg_total_units < os.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS avg_total_units_category FROM dept_stats ds CROSS JOIN overall_stats os ORDER BY ds.total_units_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the difference between the number of enrolled students for each subject and the minimum number of enrolled students in its offering department, ordered by offering department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled FROM inner_cte ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by offering department.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA'

question: For each subject, what is the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL and the sum of academic years from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL for materials with a required status and where the term parameter is 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM'? Also, indicate whether the minimum record count for the subject is above or below the average minimum record count across all subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS total_academic_years FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND atp.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_academic_years, CASE WHEN inner_cte.min_record_count > (SELECT AVG(min_record_count) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.min_record_count < (SELECT AVG(min_record_count) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS record_count_category FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: What is the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL and the sum of academic years from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL for materials with a required status and where the term parameter is 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM'?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS total_academic_years FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND atp.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM';

question: For fiscal quarters in the year 2026, show the fiscal year, fiscal quarter code, quarter start date, calendar year, calendar period description, calendar month name, the average calendar month (as a number) in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the fiscal period, and indicate whether the current calendar month is above, below, or at the window average. Order by the fiscal year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FISCAL_YEAR, t0.FY_QUARTER_CODE, t0.QUARTER_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_YEAR, t1.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH, AVG(t1.CALENDAR_MONTH) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.FISCAL_PERIOD ORDER BY t0.FISCAL_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_avg FROM TIME_QUARTER t0 JOIN TIME_MONTH t1 ON t0.FISCAL_YEAR = t1.FISCAL_YEAR WHERE t0.FISCAL_YEAR = 2026 ) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.FY_QUARTER_CODE, inner_cte.QUARTER_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_YEAR, inner_cte.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, inner_cte.window_avg, CASE WHEN inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH > inner_cte.window_avg THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH < inner_cte.window_avg THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AT_AVERAGE' END AS month_vs_window FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR;
sub_questions: For fiscal quarters in the year 2026, show the fiscal year, fiscal quarter code, quarter start date, calendar year, calendar period description, calendar month name, and the average calendar month (as a number) in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the fiscal period, ordered by the fiscal year.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.FISCAL_YEAR, t0.FY_QUARTER_CODE, t0.QUARTER_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_YEAR, t1.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, AVG(t1.CALENDAR_MONTH) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.FISCAL_PERIOD ORDER BY t0.FISCAL_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM TIME_QUARTER t0 JOIN TIME_MONTH t1 ON t0.FISCAL_YEAR = t1.FISCAL_YEAR WHERE t0.FISCAL_YEAR = 2026

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, and the subject description from the course catalog, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary, but only include those where the department name starts with the letter 'H'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE 'H%';
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, and the subject description from the course catalog, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

question: For each space unit with a room square footage greater than 100, what is the building room, building room name, space usage, the number of distinct floors it appears on, and the total room counter, but only include those where the total room counter is greater than the average room counter across all space units with room square footage greater than 100? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS floor_count, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_room_counter FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, SPACE_USAGE, floor_count, total_room_counter FROM inner_cte WHERE total_room_counter > ( SELECT AVG(total_room_counter) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_room_counter FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY ) sub )
sub_questions: For each space unit with a room square footage greater than 100, what is the building room, building room name, space usage, the number of distinct floors it appears on, and the total room counter?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS floor_count, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_room_counter FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering during regular terms, give the department name, the total number of tip materials offered for its subjects, and the average number of tip materials per subject, but only for departments where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms, where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10;

question: Among courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, which offering department has the most such courses? For the top 5 offering departments by count, show the department name, the number of qualifying courses, and the course number and description of the most recently added course in each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses, ic_recent.course_number AS most_recent_course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS most_recent_course_description FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, course_number, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ic_recent ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic_recent.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic_recent.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic_recent.course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 5;
sub_questions: For courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show the course number, course description, subject title, total units, offering department name, and assign row numbers within each offering department ordered by course number.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

question: For each department, show the department name, the corresponding course number, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the total number of such subjects per department and course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, subj_count.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE ) AS subj_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE = subj_count.COURSE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each building, give the building key and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term, but only include buildings where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units for all such subjects in the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each building, give the building key and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term.
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that subject code), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that subject code), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), subject_code_avg AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN subject_code_avg a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units. Additionally, for each subject title, include a grand total of enrolled students across all terms in the format of (subject title, null, null, null, null, total enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rr.TOTAL_UNITS, rr.total_enrolled_students FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE
sub_questions: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0

question: For each organization, what is the highest number of space units it has ever had associated with it on a single warehouse load date? Show the organization name and the highest space unit count. Do not return any rounded answers.
