sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, f.AREA AS room_area FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS f ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department, considering only rooms with an area greater than 40?
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

question: For each library reserve material with material status key 'U', show the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, and the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key, along with the total number of such materials for each academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.window_column, y.total_materials_per_year FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_materials_per_year FROM ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR
sub_questions: For library reserve materials with material status key 'U', show the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, and the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300 and access level equal to 1, show the building-room identifier, the room's major use description, the organization name, and the total number of such rooms per organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ) org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME;
sub_questions: For rooms with an area greater than 300 and access level equal to 1, show the building-room identifier, the room's major use description, the organization name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building-room identifier.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1

question: For each organization, give the organization name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization, considering only organizations where the average room area is greater than the overall average room area. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > (SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;
sub_questions: For each floor, give the floor key and the coefficient of variation of the area of rooms located on that floor, considering only floors where the average room area is greater than zero.
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each major organization and top-level HR organization name, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers, considering only organizations that are assignable and have a non-null organization number, and only include those groups where the average organization number is greater than the overall average organization number for all such organizations? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT MAJOR_ORG, ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, avg_org_number, org_number_variance, org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_org_number > ( SELECT AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each major organization, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the organization numbers for each top-level HR organization name, considering only organizations that are assignable and have a non-null organization number?
sub_sqls: SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each department, list the department name, the subject ID, subject title, and the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the term '2014JA' with a nonzero total units value. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2014JA' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2014JA' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects offered in the term '2014JA' and with a nonzero total units value?
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2014JA' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, list the department name and the total number of reserve materials assigned, but only include departments where the total number of reserve materials is greater than the average number of reserve materials assigned per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, num_reserve_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE num_reserve_materials > ( SELECT AVG(num_reserve_materials) FROM inner_cte );
sub_questions: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each school, provide the school name and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by departments within that school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for courses offered by that department.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the minimum degree year among regular academic terms that have a current term indicator in the academic term parameter? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(at.DEGREE_YEAR) AS total_degree_years FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(at.DEGREE_YEAR) AS min_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: What is the minimum academic year and the sum of degree years from academic terms that are regular terms and have a current term indicator in the academic term parameter?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(at.DEGREE_YEAR) AS total_degree_years FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y';

question: For each subject offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, provide the subject key, subject title, department name, the number of subject offerings, the total number of units for those offerings, and the maximum number of enrolled students in any of those offerings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, provide the subject key, subject title, department name, the number of subject offerings, and the total number of units for those offerings.
sub_sqls: SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the name of the school area from the HR organization unit. Assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name, for departments in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, and whether the subject's total units are above, below, or equal to the average total units for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), avg_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT cte.SUBJECT_ID, cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN cte.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN cte.TOTAL_UNITS < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'EQUAL_TO_AVERAGE' END AS unit_comparison FROM inner_cte cte JOIN avg_units a ON cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, and the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, and the number of subjects offered by each department in that term. For each department, include a grand total for all subjects offered in the format of (null, null, offering department name, term description, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dsc.num_subjects FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc LEFT JOIN inner_cte ict ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ict.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, and the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show each subject's ID, total units, department name, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show the subject IDs and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU'

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, and also show the total number of enrolled students for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ORDER BY i.record_count_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each subject, provide the subject title and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, considering only subjects offered in the term '2017FA'.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_range DESC;

question: For rooms on floor 2 with access level 1, show the building room, space usage, space unit name, and the total number of such rooms per space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_USAGE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, RoomCounts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT ) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT = RoomCounts.SPACE_UNIT;
sub_questions: For rooms on floor 2 with access level 1, show the building room, space usage, space unit name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by building room.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1

question: List the minimum department budget code, the sum of total units, and the number of unique courses for each department whose name includes 'Engineering' and that are degree granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS unique_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum
sub_questions: What is the minimum department budget code and the sum of total units for courses in departments whose name includes 'Engineering' and that are degree granting?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y';

question: For IAP activities that are not cancelled and are offered in a non-summer academic term, list the top 10 activities by the number of distinct departments whose subjects are offered in the same term. Show the IAP activity title, the count of distinct departments, and the name of the department with the most subjects offered in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, iap.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap.TERM_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_count, icte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON icte.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_CODE ), TopDept AS ( SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subj_in_dept, icte.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON icte.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE ) SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.dept_count, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department FROM DeptCounts d LEFT JOIN TopDept t ON d.ACTIVITY_TITLE = t.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.rn = 1 ORDER BY d.dept_count DESC, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: List the top 10 IAP activities by the number of subjects offered in the same academic term, showing the IAP activity title and the count of distinct subject titles offered in that term, for activities that are not cancelled and are offered in a term that is not the summer term.
sub_sqls: SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the total number of unique TIP subjects offered, and the maximum total number of students enrolled in all corresponding library subjects (where the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 5) for any term within that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_library_enrollment, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_tip_subjects) AS total_tip_subjects, MAX(total_library_enrollment) AS max_total_library_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic term in 2014, provide the term code, term description, the number of unique TIP subjects offered, and the total number of students enrolled in all corresponding library subjects where the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 5.
sub_sqls: SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_library_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each space unit whose name starts with 'A' (case insensitive), and which contains between 5 and 15 rooms inclusive, list the space unit name and the number of rooms it contains. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_count FROM inner_cte WHERE UPPER(SPACE_UNIT) LIKE 'A%' AND room_count BETWEEN 5 AND 15;
sub_questions: List the top 10 space units by the number of rooms they contain, showing the space unit name and the count of rooms for each.
sub_sqls: SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE', along with the department's average enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, and assign row numbers within each department name group ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'

question: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, ordered by category code. Additionally, for each school name, include a grand total for all courses in that school in the format of (nulls for course-specific fields, school name, nulls for other fields, and the total number of courses in that school). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ), SchoolTotals AS ( SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.COURSE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.PROGRAM_CODE, i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_CODE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, i.min_warehouse_load_date, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.PROGRAM_CODE, s.PROGRAM_TITLE, s.CATEGORY_CODE, s.CATEGORY_TITLE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s.min_warehouse_load_date, s.total_courses FROM SchoolTotals s ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, COURSE
sub_questions: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, ordered by category code.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year that is classified as a HASS Elective, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, the number of units for the subject, the total number of subjects in the same department that are also HASS Electives, and indicate whether the subject has more units than the average number of units for HASS Electives in its department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' ) , dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE_UNITS' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE_UNITS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNITS' END AS unit_comparison FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg_units d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year that is classified as a HASS Elective, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, the number of units for the subject, and the total number of subjects in the same department that are also HASS Electives.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective';

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300, show the building-room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, DLC key, and the average area in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by area, but only include those department codes where the average area of such rooms is above 400. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.AREA, t1.DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 ), DeptAvg AS ( SELECT DEPT_CODE, AVG(AREA) AS dept_avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPT_CODE HAVING AVG(AREA) > 400 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DLC_KEY, ic.window_avg_area FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptAvg da ON ic.DEPT_CODE = da.DEPT_CODE
sub_questions: For rooms with an area greater than 300, show the building-room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, DLC key, and the average area in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by area.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, but only include those results where the total units is greater than the average total units across all subjects with at least one enrolled student. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(sos2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td2 ON lso2.SUBJECT_ID = td2.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON td2.SUBJECT_ID = sos2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 )
sub_questions: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0

question: List the department names, the corresponding subject titles, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject, and the total number of material records for subjects offered by the School of Engineering, considering only those materials with a status of 'RQ'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.RECORD_COUNT FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: What is the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject and the total number of material records for subjects offered by the School of Engineering, considering only those materials with a status of 'RQ'?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ';

question: For each building in the city of CAMBRIDGE, show the building name, building number, city, state, and the maximum number of rooms found in any building, ordered by building number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t0.CITY, t0.STATE, AVG(t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE, MAX(avg_num_of_rooms) AS max_avg_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE ORDER BY BUILDING_NUMBER;
sub_questions: For each building, show the building name, building number, city, state, and the average number of rooms within each building, ordered by the building number, for buildings located in the city of CAMBRIDGE.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t0.CITY, t0.STATE, AVG(t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE'

question: For the top 10 buildings with the largest range in room areas (among buildings with more than 10 rooms), list each building's name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of its room areas, as well as the most common major use among its rooms and the count of rooms with that major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, muc.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS Most_Common_Major_Use, muc.Room_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC ) muc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = muc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND muc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each building, provide the building name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, considering only buildings with more than 10 rooms.
sub_sqls: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC;

question: For each department name, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each subject title, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U'?
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department name and school name, show the number of offered subjects and the minimum number of enrolled students (where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3), and classify the department as 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' if the number of offered subjects is at least 20% greater than the average across all departments, 'LOW_ACTIVITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(offered_subject_count) AS avg_offered_subjects FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.offered_subject_count, i.min_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN i.offered_subject_count > d.avg_offered_subjects * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.offered_subject_count < d.avg_offered_subjects * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN dept_avg d;
sub_questions: For each department name and school name, where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, give the number of offered subjects and the minimum number of enrolled students.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each organization that has a space unit code of 402100, show the organization name, its dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization number, and the corresponding DLC key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, window_column, DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For space units with a space unit code of 402100, show the organization names and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization number.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100

question: For each student year and department, list the student year, department, the number of students, average department budget code, the school name, and department phone number. Include subtotals for each student year (the corresponding student year field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all years (the corresponding student year field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the student year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by student year and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(student_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, student_year, dept_sort) = student_year THEN NULL ELSE student_year END AS student_year, department, student_count, avg_budget_code, school_name, department_phone_number FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS student_year, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department, COUNT(*) AS student_count, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code, MAX(SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name, MAX(DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS department_phone_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort;
sub_questions: For each student year, give the student year and calculate the average, range, and variance of department budget codes for students in that year, considering only students whose department code matches both an academic department and an administrative department.
sub_sqls: SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY budget_range DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, and the academic year description. Assign row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE
sub_questions: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, and assign row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12

question: For each department, what is the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022? Also, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, min_lecture_units, total_units). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_lecture_units, total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL, MIN(min_lecture_units), SUM(total_units) FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: What is the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022;

question: For each student department, provide the department name, the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned, and the average office phone number (as a numeric value) for those students. Also, include a subtotal for each department (with the department name as 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (with the department name as 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, total_active_grad_students, avg_office_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students, AVG(CASE WHEN OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE OFFICE_PHONE END) AS avg_office_phone FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m JOIN SE_PERSON s ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort;
sub_questions: For each student department, give the department name and calculate the total number of active students who are graduate students and have an office location assigned.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

question: For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs and the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, and also show the maximum of these subject counts across all department and school combinations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subject_count, min_isbn, (SELECT MAX(subject_count) FROM inner_cte) AS max_subject_count_over_all FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs and the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (considering only records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), and the total number of unique subjects offered in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, COUNT(DISTINCT LRM.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS unique_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AT ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = AT.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND AT.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL LRM ON LRM.TERM_CODE = AT.TERM_CODE AND LRM.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered, considering only records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title from SUBJECT_OFFERED, the offer department name, the total units from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, and the department name from SUBJECT_SUMMARY. Assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title from SUBJECT_OFFERED, the offer department name, the total units from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'

question: For each department, what is the name of the department and the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students it has ever had in any term, considering only courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned in that term? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the name of the department and the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned, considering only courses offered in the term '2013FA'?
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For each subject in the 2019FA term with total units greater than 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each school, and the academic year description, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON ic.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each subject in the 2019FA term with total units greater than 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school, ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1

question: For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the number of unique subjects, the minimum academic term start date, and the total number of TIP materials per subject category and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, tip_counts.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS tip_counts ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = tip_counts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, give the number of unique subjects and the minimum academic term start date.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year and school, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year and school, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students? Also, include subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding school field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all years (the corresponding school field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ata.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, academic_year, school_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, school, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, school_sort;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students?
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ata.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year description, the total number of unique course materials assigned for non-current terms where the course material status is 'RQ', and the number of those materials that have a non-null ISBN. Only include academic years where at least 50% of the unique materials have a non-null ISBN, and show the top 10 academic years by total unique materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) , isbn_counts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS materials_with_isbn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND TIP_DETAIL.ISBN IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, isbn_counts.materials_with_isbn FROM inner_cte JOIN isbn_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = isbn_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE isbn_counts.materials_with_isbn >= 0.5 * inner_cte.unique_materials ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: List the top 10 academic years by the number of unique course materials assigned, including the academic year description and the total count of unique materials, for terms that are not current and where the course material status is 'RQ'.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and classify the year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average across all years, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year, considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: Show the offer department name, the number of distinct subjects offered by each department in the academic year 2012, and for each subject, display the subject key, subject title, academic year, and term description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_counts.num_subjects, ic.SUBJECT_KEY, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_KEY;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012, show the subject key, subject title, offer department name, academic year, term description, and assign row numbers within each offer department name group ordered by subject key.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012

question: Among all departments in the School of Engineering, list the top 5 departments with the highest total student enrollment in their offered courses, and for each, show the department name, total enrollment, and the course with the highest enrollment (including the course number and its enrollment). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.COURSE_NUMBER, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_enroll.total_enrollment, top_course.COURSE_NUMBER AS highest_enrolled_course, top_course.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS course_enrollment FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5) dept_enroll JOIN ( SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.COURSE_NUMBER, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enroll FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enroll ) top_course ON dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_course.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_enroll.total_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

question: For each program category in the School of Engineering with a program version after 2000, what is the latest course start term, the highest program version, and the department that offers the most courses in that category, along with the count of courses from that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
