sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM'

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the total number of unique subjects with TIP materials in that year, and the average, range, and variance of the record counts for TIP materials, considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_subject_count DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the record counts for TIP materials in that year, considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject code, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, but only include those subjects whose total units exceed the average total units for their department in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject code, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'

question: Show the organization names, organization keys, HR department names, HR org unit titles, HR org unit keys, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, and the corresponding HR org unit level and HR department code, for organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY;
sub_questions: For each organization, show the organization name, organization key, HR department name, HR org unit title, HR org unit key, and the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, for organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, as well as the school name and department phone number. Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'

question: For each department, what is the maximum average total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in any single term with a term status of 'Previous'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous'?
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each organization, what is the organization name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department codes (HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) among its associated HR org units, and the number of unique HR org unit titles, considering only organizations that have more than 3 associated HR org units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS unique_org_unit_titles FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.dept_code_stddev DESC;
sub_questions: For each organization, what is the organization name and the standard deviation of the department codes (HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) among its associated HR org units, considering only organizations that have more than 3 associated HR org units?
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY dept_code_stddev DESC;

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, but only include those departments where the minimum total units is greater than the overall minimum total units across all such departments and years. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > ( SELECT MIN(min_total_units) FROM inner_cte );
sub_questions: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each IAP subject activity that is not cancelled and has a non-null maximum enrollment, provide the activity title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the academic years in which the activity was offered, and also include the earliest and latest term start dates for those offerings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) - MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_range, VARIANCE(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_variance, STDDEV(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON d.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aa ON a.TERM_CODE = aa.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE ) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.academic_year_range, ic.academic_year_variance, ic.academic_year_stddev, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start, MAX(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start FROM inner_cte ic JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON d.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.academic_year_range, ic.academic_year_variance, ic.academic_year_stddev ORDER BY ic.academic_year_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each IAP subject activity, provide the activity title and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the academic years (from the academic terms) in which the activity was offered, considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a non-null maximum enrollment.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) - MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_range, VARIANCE(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_variance, STDDEV(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON d.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aa ON a.TERM_CODE = aa.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY academic_year_range DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and also show the difference between the average total units of each department and the overall average total units across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, (inner_cte.avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units_overall) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_overall FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) overall ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For the top 10 activity titles with the highest number of associated course materials, provide the activity title, the term description, the count of course materials, and indicate whether the material count is 'HIGH_MATERIAL' (at least 10% greater than the average for that term), 'LOW_MATERIAL' (at least 10% less than the average for that term), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) , term_avg AS ( SELECT TERM_CODE, AVG(material_count) AS avg_material_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.material_count, CASE WHEN i.material_count > t.avg_material_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL' WHEN i.material_count < t.avg_material_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS material_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN term_avg t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.material_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: Which are the top 10 activity titles with the highest number of associated course materials, including the activity title from IAP subject details, the term description from academic terms, and the count of course materials from TIP detail?
sub_sqls: SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic building with rooms larger than 40 square meters, show the building name, the average, range, and variance of the room areas, and also display the total assignable area of the building and the year the building was built. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_room_area, ic.room_area_range, ic.room_area_variance, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = fb.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.room_area_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each building, give the building name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the room areas for rooms in that building where the building type is 'ACADEMIC' and the room area is greater than 40.
sub_sqls: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC;

question: For each textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ', show the subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, academic year, and term description, along with the number of textbook materials per academic year and the minimum term code for each academic year. Include subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding academic year field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all academic years (the corresponding academic year field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code
sub_questions: For each textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ', show the subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, academic year, term description, and assign row numbers within each academic year group ordered by term code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'

question: For each organization whose major organization is 'PROVST' or 'CHNCLR' and has more than 2 distinct space units, show the organization name, the DLC key, the total number of distinct space units, and the most recent warehouse load date for any of its space units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.num_space_units, MAX(su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS most_recent_load_date FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.num_space_units;
sub_questions: For each organization, give the organization name and calculate the total number of distinct space units associated with organizations whose major organization is 'PROVST' or 'CHNCLR', and only include organizations with more than 2 space units.
sub_sqls: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2;

question: For each subject in the term "2010FA", show the subject ID, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the department name from SIS_DEPARTMENT. Also, show the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each subject in the term "2010FA", show the subject ID, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA'

question: For each course subject title, what is the highest average number of enrolled students in any term among courses that have at least one reserved library material and at least one course material with a non-null ISBN? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.TERM_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(avg_enrolled) AS highest_avg_enrolled_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY highest_avg_enrolled_per_term DESC;
sub_questions: For each course subject title, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material and at least one course material with a non-null ISBN?
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, and the day of the week, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t1.DAY_OF_WEEK, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.CALENDAR_DATE
sub_questions: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'

question: For the top 5 organizations with the highest variance in room area (among those with a non-null DLC key), show each organization's name, the variance of its room areas, the building with the largest total room area for that organization, and the total area of rooms in that building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_variance, br.BUILDING_ROOM AS Largest_Building, br.Total_Building_Area FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM, SUM(r.AREA) AS Total_Building_Area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY SUM(r.AREA) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ROOMS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM ) br ON ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = br.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND br.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_variance DESC LIMIT 5;
sub_questions: For each organization, what is the organization name and the variance of the area of its rooms for organizations that have a non-null DLC key?
sub_sqls: SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, grouped by whether the total number of enrolled students in the department's subjects is at least 100 ('High Enrollment') or less than 100 ('Low Enrollment'). For each enrollment group, include a grand total for all departments in that group in the format of (null, null, null, null, total enrollment). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), EnrollmentGroup AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, CASE WHEN total_enrollment >= 100 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END AS enrollment_group FROM inner_cte ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT enrollment_group, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_enrollment) AS total_enrollment FROM EnrollmentGroup GROUP BY enrollment_group, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_enrollment) > 0 ) SELECT rr.enrollment_group, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, rr.subject_count, rr.total_enrollment FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.enrollment_group, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

question: Among all organizations with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' and an organization level of 5, what are the names and descriptions of these organizations, and for each, what is the name and description of their parent organization? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DESCRIPTION, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Org_Name, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION AS Org_Description, parent_org.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Parent_Org_Name, parent_org.DESCRIPTION AS Parent_Org_Description FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION parent_org ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY = parent_org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;
sub_questions: How many organizations have a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' and an organization level of 5?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS meche_level5_orgs FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5;

question: For each subject offered in the term 2013FA, list the subject offered key, the subject ID, the number of materials assigned, the total new shelf price of those materials (considering only materials with a new shelf price greater than 10), and whether the total new shelf price is 'EXPENSIVE' (if it exceeds 200), 'CHEAP' (if it is less than 50), or 'MODERATE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price > 200 THEN 'EXPENSIVE' WHEN inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price < 50 THEN 'CHEAP' ELSE 'MODERATE' END AS price_category FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the term 2013FA, list the subject offered key, the subject ID, the number of materials assigned, and the total new shelf price of those materials, considering only materials with a new shelf price greater than 10.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department in the current academic term, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered? Show the department name, school name, and these statistics. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each school, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in the current academic term? Show the school name along with these statistics.
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic term, provide the term description, the total number of IAP activities that are not cancelled and have at least one required course material, and for each term, also show the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for those activities. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, AVG(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY total_activities DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic term, give the term description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for IAP activities that are not cancelled and have at least one required course material.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC;

question: For each department under the 'Provost Area' in the department hierarchy, what is the minimum organization level and the total number of assignable organizations, and include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, total assignable, min org level)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS min_org_level, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE) AS total_assignable, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS dept_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT dept_name, min_org_level, total_assignable FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dept_name, min_org_level, total_assignable WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_assignable) > 0 ORDER BY dept_name
sub_questions: What is the minimum organization level and the total number of assignable organizations for organizations that belong to departments under the 'Provost Area' in the department hierarchy?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS min_org_level, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE) AS total_assignable FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area'

question: For space units with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, and also include the total number of space units for each organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units_for_org FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code
sub_questions: For space units with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, and the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500

question: For each program category in the School of Engineering with a program version after 2000, what is the latest course start term and the highest program version? Also, for each category, which course has the latest start term and what is its course description? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.CATEGORY_TITLE, MAX(s.FROM_TERM) AS latest_start_term, MAX(c.VERSION) AS highest_program_version FROM CIP c JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.VERSION > 2000 GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE ) SELECT i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.latest_start_term, i.highest_program_version, s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte i JOIN CIP c ON i.CATEGORY_TITLE = c.CATEGORY_TITLE AND i.highest_program_version = c.VERSION JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AND s.FROM_TERM = i.latest_start_term WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering';
sub_questions: For each program category, what is the latest course start term and the highest program version for courses in the School of Engineering with a program version after 2000?
sub_sqls: SELECT c.CATEGORY_TITLE, MAX(s.FROM_TERM) AS latest_start_term, MAX(c.VERSION) AS highest_program_version FROM CIP c JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.VERSION > 2000 GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE;

question: For each department, what is the highest average total units for degree-granting subjects offered in any academic year, and in which academic year did this occur? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units, ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC) AS rnk FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rnk = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each student year, list the student year and the average, range, and variance of department budget codes for students in that year, considering only students whose department code matches both an academic department and an administrative department, and include only those student years where the average department budget code exceeds the overall average department budget code across all student years. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.avg_budget, inner_cte.budget_range, inner_cte.budget_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_budget > (SELECT AVG(avg_budget) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.budget_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each student year, give the student year and calculate the average, range, and variance of department budget codes for students in that year, considering only students whose department code matches both an academic department and an administrative department.
sub_sqls: SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY budget_range DESC;

question: For each subject offered, show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, subject ID, the term description, academic year, term start date, the maximum term end date for each row and the next two rows in order of subject offered key, and indicate whether the term status indicator is 'P' (past), 'C' (current), or 'F' (future), only for terms that are not the current term and have a material status key of 'RQ'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(t1.TERM_END_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered, show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, subject ID, the term description, academic year, term start date, and the maximum term end date for each row and the next two rows in order of subject offered key, only for terms that are not the current term and have a material status key of 'RQ'.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(t1.TERM_END_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum total units offered, and the number of courses where the design units are at least 3. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units;
sub_questions: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units offered.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each space unit, list the space unit name and the number of rooms it contains, but only include those space units that have more rooms than the average number of rooms per space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.room_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(room_count) AS avg_room_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) sub ) a ON 1=1 WHERE i.room_count > a.avg_room_count;
sub_questions: List the top 10 space units by the number of rooms they contain, showing the space unit name and the count of rooms for each.
sub_sqls: SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For rooms with an access level of 1, show the building-room identifier, the area, the major use description, and the average area for each major use description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT DESCRIPTION, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION;
sub_questions: For rooms with an access level of 1, show the building-room identifier, the area, the major use description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the major use description.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1

question: For each organization with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, show the organization name, organization key, HR department name, HR org unit title, HR org unit key, and the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, but only include those where the average organization key is greater than the overall average organization key for all such organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND ASSIGNABLE = 1 );
sub_questions: For each organization, show the organization name, organization key, HR department name, HR org unit title, HR org unit key, and the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, for organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1

question: For buildings with a building type of 'ACADEMIC' and a campus sector of 'MAIN GROUP', show the building name from the current table, the fiscal period from the history table, and the maximum assignable area from the history table for each building, along with their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the assignable area from the history table. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP' ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, FISCAL_PERIOD, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_NAME) AS max_assignable_area, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For buildings with a building type of 'ACADEMIC' and a campus sector of 'MAIN GROUP', show the building name from the current table and the fiscal period from the history table, along with their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the assignable area from the history table.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_BUILDING t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP'

question: For each HASS attribute, what is the maximum row number assigned to any subject offered in the academic year 2022 with that HASS attribute, where row numbers are assigned within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title? Show the HASS attribute, its description, and the maximum row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, t1.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE t1 ON t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = t1.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) SELECT HASS_ATTRIBUTE, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, MAX(window_column) AS max_row_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HASS_ATTRIBUTE, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a HASS attribute of 'HE', show the subject title, department name, HASS attribute description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE t1 ON t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = t1.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = 'HE'

question: List the subject code, subject code description, and department name for all subject codes that are associated with departments that are degree-granting and belong to the School of Engineering. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering';
sub_questions: How many subject codes are associated with departments that are degree-granting and belong to the School of Engineering?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering';

question: For each department, what is the highest number of units among all HASS Elective subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and which subject(s) have that number of units? Provide the department code, subject code, subject number, subject title, and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) m ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND i.TOTAL_UNITS = m.max_units
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year that is classified as a HASS Elective, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, the number of units for the subject, and the total number of subjects in the same department that are also HASS Electives.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective';

question: What is the minimum CIP program code and the total number of unique school names for courses where the department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', the subject code description is not null, and the course level is 'G'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_unique_school_names FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.min_cip_program_code, inner_cte.total_unique_school_names FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 ON scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON scd2.COURSE = ssc2.SUBJECT_CODE AND ssc2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL;
sub_questions: What is the minimum CIP program code and the total number of unique school names for courses where the department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' and the subject code description is not null?
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_unique_school_names FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the average subject enrollment number as a benchmark, and classify the department-year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the minimum total units is at least 10% greater than the benchmark, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with that department, considering only space units with a code greater than 0? Also, for each department, indicate whether the geometric mean is 'HIGH' (at least 20% greater than the average geometric mean across all departments), 'LOW' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Provide the department name, the geometric mean, the overall average geometric mean, and the category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.geometric_mean, avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN ic.geometric_mean < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.8 THEN 'LOW' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with that department, considering only space units with a code greater than 0? Provide the department name and the geometric mean.
sub_sqls: SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

question: List the department codes, department names, and the total number of units for all courses in each department, but only for those departments whose total units are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department code and the total number of units for all courses in that department, considering only departments whose total units are more than one standard deviation above the mean total units across all departments?
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t );

question: For each DLC, provide the DLC name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for assignable organizations associated with that DLC, but only include DLCs where the average organization number is greater than the overall average organization number for all assignable organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ) SELECT DLC_NAME, avg_org_number, org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_org_number > ( SELECT AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC;
sub_questions: For each DLC, provide the DLC name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, considering only organizations that are assignable.
sub_sqls: SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC;

question: For each activity title, what is the highest number of associated course materials it has had in any term, including the activity title from IAP subject details and the maximum material count? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE;
sub_questions: Which are the top 10 activity titles with the highest number of associated course materials, including the activity title from IAP subject details, the term description from academic terms, and the count of course materials from TIP detail?
sub_sqls: SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For organizations with a major organization key of 230, show the organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent, and also display the top department (by count of organizations) within each organization parent, along with the count of organizations for that department. Limit the results to the top 10 organization parents with the highest total organization counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, ic.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY ic.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, dept_stats.Top_Department, dept_stats.Department_Org_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Org_Count FROM inner_cte ic2 GROUP BY ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = ( SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inner_cte ic3 WHERE ic3.ORG_PARENT = ic2.ORG_PARENT GROUP BY ic3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) ) dept_stats ON ic.ORG_PARENT = dept_stats.ORG_PARENT AND ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.Top_Department WHERE ic.ORG_PARENT IN ( SELECT org_parent FROM ( SELECT ic4.ORG_PARENT AS org_parent, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs FROM inner_cte ic4 GROUP BY ic4.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY total_orgs DESC LIMIT 10 ) top_parents ) ORDER BY ic.ORG_PARENT, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME;
sub_questions: For organizations with a major organization key of 230, show the organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, and the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent, ordered by the organization name.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230

question: For each department in the 2022 academic year, list the department code, department name, the HASS Elective attribute description, the number of HASS Elective subjects offered in that department, and a grand total of HASS Elective subjects across all departments. For each department, include a grand total row in the format (null, null, null, total HASS Elective subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' ), DepartmentHassCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, COUNT(*) AS num_hass_electives FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, num_hass_electives FROM DepartmentHassCounts ORDER BY CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, DEPARTMENT_CODE ;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year that is classified as a HASS Elective, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, the number of units for the subject, and the total number of subjects in the same department that are also HASS Electives.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective';

question: For each school, list the school name, the number of departments in that school that offer at least one course with more than 9 total units, and the maximum total units of any course in those departments, but only include schools where at least two such departments exist. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments_with_big_courses, MAX(ic.max_total_units) AS max_total_units_in_school FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.max_total_units > 9 GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) >= 2;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, and what is the name of the school that department belongs to, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6?
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

question: For each sponsor, provide the sponsor name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, and also display the sponsor type. Only include sponsors whose average maximum enrollment is among the top 5 highest. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE ) SELECT icte.SPONSOR_NAME, icte.SPONSOR_TYPE, icte.avg_max_enrollment, icte.var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.avg_max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5;
sub_questions: For each sponsor, provide the sponsor name and calculate the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department, and the total number of subjects offered by each department in that term, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
