question: For each department in the School of Engineering where the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department is greater than 50, what is the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and the variance of the total units for those courses? Please list the department name, total enrollment, average units, and units variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance FROM dept_enrollment e JOIN dept_units_stats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50.
For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each grade type, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units), ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EngSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Combined AS ( SELECT e.SUBJECT_CODE, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM EngSubjects e JOIN DeptStats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM Combined ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type, ordered by subject code.

For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units?
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA that have total units greater than 1, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID, and the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubjectsOffered2019FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), SubjectsWithUnits2019FA AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM SubjectsOffered2019FA s1 JOIN SubjectsWithUnits2019FA s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each Mathematics department course with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearlyVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yv.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathCourses mc JOIN YearlyVariation yv ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.COURSE_NUMBER;
sub_questions: For courses offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and assign row numbers within each academic year group ordered by course number.
For each academic year, give the academic year and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees and offers at least one subject with more than 0 total units, display the department name, the average of the total units, the variance of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and, if available, the total number of tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10. The results should be ordered by the variance of the total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), eng_tip_materials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, e.total_tip_materials FROM dept_units_stats d LEFT JOIN eng_tip_materials e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units?

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms, where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10;

question: For each department, academic year, activity title, and sponsor name where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the maximum enrollment for the activity is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, activity title, sponsor name, number of unique activities, and minimum fee. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), ActivitySponsorStats AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME ), TermJoin AS ( SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN TermJoin tj ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tj.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ActivitySponsorStats ass ON tj.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND tj.SPONSOR_NAME = ass.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME
sub_questions: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered.
For each activity title and sponsor name where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, provide the number of unique activities and the minimum fee.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME;

question: List the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title for activities in the "Mathematics" category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AllActivitiesByCategory AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), MathematicsActivitiesWithRowNum AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, a.window_column AS category_dense_rank, m.window_column AS mathematics_row_number FROM AllActivitiesByCategory a JOIN MathematicsActivitiesWithRowNum m ON a.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND a.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, a.ACTIVITY_TITLE;
sub_questions: List the activity title, enrollment type, and maximum enrollment for each activity, along with the category name, and show the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name.

For IAP subjects in the "Mathematics" category, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, and assign row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title.

SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department where the organization is assignable and the organization level is greater than 4, list the department name, the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, and the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with that department (considering only space units with a code greater than 0), ordered by geometric mean in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH GeometricMeanByDepartment AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), OrganizationStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT gm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, gm.geometric_mean FROM GeometricMeanByDepartment gm JOIN OrganizationStats os ON gm.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY gm.geometric_mean DESC
sub_questions: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with that department, considering only space units with a code greater than 0? Provide the department name and the geometric mean.
For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization level is greater than 4, give the number of organizations and the minimum organization number.
sub_sqls: SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each room with area greater than 200, show the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group (ordered by building-room), and for the corresponding DLC key, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations that have a non-null organization name). Order the results by building-room. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH OrgDlcStats AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ), RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, ods.org_count_range, ods.org_count_variance, ods.org_count_stddev FROM RoomAreaStats ras JOIN OrgDlcStats ods ON ras.DLC_KEY = ods.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM;
sub_questions: For each DLC key, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key, considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations that have a non-null organization name?

For rooms with area greater than 200, show the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, and the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room.
sub_sqls: SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC;

SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200

question: For each department that is degree-granting and in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its offered courses greater than 50, what is the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), EngineeringDeptTotals AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, e.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats d JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students?

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

question: For each department that grants degrees and offers graduate-level courses, and for which the number of enrolled students in at least one subject is greater than 2, provide the department name, the range of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, the variance of enrolled students, the offering school name, the count of distinct subject IDs with more than 2 enrolled students, and the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials. List the results ordered by the range of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), DeptSubjectMaterialStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, d2.subject_count, d2.min_isbn FROM DeptEnrolledStats d1 JOIN DeptSubjectMaterialStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d1.enrolled_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and courses that are at the graduate level? Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, and the variance of enrolled students.

For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs and the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, along with the building key, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. Order the results by category code and descending standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH course_info AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ), building_stats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT ci.COURSE, ci.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ci.SCHOOL_NAME, ci.PROGRAM_CODE, ci.PROGRAM_TITLE, ci.CATEGORY_CODE, ci.CATEGORY_TITLE, ci.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ci.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ci.min_warehouse_load_date, bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units FROM course_info ci JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.SUBJECT_CODE = ci.COURSE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = cso.MEET_PLACE JOIN building_stats bs ON bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ci.CATEGORY_CODE, bs.stddev_total_units DESC
sub_questions: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, ordered by category code.
For each building, give the building key and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6

SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For rooms with an area of at least 300, show the room key, building room, area, building number, city, and assign row numbers within each city ordered by area. For each such room, also show the DLC key associated with the room, and the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms by DLC key (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). Order the results by city and area descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH LargeRoomsByCity AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.CITY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.CITY ORDER BY t0.AREA) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA >= 300 ), RoomAreaStatsByDLC AS ( SELECT fod.DLC_KEY, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fod JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 40 GROUP BY fod.DLC_KEY ORDER BY area_variance DESC ) SELECT lr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, lr.BUILDING_ROOM, lr.AREA, lr.BUILDING_NUMBER, lr.CITY, lr.window_column, fod.DLC_KEY, ras.avg_area, ras.area_variance, ras.area_stddev FROM LargeRoomsByCity lr JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fod ON lr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN RoomAreaStatsByDLC ras ON fod.DLC_KEY = ras.DLC_KEY ORDER BY lr.CITY, lr.AREA DESC;
sub_questions: For rooms with an area of at least 300, show the room key, building room, area, building number, city, and assign row numbers within each city ordered by area.
For each DLC key, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the area of rooms by DLC key, considering only rooms with an area greater than 40?
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.CITY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.CITY ORDER BY t0.AREA) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA >= 300

SELECT fod.DLC_KEY, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fod JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 40 GROUP BY fod.DLC_KEY ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the name of the department, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned and are offered in the term '2013FA'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH department_catalog_key_variance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), department_enrolled_stddev AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT dckv.DEPARTMENT, dckv.catalog_key_variance, desd.enrolled_stddev FROM department_catalog_key_variance dckv JOIN department_enrolled_stddev desd ON dckv.DEPARTMENT = desd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the name of the department and the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U'?

For each department, what is the name of the department and the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned, considering only courses offered in the term '2013FA'?
sub_sqls: SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For each department, display the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, along with each HGN code, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table, for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units, where the department name matches in both cases. Show the results ordered by the enrolled student range (descending) and then by the maximum lecture units (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), hgn_subjects AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, hs.HGN_CODE, hs.max_lecture_units, hs.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_enrollment_stats des JOIN hgn_subjects hs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrolled_range DESC, hs.max_lecture_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA.

For each HGN code, what is the department name, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table, for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2;

question: For each building that has more than five rooms, show the building number and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms, and for each room in that building with an access level of 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, and the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH BuildingAreaStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC ), RoomAccessLevel1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT bal.BUILDING_NUMBER, bal.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column FROM BuildingAreaStddev bal JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON bal.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessLevel1 ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY bal.area_stddev DESC, ral1.FLOOR
sub_questions: For each building, what is the building number and the standard deviation of the area of its rooms, considering only buildings that have more than five rooms?

For each room with an access level of 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, and the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor.
sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC;

SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department ordered by academic year, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter (considering only terms that are regular terms). Present the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.TERM_PARAMETER = s2.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR
sub_questions: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, and the running sum of academic years within each department, ordered by academic year.

For each academic term parameter, provide the term parameter name and both the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter, considering only terms that are regular terms.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C'

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its courses greater than 50, give the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and the variance of the total units for those courses. List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance FROM DeptEnrollment e JOIN DeptUnitsStats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50.
For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the subject is scheduled in a building during the fall term, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, the building key, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. Order the results by school name, subject code rank, and descending standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DegreeGrantingSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), BuildingSubjectUnits AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT dgs.SUBJECT_CODE, dgs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgs.SCHOOL_NAME, dgs.window_column, bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bsu.avg_total_units, bsu.stddev_total_units FROM DegreeGrantingSubjects dgs JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON dgs.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingSubjectUnits bsu ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY dgs.SCHOOL_NAME, dgs.window_column, bsu.stddev_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code.
For each building, give the building key and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each academic year where the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year, show the academic year, academic year description, the average record count for TIP materials in that year (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), the range of record counts, the variance of record counts, and the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL for that academic year. List the results in descending order of the total number of materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH YearlyTipStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), YearlyTotalMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) SELECT yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yts.avg_record_count, yts.record_count_range, yts.record_count_variance, ytm.total_materials FROM YearlyTipStats yts JOIN YearlyTotalMaterials ytm ON yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ytm.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ytm.total_materials DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the record counts for TIP materials in that year, considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'.

For each academic year, what is the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL, considering only those academic years where the total number of materials is greater than one standard deviation above the mean total number of materials per academic year?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub )

question: For each tip detail where the material status key is 'EO', show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, term parameter, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by subject offered key, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of materials per subject for the corresponding term parameter (for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date). Present the results ordered by academic year and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH avg_stats AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC ), eo_materials AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' ) SELECT eo_materials.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eo_materials.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eo_materials.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eo_materials.TERM_CODE, eo_materials.SUBJECT_ID, eo_materials.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eo_materials.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eo_materials.TERM_PARAMETER, eo_materials.window_column, avg_stats.avg_materials_per_subject, avg_stats.variance_materials_per_subject, avg_stats.stddev_materials_per_subject FROM eo_materials LEFT JOIN avg_stats ON eo_materials.TERM_PARAMETER = avg_stats.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY eo_materials.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eo_materials.window_column;
sub_questions: For each term parameter, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of materials per subject for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date?

For tip details where the material status key is 'EO', show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, term parameter, and assign row numbers within each academic year group ordered by subject offered key.
sub_sqls: SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC;

SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO'

question: For each organization that has both rooms on floor 2 or higher and at least one associated space unit with a non-null DLC key, list the organization name, the average access level of rooms assigned to that organization, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of those access levels, the average space unit code assigned to the organization, the variance of those space unit codes, and calculate the access to space ratio rounded (average access level divided by average space unit code).
sql: WITH OrgAccessStats AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC ), DeptSpaceStats AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_space_unit_code DESC ) SELECT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev, dss.avg_space_unit_code, dss.var_space_unit_code, ROUND(oas.avg_access_level / NULLIF(dss.avg_space_unit_code, 0), 2) AS access_to_space_ratio FROM OrgAccessStats oas JOIN DeptSpaceStats dss ON oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_to_space_ratio DESC;
sub_questions: For each organization, provide the organization name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the access levels of rooms assigned to that organization, considering only rooms on floor 2 or higher.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average and variance of the space unit codes assigned to it, considering only departments that have a non-null DLC key and at least one associated space unit.
sub_sqls: SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC;

SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_space_unit_code DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, total units, department full name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subjects2025FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, e.TOTAL_UNITS, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.window_column FROM Subjects2025FA s JOIN EngineeringSubjects e ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = e.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = e.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by offering department.

For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject title, total units, department full name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each academic year and department, list the academic year, department name, average total units, variance of total units for subjects offered in regular terms, the academic year description, and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AvgVarTotalUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM AvgVarTotalUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, what is the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms?

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year?
sub_sqls: SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' that have at least one reserved material with material status 'U', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject, ordered by offering department and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subjects2025FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), SubjectReservedMaterialStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC ) SELECT s2025.SUBJECT_ID, s2025.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2025.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2025.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2025.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2025.TERM_START_DATE, s2025.TERM_END_DATE, s2025.TERM_PARAMETER, s2025.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, srms.reserved_material_range, srms.reserved_material_variance, srms.reserved_material_stddev FROM Subjects2025FA s2025 JOIN SubjectReservedMaterialStats srms ON s2025.SUBJECT_TITLE = srms.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s2025.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by offering department.

For each subject offered, give the subject title and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of reserved materials per subject, considering only subjects with at least one reserved material and where the material status is 'U'.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, and the name of the school that department belongs to, but only for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6. List the results ordered by the range of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), DeptMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dms.units_range, dms.units_variance, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME FROM DeptUnitsStats dms JOIN DeptMaxUnits dmu ON dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dms.units_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022.

For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, and what is the name of the school that department belongs to, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6?
sub_sqls: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum start date of the academic term, and for subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, department name, course description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, for those department names that appear in both sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_start_date, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON lso.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN subq2 s2 ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum start date of the academic term.

For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, department name, and course description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E'

question: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, provide the academic year, academic year description, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum number of total units for those subjects, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev FROM EnrolledStats e JOIN DeptSubjectStats d ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and provide both the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0.
