For each degree-granting department and subject code, provide the department name, subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, and the full department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1 ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, what are the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, and the subject code of the course with the maximum total units, and for each such course offered in the term with code '2022SU', what are the subject's ID, total units, department name, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_total_units, i.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = i.max_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_total_units, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subq2_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 s2 ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, and what is the name of the school that department belongs to, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6?
For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show the subject IDs and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units.

For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, what is the name of the school that department belongs to, and what is the subject code of the course with the maximum total units, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6?

For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show each subject's ID, total units, department name, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_total_units, i.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = i.max_total_units;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC;

question: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, but only include those courses where the minimum warehouse load date for the category code is after '01-JAN-20' and where the department offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022 with the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects greater than 3. For these departments, also show the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term. Order the results by category code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH CourseCIPInfo AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ), DeptSubjectCount AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM DeptSubjectStats inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT cci.COURSE, cci.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cci.SCHOOL_NAME, cci.PROGRAM_CODE, cci.PROGRAM_TITLE, cci.CATEGORY_CODE, cci.CATEGORY_TITLE, cci.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, cci.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, cci.min_warehouse_load_date, dsc.max_lecture_units, dsc.TERM_START_DATE, dsc.num_subjects_offered FROM CourseCIPInfo cci JOIN DeptSubjectCount dsc ON cci.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cci.min_warehouse_load_date > '01-JAN-20' ORDER BY cci.CATEGORY_CODE;
sub_questions: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, ordered by category code.

For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, what is the department name, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, and the start date of the term, considering only subjects with more than 3 lecture units?

For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, but only include those courses where the minimum warehouse load date for the category code is after '01-JAN-20'. Order the results by category code.

For each department that offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022, what is the department name, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term, considering only departments where the highest number of lecture units among their subjects is greater than 3?
sub_sqls: SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE min_warehouse_load_date > '01-JAN-20' ORDER BY CATEGORY_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE;

question: For IAP subjects with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, academic year, term description, subject title, the difference between the maximum enrollment and the total units, the subject code, subject code description, department name, and the number of subjects in the same department, for each subject offered in the same term and where the school code and subject title are not null. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH iap_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, (12 - c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS enrollment_minus_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.SUBJECT_TITLE = c.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subject_department_counts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.subjects_in_department, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subjects_in_department FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT iap_enrollment.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap_enrollment.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iap_enrollment.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap_enrollment.TERM_DESCRIPTION, iap_enrollment.SUBJECT_TITLE, iap_enrollment.enrollment_minus_units, subject_department_counts.SUBJECT_CODE, subject_department_counts.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subject_department_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_department_counts.subjects_in_department FROM iap_enrollment JOIN subject_department_counts ON iap_enrollment.SUBJECT_TITLE = subject_department_counts.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY iap_enrollment.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap_enrollment.ACTIVITY_TITLE;
sub_questions: For IAP subjects with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, academic year, term description, subject title, and rank within each academic year group ordered by activity title.

Show the subject code, subject code description, department name, and subject title for each subject, along with the dense rank of each row partitioned by the school code and ordered by school code, for subjects where the school code is not null and the subject title is not null.

For IAP subjects with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, academic year, term description, subject title, and the difference between the maximum enrollment and the total units for each subject offered in the same term.

For each subject, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, subject title, and the number of subjects in the same department, for subjects where the school code is not null and the subject title is not null.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, (12 - c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS enrollment_minus_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.SUBJECT_TITLE = c.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.subjects_in_department FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subjects_in_department FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, the subject title, and whether the subject is offered in the fall term, along with, for each matching department and grade type in the School of Engineering, the grade type, department name, the number of subjects with at least 6 units, the average total units for those subjects, the school name, and the department full name. The results are ordered by subject ID, grade type, and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), cte1 AS ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(grade_type) OVER (ORDER BY grade_type_sort, grade_type, dept_sort) = grade_type THEN NULL ELSE grade_type END AS grade_type, dept, subj_count, avg_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, tbltmp.dept_sort, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS subj_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, MAX(DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY grade_type_sort, dept_sort ) SELECT c1.SUBJECT_ID, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c1.window_column, c1.SUBJECT_TITLE, c1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, c2.grade_type, c2.dept, c2.subj_count, c2.avg_units, c2.school_name, c2.department_full_name FROM cte1 c1 JOIN cte2 c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c1.SUBJECT_ID, c2.grade_type, c2.dept_sort;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, ordered by subject ID.

For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type, ordered by subject code.

For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, along with the subject title and whether the subject is offered in the fall term, ordered by subject ID.

For each grade type and department in the School of Engineering, list the grade type, department name, the number of subjects with at least 6 units, the average total units for those subjects, the school name, and the department full name. Include subtotals for each grade type (the corresponding grade type field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all grade types (the corresponding grade type field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the grade type if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by grade type and department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(grade_type) OVER (ORDER BY grade_type_sort, grade_type, dept_sort) = grade_type THEN NULL ELSE grade_type END AS grade_type, dept, subj_count, avg_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS subj_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY grade_type_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, academic year description, department name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', and for those departments, what is the total number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP' where the total number of reserved materials is greater than the average number of reserved materials per department for that term? List the academic year, academic year description, department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), department name for 2009SP, and total reserved materials for 2009SP in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH academic_year_variation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), dept_reserved_materials_2009sp AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > ( SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte ) ) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ayv.coefficient_of_variation, drm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, drm.reserved_materials FROM academic_year_variation ayv LEFT JOIN dept_reserved_materials_2009sp drm ON ayv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = drm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials, including the subject title, the offering department name, and the count of reserved materials, for subjects offered in the term '2009SP'.

sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > ( SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte );

question: For each major use description, list the building-room identifier, area, major use description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the major use description, as well as the organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, and the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent, ordered by the organization name, but only include those organizations whose organization number is greater than the average organization number of their parent group. For each major use description, include a grand total row for all rooms in the format of (null, null, major use description, total rooms) and only include rooms whose organization matches the filtered organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DESCRIPTION ), RoomMajorUse AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.AREA, ic.DESCRIPTION, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte1 ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS AREA, rc.DESCRIPTION, NULL AS FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rc.total_rooms AS window_column FROM RoomCounts rc ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ), FilteredOrgs AS ( SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, i.window_column, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN ( SELECT ORG_PARENT, AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_num FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ORG_PARENT ) a ON i.ORG_PARENT = a.ORG_PARENT WHERE i.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > a.avg_org_num ) SELECT rm.BUILDING_ROOM, rm.AREA, rm.DESCRIPTION, rm.window_column AS room_window_column, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, fo.window_column AS org_window_column FROM RoomMajorUse rm JOIN FilteredOrgs fo ON rm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rm.DESCRIPTION, rm.BUILDING_ROOM, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME

sub_sqls: SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.AREA, ic.DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS AREA, rc.DESCRIPTION, rc.total_rooms AS window_column FROM RoomCounts rc ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, BUILDING_ROOM

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, AVG(t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT ORG_PARENT, AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_num FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORG_PARENT ) a ON i.ORG_PARENT = a.ORG_PARENT WHERE i.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > a.avg_org_num ORDER BY i.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each organization, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the corresponding HR org unit title, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, and, if available, the space unit name, space unit code, department count, number of supervisees, and the highest research volume ever recorded for each department count group for space units with a space unit code of 97500. Also, for each organization and department name, include a grand total for all HR org units in the format of (organization key, organization name, department name, null, total department IDs, null, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), OrgUnitDetails AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(i.total_department_id) AS total_department_id FROM inner_cte1 i LEFT JOIN OrgUnitDetails o ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, t2.RESEARCH_VOLUME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), SpaceUnitAgg AS ( SELECT space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, MAX(RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS highest_research_volume, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.hr_org_unit_count, rr.total_department_id, sua.space_unit_name, sua.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sua.DEPT_COUNT, sua.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sua.highest_research_volume FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN SpaceUnitAgg sua ON rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sua.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
sub_questions: For each organization, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, and the total of their department IDs, for organizations that are assignable and have a department code above 100000.

For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, and the average department count within each department count group ordered by number of supervisees.

sub_sqls: SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , OrgUnitDetails AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(i.total_department_id) AS total_department_id FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN OrgUnitDetails o ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.hr_org_unit_count, rr.total_department_id FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, t2.RESEARCH_VOLUME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, MAX(RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS highest_research_volume FROM inner_cte GROUP BY space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES;

question: For each subject in the 2019FA term with total units greater than 1 and for each category, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each school, the academic year description, the category name, and the highest maximum enrollment among its activities, ordered by subject ID and category name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ), SubjectStatsWithYear AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.TERM_CODE FROM SubjectStats ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON ic.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ), CategoryMaxEnrollment AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), CategoryMaxEnrollmentAgg AS ( SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM CategoryMaxEnrollment GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column AS running_sum_total_units_within_school, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.highest_max_enrollment FROM SubjectStatsWithYear s JOIN CategoryMaxEnrollmentAgg c ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ID, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;
sub_questions: For each subject in the 2019FA term with total units greater than 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school, ordered by subject ID.

List the activity title, enrollment type, and maximum enrollment for each activity, along with the category name, and show the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name.

For each subject in the 2019FA term with total units greater than 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each school, and the academic year description, ordered by subject ID.
For each category, list the category name and the highest maximum enrollment among its activities.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1

SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON ic.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

question: For each subject category, provide the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, and the difference between the average and the variance for each category. Additionally, for each subject offered by the library in the term "2019SP" whose offering department name matches the subject category name, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term description, the total units for the subject, the average total units within each subject group, the offering department name, and the school name. Do not repeat the subject title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the results by the difference between the average and variance in descending order, then by the number of enrolled students and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH iap_category_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC ), library_subjects_2019sp AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ics.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ics.avg_max_enrollment, ics.var_max_enrollment, ics.avg_minus_var, lso.subject_title, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lso.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM iap_category_stats ics LEFT JOIN library_subjects_2019sp lso ON ics.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ics.avg_minus_var DESC, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC;

SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For rooms with a square footage of 150, show the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, and the number of rooms for each space unit code (including a grand total for each space unit code in the format of (null, null, space unit code, space unit name, total rooms)), and for each such room, if it is assigned to a department and its area is greater than 40 and above the average area of rooms (with area > 40) assigned to that department, also show the department name and the room area. List the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, total rooms, department name, and area in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH RoomRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150 ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS num_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, SUM(num_rooms) AS total_rooms FROM RoomCounts GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_rooms) > 0 ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, total_rooms FROM RollupResults ), DeptRoomAboveAvg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.AREA > a.avg_area ) SELECT rr.BUILDING_ROOM, rr.ROOM_NUMBER, rr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rr.SPACE_UNIT, rr.total_rooms, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.AREA FROM RoomRollup rr JOIN DeptRoomAboveAvg d ON rr.BUILDING_ROOM = d.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY rr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rr.BUILDING_ROOM, rr.ROOM_NUMBER, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.AREA DESC;
sub_questions: For rooms with a square footage of 150, show the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, and rank within each space unit code group ordered by building room.
For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the area of rooms assigned to it, considering only rooms with an area greater than 40.

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150

SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150 ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS num_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, SUM(num_rooms) AS total_rooms FROM RoomCounts GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_rooms) > 0 ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, total_rooms FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.AREA > a.avg_area ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.AREA DESC;

question: For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, and for organizations with an organization level of 5 and HR org unit level 'DEPARTMENTS', provide the organization, space unit, number of space units, minimum organization number, DLC name, organization name, organization ID, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and the row number within each HR department name group ordered by organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.space_unit_count, i.min_org_number, o.DLC_NAME, o.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON i.ORGANIZATION = o.ORGANIZATION ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' ) SELECT subq1.ORGANIZATION, subq1.SPACE_UNIT, subq1.space_unit_count, subq1.min_org_number, subq1.DLC_NAME, subq2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, subq2.ORGANIZATION_ID, subq2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, subq2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DLC_KEY = subq2.DLC_KEY

SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS';

question: For each previous academic term and each day of the week, and for each subject that has at least one enrolled student in that term, show the term code (with subtotals and grand total as in the original), day of week, the number of calendar dates that fall on that day of week for the term's start date, the average calendar year for those dates, the term start date, the subject title, the maximum number of enrolled students for that subject, the tip material status key, and the total units for the subject. Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term start date, day of week, and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, day_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, day_of_week, date_count, avg_calendar_year, term_start_date, term_sort FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DAY_OF_WEEK END AS day_sort, DAY_OF_WEEK AS day_of_week, COUNT(DISTINCT CALENDAR_DATE) AS date_count, AVG(window_column) AS avg_calendar_year, MIN(TERM_START_DATE) AS term_start_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DAY_OF_WEEK WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY term_sort, day_sort ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS ) SELECT s1.term, s1.day_of_week, s1.date_count, s1.avg_calendar_year, s1.term_start_date, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.max_enrolled_students, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.term_sort = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.term_start_date, s1.day_of_week, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE
