sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE COURSE_LEVEL END AS course_level_sort, COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level, SUM(student_count) AS student_count, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TIP_DETAIL.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' AND TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.total_materials, subj_stats.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject, subj_stats.material_count AS Top_Subject_Material_Count FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) subj_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subj_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND subj_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.total_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, the total number of subjects offered by each department in that term, the minimum number of lecture units, and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_subject_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.enrolled_range, s1.enrolled_variance, s1.enrolled_stddev, s1.total_subjects, s2.min_lecture_units, s2.total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.enrolled_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA.
What is the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022?

For each department, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, along with the total number of subjects offered by each department in that term.
For each department, what is the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_subject_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials in the term '2009SP', including the subject title, offering department name, number of reserved materials, and total number of enrolled students for each subject, also provide for each subject the academic year, department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, department phone number, and school name for the corresponding department and academic year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students. The results should be ordered by the number of reserved materials (descending), academic year, and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), TopSubjects2009SP AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.reserved_materials, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.department_phone, d.school_name FROM TopSubjects2009SP t JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t.reserved_materials DESC, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials, including the subject title, the offering department name, and the count of reserved materials, for subjects offered in the term '2009SP'.

For each academic year, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students? Please provide the academic year and these statistics.
For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials in the term '2009SP', also include the total number of enrolled students for each subject.

For each academic year and department, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students? Please provide the academic year, department name, average enrollment, and enrollment variance, along with the department phone number and school name.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP';

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree granting department and each subject it offers in the term with code '2025FA', provide the department name, the average and variance of the ASCII values of its subject codes' course numbers, the total number of subject codes for the department, the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii ORDER BY i.var_course_number_ascii DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.TERM_END_DATE, i.TERM_PARAMETER, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_course_number_ascii, s1.var_course_number_ascii, s1.total_subject_codes, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TERM_END_DATE, s2.TERM_PARAMETER, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting.

For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by offering department.

For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the ASCII values of its subject codes' course numbers (considering only degree granting departments), and also show the total number of subject codes for each department.

For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by offering department.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii ORDER BY i.var_course_number_ascii DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.TERM_END_DATE, i.TERM_PARAMETER, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For subjects with at least 5 enrolled students that are also offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, responsible faculty name, the row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, the offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, and for each subject code, the grand total of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID AND i.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column, SUBJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.window_column AS material_status_row_number, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.window_column AS min_enrolled_students_per_code, s2.total_enrolled_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For subjects with at least 5 enrolled students, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, and assign row numbers within each material status group ordered by subject ID.

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by subject code.

For subjects with at least 5 enrolled students, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, and the responsible faculty name, and assign row numbers within each material status group ordered by subject ID.

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, and for each subject code, include a grand total of enrolled students in the format of (null, null, null, null, subject code, subject code description, total enrolled students). Order the results by subject code and subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID AND i.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, and the total number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP' (if any). Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code, null for reserved materials). Only include departments where the total number of reserved materials is greater than the average number of reserved materials per department for that term, or departments with no reserved materials for that term. Present the results in the order of school name and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code, ic2.reserved_materials FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE (ic2.reserved_materials > (SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte2) OR ic2.reserved_materials IS NULL) ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department name and school name, where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions.

List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials, including the subject title, the offering department name, and the count of reserved materials, for subjects offered in the term '2009SP'.

For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code).

For each department, list the department name and the total number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', but only include departments where the total number of reserved materials is greater than the average number of reserved materials per department for that term.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > ( SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte );

question: For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, and where the offering department is among the top 5 Engineering school departments (by number of courses with exactly 12 units), show the offering department name, course number description, number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description, the number of qualifying courses in the department, and the course number and description of the most recently added such course in each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), dept_counts AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), ic_recent AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, course_number, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte2 ), top_departments AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses, ic_recent.course_number AS most_recent_course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS most_recent_course_description FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN ic_recent ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic_recent.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic_recent.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic_recent.course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, d.isbn_count, d.min_faculty_mit_id, dcr.total_tip_detail_records, td.num_courses, td.most_recent_course_number, td.most_recent_course_description FROM (SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.isbn_count, inner_cte.min_faculty_mit_id FROM inner_cte JOIN dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dept_counts.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) d JOIN dept_counts dcr ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dcr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND d.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dcr.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC JOIN top_departments td ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, td.num_courses DESC;
sub_questions: For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, give the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL and the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.

For courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show the course number, course description, subject title, total units, offering department name, and assign row numbers within each offering department ordered by course number.

For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, show the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, and the total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description.

Among courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, which offering department has the most such courses? For the top 5 offering departments by count, show the department name, the number of qualifying courses, and the course number and description of the most recently added course in each department.
sub_sqls: SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC;

SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.isbn_count, inner_cte.min_faculty_mit_id, dept_counts.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dept_counts.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses, ic_recent.course_number AS most_recent_course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS most_recent_course_description FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, course_number, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ic_recent ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic_recent.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic_recent.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic_recent.course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each organization with a name starting with 'R' (case insensitive), and where the average room area for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area is greater than 300, and where the average room area is also greater than the overall average room area, provide the organization name, the number of such rooms, the average, minimum, and maximum room area, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization. List the results ordered by average room area descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH org_room_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(ic.AREA) AS room_count, AVG(ic.AREA) AS avg_area, MIN(ic.AREA) AS min_area, MAX(ic.AREA) AS max_area FROM inner_cte ic WHERE UPPER(ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME) LIKE 'R%' GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(ic.AREA) > 300 ORDER BY avg_area DESC ), org_coeff_var AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > (SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.room_count, ors.avg_area, ors.min_area, ors.max_area, ocv.coefficient_of_variation FROM org_room_stats ors JOIN org_coeff_var ocv ON ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ocv.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ors.avg_area DESC
sub_questions: For each organization, give the organization name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the room areas for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area.
For each floor, give the floor key and the coefficient of variation of the area of rooms located on that floor, considering only floors where the average room area is greater than zero.

For each organization with a name starting with 'R' (case insensitive), and where the average room area for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area is greater than 300, provide the organization name, the number of such rooms, and the average, minimum, and maximum room area.

For each organization, give the organization name and the coefficient of variation of the area of rooms assigned to that organization, considering only organizations where the average room area is greater than the overall average room area.
sub_sqls: SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC;

SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(ic.AREA) AS room_count, AVG(ic.AREA) AS avg_area, MIN(ic.AREA) AS min_area, MAX(ic.AREA) AS max_area FROM inner_cte ic WHERE UPPER(ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME) LIKE 'R%' GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(ic.AREA) > 300 ORDER BY avg_area DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > (SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each of the top 5 administrative departments with the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in student office phone numbers (considering only students with a non-null office phone number), list the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers, the total number of such students in the department, the degree-granting department name, the school name, and the total number of courses in that department (including grand totals for each school in the format of (null, school name, total courses)). The results are ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in office phone numbers (descending), then by school name and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopStddevDepartments AS ( SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, COUNT(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.FULL_NAME) AS student_count FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT AND MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_office_phone DESC LIMIT 5 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, question: For each space unit with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, the total number of space units for each organization, the average and variance of the HR organization unit IDs associated with the space unit, and also display the most common HR department name among those units along with the count of units in that department. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.avg_org_unit_id, icte.org_unit_id_variance, dept_stats.Most_Common_HR_Department, dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Common_HR_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Unit_Count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT AND dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count = ( SELECT MAX(sub_dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count) FROM ( SELECT su2.SPACE_UNIT, hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Department_Unit_Count FROM SPACE_UNIT su2 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo2 ON su2.DLC_KEY = fo2.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou2 ON fo2.DLC_KEY = hou2.DLC_KEY WHERE hou2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su2.SPACE_UNIT, hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub_dept_stats WHERE sub_dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT = dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT ) ORDER BY icte.org_unit_id_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units_for_org, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT subq2.space_unit_name, subq2.organization_name, subq2.dlc_name, subq2.org_dlc_key, subq2.window_min_space_unit_code, subq2.total_space_units_for_org, subq1.avg_org_unit_id, subq1.org_unit_id_variance, subq1.Most_Common_HR_Department, subq1.Department_Unit_Count FROM subq2 JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON subq2.space_unit_name = su.SPACE_UNIT JOIN subq1 ON question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', and the total number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', but only include departments where the total number of reserved materials is greater than the average number of reserved materials per department for that term? List the results in order of decreasing coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) and, within that, by decreasing total number of reserved materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > ( SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte ) ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.coefficient_of_variation, subq2.reserved_materials FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.coefficient_of_variation DESC, subq2.reserved_materials DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID AND i.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each sponsor whose average maximum enrollment for their IAP activities is among the top 5 highest, provide the sponsor name, sponsor type, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, and for each department associated with that sponsor in 2021 (for IAP activities that were not cancelled), provide the department name and the highest maximum enrollment among those activities. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SponsorStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE ) SELECT icte.SPONSOR_NAME, icte.SPONSOR_TYPE, icte.avg_max_enrollment, icte.var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.avg_max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5 ), DeptMaxEnroll AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS math_iap_activities_2021 FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment, isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY ) SELECT ss.SPONSOR_NAME, ss.SPONSOR_TYPE, ss.avg_max_enrollment, ss.var_max_enrollment, dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.highest_max_enrollment FROM SponsorStats ss JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON ss.SPONSOR_NAME = s.SPONSOR_NAME AND ss.SPONSOR_TYPE = s.SPONSOR_TYPE JOIN DeptMaxEnroll dme ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = dme.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
sub_questions: For each sponsor, provide the sponsor name and calculate the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities.

For each department, what is the highest maximum enrollment among IAP activities in 2021 that were not cancelled and were associated with subjects offered by that department?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS math_iap_activities_2021 FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE ) SELECT icte.SPONSOR_NAME, icte.SPONSOR_TYPE, icte.avg_max_enrollment, icte.var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.avg_max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS math_iap_activities_2021 FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department where the average total units for subjects offered is greater than the overall average total units across all subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and for each course number description offered by that department where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, provide the department name, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, course number description, number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, and the total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description. Order the results by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), filtered_departments AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), dept_counts AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) SELECT fd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fd.avg_total_units, fd.stddev_total_units, ic2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, ic2.isbn_count, ic2.min_faculty_mit_id, dc.total_tip_detail_records FROM filtered_departments fd JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON fd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_counts dc ON ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dc.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ORDER BY fd.stddev_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units.

For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, give the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL and the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.

For each department, provide the department name, average, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), but only include departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units across all subjects.

For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, show the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, and the total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.isbn_count, inner_cte.min_faculty_mit_id, dept_counts.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dept_counts.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC;

question: For each academic year where the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students) is greater than the overall geometric mean across all years, list the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of enrolled students, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), and the number of unique departments represented among those subjects. Present the results ordered by geometric mean of enrolled students (descending), then by variance of tip detail records (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH geometric_mean_enrollment_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_enrollment > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ), record_count_variance_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, rcv.record_count_variance, rcv.unique_departments FROM geometric_mean_enrollment_cte gme JOIN record_count_variance_cte rcv ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, rcv.record_count_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year, considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students?

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record?

sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_enrollment > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ', show the academic year, subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, term description, the number of textbook materials per academic year, and the minimum term code for each academic year, along with the subject title, textbook ISBN, and the difference between the total units of the subject and the average total units for all subjects in the same term description (if available for subjects offered in academic year 2022 with a required textbook). Include subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding academic year field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all academic years (the corresponding academic year field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and minimum term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), avg_units AS ( SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT s1.academic_year, s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.material_count, s1.min_term_code, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.units_deviation FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.academic_year, s1.min_term_code

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department ordered by academic year, the subject title, the total units of the offered subject, the number of subject materials with status 'EO' offered in academic years after 2015 and with more than 5 total units for the department, the average total units for those subjects in the department, and classify the department as 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' if the count is at least 50% greater than the average count across all departments, 'LOW_ACTIVITY' if at least 50% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte1.TERM_CODE, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.window_column, t3.SUBJECT_TITLE, t3.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte1 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON inner_cte1.TERM_CODE = t3.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_counts AS ( SELECT AVG(eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte2 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units > a.avg_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units < a.avg_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN avg_counts a ON 1=1 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, a.avg_count ) SELECT s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, s2.avg_total_units, s2.activity_level FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the current academic term, which school within that department has the highest average total units, its average total units, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the average subject enrollment number as a benchmark, and the enrollment category (classified as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the minimum total units is at least 10% greater than the benchmark, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise)? Show the department name, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), school name with the highest average, its average total units, academic year, subject count, minimum total units, benchmark enrollment, and enrollment category, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, hs.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_with_highest_avg, hs.school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) hs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hs.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, hs.SCHOOL_NAME, hs.school_avg_total_units ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.school_with_highest_avg, dus.school_avg_total_units, des.ACADEMIC_YEAR, des.subject_count, des.min_total_units, des.benchmark_enrollment, des.enrollment_category FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC, des.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;
