question: For each department in the Engineering school that, in the current academic term, has a maximum subject enrollment number greater than 5, list the department name, subject ID, subject title, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the total number of subjects per department, the school name, the term start date, and the total maximum enrollment for that department and term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptMaxEnroll AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_START_DATE, SUM(max_enrollment) AS total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_START_DATE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment) > 0 ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EngSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SUBJECT_ID, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.window_column, e.Total_Subjects, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.TERM_START_DATE, d.total_max_enrollment FROM EngSubjects e JOIN DeptMaxEnroll d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SUBJECT_ID, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR
sub_questions: For each department in the current academic term, what is the maximum subject enrollment number and the term start date, considering only departments where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5?

For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, and the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID.

For each department and school in the current academic term, what is the maximum subject enrollment number and the term start date, considering only departments where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5? For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null department, school, null term start date, total max enrollment).

Show the department name, subject ID, subject title, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and the total number of subjects per department for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1.
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_START_DATE, SUM(max_enrollment) AS total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_START_DATE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment) > 0 ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department whose geometric mean of total units for subjects offered by that department (where total units is greater than zero) is greater than the overall geometric mean of total units for all subjects with total units greater than zero, list the department name, the geometric mean of total units, and for each academic year in which the department is among the top 5 departments with the highest total number of enrolled students in non-repeatable subjects, also display the academic year, the total number of enrolled students, and the subject with the highest enrollment in that department for that year along with its enrollment count, with the columns in the following order: department name, geometric mean of total units, academic year, total number of enrolled students, subject with highest enrollment, and its enrollment count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DepartmentGeometricMean AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_total_units > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(TOTAL_UNITS))) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' ), dept_year_totals AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), ranked_depts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, total_enrollment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC) AS dept_rank FROM dept_year_totals ), subject_enrollments AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS subj_rank FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT dgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgm.geometric_mean_total_units, rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rd.total_enrollment, se.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject, se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM DepartmentGeometricMean dgm JOIN ranked_depts rd ON dgm.DEPARTMENT_CODE = rd.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN subject_enrollments se ON rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = se.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rd.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = se.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND se.subj_rank = 1 WHERE rd.dept_rank <= 5 ORDER BY dgm.geometric_mean_total_units DESC, rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rd.total_enrollment DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero?
For each academic year, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered, considering only subjects that are not repeatable?

For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the geometric mean is greater than the overall geometric mean of total units for all subjects with total units greater than zero?

Among the top 5 departments with the highest total number of enrolled students in non-repeatable subjects for each academic year, display each department's name, the academic year, the total number of enrolled students, and the subject with the highest enrollment in that department for that year along with its enrollment count.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_total_units > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(TOTAL_UNITS))) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' ) , dept_year_totals AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) , ranked_depts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, total_enrollment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC) AS dept_rank FROM dept_year_totals ) , subject_enrollments AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS subj_rank FROM inner_cte ) SELECT rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rd.total_enrollment, se.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject, se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM ranked_depts rd LEFT JOIN subject_enrollments se ON rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = se.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = se.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND se.subj_rank = 1 WHERE rd.dept_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rd.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For each library reserve material detail where the material status key is 'U' and the term status is 'Previous', show the subject ID, the academic year, the deviation of the academic year from the average academic year for all such materials, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, and the total number of unique TIP material keys per academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'. The results should be ordered by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), avg_year AS ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS avg_academic_year FROM inner_cte1 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, (i.ACADEMIC_YEAR - a.avg_academic_year) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 i CROSS JOIN avg_year a ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), material_counts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.record_count_variance, inner_cte2.record_count_stddev, material_counts.total_materials FROM inner_cte2 JOIN material_counts ON inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = material_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.record_count_variance, s2.record_count_stddev, s2.total_materials FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For library reserve material details where the material status key is 'U', show the subject ID from the reserve material detail and the dense rank of the academic year from the academic terms, considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year, for terms where the term status is 'Previous'.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are both the variance and standard deviation of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'?

For each library reserve material detail where the material status key is 'U' and the term status is 'Previous', show the subject ID, the academic year, and the deviation of the academic year from the average academic year for all such materials.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are both the variance and standard deviation of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, as well as the total number of unique TIP material keys per academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'?
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), avg_year AS ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS avg_academic_year FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, (i.ACADEMIC_YEAR - a.avg_academic_year) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_year a;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, material_counts.total_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS material_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = material_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For all subject codes that are associated with departments that are degree-granting and belong to the School of Engineering, provide the subject code, subject code description, department name, the school name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), ordered by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.coefficient_of_variation FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subq2.coefficient_of_variation DESC
sub_questions: How many subject codes are associated with departments that are degree-granting and belong to the School of Engineering?

For each department, what is the department name and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student?
List the subject code, subject code description, and department name for all subject codes that are associated with departments that are degree-granting and belong to the School of Engineering.

For each department, what is the department name, the school name, and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering';

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering';

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each subject that is both offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA' and is in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID, the name of the responsible faculty member for each subject, the academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the term description, and the term start date, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS sum_lecture_units_by_grade_type, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS subject_rank_within_academic_year, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_ID;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1

question: For each department, list the department name, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the total number of subjects per department that have at least one associated course material, the subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, and the full department name, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with at least one associated course material. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq1.Total_Subjects, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.subject_code_count, subq2.min_dept_budget_code, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.Total_Subjects DESC, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one associated course material.
For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting, provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code.
For each department, list the department name, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of subjects per department that have at least one associated course material.
For each degree-granting department and subject code, provide the department name, subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, and the full department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects in the Engineering school during the Fall Term 2024-2025, show the subject title, department name, total units, the academic year description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for each subject's department, provide the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the average total units as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'HIGH_UNIT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the results with the columns: subject title, department name, total units, academic year description, window row number, department geometric mean, department average total units, and unit category, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ic.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte2.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte2.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte2.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.window_column, cte2.department_geometric_mean, cte2.department_avg_total_units, cte2.unit_category FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For subjects in the "Engineering" school during the Fall Term 2024-2025, show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and have total units greater than zero?

For subjects in the "Engineering" school during the Fall Term 2024-2025, show the subject title, department name, total units, and the academic year description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.

For each department, provide the department name, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the average total units as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'HIGH_UNIT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ic.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY department_geometric_mean DESC;

question: For each organization and each room with an area greater than 300 located in a building with more than 100 rooms, show the organization name, the highest number of space units it has ever had associated with it on a single warehouse load date, the building's long name, the room's full name, the room's area, the building's type, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building's long name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH OrgSpaceUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(space_unit_count) AS highest_space_unit_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ), LargeRooms AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ), OrgRoomCombined AS ( SELECT o. ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.highest_space_unit_count, r.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, r.ROOM_FULL_NAME, r.AREA, r.BUILDING_TYPE, r.window_column FROM OrgSpaceUnits o JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN LargeRooms r ON fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME = r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING WHERE BUILDING_NAME_LONG = r.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, highest_space_unit_count, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ROOM_FULL_NAME, AREA, BUILDING_TYPE, window_column FROM OrgRoomCombined ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ROOM_FULL_NAME;
sub_questions: List the top 10 organizations by the number of associated space units, showing the organization name and the count of space units for each.

For rooms with an area greater than 300 and located in buildings with more than 100 rooms, show the building's long name, the room's full name, the room's area, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building's long name.
For each organization, what is the highest number of space units it has ever had associated with it on a single warehouse load date? Show the organization name and the highest space unit count.

For rooms with an area greater than 300 and located in buildings with more than 100 rooms, show the building's long name, the room's full name, the room's area, and the building's type. Also, assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building's long name.
sub_sqls: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY space_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(space_unit_count) AS highest_space_unit_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the average total units as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'HIGH_UNIT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise; also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, and indicate whether the department is a 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% greater than the average variance across all departments), 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. List the department name, department geometric mean of total units, department average total units, unit category, material count range, material count variance, material count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and variance category in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY department_geometric_mean DESC ), dept_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.material_count_range, i.material_count_variance, i.material_count_stddev, CASE WHEN i.material_count_variance > s.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' WHEN i.material_count_variance < s.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(material_count_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) s ORDER BY i.material_count_range DESC ) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.department_geometric_mean, du.department_avg_total_units, du.unit_category, dm.material_count_range, dm.material_count_variance, dm.material_count_stddev, dm.variance_category FROM dept_units du JOIN dept_materials dm ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY du.department_geometric_mean DESC, dm.material_count_range DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY department_geometric_mean DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.material_count_range, i.material_count_variance, i.material_count_stddev, CASE WHEN i.material_count_variance > s.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' WHEN i.material_count_variance < s.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(material_count_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) s ORDER BY i.material_count_range DESC;

question: For each department that (1) has at least one course with at least one enrolled student and a material status of 'U', and (2) offered subjects in the term with code '2022SU' where the department's average total units for its subjects in that term is greater than the average total units for all subjects in that term, list the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the qualifying courses, the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students among those courses and that enrollment count, and the average total units for the department's subjects in the 2022SU term. Present the columns in this order: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, top subject title, top enrollment count, and average total units for 2022SU. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(t3.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.enrolled_range, s1.enrolled_variance, s1.top_subject_title, s1.top_enrollment, s2.avg_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.enrolled_range DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(t3.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' )

question: For each department that has at least one subject with associated course material, list the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, total number of such subjects per department, the subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, and the full department name, considering only degree-granting departments and subject codes. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq1.Total_Subjects, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.subject_code_count, subq2.min_dept_budget_code, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.Total_Subjects DESC, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE;

For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting, provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code.

sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year description, library material status, and TIP material status, what is the geometric mean of the record counts of TIP materials for each TIP material status (including a grand total geometric mean across all TIP material statuses with null for TIP material status, considering only records where the record count is greater than zero), and for each academic year description, what is the academic year, the maximum variance, and the minimum variance of record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM')? Present the results with the columns: academic year description, library material status, TIP material status, geometric mean record count, academic year, maximum record count variance, and minimum record count variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH geometric_mean_by_status AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_record_count))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_record_count))) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ), variance_by_year AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT gmbs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmbs.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, gmbs.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, gmbs.geometric_mean_record_count, vby.ACADEMIC_YEAR, vby.max_record_count_variance, vby.min_record_count_variance FROM geometric_mean_by_status gmbs LEFT JOIN variance_by_year vby ON gmbs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = vby.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmbs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmbs.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, gmbs.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the geometric mean of the record counts of TIP materials for each library material status, considering only records where the record count is greater than zero?

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are both the variance and standard deviation of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'?

Also, for each academic year and library material status, include a grand total geometric mean across all TIP material statuses (with null for TIP material status).

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are both the maximum and minimum of the variance of record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'?
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_record_count))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_record_count))) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 20, show the activity title, the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year of the associated term, the IAP term description, and for each such activity, show the previous academic term code, previous term description, previous academic year, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for previous terms, and the previous academic year description, for all previous academic terms that share the same term code as the IAP activity. Order the results by activity title and previous academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH iap_activities AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ), previous_terms AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ) SELECT iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap_activities.window_column AS IAP_DENSE_RANK, iap_activities.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, previous_terms.TERM_CODE AS PREV_TERM_CODE, previous_terms.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, previous_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, previous_terms.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, previous_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM iap_activities JOIN previous_terms ON iap_activities.TERM_CODE = previous_terms.TERM_CODE ORDER BY iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, previous_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5 and for which the average organization key within each organization key group is greater than the overall average organization key across all organizations, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group, the DLC key, the number of organizations in the group, the minimum organization number in the group, the most prominent major organization name in the group (i.e., the major organization name with the highest count of organizations), and that count. Order the results by space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), org_stats AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), org_group_stats AS ( SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number, mo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Prominent_Major_Org, mo.Major_Org_Count FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Major_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG ) mo ON ic.DLC_KEY = mo.DLC_KEY AND ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = mo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND mo.rn = 1 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, g.DLC_KEY, g.organization_count, g.min_organization_number, g.Most_Prominent_Major_Org, g.Major_Org_Count FROM org_stats o JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN org_group_stats g ON fo.DLC_KEY = g.DLC_KEY AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = g.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY;

SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION) ORDER BY SPACE_UNIT_KEY;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number, mo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Prominent_Major_Org, mo.Major_Org_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Major_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG ) mo ON ic.DLC_KEY = mo.DLC_KEY AND ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = mo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND mo.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.organization_count DESC;

question: For each academic year and offering department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in library subjects offered during IAP, and for the same department, what is the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, as well as the enrollment category (HIGH_ENROLLMENT, LOW_ENROLLMENT, or AVERAGE) for the department based on its average enrollment compared to the overall average? Also, for each academic year, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (academic year, null, total statistics). The columns returned are: academic year, offering department name, IAP average enrollment, IAP enrollment variance, IAP enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), TIP average enrollment, TIP enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH iap_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), tip_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT iap_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, iap_stats.avg_enrollment AS iap_avg_enrollment, iap_stats.enrollment_variance AS iap_enrollment_variance, iap_stats.enrollment_stddev AS iap_enrollment_stddev, tip_stats.avg_enrollment AS tip_avg_enrollment, tip_stats.enrollment_stddev AS tip_enrollment_stddev, tip_stats.enrollment_category FROM iap_stats LEFT JOIN tip_stats ON iap_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tip_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY iap_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;
