WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each academic year and each academic term within that year, show the academic year description, the number of terms, the average number of terms across all academic years as a benchmark, the classification of the academic year as 'HIGH_TERM_YEAR', 'LOW_TERM_YEAR', or 'AVERAGE', the term description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment values for IAP subject activities in that term. Only consider terms where the term status indicator in ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL is 'P' and the term status in ACADEMIC_TERMS is not 'Future', and only include terms where at least one IAP subject activity has a non-null maximum enrollment and the activity is not cancelled. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH YearTermStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(at.TERM_CODE) AS term_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(term_count) AS avg_term_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.term_count, b.avg_term_count, CASE WHEN i.term_count > b.avg_term_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_TERM_YEAR' WHEN i.term_count < b.avg_term_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_TERM_YEAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS term_year_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ), TermEnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.max_enrollment_range, inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance, inner_cte.max_enrollment_stddev, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yts.term_count, yts.avg_term_count, yts.term_year_category, tes.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tes.max_enrollment_range, tes.max_enrollment_variance, tes.max_enrollment_stddev FROM YearTermStats yts JOIN TermEnrollmentStats tes ON yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = tes.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY yts.term_count DESC, tes.max_enrollment_range DESC;
sub_questions: List the top 10 academic years by the number of terms, showing the academic year description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL and the count of terms from ACADEMIC_TERMS, considering only terms where the term status indicator in ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL is 'P' and the term status in ACADEMIC_TERMS is not 'Future'.

For each academic term, provide the term description and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the maximum enrollment values for IAP subject activities in that term, considering only terms where at least one activity has a non-null maximum enrollment and the term is not cancelled.

For each academic year, show the academic year description, the number of terms, the average number of terms across all academic years as a benchmark, and classify the academic year as 'HIGH_TERM_YEAR' if it has at least 10% more terms than average, 'LOW_TERM_YEAR' if it has at least 10% fewer terms than average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only consider terms where the term status indicator in ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL is 'P' and the term status in ACADEMIC_TERMS is not 'Future'.

For each academic term, provide the term description, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the maximum enrollment values for IAP subject activities in that term, as well as the academic year description, considering only terms where at least one activity has a non-null maximum enrollment and the term is not cancelled.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(at.TERM_CODE) AS term_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY term_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(at.TERM_CODE) AS term_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(term_count) AS avg_term_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.term_count, b.avg_term_count, CASE WHEN i.term_count > b.avg_term_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_TERM_YEAR' WHEN i.term_count < b.avg_term_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_TERM_YEAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS term_year_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ORDER BY i.term_count DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.max_enrollment_range, inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance, inner_cte.max_enrollment_stddev, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY inner_cte.max_enrollment_range DESC;

question: List, for each department, either (a) the department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, and the highest minimum total units (in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year) for subjects offered in the academic year 2024, or (b) the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and total number of subjects per department that have at least one associated course material. For each row, include a reason for inclusion: 'HighestMinTotalUnits2024' for the first case and 'SubjectsWithMaterials' for the second case. The columns should be shown in the following order: department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, highest minimum total units, number of enrolled students, total number of subjects, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, highest_min_total_units, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TOTAL_SUBJECTS, 'HighestMinTotalUnits2024' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 UNION ALL SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS highest_min_total_units, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, Total_Subjects, 'SubjectsWithMaterials' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 ) SELECT DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, highest_min_total_units, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TOTAL_SUBJECTS, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered by the Mathematics department in the academic year 2024, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, and the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year.
For each department, give the department name and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one associated course material.

For each department, show the department name and the highest minimum total units (in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year) for subjects offered in the academic year 2024, along with the corresponding subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, and term description.
For each department, list the department name, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of subjects per department that have at least one associated course material.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: List, for all organizations that either have a geometric mean of room areas (considering only rooms with area greater than zero) greater than the overall average geometric mean across all departments, or are among the top 10 organizations with the highest variance in room area (considering only rooms with non-null area and department code), the following columns: organization name, department code, geometric mean of room areas, variance of room areas, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of room areas, organization description, and the reason for inclusion ('HighGeometricMean' for high geometric mean and 'TopVariance' for top variance), with the columns listed in this order: organization name, department code, geometric mean of room areas, variance of room areas, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of room areas, organization description, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH GeometricMeanDepts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte ) a ON i.geometric_mean_area > a.avg_geom_mean ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_area DESC ), TopVarianceOrgs AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL AND r.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DEPT_CODE, icte.area_variance, icte.area_stddev, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.area_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS DEPT_CODE, gmd.geometric_mean_area, NULL AS area_variance, NULL AS area_stddev, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, 'HighGeometricMean' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDepts gmd UNION ALL SELECT tvo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, tvo.DEPT_CODE, NULL AS geometric_mean_area, tvo.area_variance, tvo.area_stddev, tvo.ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, 'TopVariance' AS Reason FROM TopVarianceOrgs tvo ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_CODE, geometric_mean_area, area_variance, area_stddev, ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the areas of rooms assigned to that department, considering only rooms with area greater than zero?

For each organization, what is the variance and standard deviation of the area of rooms assigned to that organization? Please provide the organization name, the department code, and both the variance and standard deviation of room areas, considering only rooms with a non-null area and department code.

For each department, list the department name and the geometric mean of the areas of rooms assigned to that department, but only include departments where the geometric mean of room areas is greater than the overall average geometric mean across all departments (considering only rooms with area greater than zero).

Among the top 10 organizations with the highest variance in room area (considering only rooms with non-null area and department code), list each organization's name, department code, the variance and standard deviation of room areas, and the description of the organization.
sub_sqls: SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_area DESC;

SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL AND r.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte ) a ON i.geometric_mean_area > a.avg_geom_mean ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_area DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL AND r.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DEPT_CODE, icte.area_variance, icte.area_stddev, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.area_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each of the top 10 subjects by the number of reserved library materials offered in the term '2009SP', list the subject title, the offering department name, the count of reserved library materials, and the total number of enrolled students for that subject, along with (if available) the department's total count of 12-unit subjects offered in Fall Term 2024-2025, the school name, the subject with the highest enrollment in that department in Fall Term 2024-2025 (show its subject ID and title), and the enrollment number for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC, SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY Subject_Count DESC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.reserved_materials, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.Subject_Count, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.Top_Subject_ID, s2.Top_Subject_Title, s2.Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials, including the subject title, the offering department name, and the count of reserved materials, for subjects offered in the term '2009SP'.

For subjects in the Fall Term 2024-2025 with a total of 12 units, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, school name, total units, term description, term start date, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject ID.

For each subject offered in the term '2009SP', list the subject title, the offering department name, the count of reserved library materials, and the total number of enrolled students for that subject. Show only the top 10 subjects by the number of reserved materials.

Among the top 5 departments with the highest number of 12-unit subjects offered in the Fall Term 2024-2025, list each department's name, the total count of such subjects, the school name, the subject with the highest enrollment in that department (show its subject ID and title), and the enrollment number for that subject.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC, SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY Subject_Count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA' that also have at least one activity with an enrollment type of "Advance sign-up required" and a maximum enrollment of 12 (where the number of enrolled students is at least 10), show the subject ID, department name, subject term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, subject title, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the activity title, activity term code, activity maximum enrollment, activity term description, activity term start date, number of enrolled students in the activity, the offer department name for the activity, the responsible faculty name for the activity, and the row number of the activity within each subject title group, ordered by subject ID and activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS SUBJECT_RUNNING_SUM_TOTAL_UNITS, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each department where the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department is greater than the overall geometric mean of total units for all subjects with total units greater than zero, and for each library reserve material detail with material status key equal to 'U' and offer department name matching the department name, show the department name, the geometric mean of total units, the library course instructor key, the library reserve catalog key, the term code, the subject ID, the tip material key, the tip material status key, the tip ISBN, the subject title, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, and the offer department name, ordered by the geometric mean of total units descending and then by library course instructor key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE geometric_mean_total_units > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(TOTAL_UNITS))) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte2.ISBN, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.window_column, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON inner_cte2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.geometric_mean_total_units, cte2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, cte2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, cte2.TERM_CODE, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, cte2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cte2.ISBN, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.window_column, cte2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.geometric_mean_total_units DESC, cte2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY;

SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER ( ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: For each subject in the 2019FA term with total units greater than 1 and for each category, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each school, the academic year description, the category name, and the highest maximum enrollment among its activities, ordered by subject ID and category name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON ic.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS running_sum_total_units_within_school, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s2.highest_max_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 s2 ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON ic.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering in 2022 that also had subjects offered in 2019FA where the department's total enrolled students in 2019FA was greater than the average per-department enrollment for that term, list the department name, the highest total subject enrollment in any academic term for that department in 2022, the maximum number of subjects offered by that department in 2022, and for each such subject in 2019FA, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, and the department full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH eng_dept_2022 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrollment) AS highest_term_enrollment, MAX(subject_count) AS max_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_2019fa_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_totals AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_totals d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d.total_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM dept_totals ) ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.highest_term_enrollment, e.max_subjects_offered, d.SUBJECT_ID, d.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM eng_dept_2022 e JOIN dept_2019fa_enrollment d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department ordered by academic year, the subject title, and the total units of the offered subject, but only for departments that are degree-granting and have an average number of enrolled students in offered subjects (with more than 0 enrolled students) greater than the overall average enrollment across all such subjects. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.SUBJECT_TITLE, t3.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ) SELECT s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_variance, s2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year and for each department, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), the department name, the total number of such library subjects offered per department in that year, and for each HGN code in that department, what is the HGN code, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table, for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units, and only include those records where the maximum number of lecture units for that HGN code and department exceeds the average lecture units for that HGN code and department in 2012? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH academic_year_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), hgn_max_lecture AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ), avg_lecture AS ( SELECT HGN_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY HGN_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.HGN_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_lecture_units, i.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_lecture a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.max_lecture_units > a.avg_lecture_units ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.enrolled_students_variance, ays.department_name, ays.total_library_subjects_offered, hml.HGN_CODE, hml.max_lecture_units, hml.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM academic_year_stats ays JOIN hgn_max_lecture hml ON ays.department_name = hml.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.department_name, hml.HGN_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ), avg_lecture AS ( SELECT HGN_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY HGN_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.HGN_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_lecture_units, i.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_lecture a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.max_lecture_units > a.avg_lecture_units;

question: For each school and department where the department offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022 and the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects in that term is greater than 3, list the school name, department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects in Fall 2022, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term. For each school, also include a grand total row with the school name, null for department name, the total range and variance for all departments, and nulls for the remaining columns. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolDepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM inner_cte1 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(units_range) AS units_range, VARIANCE(units_range) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ), DepartmentFallSubjects AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.max_lecture_units, inner_cte2.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.max_lecture_units, inner_cte2.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.units_range, s.units_variance, d.max_lecture_units, d.TERM_START_DATE, d.num_subjects_offered FROM SchoolDepartmentUnitsStats s JOIN DepartmentFallSubjects d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year where the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for previous terms is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, and for each subject in the term "2010FA" that is a regular term, show the previous term code, previous term description, previous academic year, the running sum of academic years for previous terms, the financial aid year, the subject ID, the subject's term description, the material status key, the subject's academic year, and the rank of the subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', show the term code from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, ordered by academic year.

For each subject in the term "2010FA", show the subject ID, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID.

For academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', show the term code from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, but only include those financial aid year groups where the running sum is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms.

For each subject in the term "2010FA", show the subject ID, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID, but only include subjects where the term is a regular term according to ACADEMIC_TERMS.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'

question: For each department, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, the total number of subjects offered by each department in that term, the minimum number of lecture units, and the total number of units for all subjects offered by that department in the Fall term of the academic year 2022. Present the results ordered by the range of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_subject_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects ), dept_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d1.enrolled_stddev, d1.total_subjects, d2.min_lecture_units, d2.total_units FROM dept_enrollment_stats d1 JOIN dept_units_stats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.enrolled_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA.
What is the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022?

For each department, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, along with the total number of subjects offered by each department in that term.
For each department, what is the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_subject_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year and subject category where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, the subject category key, the number of unique subjects, the minimum academic term start date, and the total number of TIP materials per subject category and academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, tip_counts.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS tip_counts ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = tip_counts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.unique_departments, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s2.subject_count, s2.min_term_start_date, s2.total_tip_materials FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY;

For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, give the number of unique subjects and the minimum academic term start date.

For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the number of unique subjects, the minimum academic term start date, and the total number of TIP materials per subject category and academic year.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, tip_counts.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS tip_counts ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = tip_counts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', and for students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department whose last name is alphabetically after the average last name (in terms of ASCII value) within their course level group, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, the school name, department phone number, the student's full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and the student's row number within their course level group ordered by last name. Order the results by subject code, course level, and student row number within course level. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t2.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), avg_lastname_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(ASCII(SUBSTR(LAST_NAME, 1, 1))) AS avg_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT i.FULL_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY i.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_lastname_cte a ON i.COURSE_LEVEL = a.COURSE_LEVEL WHERE ASCII(SUBSTR(i.LAST_NAME, 1, 1)) > a.avg_ascii ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.window_column AS MIN_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS_OVER_SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.COURSE_LEVEL, s2.window_column AS STUDENT_ROW_NUMBER_WITHIN_COURSE_LEVEL FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.COURSE_LEVEL, s2.window_column;

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'

SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t2.LAST_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), avg_lastname_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(ASCII(SUBSTR(LAST_NAME, 1, 1))) AS avg_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT i.FULL_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY i.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_lastname_cte a ON i.COURSE_LEVEL = a.COURSE_LEVEL WHERE ASCII(SUBSTR(i.LAST_NAME, 1, 1)) > a.avg_ascii

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, school name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the same department and school in the current academic term. List the subject title, offer department name, department full name, school name, number of enrolled students, windowed average number of enrolled students, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, ordered by the subject title.
For each school, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in the current academic term? Show the school name along with these statistics.

For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, school name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, ordered by the subject title.

For each department in the current academic term, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered? Show the department name, school name, and these statistics.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0

SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the number of subject codes per school name, and whether the subject code description is present ('Has Description') or missing ('No Description'), as well as, for subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more enrolled students than the average for that term, the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID. For each school name, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (null, null, null, school name, null, total subject codes, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, l.COURSE_NUMBER, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ), FilteredSubjects AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) ) SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE, fs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, fs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, fs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, fs.window_column FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status LEFT JOIN FilteredSubjects fs ON scv.SUBJECT_CODE = fs.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE
