Order the results by subject code.

For each building, list its key, the floor key, and the coefficient of variation of the area of rooms located on that floor, considering only floors where the average room area is greater than zero. For each building, include a grand total for all floors in the format of (building key, null, total coefficient of variation).
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6

SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0 ) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting and the department's budget code is greater than the average budget code of all Engineering school departments, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the course description, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code, course description, dense rank), but only for departments meeting the budget code condition. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code, ic2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic2.window_column FROM RollupResults rr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rr.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.window_column
sub_questions: For each department name and school name, where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions.

For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code.

For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code).

For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, but only include courses where the department's budget code is greater than the average budget code of all Engineering school departments.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL )

question: For each material status key, provide the material status key, the average and variance of the record counter for reserve catalog items associated with that status (considering only records where the catalog year is greater than 2000), and classify the status as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all statuses, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. For each subject in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student and whose TIP material status key matches the material status key, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, and whether the total units are 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for that department), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Present the results with the columns in the following order: material status key, average record counter, record counter variance, variance category, subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total units, window minimum total units, and unit load category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ), avg_var AS ( SELECT AVG(record_counter_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ), material_status_stats AS ( SELECT i.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.avg_record_counter, i.record_counter_variance, CASE WHEN i.record_counter_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.record_counter_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_var a ORDER BY i.record_counter_variance DESC ), subject_inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), subject_stats AS ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category, icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM subject_inner_cte icte JOIN dept_avg da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.avg_record_counter, ms.record_counter_variance, ms.variance_category, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ss.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.window_column, ss.unit_load_category FROM material_status_stats ms JOIN subject_stats ss ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ss.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For each material status, give the material status key and calculate the average and variance of the record counter for reserve catalog items associated with that status, considering only records where the catalog year is greater than 2000.

For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number.

For each material status, provide the material status key, the average and variance of the record counter for reserve catalog items associated with that status (considering only records where the catalog year is greater than 2000), and classify the status as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all statuses, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise.

For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, and whether the total units are 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for that department), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY record_counter_variance DESC;

SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) , avg_var AS ( SELECT AVG(record_counter_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.avg_record_counter, i.record_counter_variance, CASE WHEN i.record_counter_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.record_counter_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_var a ORDER BY i.record_counter_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_avg da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE;

question: For each subject category and academic year where the maximum enrollment is at least 10, provide the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the average number of lecture units as a benchmark, and indicate whether the minimum total units is at least 10% greater than the average lecture units ('HIGH_UNIT'), at least 10% less ('LOW_UNIT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT'. Also, for each academic year, include the number of regular academic terms that are also present in the ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL table (with null for the grand total), and present all these columns in the following order: subject category key, academic year, subject count, minimum total units, benchmark lecture units, unit category, and total regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subject_category_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, s.avg_lecture_units AS benchmark_lecture_units, CASE WHEN ic.min_total_units > s.avg_lecture_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.min_total_units < s.avg_lecture_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) s ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), regular_term_counts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_total_units, scs.benchmark_lecture_units, scs.unit_category, rtc.total_terms FROM subject_category_stats scs LEFT JOIN regular_term_counts rtc ON scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rtc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each subject category and academic year where the maximum enrollment is at least 10, provide the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects.
What is the minimum academic year and the total number of terms for all regular academic terms that are also present in the ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL table?

For each subject category and academic year where the maximum enrollment is at least 10, provide the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the average number of lecture units as a benchmark. Also, indicate whether the minimum total units is at least 10% greater than the average lecture units ('HIGH_UNIT'), at least 10% less ('LOW_UNIT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT'.
For each academic year, list the number of regular academic terms that are also present in the ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL table, and include a grand total for all years in the format of (null, total terms).
sub_sqls: SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y';

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, s.avg_lecture_units AS benchmark_lecture_units, CASE WHEN ic.min_total_units > s.avg_lecture_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.min_total_units < s.avg_lecture_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) s ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, and for departments that in 2022 offered at least 5 degree granting subjects, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, number of courses where the design units are at least 3, the number of subjects offered, the average, range, and variance of the total units for those subjects, and calculate the course-to-subject ratio (number of unique courses divided by number of subjects), ordered by the course-to-subject ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY subject_count DESC, total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, s2.subject_count, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, ROUND(s1.course_count / NULLIF(s2.subject_count, 0), 2) AS course_to_subject_ratio FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY course_to_subject_ratio DESC;
sub_questions: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units offered.
For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting.

For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum total units offered, and the number of courses where the design units are at least 3.

For each department, among subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, provide the department name, the number of subjects offered, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for those subjects, but only include departments that offered at least 5 such subjects.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY subject_count DESC, total_units_range DESC;

question: For the top 10 subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with the highest number of enrolled students (according to the library subject data), display each subject's title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name and offer department name from the TIP subject, the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, and the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students ever recorded for that department in any term (considering only courses with at least 5 different materials assigned in that term). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.join_OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptStddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.window_column, ds.highest_enrolled_stddev FROM TopSubjects ts LEFT JOIN DeptStddev ds ON ts.join_OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA', show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID.

For each department, what is the name of the department and the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned, considering only courses offered in the term '2013FA'?

From the top 10 subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with the highest number of enrolled students (according to the library subject data), display each subject's title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name and offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID.

For each department, what is the name of the department and the highest standard deviation of the number of enrolled students it has ever had in any term, considering only courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned in that term?
sub_sqls: SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' that are not repeatable, show the subject title, the offer department name, the total units, the department name from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, the academic year, the average number of enrolled students, the variance, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students for each subject and department, ordered by variance descending and then subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_variance, s2.enrollment_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2.enrollment_variance DESC, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title from SUBJECT_OFFERED, the offer department name, the total units from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.
For each academic year, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered, considering only subjects that are not repeatable?

For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title from SUBJECT_OFFERED, the offer department name, the total units from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, and the department name from SUBJECT_SUMMARY. Assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title.

For each academic year, among subjects that are not repeatable, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by each department? List the academic year, department name, average enrollment, variance, and standard deviation, ordered by variance descending.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA' in departments that offer more than 5 subjects in that term, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, and the total number of subjects per department for that term. Additionally, for each subject offered by the same department in the term '2017JA', show the number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that subject code), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that subject code), or 'AVERAGE'. Present the results ordered by subject ID and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS SUBJECT_COUNT FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), subject_code_avg AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic1.SUBJECT_ID, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.window_column, dc.SUBJECT_COUNT, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, CASE WHEN ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > sca.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < sca.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte1 ic1 JOIN DeptCounts dc ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN subject_code_avg sca ON ic2.SUBJECT_CODE = sca.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY ic1.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID.

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by subject code.

For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID, and also include the total number of subjects per department for that term. Only include departments that offer more than 5 subjects in that term.

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that subject code), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that subject code), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS SUBJECT_COUNT FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, dc.SUBJECT_COUNT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptCounts dc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), subject_code_avg AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN subject_code_avg a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year, academic year description, department name, subject ID, total units, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, deviation of the subject's total units from the department's average in that year, course level, number of unique degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6, minimum total units offered, and number of courses with design units at least 3, provide these values for each subject offered in regular terms, joining with department-level course statistics for degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC ) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.deviation_from_avg, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.deviation_from_avg DESC;
sub_questions: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units offered.
For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms.

For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum total units offered, and the number of courses where the design units are at least 3.

For each academic year and department, give the academic year description, department name, the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and show the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average in that year.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that year, the average total units of those subjects for that year, and the maximum number of total units offered for any subject in that department and year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte ic ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.coefficient_of_variation, subq1.avg_total_units, subq2.max_total_units FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects.
For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered.
For each academic year, provide the academic year, the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, and the average total units of those subjects.
For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, what is the maximum number of total units offered for any subject in that department and year?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte ic ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the total number of enrolled students, the department name, the subject code, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero. Additionally, for each subject title, include a grand total of enrolled students across all terms in the format of (subject title, null, null, null, total enrolled students, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rr.TOTAL_UNITS, rr.total_enrolled_students, gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.SUBJECT_ID, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON rr.SUBJECT_TITLE = sos.SUBJECT_TITLE AND rr.TOTAL_UNITS = sos.TOTAL_UNITS LEFT JOIN GeometricMeanUnits gmu ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = gmu.SUBJECT_ID AND rr.SUBJECT_TITLE = gmu.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units DESC

sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rr.TOTAL_UNITS, rr.total_enrolled_students FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each department and each subject offered in the academic year 2024, show the department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, and the highest minimum total units (in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year) for that subject, along with the course description, subject code description, and the difference between the number of characters in the course description and the average number of characters in course descriptions for that department, for courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.COURSE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LENGTH(COURSE_DESCRIPTION)) AS avg_desc_length FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (LENGTH(i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) - d.avg_desc_length) AS desc_length_deviation, i.COURSE FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.TERM_CODE, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.highest_min_total_units, cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte2.desc_length_deviation FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cte1.SUBJECT_CODE = cte2.COURSE ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_NUMBER;
sub_questions: For subjects offered by the Mathematics department in the academic year 2024, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, and the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year.

For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description.

For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the difference between the number of characters in the course description and the average number of characters in course descriptions for that department.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024

SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LENGTH(COURSE_DESCRIPTION)) AS avg_desc_length FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (LENGTH(i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) - d.avg_desc_length) AS desc_length_deviation FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, for each subject title that has at least one associated course material, provide the department name, the subject title, the number of enrolled students in that subject, the total number of such subjects per department with at least one associated course material, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and the total number of such subjects per department. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ), dept_totals AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_subject_materials AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte2 JOIN dept_totals ON inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT dsm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsm.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsm.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dsm.Total_Subjects, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, des.num_subjects FROM dept_subject_materials dsm JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON dsm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dsm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsm.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in the year 2017?
For each department, give the department name and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one associated course material.

For each department, in the year 2017, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, and also provide the total number of such subjects per department?
For each department, list the department name, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of subjects per department that have at least one associated course material.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department and academic year, show the department name, academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the department's courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U', as well as the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students among those courses and that enrollment count. List the results ordered by department name and academic year descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH geometric_mean_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled ) SELECT gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, es.top_subject_title, es.top_enrollment FROM geometric_mean_units gmu LEFT JOIN enrollment_stats es ON gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and have total units greater than zero?
For each subject title, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U'?

Show the department names, academic year, academic year description, and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by each department in regular terms with total units greater than zero.
