sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department name and school name, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students (where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3), and classify the department as 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' if the number of offered subjects is at least 20% greater than the average across all departments, 'LOW_ACTIVITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' where the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than the average for all library subjects in '2014FA', also show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID. Only include results where the department name matches the offer department name from the TIP subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(offered_subject_count) AS avg_offered_subjects FROM inner_cte1 ), DepartmentActivity AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.offered_subject_count, i.min_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN i.offered_subject_count > d.avg_offered_subjects * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.offered_subject_count < d.avg_offered_subjects * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte1 i CROSS JOIN dept_avg d ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.SCHOOL_NAME, da.offered_subject_count, da.min_enrolled_students, da.activity_level, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic2.window_column FROM DepartmentActivity da JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON da.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.join_OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' )

SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(offered_subject_count) AS avg_offered_subjects FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.offered_subject_count, i.min_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN i.offered_subject_count > d.avg_offered_subjects * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.offered_subject_count < d.avg_offered_subjects * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN dept_avg d;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' );

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units for those subjects, the average number of enrolled students for those subjects, and for each such department also show the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022, including a grand total row for all departments in the format of (null, min_lecture_units, total_units). The columns should be: offering department name, offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, average number of enrolled students, department name (from Fall 2022), minimum lecture units (Fall 2022), and total units (Fall 2022). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), RQ_DeptSchool AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), FallDeptSummary AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_lecture_units, total_units FROM inner_cte2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL, MIN(min_lecture_units), SUM(total_units) FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT rds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rds.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, rds.subject_count, rds.min_total_units, rds.avg_num_enrolled_students, fds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fds.min_lecture_units, fds.total_units FROM RQ_DeptSchool rds LEFT JOIN FallDeptSummary fds ON rds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = fds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY rds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rds.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, fds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_lecture_units, total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL, MIN(min_lecture_units), SUM(total_units) FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, and for each academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, provide the department name, course level, number of unique students, minimum CIP program code among their courses, school name, department's full name, academic year, number of unique subjects offered, minimum number of total units for those subjects, and average number of enrolled students per subject. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department, course level, and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), DepartmentCourseLevelStats AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, dept AS join_department FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE COURSE_LEVEL END AS course_level_sort, COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level, SUM(student_count) AS student_count, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DepartmentYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units ) SELECT dcls.department, dcls.course_level, dcls.student_count, dcls.min_cip_code, dcls.school_name, dcls.department_full_name, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units, dys.avg_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentCourseLevelStats dcls JOIN DepartmentYearSubjectStats dys ON dcls.join_department = dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcls.department, dcls.course_level, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR

sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE COURSE_LEVEL END AS course_level_sort, COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level, SUM(student_count) AS student_count, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units;

question: For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, and considering only rooms on floor 2, provide the organization name, the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms associated with that space unit, the total number of such rooms per space unit, the number of distinct space units, the minimum organization number, and the total number of organizations that share the same DLC key as the space unit, ordered by the variance of access levels in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.access_level_variance, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, RoomCounts.total_rooms, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT = RoomCounts.SPACE_UNIT ), OrgSpaceUnitStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.space_unit_count, ic.min_org_number, d.org_count, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) d ON ic.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ) SELECT oss.ORGANIZATION, srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.access_level_variance, srs.access_level_stddev, srs.total_rooms, oss.space_unit_count, oss.min_org_number, oss.org_count FROM OrgSpaceUnitStats oss JOIN SpaceUnitRoomStats srs ON oss.SPACE_UNIT = srs.SPACE_UNIT AND oss.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = srs.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY srs.access_level_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each space unit, what is the name of the space unit, and what are both the variance and standard deviation of the access levels of rooms associated with that space unit, considering only rooms on floor 2?

For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, provide the number of distinct space units and the minimum organization number.

For each space unit, what is the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation of the access levels of rooms associated with that space unit (considering only rooms on floor 2), and the total number of such rooms per space unit?

For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, provide the number of distinct space units, the minimum organization number, and the total number of organizations that share the same DLC key as the space unit.
sub_sqls: SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC;

SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.access_level_variance, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, RoomCounts.total_rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT = RoomCounts.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY inner_cte.access_level_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, su.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.space_unit_count, ic.min_org_number, d.org_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) d ON ic.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering and for each academic year, what is the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject in that department, the total number of material records for subjects in that department with a status of 'RQ', the academic year, the academic year description, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that department and year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0)? Also, provide a grand total for the entire School of Engineering in the format (null, min_enrolled, total_material_records, academic_year, academic_year_desc, enrolled_students_variance, enrolled_students_stddev). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptMaterialStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ), YearDeptEnrolledStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dms.min_enrolled, dms.total_material_records, ydes.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ydes.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ydes.enrolled_students_variance, ydes.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptMaterialStats dms LEFT JOIN YearDeptEnrolledStats ydes ON dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ydes.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ydes.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: What is the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject and the total number of material records for subjects offered by the School of Engineering, considering only those materials with a status of 'RQ'?

For each academic year, give the academic year description and provide both the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0.

For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject and the total number of material records for subjects in that department, considering only those materials with a status of 'RQ'? Also, provide a grand total for the entire School of Engineering in the format (null, min_enrolled, total_material_records).

For each academic year and department, provide the academic year description, department name, and both the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that department and year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0.
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ';

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department that offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022 and has at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students that is degree granting, show the department code, department name, school name, the variance of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, the subject ID, the total units for each subject, the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects in Fall 2022, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term, considering only departments where the highest number of lecture units is greater than 3. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, (sos.TOTAL_UNITS - AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.total_units_variance, subq1.SUBJECT_ID, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.deviation_from_dept_avg, subq2.max_lecture_units, subq2.TERM_START_DATE, subq2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting?

For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, what is the department name, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, and the start date of the term, considering only subjects with more than 3 lecture units?

For each department, what is the department name, the school name, the variance of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting?

For each department that offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022, what is the department name, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term, considering only departments where the highest number of lecture units is greater than 3?
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, (sos.TOTAL_UNITS - AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_ID;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE;

question: Show, for each combination of offering department and person role, the offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, the total number of subjects offered per department, the person role name, the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for the activities led by that role (considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a specified maximum enrollment), and the total number of such activities for each role. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT i.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.PERSON_ROLE, s2.avg_max_enrollment, s2.max_enrollment_range, s2.max_enrollment_variance, s2.total_activities FROM subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 s2;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with the parameter 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM', show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year.

For each person role, give the person role name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for the activities they lead, considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a specified maximum enrollment.

Show the offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, and the total number of subjects offered per department for subjects offered in the term with the parameter 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM'.

For each person role, provide the person role name, the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for the activities they lead (considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a specified maximum enrollment), and also include the total number of such activities for each role.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM'

SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT i.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC;

question: For each offering department in the 'Engineering' school where the average total units of its courses is greater than the average total units of all 'Engineering' school courses, what is the department name, the average total units of its courses, the subject code, the subject title, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero? List the results ordered by department name and then by geometric mean of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH engineering_dept_avg_units AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) dept_courses GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) all_courses ) ), dept_subjects_geom_mean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT edau.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, edau.avg_total_units, dsgm.SUBJECT_ID, dsgm.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsgm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM engineering_dept_avg_units edau JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON edau.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_subjects_geom_mean dsgm ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY edau.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsgm.geometric_mean_total_units DESC

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each academic year where the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students) is greater than the overall geometric mean across all years, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of enrolled students, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), and the number of unique departments represented among those subjects? List the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean enrollment, record count variance, and unique departments in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH geometric_mean_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_enrollment > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ), record_variance_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT g.ACADEMIC_YEAR, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_enrollment, r.record_count_variance, r.unique_departments FROM geometric_mean_cte g JOIN record_variance_cte r ON g.ACADEMIC_YEAR = r.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY g.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that has a total student enrollment greater than 50 and an average enrollment per course of at least 20, and for each subject offered by that department in the current term, show the offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, the total number of subjects offered per department, the department name, and the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_cte ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avg_cte.avg_enrollment >= 20 ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.total_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_cte ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avg_cte.avg_enrollment >= 20;

question: For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, the total number of course materials per department and school, and for each course in that department offered in the year 2022 with at least one required or optional textbook and total units greater than the average for such courses, show the course's subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, the term description, the textbook material key, the textbook material status key, and the row number within the department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ), subq2 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte2 WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ) ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_isbn, s1.total_materials, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column;
sub_questions: For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs and the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials.

For each course that is offered in the year 2022 and has at least one required or optional textbook, show the course's subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, the term description, the textbook material key, the textbook material status key, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code.

For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, and the total number of course materials per department and school.

For each course that is offered in the year 2022 and has at least one required or optional textbook, show the course's subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, the term description, the textbook material key, the textbook material status key, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code, but only include courses where the total number of units is greater than the average total units of all courses offered in 2022 with required or optional textbooks.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO')

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ) ;

question: For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the subject category key, academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, the total number of unique subjects offered in that year, the number of unique subjects in the subject category, the minimum academic term start date, and the total number of TIP materials per subject category and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH academic_year_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count ), subject_category_year_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, tip_counts.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS tip_counts ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = tip_counts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT sys.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, sys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.geometric_mean_record_count, ays.num_unique_subjects, sys.subject_count, sys.min_term_start_date, sys.total_tip_materials FROM subject_category_year_stats sys JOIN academic_year_stats ays ON sys.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY sys.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, sys.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year?
For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, give the number of unique subjects and the minimum academic term start date.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the total number of unique subjects offered in that year?

For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the number of unique subjects, the minimum academic term start date, and the total number of TIP materials per subject category and academic year.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, tip_counts.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS tip_counts ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = tip_counts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, and for each academic year and subject in that department, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, number of courses where the design units are at least 3, academic year, academic year description, subject ID, total units for the subject, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms in that department and year, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units offered.
For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms.

For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum total units offered, and the number of courses where the design units are at least 3.

For each academic year and department, give the academic year description, department name, the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and show the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average in that year.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each subject in the Engineering school with total units equal to 1, what are the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the term description, the term start date, and, for each subject, the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL and the total new shelf price from TIP_MATERIAL for materials with a non-null author and a material info source of 'ISBN'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE tm.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_record_count, total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s1.min_record_count, s1.total_new_shelf_price FROM subq2 s2 LEFT JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.SUBJECT_ID = s1.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: What is the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL and the total new shelf price from TIP_MATERIAL for materials with a non-null author and a material info source of 'ISBN'?

For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, and the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID.
For each subject, what is the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL and the total new shelf price from TIP_MATERIAL for materials with a non-null author and a material info source of 'ISBN'?

For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and also include the term description and term start date for each subject.
sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE tm.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN';

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE tm.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_record_count, total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, list the department name, the subject title, and the dense rank of each subject within the department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units, as well as the subject ID, number of enrolled students, and department full name for subjects offered in 2019FA in departments where the total number of enrolled students across all their offered subjects in 2019FA is greater than the average number of enrolled students per department for that term. For each department, also include a grand total row for all subjects in that department in the format of (department name, null, total subjects), along with the corresponding subject ID, number of enrolled students, and department full name for matching subjects in 2019FA. The columns should be: department name, subject title, dense rank or total subjects, subject ID, number of enrolled students, and department full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
