WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ), avg_lecture AS ( SELECT HGN_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY HGN_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.HGN_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_lecture_units, i.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_lecture a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.max_lecture_units > a.avg_lecture_units;

question: For each department, show the department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, and the highest minimum total units (in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year) for subjects offered in the academic year 2024, along with the course description, subject code description, and the difference between the number of characters in the course description and the average number of characters in course descriptions for that department, for each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER ( ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LENGTH(COURSE_DESCRIPTION)) AS avg_desc_length FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (LENGTH(i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) - d.avg_desc_length) AS desc_length_deviation FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.highest_min_total_units, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.desc_length_deviation FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For subjects offered by the Mathematics department in the academic year 2024, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, and the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year.

For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description.

For each department, show the department name and the highest minimum total units (in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year) for subjects offered in the academic year 2024, along with the corresponding subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, and term description.

For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the difference between the number of characters in the course description and the average number of characters in course descriptions for that department.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024

SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LENGTH(COURSE_DESCRIPTION)) AS avg_desc_length FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (LENGTH(i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) - d.avg_desc_length) AS desc_length_deviation FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the top 3 most frequently offered IAP activities that are not cancelled, provide the activity title, max enrollment, the term description, the academic year description, the term start and end dates, and for the corresponding academic year, the maximum and minimum of the variance of record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'). List the columns in the following order: activity title, max enrollment, term description, academic year description, term start date, term end date, maximum variance of record counts, and minimum variance of record counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ta.TERM_START_DATE, ta.TERM_END_DATE, ta.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ta.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.TERM_START_DATE, cte1.TERM_END_DATE, cte2.max_record_count_variance, cte2.min_record_count_variance FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE;
sub_questions: For the top 3 most frequently offered IAP activities, give the activity title, max enrollment, the term description and the academic year description for each, considering only activities that are not cancelled?

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are both the variance and standard deviation of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'?

For the top 3 most frequently offered IAP activities, provide the activity title, max enrollment, the term description, the academic year description, and the term start and end dates for each, considering only activities that are not cancelled.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are both the maximum and minimum of the variance of record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ta.TERM_START_DATE, ta.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ta.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC;

question: For rooms with a square footage of 150, show the space unit code, space unit name, and the maximum rank within each space unit code group, and for each of those space units, show the major organization, top-level HR organization name, HR department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for each HR department name, considering only organizations that are assignable and have a non-null organization number. The results should include the space unit code, space unit name, maximum rank, major organization, top-level HR organization name, HR department name, average organization number, organization number variance, and organization number standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH space_unit_max_rank AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150 ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, MAX(window_column) AS max_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT ), org_stats_by_dept AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_ORG, icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, H.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION F ON icte.MAJOR_ORG = F.MAJOR_ORG JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD AND icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY icte.MAJOR_ORG, icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, H.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.max_rank, o.MAJOR_ORG, o.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.avg_org_number, o.org_number_variance, o.org_number_stddev FROM space_unit_max_rank s JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN org_stats_by_dept o ON fo.MAJOR_ORG = o.MAJOR_ORG
sub_questions: For rooms with a square footage of 150, show the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, and rank within each space unit code group ordered by building room.

For each major organization, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the organization numbers for each top-level HR organization name, considering only organizations that are assignable and have a non-null organization number?
For rooms with a square footage of 150, show the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, and the maximum rank within each space unit code group.

For each major organization and top-level HR organization name, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the organization numbers for each HR department name, considering only organizations that are assignable and have a non-null organization number?
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150

SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150 ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, MAX(window_column) AS max_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_ORG, icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, H.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION F ON icte.MAJOR_ORG = F.MAJOR_ORG JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD AND icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY icte.MAJOR_ORG, icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, H.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3 and for each corresponding offering school name where the course material status is 'RQ', show the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, the total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects, listing the columns in the following order: offering department name, course number description, number of distinct ISBNs, minimum responsible faculty MIT ID, total number of TIP_DETAIL records, offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, and maximum number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte1.isbn_count, inner_cte1.min_faculty_mit_id, dept_counts.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dept_counts.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s1.isbn_count, s1.min_faculty_mit_id, s1.total_tip_detail_records, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.max_num_enrolled_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, give the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL and the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.
For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects.

For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, show the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, and the total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description.

For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects, and also include the maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects.
sub_sqls: SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.isbn_count, inner_cte.min_faculty_mit_id, dept_counts.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dept_counts.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units;

question: List the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, total number of unique courses, and minimum CIP program code for all subject codes that are associated with departments that are degree-granting and belong to the School of Engineering. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.total_courses, s2.min_cip_code FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering';

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, the total number of enrolled students (with grand totals for each subject code), and, for each department, include only those where the total number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP' is greater than the average number of reserved materials per department for that term. Also include the total number of reserved library materials for each such department. Order the results by subject code and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), SubjectEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), HighReserveDepartments AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte2 WHERE reserved_materials > (SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte2) ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.window_column, s.total_enrolled_students, h.reserved_materials FROM SubjectEnrolledStats s JOIN HighReserveDepartments h ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = h.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials, including the subject title, the offering department name, and the count of reserved materials, for subjects offered in the term '2009SP'.

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, and for each subject code, include a grand total of enrolled students in the format of (null, null, null, null, subject code, subject code description, total enrolled students). Order the results by subject code and subject title.

For each department, list the department name and the total number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', but only include departments where the total number of reserved materials is greater than the average number of reserved materials per department for that term.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > ( SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte );

question: For each department, show the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the total number of such subjects per department, the subject title, the number of enrolled students for each subject that has at least one associated course material, and the total number of such subjects with course materials per department. List the columns in this order: department name, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), number of subjects with enrollment in 2017, subject title, number of enrolled students with course material, and number of subjects with course materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.enrolled_students_variance, subq1.enrolled_students_stddev, subq1.num_subjects AS num_subjects_with_enrollment_2017, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS subject_num_enrolled_students_with_material, subq2.Total_Subjects AS num_subjects_with_materials FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.enrolled_students_variance DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in the year 2017?
For each department, give the department name and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one associated course material.

For each department, in the year 2017, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, and also provide the total number of such subjects per department?
For each department, list the department name, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the total number of subjects per department that have at least one associated course material.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each of the top 10 IAP activities with the highest maximum enrollment, display the activity's title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, the category name, the number of activities in that category, and the dense rank of the activity within its category by maximum enrollment, along with, for each department and academic year, the department name, academic year, the number of subjects offered that are not repeatable for credit and are offered in the fall term, the average number of such subjects across all departments for that year, and whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_ACTIVITY', 'LOW_ACTIVITY', or 'AVERAGE' based on its subject count compared to the average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH iap_top_activities AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cat_stats.Category_Activity_Count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT DESC) AS Category_Dense_Rank FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Category_Activity_Count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) cat_stats ON ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = cat_stats.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_fall_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iap.MAX_ENROLLMENT, iap.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, iap.Category_Activity_Count, iap.Category_Dense_Rank, dfs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dfs.subject_count, dfs.avg_subject_count, dfs.activity_level FROM iap_top_activities iap CROSS JOIN dept_fall_subjects dfs;
sub_questions: List the activity title, enrollment type, and maximum enrollment for each activity, along with the category name, and show the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name.
List the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years by the number of subjects offered, including only subjects that are not repeatable for credit and are offered in the fall term.

From the top 10 IAP activities with the highest maximum enrollment, display each activity's title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, the category name, and the number of activities in that category, along with the dense rank of each activity within its category by maximum enrollment.

For each department and academic year, provide the department name, academic year, the number of subjects offered that are not repeatable for credit and are offered in the fall term, and classify the department as 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' if it offers at least 10% more such subjects than the average across all departments for that year, 'LOW_ACTIVITY' if it offers at least 10% fewer, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cat_stats.Category_Activity_Count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT DESC) AS Category_Dense_Rank FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Category_Activity_Count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) cat_stats ON ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = cat_stats.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, school name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the same department and school in the current academic term. Present the results ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SCHOOL_CODE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department in the 2012SU term that is part of the School of Engineering and has subjects with required materials, list the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered, the average number of enrolled students per subject, the subject title, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject, and the total number of material records for subjects with a status of 'RQ'. Sort the results by variance of total units in descending order and then by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptStats2012SU AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.total_units_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.total_units_variance ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.RECORD_COUNT FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), EngDeptMaterials AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(inner_cte2.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_units_variance, d.avg_enrolled_students, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.min_enrolled, e.total_material_records FROM DeptStats2012SU d JOIN EngDeptMaterials e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_units_variance DESC, e.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For rooms on floor 2, show the building room, space usage, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the department name, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, the department's long name, the DLC name, and the highest floor among rooms with access level 1 for each space usage group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, MAX(FLOOR) AS highest_floor FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_USAGE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t2.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ) SELECT s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.SPACE_USAGE, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, s2.DLC_NAME, s1.highest_floor FROM subq2 s2 LEFT JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.SPACE_USAGE = s1.SPACE_USAGE;

question: For each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, the minimum area value over each major use group, whether the room is a 'LARGE_ROOM' (at least 20% greater than the minimum area for its major use), 'SMALL_ROOM' (at least 20% less than the minimum area for its major use), or 'AVERAGE', and the average area for each major use description (considering only rooms with access level 1), but only include rooms whose area is greater than the average area for their major use description. Order the results by major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH RoomAreaCategories AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, ROOM, SPACE_ID, AREA, MAJOR_USE, DESCRIPTION, min_area_per_major_use, CASE WHEN AREA > min_area_per_major_use * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN AREA < min_area_per_major_use * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_ROOM' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS room_size_category, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM inner_cte ), MajorUseAvgArea AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT DESCRIPTION, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ) SELECT rac.BUILDING_ROOM, rac.FLOOR, rac.ROOM, rac.SPACE_ID, rac.AREA, rac.MAJOR_USE, rac.DESCRIPTION, rac.min_area_per_major_use, rac.room_size_category, mua.avg_area FROM RoomAreaCategories rac JOIN MajorUseAvgArea mua ON rac.DESCRIPTION = mua.DESCRIPTION AND rac.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mua.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE rac.AREA > mua.avg_area ORDER BY rac.MAJOR_USE;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department ordered by academic year, the subject title, and the total units of the offered subject. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.SUBJECT_TITLE, t3.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_variance, s2.enrollment_stddev, ROUND(s2.avg_enrollment / NULLIF(s1.TOTAL_UNITS, 0), 2) AS avg_enrollment_per_unit FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.SUBJECT_TITLE, t3.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, and for all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', provide the department name, course number, offering school name, total number of unique library subjects offered, minimum total units for those subjects, subject title, term description, number of enrolled students, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Only include rows where the department name matches in both sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE) WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_subjects, s1.min_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE) WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA';

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, and for each academic year where the average number of enrolled students per subject is greater than 20, provide the department name, course level, number of unique students, minimum CIP program code among their courses, school name, department's full name, academic year, number of unique subjects offered, minimum number of total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students per subject. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department, course level, and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE COURSE_LEVEL END AS course_level_sort, COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level, SUM(student_count) AS student_count, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units ) SELECT s1.department, s1.course_level, s1.student_count, s1.min_cip_code, s1.school_name, s1.department_full_name, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.avg_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON s1.department = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE s2.avg_enrolled_students > 20 ORDER BY s1.department, s1.course_level, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
