For each department offering a course, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in those courses, considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0?

For each degree-granting department, list the department name, the subject code, the subject code description, and the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code.

For each department offering a course, what is the maximum average enrollment among all terms for courses that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0?
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_enrollment_per_term DESC;

question: For each space unit and its associated organization, what is the space unit name, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the deviation of the HR department code from the average HR department code for HR org units linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), as well as, for each organization with a non-null description, the organization name (not repeated if the same as the previous row), the minimum access level among its rooms, the total number of unique space usages, and the number of rooms assigned to that organization? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' ), avg_codes AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, AVG(CAST(HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_hr_dept_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, (CAST(i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS FLOAT) - a.avg_hr_dept_code) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN avg_codes a ON i.SPACE_UNIT = a.SPACE_UNIT ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT MIN(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS min_access_level, COUNT(DISTINCT z.SPACE_USAGE) AS total_space_usages, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z ON f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ), subq2 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) = ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, min_access_level, total_space_usages, COUNT(z.BUILDING_ROOM) AS num_rooms, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM inner_cte2 inner_cte LEFT JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, min_access_level, total_space_usages, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY organization_name ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.organization_name, s2.min_access_level, s2.total_space_usages, s2.num_rooms FROM subq1 s1 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN subq2 s2 ON fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = s2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
sub_questions: For each space unit, what is the space unit name, the associated organization name, and the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit, considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'?
What is the minimum access level and the total number of unique space usages for rooms that belong to organizations with a non-null description?

For each space unit, what is the space unit name, the associated organization name, the HR org unit title, and the deviation of the HR department code from the average HR department code for HR org units linked to that space unit, considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'?

For each organization with a non-null description, list the organization name, the minimum access level among its rooms, the total number of unique space usages, and the number of rooms assigned to that organization. Do not repeat the organization name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by organization name.
sub_sqls: SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC;

SELECT MIN(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS min_access_level, COUNT(DISTINCT z.SPACE_USAGE) AS total_space_usages FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z ON f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' ) , avg_codes AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, AVG(CAST(HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_hr_dept_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, (CAST(i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS FLOAT) - a.avg_hr_dept_code) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_codes a ON i.SPACE_UNIT = a.SPACE_UNIT;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS min_access_level, COUNT(DISTINCT z.SPACE_USAGE) AS total_space_usages, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z ON f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) = ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, min_access_level, total_space_usages, COUNT(z.BUILDING_ROOM) AS num_rooms FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, min_access_level, total_space_usages ORDER BY organization_name;

question: For each academic year and offering department, what is the total range and total variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered (including a grand total for all departments as (academic year, null, total range, total variance)), considering only terms that are not the current term, and for each matching department in the 2005 Fall term, what are the subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, term description, average number of enrolled students within each subject title group, and the enrollment category ('HIGH_ENROLLMENT', 'LOW_ENROLLMENT', or 'AVERAGE') for each subject? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH enrolled_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(enrolled_range) AS total_enrolled_range, SUM(enrolled_variance) AS total_enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(enrolled_range) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subject_enrollment_2005fa AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, es.total_enrolled_range, es.total_enrolled_variance, se.SUBJECT_TITLE, se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, se.DEPARTMENT_NAME, se.TERM_DESCRIPTION, se.avg_enrolled_students, se.enrollment_category FROM enrolled_stats es LEFT JOIN subject_enrollment_2005fa se ON es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = se.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, se.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered, considering only terms that are not the current term?

For each subject offered in the term "2005FA", show the subject title from the subject summary, the number of enrolled students from the subject offered table, the department name from the subject summary, the term description from the academic terms table, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by department name.

For each academic year and offering department, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered, considering only terms that are not the current term? Additionally, for each academic year, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (academic year, null, total range, total variance).

For each subject offered in the term "2005FA", show the subject title from the subject summary, the number of enrolled students from the subject offered table, the department name from the subject summary, the term description from the academic terms table, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group, and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 10% greater than the average for its subject title, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(enrolled_range) AS total_enrolled_range, SUM(enrolled_variance) AS total_enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(enrolled_range) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and classify the year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average across all years, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise, along with the reason 'YearlyEnrollment'. Also, for each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, provide the academic year, department name, number of unique subjects offered, minimum number of total units for those subjects, and average number of enrolled students per subject, along with the reason 'DepartmentYearStats'. List all these results together, showing the columns: academic year, academic year description, department name, subject count, minimum total units, average enrolled students, geometric mean enrollment, enrollment category, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ), DepartmentYearStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT g.ACADEMIC_YEAR, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_total_units, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, g.geometric_mean_enrollment, g.enrollment_category, 'YearlyEnrollment' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment g UNION ALL SELECT d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, d.avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS geometric_mean_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_category, 'DepartmentYearStats' AS Reason FROM DepartmentYearStats d ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units, avg_enrolled_students, geometric_mean_enrollment, enrollment_category, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, Reason, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year, considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students?

For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for those subjects.

For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and classify the year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average across all years, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise.

For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, provide the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum number of total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students per subject.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units;

question: For the academic year and description with the highest variance in the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in the fall term (with at least one associated tip detail record), what is the most represented department among those subjects in that year and the count of such subjects from that department, and for that department in the current academic term, what is the school name, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered? List the academic year, academic year description, record count variance, most represented department, subject count, school name, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in this order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1 ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.Most_Represented_Department = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record?
For each school, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in the current academic term? Show the school name along with these statistics.

Among all academic years, which academic year and its description had the highest variance in the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in the fall term (with at least one associated tip detail record), and what is the department most represented among those subjects in that year, along with the count of such subjects from that department?

For each department in the current academic term, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered? Show the department name, school name, and these statistics.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1 ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials in the term '2009SP', list the subject title, department name, number of reserved materials, total number of enrolled students for each subject, the academic year, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered by the department (considering only subjects offered in the fall term with more than 0 enrolled students), as well as the department phone number and school name, with the results ordered by the number of reserved materials (descending) and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.SUBJECT_ID, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.reserved_materials, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, des.ACADEMIC_YEAR, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.department_phone, des.school_name FROM TopSubjects ts JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ts.reserved_materials DESC, des.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials, including the subject title, the offering department name, and the count of reserved materials, for subjects offered in the term '2009SP'.

For each academic year, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students? Please provide the academic year and these statistics.
For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials in the term '2009SP', also include the total number of enrolled students for each subject.

For each academic year and department, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students? Please provide the academic year, department name, average enrollment, and enrollment variance, along with the department phone number and school name.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP';

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of tip materials for that subject, along with the offering department name and the offering school name, as well as the department name, school name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department and school (including subtotals for each department and a grand total across all departments and schools, where the school field is 'SUBTOTAL' or 'TOTAL'), considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school. Sort the results by the range of record counts in descending order, then by subject title and school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte_1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte_1 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, school, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, department_name AS join_department_name, school AS join_school FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school_sort, department_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte_2 GROUP BY department_name, school_name WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.record_count_range, s1.record_count_variance, s1.record_count_stddev, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.department_name, s2.school, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.join_department_name AND s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.join_school ORDER BY s1.record_count_range DESC, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.school;
sub_questions: For each subject, give the subject title and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the record counts of tip materials for that subject, considering only subjects offered in the term '2017FA'.

For each department, give the department name and provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school.

For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the record counts of tip materials for that subject, along with the offering department name and the offering school name. Sort the results by the range of record counts in descending order.

For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department and school, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school. Also, include subtotals for each department (the corresponding school field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments and schools (the corresponding school field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department and school.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_range DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ORDER BY i.record_count_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, school, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school_sort, department_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name, school_name WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort;

question: For organizations with a major organization key of 230, show the organization parent, organization name, HR department name, HR department code, HR department long name, HR org unit level, the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent, the top department (by count of organizations) within each organization parent, and the count of organizations for that department. Also, for each matching HR department name and DLC key, show the organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, and the highest HR org unit ID within each HR department name group, considering only organizations with an organization level of 5. Limit the results to the top 10 organization parents with the highest total organization counts. The columns should be: organization parent, organization name, HR department name, HR department code, HR department long name, HR org unit level, the windowed average organization number, top department, department organization count, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, and highest HR org unit ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH orgs_major_230 AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, t2.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ), orgs_major_230_stats AS ( SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, ic.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ic.DLC_KEY, AVG(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY ic.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, dept_stats.Top_Department, dept_stats.Department_Org_Count, ic.ORG_PARENT FROM orgs_major_230 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Org_Count FROM orgs_major_230 ic2 GROUP BY ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = ( SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orgs_major_230 ic3 WHERE ic3.ORG_PARENT = ic2.ORG_PARENT GROUP BY ic3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) ) dept_stats ON ic.ORG_PARENT = dept_stats.ORG_PARENT AND ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.Top_Department WHERE ic.ORG_PARENT IN ( SELECT org_parent FROM ( SELECT ic4.ORG_PARENT AS org_parent, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs FROM orgs_major_230 ic4 GROUP BY ic4.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY total_orgs DESC LIMIT 10 ) top_parents ) ), orgs_level_5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), highest_hr_org_unit AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM orgs_level_5 GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT o.ORG_PARENT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, o.Top_Department, o.Department_Org_Count, ol5.ORGANIZATION_ID, ol5.DLC_NAME, ol5.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hho.highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM orgs_major_230_stats o LEFT JOIN orgs_level_5 ol5 ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = ol5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND o.DLC_KEY = ol5.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN highest_hr_org_unit hho ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = hho.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY o.ORG_PARENT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, ic.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY ic.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, dept_stats.Top_Department, dept_stats.Department_Org_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Org_Count FROM inner_cte ic2 GROUP BY ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = ( SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inner_cte ic3 WHERE ic3.ORG_PARENT = ic2.ORG_PARENT GROUP BY ic3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) ) dept_stats ON ic.ORG_PARENT = dept_stats.ORG_PARENT AND ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.Top_Department WHERE ic.ORG_PARENT IN ( SELECT org_parent FROM ( SELECT ic4.ORG_PARENT AS org_parent, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs FROM inner_cte ic4 GROUP BY ic4.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY total_orgs DESC LIMIT 10 ) top_parents ) ORDER BY ic.ORG_PARENT, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered with a section ID of 0 and a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title, the department name, the term description, the term start date, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and, for each department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U'. Show all columns in this order: subject title, department name, term description, term start date, window row number, enrolled student range, and enrolled student variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.SECTION_ID = 0 AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq1.TERM_START_DATE, subq1.window_column, subq2.enrolled_range, subq2.enrolled_variance FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.SECTION_ID = 0 AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.SECTION_ID = 0 AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department name and its corresponding organization key in the Provost Area, show the number of organizations, the minimum and maximum department hierarchy level 3 codes, the organization name, the number of associated space units, the average number of space units, and whether the organization is a 'LARGE_HOLDER', 'SMALL_HOLDER', or 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' based on space unit count. List the results ordered by department name and organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH OrgSpaceStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DLC_KEY, ic.space_unit_count, avg_stats.avg_space_units, CASE WHEN ic.space_unit_count > avg_stats.avg_space_units * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_HOLDER' WHEN ic.space_unit_count < avg_stats.avg_space_units * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_HOLDER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' END AS holder_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(space_unit_count) AS avg_space_units FROM inner_cte) avg_stats ), ProvostDeptStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.DLC_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.DLC_KEY ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.DLC_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, MAX(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS max_level3_code FROM inner_cte i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON i.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME GROUP BY i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.DLC_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code ) SELECT pds.DLC_NAME, pds.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, pds.org_count, pds.min_level3_code, pds.max_level3_code, oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oss.space_unit_count, oss.avg_space_units, oss.holder_category FROM ProvostDeptStats pds JOIN OrgSpaceStats oss ON pds.DLC_KEY = oss.DLC_KEY ORDER BY pds.DLC_NAME, oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

For each department name and its corresponding organization key where the department is in the Provost Area, provide the number of organizations and the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code.

For each organization, show the organization name, the number of associated space units, and whether the organization is a 'LARGE_HOLDER' (at least 20% more space units than the average), 'SMALL_HOLDER' (at least 20% fewer space units than the average), or 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' otherwise.

For each department name and its corresponding organization key where the department is in the Provost Area, provide the number of organizations, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, and the maximum department hierarchy level 3 code.
sub_sqls: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY space_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count, avg_stats.avg_space_units, CASE WHEN ic.space_unit_count > avg_stats.avg_space_units * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_HOLDER' WHEN ic.space_unit_count < avg_stats.avg_space_units * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_HOLDER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' END AS holder_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(space_unit_count) AS avg_space_units FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, MAX(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS max_level3_code FROM inner_cte i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON i.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME GROUP BY i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department ordered by academic year, the subject title, and the total units of the offered subject. Additionally, for each result, include the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned in the same department and the average office phone number (as a numeric value) for those students, including subtotals and a grand total as 'SUBTOTAL' and 'TOTAL' for each department, respectively. The results are ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.SUBJECT_TITLE, t3.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, total_active_grad_students, avg_office_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students, AVG(CASE WHEN OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE OFFICE_PHONE END) AS avg_office_phone FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m JOIN SE_PERSON s ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort ) SELECT s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.total_active_grad_students, s2.avg_office_phone FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.department_name ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR
