For each department, course number, and offering school name, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (department, course number, null, total subjects, min total units).
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.num_reserve_materials FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.num_reserve_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(TERM_CODE) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ) ic WHERE ic.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserve_materials DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each department, list the top 5 subject titles with the highest number of reserve materials assigned in the most recent term, including the department name, term code, subject title, and the number of reserve materials, and for each department also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, as well as whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE', 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE', or 'AVERAGE', showing the columns in the following order: department name, term code, subject title, number of reserve materials, material count range, material count variance, material count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and variance category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ), TopSubjects AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.num_reserve_materials FROM ( SELECT inner_cte1.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte1.num_reserve_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 WHERE inner_cte1.TERM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(TERM_CODE) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ) ic WHERE ic.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserve_materials DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptMaterialVariance AS ( SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.material_count_range, i.material_count_variance, i.material_count_stddev, CASE WHEN i.material_count_variance > s.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' WHEN i.material_count_variance < s.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte2 i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(material_count_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte2) s ORDER BY i.material_count_range DESC ) SELECT ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.num_reserve_materials, dmv.material_count_range, dmv.material_count_variance, dmv.material_count_stddev, dmv.variance_category FROM TopSubjects ts JOIN DeptMaterialVariance dmv ON ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dmv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.num_reserve_materials DESC;
sub_questions: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code.
For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP.

For each department, list the top 5 subject titles with the highest number of reserve materials assigned in the most recent term, including the department name, term code, and the number of reserve materials.

For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, and indicate whether the department is a 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% greater than the average variance across all departments), 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.num_reserve_materials FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.num_reserve_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(TERM_CODE) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ) ic WHERE ic.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserve_materials DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.material_count_range, i.material_count_variance, i.material_count_stddev, CASE WHEN i.material_count_variance > s.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' WHEN i.material_count_variance < s.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(material_count_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) s ORDER BY i.material_count_range DESC;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the cluster type description and the HGN code description for each subject. Additionally, for each subject's offering department, show the school name, department name, the total number of unique subject codes, and the minimum department budget code for degree-granting departments, including grand totals for each school where department is null. The columns should be shown in the following order: subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total number of units, windowed minimum total units, cluster type description, HGN code description, school name, department name, total subject codes, and minimum department budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte1.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte1.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_code_count) AS total_subject_codes, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_code_count) > 0 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_subject_codes, min_dept_budget_code, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, cte1.window_column, cte1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, cte1.HGN_CODE_DESC, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.total_subject_codes, cte2.min_dept_budget_code FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting, provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code.

sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER ( ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_code_count) AS total_subject_codes, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_code_count) > 0 ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_subject_codes, min_dept_budget_code FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department, list the department code, department name, and either (a) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (only including departments where the range of total units is greater than the average range across all departments, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school), or (b) the number of subjects offered by the department, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject, and the total number of units for all such subjects (for subjects offered by degree-granting departments in the School of Engineering this year). For each row, include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('UnitsStats' for the first case, 'SubjectStats' for the second). The columns should be: department code, department name, total units range, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), number of subjects offered, minimum enrolled students, total units, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units_range > (SELECT AVG(total_units_range) FROM inner_cte) ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students, inner_cte.total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students, inner_cte.total_units ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, NULL AS num_subjects_offered, NULL AS min_enrolled_students, NULL AS total_units, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats dus UNION ALL SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, dss.num_subjects_offered, dss.min_enrolled_students, dss.total_units, 'SubjectStats' AS Reason FROM DeptSubjectStats dss ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, num_subjects_offered, min_enrolled_students, total_units, Reason FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area", show the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, the corresponding DLC name from the HR_ORG_UNIT table, and, for rooms assigned to it with area greater than 40 and above the department's average (for rooms with area > 40), show the building-room identifier and the room area. List the results ordered by department name and descending room area. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), rooms_above_avg AS ( SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA, i.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.AREA > a.avg_area ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), provost_depts AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, t2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY ) SELECT p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, p.window_column, p.DLC_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA FROM provost_depts p JOIN rooms_above_avg r ON p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND p.DLC_KEY = r.DLC_KEY ORDER BY p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.AREA DESC

sub_sqls: SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC;

SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.AREA > a.avg_area ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.AREA DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t2.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY;

question: For each department name and school name, list the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students for subjects with more than 3 enrolled students, the total student enrollment in offered courses (for the top 5 departments in the School of Engineering), and the course with the highest enrollment (including the course number and its enrollment). Additionally, for each school name, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total offered subjects, minimum enrolled students, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(offered_subject_count) AS total_offered_subjects, MIN(min_enrolled_students) AS min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(offered_subject_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.COURSE_NUMBER, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), TopDepartments AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5 ), TopCourses AS ( SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.COURSE_NUMBER, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte2 i1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enroll FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enroll ) SELECT r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.SCHOOL_NAME, r.total_offered_subjects, r.min_enrolled_students, td.total_enrollment, tc.COURSE_NUMBER AS highest_enrolled_course, tc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS course_enrollment FROM RollupResults r LEFT JOIN TopDepartments td ON r.DEPARTMENT_NAME = td.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN TopCourses tc ON r.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE r.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.SCHOOL_NAME, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(offered_subject_count) AS total_offered_subjects, MIN(min_enrolled_students) AS min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(offered_subject_count) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, total_offered_subjects, min_enrolled_students FROM RollupResults WHERE SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.COURSE_NUMBER, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_enroll.total_enrollment, top_course.COURSE_NUMBER AS highest_enrolled_course, top_course.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS course_enrollment FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5) dept_enroll JOIN ( SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.COURSE_NUMBER, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enroll FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enroll ) top_course ON dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_course.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_enroll.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For each academic year where the running sum of academic years within a financial aid year group for previous terms is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, the term code, the term description, the running sum of academic years within the financial aid year group, and the financial aid year? List the results ordered by the variance of tip detail record counts (descending), financial aid year, and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.unique_departments, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.record_count_variance DESC, s2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), and the number of unique departments represented among those subjects?

For academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', show the term code from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, but only include those financial aid year groups where the running sum is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department and academic year, show the department name, academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the department's courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U', as well as the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students among those courses and the corresponding enrollment count. List the columns in the following order: department name, academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of total units, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, top subject title, and top enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte2 ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled ) SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.geometric_mean_total_units, enrollment_stats.enrolled_range, enrollment_stats.enrolled_variance, enrollment_stats.top_subject_title, enrollment_stats.top_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN enrollment_stats ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = enrollment_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and have total units greater than zero?
For each subject title, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U'?

Show the department names, academic year, academic year description, and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by each department in regular terms with total units greater than zero.

For each department, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U'? Also, for each department, what is the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students among those courses, and what is that enrollment count?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, what is the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, the subject code of the course with the maximum total units, and for subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU' that match that subject code and department, what is the subject's ID, total units, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_total_units, i.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = i.max_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.max_total_units, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON subq1.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE AND subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, and what is the name of the school that department belongs to, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6?
For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show the subject IDs and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units.

For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, what is the name of the school that department belongs to, and what is the subject code of the course with the maximum total units, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6?

For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show each subject's ID, total units, department name, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_total_units, i.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = i.max_total_units;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC;

question: For each department in the Provost Area, show the DLC name, the average and maximum faculty organization key associated with that department, the total number of unique DLC codes at the third hierarchy level for each department, the HR department name, and the highest HR org unit ID within each HR department name group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH org_dept_max_hr_unit AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), provost_dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ) SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS avg_org_key, MAX(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS max_org_key, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.DLC_CODE) AS unique_lvl3_dlc_codes FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m2 ON m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE = m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE AND m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY avg_org_key DESC ) SELECT p.DLC_NAME, p.avg_org_key, p.max_org_key, p.unique_lvl3_dlc_codes, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM provost_dept_stats p JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON p.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME JOIN org_dept_max_hr_unit o ON h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY p.avg_org_key DESC
sub_questions: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name.
For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of faculty organization keys associated with that department, considering only departments in the Provost Area?

For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and the highest HR org unit ID within each HR department name group.

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5

SELECT m.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_key_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ) SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS avg_org_key, MAX(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS max_org_key, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.DLC_CODE) AS unique_lvl3_dlc_codes FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m2 ON m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE = m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE AND m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY avg_org_key DESC;

question: For each department offering subjects, list the department name, the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject (where the material status is 'U'), and for each department also include a grand total for all its subjects in the format of (department name, null, total statistics). Additionally, for each department, provide the offering school name, the number of unique subjects with course material status 'RQ', the minimum total units for those subjects, and the maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects. Present the columns in the following order: department name, subject title, reserved material range, reserved material variance, reserved material standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), offering school name, subject count, minimum total units, and maximum number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE ), DeptReservedStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(material_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptSchoolRQStats AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.reserved_material_range, d.reserved_material_variance, d.reserved_material_stddev, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.subject_count, s.min_total_units, s.max_num_enrolled_students FROM DeptReservedStats d LEFT JOIN DeptSchoolRQStats s ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For each subject offered, give the subject title and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of reserved materials per subject, considering only subjects with at least one reserved material and where the material status is 'U'.
For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects.

For each department offering subjects, list the department name, the subject title, and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of reserved materials per subject (where the material status is 'U'), considering only departments with at least one reserved material. For each department, include a grand total for all its subjects in the format of (department name, null, total statistics).

For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects, and also include the maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(material_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units;

question: For rooms on floor 2 with access level 1, show the space unit, the maximum row number (within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by building room) for each space unit, the building room, the organization name, the department name, and the difference between the access level of the room and the average access level for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, MAX(window_column) AS max_window_row_number, SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (i.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.max_window_row_number, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.access_level_deviation FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SPACE_UNIT, s2.BUILDING_ROOM;

sub_sqls: SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1

SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, MAX(window_column) AS max_window_row_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (i.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List, for all subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units and a running sum of total units within each grade type exceeding 12, the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type; and for each department that offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022 where the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects is greater than 3, the department name, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term. Indicate the source of each row as either 'Subject' or 'Department'. Show the columns in the following order: subject code, subject title, department name, running sum of total units, highest number of lecture units, term start date, total number of subjects offered, and source. Order the results by department name, source, and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS num_subjects_offered, 'Subject' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.max_lecture_units, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.num_subjects_offered, 'Department' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, max_lecture_units, TERM_START_DATE, num_subjects_offered, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source, SUBJECT_CODE
sub_questions: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type, ordered by subject code.

SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE;

question: List, for all subjects offered in the term '2009SP' whose offering department is an Engineering department that is degree granting, the subject title, offering department name, number of reserved library materials, total number of enrolled students, and demand category ('HIGH_DEMAND', 'LOW_DEMAND', or 'AVERAGE'), as well as, for all Engineering departments that are degree granting and that offer at least one of these subjects, the department name, minimum department budget code, sum of total units, and number of unique courses. Indicate the source of each row as either 'Subject' or 'Department'. Show all columns in the following order: subject title, offering department name, number of reserved materials, number of enrolled students, demand category, department name, minimum budget code, sum of total units, number of unique courses, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN i.reserved_materials > s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_DEMAND' WHEN i.reserved_materials < s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_DEMAND' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS demand_category, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS unique_courses, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.reserved_materials, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.demand_category, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS min_budget_code, NULL AS total_units_sum, NULL AS unique_courses, 'Subject' AS Source FROM subq1 s1 WHERE s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM subq2) UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS reserved_materials, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS demand_category, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.min_budget_code, s2.total_units_sum, s2.unique_courses, 'Department' AS Source FROM subq2 s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM subq1) ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, COALESCE(SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME);

sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y';

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN i.reserved_materials > s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_DEMAND' WHEN i.reserved_materials < s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_DEMAND' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS demand_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS unique_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum

question: For each department, list the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered in the fall term with more than 0 enrolled students, the employee type, the number of people, the minimum MIT ID, and the number of unique office locations for graduate students in that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), grad_student_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, gs.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, gs.person_count, gs.min_mit_id, gs.unique_office_locations FROM enrollment_stats es JOIN grad_student_stats gs ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.enrollment_variance DESC, gs.person_count DESC;
