For each department, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered in the fall term with more than 0 enrolled students? Please provide the department name along with these statistics.
For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', provide the number of people, the minimum MIT ID, and the number of unique office locations for those students.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id;

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, and for each administrative department and term where the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering is greater than 100, provide the department name, school name, total number of unique courses, minimum CIP program code, administrative department name, term, and total number of enrolled students. Additionally, include a grand total for all departments in each school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code), as well as subtotals for each administrative department (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all administrative departments and terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the administrative department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by school name, department name, administrative department, and term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code, MIN(DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), AdminRollup AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(admin_dept) OVER (ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort) = admin_dept THEN NULL ELSE admin_dept END AS admin_dept, term, total_enrolled, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS admin_dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS admin_dept, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, MIN(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code, ar.admin_dept, ar.term, ar.total_enrolled FROM RollupResults rr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN AdminRollup ar ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ar.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ar.admin_dept, ar.term
sub_questions: For each department name and school name, where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions.

For each administrative department, give the administrative department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100.

For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code).

For each administrative department and term, provide the administrative department name, term, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100. Also, include subtotals for each administrative department (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all administrative departments and terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the administrative department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by administrative department and term.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(admin_dept) OVER (ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort) = admin_dept THEN NULL ELSE admin_dept END AS admin_dept, term, total_enrolled FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS admin_dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS admin_dept, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort;

question: For each subject offered and for each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, subject ID, the term description, academic year, term start date, the maximum term end date for each row and the next two rows in order of subject offered key, the term status indicator (indicating whether the term is past, current, or future), the department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum number of total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students per subject, only for terms that are not the current term and have a material status key of 'RQ'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(t1.TERM_END_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units ) SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.avg_enrolled_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each subject offered, show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, subject ID, the term description, academic year, term start date, and the maximum term end date for each row and the next two rows in order of subject offered key, only for terms that are not the current term and have a material status key of 'RQ'.

For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for those subjects.

For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, provide the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum number of total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students per subject.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(t1.TERM_END_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(t1.TERM_END_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units;

question: For each combination of IAP category and top 10 subject titles by number of materials offered in regular academic terms, list the category name, the highest maximum enrollment among its activities, the subject title, the department name, the total count of materials, and the academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH category_max_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ), top_subject_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT cme.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cme.highest_max_enrollment, tsm.SUBJECT_TITLE, tsm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tsm.material_count, tsm.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM category_max_enrollment cme CROSS JOIN top_subject_materials tsm;

List the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered, including the subject title, department name, and the total count of materials, for subjects in regular academic terms.

sub_sqls: SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ' and an academic year greater than the average academic year of all such records, show the subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, academic year, term description, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by term code. For each such academic year, also show the academic year description, the range and variance of the total units for all subjects offered in current terms, and which department has the highest number of subjects offered in those terms along with the count of subjects from that department. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM inner_cte) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, dept_stats.subject_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count ORDER BY units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.units_range, s2.units_variance, s2.most_subjects_department, s2.subject_count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column;

question: For each department that offered at least 5 degree-granting subjects in the 2022 academic year, provide the department name, the number of such subjects offered, the average, range, and variance of the total units for those subjects, and for each academic year in which the department had library reserve materials with material status 'U', also provide the academic year, the academic year description, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for those library reserve materials. sql: WITH DeptStats2022 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ), LibResMatrlStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_count, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, l.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptStats2022 d JOIN LibResMatrlStats l ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.subject_count DESC, l.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department that offered subjects in both the 2012SU term and the current academic term, list the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered in 2012SU, the average number of enrolled students per subject in 2012SU, the average total units for subjects offered in the current term, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects in the current term, the school within the department with the highest average total units in the current term, and that school's average total units. Order the results by the variance of total units in 2012SU in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, hs.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_with_highest_avg, hs.school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) hs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hs.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, hs.SCHOOL_NAME, hs.school_avg_total_units ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units_variance AS variance_total_units_2012SU, s1.avg_enrolled_students AS avg_enrolled_students_2012SU, s2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_current, s2.total_units_variance AS variance_total_units_current, s2.total_units_stddev AS stddev_total_units_current, s2.school_with_highest_avg, s2.school_avg_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, the library material status with the highest geometric mean of TIP material record counts (considering only records where the record count is greater than zero), and what is that geometric mean? sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AcademicYearVarianceDepartments AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.record_count_variance ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ), MaxGeomMeanStatus AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(geometric_mean_record_count) AS max_geom_mean FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT avd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, avd.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avd.record_count_variance, avd.unique_departments, ic2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic2.geometric_mean_record_count FROM AcademicYearVarianceDepartments avd JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON avd.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN MaxGeomMeanStatus mgs ON ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = mgs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ic2.geometric_mean_record_count = mgs.max_geom_mean ORDER BY avd.record_count_variance DESC, avd.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(geometric_mean_record_count) AS max_geom_mean FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) max_cte ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = max_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ic.geometric_mean_record_count = max_cte.max_geom_mean ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each library reserve material detail where the material status key is 'U' and the term status is 'Previous', show the subject ID, the academic year, the deviation of the academic year from the average academic year for all such materials, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, and the total number of unique TIP material keys per academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), avg_year AS ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS avg_academic_year FROM inner_cte ), library_deviation AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, (i.ACADEMIC_YEAR - a.avg_academic_year) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_year a ), tip_stats_inner AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), material_counts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), tip_stats AS ( SELECT tip_stats_inner.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tip_stats_inner.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tip_stats_inner.record_count_variance, tip_stats_inner.record_count_stddev, material_counts.total_materials FROM tip_stats_inner JOIN material_counts ON tip_stats_inner.ACADEMIC_YEAR = material_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ld.SUBJECT_ID, ld.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ld.deviation_from_avg, ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ts.record_count_variance, ts.record_count_stddev, ts.total_materials FROM library_deviation ld JOIN tip_stats ts ON ld.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ld.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For library reserve material details where the material status key is 'U', show the subject ID from the reserve material detail and the dense rank of the academic year from the academic terms, considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year, for terms where the term status is 'Previous'.

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), avg_year AS ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS avg_academic_year FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, (i.ACADEMIC_YEAR - a.avg_academic_year) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_year a;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, material_counts.total_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS material_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = material_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each academic term in 2014 and for each library subject enrollment visibility ('High Enrollment' if the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 20, and 'Low Enrollment' otherwise), provide the term code, term description, enrollment visibility, the total number of students enrolled in all corresponding library subjects, and for each grade type and department in the School of Engineering, list the grade type, department name, the number of subjects with at least 6 units, the average total units for those subjects, the school name, and the department full name. For each term, also include a grand total for all students enrolled in library subjects in the format of (term code, term description, null, total students). Include subtotals for each grade type (the corresponding grade type field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all grade types (the corresponding grade type field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the grade type if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term code, enrollment visibility, grade type, and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_library_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), LibraryEnrollmentVisibility AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, CASE WHEN l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 20 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END AS enrollment_visibility, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 20 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, enrollment_visibility, SUM(total_students) AS total_students FROM LibraryEnrollmentVisibility GROUP BY TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, enrollment_visibility WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), GradeTypeDeptRollup AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(grade_type) OVER (ORDER BY grade_type_sort, grade_type, dept_sort) = grade_type THEN NULL ELSE grade_type END AS grade_type, dept, subj_count, avg_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS subj_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY grade_type_sort, dept_sort ) SELECT rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rr.enrollment_visibility, rr.total_students, gtd.grade_type, gtd.dept, gtd.subj_count, gtd.avg_units, gtd.school_name, gtd.department_full_name FROM RollupResults rr JOIN GradeTypeDeptRollup gtd ON 1=1 ORDER BY rr.TERM_CODE, rr.enrollment_visibility, gtd.grade_type, gtd.dept ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_library_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), LibraryEnrollmentVisibility AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, CASE WHEN l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 20 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END AS enrollment_visibility, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 20 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, enrollment_visibility, SUM(total_students) AS total_students FROM LibraryEnrollmentVisibility GROUP BY TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, enrollment_visibility WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ) SELECT rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rr.enrollment_visibility, rr.total_students FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.TERM_CODE, rr.enrollment_visibility ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(grade_type) OVER (ORDER BY grade_type_sort, grade_type, dept_sort) = grade_type THEN NULL ELSE grade_type END AS grade_type, dept, subj_count, avg_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS subj_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY grade_type_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each subject offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program that is also offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', provide the subject key, subject title, department name, the number of subject offerings, the total number of units for those offerings, the total number of enrolled students in those offerings, the number of enrolled students for the subject, the average number of enrolled students for all such subjects, and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, a.avg_enrolled, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.offering_count, s1.total_units, s1.total_enrolled_students, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.avg_enrolled, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_KEY;

sub_sqls: SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, a.avg_enrolled, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a;

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects (but only include those departments where the minimum total units is greater than the overall minimum total units across all such departments and years), and for each such department also display the department's geometric mean of total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the average total units as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'HIGH_UNIT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Show the columns in this order: academic year, department name, subject count, minimum total units, department geometric mean, department average total units, and unit category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > (SELECT MIN(min_total_units) FROM inner_cte) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY department_geometric_mean DESC ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.subject_count, subq1.min_total_units, subq2.department_geometric_mean, subq2.department_avg_total_units, subq2.unit_category FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and have total units greater than zero?

For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, but only include those departments where the minimum total units is greater than the overall minimum total units across all such departments and years.

For each department, provide the department name, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the average total units as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'HIGH_UNIT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise.
sub_sqls: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > ( SELECT MIN(min_total_units) FROM inner_cte );

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY department_geometric_mean DESC;

question: Show all textbook materials in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ' where the academic year is greater than the average academic year of all such records, displaying the subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, academic year, term description, and row number within each academic year group ordered by term code. Also, show the top 5 departments with the highest average total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', including each department's name, average total units, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the subject with the highest total units in that department along with its total units. Indicate the source of each row as either 'TextbookMaterial' or 'TopDepartment'. The columns should be: subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, academic year, term description, row number, department name, average total units, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), top subject, top subject total units, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM inner_cte) ), Subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ss2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject, ss2.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ss2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss2.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS Top_Subject, NULL AS Top_Subject_Total_Units, 'TextbookMaterial' AS Source FROM Subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.Top_Subject, s2.Top_Subject_Total_Units, 'TopDepartment' AS Source FROM Subq2 s2 ) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, Top_Subject, Top_Subject_Total_Units, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ', show the subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, academic year, term description, and assign row numbers within each academic year group ordered by term code.
For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous'?

For each textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ', show the subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, academic year, term description, and assign row numbers within each academic year group ordered by term code, but only include those where the academic year is greater than the average academic year of all such records.

Among the top 5 departments with the highest average total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', show each department's name, average total units, variance, standard deviation, and the subject with the highest total units in that department along with its total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'

SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM inner_cte);

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ss2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject, ss2.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ss2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss2.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key equal to 'U' and for subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students (only including those where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average across all subjects), the offering department name, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, the offering school name, and the responsible faculty name for each subject. Order the results by offering department and descending number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER ( ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ISBN, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ) SELECT s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TERM_END_DATE, s2.TERM_PARAMETER, s2.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER ( ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ISBN, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED );

question: For each space unit where the number of rooms with an access level of at least 1 is greater than the average number of such rooms per space unit, list the space unit name, the number of rooms assigned to it, the associated DLC key, the DLC name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys and organization names that are not null), and the total number of unique organizations per DLC key. Present the results ordered by the number of rooms (descending) and then by the organization count range (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, COUNT(zr.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.ACCESS_LEVEL >= 1 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ), space_unit_rooms AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, DLC_KEY, room_count FROM inner_cte1 WHERE room_count > (SELECT AVG(room_count) FROM inner_cte1) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ), dlc_org_stats AS ( SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations ) SELECT sur.SPACE_UNIT, sur.room_count, dos.DLC_KEY, dos.DLC_NAME, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, dos.total_organizations FROM space_unit_rooms sur JOIN dlc_org_stats dos ON sur.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY sur.room_count DESC, dos.org_count_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations ORDER BY org_count_range DESC;

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, and the total number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP' (only for departments where the total number of reserved materials is greater than the average per department for that term). Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code, null for reserved materials). The columns should be: department name, school name, total courses, minimum CIP program code, and reserved materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), FilteredDepartments AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte2 WHERE reserved_materials > ( SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte2 ) ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code, fd.reserved_materials FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN FilteredDepartments fd ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = fd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year description, the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', and the total number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP' (only including departments where the total number of reserved materials is greater than the average number of reserved materials per department for that term)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > ( SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte ) ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.coefficient_of_variation, subq2.reserved_materials FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.coefficient_of_variation DESC;
