For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), and whether the range is 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 20 or more), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (less than 5), or 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' otherwise?
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT BETWEEN 15 AND 30 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2012SU' that are in academic years where the total number of unique subjects with TIP materials (excluding those with TIP material status key 'NM') for all terms in that year with non-null term status exceeds the average per academic year, provide the subject title, subject ID, offer department name, academic year, term description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, the average number of enrolled students for that term, the enrollment category (classified as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the average for that term, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise), the academic year description, and the total number of unique subjects with TIP materials for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.unique_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ( SELECT AVG(unique_subject_count) AS avg_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1 ) avg_cte ON inner_cte1.unique_subject_count > avg_cte.avg_unique_subjects ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.window_column, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 JOIN ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t1.TERM_CODE ) avg_stats ON avg_stats.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.window_column, cte2.avg_enrolled_students, cte2.enrollment_category, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.unique_subject_count FROM cte2 JOIN cte1 ON cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the average and variance of the record count of TIP materials for all terms in that year where the term status is not null and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'.

For subjects offered in the term with code '2012SU', show the subject title, subject ID, offer department name, academic year, term description, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year.

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the total number of unique subjects that have TIP materials (excluding those with TIP material status key 'NM') for all terms in that year where the term status is not null, but only include academic years where the total number of unique subjects exceeds the average number of unique subjects per academic year.

For subjects offered in the term with code '2012SU', show the subject title, subject ID, offer department name, academic year, term description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the average for that term, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_subject_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(unique_subject_count) AS avg_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte ) avg_cte ON inner_cte.unique_subject_count > avg_cte.avg_unique_subjects ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_subject_count DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t1.TERM_CODE ) avg_stats ON avg_stats.TERM_CODE = '2012SU';

question: For each building located on the MIT site with more than 5 rooms, and for each organization with organization level 5 and HR org unit level 'DEPARTMENTS' that has rooms in that building, what is the building's long name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, the average area of its rooms as a benchmark, whether the building is a 'LARGE_VARIANCE' (if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average area), 'SMALL_VARIANCE' (if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average area), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise, the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and the row number within each HR department name group ordered by organization name? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH BuildingVariance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, AVG(r.AREA) AS area_avg FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, i.area_stddev, i.area_avg, CASE WHEN i.area_stddev > i.area_avg * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_VARIANCE' WHEN i.area_stddev < i.area_avg * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i ), OrgDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' ), OrgRooms AS ( SELECT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT bv.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, bv.area_stddev, bv.area_avg, bv.variance_category, od.ORGANIZATION_NAME, od.ORGANIZATION_ID, od.DLC_NAME, od.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, od.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, od.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, od.window_column FROM BuildingVariance bv JOIN OrgRooms orr ON bv.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = orr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN OrgDepartments od ON orr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = od.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY bv.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, od.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, od.ORGANIZATION_NAME
sub_questions: For each building, what is the building's long name and the standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, considering only buildings with more than 5 rooms and where the building is located on the MIT site?

For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name.

For each building located on the MIT site with more than 5 rooms, what is the building's long name, the standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, the average area of its rooms as a benchmark, and whether the building is a 'LARGE_VARIANCE' (if the standard deviation is at least 20% greater than the average area), 'SMALL_VARIANCE' (if the standard deviation is at least 20% less than the average area), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise?

For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name, but only include those where the HR org unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS'.
sub_sqls: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC;

SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, AVG(r.AREA) AS area_avg FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, i.area_stddev, i.area_avg, CASE WHEN i.area_stddev > i.area_avg * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_VARIANCE' WHEN i.area_stddev < i.area_avg * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY i.area_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS';

question: List the full names and email addresses of students in the MIT student directory who are in departments belonging to the School of Engineering and whose department name contains the word "Engineering", along with the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, the offering school name, and the responsible faculty name for subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' in their department. Order the results by student full name and offering department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EngineeringStudents AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ) SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ), Subjects2025FA AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte ) SELECT es.FULL_NAME, es.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM EngineeringStudents es JOIN Subjects2025FA s ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY es.FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ) SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%';

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, grade type, and the running sum of total units within each grade type, but only include those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type. For each such subject, also show, for IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled and are associated with the same subject code, the academic term description, activity title, enrollment type, and the total count of such activities (with a grand total row for all activities in each term, where activity title, enrollment type, and subject title are null and the total count is for all activities in that term). Order the results by subject code, academic term description, and activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE, window_column FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column > 12 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), rollup_cte AS ( SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.GRADE_TYPE, s1.window_column, r1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, r1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, r1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, r1.activity_count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN rollup_cte r1 ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = r1.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, r1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, r1.ACTIVITY_TITLE

question: For each academic term where the term status indicator is 'P' and the term parameter is 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM', what are the academic terms key, term description, academic year description, term start date, term end date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the term code, the total number of academic terms per academic year, and the maximum average subject enrollment number for subjects offered in terms that are not the current term and have more than 0 total units, with all results grouped and ordered by academic year description and term start date? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH max_avg_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) subq GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_avg_subject_enrollment DESC ), term_window_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Terms.Total_Terms_Per_Year, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.TERM_CODE) AS Total_Terms_Per_Year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 GROUP BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS Total_Terms ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT tws.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE, tws.TERM_END_DATE, tws.window_column, tws.Total_Terms_Per_Year, mae.max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM term_window_stats tws JOIN max_avg_enrollment mae ON tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mae.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) subq GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_avg_subject_enrollment DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Terms.Total_Terms_Per_Year FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.TERM_CODE) AS Total_Terms_Per_Year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 GROUP BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS Total_Terms ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject offered in the current SIS term, list the offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, the total number of subjects offered per department, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one associated course material in that department, and indicate whether the department's average enrollment is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. The columns should be: offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, total number of subjects offered per department, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME as OFFER_DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) overall ) SELECT subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, subq1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.Total_Subjects, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_stddev, subq2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each department in the 2022 academic year where the average subject enrollment number (in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units for subjects with 12 units) is greater than the overall average subject enrollment number for all subjects in 2022, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in 2022, the number of unique subject titles offered in 2022, and the windowed average subject enrollment number, listing the results in descending order of the total units range. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance ORDER BY i.total_units_range DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(window_column) > ( SELECT AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type (only including those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type), and for each such department and each employee type where the student year is 'G', show the number of people, the minimum MIT ID, and the list of unique office locations for those employees. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sp.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte JOIN SE_PERSON sp ON sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, subq2.person_count, subq2.min_mit_id, subq2.unique_office_locations FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.EMPLOYEE_TYPE;

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS SUBJECT_COUNT FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, dc.SUBJECT_COUNT FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN DeptCounts dc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column2 FROM inner_cte2 WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_ID, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.window_column, cte1.SUBJECT_COUNT, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.window_column2 FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.SUBJECT_ID = cte2.SUBJECT_ID AND cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject category, academic year, subject count, and minimum academic term start date where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, list the total number of subject IDs from the TIP_DETAIL table for that term, the academic year description, department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms. sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date, a.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.TERM_CODE ), SubjectIDCounts AS ( SELECT icte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_term_start_date, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_id_count, icte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 icte JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON icte.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_term_start_date, icte.TERM_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_term_start_date, SUM(subject_id_count) AS total_subject_ids, TERM_CODE FROM SubjectIDCounts GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_term_start_date, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_id_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT r.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.subject_count, r.min_term_start_date, r.total_subject_ids, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units FROM RollupResults r JOIN DeptUnitStats d ON r.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY r.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.subject_count, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), subject_summary1 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), subject_summary2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE) WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_subjects, s1.min_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column FROM subject_summary1 s1 JOIN subject_summary2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2019SP", show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term description, the total units for the subject, the average total units within each subject group, the offering department name, the school name, and the number of unique subject titles with materials offered in regular academic terms for the same department and school. Do not repeat the subject title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the number of enrolled students and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS join_school_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, join_dept_name, join_school_name FROM inner_cte ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title_count FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) > 0 ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.subject_title, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_total_units, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_title_count FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.join_school_name = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each organization, list the organization name, the total number of rooms with a non-null area, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room areas for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area, and for each organization also show the major organization, the top-level HR organization name, the HR department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for each top-level HR organization name and HR department name, considering only organizations that are assignable and have a non-null organization number. The columns should be: organization name, total number of rooms, area range, area variance, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), major organization, top-level HR organization name, HR department name, average organization number, organization number variance, and organization number standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH org_room_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = r.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), major_org_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_ORG, icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, H.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_org_number, icte.org_number_variance, icte.org_number_stddev, F.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte icte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION F ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.total_rooms, ors.area_range, ors.area_variance, ors.area_stddev, mos.MAJOR_ORG, mos.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, mos.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mos.avg_org_number, mos.org_number_variance, mos.org_number_stddev FROM org_room_stats ors JOIN major_org_stats mos ON ors.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = mos.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ors.total_rooms DESC, mos.org_number_variance DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC;

SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = r.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev ORDER BY total_rooms DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_ORG, icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, H.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_org_number, icte.org_number_variance, icte.org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte icte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ORDER BY icte.org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the current academic term that has offered more than 5 unique subjects in terms from the academic year 2014 or later, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered, which school within that department has the highest average total units, the average total units for that school, the count of unique subject titles, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects? Show the department name, average total units, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, school name with the highest average, its average total units, subject count, and total enrolled students, in that order, sorted by total enrolled students descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, hs.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_with_highest_avg, hs.school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) hs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hs.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, hs.SCHOOL_NAME, hs.school_avg_total_units ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), dept_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count HAVING inner_cte.subject_count > 5 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ds.school_with_highest_avg, ds.school_avg_total_units, dsub.subject_count, dsub.total_enrolled_students FROM dept_stats ds JOIN dept_subjects dsub ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsub.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dsub.total_enrolled_students DESC;

SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, hs.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_with_highest_avg, hs.school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) hs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hs.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, hs.SCHOOL_NAME, hs.school_avg_total_units ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count HAVING inner_cte.subject_count > 5 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC;

question: For each department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name where the department hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy' and the organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', provide the number of unique facility organization keys, the minimum organization unit ID, the most recent warehouse load date, the corresponding department code, and the department name. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept_long) OVER (ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort) = dept_long THEN NULL ELSE dept_long END AS department_long_name, hier3_name, org_count, min_org_unit_id, max_load_date FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS hier3_sort, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS hier3_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS max_load_date FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.min_org_unit_id, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' ) SELECT s1.department_long_name, s1.hier3_name, s1.org_count, s1.min_org_unit_id, s1.max_load_date, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.department_long_name = s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND s1.hier3_name = s2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AND s1.min_org_unit_id = s2.min_org_unit_id ORDER BY s1.department_long_name, s1.hier3_name;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and belong to departments where the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022 is greater than the overall average total units for that term, show the course description, department name, subject title, the subject's grade type description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, the minimum number of lecture units for the department, and the total number of units for the department. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_lecture_units, total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(c2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON c2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_totals ) ) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, s1.window_column, s2.min_lecture_units, s2.total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(units_range) AS units_range, VARIANCE(units_range) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ) SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ) SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.units_range, subq1.units_variance, subq2.FULL_NAME, subq2.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME AND subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.FULL_NAME

sql: WITH iap_activities AS ( SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t1.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column FROM ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) inner_cte JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.CALENDAR_DATE ), eng_subjects AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap_activities.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iap_activities.CALENDAR_DATE, iap_activities.FISCAL_YEAR, iap_activities.window_column AS IAP_WINDOW_NUMBER, eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_ID, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng_subjects.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eng_subjects.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK, eng_subjects.Total_Subjects FROM iap_activities JOIN eng_subjects ON iap_activities.FISCAL_YEAR = eng_subjects.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each academic year and offering department, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered (considering only subjects that are not repeatable and are master sections), the overall average enrollment across all departments in that year, and whether the department's average enrollment is categorized as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH cte1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ), cte2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS overall_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_variance, i.enrollment_stddev, o.overall_avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.avg_enrollment > o.overall_avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.avg_enrollment < o.overall_avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN overall_avg o ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = o.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.record_count_variance, cte1.unique_departments, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.avg_enrollment, cte2.enrollment_variance, cte2.enrollment_stddev, cte2.overall_avg_enrollment, cte2.enrollment_category FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) , overall_avg AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS overall_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_variance, i.enrollment_stddev, o.overall_avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.avg_enrollment > o.overall_avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.avg_enrollment < o.overall_avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN overall_avg o ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = o.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each academic year where the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students) is greater than the overall geometric mean across all years, and which is also among the top 10 academic years with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', list the academic year description, the geometric mean of enrolled students, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the department with the highest average total units in those terms, and that department's average total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH geometric_mean_enrollment_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_enrollment > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ), coefficient_of_variation_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, dept_stats.avg_total_units AS Department_Avg_Total_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, cov.coefficient_of_variation, cov.Top_Department, cov.Department_Avg_Total_Units FROM geometric_mean_enrollment_cte gme JOIN coefficient_of_variation_cte cov ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;
