For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student.

For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a total of 1 unit, show the subject title from the summary, the course number from the offered table, the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the summary, the offer department name from the offered summary, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject title from the summary, and for each department, also provide the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student). List the results ordered by department name and row number.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT subq1.summary_subject_title, subq1.COURSE_NUMBER, subq1.offered_summary_subject_title, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_total_units, subq2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column;

question: For each student in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and their row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name, along with the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by their department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units). Additionally, provide the school name of the department and the number of unique courses offered by the department. List the results ordered by the row number within each course level group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dc.num_courses FROM EECSStudents eecs JOIN DepartmentUnits du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT ) dc ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dc.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY eecs.window_column ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

WITH DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.stddev_total_units FROM EECSStudents eecs JOIN DepartmentUnits du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY eecs.window_column;

question: Among departments in the "Sloan School of Management" area with a "Standard Hierarchy" type and also in the "Provost Area" at hierarchy level 2, which department has the highest number of organizations associated with it? For the top 5 such departments by organization count, show the department code, department name, the dense rank of each department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name, the department's name, the total number of organizations, and the average organization number for organizations within that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SloanStandardDepartments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ), ProvostDeptOrgStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_count, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ssd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssd.window_column, pds.department_name, pds.org_count, pds.avg_org_number FROM SloanStandardDepartments ssd JOIN ProvostDeptOrgStats pds ON ssd.DLC_KEY = pds.DLC_KEY ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, department_name, org_count, avg_org_number FROM inner_cte ORDER BY org_count DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME AS department_name, MAX(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) - MIN(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_range DESC;

WITH SloanStandardDepartments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ), ProvostDeptOrgStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME AS department_name, MAX(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) - MIN(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ssd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssd.window_column, pds.department_name, pds.org_number_range, pds.org_number_variance FROM SloanStandardDepartments ssd JOIN ProvostDeptOrgStats pds ON ssd.DLC_KEY = pds.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ssd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pds.org_number_range DESC;

question: For departments where the range of total units for subjects offered in the academic year 2022 is greater than 5 and the variance of total units is greater than 2, give the department name, the range of total units, the variance of total units, and for each subject in the 2019FA term with total units greater than 1 in that department, show the subject ID, subject title, the running sum of total units within each school, and the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ordered by department range descending and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, suw.SUBJECT_ID, suw.SUBJECT_TITLE, suw.window_column, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte dus JOIN ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID_FOR_JOIN, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) suw ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = suw.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.COURSE = SUBSTRING(suw.SUBJECT_ID_FOR_JOIN, 1, POSITION('.' IN suw.SUBJECT_ID_FOR_JOIN) - 1) WHERE dus.units_range > 5 AND dus.units_variance > 2 ORDER BY dus.units_range DESC, suw.SUBJECT_ID;

sub_sqls: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), SubjectUnitsWindow AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, suw.SUBJECT_ID, suw.SUBJECT_TITLE, suw.window_column FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN SubjectUnitsWindow suw ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = suw.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dus.units_range > 5 AND dus.units_variance > 2 ORDER BY dus.units_range DESC, suw.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" and offered by one of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in academic years 2014 or later, show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, the count of unique subject titles offered by the department since 2014, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects in "Fall Term 2024-2025", ordered by the count of unique subject titles (descending), offering department name, and subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), Top10DeptsSince2014 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), SubjectEnrollmentInFall2024 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUM(COALESCE(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' GROUP BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) SELECT icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, tds.subject_count, se.total_enrolled FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Top10DeptsSince2014 tds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SubjectEnrollmentInFall2024 se ON icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = se.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ORDER BY tds.subject_count DESC, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

WITH SubjectRankInFall2024 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), Top10DeptsSince2014 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT srf.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, srf.SUBJECT_TITLE, srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, srf.TERM_DESCRIPTION, srf.window_column, tds.subject_count FROM SubjectRankInFall2024 srf JOIN Top10DeptsSince2014 tds ON srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tds.subject_count DESC, srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, srf.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show each subject's ID, title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start and end dates, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for each department and academic year (where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5), as well as the subject's total units, grade type, and responsible faculty name. Present the results ordered by offering department and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.GRADE_TYPE, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte s JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by offering department.

For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for those subjects.

For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, as well as the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5. Present the results ordered by offering department and subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH SubjectsIn2025FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM SubjectsIn2025FA s JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting within that department, show the course description, subject code description, and the deviation of the course's total units from the average total units of all subjects in that department. List the results ordered by department name and course description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), DeptAvgUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (e.TOTAL_UNITS - dau.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_units FROM inner_cte d JOIN EngDegreeCourses e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptAvgUnits dau ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dau.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION;
sub_questions: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department, considering only rooms with an area greater than 40?

For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description.

For each department, show the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), and for each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting within that department, show the course description, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description. List the results ordered by department name and course description.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

WITH DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column FROM DeptRoomStats d JOIN EngDegreeCourses e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each IAP subject activity and department, list the activity title, department name, the number of activities, average maximum enrollment, the academic term description, and the subject title. Include subtotals for each activity (the corresponding activity field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all activities (the corresponding activity field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the activity title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by activity title and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(activity_title) OVER (ORDER BY activity_sort, dept_sort) = activity_title THEN NULL ELSE activity_title END AS activity_title, dept, activity_count, avg_max_enrollment, term_description, subject_title FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACTIVITY_TITLE END AS activity_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ACTIVITY_TITLE END AS activity_title, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, AVG(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS term_description, MAX(t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY activity_sort, dept_sort;
sub_questions: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, and the subject title from the course catalog, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title.

For IAP subject activities that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, term code, academic term description from the time day table, term start date from the academic terms table, and the minimum maximum enrollment value over each term code group, ordered by term code.

For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, and for those that are also not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, the subject title from the course catalog, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, the maximum enrollment, the academic term description from the time day table, the term start date from the academic terms table, and the minimum maximum enrollment value over each term code group, ordered by activity title and term code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'

SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TERM_START_DATE, min(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TERM_START_DATE, min(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS s1_window_column, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.window_column AS s2_window_column FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department and school, where the range of total units for subjects offered in the academic year 2022 is greater than 0 and the average total units for subjects with at least one enrolled student and required course materials is greater than 0, list the department name, school name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects with at least one enrolled student and required course materials, in that order. Also include the department phone number. Sort the results by school name and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnits2022 AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptUnitsWithMaterials AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2022.SCHOOL_NAME, d2022.units_range, d2022.units_variance, dmat.avg_total_units, dmat.total_units_range, dmat.total_units_variance FROM DepartmentUnits2022 d2022 JOIN DeptUnitsWithMaterials dmat ON d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmat.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND d2022.SCHOOL_NAME = dmat.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WHERE d2022.units_range > 0 AND dmat.avg_total_units > 0 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.units_variance, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022.

For each department offering a subject, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials.

For each department, where the range of total units for subjects offered in the academic year 2022 is greater than 0 and the average total units for subjects with at least one enrolled student and required course materials is greater than 0, give the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects with at least one enrolled student and required course materials, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH DepartmentUnits2022 AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), DeptUnitsWithMaterials AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2022.units_range, d2022.units_variance, dmat.avg_total_units, dmat.total_units_range, dmat.total_units_variance FROM DepartmentUnits2022 d2022 JOIN DeptUnitsWithMaterials dmat ON d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmat.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE d2022.units_range > 0 AND dmat.avg_total_units > 0 ORDER BY d2022.units_range DESC

question: For each assignable organization with a department code above 100000, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, the department name, the average number of sub-departments (where HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL is 'SUB DEPARTMENT') associated with the department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of sub-departments, and the top-level area name from the HR org hierarchy. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id, f.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY ), dept_subdept_stats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS avg_num_sub_departments, STDDEV(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS stddev_num_sub_departments, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT h2.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS num_sub_depts FROM HR_ORG_UNIT h2 WHERE h2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT' GROUP BY h2.DLC_KEY ) sub_dept_counts ON m.DLC_KEY = sub_dept_counts.DLC_KEY WHERE m.DLC_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_num_sub_departments DESC ) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_subdept_stats d ON i.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each organization, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, and the total of their department IDs, for organizations that are assignable and have a department code above 100000.
For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of sub-departments (HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT') associated with it.

For each organization that is assignable and has a department code above 100000, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, the department name, the average number of sub-departments (where HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL is 'SUB DEPARTMENT') associated with the department, and the standard deviation of the number of sub-departments.
sub_sqls: SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS avg_num_sub_departments, STDDEV(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS stddev_num_sub_departments FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT h2.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS num_sub_depts FROM HR_ORG_UNIT h2 WHERE h2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT' GROUP BY h2.DLC_KEY ) sub_dept_counts ON m.DLC_KEY = sub_dept_counts.DLC_KEY WHERE m.DLC_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY stddev_num_sub_departments DESC;

WITH org_hr_summary AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id, f.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY ), dept_subdept_stats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS avg_num_sub_departments, STDDEV(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS stddev_num_sub_departments, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT h2.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS num_sub_depts FROM HR_ORG_UNIT h2 WHERE h2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT' GROUP BY h2.DLC_KEY ) sub_dept_counts ON m.DLC_KEY = sub_dept_counts.DLC_KEY WHERE m.DLC_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_num_sub_departments DESC ) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments FROM org_hr_summary o JOIN dept_subdept_stats d ON o.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY;

question: For each department that grants degrees, where the range of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects offered by that department is greater than 0 and the variance of the total number of units for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students is available, provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, the variance of total units, and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects. List the department name, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, variance of total units, and average enrolled students in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), UnitsVariance AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance, es.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN UnitsVariance uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE es.enrolled_range > 0 AND uv.total_units_variance IS NOT NULL ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tso.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC;

Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, and the variance of enrolled students.

For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting?

For each department that grants degrees, where the range of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects offered by that department is greater than 0 and the variance of the total number of units for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students is available, provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, and the variance of the total number of units. List the department name, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, and variance of total units in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), UnitsVariance AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN UnitsVariance uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE es.enrolled_range > 0 AND uv.total_units_variance IS NOT NULL ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', the department is in the School of Engineering with more than 50 students enrolled in its courses, and the minimum MIT ID is an even number, provide the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department, and the normalized person count rounded (number of people divided by total enrollment), listing the results in descending order of normalized person count.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT icte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.person_count, icte.min_mit_id, sq2.total_enrollment, ROUND(icte.person_count / NULLIF(sq2.total_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_person_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE MOD(icte.min_mit_id, 2) = 0 ORDER BY normalized_person_count DESC;

For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G' and the department is in the School of Engineering with more than 50 students enrolled in its courses, provide the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department, and the normalized person count rounded (number of people divided by total enrollment), listing the results in descending order of normalized person count.
sub_sqls: SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT sq1.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.person_count, sq1.min_mit_id, sq2.total_enrollment, ROUND(sq1.person_count / NULLIF(sq2.total_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_person_count FROM Subquery1 sq1 JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_person_count DESC;

question: For each department that offers at least one subject in the Fall Term 2024-2025 with a total of 12 units, what is the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, and for each such subject in Fall Term 2024-2025, what are the subject ID, subject title, school name, total units, term description, term start date, the row number within the department ordered by subject ID, and the name of the responsible faculty member for that subject? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, f24.SUBJECT_ID, f24.SUBJECT_TITLE, f24.SCHOOL_NAME, f24.TOTAL_UNITS, f24.TERM_DESCRIPTION, f24.TERM_START_DATE, f24.window_column, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte dus JOIN ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) f24 ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = f24.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON f24.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f24.window_column;

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

WITH department_units_stats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), fall_2024_12unit_subjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, f24.SUBJECT_ID, f24.SUBJECT_TITLE, f24.SCHOOL_NAME, f24.TOTAL_UNITS, f24.TERM_DESCRIPTION, f24.TERM_START_DATE, f24.window_column FROM department_units_stats dus JOIN fall_2024_12unit_subjects f24 ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = f24.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f24.window_column;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its courses greater than 50, give the department name, the total number of enrolled students, and for each academic year, the average of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0. List the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.ACADEMIC_YEAR, u.avg_units FROM DeptEnrollment e JOIN DeptUnitsStats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrollment, ACADEMIC_YEAR, avg_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR;
