List the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, and the reserve catalog key for each subject, along with dense ranks over the material status key ordered by material status key, for subjects that have more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U'.

For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, and the dense rank over the material status key, ordered by subject offered key and course number.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'

SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'

WITH SubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), LibrarySubjectStats AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, lss.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lss.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lss.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status FROM SubjectOfferings so JOIN LibrarySubjectStats lss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = lss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, lss.COURSE_NUMBER

question: For each organization and department in the Provost Area with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, list the organization name, organization key, department name, department code, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by department code, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name. Additionally, include the department's top-level area name from HR_ORG_UNIT. Order the results by department code and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.window_column AS org_window_avg_key, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS dept_row_number, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON h.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY WHERE h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each organization, show the organization name, organization key, department name, department code, and the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by department code, for organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1.

For each department, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name, for departments in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code.

For each organization and department in the Provost Area with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, list the organization name, organization key, department name, department code, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by department code, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name. Order the results by department code and department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1

SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL

WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_avg_key, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_row_number FROM OrgStats o JOIN DeptStats d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and for each degree granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, and whether the course's total units is at least 10% greater than the average for its school ('HIGH_UNIT'), at least 10% less than the average ('LOW_UNIT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, cd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CASE WHEN co.TOTAL_UNITS > ic.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN co.TOTAL_UNITS < ic.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = cd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT dep ON cd.DEPARTMENT = dep.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED co ON cd.COURSE = co.SUBJECT_CODE AND co.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 WHERE dep.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND dep.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
sub_questions: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year.

For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code.

For each school, provide the school name, the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and for each degree granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

WITH SchoolStats AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EngineeringCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.avg_total_units, ss.stddev_total_units, ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column FROM SchoolStats ss JOIN EngineeringCourses ec ON ss.SCHOOL_NAME = ec.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each department and school, list the department name, school name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, and the variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate. For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, school name, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.SCHOOL_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM DepartmentUnitsVariance duv JOIN DepartmentCIPStats dcs ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND duv.SCHOOL_NAME = dcs.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_variance, ic.avg_cip_code, ic.cip_code_range, ic.cip_code_variance FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_variance, avg_cip_code, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_variance, avg_cip_code, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_units_variance) IS NOT NULL ) ic ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year?

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate.

For each department, list the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, and the variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC;

WITH DepartmentUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM DepartmentUnitsVariance duv JOIN DepartmentCIPStats dcs ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY duv.total_units_variance DESC, dcs.cip_code_range DESC;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, and for students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, the student's full name, email address, course description, course level, and the most common student year among those students for each course level. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t2.STUDENT_YEAR FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, es.FULL_NAME, es.EMAIL_ADDRESS, es.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, es.COURSE_LEVEL, es.STUDENT_YEAR FROM DeptMaxUnits dmu JOIN EECSStudents es ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, mode_stats.Most_Common_Student_Year FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COURSE_LEVEL, STUDENT_YEAR AS Most_Common_Student_Year FROM ( SELECT COURSE_LEVEL, STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY COURSE_LEVEL, STUDENT_YEAR ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) mode_stats ON inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = mode_stats.COURSE_LEVEL
sub_questions: For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, and what is the name of the school that department belongs to, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6?

For students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and assign row numbers within each course level group ordered by the student's last name.

For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, and for students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, the student's full name, email address, course description, course level, and the row number assigned within each course level group ordered by the student's last name.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

WITH DeptMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, es.FULL_NAME, es.EMAIL_ADDRESS, es.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, es.COURSE_LEVEL, es.window_column FROM DeptMaxUnits dmu JOIN EECSStudents es ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U', show the reserve catalog key, subject offered key, term code, the academic year, the term description, the tip material key, the tip material status key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the tip material status key and ordered by the academic year. For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, show the department name, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units offered. Additionally, for each department and academic year, provide a grand total row for all subjects in the format of (department name, academic year, null, total subjects, min total units). Present the results ordered by academic year, department name, and reserve catalog key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH LibraryReserveMaterialDetails AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID ), DepartmentStatsRollup AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM DepartmentSubjectStats GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) > 0 OR SUBJECT_ID IS NULL ) SELECT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lrm.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.window_column, dsr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsr.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS dept_academic_year, dsr.SUBJECT_ID, dsr.subject_count, dsr.min_total_units FROM LibraryReserveMaterialDetails lrm JOIN DepartmentStatsRollup dsr ON lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dsr.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dsr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each grade type, and for the corresponding department also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school), as well as the average lecture units for those subjects in the department, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s3.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) s3 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each DLC, show the DLC name and the average geometric mean of the areas of rooms assigned to organizations under that DLC (considering only rooms with area greater than zero), but only include DLCs where this average geometric mean is greater than the overall average geometric mean across all DLCs. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(i.geometric_mean_area) > ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_area) FROM inner_cte ) ;

WITH SpaceUnitInfo AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), DeptGeomMeanArea AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT s.space_unit_name, s.organization_name, s.dlc_name, s.org_dlc_key, s.window_min_space_unit_code, d.geometric_mean_area FROM SpaceUnitInfo s LEFT JOIN DeptGeomMeanArea d ON s.organization_name = d.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each department in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the number of unique space units (with space unit key greater than 100000) associated with the department. For each department, also include a grand total row in the format (department name, department long name, hierarchy level 3 name, null, total unique space units). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), DeptSpaceUnitCount AS ( SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS unique_space_units FROM inner_cte d LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY AND s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SUM(unique_space_units) AS total_unique_space_units FROM DeptSpaceUnitCount GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(unique_space_units) > 0 ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, total_unique_space_units FROM RollupResults ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_CODE

WITH DeptWindowed AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), SpaceUnitWindowed AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS spaceunit_hr_department_name, s.window_column AS spaceunit_window_column FROM DeptWindowed d JOIN SpaceUnitWindowed s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, along with the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects in that department that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. Additionally, for each department, include the total number of such subjects and the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject with required course materials. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_with_required_materials, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.num_subjects_with_required_materials, d.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte s JOIN DeptUnitsStats d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH Subjects2024_12Units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance FROM Subjects2024_12Units s JOIN DeptUnitsStats d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each academic year and department, list either (1) the academic year, academic year description, department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered by that department during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), or (2) for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, the academic year, subject ID, subject title, department name, and the rank of each subject within its academic year and department group ordered by subject ID. Indicate the reason for inclusion as either 'EnrolledStatsByDept' or 'EngineeringSubjects'. The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, department name, enrolled range, enrolled variance, subject ID, subject title, rank, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS window_column, 'EnrolledStatsByDept' AS Reason FROM inner_cte icte UNION ALL SELECT eng.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, eng.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, eng.SUBJECT_ID, eng.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng.window_column, 'EngineeringSubjects' AS Reason FROM EngineeringSubjects eng ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason, SUBJECT_ID;

WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM EnrolledStats es UNION ALL SELECT eng.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, eng.SUBJECT_ID, eng.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng.window_column, 'EngineeringSubjects' AS Reason FROM EngineeringSubjects eng ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, list the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the access level name, the variance of the number of rooms in the building history for buildings with a nonzero number of rooms and assignable area greater than 0, and the total assignable area of those buildings, with the results ordered by major use description and organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.room_count, icte.min_floor, abs.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, abs.num_rooms_variance, abs.total_assignable_area FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(bh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance, SUM(bh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST bh ON b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = bh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE bh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND bh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ) abs ON icte.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = abs.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ORDER BY icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ORDER BY num_rooms_variance DESC;

WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ), AccessLevelStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ORDER BY num_rooms_variance DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, als.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, als.num_rooms_variance FROM RoomStats rs JOIN AccessLevelStats als ON rs.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = als.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each department and cluster type where the average total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term is greater than 8 and the number of subjects with total units greater than 6 is at least 3, give the department name, cluster type, number of subjects, minimum number of enrolled students, average total units, variance of total units, and the maximum subject enrollment number among those subjects, in that order, ordered by the variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptClusterStats AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dcs.CLUSTER_TYPE, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_enrolled_students, dus.avg_units, dus.units_variance FROM DeptClusterStats dcs JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dus.avg_units > 8 AND dcs.subject_count >= 3 ORDER BY dus.units_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.CLUSTER_TYPE, icte.subject_count, icte.min_enrolled_students, icte.avg_units, icte.units_variance, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.CLUSTER_TYPE = icte.CLUSTER_TYPE GROUP BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.CLUSTER_TYPE, icte.subject_count, icte.min_enrolled_students, icte.avg_units, icte.units_variance ORDER BY icte.units_variance DESC;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, the academic year, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and the total number of such courses per department and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.subject_count, ss.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance FROM SubjectStats ss JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance dev ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ss.subject_count DESC, dev.enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_courses_with_rq_materials FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON c.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.enrolled_variance ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name, along with the name of each associated space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit, and the total number of unique HR org unit titles associated with each space unit, considering only space units with a non-null DLC key and organizations with assignable status. Present the results ordered by HR department name, organization name, and descending variance of organization numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_ID, o5.DLC_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o5.window_column, su.SPACE_UNIT, su.org_number_variance, su.org_number_stddev, o5.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM OrgLevel5 o5 JOIN SpaceUnitStats su ON o5.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_ID, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, icte.window_column, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.org_number_variance, icte.org_number_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS unique_hr_org_unit_titles_per_space_unit FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND s.SPACE_UNIT = icte.SPACE_UNIT WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_ID, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, icte.window_column, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.org_number_variance, icte.org_number_stddev ORDER BY icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.org_number_variance DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5

SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;

WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_ID, o5.DLC_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o5.window_column, su.SPACE_UNIT, su.org_number_variance, su.org_number_stddev FROM OrgLevel5 o5 JOIN SpaceUnitStats su ON o5.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.org_number_variance DESC

question: For rooms with area greater than 200, show the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room, the HR department name, the HR org unit title, the HR org unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, and the HR org unit level, for organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.window_column AS room_area_sum, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_key_avg, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON o.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ORDER BY icte.BUILDING_ROOM, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY;

SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1

WITH RoomAreas AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ), OrgAverages AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT ra.BUILDING_ROOM, ra.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ra.DLC_KEY, ra.window_column AS room_area_sum, oa.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, oa.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, oa.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, oa.window_column AS org_key_avg FROM RoomAreas ra JOIN OrgAverages oa ON ra.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area", show the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, and also provide the average, range, and variance of the area of rooms assigned to the department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). Additionally, for each department, show the total number of rooms assigned (with area greater than 40). List the results ordered by school area name and department rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY area_range DESC ), ProvostDeptRanks AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, p.window_column, d.avg_area, d.area_range, d.area_variance, d.DLC_KEY FROM ProvostDeptRanks p JOIN DeptRoomStats d ON p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND p.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.avg_area, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, RoomCounts.total_rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = RoomCounts.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.DLC_KEY = RoomCounts.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte.window_column;

WITH DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY area_range DESC ), ProvostDeptRanks AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, p.window_column, d.avg_area, d.area_range, d.area_variance FROM ProvostDeptRanks p JOIN DeptRoomStats d ON p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND p.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ORDER BY p.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, p.window_column;

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U', show the reserve catalog key, subject offered key, term code, the academic year, the term description, the tip material key, the tip material status key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the tip material status key and ordered by the academic year, along with the average and variance of the record counter for reserve catalog items associated with that material status key where the catalog year is greater than 2000. Additionally, for each result, include the catalog title and catalog author name from the reserve catalog. Present the results ordered by academic year descending and record counter variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), MaterialStatusStats AS ( SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY record_counter_variance DESC ) SELECT ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, ic.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.window_column, mss.avg_record_counter, mss.record_counter_variance, rc.CATALOG_TITLE, rc.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MaterialStatusStats mss ON ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = mss.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG rc ON ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, mss.record_counter_variance DESC

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'

SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY record_counter_variance DESC;

WITH ReserveMaterialDetails AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), MaterialStatusStats AS ( SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY record_counter_variance DESC ) SELECT rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, rmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, rmd.TERM_CODE, rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rmd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rmd.window_column, mss.avg_record_counter, mss.record_counter_variance FROM ReserveMaterialDetails rmd JOIN MaterialStatusStats mss ON rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = mss.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, mss.record_counter_variance DESC

question: For Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the term start date, calendar date, day of week, and the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, but only for academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', and only include results where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average number of enrolled students for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t1.TERM_START_DATE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), AvgEnrolled AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column AS math_window_column, p.TERM_START_DATE, p.CALENDAR_DATE, p.DAY_OF_WEEK, p.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN PreviousTerms p ON i.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE JOIN AvgEnrolled a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.COURSE_NUMBER, p.TERM_START_DATE;
sub_questions: For courses offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and assign row numbers within each academic year group ordered by course number.

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5

SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'

WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT m.COURSE_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.window_column AS math_window_column, p.TERM_START_DATE, p.CALENDAR_DATE, p.DAY_OF_WEEK, p.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column FROM MathCourses m JOIN PreviousTerms p ON m.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, TERM_START_DATE;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, with the results for both the most recent academic year and regular academic terms shown side by side for each department? Additionally, for each department, show the total number of subjects offered in the most recent academic year and in regular academic terms, and include a grand total row for all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year_stats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), regular_term_stats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mry.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, mry.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, mry.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, mry.num_subjects AS most_recent_year_num_subjects, rts.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, rts.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, rts.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance, rts.num_subjects AS regular_term_num_subjects FROM most_recent_year_stats mry JOIN regular_term_stats rts ON mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, most_recent_year_avg_total_units, most_recent_year_total_units_range, most_recent_year_total_units_variance, most_recent_year_num_subjects, regular_term_avg_total_units, regular_term_total_units_range, regular_term_total_units_variance, regular_term_num_subjects FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT 'ALL DEPARTMENTS' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(most_recent_year_avg_total_units), MAX(most_recent_year_total_units_range), VARIANCE(most_recent_year_total_units_variance), SUM(most_recent_year_num_subjects), AVG(regular_term_avg_total_units), MAX(regular_term_total_units_range), VARIANCE(regular_term_total_units_variance), SUM(regular_term_num_subjects) FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;
