sub_sqls: SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH most_recent_year_stats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), regular_term_stats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mry.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, mry.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, mry.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, rts.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, rts.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, rts.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance FROM most_recent_year_stats mry JOIN regular_term_stats rts ON mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of that number, the school name, and the department phone number. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEng2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.subject_count, de.total_enrollment, ds.avg_subject_codes, ds.stddev_subject_codes FROM DeptEng2021 de JOIN DeptSubjectStats ds ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cd.subject_count, cd.total_enrollment, cd.avg_subject_codes, cd.stddev_subject_codes, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM CombinedDepts cd LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY department_name_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, department_code, department_full_name, subject_count, total_enrollment, avg_subject_codes, stddev_subject_codes, school_name, department_phone_number FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, subject_count, total_enrollment, avg_subject_codes, stddev_subject_codes, SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, avg_subject_codes, stddev_subject_codes, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY department_name_sort;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects.

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments.

For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and the standard deviation of that number. List the results ordered by department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC;

WITH DeptEng2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.subject_count, de.total_enrollment, ds.avg_subject_codes, ds.stddev_subject_codes FROM DeptEng2021 de JOIN DeptSubjectStats ds ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', and the maximum number of lecture units among those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCatalogVariance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), YearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_total_units, dcv.catalog_key_variance FROM YearDeptSubjectStats yds JOIN DeptCatalogVariance dcv ON yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcv.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.catalog_key_variance, MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.catalog_key_variance ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the name of the department and the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U'?
For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects.

For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U'.
sub_sqls: SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DeptCatalogVariance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), YearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_total_units, dcv.catalog_key_variance FROM YearDeptSubjectStats yds JOIN DeptCatalogVariance dcv ON yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcv.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, provide the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), and the total research volume for each organization (considering only research volumes greater than zero), listing the columns in the order: major use description, organization name, number of rooms, minimum floor number, geometric mean of supervisees, and total research volume. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgSuperviseeStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgResearchVolume AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.RESEARCH_VOLUME > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, os.geometric_mean_supervisees, orv.total_research_volume FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN OrgSuperviseeStats os ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN OrgResearchVolume orv ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = orv.ORGANIZATION_NAME;
sub_questions: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, give the number of rooms and the minimum floor number.

For each organization, what is the organization name and the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department, considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero?

For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, give the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, and the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), listing the columns in the order: major use description, organization name, number of rooms, minimum floor number, and geometric mean of supervisees.
sub_sqls: SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC;

WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgSuperviseeStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC ) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, os.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM RoomStats rs LEFT JOIN OrgSuperviseeStats os ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each department, either (a) list the department name, average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (for degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), or (b) list the department name and total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and also show the number of unique subjects offered by that department. For each row, include a reason for inclusion ('DegreeGrantingStats' for the first case and 'EngineeringTotals' for the second). Show the department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total enrollment, number of unique subjects, and reason, in that order, sorted by department name and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS total_enrollment, NULL AS num_unique_subjects, 'DegreeGrantingStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte d UNION ALL SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, 'EngineeringTotals' AS Reason FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students?

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50.

List, for each department, either (a) the department name, average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (for degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), or (b) the department name and total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50. For each row, include a reason for inclusion ('DegreeGrantingStats' for the first case and 'EngineeringTotals' for the second). Show the department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation, total enrollment, and reason, in that order, sorted by department name and reason.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), EngineeringDeptTotals AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS total_enrollment, 'DegreeGrantingStats' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollmentStats d UNION ALL SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, e.total_enrollment, 'EngineeringTotals' AS Reason FROM EngineeringDeptTotals e ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name. For each such organization, for each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group. Additionally, for each such room, show the HR org unit title and HR org unit level from the HR_ORG_UNIT table (joined via DLC_KEY), and the difference between the room's area and the minimum area for its major use. Order the results by HR department name, organization name, and major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgInfo AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), RoomInfo AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, o.DLC_KEY, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, (r.AREA - r.min_area_per_major_use) AS area_deviation FROM OrgInfo o JOIN RoomInfo r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_ID, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE_FROM_HR, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL_FROM_HR, inner_cte.area_deviation FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE;
sub_questions: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name.

For each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group, ordered by major use.

For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name, and for each such organization, for each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group, ordered by HR department name, organization name, and major use.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5

SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1

WITH OrgInfo AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), RoomInfo AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use FROM OrgInfo o JOIN RoomInfo r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.MAJOR_USE

question: List the offering department names, their corresponding subject codes, subject titles, and the total number of unique subjects per department for all departments that have at least one course with TIP material status 'RQ' and where the course has more than 0 total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For each department offering a course, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in those courses, considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0?
For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects.

For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0), along with the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects, listing the offering department name, offering school name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, subject count, and minimum total units in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each term and department in the School of Engineering, list the term, department, the number of subjects offered with at least 6 total units, the average number of enrolled students in those subjects, the school name, and the department full name. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.TERM_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ss ON s.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subj_cnt, avg_enrolled_students, school_name, department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subj_cnt, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, and assign row numbers within each department name group ordered by subject ID.

For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school, ordered by subject ID.

For subjects offered in the term 2019FA that are also offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID, and the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS engineering_running_sum_units FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300 and located in buildings with more than 100 rooms, and for each such room's organization that is associated with a space unit with a non-null DLC key and assignable status, show the building's long name, the room's full name, the room's area, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building's long name, the name of the space unit, the associated organization name, the variance of the organization numbers, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit, and the maximum organization number among those organizations. List the results ordered by the building's long name and descending variance of organization numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomWindow AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT rw.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, rw.ROOM_FULL_NAME, rw.AREA, rw.window_column, sus.SPACE_UNIT, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.org_number_variance, sus.org_number_stddev, sus.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM RoomWindow rw JOIN SpaceUnitStats sus ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sus.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rw.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, sus.org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.ROOM_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.org_number_variance, inner_cte.org_number_stddev, MAX(o2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_org_number FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o2 ON su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.ROOM_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.org_number_variance, inner_cte.org_number_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.org_number_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For rooms with an area greater than 300 and located in buildings with more than 100 rooms, show the building's long name, the room's full name, the room's area, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building's long name.

For each space unit, what is the name of the space unit, the associated organization name, and both the variance and standard deviation of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit, considering only space units with a non-null DLC key and organizations with assignable status?

For rooms with an area greater than 300 and located in buildings with more than 100 rooms, and for each such room's organization that is associated with a space unit with a non-null DLC key and assignable status, show the building's long name, the room's full name, the room's area, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building's long name, the name of the space unit, the associated organization name, the variance of the organization numbers, and the standard deviation of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit. List the results ordered by the building's long name and descending variance of organization numbers.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100

SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;

WITH RoomWindow AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT rw.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, rw.ROOM_FULL_NAME, rw.AREA, rw.window_column, sus.SPACE_UNIT, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.org_number_variance, sus.org_number_stddev FROM RoomWindow rw JOIN SpaceUnitStats sus ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sus.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rw.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, sus.org_number_variance DESC

question: For each department-level organization whose DLC key is not null and which has rooms with area greater than 0, and which also has organization level 5, give the organization name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization, the dense rank of its corresponding HR department name considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the HR department code from the HR organization unit table, and the total number of unique buildings in which the organization's rooms are located. Show the organization name, area variance, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the dense rank, and the building count in that order, ordered by area variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.area_variance, ors.area_stddev, ohr.window_column FROM ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ) ors JOIN ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) ohr ON ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_count FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.window_column ORDER BY inner_cte.area_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department-level organization, give the organization name and both the variance and standard deviation of the area of rooms assigned to that organization, but only include organizations whose DLC key is not null and only include rooms with area greater than 0.

Show the organization name, area variance, area standard deviation, and the dense rank in that order, ordered by area variance descending.

WITH OrgRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), OrgHRRank AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.area_variance, ors.area_stddev, ohr.window_column FROM OrgRoomStats ors JOIN OrgHRRank ohr ON ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ors.area_variance DESC;

question: For each activity, list the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, and the average maximum enrollment for activities in the same category. Only include activities where the maximum enrollment is greater than the average maximum enrollment for all activities. Present the results ordered by category name and activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d2 WHERE d2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) AS avg_max_enrollment_in_category FROM inner_cte i WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > ( SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL ) ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.ACTIVITY_TITLE;
sub_questions: List the activity title, enrollment type, and maximum enrollment for each activity, along with the category name, and show the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name.

For IAP subjects in the "Mathematics" category, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, and assign row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title.

For each activity, list the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the dense rank of the activity within its category (partitioned by category name and ordered by category name), and, if the activity is in the "Mathematics" category, the row number of the activity within its enrollment type group ordered by activity title; otherwise, show null for the row number. Present the results ordered by category name and activity title.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH ActivityCategoryRank AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), MathEnrollmentRowNum AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT acr.ACTIVITY_TITLE, acr.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, acr.MAX_ENROLLMENT, acr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, acr.window_column AS category_dense_rank, mer.window_column AS math_enrollment_row_number FROM ActivityCategoryRank acr LEFT JOIN MathEnrollmentRowNum mer ON acr.ACTIVITY_TITLE = mer.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND acr.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = mer.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND acr.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = mer.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ORDER BY acr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, acr.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each department in the Provost Area with a non-null department code, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, the average space unit key for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000 and matching DLC key, and classify each department as 'LARGE_SPACE' if the average space unit key is at least 20% greater than the overall average, 'SMALL_SPACE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Show the columns in this order: department name, department long name, hierarchy level 3 name, average space unit key, and space size category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), space_avg AS ( SELECT s.DLC_KEY, AVG(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS avg_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT s WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY s.DLC_KEY ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS overall_avg_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT WHERE SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, sa.avg_space_unit_key, CASE WHEN sa.avg_space_unit_key > oa.overall_avg_space_unit_key * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_SPACE' WHEN sa.avg_space_unit_key < oa.overall_avg_space_unit_key * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_SPACE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS space_size_category FROM inner_cte d JOIN space_avg sa ON d.DLC_KEY = sa.DLC_KEY CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name, for departments in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code.

For space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, show the space unit code, the organization name, the HR department name, and the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, ordered by space unit key.

For each department in the Provost Area with a non-null department code, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name, the space unit code for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, the organization name, the HR department name from the space unit, and the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group ordered by space unit key, for departments and space units that share the same DLC key. The columns should be shown in the following order: department name, department long name, hierarchy level 3 name, department window column, space unit code, organization name, HR department name from the space unit, and space unit window column.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL

SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000

WITH DeptWindowed AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), SpaceUnitWindowed AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS spaceunit_hr_department_name, s.window_column AS spaceunit_window_column FROM DeptWindowed d JOIN SpaceUnitWindowed s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For each department in the School of Engineering where the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department is greater than 50, what is the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, the variance of the total units for those courses, and the maximum number of enrolled students in any single course offered by that department? Please list the department name, total enrollment, average units, units variance, and maximum course enrollment in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance, m.max_course_enrollment FROM inner_cte e JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_course_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) m ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

For each department in the School of Engineering where the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department is greater than 50, what is the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and the variance of the total units for those courses? Please list the department name, total enrollment, average units, and units variance in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC;

WITH dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance FROM dept_enrollment e JOIN dept_units_stats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For rooms in building E38, show the building room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, office location, full name of the employee, department name, and the average area of rooms in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department number and ordered by floor, along with the space unit name, the average HR organization unit ID, the variance of the HR organization unit IDs associated with the space unit for the organization of the room, and the HR organization unit title and HR department name for the organization of the room. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38' ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC ) SELECT e.BUILDING_ROOM, e.FLOOR, e.MAJOR_USE_DESC, e.ORGANIZATION_NAME, e.OFFICE_LOCATION, e.FULL_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.avg_org_unit_id, s.org_unit_id_variance, s.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte e JOIN SpaceUnitStats s ON e.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC;

WITH E38Rooms AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38' ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC ) SELECT e.BUILDING_ROOM, e.FLOOR, e.MAJOR_USE_DESC, e.ORGANIZATION_NAME, e.OFFICE_LOCATION, e.FULL_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.avg_org_unit_id, s.org_unit_id_variance FROM E38Rooms e JOIN SpaceUnitStats s ON e.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

question: For each academic year and department, list the academic year, department name, average total units, variance of total units for subjects offered in regular terms, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the number of subjects in that department and year that have at least one required course material. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgVarTotalUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM AvgVarTotalUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, COALESCE(s.subjects_with_required_materials, 0) AS subjects_with_required_materials FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_with_required_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND t.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) s ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.var_total_units DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

WITH AvgVarTotalUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM AvgVarTotalUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the total number of subjects offered by the department in 2022? Please provide the department name, the variance of total units, the variance of enrolled students, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and the total number of subjects offered, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dev.enrolled_students_variance, dev.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptUnitsVariance duv JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY duv.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, COALESCE(subject_count.subjects_offered, 0) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_offered FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subject_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subject_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year?

For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description? Please provide the department name, the variance of total units, the variance of enrolled students, and the standard deviation of enrolled students, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dev.enrolled_students_variance, dev.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptUnitsVariance duv JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY duv.total_units_variance DESC

question: For each degree-granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, subject code description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, and, for each course, provide the number of subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 that are variable unit subjects, as well as the percentage of such variable unit subjects out of all subjects offered by that department in 2022.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM EngDegreeCourses edc LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptVariableUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS variable_unit_count, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.window_column, dvu.variable_unit_count, ROUND(100.0 * dvu.variable_unit_count / NULLIF(dvu.total_subjects,0), 2) AS percent_variable_unit_subjects FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DeptVariableUnits dvu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dvu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
