WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM EngDegreeCourses edc LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: Show the department full names, subject titles, total units, and the number of unique course materials per subject for subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering. For each subject, also provide the material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, course number description, offering department name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, where the subject title and department code match between the subject and course material datasets. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, mat_count.num_materials, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ) s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t0d ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t0d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t0 ON t2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ) mat_count ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mat_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = mat_count.SUBJECT_TITLE
sub_questions: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject title, total units, department full name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.

For each course material detail, provide the material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, the course number description, the subject title, the offering department name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key.

Additionally, for each matching course material detail, provide the material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, the course number description, the offering department name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key. The results should include the subject title, total units, department full name, window row number, material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, course number description, offering department name, and the maximum number of enrolled students, in that order, for subjects and course materials where the subject title and department code match between the two datasets.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'

SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each academic year, which department had the highest average number of enrolled students in fall term subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and what is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Please provide the academic year, department name, highest average enrollment, minimum academic year, and total units sum, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MaxDeptAvgEnrollment AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) m ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.avg_enrollment = m.max_avg_enrollment ), MinYearTotalUnits AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.avg_enrollment, t.min_academic_year, t.total_units_sum FROM MaxDeptAvgEnrollment m CROSS JOIN MinYearTotalUnits t ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students? Please provide the academic year and these statistics.
What is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, considering only library reserve material details with material status 'U'?

For each academic year, what are the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students), together with the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Please provide the academic year, average enrollment, enrollment variance, minimum academic year, and total units sum, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y';

WITH AvgVarEnrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), MinYearTotalUnits AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.avg_enrollment, a.enrollment_variance, m.min_academic_year, m.total_units_sum FROM AvgVarEnrollment a CROSS JOIN MinYearTotalUnits m ORDER BY a.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each administrative department and each subject offered by that department in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students who have a non-null office phone number), the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students for the subject is at least 20% above the window average ('ABOVE_AVERAGE'), at least 20% below the window average ('BELOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Order the results by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptPhoneStats AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC ), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dps.avg_office_phone, dps.stddev_office_phone, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.window_column FROM DeptPhoneStats dps JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats ses ON dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = ses.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > inner_cte.window_column * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < inner_cte.window_column * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each administrative department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the office phone numbers of students in that department, considering only students who have a non-null office phone number.

For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, ordered by the subject title.

For each administrative department and each subject offered by that department in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, give the department name, the average and standard deviation of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students who have a non-null office phone number), the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, ordered by the department name and subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0

WITH DeptPhoneStats AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC ), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dps.avg_office_phone, dps.stddev_office_phone, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.window_column FROM DeptPhoneStats dps JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats ses ON dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = ses.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: From the top 10 department and academic year combinations with the highest number of unique subjects (where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10), display each department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ', as well as the subject with the highest enrollment in that group and its enrollment number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptMaxEnrolledSubject AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC ) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance, dms.SUBJECT_ID AS max_enrolled_subject_id, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_enrolled_subject_title, dms.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptMaxEnrolledSubject dms ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dms.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dms.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered.

For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ'?

For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ'. Also, for each department that has the variance of enrolled students in such courses but does not appear in the first group, include the department name and the variance, with academic year, number of unique subjects, and minimum total units as null.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC;

WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptEnrolledVariance dev LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectStats dss ON dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_total_units, enrolled_variance FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', and also offered courses in the term '2019FA' that are offered by both the library and the TIP system with more than 10 enrolled students, and where the average total units for the department is greater than 3, provide the department name, the average of the total units, the variance of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the total number of enrolled students, in that order, ordered by the variance of the total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, des.total_enrolled FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStats des ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE ic.avg_total_units > 3 ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC

sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10;

WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, des.total_enrolled FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStats des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name. For each such organization, for each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use that belongs to the organization, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group. Additionally, for each such room, show the HR org unit key and the HR org unit title from the HR_ORG_UNIT table (joined via DLC_KEY). Present the results with the columns: organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, row number, building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, minimum area per major use, HR org unit key, and HR org unit title, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), LargeAssignableRooms AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON o.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', but only include departments where the average total units for such subjects is greater than the overall average total units for all subjects with library reserve materials in 'Previous' terms. The columns should be: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average total units, total units variance, and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH enrolled_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), units_stats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM enrolled_stats e LEFT JOIN units_stats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, enrolled_stddev, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' );

WITH enrolled_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), units_stats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM enrolled_stats e LEFT JOIN units_stats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department and course number, show the department name, the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term (where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10), the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the number of unique responsible faculty members for those subjects, but only include department and course number pairs where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units, lss.unique_faculty_count FROM inner_cte de JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS unique_faculty_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY so ON l.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lss.COURSE_NUMBER;

WITH DepartmentEnrollments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), LibrarySubjectStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units FROM DepartmentEnrollments de JOIN LibrarySubjectStats lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lss.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', what are the subject title, the offering department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description), the count of reserved materials, and the total number of units for each subject? Please provide the subject title, the offering department name, the variance, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the count of reserved materials, and the total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), TopReservedSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, trs.reserved_materials, soss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM TopReservedSubjects trs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY soss ON trs.SUBJECT_TITLE = soss.SUBJECT_TITLE AND trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = soss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), TopReservedSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, trs.reserved_materials FROM TopReservedSubjects trs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC;

question: Among all Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, list the top 10 courses with the highest enrollment. For each, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that academic year, and the subject title with the highest enrollment in that academic year along with its enrollment count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearlyVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), MaxEnrolledSubject AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column, yv.coefficient_of_variation, mes.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_enrolled_subject_title, mes.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN YearlyVariation yv ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yv.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN MaxEnrolledSubject mes ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mes.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mes.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearlyVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yv.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathCourses mc JOIN YearlyVariation yv ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each organization whose parent is 'S H&SS' and that is associated with a space unit with space unit code 97500, list the organization name, description, HR org unit title, row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name, the space unit name, space unit code, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group ordered by number of supervisees, and the total square footage for each organization. Include subtotals for each organization (the corresponding organization name field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all organizations (the corresponding organization name field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the organization name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by organization name and space unit name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgWindowed AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t2.SQFT, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column, sus.space_unit_name, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.DEPT_COUNT, sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sus.avg_dept_count_within_group, sus.SQFT FROM OrgWindowed ow JOIN SpaceUnitStats sus ON ow.DLC_KEY = sus.DLC_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY org_sort, space_unit_name) = ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, DESCRIPTION, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, window_column, space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, avg_dept_count_within_group, SQFT, SUM(SQFT) OVER (PARTITION BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS total_sqft_per_org FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, window_column, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE space_unit_name END AS space_unit_sort, space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, avg_dept_count_within_group, SQFT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, window_column, space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, avg_dept_count_within_group, SQFT WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY org_sort, space_unit_sort;

question: For each department, what is the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0? Additionally, for each department, provide the number of unique subject codes offered in 2022 that are also in the CIS course catalog. Present the department name, units range, variance of units range, average units, variance of average units, and the count of unique subject codes in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), dept_avg_variance_units AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ), dept_subject_code_count AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance AS range_variance, dau.avg_units, dau.units_variance AS avg_variance, dscc.unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte JOIN dept_avg_variance_units dau ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dau.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_subject_code_count dscc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dscc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH dept_units_range_variance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), dept_avg_variance_units AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dr.units_range, dr.units_variance AS range_variance, da.avg_units, da.units_variance AS avg_variance FROM dept_units_range_variance dr JOIN dept_avg_variance_units da ON dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', but only include departments where the average number of unique subject codes is greater than the overall average across all departments. List the columns in the order: department name, average subject codes, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subject codes, and enrolled variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_subject_codes, stddev_subject_codes, enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_subject_codes > (SELECT AVG(avg_subject_codes) FROM inner_cte);

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC;

WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each IAP subject that is not cancelled and has a non-null maximum enrollment and also has a maximum enrollment of 12, list the activity title, enrollment type, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, offer department code, the dense rank over the offer department code ordered by offer department code, the responsible faculty MIT ID, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the responsible faculty MIT ID and ordered by the number of enrolled students, and for each offer department code, include a grand total of the number of enrolled students in the format of (nulls for all columns except offer department code and total enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH iap_subjects_not_cancelled AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ), iap_subjects_max_enrollment_12 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, AVG(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ORDER BY t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inc.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inc.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inc.SUBJECT_TITLE, inc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, inc.window_column AS dense_rank_over_offer_dept_code, ime12.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, ime12.window_column AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM iap_subjects_not_cancelled inc JOIN iap_subjects_max_enrollment_12 ime12 ON inc.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ime12.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inc.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ime12.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND inc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ime12.TERM_DESCRIPTION AND inc.SUBJECT_TITLE = ime12.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ime12.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ) , dept_totals AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dt.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, i.dense_rank_over_offer_dept_code, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, dt.total_enrolled_students FROM dept_totals dt LEFT JOIN inner_cte i ON dt.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dt.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, the variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term for each department, and the total number of students enrolled in each subject in the 2012SU term. List the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, average subject enrollment number in window, total units variance, and total number of students enrolled in 2012SU in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Subquery3 AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_students_2012SU FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, s2.total_units_variance, COALESCE(s3.total_students_2012SU, 0) AS total_students_2012SU FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON icte.join_department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN Subquery3 s3 ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = SUBSTRING(s3.SUBJECT_ID, 1, LENGTH(icte.SUBJECT_CODE))

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.join_department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: From the top 10 DLC and academic year combinations (where the DLC name matches the department name and the term status is 'Previous') with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC (considering only rooms with an area greater than 0), display the DLC key, DLC name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the subject with the highest total units along with its subject title and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, s.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) s ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;
sub_questions: For each DLC, give the DLC name and the coefficient of variation of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC, considering only rooms with an area greater than 0.
For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects.

For each DLC and academic year where the DLC name matches the department name and the term status is 'Previous', provide the DLC key, DLC name, coefficient of variation of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC (considering only rooms with an area greater than 0), academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects, listing the columns in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its courses greater than 50, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and the number of unique faculty members responsible for those courses. Order the results by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance, COALESCE(f.num_faculty, 0) AS num_unique_faculty FROM inner_cte e JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS num_faculty FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t WHERE t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) f ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = f.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC;

WITH DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance FROM DeptEnrollment e JOIN DeptUnitsStats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that has a maximum total units of any course greater than 6, list the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, the name of the school that department belongs to, and the number of unique subject titles offered by that department in 2022. Order the results by the number of unique subject titles descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH UnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), MaxUnitsSchool AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT us.DEPARTMENT_NAME, us.units_range, us.units_variance, mu.max_total_units, mu.SCHOOL_NAME FROM UnitsStats us JOIN MaxUnitsSchool mu ON us.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.units_variance, icte.max_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CCSO.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_subject_titles_2022 FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = CCSO.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.units_variance, icte.max_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY unique_subject_titles_2022 DESC;

For each department that has a maximum total units of any course greater than 6, list the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, the name of the school that department belongs to, and calculate the normalized range ratio rounded (the range of total units divided by the maximum total units in that department), ordered by normalized range ratio descending.
sub_sqls: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

WITH UnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), MaxUnitsSchool AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT us.DEPARTMENT_NAME, us.units_range, us.units_variance, mu.max_total_units, mu.SCHOOL_NAME, ROUND(us.units_range / NULLIF(mu.max_total_units, 0), 2) AS normalized_range_ratio FROM UnitsStats us JOIN MaxUnitsSchool mu ON us.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_range_ratio DESC;

question: For each department that is a degree-granting department and also an Engineering department with more than 50 total enrolled students in its offered courses, what is the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the variance of the number of enrolled students, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, and the maximum number of enrolled students in any single subject offered by that department? List the results ordered by the variance of the number of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), EngineeringDeptTotals AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dts.avg_enrollment, dts.enrollment_variance, dts.enrollment_stddev, edt.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats dts JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals edt ON dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dts.enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, icte.total_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment_in_subject FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, icte.total_enrollment ORDER BY icte.enrollment_variance DESC;
