sub_sqls: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC;

SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2

WITH DLCOrgStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ), Floor2RoomStats AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DLC_NAME FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT d.DLC_NAME, d.org_number_stddev, f.BUILDING_ROOM, f.SPACE_USAGE, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.window_column FROM DLCOrgStddev d JOIN Floor2RoomStats f ON d.DLC_NAME = f.DLC_NAME ORDER BY d.org_number_stddev DESC, f.BUILDING_ROOM

question: For subjects offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject title, department name, total units, assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for each such subject, also show the highest number of lecture units among subjects offered by the same department in the Fall term of 2022 (considering only departments with subjects having more than 3 lecture units in 2022FA), the start date of the 2022FA term, and the number of distinct subjects offered by the same department in 2022FA. The columns should be: subject title, department name, total units, window row number, highest lecture units in 2022FA, 2022FA term start date, and count of distinct subjects in 2022FA. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name_1 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), dept_2022fa_stats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count_2022fa FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, d22.max_lecture_units, d22.TERM_START_DATE, d22.subject_count_2022fa FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_2022fa_stats d22 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d22.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name_1 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.max_lecture_units, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each space unit and its associated organization, list the space unit name, organization name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null. Additionally, include the HR org unit title and HR org unit level for each HR org unit linked to the space unit. Do not repeat the space unit name if it is the same as the previous row. List the results ordered by the HR department code range (descending), then by the variance of the HR department codes (old) (descending), and then by HR org unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ), OrgStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old, s.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte s JOIN OrgStats o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(cs.SPACE_UNIT) OVER (ORDER BY cs.hr_dept_code_range DESC, cs.var_dept_code_old DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) = cs.SPACE_UNIT THEN NULL ELSE cs.SPACE_UNIT END AS SPACE_UNIT, cs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cs.avg_hr_dept_code, cs.hr_dept_code_range, cs.hr_dept_code_variance, cs.avg_dept_code_old, cs.var_dept_code_old, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM CombinedStats cs JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON cs.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' ORDER BY cs.hr_dept_code_range DESC, cs.var_dept_code_old DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For each space unit, what is the space unit name, the associated organization name, and the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit, considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'?

For each space unit, what is the space unit name, the associated organization name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null? List the results ordered by the HR department code range (descending) and then by the variance of the HR department codes (old) (descending).
sub_sqls: SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC;

SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC;

WITH SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ), OrgStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old FROM SpaceUnitStats s JOIN OrgStats o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC, var_dept_code_old DESC;

question: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5 and the academic year has terms that are current or previous terms, what are the academic year, academic year description, variance of the record count of tip details for those terms, department name, number of unique subjects offered, the minimum number of total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects? List the results ordered by academic year and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AcademicYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.record_count_variance, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM AcademicYearVariance ayv JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms?

For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for those subjects.

For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5 and the academic year has terms that are current or previous terms, what are the academic year, academic year description, variance of the record count of tip details for those terms, department name, number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum number of total units for those subjects? List the results ordered by academic year and department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH AcademicYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.record_count_variance, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM AcademicYearVariance ayv JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021 and has more than 10 tip materials for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of tip materials, the average number of enrolled students per subject (rounded to two decimal places), and the ratio of total enrolled students to total tip materials (rounded to two decimal places), listing the results in descending order of the average number of enrolled students per subject.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, dtm.total_tip_materials, ROUND(icte.total_enrollment / NULLIF(icte.subject_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Enrollment_per_Subject, ROUND(icte.total_enrollment / NULLIF(dtm.total_tip_materials, 0), 2) AS Enrollment_per_TipMaterial FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) dtm ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Avg_Enrollment_per_Subject DESC;
sub_questions: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms, where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10.

For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021 and has more than 10 tip materials for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of tip materials, the ratio of total enrolled students to total tip materials rounded to two decimal places, and the ratio of number of subjects offered to total tip materials rounded to two decimal places, listing the results in descending order of the ratio of total enrolled students to total tip materials.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10;

WITH DeptSubjects AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptTipMaterials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.subject_count, ds.total_enrollment, dtm.total_tip_materials, ROUND(ds.total_enrollment / NULLIF(dtm.total_tip_materials, 0), 2) AS Enrollment_per_TipMaterial, ROUND(ds.subject_count / NULLIF(dtm.total_tip_materials, 0), 2) AS Subjects_per_TipMaterial FROM DeptSubjects ds JOIN DeptTipMaterials dtm ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Enrollment_per_TipMaterial DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group. Also, for each subject, provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year in the same department, and indicate whether the subject is a 'HIGH_LOAD' (if its number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the department's average total units), 'LOW_LOAD' (if at least 10% less), or 'AVERAGE_LOAD' otherwise. Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > s2.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < s2.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_LOAD' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by subject code.
For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year.

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, along with the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year in the same department, and calculate the normalized enrollment to units ratio (number of enrolled students divided by average total units, rounded to two decimals), ordered by subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'

SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, ROUND(s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s2.avg_total_units, 0), 2) AS normalized_enrollment_to_units FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each offering department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered in the term with code '2025FA'? Show the offering department name and the highest number of enrolled students for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t3 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' AND t3.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by offering department.

For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject title, total units, department full name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.

For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, total units, department full name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, ordered by offering department name and subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For all organizations that either have a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' (showing their organization key, organization name, DLC name, and their rank within each DLC name group ordered by organization key) or are assignable with a department code above 100000 (showing their organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, and the total of their department IDs), provide, for each, the highest HR department ID among their associated HR org units. The columns should be: organization key, organization name, DLC name, rank, department name, number of HR org units, total of department IDs, reason for inclusion, and highest HR department ID, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DLCMechOrgs AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ), AssignableLargeDeptOrgs AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedOrgs AS ( SELECT d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.DLC_NAME, d.window_column, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS hr_org_unit_count, NULL AS total_department_id, 'DLC_MECHE' AS Reason FROM DLCMechOrgs d UNION ALL SELECT a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS DLC_NAME, NULL AS window_column, a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.hr_org_unit_count, a.total_department_id, 'ASSIGNABLE_LARGE_DEPT' AS Reason FROM AssignableLargeDeptOrgs a ) SELECT * FROM CombinedOrgs ) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_NAME, i.window_column, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, i.Reason, MAX(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS highest_hr_department_id FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_NAME, i.window_column, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, i.Reason ORDER BY i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.Reason;
sub_questions: For each organization with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE', show the organization key, organization name, DLC name, and the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key.

For each organization, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, and the total of their department IDs, for organizations that are assignable and have a department code above 100000.

List all organizations that either have a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' (showing their organization key, organization name, DLC name, and their rank within each DLC name group ordered by organization key) or are assignable with a department code above 100000 (showing their organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, and the total of their department IDs), along with the reason for inclusion ('DLC_MECHE' for the first group and 'ASSIGNABLE_LARGE_DEPT' for the second group). The columns should be: organization key, organization name, DLC name, rank, department name, number of HR org units, total of department IDs, and reason for inclusion, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE'

SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DLCMechOrgs AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ), AssignableLargeDeptOrgs AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedOrgs AS ( SELECT d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.DLC_NAME, d.window_column, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS hr_org_unit_count, NULL AS total_department_id, 'DLC_MECHE' AS Reason FROM DLCMechOrgs d UNION ALL SELECT a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS DLC_NAME, NULL AS window_column, a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.hr_org_unit_count, a.total_department_id, 'ASSIGNABLE_LARGE_DEPT' AS Reason FROM AssignableLargeDeptOrgs a ) SELECT * FROM CombinedOrgs ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, Reason;

question: For each department name and course level, provide the department name, course level, number of unique degree granting courses with total units greater than 6, the minimum total units offered, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department, as well as the average total units for those courses, but only include results where the number of unique courses is more than 2 and the department's range of total units is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.course_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.total_units_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_avg FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dus ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE inner_cte.course_count > 2 AND dus.total_units_range > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL;
sub_questions: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units offered.
For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for courses offered by that department.

For each department name and course level where the number of unique degree granting courses with total units greater than 6 is more than 2 and the department's range of total units is greater than 0, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for courses offered by that department, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH DegreeGrantingCourses AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), DepartmentUnitStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgc.COURSE_LEVEL, dgc.course_count, dgc.min_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DegreeGrantingCourses dgc JOIN DepartmentUnitStats dus ON dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dgc.course_count > 2 AND dus.total_units_range > 0 ORDER BY dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgc.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each department hierarchy, provide the department hierarchy name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, and for each department in that hierarchy, give the department's name, the maximum and minimum area of rooms assigned to that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), and the difference between the department's average room area and the overall average room area for all such rooms. Present the results ordered by department hierarchy name and then by the difference in average area in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ), dept_room_area_ext AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) AS max_area, MIN(r.AREA) AS min_area, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_dept_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), overall_avg_area AS ( SELECT AVG(AREA) AS overall_avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS WHERE AREA > 40 ) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, drae.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drae.max_area, drae.min_area, (drae.avg_dept_area - oaa.overall_avg_area) AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_room_area_ext drae ON icte.DLC_NAME = drae.DLC_NAME CROSS JOIN overall_avg_area oaa ORDER BY icte.DLC_NAME, diff_from_overall_avg DESC;

For each department, give the department's name and calculate the range and variance of the areas of rooms assigned to it, considering only rooms with an area greater than 40.

For each department hierarchy and its departments, give the department hierarchy name, the average and standard deviation of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, the department's name, and the range and variance of the areas of rooms assigned to that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). sub_sqls: SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC;

SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC;

WITH dept_hierarchy_org_levels AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC ), dept_room_area_stats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ) SELECT dhol.DLC_NAME, dhol.avg_org_level, dhol.org_level_stddev, dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dras.area_range, dras.area_variance FROM dept_hierarchy_org_levels dhol JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON dhol.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN dept_room_area_stats dras ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME GROUP BY dhol.DLC_NAME, dhol.avg_org_level, dhol.org_level_stddev, dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dras.area_range, dras.area_variance ORDER BY dhol.DLC_NAME, dras.area_range DESC;

question: For each academic year and department, show the academic year, academic year description, department name, the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms, the range of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered for terms that are not the current term, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered for terms that are not the current term. Include subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding academic year field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all academic years (the corresponding academic year field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RecordCountVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept, rcv.record_count_variance, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountVariance rcv JOIN EnrolledStats es ON rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND rcv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC END AS academic_year_desc, dept, record_count_variance, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC END AS academic_year_desc_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dept END AS dept_sort, dept, SUM(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance, MAX(enrolled_range) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(enrolled_variance) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY academic_year_sort, dept_sort;

sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

WITH RecordCountVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcv.record_count_variance, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountVariance rcv JOIN EnrolledStats es ON rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each tip detail record where the material status key is 'RQ' and the term description matches one of the top 3 most frequently offered IAP activities (considering only activities that are not cancelled), and where the IAP activity has a maximum enrollment of at least 10, show the subject ID, term description, term start date, tip material key, the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the financial aid year, the activity title, max enrollment, the IAP activity's term description, the academic year description, and the IAP activity's enrollment type, ordered by the subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), TopIAPActivities AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, icte.window_column, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, tia.MAX_ENROLLMENT, tia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tia.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TopIAPActivities tia ON icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = tia.TERM_DESCRIPTION WHERE tia.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID;

SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3;

WITH TipDetailWindow AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), TopIAPActivities AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT tdw.SUBJECT_ID, tdw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tdw.TERM_START_DATE, tdw.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tdw.window_column, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, tia.MAX_ENROLLMENT, tia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tia.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM TipDetailWindow tdw JOIN TopIAPActivities tia ON tdw.TERM_DESCRIPTION = tia.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY tdw.SUBJECT_ID;

question: Show the Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, including the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, and for each course, also display the responsible faculty name and the offer school name, but only for academic terms where the term status is 'Previous'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column AS math_window_column, pt.TERM_START_DATE, pt.CALENDAR_DATE, pt.DAY_OF_WEEK, pt.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN PreviousTerms pt ON ic.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ic.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER AND ic.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.COURSE_NUMBER, pt.TERM_START_DATE;

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5

SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'

WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT m.COURSE_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.window_column AS math_window_column, p.TERM_START_DATE, p.CALENDAR_DATE, p.DAY_OF_WEEK, p.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column FROM MathCourses m JOIN PreviousTerms p ON m.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, TERM_START_DATE;

question: For each of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in academic years 2014 or later, show the department name, the count of unique subject titles, and for each department also provide the average, minimum, and maximum number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, with the columns in the following order: department name, count of unique subject titles, average number of enrolled students per subject in 2017SP, minimum number of enrolled students per subject in 2017SP, and maximum number of enrolled students per subject in 2017SP. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.subject_count, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_2017SP, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students_2017SP, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students_2017SP FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC, avg_enrolled_students_2017SP DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP.
List the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered, including the department name and the count of unique subject titles, for terms in the academic year 2014 or later.

For each of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in academic years 2014 or later, show the department name, the count of unique subject titles, and for each department also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, with the columns in the following order: department name, count of unique subject titles, range of course materials per subject in 2017SP, variance of course materials per subject in 2017SP, and standard deviation of course materials per subject in 2017SP.
sub_sqls: SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count_range DESC;

SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH DepartmentMaterialStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count_range DESC ), TopDepartmentsBySubjects AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tds.subject_count, dms.material_count_range, dms.material_count_variance, dms.material_count_stddev FROM TopDepartmentsBySubjects tds JOIN DepartmentMaterialStats dms ON tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tds.subject_count DESC, dms.material_count_range DESC;

question: From the top 10 organizations (by the number of associated space units with code 402100), display each organization's name, the count of such space units, its assignable status, the HR department most frequently associated with its HR org units (where the HR department name is not null), and the count of HR org units for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ), org_space_counts AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ASSIGNABLE, COUNT(t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 GROUP BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ASSIGNABLE ), org_hr_dept_counts AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS hr_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), org_hr_dept_ranked AS ( SELECT ohdc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ohdc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohdc.hr_unit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ohdc.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ohdc.hr_unit_count DESC) AS dept_rank FROM org_hr_dept_counts ohdc ) SELECT osc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, osc.space_unit_count, osc.ASSIGNABLE, ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Frequent_HR_Department, ohr.hr_unit_count AS HR_Unit_Count FROM org_space_counts osc LEFT JOIN org_hr_dept_ranked ohr ON osc.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND ohr.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY osc.space_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For space units with a space unit code of 402100, show the organization names and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization number.

For each organization, provide the organization name and calculate the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null.

For each organization that has a space unit with a space unit code of 402100, show the organization name, its dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization number, the average of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null, and the variance of the HR department codes (old) for those HR org units. List the results ordered by the dense rank and then by the variance of the HR department codes (old) in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100

SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC;

WITH SpaceUnitRanks AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ), OrgHRStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ) SELECT s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.window_column, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old FROM SpaceUnitRanks s JOIN OrgHRStats o ON s.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY s.window_column, o.var_dept_code_old DESC

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, the number of unique students is at least 10, and the average number of enrolled students in courses with at least one associated course material is greater than 30, provide the department name, course level, number of unique students, minimum CIP program code among their courses, average enrollment, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrollment, and the total number of courses offered by the department at that level, listing the results in descending order of enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.student_count, icte.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, COUNT(scd2.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd2.COURSE_LEVEL WHERE des.avg_enrollment > 30 AND icte.student_count >= 10 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.student_count, icte.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY des.enrollment_stddev DESC;
sub_questions: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique students and the minimum CIP program code among their courses.
For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material.

For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, the number of unique students is at least 10, and the average number of enrolled students in courses with at least one associated course material is greater than 30, provide the department name, course level, number of unique students, minimum CIP program code among their courses, average enrollment, and standard deviation of enrollment, listing the results in descending order of enrollment standard deviation.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

WITH DepartmentCourseStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_LEVEL, dcs.student_count, dcs.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev FROM DepartmentCourseStats dcs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE des.avg_enrollment > 30 AND dcs.student_count >= 10 ORDER BY des.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each grade type, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units), and also include the number of subjects offered by each department, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Combined AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, d.num_subjects FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptStats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, num_subjects FROM Combined ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE;

sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6

WITH EngSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Combined AS ( SELECT e.SUBJECT_CODE, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM EngSubjects e JOIN DeptStats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM Combined ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, and the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material). Also, include the school name and department phone number for each department. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.avg_academic_year, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE;
