The results should include the offering department name, offering school name, subject count, minimum total units, subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, offer department name from the library subject, and the windowed minimum number of enrolled students, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS LIB_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each organization with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' and for each space unit associated with that organization (where the space unit has a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and the HR org units linked to it have a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), show the organization key, organization name, DLC name, the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key, the space unit name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit, as well as the HR department name and the HR org unit title. The columns should be shown in the following order: organization key, organization name, DLC name, rank, space unit name, average HR department code, HR department code range, HR department code variance, HR department name, and HR org unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ) SELECT icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.window_column, su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS hr_dept_code_variance, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY AND su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.window_column, su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.DLC_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT ;
sub_questions: For each organization with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE', show the organization key, organization name, DLC name, and the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key.

For each space unit, what is the space unit name, the associated organization name, and the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit, considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'?

For each organization with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' and for each space unit associated with that organization (where the space unit has a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and the HR org units linked to it have a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), show the organization key, organization name, DLC name, the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key, the space unit name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit. The columns should be shown in the following order: organization key, organization name, DLC name, rank, space unit name, average HR department code, HR department code range, and HR department code variance.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE'

SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ) SELECT s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.DLC_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SPACE_UNIT, s2.avg_hr_dept_code, s2.hr_dept_code_range, s2.hr_dept_code_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of courses, average number of equivalent subjects, the school name, department phone number, and the number of distinct required or optional textbook materials used in that department and term. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, MIN(MEET_TIME) AS mintime, AVG( CASE WHEN equivalent_subjects IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH(equivalent_subjects) - LENGTH(REPLACE(equivalent_subjects, ',', '')) END ) AS avgeqisub FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avgeqisub, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, COALESCE(mat.material_count, 0) AS num_required_or_optional_materials FROM inner_cte tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) mat ON tbltmp.term = mat.TERM_CODE AND tbltmp.dept = mat.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;
sub_questions: For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, give the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL and the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.

For each course that is offered in the year 2022 and has at least one required or optional textbook, show the course's subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, the term description, the textbook material key, the textbook material status key, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code.

List, for each subject ID and term code, either (1) the offering department name, course number description, number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, and minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED for library subjects with more than 3 enrolled students, or (2) the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, textbook material key, textbook material status key, and row number within each department ordered by subject code for courses offered in 2022 with at least one required or optional textbook. Indicate the source of each row as either 'Sub1' or 'Sub2'. The results are ordered by subject ID, term code, and source.
sub_sqls: SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO')

WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id, l.SUBJECT_ID, l.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.SUBJECT_ID, l.TERM_CODE ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ), Combined AS ( SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s1.isbn_count, s1.min_faculty_mit_id, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS window_column, 'Sub1' AS Source FROM Sub1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NULL AS isbn_count, NULL AS min_faculty_mit_id, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.window_column, 'Sub2' AS Source FROM Sub2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, Source;

question: For each department and academic year, give the department name, the academic year, the academic year description, the average of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, where the geometric mean is computed only for subjects with total units greater than zero. Present the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR;

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and have total units greater than zero?

For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the average of the total units, the standard deviation of the total units, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, where the geometric mean is computed only for subjects with total units greater than zero. Present the results ordered by academic year.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject that appears both among subjects offered in the term '2017FA' (for which the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of tip materials are calculated) and among subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E' (for which the department name, course description, and a row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title are assigned), and for which the department name and course description are further joined to retrieve the school name from the course description table, give the subject title, the range of record counts, the variance of record counts, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of record counts, the department name, the course description, the school name, and the window row number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_range DESC ) SELECT sts.SUBJECT_TITLE, sts.record_count_range, sts.record_count_variance, sts.record_count_stddev, sddw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sddw.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sddw.window_column FROM inner_cte sts JOIN ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.COURSE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) sddw ON sts.SUBJECT_TITLE = sddw.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sddw.COURSE = scd.COURSE ORDER BY sts.record_count_range DESC, sddw.window_column ASC;
sub_questions: For each subject, give the subject title and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the record counts of tip materials for that subject, considering only subjects offered in the term '2017FA'.

For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, department name, and course description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.

For each subject that appears both among subjects offered in the term '2017FA' (for which the range, variance, and standard deviation of the record counts of tip materials are calculated) and among subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E' (for which the department name, course description, and a row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title are assigned), give the subject title, the range of record counts, the variance of record counts, the standard deviation of record counts, the department name, the course description, and the window row number, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_range DESC;

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E'

WITH SubjectTipStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_range DESC ), SubjectDeptDescWindow AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT sts.SUBJECT_TITLE, sts.record_count_range, sts.record_count_variance, sts.record_count_stddev, sddw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sddw.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sddw.window_column FROM SubjectTipStats sts JOIN SubjectDeptDescWindow sddw ON sts.SUBJECT_TITLE = sddw.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sts.record_count_range DESC, sddw.window_column ASC;

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for each offering department, show the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded. For each subject, also include the department code and the school name from the SIS_SUBJECT_CODE table. Present the subject title, offer department name, department code, school name, term description, window column, average total units, and total units variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON icte.join_dept_name = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON icte.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE

sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA'

SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH SubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance FROM SubjectOfferings so JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON so.join_dept_name = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: From the top 10 subjects with the highest number of enrolled students (considering only library reserve material details where the material status is 'U'), display each subject's ID, subject title, total number of enrolled students, the instructor key most frequently associated with that subject, and the count of times that instructor appears for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON l.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), subject_enrollment AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE ), instructor_counts AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, COUNT(*) AS INSTRUCTOR_COUNT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY ), ranked_instructors AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ic.INSTRUCTOR_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.INSTRUCTOR_COUNT DESC) AS rn FROM instructor_counts ic ) SELECT se.SUBJECT_ID, se.SUBJECT_TITLE, se.TOTAL_ENROLLED, ri.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY AS MOST_FREQUENT_INSTRUCTOR, ri.INSTRUCTOR_COUNT AS INSTRUCTOR_OCCURRENCES FROM subject_enrollment se LEFT JOIN ranked_instructors ri ON se.SUBJECT_ID = ri.SUBJECT_ID AND ri.rn = 1 ORDER BY se.TOTAL_ENROLLED DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For library reserve material details with material status key equal to 'U', show the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, and the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students.

For each subject, what is the variance of the record count for TIP materials associated with that subject, considering only records where the library material status is 'U' and the TIP material status is 'RQ'?

For each library reserve material detail with material status key equal to 'U', show the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, and the variance of the record count for TIP materials associated with that subject considering only records where the library material status is 'U' and the TIP material status is 'RQ'. List the columns in the following order: library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, tip material key, tip material status key, ISBN, subject title, windowed minimum tip material status key, and record count variance.
sub_sqls: SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'

SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

WITH LibraryReserveMaterialDetails AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), SubjectRecordCountVariance AS ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.ISBN, lrm.SUBJECT_TITLE, lrm.window_column, srv.record_count_variance FROM LibraryReserveMaterialDetails lrm LEFT JOIN SubjectRecordCountVariance srv ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY;

question: For each department, what is the average and maximum number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables), as well as the number of unique degree-granting courses and the maximum total units offered for courses where the total units are at least 9? Please provide the department name, average enrolled students, maximum enrolled students, course count, and maximum total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), course_stats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS >= 9 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrolled_students, i.max_enrolled_students, cs.course_count, cs.max_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN course_stats cs ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department name, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings, considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables?
For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units offered.

For each department name and course level, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables), as well as the number of unique degree-granting courses and the minimum total units offered for courses where the total units are greater than 6? Please provide the department name, variance, standard deviation, course level, course count, and minimum total units in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH library_students_stats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ), course_level_stats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lss.library_students_variance, lss.library_students_stddev, cls.COURSE_LEVEL, cls.course_count, cls.min_total_units FROM library_students_stats lss JOIN course_level_stats cls ON lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cls.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cls.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each subject offered in the term "2005FA", show the subject title from the subject summary, the number of enrolled students from the subject offered table, the department name from the subject summary, the term description from the academic terms table, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by department name, and for the corresponding department, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous'. Additionally, for each subject, show the total number of library reserve materials associated with it in the same term. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ), DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), SubjectLibraryReserveCount AS ( SELECT lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS num_library_reserves FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm GROUP BY lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.avg_enrolled_students, dlu.avg_total_units, dlu.total_units_variance, dlu.total_units_stddev, COALESCE(slrc.num_library_reserves, 0) AS num_library_reserves FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats dlu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dlu.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' LEFT JOIN SubjectLibraryReserveCount slrc ON tso.TERM_CODE = slrc.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = slrc.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

WITH SubjectEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ), DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ses.avg_enrolled_students, dlu.avg_total_units, dlu.total_units_variance, dlu.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectEnrolledStats ses LEFT JOIN DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats dlu ON ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dlu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, and where the organization is linked to a department in the Provost Area, provide the organization, the space unit, the number of space units, the minimum organization number, the department name, the number of organizations for that department, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, and the total number of unique space units for each department. List the results ordered by organization and space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ProvostAreaDepartments AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), AssignableOrgSpaceUnits AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DLC_KEY ) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION, a.SPACE_UNIT, a.space_unit_count, a.min_org_number, p.DLC_NAME, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code, a.DLC_KEY FROM AssignableOrgSpaceUnits a JOIN ProvostAreaDepartments p ON a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.space_unit_count, i.min_org_number, i.DLC_NAME, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, d.total_unique_space_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT o.DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_unique_space_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.DLC_KEY ) d ON i.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ORDER BY i.ORGANIZATION, i.SPACE_UNIT;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, term description, and the rank of the subject within its offering department. For each tip detail record where the material status key is 'RQ', show the subject ID, term description, term start date, tip material key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the financial aid year. Additionally, for each subject offered in "Fall Term 2024-2025", include the academic year description from the academic terms table. Indicate the source of each row as either 'SubjectOffered' or 'TipDetail'. The results should be ordered by subject ID and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) , Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) , SubjectOfferedWithYear AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column AS subject_rank, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) , CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.subject_rank, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS avg_record_count, 'SubjectOffered' AS Source FROM SubjectOfferedWithYear s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.window_column AS avg_record_count, 'TipDetail' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, Source;

question: For each space unit with a space unit key greater than 100000 and with rooms on floor 2, what is the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of its associated rooms, the organization name, the HR department name, and the HR org unit title, for each space unit, ordered by access level variance and HR org unit title? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.access_level_variance, icte.access_level_stddev, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON icte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ORDER BY icte.access_level_variance DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE;

question: For each department in the Provost Area, show the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of the department within its school area based on department code, and for each matching space unit with a space unit key greater than 100000, show the space unit code, the organization name, the HR department name from the space unit, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, and the description of the organization from the FCLT_ORGANIZATION table, where the department code matches between the department and the space unit. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH provost_departments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), space_unit_summaries AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DESCRIPTION FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column AS department_rank_within_school_area, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS space_unit_hr_department_name, sus.window_column AS sum_space_unit_key_within_warehouse_load_date, sus.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description FROM provost_departments pd JOIN space_unit_summaries sus ON pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

sub_sqls: SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area'

SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000

WITH provost_departments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), space_unit_summaries AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column AS department_rank_within_school_area, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS space_unit_hr_department_name, sus.window_column AS sum_space_unit_key_within_warehouse_load_date FROM provost_departments pd JOIN space_unit_summaries sus ON pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered (considering only subjects that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the total number of unique responsible faculty members teaching those subjects? List the academic year, academic year description, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), geometric mean record count, and total unique responsible faculty in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, tso.TERM_CODE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, ms.geometric_mean_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS total_unique_responsible_faculty FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) ms ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.geometric_mean_record_count ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year?

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered (considering only subjects that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students, and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year? List the academic year, academic year description, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation, and geometric mean record count in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

WITH EnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), MaterialStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev, ms.geometric_mean_record_count FROM EnrollmentStats es JOIN MaterialStats ms ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: Show the department names, subject codes, subject numbers, subject titles, term descriptions, total units, and the total number of subjects per department for all subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that either (a) have a total of 12 units, or (b) have at least one required or optional textbook. For each row, also include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('12UnitSubject' for the first case and 'TextbookSubject' for the second case). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, '12UnitSubject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, 'TextbookSubject' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.SUBJECT_CODE, cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cs.TOTAL_UNITS, cs.Reason FROM CombinedSubjects cs ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, TotalSubjects.Total_Subjects, icte.Reason FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS TotalSubjects ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = TotalSubjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.Reason;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units.

For each course that is offered in the year 2022 and has at least one required or optional textbook, show the course's subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, the term description, the textbook material key, the textbook material status key, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code.

List all subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that either (a) have a total of 12 units, showing the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, or (b) have at least one required or optional textbook, showing the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, the textbook material key, the textbook material status key, and the row number within each department ordered by subject code. For each row, also include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('12UnitAvgEnrollment' for the first case and 'Textbook' for the second case). The columns should be: subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, average subject enrollment window, textbook material key, textbook material status key, textbook row number, and reason.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO')

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column AS avg_enrollment_window, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS textbook_row_number, '12UnitAvgEnrollment' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS avg_enrollment_window, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.window_column AS textbook_row_number, 'Textbook' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_enrollment_window, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, textbook_row_number, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, Reason;

question: List the department names, their corresponding subject codes, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and the minimum total units for each department and subject code, considering only degree-granting departments and courses with more than 6 total units. Present the results ordered by the total number of courses in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses ORDER BY ic.Total_Courses DESC
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate.
For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units offered.

For each department and course level, provide the department name, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, the variance of CIP program codes for all undergraduate courses offered by degree-granting departments, as well as the course level, the number of unique degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6, and the minimum total units offered. Present the results ordered by the range of CIP program codes in descending order and then by the number of unique courses in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC;

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH DeptCipStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, dct.COURSE_LEVEL, dct.course_count, dct.min_total_units FROM DeptCipStats dcs JOIN DeptCourseStats dct ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dct.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.cip_code_range DESC, dct.course_count DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year from the academic terms table, and the term description from the academic terms table, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.CALENDAR_DATE, s1.window_column AS row_number_window, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_window, s1.TERM_CODE FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.CALENDAR_DATE, i.row_number_window, i.dense_rank_window, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE;

For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title and the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year from the academic terms table.

For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, and the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year from the academic terms table, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'

question: Show the department name, subject ID, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, subject title, textbook ISBN, subject rank within its term description group ordered by subject ID, and the total number of subjects offered by each department in the term with code '2022FA'. Only subjects in the academic year 2022 with a required textbook will have subject title, ISBN, and rank populated; others will have these fields as null. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS running_sum_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.window_column AS subject_rank_within_term FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.running_sum_total_units, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.ISBN, i.subject_rank_within_term, dept_counts.total_subjects_in_dept FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_counts ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, along with the offering department name, offering school name, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units, and the total number of enrolled students for each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN subq2 s2 ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered in regular academic terms, display each subject title, department name, total count of materials, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with at least one associated TIP material), the school name, and the department phone number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.material_count DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

WITH top_subjects AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev FROM top_subjects ts LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department ORDER BY ts.material_count DESC;

question: For the top 10 departments with the highest number of graduate students, list each department's name, total graduate student count, the most frequently offered subject in the 2017JA term for that department, the number of times that subject was offered, the subject code, and the subject code description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS grad_student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.grad_student_count, so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Frequent_Subject, so.subject_offer_count, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_offer_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE ) so JOIN inner_cte ic ON so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(subject_offer_count) AS max_count FROM ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_offer_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE ) sub GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) maxsub ON so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = maxsub.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND so.subject_offer_count = maxsub.max_count ORDER BY ic.grad_student_count DESC LIMIT 10;
