SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC;

WITH DeptEng2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.subject_count, de.total_enrollment, ds.avg_subject_codes, ds.stddev_subject_codes FROM DeptEng2021 de JOIN DeptSubjectStats ds ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a total of 1 unit, show the subject title from the summary, the course number from the offered table, the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the summary, the offer department name from the offered summary, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject title from the summary, and for each department, also provide the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student). Additionally, include the full department name and the school name from the SIS_DEPARTMENT table for each department. List the results ordered by department name and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.summary_subject_title, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.offered_summary_subject_title, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.stddev_total_units, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column;

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT subq1.summary_subject_title, subq1.COURSE_NUMBER, subq1.offered_summary_subject_title, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_total_units, subq2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column;

question: For each of the top 10 space units by the number of rooms they contain, display the space unit name, the count of rooms, the department hierarchy name associated with the space unit, the average organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, and the total square footage of all rooms in the space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_hierarchy_stats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC ), top_space_units AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tsu.SPACE_UNIT, tsu.room_count, dhs.DLC_NAME, dhs.avg_org_level, dhs.org_level_stddev, tsu.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM top_space_units tsu LEFT JOIN dept_hierarchy_stats dhs ON tsu.DLC_KEY = (SELECT DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY WHERE DLC_NAME = dhs.DLC_NAME LIMIT 1) ORDER BY tsu.room_count DESC ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.room_count, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd ON icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.room_count, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev ORDER BY icte.room_count DESC;

WITH dept_hierarchy_stats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC ), top_space_units AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count, su.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tsu.SPACE_UNIT, tsu.room_count, dhs.DLC_NAME, dhs.avg_org_level, dhs.org_level_stddev FROM top_space_units tsu LEFT JOIN dept_hierarchy_stats dhs ON tsu.DLC_KEY = (SELECT DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY WHERE DLC_NAME = dhs.DLC_NAME LIMIT 1) ORDER BY tsu.room_count DESC;

question: For the top 10 activity titles with the highest number of associated course materials, what are the activity title, the term description, the count of course materials, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment across all academic terms for each activity? Additionally, for each activity title, provide the total number of unique academic years in which the activity was offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), ActivityEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN TIME_DAY ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ), ActivityAcademicYears AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS unique_academic_years FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE ) SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.material_count, aes.enrollment_range, aes.enrollment_variance, aes.enrollment_stddev, aay.unique_academic_years FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ActivityEnrollmentStats aes ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aes.ACTIVITY_TITLE LEFT JOIN ActivityAcademicYears aay ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aay.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

WITH TopActivityMaterials AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), ActivityEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN TIME_DAY ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT tam.ACTIVITY_TITLE, tam.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tam.material_count, aes.enrollment_range, aes.enrollment_variance, aes.enrollment_stddev FROM TopActivityMaterials tam LEFT JOIN ActivityEnrollmentStats aes ON tam.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aes.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, and where the department has more than 10 tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms, provide the department name, course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the total number of tip materials offered for that department, and the average total units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCourseSubjects AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ), EngineeringDeptTips AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.COURSE_NUMBER, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptCourseSubjects d JOIN EngineeringDeptTips e ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON l.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER;

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms, where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10.

For each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, and where the department has more than 10 tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms, provide the department name, course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the total number of tip materials offered for that department.
sub_sqls: SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10;

WITH DeptCourseSubjects AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ), EngineeringDeptTips AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.COURSE_NUMBER, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptCourseSubjects d JOIN EngineeringDeptTips e ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each department, show the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022. For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting within those departments, show the course description, department name, and subject code description. Additionally, for each subject code, indicate whether it is associated with an undergraduate or graduate level (based on HGN_DESC in COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), and count the number of subjects of each level per department. Include a grand total of subjects per department in the format (department name, null, total subjects). Present the results ordered by the units range in descending order and then by course description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), EngineeringDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectLevelCounts AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.HGN_DESC AS subject_level, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.HGN_DESC ), RollupSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT slc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, slc.subject_level, SUM(slc.num_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM SubjectLevelCounts slc GROUP BY slc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, slc.subject_level WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(slc.num_subjects) > 0 ) SELECT dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, rsc.subject_level, rsc.total_subjects FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN EngineeringDegreeCourses edc ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN RollupSubjectCounts rsc ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.units_range DESC, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION

SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), EngineeringDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT d.units_range, d.units_variance, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column FROM DepartmentUnitsStats d JOIN EngineeringDegreeCourses e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.units_range DESC, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION

question: For each department hierarchy whose name starts with 'D' (case insensitive), and for departments in that hierarchy that have more than 5 rooms with area greater than 100, provide the department hierarchy name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, the department's name, and the count and average area of rooms assigned to that department (considering only rooms with area greater than 100). Only include results where the average room area for the department is above 200. Present the results ordered by department hierarchy name and then by average room area in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME) LIKE 'D%' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ), DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5 ) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drs.room_count, drs.avg_room_area FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN DeptRoomStats drs ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE drs.avg_room_area > 200 GROUP BY icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drs.room_count, drs.avg_room_area ORDER BY icte.DLC_NAME, drs.avg_room_area DESC;
sub_questions: For each department hierarchy, give the department hierarchy name and find the average and standard deviation of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy.
For each department, give the department's name and calculate the range and variance of the areas of rooms assigned to it, considering only rooms with an area greater than 40.

For each department hierarchy and its departments, give the department hierarchy name, the average and standard deviation of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, the department's name, and the range and variance of the areas of rooms assigned to that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). Present the results ordered by department hierarchy name and then by area range in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC;

SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC;

WITH dept_hierarchy_org_levels AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC ), dept_room_area_stats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ) SELECT dhol.DLC_NAME, dhol.avg_org_level, dhol.org_level_stddev, dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dras.area_range, dras.area_variance FROM dept_hierarchy_org_levels dhol JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON dhol.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN dept_room_area_stats dras ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME GROUP BY dhol.DLC_NAME, dhol.avg_org_level, dhol.org_level_stddev, dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dras.area_range, dras.area_variance ORDER BY dhol.DLC_NAME, dras.area_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (for records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900, and the geometric mean of the financial aid year from all academic terms where the financial aid year is greater than 1900. Also, include the reason for inclusion ('MaterialsPerSubject' for the geometric mean of materials per subject, 'DegreeYear' for the geometric mean of degree year, and 'FinancialAidYear' for the geometric mean of financial aid year). Show the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of materials per subject, geometric mean of degree year, geometric mean of financial aid year, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), CombinedGeometricMeans AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'MaterialsPerSubject' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'DegreeYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDegreeYear UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'FinancialAidYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, Reason FROM CombinedGeometricMeans ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900?

For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (for records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900, and the reason for inclusion ('MaterialsPerSubject' for the geometric mean of materials per subject and 'DegreeYear' for the geometric mean of degree year). Show the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of materials per subject, geometric mean of degree year, and reason, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_degree_year DESC;

WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), CombinedGeometricMeans AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, 'MaterialsPerSubject' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, 'DegreeYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDegreeYear ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, Reason FROM CombinedGeometricMeans ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason;

question: For the top 10 academic years with the highest variance in the record count of tip details for current or previous terms, display each academic year's description, the variance of the record count, and the department with the most unique subjects offered in that year, along with the count of those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_subjects AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), ranked_depts AS ( SELECT ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.subject_count, @rank := IF(@current_year = ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, @rank + 1, 1) AS dept_rank, @current_year := ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ( SELECT * FROM dept_subjects ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count DESC ) ds CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_year := 0) vars ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.record_count_variance, rd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, rd.subject_count AS Department_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ranked_depts rd ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rd.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.record_count_variance DESC;

For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for those subjects.

List, for each academic year, either the academic year description and the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms, or for each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, the department name, number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum number of total units for those subjects. Indicate the reason for inclusion as 'RecordCountVariance' for the first case and 'SubjectStats' for the second. The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, department name, subject count, minimum total units, record count variance, and reason, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH RecordCountVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), SubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_total_units, r.record_count_variance, 'RecordCountVariance' AS Reason FROM RecordCountVariance r UNION ALL SELECT s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.subject_count, s.min_total_units, NULL AS record_count_variance, 'SubjectStats' AS Reason FROM SubjectStats s ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units, record_count_variance, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For the top 10 buildings on the MIT site with the highest number of rooms, show each building's long name, total room count, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms. Additionally, for the top 10 space units (with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24') that are associated with the largest number of HR org units (with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), display the space unit name, the associated organization name, the number of linked HR org units, and the average HR department code for those units. Indicate the reason for inclusion as 'BuildingRoomStats' for building statistics and 'SpaceUnitOrgStats' for space unit and organization statistics. The columns returned are: building long name, room count, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), space unit name, organization name, HR org unit count, average HR department code, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), SpaceUnitOrgStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_hr_dept_code FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_org_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.room_count, b.area_stddev, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS hr_org_unit_count, NULL AS avg_hr_dept_code, 'BuildingRoomStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte b LEFT JOIN SpaceUnitOrgStats s ON 1=0 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG, NULL AS room_count, NULL AS area_stddev, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.hr_org_unit_count, s.avg_hr_dept_code, 'SpaceUnitOrgStats' AS Reason FROM SpaceUnitOrgStats s LEFT JOIN inner_cte b ON 1=0 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY Reason, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, SPACE_UNIT;
sub_questions: For each building, what is the building's long name and the standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, considering only buildings with more than 5 rooms and where the building is located on the MIT site?

For each space unit, what is the space unit name, the associated organization name, and the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit, considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'?

List, for all buildings with more than 5 rooms located on the MIT site, the building's long name and the standard deviation of the areas of its rooms, and for all space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24', the space unit name, the associated organization name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit. Indicate the reason for inclusion as 'BuildingRoomStats' for building statistics and 'SpaceUnitOrgStats' for space unit and organization statistics. The columns returned are: building long name, area standard deviation, space unit name, organization name, average HR department code, HR department code range, HR department code variance, and reason for inclusion, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC;

SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC;

WITH BuildingRoomStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC ), SpaceUnitOrgStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, NULL AS area_stddev, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance, 'SpaceUnitOrgStats' AS Reason FROM SpaceUnitOrgStats s LEFT JOIN BuildingRoomStats b ON 1=0 UNION ALL SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.area_stddev, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS avg_hr_dept_code, NULL AS hr_dept_code_range, NULL AS hr_dept_code_variance, 'BuildingRoomStats' AS Reason FROM BuildingRoomStats b LEFT JOIN SpaceUnitOrgStats s ON 1=0 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY Reason, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, SPACE_UNIT;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, and for subjects offered in the term 2019FA from the same department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each 2024 subject within its department ordered by subject code, the 2019FA subject ID, number of enrolled students in 2019FA, department full name, the row number of each 2019FA subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID, and the school name for each department. Order the results by department name, subject code, and 2019FA subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subjects2019FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s24.SUBJECT_TITLE, s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s24.window_column AS department_rank_2024, s19.SUBJECT_ID, s19.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s19.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s19.window_column AS department_rownum_2019, s19.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte s24 JOIN Subjects2019FA s19 ON s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s19.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, list the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, but only include those subjects where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average for their department. Also, for the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered for terms in the academic year 2014 or later, include the department name, the count of unique subject titles, and the full department name. For each row, add a reason for inclusion ('2019FA_Subject_AboveAvg' for subjects and 'Top10_Dept_2014plus' for departments). The columns should be: subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, windowed average of enrolled students, subject count, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), DeptAvg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS dept_avg FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), SubjectsAboveDeptAvg AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column, NULL AS subject_count, '2019FA_Subject_AboveAvg' AS Reason FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptAvg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.dept_avg ), Top10Depts2014 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), Top10Depts2014Formatted AS ( SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, t.subject_count, 'Top10_Dept_2014plus' AS Reason FROM Top10Depts2014 t ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, subject_count, Reason FROM ( SELECT * FROM SubjectsAboveDeptAvg UNION ALL SELECT * FROM Top10Depts2014Formatted ) AS CombinedResults ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE;

For each row, also include a reason for inclusion ('2019FA_Subject' for subjects and 'Top10_Dept_2014plus' for departments). WITH Subjects2019FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Top10Depts2014 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.window_column, NULL AS subject_count, '2019FA_Subject' AS Reason FROM Subjects2019FA s UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, t.subject_count, 'Top10_Dept_2014plus' AS Reason FROM Top10Depts2014 t ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, subject_count, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department that offers at least one subject in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, display the department name, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', the number of such subjects offered, and the average subject enrollment number for those subjects, but only include departments where the average subject enrollment number for these subjects is greater than the overall average subject enrollment number for all subjects offered in 2022 with 12 units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_variance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), subject_window AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects, AVG(sw.window_column) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM subject_window sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, catalog_key_variance, num_subjects, avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_subject_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) ORDER BY avg_subject_enrollment DESC, catalog_key_variance DESC ;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the name of the department and the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U'?

For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units.

For each subject offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, display the department name, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', the subject code, subject number, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units.
sub_sqls: SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

WITH dept_variance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), subject_window AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.TOTAL_UNITS, sw.window_column FROM subject_window sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dv.catalog_key_variance DESC, sw.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of unique courses among degree-granting departments, show each department's name, school name, total unique course count, the minimum CIP program code, the subject title from the summary, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and the total units for each subject, but only for subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), SubjectWindowStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT, t0.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, sws.SUBJECT_TITLE, sws.window_column, sws.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte dcs JOIN SubjectWindowStats sws ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sws.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dcs.course_count DESC LIMIT 10;

For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog.

sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

WITH DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), SubjectWindowStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, sws.SUBJECT_TITLE, sws.window_column FROM DeptCourseStats dcs JOIN SubjectWindowStats sws ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sws.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sws.window_column;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students), as well as the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Please provide the academic year, department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, minimum academic year, and total units sum, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), library_units_stats AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, library_units_stats.min_academic_year, library_units_stats.total_units_sum FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN library_units_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = library_units_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = library_units_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y';

WITH avg_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), library_units_stats AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT avg_enrollment_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, avg_enrollment_stats.avg_enrollment, avg_enrollment_stats.enrollment_variance, library_units_stats.min_academic_year, library_units_stats.total_units_sum FROM avg_enrollment_stats LEFT JOIN library_units_stats ON avg_enrollment_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR = library_units_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY avg_enrollment_stats.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: From the top 10 combinations of department name, subject code, and course number (where the department is degree granting and the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2) with the highest number of unique library subjects offered, display the department name, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, course number, number of unique library subjects offered, minimum total units, the subject title with the most enrolled students for that course, and the corresponding number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_total_units FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN DeptCourseStats dcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = dcs.COURSE_NUMBER ), SubjectMaxEnroll AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, sme.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, sme.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SubjectMaxEnroll sme ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sme.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_NUMBER = sme.COURSE_NUMBER AND sme.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_total_units FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN DeptCourseStats dcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = dcs.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For rooms on floor 2 that are associated with a DLC having more than five organizations, provide the building room, space usage, organization name, HR org unit title, department name, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, and the DLC name and HR org unit level. Do not repeat the DLC name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers (descending), DLC name, and then by building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DLCOrgStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ), Floor2Rooms AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT f2r.BUILDING_ROOM, f2r.SPACE_USAGE, f2r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f2r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f2r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f2r.window_column, dos.org_number_stddev, f2r.DLC_NAME, f2r.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM Floor2Rooms f2r JOIN DLCOrgStddev dos ON f2r.DLC_NAME = dos.DLC_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DLC_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC, DLC_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM) = DLC_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM, SPACE_USAGE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, org_number_stddev, HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC, DLC_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM;
sub_questions: For each DLC, provide the DLC name and the standard deviation of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, considering only DLCs with more than five organizations.

For rooms on floor 2, show the building room, space usage, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the department name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component.
