For each academic year, give the academic year and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects.

For academic terms where the term status indicator is 'P', show the term code, the term parameter, the term description, the academic year, the term start date, the average academic year in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the term indicator and ordered by the term start date, and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for the corresponding academic year.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH AcademicTermStats AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P' ), AcademicYearVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT ats.TERM_CODE, ats.TERM_PARAMETER, ats.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ats.TERM_START_DATE, ats.window_column, ayv.coefficient_of_variation FROM AcademicTermStats ats JOIN AcademicYearVariation ayv ON ats.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ats.TERM_CODE

question: For each department, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', and the number of unique subjects with library reserve materials in those terms, with the columns in the following order: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and count of unique subjects with library reserve materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) , DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects_with_reserve FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.unique_subjects_with_reserve FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC, dus.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA.
For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous'?

For each department, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', with the columns in the following order: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation, average total units, total units variance, and total units standard deviation.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentEnrolledStats des JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrolled_range DESC, dus.total_units_variance DESC;

question: From the top 10 subjects with the highest number of degree-granting courses in the School of Engineering, display each subject's code, subject code description, department name, the total count of such courses, and the course description, department name, and subject title of the most recently updated course for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ), eng_degree_courses AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), subject_course_counts AS ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(edc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS degree_course_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN eng_degree_courses edc ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = edc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), most_recent_course AS ( SELECT edc.SUBJECT_CODE, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY edc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY edc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM eng_degree_courses edc ) SELECT scc.SUBJECT_CODE, scc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scc.degree_course_count, mrc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mrc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mrc.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM subject_course_counts scc LEFT JOIN most_recent_course mrc ON scc.SUBJECT_CODE = mrc.SUBJECT_CODE AND mrc.rn = 1 ORDER BY scc.degree_course_count DESC LIMIT 10;

For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject title, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL

SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

WITH subject_dense_rank AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ), engineering_degree_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT sdr.SUBJECT_CODE, sdr.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sdr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sdr.window_column AS subject_dense_rank, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS edc_DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS edc_SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.window_column AS engineering_row_number FROM subject_dense_rank sdr JOIN engineering_degree_courses edc ON sdr.SUBJECT_CODE = edc.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, display each department's name, the total number of such subjects, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects in that department that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials, and the subject code, subject number, and subject title of the most frequently offered subject in that department. List the results ordered by the total number of subjects in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MostFrequentSubject AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS freq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, icte.SUBJECT_CODE) AS rn FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.subject_count, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, mfs.SUBJECT_CODE, mfs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, mfs.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN MostFrequentSubject mfs ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mfs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND mfs.rn = 1 ORDER BY dsc.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH Subjects2024_12Units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance FROM Subjects2024_12Units s JOIN DeptUnitsStats d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For subjects in the Engineering school during the Fall Term 2024-2025, show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each subject, also show the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by the same department (considering only courses with at least one associated TIP material and total units greater than 0), and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 10% greater than the department average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the results ordered by enrollment variance (descending) and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.window_column, es.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance FROM EngineeringSubjects es JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, CASE WHEN inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > inner_cte.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < inner_cte.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'

SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.window_column, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance FROM EngineeringSubjects es JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrollment_variance DESC, es.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department. Additionally, for each subject, provide the total units from the course catalog, and classify the subject as 'HIGH_LOAD' if its total units are at least 20% greater than the average total units for its department and academic year, 'LOW_LOAD' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_unit_benchmark AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, c.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte s JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN dept_unit_benchmark d ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by offering department.

For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for those subjects.

For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, as well as the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5. Present the results ordered by offering department name and subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH SubjectsIn2025FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM SubjectsIn2025FA s JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each activity, provide the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name, the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title, and the length of the activity description. For activities in the "Mathematics" category, also include the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title; otherwise, show null. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS dense_rank_within_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS row_number_within_enrollment_type, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, LENGTH(d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION) AS activity_description_length FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), math_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_mathematics, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.dense_rank_within_category, i.row_number_within_enrollment_type, i.activity_description_length, m.row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_mathematics FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN math_cte m ON i.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND i.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY;
sub_questions: List the activity title, enrollment type, and maximum enrollment for each activity, along with the category name, and show the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name.

For IAP subjects in the "Mathematics" category, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, and assign row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title.

List the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title for activities in the "Mathematics" category (if applicable; otherwise null).
sub_sqls: SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics'

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s1.window_column AS dense_rank_within_category, s2.window_column AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_mathematics FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s1.MAX_ENROLLMENT = s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY;

question: For each department, show the department code, department name, the number of subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects. Also, for each offering department and school, show the offering department name, offering school name, the count of distinct subject IDs, and the minimum ISBN value for associated course materials where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS join_department_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(icte.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2024_12units, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12, show the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code.

For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs and the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials.

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12, show the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code, along with the offering department name, offering school name, count of distinct subject IDs, and minimum ISBN value for associated course materials for each offering department and school where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS join_department_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS join_department_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.window_column, subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.subject_count, subq2.min_isbn FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.join_department_code;

question: For each department, give the department code, department name, the average of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, where the geometric mean is calculated only for subjects with total units greater than zero. Present the results ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, EXP(AVG(CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 THEN LN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) END)) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON t.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and have total units greater than zero?

For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the average of the total units, the standard deviation of the total units, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, where the geometric mean is calculated only for subjects with total units greater than zero. Present the results ordered by academic year.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group, and for each organization, the number of unique HR organization unit titles associated with it. For each organization, also include a grand total for all unique HR organization unit titles in the format of (organization name, null, total unique HR org unit titles). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), OrgUnitTitleCounts AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS unique_hr_org_unit_ids FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(unique_hr_org_unit_ids) AS total_unique_hr_org_unit_ids FROM OrgUnitTitleCounts GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(unique_hr_org_unit_ids) > 0 ) SELECT ic.space_unit_name, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DEPT_COUNT, ic.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, ic.avg_dept_count_within_group, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.total_unique_hr_org_unit_ids FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN RollupResults rr ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ic.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ;
sub_questions: For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, and the average department count within each department count group ordered by number of supervisees.

For each organization, what is the coefficient of variation of the old department codes among its associated HR organization units? Show the organization name and the coefficient of variation, but only include organizations where the average old department code is greater than zero.

For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group, and the coefficient of variation of the old department codes among its associated HR organization units (only including organizations where the average old department code is greater than zero), ordered by number of supervisees.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500

SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), OrgDeptCodeVariation AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT sus.space_unit_name, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.DEPT_COUNT, sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sus.avg_dept_count_within_group, odv.coefficient_of_variation FROM SpaceUnitStats sus JOIN OrgDeptCodeVariation odv ON sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME = odv.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, and for each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" by the same department, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, and the number of enrolled students in each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS course_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.course_dense_rank, tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_rank_within_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'
sub_questions: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code.

For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, and the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key.

For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, and for each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" by the same department, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, and the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS course_dense_rank, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS subject_rank_within_dept FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE

question: For each space unit, what is the space unit name, the associated organization name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null? Additionally, for each result, include the number of unique HR org unit titles associated with the space unit. List the results ordered by the HR department code range (descending), then by the variance of the HR department codes (old) (descending), and then by the count of unique HR org unit titles (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ), OrgStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ), HRUnitTitleCounts AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS unique_hr_org_unit_titles, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.DLC_KEY ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.avg_hr_dept_code, icte.hr_dept_code_range, icte.hr_dept_code_variance, ost.avg_dept_code_old, ost.var_dept_code_old, htc.unique_hr_org_unit_titles FROM inner_cte icte JOIN OrgStats ost ON icte.DLC_KEY = ost.DLC_KEY JOIN HRUnitTitleCounts htc ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = htc.SPACE_UNIT AND icte.DLC_KEY = htc.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.hr_dept_code_range DESC, ost.var_dept_code_old DESC, htc.unique_hr_org_unit_titles DESC;

WITH SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ), OrgStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old FROM SpaceUnitStats s JOIN OrgStats o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC, var_dept_code_old DESC;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the number of Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students that are also offered in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, as well as the average number of enrolled students for those courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Math_Courses_2014FA, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Avg_Enrolled_Students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte icte ON scd.COURSE = icte.COURSE_NUMBER AND icte.SUBJECT_ID IN ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), Subjects2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column AS math_row_number, s14.SUBJECT_TITLE AS s14_SUBJECT_TITLE, s14.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s14.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s14.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s14.TOTAL_UNITS, s14.window_column AS s14_min_total_units_window, ROUND(mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s14.TOTAL_UNITS, 0), 2) AS Enrolled_Per_Unit FROM MathCourses mc JOIN Subjects2014FA s14 ON mc.SUBJECT_ID = s14.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY Enrolled_Per_Unit DESC;

question: For each Mathematics department course with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the degree year for that academic year (considering only degree years greater than 1900), and classify the course as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 20% greater than the average for Mathematics courses in that academic year, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. List the results ordered by academic year and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearDegreeStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), MathYearAvg AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yds.geometric_mean_degree_year, CASE WHEN mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > mya.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < mya.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte mc JOIN YearDegreeStats yds ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN MathYearAvg mya ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mya.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each activity, list its title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title for activities in the "Mathematics" category (showing null for activities not in "Mathematics"). Additionally, for each category, include a grand total row showing the total number of activities in that category (with nulls for activity-specific columns). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH activity_category_dense_rank AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), math_enrollment_row_number AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, a.window_column AS dense_rank_within_category, m.window_column AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math FROM activity_category_dense_rank a LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_row_number m ON a.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND a.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, dense_rank_within_category, row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math, COUNT(*) AS total_activities_in_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, dense_rank_within_category, row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math WITH ROLLUP HAVING (ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR ENROLLMENT_TYPE IS NOT NULL OR MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL OR dense_rank_within_category IS NOT NULL OR row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math IS NOT NULL) OR (ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NULL AND ENROLLMENT_TYPE IS NULL AND MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND dense_rank_within_category IS NULL AND row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math IS NULL) ORDER BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ACTIVITY_TITLE ;

question: For each academic year and department, list the academic year, department name, average total units for subjects offered in regular terms, variance of total units, academic year description, geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and only include those department-year pairs where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units for all departments and years. Show the results ordered by average total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), GeomMeanMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN GeomMeanMaterials g ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON c2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) ORDER BY i.avg_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year and department, what is the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms?

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year?

For each academic year and department, list the academic year, department name, average total units for subjects offered in regular terms, variance of total units, academic year description, geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and calculate the average total units divided by the geometric mean of required course material record counts rounded to two decimal places, ordered by this ratio in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

WITH AvgVarUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), GeomMeanMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count, ROUND(a.avg_total_units / NULLIF(g.geometric_mean_record_count, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_geom_material FROM AvgVarUnits a JOIN GeomMeanMaterials g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY avg_units_per_geom_material DESC;

question: For each DLC and academic year where the DLC name matches the department name and the term status is 'Previous', provide the DLC key, DLC name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC (considering only rooms with an area greater than 0), academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the average lecture units for those subjects, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC ) SELECT icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units ORDER BY icte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects.

sub_sqls: SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each term parameter, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of materials per subject for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date, and for each such term parameter, for tip details where the material status key is 'EO', show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by subject offered key, and also include only those term parameters where the number of EO materials is greater than 5? List the columns in the following order: term parameter, average materials per subject, variance of materials per subject, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of materials per subject, subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC ), EOMaterialDetails AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' ), EOCounts AS ( SELECT eomd.TERM_PARAMETER, COUNT(*) AS eo_material_count FROM EOMaterialDetails eomd GROUP BY eomd.TERM_PARAMETER ) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.avg_materials_per_subject, icte.variance_materials_per_subject, icte.stddev_materials_per_subject, eomd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eomd.TERM_CODE, eomd.SUBJECT_ID, eomd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN EOMaterialDetails eomd ON icte.TERM_PARAMETER = eomd.TERM_PARAMETER JOIN EOCounts eoc ON icte.TERM_PARAMETER = eoc.TERM_PARAMETER WHERE eoc.eo_material_count > 5 ORDER BY icte.variance_materials_per_subject DESC, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column;
sub_questions: For each term parameter, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the number of materials per subject for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date?

List the columns in the following order: term parameter, average materials per subject, variance of materials per subject, standard deviation of materials per subject, subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, and row number.
sub_sqls: SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC;

SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO'

WITH TermParameterMaterialStats AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC ), EOMaterialDetails AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' ) SELECT tpm.TERM_PARAMETER, tpm.avg_materials_per_subject, tpm.variance_materials_per_subject, tpm.stddev_materials_per_subject, eomd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eomd.TERM_CODE, eomd.SUBJECT_ID, eomd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column FROM TermParameterMaterialStats tpm JOIN EOMaterialDetails eomd ON tpm.TERM_PARAMETER = eomd.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY tpm.variance_materials_per_subject DESC, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column;

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the area of rooms assigned to it (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, and classify each department as 'LARGE_AREA' if its average room area is at least 10% greater than the overall average room area, 'SMALL_AREA' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. List the department name, average area, area range, area variance, average total units, total units range, total units variance, and area size category in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ), SubjectUnitsStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ras.avg_area, ras.area_range, ras.area_variance, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM RoomAreaStats ras JOIN SubjectUnitsStats sus ON ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ras.area_range DESC ), OverallAvgArea AS ( SELECT AVG(r.AREA) AS overall_avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS r WHERE r.AREA > 40 ) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_area, i.area_range, i.area_variance, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN i.avg_area > o.overall_avg_area * 1.1 THEN 'LARGE_AREA' WHEN i.avg_area < o.overall_avg_area * 0.9 THEN 'SMALL_AREA' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS area_size_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN OverallAvgArea o ORDER BY i.area_range DESC;
