WITH SubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.window_column, dss.COURSE_LEVEL, dss.student_count, dss.min_cip_code FROM SubjectOfferings so JOIN DepartmentStudentStats dss ON so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE, dss.COURSE_LEVEL

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for each, include the course level, the number of unique students, the minimum CIP program code among courses in the corresponding degree-granting department, and the department's full name. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, dss.COURSE_LEVEL, dss.student_count, dss.min_cip_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentStudentStats dss ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dss.COURSE_LEVEL

sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA'

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH SubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.window_column, dss.COURSE_LEVEL, dss.student_count, dss.min_cip_code FROM SubjectOfferings so JOIN DepartmentStudentStats dss ON so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE, dss.COURSE_LEVEL

question: From the top 10 departments in the "Provost Area" with the highest number of associated space units (where the space unit key is greater than 100000), display each department's code, department name, school area name, the department's rank within its school area based on department code, the total count of such space units, and the sum of their space unit keys. Also, for each space unit with a key greater than 100000, show the space unit code, organization name, HR department name (for the space unit), and the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group. Indicate the source of each row as either "TopProvostDepartment" or "SpaceUnit". The columns should be: department code, department name, school area name, department rank within school area, space unit count (for department), sum of space unit keys (for department), space unit code, organization name, HR department name (for space unit), sum of space unit keys within warehouse load date, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_rank_within_school_area, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), DeptSpaceUnitAgg AS ( SELECT ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, ic.department_rank_within_school_area, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, SUM(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS sum_space_unit_keys FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON ic.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, ic.department_rank_within_school_area ), TopDeptSpaceUnitAgg AS ( SELECT * FROM DeptSpaceUnitAgg ORDER BY space_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), SpaceUnits AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, t2.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT td.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, td.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, td.department_rank_within_school_area, td.space_unit_count, td.sum_space_unit_keys, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT_CODE, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS spaceunit_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, 'TopProvostDepartment' AS Source FROM TopDeptSpaceUnitAgg td UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, NULL AS department_rank_within_school_area, NULL AS space_unit_count, NULL AS sum_space_unit_keys, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS spaceunit_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, 'SpaceUnit' AS Source FROM SpaceUnits su ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, department_rank_within_school_area, space_unit_count, sum_space_unit_keys, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, spaceunit_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT_CODE;

SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000

WITH ProvostDepartments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), SpaceUnits AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column AS department_rank_within_school_area, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT_CODE, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS spaceunit_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, 'ProvostDepartment' AS Source FROM ProvostDepartments pd UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, NULL AS department_rank_within_school_area, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS spaceunit_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.window_column AS sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, 'SpaceUnit' AS Source FROM SpaceUnits su ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, department_rank_within_school_area, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, spaceunit_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT_CODE;

question: For each subject that is either offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' (showing the subject title, subject key, department name, and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students, with the reason 'Cluster S Dense Rank'), or is offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program (showing the subject title, subject key, department name, the number of subject offerings, and the total number of units for those offerings, with the reason 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment'), also include the total number of lab units for each subject (if available). For each result, include the subject title, subject key, department name, offering count, total units, total lab units, window column, and the reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) , Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS offering_count, NULL AS total_units, SUM(t3.LAB_UNITS) AS total_lab_units, s.window_column, 'Cluster S Dense Rank' AS Reason FROM inner_cte s JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON s.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t3 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t3.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column ) , Subquery2 AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_KEY, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, SUM(ss.LAB_UNITS) AS total_lab_units, NULL AS window_column, 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment' AS Reason FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_KEY, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.offering_count, s1.total_units, s1.total_lab_units, s1.window_column, s1.Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.offering_count, s2.total_units, s2.total_lab_units, s2.window_column, s2.Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME, offering_count, total_units, total_lab_units, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title from the summary table and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students in the offered table.

For each subject offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, provide the subject key, subject title, department name, the number of subject offerings, and the total number of units for those offerings.

List all subject titles that are either offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' (showing the subject title and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students, with the reason 'Cluster S Dense Rank') OR are offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program (showing the subject title, subject key, department name, the number of subject offerings, and the total number of units for those offerings, with the reason 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment'). For each result, include the subject title, subject key, department name, offering count, total units, window column, and the reason for inclusion, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'

SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS SUBJECT_KEY, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS offering_count, NULL AS total_units, s1.window_column, 'Cluster S Dense Rank' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.offering_count, s2.total_units, NULL AS window_column, 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME, offering_count, total_units, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: From the top 10 departments in the 'Engineering' school with the highest number of 12-unit courses, display each department's name, the total count of such courses, the subject title most frequently offered among those courses, and the count of courses for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, dept_course_counts.course_count AS total_12unit_courses, dept_subject_counts.top_subject_title, dept_subject_counts.subject_course_count FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS course_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_course_counts JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, subject_course_count FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) dept_subject_counts ON dept_course_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte ) ic ON dept_course_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dept_course_counts.course_count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show the course number, course description, subject title, total units, offering department name, and assign row numbers within each offering department ordered by course number.

For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject title and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units.

For courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show the course number, course description, subject title, total units, offering department name, the row number of the course within each offering department ordered by course number, and the dense rank of the subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'

WITH engineering_12unit_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), engineering_subject_dense_rank AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT e12.course_number, e12.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e12.SUBJECT_TITLE, e12.TOTAL_UNITS, e12.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, e12.window_column AS course_row_number, esdr.window_column AS subject_dense_rank FROM engineering_12unit_courses e12 LEFT JOIN engineering_subject_dense_rank esdr ON e12.SUBJECT_TITLE = esdr.SUBJECT_TITLE AND e12.course_number = esdr.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each Mathematics department course with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, and the highest number of enrolled students in any Mathematics department course for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.window_column, max_stats.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) max_stats ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = max_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.window_column;
sub_questions: For courses offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and assign row numbers within each academic year group ordered by course number.
For each academic year, give the academic year and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects.

For each Mathematics department course with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that academic year.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearlyEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yes.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathCourses mc JOIN YearlyEnrolledStats yes ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yes.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column;

question: Show the activity titles, enrollment types, maximum enrollments, session titles, session locations, session dates, session start and end times, the minimum session start time per session location, the dense rank (considering the current and 2 preceding rows) ordered by academic year, and the term description for IAP subject activities in term '2021JA' that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of at least 20, ordered by session location. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte.SESSION_TITLE, cte.SESSION_LOCATION, cte.SESSION_DATE, cte.SESSION_START_TIME, cte.SESSION_END_TIME, cte.min_start_time_per_location, dr.window_column, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ) dr ON cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = dr.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND cte.TERM_CODE = dr.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cte.SESSION_LOCATION;

question: For subjects that are both (1) offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units and (2) among the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', display the subject title, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, the offering department name, the count of reserved materials, the school name from the department table, and the department phone number from the admin department table, ordered by the count of reserved materials (descending) and then by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, t0.SUBJECT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, subq1.window_column, subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq2.reserved_materials, subq1.SUBJECT_ID FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.reserved_materials, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.reserved_materials DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and have a course level of 'G', show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the average of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, the variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, and the total number of subject codes for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' ), DepartmentCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii, dcs.total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DepartmentCourseStats dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the subject title from the subject offered summary, and the average total units from the course catalog for subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units. Only include results where the average total units is greater than 6. List the results ordered by department name and average total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_2010FA, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_2010FA, inner_cte.window_column, t25.SUBJECT_TITLE, t25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t25.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, tA.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_2025FA, tA.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_2025FA, tA.TERM_START_DATE, tA.TERM_END_DATE, tP.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t25.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t25.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t25 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = t25.SUBJECT_ID AND t25.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS tA ON t25.TERM_CODE = tA.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER tP ON tA.TERM_CODE = tP.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, t25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each department, where the range of total units for subjects offered in the academic year 2022 is greater than 0 and the average total units for subjects with at least one enrolled student and required course materials is greater than 0, give the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects with at least one enrolled student and required course materials, and the number of unique responsible faculty who taught these subjects with required materials and enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnits2022 AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), DeptUnitsWithMaterials AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2022.units_range, d2022.units_variance, dmat.avg_total_units, dmat.total_units_range, dmat.total_units_variance FROM DepartmentUnits2022 d2022 JOIN DeptUnitsWithMaterials dmat ON d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmat.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE d2022.units_range > 0 AND dmat.avg_total_units > 0 ORDER BY d2022.units_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS num_unique_faculty FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC;

question: For each previous academic term where the term start date matches the minimum academic term start date for a subject category and academic year with more than 10 maximum enrollment, show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the subject category key, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum academic term start date, the normalized subjects per year rounded (number of unique subjects divided by the average calendar year), and the total number of TIP_DETAIL records for that term.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), SubjectCategoryStats AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), TipCounts AS ( SELECT TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS tip_detail_count FROM TIP_DETAIL GROUP BY TERM_CODE ) SELECT ti.TERM_CODE, ti.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ti.TERM_START_DATE, ti.CALENDAR_DATE, ti.DAY_OF_WEEK, ti.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(ti.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year, COALESCE(tc.tip_detail_count, 0) AS tip_detail_count FROM inner_cte ti JOIN SubjectCategoryStats scs ON ti.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date LEFT JOIN TipCounts tc ON ti.TERM_CODE = tc.TERM_CODE ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses_with_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, ds.avg_enrollment, ds.enrollment_stddev, ds.num_courses_with_materials FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_stats ds ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: From the top 10 schools with the highest average total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, display each school's name, average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the course description and department name of the highest ranked degree-granting course in the School of Engineering (by department budget code), and the dense rank of that course within its school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EngineeringDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.avg_total_units, s.stddev_total_units, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column FROM inner_cte s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY window_column) AS rn FROM EngineeringDegreeCourses ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) e ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = e.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year.

For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code.

For each school, provide the school name, the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and for each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code. List the results ordered by the standard deviation of total units in descending order and then by the dense rank.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

WITH SchoolUnitsStats AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EngineeringDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.avg_total_units, s.stddev_total_units, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column FROM SchoolUnitsStats s JOIN EngineeringDegreeCourses e ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = e.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.stddev_total_units DESC, e.window_column;

question: For each academic term parameter, list the term parameter, term code, academic year, department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter (if available), and the number of unique subjects offered in that term parameter, with all columns shown in the order: term parameter, term code, academic year, department name, running sum of academic years, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), number of subjects, and reason for inclusion ('TermIndicatorC' for term indicator 'C' and 'RegularTermVariance' for regular term variance/statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Combined AS ( SELECT i.TERM_PARAMETER, i.TERM_CODE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS num_subjects, 'TermIndicatorC' AS Reason FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT s2.TERM_PARAMETER, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.num_subjects, 'RegularTermVariance' AS Reason FROM Sub2 s2 ) SELECT TERM_PARAMETER, TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, num_subjects, Reason FROM Combined ORDER BY TERM_PARAMETER, Reason;
sub_questions: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, and the running sum of academic years within each department, ordered by academic year.

List, for each academic term parameter, the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, the variance and standard deviation of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter (if available), and the reason for inclusion ('TermIndicatorC' for term indicator 'C' and 'RegularTermVariance' for regular term variance/statistics), with all columns shown in the order: term parameter, term code, academic year, department name, running sum of academic years, variance, standard deviation, and reason.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C'

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Combined AS ( SELECT s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'TermIndicatorC' AS Reason FROM Sub1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.TERM_PARAMETER, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, 'RegularTermVariance' AS Reason FROM Sub2 s2 ) SELECT TERM_PARAMETER, TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, Reason FROM Combined ORDER BY TERM_PARAMETER, Reason;

question: For each degree-granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, along with the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, and also include the subject title and subject description for one subject offered by that department in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH department_units_stats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), engineering_degree_courses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM engineering_degree_courses edc LEFT JOIN department_units_stats dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022

sub_sqls: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

WITH department_units_stats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), engineering_degree_courses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM engineering_degree_courses edc LEFT JOIN department_units_stats dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA that are also offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID, the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID, and for each department, include a grand total of enrolled students in the format of (null subject ID, null subject title, null row number, null running sum, department name, department full name, total enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS engineering_running_sum_units FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , DeptTotals AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.dept_row_number, i.engineering_running_sum_units, NULL AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS dept_row_number, NULL AS engineering_running_sum_units, d.total_enrolled_students FROM DeptTotals d ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS engineering_running_sum_units FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', and for each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, provide the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, and the responsible faculty name and their MIT ID for the subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH employee_type_department_g AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects_regular_terms AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT etd.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, etd.person_count, etd.min_mit_id, msrt.SUBJECT_TITLE, msrt.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, msrt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, msrt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, msrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msrt.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, msrt.max_total_units, msrt.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, msrt.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM employee_type_department_g etd JOIN math_subjects_regular_terms msrt ON etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msrt.join_dept_name ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

sub_sqls: SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'

WITH employee_type_department_g AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects_regular_terms AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT etd.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, etd.person_count, etd.min_mit_id, msrt.SUBJECT_TITLE, msrt.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, msrt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, msrt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, msrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msrt.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, msrt.max_total_units FROM employee_type_department_g etd JOIN math_subjects_regular_terms msrt ON etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msrt.join_dept_name;

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms assigned to the space unit, and the total number of rooms assigned to each space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, s.coefficient_of_variation, s.room_count FROM inner_cte o JOIN ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(zr.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ) s ON o.SPACE_UNIT = s.SPACE_UNIT AND o.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5

SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), SpaceUnitVariation AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, s.coefficient_of_variation FROM OrgLevel5 o JOIN SpaceUnitVariation s ON o.SPACE_UNIT = s.SPACE_UNIT AND o.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code, also provide the total number of unique instructors who assigned reserve materials for each subject. List the subject title, department name, term code, number of reserve materials, number of unique instructors, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject (considering only subjects with at least one reserved material and where the material status is 'U'). Order the results by the number of reserve materials in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), SubjectReserveStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC ), InstructorCounts AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS num_unique_instructors FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_reserve_materials, ic.num_unique_instructors, srs.reserved_material_range, srs.reserved_material_variance, srs.reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SubjectReserveStats srs ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = srs.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN InstructorCounts ic ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ic.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.TERM_CODE = ic.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.num_reserve_materials DESC;

WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), SubjectReserveStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.num_reserve_materials, srs.reserved_material_range, srs.reserved_material_variance, srs.reserved_material_stddev FROM TopSubjects ts JOIN SubjectReserveStats srs ON ts.SUBJECT_TITLE = srs.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ts.num_reserve_materials DESC;

question: From the top 10 departments in the Provost Area with the highest number of associated space units (where the department code is not null and the space unit key is greater than 100000), display each department's name, long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, the total count of space units, the most represented organization name among those space units, and the count of space units for that organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) , DeptSpaceUnitCounts AS ( SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.DLC_KEY, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS SpaceUnit_Count FROM inner_cte d JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON d.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.DLC_KEY ) , DeptOrgCounts AS ( SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS Org_SpaceUnit_Count FROM inner_cte d JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON d.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) , RankedDeptOrg AS ( SELECT doc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, doc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, doc.Org_SpaceUnit_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY doc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY doc.Org_SpaceUnit_Count DESC) AS OrgRank FROM DeptOrgCounts doc ) SELECT dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, dsc.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, dsc.SpaceUnit_Count, rdo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Most_Represented_Organization, rdo.Org_SpaceUnit_Count AS Org_SpaceUnit_Count FROM DeptSpaceUnitCounts dsc LEFT JOIN RankedDeptOrg rdo ON dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = rdo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rdo.OrgRank = 1 ORDER BY dsc.SpaceUnit_Count DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: For each department, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name, for departments in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code.

For space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, show the space unit code, the organization name, the HR department name, and the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, ordered by space unit key.

For each department in the Provost Area with a non-null department code and for each space unit with a space unit key greater than 100000 that matches the department, list the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, the row number assigned within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by department name, the space unit code, the organization name, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group ordered by space unit key, and the normalized space unit window value (sum of space unit keys divided by the department window row number), ordered by the normalized space unit window value in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL

SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000

WITH DeptWindow AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), SpaceUnitWindow AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.window_column AS spaceunit_window_column, ROUND(s.window_column / NULLIF(d.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_SpaceUnit_Window FROM DeptWindow d JOIN SpaceUnitWindow s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY AND d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Normalized_SpaceUnit_Window DESC

question: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, provide the academic year, department name, average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the term, and classify the department's average total units as 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgVarUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), LibSubjStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, l.subject_count, l.min_term_start_date FROM AvgVarUnits a JOIN LibSubjStats l ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY i.var_total_units DESC;

WITH AvgVarUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), LibSubjStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, l.subject_count, l.min_term_start_date FROM AvgVarUnits a JOIN LibSubjStats l ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC

question: Show the department names, the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with each department (considering only space units with a code greater than 0), the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, and the total number of space units per department, for departments where the organization is assignable and the organization level is greater than 4. Order the results by geometric mean descending and then by organization count descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanByDepartment AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), OrganizationStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, gmd.geometric_mean, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, gmd.DLC_KEY FROM GeometricMeanByDepartment gmd JOIN OrganizationStats os ON gmd.DLC_KEY = os.DLC_KEY AND gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY gmd.geometric_mean DESC, os.organization_count DESC ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.geometric_mean, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON icte.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.geometric_mean, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean DESC, icte.organization_count DESC;
