For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material.

For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary, and for each such subject also show the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses from the same department that have at least one associated course material. List the subject title, department name, subject description, window column, average enrollment, and enrollment standard deviation in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN Sub2 s2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year where the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year, show the academic year, academic year description, the average record count for TIP materials in that year (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), the range of record counts, the variance of record counts, the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL for that academic year, and the number of unique subjects that had TIP materials in that year. List the results in descending order of the total number of materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH YearlyTipStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), YearlyTotalMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) SELECT yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yts.avg_record_count, yts.record_count_range, yts.record_count_variance, ytm.total_materials FROM YearlyTipStats yts JOIN YearlyTotalMaterials ytm ON yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ytm.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_record_count, inner_cte.record_count_range, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.total_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_record_count, inner_cte.record_count_range, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.total_materials ORDER BY inner_cte.total_materials DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the record counts for TIP materials in that year, considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'.

For each academic year, what is the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL, considering only those academic years where the total number of materials is greater than one standard deviation above the mean total number of materials per academic year?

For each academic year where the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL is greater than one standard deviation above the mean total number of materials per academic year, show the academic year, academic year description, the average record count for TIP materials in that year (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), the range of record counts, the variance of record counts, and the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL for that academic year. List the results in descending order of the total number of materials.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub )

WITH YearlyTipStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), YearlyTotalMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) SELECT yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yts.avg_record_count, yts.record_count_range, yts.record_count_variance, ytm.total_materials FROM YearlyTipStats yts JOIN YearlyTotalMaterials ytm ON yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ytm.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ytm.total_materials DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' and offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, total units, department full name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the responsible faculty name and their MIT ID, ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, c.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM inner_cte s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = c.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject title, total units, department full name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.

For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' and offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, total units, department full name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, ordered by offering department name and subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'

WITH SubjectsIn2025FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, e.TOTAL_UNITS, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.window_column FROM SubjectsIn2025FA s JOIN EngineeringSubjects e ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = e.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = e.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and for each department, provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department. Additionally, for each subject, include the subject description from the course catalog and the full department name from the department table. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, icte.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON icte.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog.
For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for courses offered by that department.

For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and for each department, provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for courses offered by that department.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects, display for each department its department code, department name, and the total number of unique subjects it offers, and for each subject offered by these departments in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, and the subject's short title and total units from the course catalog, ordered by the total number of unique subjects, offering department name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.num_subjects, s2025fa.SUBJECT_ID, s2025fa.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025fa.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2025fa.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2025fa.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2025fa.TERM_START_DATE, s2025fa.TERM_END_DATE, s2025fa.TERM_PARAMETER, s2025fa.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ) dsc JOIN ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) s2025fa ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY inner_cte.num_subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;
sub_questions: What are the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects, and for each, what is the department code, department name, and the total number of unique subjects they offer?

For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by offering department.

For the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects, display for each department its department code, department name, and the total number of unique subjects it offers, and for each subject offered by these departments in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by the total number of unique subjects, offering department name, and subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA'

WITH dept_subject_counts AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), subjects_2025fa AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.num_subjects, s2025fa.SUBJECT_ID, s2025fa.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025fa.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2025fa.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2025fa.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2025fa.TERM_START_DATE, s2025fa.TERM_END_DATE, s2025fa.TERM_PARAMETER, s2025fa.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM dept_subject_counts dsc JOIN subjects_2025fa s2025fa ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dsc.num_subjects DESC, s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025fa.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department name and school name, where the department is degree granting and the department has more than 10 total enrolled students in courses offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA', and where at least 60% of the enrolled students in these courses are from the School of Engineering, provide the department name, school name, number of unique courses, minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, total number of enrolled students, and the number of enrolled students from the School of Engineering. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), CombinedDeptInfo AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.course_count, d.min_cip_code, s.total_enrolled FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses d JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptInfo ), EngineeringEnrolled AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS engineering_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrolled, COALESCE(e.engineering_enrolled, 0) AS engineering_enrolled FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN EngineeringEnrolled e ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE COALESCE(e.engineering_enrolled, 0) > 0.6 * i.total_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department name and school name, where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in courses that are offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA', where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10.

For each department name and school name, where the department is degree granting and the department has more than 10 total enrolled students in courses offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA', provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, and the total number of enrolled students. List the department name, school name, course count, minimum CIP program code, and total enrolled students in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10;

WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), CombinedDeptInfo AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.course_count, d.min_cip_code, s.total_enrolled FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses d JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptInfo ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, where the range of CIP program codes for all undergraduate courses in the department is greater than 1000, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, the variance of CIP program codes, and the full department name, with the results ordered by subject title and then by CIP code range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, icte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, dcs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentCIPStats dcs ON icte.DEPT_NAME_JOIN = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dcs.cip_code_range > 1000 ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dcs.cip_code_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the library, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, and the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, considering only subjects offered in the 'Mathematics' department during regular terms.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate.

For each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, where the range of CIP program codes for all undergraduate courses in the department is greater than 1000, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, and the variance of CIP program codes, with the results ordered by subject title and then by CIP code range descending.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC;

WITH SubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, so.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM SubjectOfferings so JOIN DepartmentCIPStats dcs ON so.DEPT_NAME_JOIN = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dcs.cip_code_range > 1000 ORDER BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE, dcs.cip_code_range DESC;

question: For each department where the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term is greater than 10, and for each course number in that department where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the department name, the total number of subject enrollments, the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects. List the department name, total number of subject enrollments, course number, number of unique library subjects offered, minimum total units, and average number of enrolled students in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, dcls.COURSE_NUMBER, dcls.subject_count, dcls.min_total_units FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ) de JOIN (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) dcls ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrollments, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrollments, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER;
sub_questions: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term, where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10.

For each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the number of unique library subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects.

For each department where the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term is greater than 10, and for each course number in that department where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the department name, the total number of subject enrollments, the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects. List the department name, total number of subject enrollments, course number, number of unique library subjects offered, and minimum total units in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10;

SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER;

WITH DepartmentEnrollments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), DepartmentCourseLibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, dcls.COURSE_NUMBER, dcls.subject_count, dcls.min_total_units FROM DepartmentEnrollments de JOIN DepartmentCourseLibraryStats dcls ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcls.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5 and the academic year has terms that are current or previous terms, show the department name, subject ID, subject title, the number of enrolled students for each subject, and the variance of the record count of tip details for those terms. List the results ordered by academic year, department name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ORDER BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms?

For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for those subjects.

For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5 and the academic year has terms that are current or previous terms, what are the academic year, academic year description, variance of the record count of tip details for those terms, department name, number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum number of total units for those subjects? List the results ordered by academic year and department name.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH AcademicYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.record_count_variance, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM AcademicYearVariance ayv JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department, what are the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', and the total number of enrolled students in courses that are offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA', where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10, and where at least 60% of the subjects in the department with library reserve materials in 'Previous' terms are also offered by the library in the term '2019FA'? List the results ordered by the variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), dept_subject_counts AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.SUBJECT_ID) AS prev_term_subjects FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_subjects_in_2019FA AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_in_2019FA FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, de.total_enrolled FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_enrollment de ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_subject_counts dsc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_subjects_in_2019FA dsf ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsf.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dsf.subjects_in_2019FA >= 0.6 * dsc.prev_term_subjects ORDER BY icte.total_units_variance DESC
sub_questions: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous'?

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in courses that are offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA', where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10.

sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10;

WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, de.total_enrolled FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN dept_enrollment de ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the number of subjects offered in the 2019FA term that are also offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, COALESCE(eng_subj.Eng_2019FA_Subjects, 0) AS Eng_2019FA_Subjects FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS Eng_2019FA_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) eng_subj ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = eng_subj.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, and assign row numbers within each department name group ordered by subject ID.

For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school, ordered by subject ID.

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS engineering_running_sum_units FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting and the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA' is greater than 10, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the total number of enrolled students, and the department phone number. The columns should be department name, school name, number of unique courses, minimum CIP program code, total number of enrolled students, and department phone number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_course_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, des.total_enrolled FROM dept_course_stats dcs JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.course_count, inner_cte.min_cip_code, inner_cte.total_enrolled, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For all pairs of subjects where one is offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students and the other is in the term '2009SP', show the 2019FA subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, along with the 2009SP subject title, department name, total units, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for each pair, include the school name for the 2019FA subject and the academic year description for the 2009SP term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2019fa, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, s1.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name_2019fa, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2009sp, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column AS row_number_window, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS academic_year_desc_2009sp FROM subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2019fa, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2009sp, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column AS row_number_window FROM subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 s2;

question: From the top 10 buildings with the highest average total units for subjects scheduled in their rooms during the fall term, display each building key, its average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the subject code most frequently scheduled in that building during the fall term, and the count of times that subject code is scheduled there. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, bsc.SUBJECT_CODE AS Most_Frequent_Subject_Code, bsc.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = cso.MEET_PLACE WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, cso.SUBJECT_CODE ) bsc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bsc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bsc.rnk = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC;

SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH SubjectCodes AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), BuildingStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.window_column, bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units FROM SubjectCodes sc JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingStats bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'

question: Among all subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, which are also available in the library by the Mathematics department during regular terms, show for each subject: the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, the number of enrolled students, offering department name, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, and the department with the highest number of enrolled students for that subject along with the corresponding student count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subjects2024_12Units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), MathLibrarySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, m.max_total_units, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM Subjects2024_12Units s JOIN MathLibrarySubjects m ON s.SUBJECT_ID = m.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ic.max_total_units, d.Most_Prominent_Department, d.Student_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, ss.Student_Count FROM ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Student_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) ss WHERE ss.dept_rank = 1 ) d ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, the number of subject codes for each department and subject code, the minimum department budget code, and the maximum department last activity date for each department and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, MAX(d.DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE) AS max_dept_last_activity_date FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dss.max_dept_last_activity_date FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SUBJECT_CODE = dss.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH SubjectCodeRank AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT scr.SUBJECT_CODE, scr.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scr.SCHOOL_NAME, scr.window_column, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code FROM SubjectCodeRank scr JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scr.SUBJECT_CODE = dss.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY scr.SCHOOL_NAME, scr.window_column;

question: For each department and course level, provide the department name, course level, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department and course level (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units). For students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name. Present all these columns in the following order: department name, course level, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, full name, email address, course description, and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL) = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, COURSE_LEVEL, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units, NULL AS FULL_NAME, NULL AS EMAIL_ADDRESS, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY department_name, COURSE_LEVEL, FULL_NAME

question: For each department in the "Provost Area", grouped by department hierarchy level 2 name, and for each associated organization, list the department hierarchy level 2 name, department code, department name, number of organizational units, minimum department ID, organization name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room areas for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area, and also include the total number of rooms and the average room area for each organization. Order the results by department name and then by area range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgRoomStats AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY area_range DESC ), ProvostDeptStats AS ( SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id, h.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DLC_KEY ) SELECT p.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.org_unit_count, p.min_department_id, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.area_range, o.area_variance, o.area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM ProvostDeptStats p JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON p.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN OrgRoomStats o ON f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.org_unit_count, i.min_department_id, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.area_range, i.area_variance, i.area_stddev, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.org_unit_count, i.min_department_id, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.area_range, i.area_variance, i.area_stddev ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.area_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each organization, give the organization name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the room areas for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area.

For each department code and department name, grouped by the department hierarchy level 2 name, where the department belongs to the "Provost Area", give the number of organizational units and the minimum department ID.

For each department code and department name, grouped by the department hierarchy level 2 name, where the department belongs to the "Provost Area", and for each associated organization, give the department hierarchy level 2 name, department code, department name, number of organizational units, minimum department ID, organization name, and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the room areas for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area. List the results ordered by department name and then by area range descending.
sub_sqls: SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC;

SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

WITH OrgRoomStats AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY area_range DESC ), ProvostDeptStats AS ( SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id, h.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DLC_KEY ) SELECT p.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.org_unit_count, p.min_department_id, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.area_range, o.area_variance, o.area_stddev FROM ProvostDeptStats p JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON p.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN OrgRoomStats o ON f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.area_range DESC;

question: For each organization and department in the Provost Area with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, list the organization name, organization key, department name, department code, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by department code, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name, but only include those departments where the average organization key is greater than the overall average organization key for all such departments. Order the results by department code and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_avg_key, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_row_number FROM OrgStats o JOIN DeptStats d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE org_window_avg_key > (SELECT AVG(org_window_avg_key) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

For each organization and department in the Provost Area with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, list the organization name, organization key, department name, department code, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by department code, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name.
