SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each room with area greater than 200, what are the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group (ordered by building-room), and for the corresponding DLC key, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations that have a non-null organization name)? Additionally, for each such room, what is the total number of rooms assigned to the same organization? Present the results ordered by building-room. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dlc_org_stats AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ), room_area_stats AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, ras.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM room_area_stats ras LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats dos ON ras.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM ) SELECT icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.window_column, icte.org_count_range, icte.org_count_variance, icte.org_count_stddev, org_room_counts.total_rooms_per_org FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms_per_org FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) org_room_counts ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = org_room_counts.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.BUILDING_ROOM;

WITH dlc_org_stats AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ), room_area_stats AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev FROM room_area_stats ras LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats dos ON ras.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, show the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, the minimum area value over each major use group for rooms with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, and also include the organization description from the organization table, ordered by major use description, organization name, and major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE;

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.MAJOR_USE

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', show the subject key, subject title, academic year, the running sum of the number of enrolled students within each department, and the deviation of each subject's enrolled students from the average number of enrolled students for that department in that year, along with the academic year description, the range, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), ordered by subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), lib_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.running_enrollment_sum, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_dept_avg, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, l.enrolled_range, l.enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN lib_stats l ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_KEY;

sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives'

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.running_enrollment_sum, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.enrolled_range, s2.enrolled_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_KEY;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department (if available), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least 5 different materials assigned in term '2013FA' (if available), and indicate whether the department is a 'HIGH_VARIANCE' department (catalog key variance at least 10% greater than the average variance across all departments), a 'LOW_VARIANCE' department (catalog key variance at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. If the department only has enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), indicate 'ENROLLED_STDDEV_ONLY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(catalog_key_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ), DeptEnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT COALESCE(ic.DEPARTMENT, des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPT_NAME, ic.catalog_key_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, CASE WHEN ic.catalog_key_variance IS NOT NULL AND vb.avg_variance IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN ic.catalog_key_variance > vb.avg_variance * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.catalog_key_variance < vb.avg_variance * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END WHEN des.enrolled_stddev IS NOT NULL THEN 'ENROLLED_STDDEV_ONLY' ELSE NULL END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledStddev des ON ic.DEPARTMENT = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark vb UNION SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, NULL AS catalog_key_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, 'ENROLLED_STDDEV_ONLY' AS variance_category FROM DeptEnrolledStddev des LEFT JOIN inner_cte ic ON des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT WHERE ic.DEPARTMENT IS NULL ORDER BY DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the name of the department and the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U'?

For each department, what is the name of the department and the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned, considering only courses offered in the term '2013FA'?

List the name of each department, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department (if available), the standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least 5 different materials assigned in term '2013FA' (if available), and the reason for inclusion ('CatalogVariance' for catalog key variance and 'EnrolledStddev' for enrolled students standard deviation).
sub_sqls: SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC;

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

WITH DeptCatalogVariance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), DeptEnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT AS DEPT_NAME, catalog_key_variance, NULL AS enrolled_stddev, 'CatalogVariance' AS Reason FROM DeptCatalogVariance UNION ALL SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, NULL AS catalog_key_variance, enrolled_stddev, 'EnrolledStddev' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrolledStddev ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPT_NAME;

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student and is offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, the department name, the course description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the school name from the SIS_SUBJECT_CODE table, ordered by total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, department name, and course description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.

For each subject that has at least one enrolled student and is offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, the department name, the course description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, ordered by total units descending.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E'

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10 students), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (1-2 students), or 'MEDIUM_ENROLLMENT' (otherwise), with the columns listed in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS dept_rank, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s2.window_column AS material_status_rank FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_rank, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, material_status_rank FROM CombinedSubjects ) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_rank, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, material_status_rank, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 10 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'MEDIUM_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COURSE_NUMBER;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, and the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key.

List the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, and the reserve catalog key for each subject, along with dense ranks over the material status key ordered by material status key, for subjects that have more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U'.

For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, and the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, with the columns listed in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'

SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS dept_rank, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s2.window_column AS material_status_rank FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_rank, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, material_status_rank FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the old department codes among its associated HR organization units (only including organizations where the average old department code is greater than zero), and the HR organization unit title, ordered by number of supervisees. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), org_coeff_var AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ) SELECT s.space_unit_name, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DEPT_COUNT, s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, s.avg_dept_count_within_group, o.coefficient_of_variation, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte s LEFT JOIN org_coeff_var o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES
sub_questions: For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, and the average department count within each department count group ordered by number of supervisees.

For each organization, what is the coefficient of variation of the old department codes among its associated HR organization units? Show the organization name and the coefficient of variation, but only include organizations where the average old department code is greater than zero.

For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group, and the coefficient of variation of the old department codes among its associated HR organization units (only including organizations where the average old department code is greater than zero), ordered by number of supervisees.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500

SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH space_unit_info AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), org_coeff_var AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT s.space_unit_name, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DEPT_COUNT, s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, s.avg_dept_count_within_group, o.coefficient_of_variation FROM space_unit_info s LEFT JOIN org_coeff_var o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year. Additionally, for each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', show the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units. For each offering department and school, also include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (offering department name, offering school name, null, total subjects, min total units). Order the results by offering department name, offering school name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), DeptSchoolAgg AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID ), DeptSchoolRollup AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolAgg GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT dsr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsr.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dsr.SUBJECT_ID, dsr.subject_count, dsr.min_total_units, icte.SUBJECT_ID AS cte_subject_id, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column FROM DeptSchoolRollup dsr LEFT JOIN inner_cte icte ON dsr.SUBJECT_ID = icte.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY dsr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsr.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dsr.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, ordered by subject ID.
For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects.

For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, along with the offering department name, offering school name, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units for each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN subq2 s2 ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department name and its corresponding organization key where the department is in the Provost Area, and for each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, list the department name, organization key, number of organizations, minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, organization, space unit, number of space units, and minimum organization number. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name and organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptProvostStats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), OrgSpaceStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT dps.DLC_NAME, dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dps.org_count, dps.min_level3_code, oss.ORGANIZATION, oss.SPACE_UNIT, oss.space_unit_count, oss.min_org_number FROM DeptProvostStats dps JOIN OrgSpaceStats oss ON dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oss.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DLC_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY dlc_sort, org_sort) = DLC_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DLC_NAME END AS department, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_count, min_level3_code, ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, space_unit_count, min_org_number FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS dlc_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_count, min_level3_code, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION END AS org_sort, ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, space_unit_count, min_org_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_count, min_level3_code, ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, space_unit_count, min_org_number WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dlc_sort, org_sort;
sub_questions: For each department name and its corresponding organization key where the department is in the Provost Area, provide the number of organizations and the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code.

For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, provide the number of space units and the minimum organization number.

For each department name and its corresponding organization key where the department is in the Provost Area, and for each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, provide the department name, organization key, number of organizations, minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, organization, space unit, number of space units, and minimum organization number, for all cases where the organization key matches between the department and the organization.
sub_sqls: SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT;

WITH DeptProvostStats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), OrgSpaceStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT dps.DLC_NAME, dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dps.org_count, dps.min_level3_code, oss.ORGANIZATION, oss.SPACE_UNIT, oss.space_unit_count, oss.min_org_number FROM DeptProvostStats dps JOIN OrgSpaceStats oss ON dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oss.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY dps.DLC_NAME, oss.ORGANIZATION, oss.SPACE_UNIT;

question: For each space unit that has rooms on floor 2 and a space unit key greater than 100000, what is the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of its associated rooms on floor 2, the organization name, the HR department name, and the HR org unit title, as well as the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, ordered by space unit key? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH space_unit_access_stats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC ), space_unit_org_window AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.access_level_variance, s1.access_level_stddev, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column, zr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM space_unit_access_stats s1 JOIN space_unit_org_window s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.access_level_variance, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT;
sub_questions: For each space unit, what is the name of the space unit, and what are both the variance and standard deviation of the access levels of rooms associated with that space unit, considering only rooms on floor 2?

WITH space_unit_access_stats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC ), space_unit_org_window AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.access_level_variance, s1.access_level_stddev, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM space_unit_access_stats s1 JOIN space_unit_org_window s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings for the same department, considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables. Additionally, for each result, include the maximum subject enrollment number for that department and total units combination across all terms. List the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, windowed average subject enrollment number, library students variance, library students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the maximum subject enrollment number in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), LibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ), MaxEnrollment AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, MAX(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_subject_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TOTAL_UNITS ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev, me.max_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte s JOIN LibraryStats ls ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN MaxEnrollment me ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = me.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.TOTAL_UNITS = me.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER

WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), LibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev FROM SubjectStats s JOIN LibraryStats ls ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For each academic term where the term status indicator is 'P', show the term code, the term parameter, the term description, the academic year, the term start date, and the average academic year in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the term indicator and ordered by the term start date. Additionally, for the academic year of each such term, give the academic year description, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and for each such subject, show the subject code, subject number, and subject title, with the results ordered by term code and by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P' ) SELECT pts.TERM_CODE, pts.TERM_PARAMETER, pts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pts.TERM_START_DATE, pts.window_column, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units FROM PreviousTerms pts JOIN AcademicYearStats ays ON pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P' ) SELECT pts.TERM_CODE, pts.TERM_PARAMETER, pts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pts.TERM_START_DATE, pts.window_column, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units FROM PreviousTerms pts JOIN AcademicYearStats ays ON pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY pts.TERM_CODE, ays.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings for the same department (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables). Additionally, for each such department, show the maximum number of enrolled students in any library subject for that department. List the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, windowed average subject enrollment number, library students variance, library students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the maximum number of enrolled students in library subjects for the department, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), library_stats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), library_max_enroll AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_library_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev, lm.max_library_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN library_stats ls ON i.join_dept_name = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN library_max_enroll lm ON i.join_dept_name = lm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.library_students_variance, s2.library_students_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER;

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA, and for courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show the subject ID, subject title (from 2019FA), number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID, course number, course description, subject title (from 12-unit Engineering courses), total units, offering department name, and row number within each offering department ordered by course number, as well as the department's school name, for cases where the offering department code matches between the two sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2019fa, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS subject_window_column, s2.course_number, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_12units, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column AS course_window_column, s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.subject_title_2019fa, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.subject_window_column, inner_cte.course_number, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.subject_title_12units, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.course_window_column, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 30, and for tip details where the material status key is 'RQ', show the activity title, enrollment type, prerequisites, term code, IAP term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum term start date over each term code group, the tip subject offered key, tip material key, subject ID, tip term description, academic year, the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by academic year, and the academic year description, ordered by term code and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH IAPActivities AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ), TipRQDetails AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, trd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, trd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, trd.SUBJECT_ID, trd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, trd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, trd.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities ia JOIN TipRQDetails trd ON ia.TERM_CODE = trd.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each student in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and their row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name, along with the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by their department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units). Additionally, display the name of the school their department belongs to and the number of students in the same department. List the results ordered by the row number within each course level group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_student_counts.student_count FROM EECSStudents eecs JOIN DepartmentUnits du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) dept_student_counts ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_student_counts.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY eecs.window_column ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' and offered by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, provide the subject key, subject title, department name, the number of subject offerings, the total number of units for those offerings, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students in the offered table, and classify each subject as 'HIGH_UNIT' if its total units are at least 10% greater than the average total units for such subjects, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. List the results ordered by the total number of units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT ) SELECT sq2.SUBJECT_KEY, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.offering_count, sq2.total_units, sq1.window_column, sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM Subquery2 sq2 JOIN Subquery1 sq1 ON sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sq1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT ), unit_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_KEY, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.offering_count, ic.total_units, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN ic.total_units > ub.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.total_units < ub.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN unit_benchmark ub ORDER BY ic.total_units DESC

question: For space units with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations that have a non-null organization name), and also include the description of the organization and the warehouse load date of the space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER ( ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_min_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT icte.space_unit_name, icte.organization_name, icte.dlc_name, icte.org_dlc_key, icte.window_min_space_unit_code, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, fo.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description, su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_unit_warehouse_load_date FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ) dos ON icte.org_dlc_key = dos.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.org_dlc_key = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON icte.org_dlc_key = su.DLC_KEY AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500;

SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC;

WITH SpaceUnitInfo AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), DLCOrgStats AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ) SELECT sui.space_unit_name, sui.organization_name, sui.dlc_name, sui.org_dlc_key, sui.window_min_space_unit_code, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev FROM SpaceUnitInfo sui JOIN DLCOrgStats dos ON sui.org_dlc_key = dos.DLC_KEY;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number. Additionally, for the offering department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting. Also, include the department's full name and school name. The results are ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, stats.avg_course_number_ascii, stats.var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) stats ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department, list the department name, the range and variance of the areas of rooms assigned to it (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), the range and variance of the space unit codes associated with it (considering only organizations that have a non-null description and space units with a non-null space unit name), and the total number of unique buildings in which the department has rooms with area greater than 40, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ), OrganizationSpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY code_range DESC ) SELECT drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drs.area_range, drs.area_variance, oss.code_range, oss.code_variance FROM DepartmentRoomStats drs JOIN OrganizationSpaceUnitStats oss ON drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY drs.area_range DESC, oss.code_range DESC ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.area_range, icte.area_variance, icte.code_range, icte.code_variance, COALESCE(bldg_stats.building_count, 0) AS unique_building_count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) bldg_stats ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = bldg_stats.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte.area_range DESC, icte.code_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (considering only records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the average of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the average lecture units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve? Present the results ordered by the geometric mean of materials per subject in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, astu.avg_total_units, astu.stddev_total_units FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject gmmps LEFT JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU astu ON gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, avg_lecture_units.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) avg_lecture_units ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_lecture_units.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC;
