For each degree-granting department and course level, list the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects, the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the course level, the number of unique students, the minimum CIP program code among their courses, and calculate the average enrollment per student (average enrollment divided by number of unique students, rounded to two decimals), ordered by average enrollment per student descending.
sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptStudentCIP AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev, dsc.COURSE_LEVEL, dsc.student_count, dsc.min_cip_code, ROUND(des.avg_enrollment / NULLIF(dsc.student_count, 0), 2) AS avg_enrollment_per_student FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN DeptStudentCIP dsc ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_enrollment_per_student DESC;

question: For each department, list the top 5 departments by the total number of unique reserved materials assigned (where the material status is 'U'), and for each, also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per term within that department. Show the department name, total number of reserved materials, reserved material range per term, reserved material variance per term, and reserved material standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) per term, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 5 ), DeptTermStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS reserved_material_range_per_term, VARIANCE(term_material_count) AS reserved_material_variance_per_term, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev_per_term FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ( SELECT lso2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso2.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd2 ON lso2.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lso2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso2.TERM_CODE ) t ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_reserved_materials, dts.reserved_material_range_per_term, dts.reserved_material_variance_per_term, dts.reserved_material_stddev_per_term FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptTermStats dts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code.

For each subject offered, give the subject title and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of reserved materials per subject, considering only subjects with at least one reserved material and where the material status is 'U'.

List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code, and for each of these subjects, also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of reserved materials per subject (considering only subjects with at least one reserved material and where the material status is 'U'). Show the subject title, department name, term code, number of reserve materials, reserved material range, reserved material variance, and reserved material standard deviation, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC;

WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), SubjectStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.num_reserve_materials, ss.reserved_material_range, ss.reserved_material_variance, ss.reserved_material_stddev FROM TopSubjects ts LEFT JOIN SubjectStats ss ON ts.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, and for each department, also provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. Additionally, for each department and academic year, show the number of unique subjects offered and the number of subjects with variable units. Present the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), TermDeptWindow AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT tdw.TERM_PARAMETER, tdw.TERM_CODE, tdw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdw.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM TermDeptWindow tdw JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, SUM(CASE WHEN cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_variable_unit_subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C'

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), TermDeptWindow AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT tdw.TERM_PARAMETER, tdw.TERM_CODE, tdw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdw.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM TermDeptWindow tdw JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdw.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', and for each subject offered in the term '2017JA' in that department, provide the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the maximum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, as well as the school name of the offering department, ordered by employee type, department name, and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EmployeeTypeDeptStats AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), SubjectOfferStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.person_count, e.min_mit_id, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.window_column FROM EmployeeTypeDeptStats e JOIN SubjectOfferStats s ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE) AS max_enrolled_students_per_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE
sub_questions: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', provide the number of people and the minimum MIT ID.

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by subject code.

For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', and for each subject offered in the term '2017JA' in that department, provide the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by employee type, department name, and subject code.
sub_sqls: SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'

WITH EmployeeTypeDeptStats AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), SubjectOfferStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.person_count, e.min_mit_id, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.window_column FROM EmployeeTypeDeptStats e JOIN SubjectOfferStats s ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each of the top 10 subjects offered in the term with term code '2012SU' that are also offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', show the subject's title, offer department name, offer school name, cluster type description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, the academic year, the running sum of the number of enrolled students within each department ordered by subject key, and the deviation of the subject's current enrolled students from the average enrolled students for that department in 2012, sorted by the running enrollment sum in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.running_enrollment_sum, s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.SUBJECT_KEY FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_KEY = s2.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY s2.running_enrollment_sum DESC LIMIT 10 ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' GROUP BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, i.window_column, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.running_enrollment_sum, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY i.running_enrollment_sum DESC;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with term code '2012SU', show the subject title, offer department name, offer school name, cluster type description, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year.

For subjects offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', show the subject key, subject title, academic year, and the running sum of the number of enrolled students within each department, ordered by subject key.

From the top 10 subjects offered in the term with term code '2012SU' that are also offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', display each subject's title, offer department name, offer school name, cluster type description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, the academic year, and the running sum of the number of enrolled students within each department ordered by subject key, sorted by the running enrollment sum in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives'

WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.running_enrollment_sum FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_KEY = s2.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY s2.running_enrollment_sum DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, give the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID ;

sub_sqls: SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH MostRecentYearStats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), RegularTermStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, m.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, m.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, r.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, r.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, r.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance FROM MostRecentYearStats m JOIN RegularTermStats r ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each previous academic term where the term start date matches the minimum academic term start date for a subject category and academic year with more than 10 maximum enrollment, show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the subject category key, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum academic term start date, the normalized subjects per year rounded (number of unique subjects divided by the average calendar year), and for each such term, also list the number of unique subject IDs offered in that term and the earliest preregistration deadline among those subjects.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), SubjectCategoryStats AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), TermSubjectInfo AS ( SELECT t.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_ids, MIN(i.PREREG_DEADLINE) AS earliest_prereg_deadline FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i ON t.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE ) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(icte.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year, tsi.unique_subject_ids, tsi.earliest_prereg_deadline FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SubjectCategoryStats scs ON icte.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date JOIN TermSubjectInfo tsi ON icte.TERM_CODE = tsi.TERM_CODE ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC;

WITH TermInfo AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), SubjectCategoryStats AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ti.TERM_CODE, ti.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ti.TERM_START_DATE, ti.CALENDAR_DATE, ti.DAY_OF_WEEK, ti.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(ti.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year FROM TermInfo ti JOIN SubjectCategoryStats scs ON ti.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, and that also has at least one active graduate student with an office location assigned, list the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned, and the average number of enrolled students per subject for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EngDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), ActiveGradStudents AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.subject_count, e.total_enrollment, a.total_active_grad_students FROM EngDeptSubjects e JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ActiveGradStudents a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, total_active_grad_students, CASE WHEN subject_count > 0 THEN CAST(total_enrollment AS FLOAT)/subject_count ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte;

WITH EngDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), ActiveGradStudents AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.subject_count, e.total_enrollment, a.total_active_grad_students FROM EngDeptSubjects e JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ActiveGradStudents a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT

question: For each department, show the department code, department name, and the number of subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 and scheduled in rooms of buildings that have subjects offered in the fall term, but only for departments where this count is greater than the average such count across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), BuildingStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte ds JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ds.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ds.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND ds.TOTAL_UNITS = cso.TOTAL_UNITS JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingStats bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.subject_count FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc WHERE dsc.subject_count > ( SELECT AVG(subject_count) FROM DeptSubjectCounts ) ORDER BY dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t0.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) , DepartmentAggregates AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE) AS unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) AS unique_subject_code_descs FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , SchoolRollup AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(unique_courses) AS total_courses, SUM(unique_subject_code_descs) AS total_subject_code_descs FROM DepartmentAggregates GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(unique_courses) > 0 ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_courses, total_subject_code_descs FROM SchoolRollup ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the subject code description, and the row number of each course within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.COURSE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS dense_rank_by_budget_code, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.window_column AS row_number_by_course_description FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.COURSE = s2.COURSE ORDER BY s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION

question: Among organizations at level 5, list the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms assigned to the space unit, and for each, the space usage type that appears most frequently among its rooms, along with the count of rooms for that usage. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), SpaceUnitVariation AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ), RoomUsageRanked AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, zr.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(*) AS usage_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, zr.SPACE_USAGE ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.DESCRIPTION, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, icte.window_column, suv.coefficient_of_variation, rur.SPACE_USAGE AS most_frequent_space_usage, rur.usage_count AS usage_count_for_space_usage FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SpaceUnitVariation suv ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = suv.SPACE_UNIT AND icte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = suv.SPACE_UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN RoomUsageRanked rur ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = rur.SPACE_UNIT AND icte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = rur.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AND rur.rn = 1
sub_questions: For each organization with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, and the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key.
For each space unit, what is the coefficient of variation of the access levels of rooms assigned to it, and what is the name of the space unit?

For each organization with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, and the coefficient of variation of the access levels of rooms assigned to the space unit.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5

SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), SpaceUnitVariation AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, s.coefficient_of_variation FROM OrgLevel5 o JOIN SpaceUnitVariation s ON o.SPACE_UNIT = s.SPACE_UNIT AND o.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For each department, among those that offered subjects in the academic year 2022 and are also listed in the CIS course catalog, what is the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and the most common HASS attribute among its offered subjects in 2022? Present the department name, units range, variance of units range, average units, variance of average units, most common HASS attribute, and the count of subjects with that attribute, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_units_range_variance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), dept_avg_variance_units AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dr.units_range, dr.units_variance AS range_variance, da.avg_units, da.units_variance AS avg_variance FROM dept_units_range_variance dr JOIN dept_avg_variance_units da ON dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), hass_mode AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, COUNT(*) AS hass_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.HASS_ATTRIBUTE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.range_variance, icte.avg_units, icte.avg_variance, hm.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS most_common_hass_attribute, hm.hass_count AS hass_attribute_count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN hass_mode hm ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hm.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.units_range DESC;

WITH dept_units_range_variance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), dept_avg_variance_units AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dr.units_range, dr.units_variance AS range_variance, da.avg_units, da.units_variance AS avg_variance FROM dept_units_range_variance dr JOIN dept_avg_variance_units da ON dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, provide the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the range of the space unit codes, the variance of the space unit codes associated with the organization, and indicate whether the code range is 'LARGE_RANGE' (at least 100000), 'SMALL_RANGE' (less than 10000), or 'MEDIUM_RANGE' (otherwise). List the major use description, organization name, number of rooms, minimum floor number, code range, code variance, and range category in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), OrgSpaceStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, os.code_range, os.code_variance FROM RoomStats rs JOIN OrgSpaceStats os ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND rs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = os.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.code_range, inner_cte.code_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.code_range >= 100000 THEN 'LARGE_RANGE' WHEN inner_cte.code_range < 10000 THEN 'SMALL_RANGE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_RANGE' END AS range_category FROM inner_cte;

sub_sqls: SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), OrgSpaceStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, os.code_range, os.code_variance FROM RoomStats rs JOIN OrgSpaceStats os ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND rs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = os.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

question: Show the space unit names, their average room square footage, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room square footage, the DLC name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, and the total number of organizations per DLC for each space unit whose DLC has more than five organizations. List the results ordered by the total number of organizations per DLC in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC ), DLCOrgStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ) SELECT srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.avg_room_sqft, srs.stddev_room_sqft, dos.DLC_NAME, dos.org_number_stddev, dos.DLC_KEY FROM SpaceUnitRoomStats srs JOIN DLCOrgStddev dos ON srs.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.avg_room_sqft, inner_cte.stddev_room_sqft, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.org_number_stddev, DLCOrgCount.total_orgs_per_dlc FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_orgs_per_dlc FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) DLCOrgCount ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = DLCOrgCount.DLC_KEY ORDER BY DLCOrgCount.total_orgs_per_dlc DESC;
sub_questions: For each space unit, provide the space unit name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the room square footage for all rooms in that space unit.
For each DLC, provide the DLC name and the standard deviation of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, considering only DLCs with more than five organizations.

For each space unit whose DLC has more than five organizations, provide the space unit name, the average room square footage, the standard deviation of the room square footage, the DLC name, and the standard deviation of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC. List the results ordered by the standard deviation of the room square footage in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC;

SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC;

WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC ), DLCOrgStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ) SELECT srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.avg_room_sqft, srs.stddev_room_sqft, dos.DLC_NAME, dos.org_number_stddev FROM SpaceUnitRoomStats srs JOIN DLCOrgStddev dos ON srs.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY srs.stddev_room_sqft DESC

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code. Additionally, for subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA' in the same department, provide the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year ordered by subject ID, and the subject's short title and responsible faculty name from the course catalog. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_total_units, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS CATALOG_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s2.CATALOG_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code.
For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, ordered by subject ID.

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code, along with, for subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA' in the same department, the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year ordered by subject ID.

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering that are also offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, total units, department full name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name for the term, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, and for each department full name, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (null, null, department full name, null, null, null, null, null, null, total enrolled students), ordered by department full name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EngSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), TermSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.window_column AS eng_window_row_number, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS term_dept_full_name, ts.SUBJECT_CODE, ts.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ts.window_column AS min_enrolled_by_code FROM EngSubjects es JOIN TermSubjects ts ON es.SUBJECT_TITLE = ts.SUBJECT_TITLE AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE TOTAL_UNITS END AS TOTAL_UNITS, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE eng_window_row_number END AS eng_window_row_number, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS END AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE term_dept_full_name END AS term_dept_full_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_CODE END AS SUBJECT_CODE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_CODE_DESC END AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, eng_window_row_number, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, term_dept_full_name, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
