WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), UnitsVariance AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN UnitsVariance uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE es.enrolled_range > 0 AND uv.total_units_variance IS NOT NULL ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, and for students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, the student's full name, email address, course description, course level, and the department's full name, as well as the row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, esc.FULL_NAME, esc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, esc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, esc.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, esc.window_column FROM inner_cte dmu JOIN ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) esc ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON esc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: From the top 10 departments in the academic year 2022 with the highest average subject enrollment for 12-unit subjects, display each department's name, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', the subject code, subject number, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_variance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), subject_window AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.TOTAL_UNITS, sw.window_column, sw.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM subject_window sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.catalog_key_variance, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.window_column FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(window_column) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(catalog_key_variance) AS catalog_key_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10 ) top_depts JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_depts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY top_depts.avg_enrollment DESC, ic.TOTAL_UNITS DESC;

question: List the department names, total subject enrollments for the current term, course numbers in those departments with more than 2 enrolled students, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the corresponding subject titles. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH department_enrollments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), library_subjects_summary AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units FROM department_enrollments de JOIN library_subjects_summary lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollments, icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, so.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON icte.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY so ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2;

sub_sqls: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10;

SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER;

WITH department_enrollments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), library_subjects_summary AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units FROM department_enrollments de JOIN library_subjects_summary lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject title, total units, department full name, row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, as well as the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material and at least one course material with a non-null ISBN, and also display the number of distinct terms in which these subjects were offered, with the average, variance, and term count shown for each subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, subq2.avg_enrolled, subq2.enrolled_variance, subq2.num_terms FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subq2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject code, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, and for each department also show the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms. Additionally, include the school name and department phone number for each department. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE

SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code, and for academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', provide the subject title, department name, term code, term description, academic year, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, the number of reserve materials assigned, and the academic year description from the all-terms table, for terms where both conditions are met. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column, ts.num_reserve_materials FROM ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) ts JOIN ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) pt ON ts.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.num_reserve_materials, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE;

sub_sqls: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'

WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column, ts.num_reserve_materials FROM TopSubjects ts JOIN PreviousTerms pt ON ts.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department that grants degrees, what is the maximum and minimum number of enrolled students in the graduate-level subjects offered by that department, as well as the average and total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department with a non-null subject code description? Please provide the department name, the maximum number of enrolled students (graduate-level), the minimum number of enrolled students (graduate-level), the average number of enrolled students (with non-null subject code description), and the total number of enrolled students (with non-null subject code description), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_grad, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_grad, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enroll_stats_desc AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrolled_grad, i.min_enrolled_grad, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_enroll_stats_desc d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.max_enrolled_grad DESC;

Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students (graduate-level), the variance of enrolled students (with non-null subject code description), and the standard deviation of enrolled students (with non-null subject code description), in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

WITH dept_enroll_stats_grad AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enroll_stats_desc AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT g.DEPARTMENT_NAME, g.enrolled_range, g.enrolled_variance, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM dept_enroll_stats_grad g JOIN dept_enroll_stats_desc d ON g.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY g.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units for those subjects where the course material status is 'RQ', grouped by offering department and school. Additionally, for each offering department and school, include a grand total row for all subjects in the format of (nulls for subject-specific columns, department, school, nulls for subject-specific columns, subject count, min total units). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, i.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN Subq2 s2 ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, NULL AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Subq2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, ACADEMIC_YEAR

For each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units for those subjects where the course material status is 'RQ', grouped by offering department and school.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s1.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department name and its corresponding organization key in the Provost Area, provide the number of organizations, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room, and, for each major use description, show only those where the sum of room areas is greater than 1000. Also, calculate the ratio of the sum of room areas within each major use description group to the number of organizations (rounded), ordered by this ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptProvostArea AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), RoomAreaWindow AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT dpa.DLC_NAME, dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dpa.org_count, dpa.min_level3_code, raw.BUILDING_ROOM, raw.ORGANIZATION_NAME, raw.DLC_KEY, raw.MAJOR_USE_DESC, raw.window_column, ROUND(raw.window_column / NULLIF(dpa.org_count, 0), 2) AS window_per_org FROM DeptProvostArea dpa JOIN RoomAreaWindow raw ON dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = raw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.org_count, icte.min_level3_code, icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.window_column, icte.window_per_org FROM inner_cte icte WHERE icte.window_column > 1000 ORDER BY icte.window_per_org DESC;

SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200

WITH DeptProvostArea AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), RoomAreaWindow AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT dpa.DLC_NAME, dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dpa.org_count, dpa.min_level3_code, raw.BUILDING_ROOM, raw.ORGANIZATION_NAME, raw.DLC_KEY, raw.window_column, ROUND(raw.window_column / NULLIF(dpa.org_count, 0), 2) AS window_per_org FROM DeptProvostArea dpa JOIN RoomAreaWindow raw ON dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = raw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY window_per_org DESC;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, display the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the access level name, the variance of the number of rooms in the building history for buildings with a nonzero number of rooms and assignable area greater than 0, and whether the current number of rooms is a 'HIGH_PERFORMER' (at least 10% greater than the historical average), 'LOW_PERFORMER' (at least 10% less than the historical average), or 'AVERAGE' compared to the average historical number of rooms for that access level. Show the results ordered by the number of rooms in descending order and then by the variance of the number of rooms in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.ACCESS_LEVEL ), access_level_variance AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ), access_level_avg_rooms AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, AVG(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.room_count, icte.min_floor, av.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, av.num_rooms_variance, aavg.avg_num_rooms, CASE WHEN icte.room_count > aavg.avg_num_rooms * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_PERFORMER' WHEN icte.room_count < aavg.avg_num_rooms * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_PERFORMER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS performance_category FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN access_level_variance av ON icte.ACCESS_LEVEL = av.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE LEFT JOIN access_level_avg_rooms aavg ON icte.ACCESS_LEVEL = aavg.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ORDER BY icte.room_count DESC, av.num_rooms_variance DESC;

WITH room_stats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.ACCESS_LEVEL ), access_level_variance AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ORDER BY num_rooms_variance DESC ) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, av.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, av.num_rooms_variance FROM room_stats rs LEFT JOIN access_level_variance av ON rs.ACCESS_LEVEL = av.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ORDER BY rs.room_count DESC, av.num_rooms_variance DESC;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable, display the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), and the total research volume for each organization (summing research volume from all associated supervisees), ordered by the number of organizations descending, then by the geometric mean of supervisees descending, and then by total research volume descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), org_geom_supervisees AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), org_total_research_volume AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.organization_count, i.min_organization_number, o.geometric_mean_supervisees, r.total_research_volume FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN org_geom_supervisees o ON i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN org_total_research_volume r ON i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY i.organization_count DESC, o.geometric_mean_supervisees DESC, r.total_research_volume DESC;

question: For all subjects offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', list the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, as well as all departments in the current academic term where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5, showing the department name, the maximum subject enrollment number, and the term start date. Additionally, for each department in the current academic term, include the total number of subjects offered in that department. For each row, include a reason for inclusion: 'SubjectOffered' for subjects and 'DeptEnrollment' for departments. The columns should be: subject ID, subject title, department name, sum of lecture units within each grade type group, maximum subject enrollment number, term start date, total subjects in department, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, NULL AS max_enrollment, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS total_subjects, 'SubjectOffered' AS Reason FROM inner_cte icte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, de.max_enrollment, de.TERM_START_DATE, dsc.total_subjects, 'DeptEnrollment' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollment de JOIN DeptSubjectCounts dsc ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, max_enrollment, TERM_START_DATE, total_subjects, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID

SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5;

WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS max_enrollment, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, 'SubjectOffered' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE, 'DeptEnrollment' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, max_enrollment, TERM_START_DATE, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID

question: For each organization, provide the organization name, department code, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization (considering only rooms with a non-null area and department code), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null. Additionally, for each organization, include the HR org unit title that is most frequently associated with that organization (via DLC_KEY), and the count of HR org units with that title. List the columns in the following order: organization name, department code, area variance, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average HR department code (old), variance of HR department code (old), most frequent HR org unit title, and count of HR org units with that title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL AND r.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), OrgHRStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ) SELECT rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.DEPT_CODE, rs.area_variance, rs.area_stddev, ohs.avg_dept_code_old, ohs.var_dept_code_old FROM RoomStats rs JOIN OrgHRStats ohs ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohs.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), MostFrequentHRTitle AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hru.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS title_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hru ON fo.DLC_KEY = hru.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND hru.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hru.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DEPT_CODE, icte.area_variance, icte.area_stddev, icte.avg_dept_code_old, icte.var_dept_code_old, mfht.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS most_frequent_hr_org_unit_title, mfht.title_count AS hr_org_unit_title_count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN MostFrequentHRTitle mfht ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = mfht.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND mfht.rn = 1 ;

question: Show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the area of rooms assigned to it (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in regular academic terms, and the total number of courses offered by that department, with the columns shown in the following order: department name, average area, area range, area variance, average total units, total units range, total units variance, and total number of courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_area, d1.area_range, d1.area_variance, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance FROM ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ) d1 JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) d2 ON d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_area, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, course_counts.total_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) course_counts ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = course_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each organization with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, and for each department in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code, where the organization and department names match, show the organization name, organization key, department name, department code, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by department code, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name. Additionally, only include results where the department's long name contains the word "Science" (case insensitive). The columns should be shown in the following order: organization name, organization key, department name, department code, the average organization key window column, department long name, hierarchy level 3 name, and the department window row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_column, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_window_row_number FROM ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) o JOIN ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, org_window_column, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, dept_window_row_number FROM inner_cte WHERE LOWER(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) LIKE '%science%'

WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_column, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_window_row_number FROM OrgStats o JOIN DeptStats d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year from the academic terms table, and classify each activity as 'FULL' if the maximum enrollment is 30, 'LIMITED' if less than 30, or 'UNLIMITED' if greater than 30. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_number_window FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.CALENDAR_DATE, cte.row_number_window, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank_window, CASE WHEN isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 THEN 'FULL' WHEN isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT < 30 THEN 'LIMITED' WHEN isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 30 THEN 'UNLIMITED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS enrollment_status FROM inner_cte cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE;
