sub_sqls: SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'

SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30

WITH IAP_Activities_2021JA AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), IAP_Activities_Max30 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT a21.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a21.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a21.CALENDAR_DATE, a21.window_column AS row_number_window, a30.window_column AS dense_rank_window FROM IAP_Activities_2021JA a21 JOIN IAP_Activities_Max30 a30 ON a21.ACTIVITY_TITLE = a30.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY a21.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that are not cancelled and require advance sign-up, and the number of unique departments that offered at least one subject in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH geometric_mean_record_count_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ), max_enrollment_variance_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, mev.max_enrollment_variance FROM geometric_mean_record_count_per_year gmr JOIN max_enrollment_variance_per_year mev ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mev.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = mev.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance, dept_counts.unique_department_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_department_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = dept_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year?
For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that are not cancelled and require advance sign-up?

For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that are not cancelled and require advance sign-up?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC;

WITH geometric_mean_record_count_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ), max_enrollment_variance_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, mev.max_enrollment_variance FROM geometric_mean_record_count_per_year gmr JOIN max_enrollment_variance_per_year mev ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mev.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = mev.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, what are the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), department name, number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the academic term, and the name of the school offering the most subjects in that department and year, along with the count of subjects offered by that school? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ), SubjectCountMinStartDate AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scmsd.subject_count, scmsd.min_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment gme JOIN SubjectCountMinStartDate scmsd ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scmsd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.geometric_mean_enrollment, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_start_date, ssc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, ssc.School_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS School_Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) DESC ) AS rn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON a.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) ssc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ssc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ssc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year, considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students?
For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum start date of the academic term.

For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, what are the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), department name, number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum start date of the academic term?
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ), SubjectCountMinStartDate AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scmsd.subject_count, scmsd.min_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment gme JOIN SubjectCountMinStartDate scmsd ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scmsd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: How many rooms with a square footage greater than 100 are located on floors whose name contains the word 'Floor', and are in the Stata building? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sf.FLOOR_NAME LIKE '%Floor%';
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"

question: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, along with the department's full name and the school name, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '101' and '103'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('101', '103')"

question: For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, give the number of unique subject titles and the minimum total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: Which are the top 3 departments that offer the most distinct courses, are degree-granting, and have department codes, department names, and the corresponding administrative department names, excluding the Management department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of CIP program codes for all undergraduate courses offered by that department, where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC;

question: How many subjects in the course catalog are offered in the spring term, have a total of at least 6 units, are taught by faculty who are responsible for at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students according to the subject offered summary, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS spring_subjects_with_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ss ON s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' AND c.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND ss.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each department, give the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per term by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, have offered at least one subject in the term '2016SP', and are not the Chemistry department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: List the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered, including the department name and the total count of unique subject titles, for departments that are degree granting, have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, and exclude the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are marked as current in the term parameter table, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_range DESC;

question: For each academic building at MIT, give the building name and calculate the average and variance of the area of rooms located on floors with an access level of 2. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_room_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS var_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_NAME

question: For rooms in the Stata building (building 32) in buildings with an access level of 2, show the room key, building key, floor, major use description, area, and the average area over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the floor's sort sequence and ordered by the room's area, but exclude rooms whose major use description includes 'STORAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA, AVG(fr.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ORDER BY fr.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_area_window FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' ORDER BY ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, fr.AREA;
domain_knowledge: "exclude usage types that include 'STORAGE'" is predicated by "TABLE.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'"

question: What are the minimum total units and average subject enrollment number for each academic term, where the academic year is between 2010 and 2020 or the total units are at least 6, the total units are between 1 and 12, the department is Mathematics, and the term is a current term? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment_number FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ( (at.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020) OR ss.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ss.TERM_CODE ;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only years with more than 10 subjects offered, where the term is a regular term, and the subjects are from the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10 ;

question: How many subjects offered in 2014 by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program in the Chemistry department had a responsible faculty member named Cline, Francesca? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2014%' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = 'Cline, Francesca' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry';

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials, considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: Show the organization name, department name, department code, and department hierarchy level 2 name for each organization, along with dense ranks partitioned by department long name ordered by department long name, for organizations that have a non-null description, belong to the 'Standard Hierarchy' type, are not the 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and where the department is 'Political Science' (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
domain_knowledge: "except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')"

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For organizations whose organization name contains 'Facilities', and that are not organizations '138' or '250', show their organization IDs and the dense rank of their HR department names, considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by HR department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE '%Facilities%' AND t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"

question: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and departments that are degree granting, but excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the total number of units for all subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only academic years where the total units are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all academic years for Mathematics? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH math_units_per_year AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(total_units) AS mean_units, STDDEV(total_units) AS stddev_units FROM math_units_per_year ) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.total_units FROM math_units_per_year m CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE m.total_units > s.mean_units + s.stddev_units ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each organization, what is the organization name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to it, considering only organizations with more than 5 rooms, and excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5;

question: For each organization and its corresponding HR department where the organization is assignable, the HR organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', and the organization is not 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number, but exclude organizations with IDs '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

"exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only regular terms and only subjects from the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: How many floors are there in buildings that are located on the MIT site, have more than 50 rooms according to the building history, and are academic buildings, specifically in the Ray and Maria Stata Center? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS num_floors FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32');
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject ID, subject title, offering department code, offering department name, number of enrolled students, department full name, school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each department code group, ordered by department code, and only include subjects where the offering department name is 'Chemistry'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS min_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5'

question: For each organization, excluding organizations with IDs '138' and '250', give the organization name and calculate the average and variance of the HR department IDs for all associated HR org units that are not part of the Cambridge-MIT Institute. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS avg_department_id, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS department_id_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY department_id_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only subjects from terms with a term status indicator of 'P' and with total units greater than 0? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: What are the minimum MIT ID and average department number for each student, where MIT IDs are between 921145998 and 999756146 or department numbers are at least 4, and department numbers are between 4 and 6, and the student is in the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sp.FULL_NAME AS student_name, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id, AVG(msd.DEPARTMENT) AS avg_department_number FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE ( (sp.MIT_ID BETWEEN 921145998 AND 999756146) OR (msd.DEPARTMENT >= 4) ) AND msd.DEPARTMENT BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND sp.ORGANIZATION = 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 GROUP BY sp.FULL_NAME ;
domain_knowledge: "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION = 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science'"
"Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '6'"

question: For each academic building at MIT, give the building name and calculate the average and variance of the area of its rooms for rooms with an access level of 1 or 2. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees, what is the department name and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the term 2019FA, restricted to departments whose department code is '18' (Mathematics)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON tso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per department within that school, but only include departments named "Political Science" (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(dept_subject_count) - MIN(dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) stats ON d.SCHOOL_CODE = stats.SCHOOL_CODE AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in terms within that year, but only include subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the material status is 'U' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department's full name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

question: Which three departments that grant degrees have the highest number of courses listed in the course catalog, and what are their department codes and department names? Exclude the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department (department code '6'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 3;
domain_knowledge: "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6'"

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments that are degree granting, have at least 100 total enrolled students, and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and is the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department code, department name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, and the total number of students in that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each school, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of CIP program codes among all courses offered by departments in that school, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18) and only for degree-granting courses? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_program_code_variance DESC;

question: How many unique members with a non-null MIT ID are listed in MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL whose last update date is after January 1, 2015, whose department name in the employee directory contains the word "Department", and who are in the "Political Science" department (Course 17)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL m JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e ON m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = e.KRB_NAME WHERE m.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > '01-JAN-15' AND e.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Department%' AND e.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science';

question: For each school, what is the total number of degree-granting courses offered by departments that are also degree-granting, where the course level is 'G', the department's school code is not 'Z', and the department is Mathematics (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(scd.COURSE) AS total_degree_granting_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_CODE <> 'Z' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scd.COURSE) > 0;

question: For each DLC, what is the DLC key, DLC name, the number of unique organizations, and the total number of assignable organizations, considering only DLCs that have at least one assignable organization, whose DLC name contains the word 'Office', and that are not the biology department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) != LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"

question: For each subject offered in the School of Engineering in 2019 by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, provide the subject ID, subject title, the department name, and the number of enrolled students who are in their graduate year and whose department is degree-granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
domain_knowledge: "Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
"Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"

question: For each organization, what is the organization name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department codes (HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) among its associated HR org units, considering only organizations that have more than 3 associated HR org units, and excluding organizations '138' and '250' as well as any organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY dept_code_stddev DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

question: What is the minimum department budget code and the sum of total units for courses in departments whose name includes 'Engineering', that are degree granting, and that are not the Mechanical Engineering department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING';

question: For each academic building in the city of CAMBRIDGE, show the building key, building name, building type, floor key, floor number, and the rank of each floor within its building (ordered by floor number), but only include floors with an assignable area greater than 0. Also, only include buildings that are not the Stata building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, t2.BUILDING_NAME, t2.BUILDING_TYPE, t1.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, t1.FLOOR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t0 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department and academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, considering only subjects that are not for graduate credit and are offered in regular terms? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE so.HGN_CODE = 'N' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting, the total units are greater than 6, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For rooms with an area greater than 100 and an access level of 1, in the Stata building, show the building room identifier, the room's area, the organization name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building number from the building address, excluding rooms belonging to the department of facilities. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY fba.BUILDING_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 100 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fba.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES'
domain_knowledge: "department of facilities" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DP OF FACILITIES'"

question: For each department and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of departments and the minimum department budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and only include the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, school name, and the minimum department budget code over each school name group, ordered by school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each building, what is the building name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area across its historical records, considering only buildings with more than 3 historical records, where the building type is 'ACADEMIC', and excluding the Brown Building? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT != '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the subject title from the library subject offered table, the offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group, ordered by master subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ORDER BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course, course description, department name, program title, and rank within each department name group ordered by course. Do not return any rounded answers.
