question: For each course in the Mathematics department, show the course description, department name, school name, course level, subject title, total units, grade type, and the maximum academic year for each course considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by course in alphabetical order, only including courses that are degree granting and are offered this year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each school, give the school name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by that school, but only include schools that do not offer courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH school_course_stats AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), schools_with_math AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT scs.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(scs.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(scs.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM school_course_stats scs LEFT JOIN schools_with_math swm ON scs.SCHOOL_NAME = swm.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE swm.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scs.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME ;

question: For each administrative department, give the administrative department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and restrict the results to administrative departments whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = '2' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers, considering only the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the 'Engineering' school during terms with a term status indicator of 'P', excluding subjects offered by the Chemistry department and only including courses with materials? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each HASS attribute, what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year by the Political Science department, along with the HASS attribute's description as shown on the form? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, a.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE a ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = a.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, a.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM ORDER BY units_range DESC;

question: What are the minimum department code and average student year (numerically, with G=5, 4=4, 3=3, etc.) for each department, where department codes are either '6' or '15', or the student year is 'G', and the department is degree granting, excluding the Economics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG( CASE WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' THEN 5 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '4' THEN 4 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '3' THEN 3 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '2' THEN 2 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ( sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6' OR sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15' OR msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' ) AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Economics' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT

question: Show the room key, area, and organization name for each room in the Stata building, along with the building name and the dense rank of each room within its building, ordered by building key, for rooms with area greater than 50 and access level equal to 1, excluding rooms assigned to the department of facilities. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_dense_rank FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fr.AREA > 50 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES' ORDER BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY;
domain_knowledge: "department of facilities" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DP OF FACILITIES'"

question: For each subject offered in both the library and TIP systems in 2019, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in the library offering, the subject title from the library, and the department name from TIP, for subjects where the maximum number of enrolled students in the library is greater than 5, and where the department name from TIP is 'Chemistry' (i.e., Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS library_subject_title, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS tip_department_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING max_num_enrolled_students > 5 ;

question: For each organization in the history department, show the organization key, organization name, DLC key, DLC name, the number of associated DLC keys, and the total number of organizations under the same DLC, for organizations whose organization level is 5 and that have a non-null DLC key, excluding organizations '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(d.DLC_KEY) AS dlc_key_count, COUNT(o2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_orgs_in_dlc FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o2 ON d.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"

question: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with a non-null total units value and departments that grant degrees, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: Show the number of enrolled students, the subject title, the academic year, and the term code for each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), along with dense ranks over the offering department code ordered by the offering department code, for terms where the number of enrolled students is greater than 0, the term status indicator is 'P', and only include courses with materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t1.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

question: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses that are at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: List the top 10 departments by the number of unique courses they offer, including only departments that are degree-granting and are not the Political Science department, showing the department name from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, the school name from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, and the count of unique course numbers from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY course_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department in Spring 2016, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, school name, course description, department name, subject code, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each building, what is the building's long name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, considering only buildings with more than 5 rooms, where the building is located on the MIT site, and the building is an academic building such as the Stata building? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, but only include subjects where the offer department name is 'Chemistry'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material and are offered in the term '2009SP', considering only departments where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10, and restrict the results to the Chemistry and Biology departments (i.e., only include departments 'Chemistry' and 'Biology'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the highest student office phone number and the full name of the student with that phone number, considering only departments that grant degrees, where the highest office phone number is greater than 1000000000, and excluding the Political Science department (Course 17)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MaxPhones AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mp.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME FROM MaxPhones mp JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = mp.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered, and what is the full name of the department, considering only departments that are degree-granting and including only the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

question: For each academic building at MIT, give the building's long name and calculate the range and variance of the assignable area of its floors that have at least one room. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH floors_with_rooms AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR ), academic_buildings AS ( SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM academic_buildings ab JOIN floors_with_rooms fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ORDER BY ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ;

question: What is the minimum number of lecture units and the total sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a material status of 'U', and are in the Mathematics department? Please use data from the library reserve material details, academic terms, and course catalog subject offered tables. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each building in the city of CAMBRIDGE that is used as a residence, what is the maximum assignable area among its floors, and what is the building's name? Exclude the Stata building from the results. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS MAX_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME
domain_knowledge: "used as a residence" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'"
"Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"

question: How many library reserve material details are there for the term 2009FA, where the material status is 'U', the corresponding subject in the course catalog is offered in the fall term, and the subject is in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_library_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON l.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON s.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009FA' AND l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, what is the name of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and restrict the results to only degree-granting departments and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0;

question: How many subjects offered in the 2014 January term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program and the Chemistry department are listed in the course catalog as being offered in the academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2014JA' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 'Y';

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 in the Mathematics department, show the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code. Only include subjects from the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department, give the department name, the range and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and what is the full name of the corresponding administrative department, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each access level code, what is the access level name and the variance of the number of rooms in the building history for buildings with a nonzero number of rooms, assignable area greater than 0, and that are residential buildings? Only include buildings that are at MIT. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ;

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, and what is the department name of the course, excluding courses from the Mathematics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL;

question: For each organization, what is the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only for organizations that are not 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'? Show the organization name and the geometric mean. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')"

question: For each department, what is the total number of subject codes associated with it, considering only departments that have a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean across all departments, and only including departments that are degree-granting and are not the Biology department (Course 7)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each building type, show the building type name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of rooms in building history records for buildings of that type that are located on the MIT site, but exclude buildings that are classified as residential. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE, AVG(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms, MAX(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) - MIN(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY num_rooms_range DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and restricting the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in each term of that year, considering only terms that are regular terms, are not in the future, and where the subjects are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC;

question: What are the minimum academic year and average total units for each academic term in the Mathematics department, where the academic year is between 2000 and 2020 or the total units are at least 6, and the total units are between 1 and 12? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND ( a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE;

question: For each school, what is the name of the school and the variance of the CIP program code for all courses that are degree granting, have a non-null department name, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_variance DESC;

question: For each academic building at MIT, give the building name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department who are undergraduates (course level "U"), show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and assign row numbers within each course level group ordered by the student's last name. Additionally, restrict to students whose first name is "Kevin". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t0.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin'
domain_knowledge: "TABLE.COURSE_LEVEL" take on the values "U" for undergraduate and "G" for graduate courses
"Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"

question: What is the minimum number of lecture units and the sum of total units for all subjects that are offered in the fall term, where the subject has at least one associated textbook or material, the subject's department name is 'Mathematics', and the department code is '18'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY <> '';

question: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that school, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a non-null total units value, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: Count how many subject materials with status 'EO' were offered in academic years after 2015, for which the corresponding subject had more than 5 total units, and which were offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units_math FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each administrative department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with total units greater than 0, and excluding the Mechanical Engineering department (Course 2)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in both library and tip subjects for terms in 2014FA or 2017JA, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND tso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10;

question: For each school, give the school name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique courses per department, considering only departments in Mathematics (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(dept_course_count.num_courses) / NULLIF(AVG(dept_course_count.num_courses), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE JOIN ( SELECT c2.SCHOOL_NAME, c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c2.COURSE) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c2 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s2 ON c2.COURSE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c2.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c2.SCHOOL_NAME, c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c2.COURSE) > 0 ) dept_course_count ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_course_count.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING AVG(dept_course_count.num_courses) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

question: How many subject codes are there for subjects in the School of Engineering that are associated with an administrative department named 'ADM', and are also offered by the Mechanical Engineering department (Course 2)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subject_codes FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'ADM' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '2';

question: For each school, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department budget codes among its departments, what is the full name of the school, and only include schools that have a department named "Political Science"? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_full_name FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) > 0 ;

question: Which department name and school name have the highest number of courses, considering only courses that are degree granting, have a course level of 'U', and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term in the term parameter table and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting, but exclude the departments of Mathematics and Chemistry. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U' and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CASE WHEN AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) = 0 OR AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) END AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, considering only departments that have more than 5 subjects offered in the 2022FA term, and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For each city, give the city name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area of buildings located in that city, considering only buildings with a nonzero average assignable area and only including buildings that are used as a residence and are not the Stata building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH building_stats AS ( SELECT fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING avg_assignable_area > 0 ) SELECT CITY, STDDEV(avg_assignable_area) / AVG(avg_assignable_area) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM building_stats GROUP BY CITY;
domain_knowledge: "used as a residence" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'"

question: For each student year, give the student year and calculate the average, range, and variance of department budget codes for students in that year, considering only students whose department code matches both an academic department and an administrative department, and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY budget_range DESC;

question: How many subjects offered in the term 2019FA by departments that are degree-granting, belong to the School of Engineering, and are not from the Department of Political Science (Course 17)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ;

question: For subjects in the course catalog with a total of 12 units, offered in the fall term, and in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, and assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department, give the department code, department name, and the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are degree-granting and specifically for the Mathematics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_range DESC;

question: For each department give the department code, the department name, the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000, for departments that are Mathematics (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic term, what is the term description and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the Mathematics department during that term, considering only terms with more than 5 subjects offered, and ordering the results by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in descending order, and only including subjects that have course materials? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For graduate-level, degree-granting courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table that are offered by the Mathematics department, show the course, course description, department name, program title from CIP, category title from CIP, and assign row numbers within each school name group ordered by course. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.COURSE, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.PROGRAM_TITLE, t0.CATEGORY_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.COURSE) AS window_column FROM CIP t0 INNER JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.PROGRAM_CODE = t1.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE t1.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than 5 subjects, are degree granting, and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each DLC in the biology department, what is the DLC name and the geometric mean of the organization numbers for organizations in that DLC where the organization number is greater than 0, excluding organizations '138' and '250'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER))) AS geometric_mean_org_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 0 AND LOWER(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('Biology') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_org_number DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

question: For students whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6), and whose first name is 'Kevin', show their full name, email address, student year, the department's full name, the course description, the course level, and the minimum course level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's last name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6'

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each program category, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of courses offered by departments in that category, considering only categories with more than 3 courses, and only including degree-granting courses? Show the category title and the calculated standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and exclude the 'Political Science' department from the calculation. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_course_counts AS ( SELECT cip.CATEGORY_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM CIP cip JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON cip.PROGRAM_CODE = scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY cip.CATEGORY_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT ), category_total_courses AS ( SELECT CATEGORY_TITLE, SUM(num_courses) AS total_courses FROM dept_course_counts GROUP BY CATEGORY_TITLE ), filtered_categories AS ( SELECT CATEGORY_TITLE FROM category_total_courses WHERE total_courses > 3 ) SELECT dcc.CATEGORY_TITLE, STDDEV(dcc.num_courses) AS stddev_num_courses FROM dept_course_counts dcc JOIN filtered_categories fc ON dcc.CATEGORY_TITLE = fc.CATEGORY_TITLE GROUP BY dcc.CATEGORY_TITLE ORDER BY dcc.CATEGORY_TITLE ;

question: Count how many subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Department of Economics (Course 14) that are degree-granting had more than 5 students enrolled. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS econ_subjects_with_5plus_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Economics' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Economics'

question: For each building that is an academic building, what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms, and what is the building's full name and postal code? Only include buildings whose name is not "Ashdown House". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department and subject grade type where the subject is offered in the current academic year, is letter graded, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of subjects and the minimum total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE;

question: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6 that are degree-granting, show the course, course description, program title from the CIP table, and the running sum of department codes within each school name group ordered by course, and only include courses from the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department. question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects that have at least one associated tip material, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by the Mathematics department, considering only years with more than 10 subjects that have course materials and courses with a nonzero amount of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name, both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department (Course 8). sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', and excluding organizations with ORGANIZATION_ID '138' and '250', give the number of organizations and the minimum organization number. sql: SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For students in departments with a degree-granting status of 'Y' and in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the student's full name, email address, department name, school name, and the average department budget code in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by student year and ordered by department code. question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department code.
