question: For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"

question: List the top 10 departments by the number of graduate students, showing the department name and the count of graduate students in each department, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17) from the results. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS graduate_student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY graduate_student_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show the department name, department full name, student full name, and student email address, along with dense ranks over the school code, ordered by school code, for students whose student year is 'G', whose department is degree granting, and who are in the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18';

question: Show the subject title, total units, department name, and course description for each subject, along with dense ranks over the offer department code ordered by offer department code, for subjects offered in the 'Engineering' school, with total units greater than 0, and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department (Course 6). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
domain_knowledge: "Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
"Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that are degree granting, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

question: For each building, list the building key, building name, building type, the number of historical records, and the total assignable area from the building history for buildings that are of type 'ACADEMIC', have more than 10 rooms, are located at MIT, and exclude buildings named 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS num_historical_records, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department of Engineering or Science, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 20, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and to the Department of Mathematics. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20;

question: For each department, what is the department's full name, and what are the range and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department in the 2008 academic year and that are degree granting, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2016SP term and that are offered this year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering with a course level of 'G', offered by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course description, department name, program title, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description. Only include courses that are degree-granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.PROGRAM_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM CIP t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.PROGRAM_CODE = t1.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
domain_knowledge: "Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"

question: For each building name, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms in that building, considering only rooms with an access level of 1, buildings located on the MIT site, and only including academic buildings? Additionally, exclude buildings named "Ashdown". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

question: For graduate students in the Electrical Engineering & Computer Science department (Course 6) who are classified as students, show their MIT ID, full name, employee type, student year, and rank within each student year group ordered by MIT ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.MIT_ID, t0.FULL_NAME, t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY t0.MIT_ID) AS window_column FROM SE_PERSON t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.FULL_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND t1.DEPARTMENT = '6'
domain_knowledge: "Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
"Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '6'"

question: For each floor in the Stata building, give the floor name and calculate the total square footage of rooms on that floor where the room number is greater than 20 and the building component is not '13'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT f.FLOOR_NAME, SUM(d.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL d JOIN SPACE_FLOOR f ON d.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY WHERE d.ROOM_NUMBER > 20 AND d.BUILDING_COMPONENT <> '13' AND d.BUILDING_KEY = 32 GROUP BY f.FLOOR_NAME HAVING SUM(d.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) > 0;
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"

question: For each HASS attribute, give the HASS attribute code and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, along with the description on the form for that attribute, but only include subjects from the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS hass_attribute_code, (STDDEV_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units, h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM ;

question: What is the earliest department last activity date and the corresponding full name of a student in each department, for students whose student year is 'G' and whose department is Political Science? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(sd.DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE) AS EARLIEST_DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, msd.FULL_NAME FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND (msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' OR msd.DEPARTMENT = '17') GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.FULL_NAME ORDER BY msd.DEPARTMENT, EARLIEST_DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE;

question: For each school, what is the geometric mean of the total units of subjects offered by departments in that school, considering only subjects with more than zero total units and that are offered this year, and only for departments that are degree-granting and not the Department of Management (Course 15)? Show the school name and the geometric mean. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ;

question: For each department code and department name in the "Provost Area", grouped by the department hierarchy level 2 name, give the master department hierarchy level 2 name, the department code, the department name, the number of organizational units and the minimum department ID, but exclude departments named "Political Science" (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department in terms that are not summer terms and are currently not the current term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students per course offered by that department, considering only courses that are degree granting, students in their graduate year, and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(course_student_counts.num_students) AS avg_students_per_course, STDDEV(course_student_counts.num_students) AS stddev_students_per_course FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT scd2.DEPARTMENT, scd2.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND scd2.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd2.DEPARTMENT, scd2.COURSE ) course_student_counts ON scd.DEPARTMENT = course_student_counts.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_students_per_course DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each building use type in academic buildings, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms in buildings of that use type? Show the building use and the calculated statistics, but only include buildings that are classified as academic buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_USE IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

question: For each academic term that is marked as the current term and is in the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the term code, term description, academic year, and the number of subjects offered along with the total subject enrollment number for that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department (Course 8). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: What is the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject offered and the total number of students enrolled, for subjects offered by departments that are degree granting, have at least one student in the MIT student directory, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, are not variable units, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per term in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and what is the academic year description? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE ), stats_per_year AS ( SELECT s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(s.num_subjects) - MIN(s.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(s.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(s.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term s GROUP BY s.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT sp.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sp.range_num_subjects, sp.variance_num_subjects, sp.stddev_num_subjects FROM stats_per_year sp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON sp.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY sp.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sp.range_num_subjects, sp.variance_num_subjects, sp.stddev_num_subjects ORDER BY sp.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For subjects in the current academic term that are in the Political Science department (Course 17), show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'

question: For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department during the term '2014FA', considering only degree-granting courses and excluding the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: What are the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED and the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY for each department, where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21, and the department is degree granting, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year and calculate the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up, using only activities that have a non-null maximum enrollment and are offered by the Department of Mathematics (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each school, give the school name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for courses offered by departments in that school, considering only courses with total units greater than 0 and departments that grant degrees, and restrict the results to only include the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

question: For each building, give the building name and calculate the total area of rooms used for "RESIDENT" or "LABS" purposes, considering only buildings with a total room area greater than 1000, and only include buildings that are classified as "academic buildings" and are owned by MIT. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING total_room_area > 1000 ;

question: For each administrative department and its corresponding academic department, what is the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in the academic year 2024, and what is the name of the subject with that maximum total units, only for departments whose name is "Political Science" (Course 17), and only include results where the maximum total units is greater than 9? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS administrative_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS academic_department, t.max_total_units, t.subject_title_with_max_units FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC), ',', 1 ) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.max_total_units > 9 ;

question: For each student in the MIT student directory whose department is '6' (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their full name, email address, department name, the corresponding SIS admin department name, and the average department code within each department code group, ordered by the student's full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME) AS avg_department_code FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

question: For each department, what is the department's full name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, considering only departments that have offered more than 5 subjects and are degree-granting, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For each department, give the department code and the total number of enrolled students in both the library and tip subject offerings, considering only those departments where the total number of enrolled students is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total enrolled students across all departments, and restrict your answer to departments whose name is 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_sum) + STDDEV(total_sum) FROM ( SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_sum FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON l2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT GROUP BY l2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) dept_totals ) AND l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18';

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

question: List the subject code description, department name, and school name from the subject code table, and the course description, department name, school name, and the course level, along with dense ranks over the course level ordered by course level, for courses where the subject code description is not null, the course level is 'G', and the department name is 'Political Science' (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that are degree-granting, show the subject code, subject title, department name, department full name, course description, course level, school name, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each building, give the building name and calculate the average and variance of the area of its rooms, but only for buildings that are academic buildings and specifically include the Stata building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fbh.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS var_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' OR fbh.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' GROUP BY fbh.BUILDING_NAME

question: For each department, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have more than five subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and only including departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department? Show the department name and the calculated standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), ordered from highest to lowest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC;

question: For each building access level, what is the access level name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of rooms in building history records for academic buildings, and only for access levels with more than 5 records? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, STDDEV(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS stddev_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ;

question: List the top 10 department names from the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, along with the number of subjects they offered, for departments that also had at least one subject offered in the same term in the TIP subject offerings, but exclude the Chemistry department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tip ON so.TERM_CODE = tip.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC LIMIT 10

question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), provide the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, term code, material status key, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject ID, and only include subjects that are also offered by the Biology department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

question: What are the top 10 material statuses by the number of materials for courses in the Biology department, including the material status description and the count of materials for each status, considering only courses with materials? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Biology' AND (td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term, where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10, only for the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10;

question: For each department, provide the department code and the total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered by that department, considering only those departments where the total number of enrolled students is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the average total enrolled students across all departments, and restrict your answer to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t );

question: For each department, provide the department name and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for its associated administrative department, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Political Science department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, have total units greater than zero, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the total number of units for courses in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools, where the total units for the department is greater than 1000, and restrict the results to departments that are not "Political Science" (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000;

question: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree granting, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have at least one tip subject offered in the term '2019FA', and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses in that department that have at least one course material assigned, but only include the Chemistry and Biology departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, that are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Course 6), show the subject ID, subject title, department name, department full name, and the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), but only include subjects from degree-granting courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID;
