question: List the top 10 IAP activities by the number of subjects offered in the same academic term, showing the IAP activity title and the count of distinct subject titles offered in that term, for activities that are not cancelled, are offered in a term that is not the summer term, and where the subjects are from the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, offering department name, school name, department full name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department name, and only include courses that have course materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

question: For each subject offered in the term '2019FA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, the full department name, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group, ordered by the offering department name, and only include courses with materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

question: For buildings located in the city of CAMBRIDGE with a non-zero assignable area on their floors, and that are academic buildings, show the building name, building number, floor number, assignable area, building address postal code, and assign row numbers within each postal code group ordered by building number. Additionally, restrict the results to buildings that are Maclaurin Buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t2.BUILDING_NAME, t2.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.FLOOR, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, t0.POSTAL_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.POSTAL_CODE ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t0 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t2.BUILDING_NAME = 'MACLAURIN BUILDINGS (3)'

question: For each department offering a course, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units for courses that have at least one enrolled student, a non-null ISBN in their course materials, and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: For each building in the WEST campus sector with more than 50 rooms, that is also an academic building, what is the largest room area, the building's full name, and the building's postal code? Exclude buildings that are service buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(r.AREA) AS max_room_area, a.POSTAL_CODE FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'WEST' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'SERVICE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 50;

question: For each school, give the school name and calculate the total number of courses offered by departments that are degree granting, have a department budget code greater than 100000, and are not the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: List the top 10 academic years by the number of subjects offered in the fall term by the Mathematics department, including the academic year description and the term description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

question: List the subject title, number of enrolled students, and the responsible faculty name for each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) in the term '2019FA', where the subject has course materials, along with a dense rank over the department name, ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

question: Show the full name of each student in the Political Science department, their department name, the corresponding school name, and the SIS administrative department name, along with dense ranks over the student's year, ordered by student year, and only include students whose department is Course 17. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR;

question: For each student in the Political Science department, show their first name, last name, email address, department name, school name, and the maximum department budget code for each student considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by last name, where the student year is 'G' and the department is degree granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization is not 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', give the number of organizations and the minimum organization number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_organizations, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh ON fo.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' GROUP BY mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
domain_knowledge: "except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title from the course catalog, the number of enrolled students, and the offering department name, but only for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

question: For each department hierarchy, show the department hierarchy name and calculate the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations in that hierarchy where the organization is assignable, the organization level is at least 4, and exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250' that are not part of the Cambridge-MIT Institute. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL >= 4 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"

question: For each department, provide the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and include only departments that have more than 5 subjects offered in the 2021FA term, excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than zero total units and at least one enrolled student, and only for departments that grant degrees, restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each department, what is the range and variance of facility organization keys associated with it, excluding the Political Science department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) - MIN(fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_range, VARIANCE(fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fodk.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_NAME ORDER BY mdh.DLC_NAME;

question: How many subjects offered in 2021 that are not for graduate credit, are listed as undergraduate in the course catalog, and are in the Mathematics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS undergrad_subjects_2021 FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.HGN_CODE = c.HGN_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND c.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES = 'U' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: What is the minimum department budget code and the total number of students for departments that are degree granting, have at least one student in their directory, and are the Mathematics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 ;

question: For each department, show the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, and the average department budget code within each school, ordered by department code, for departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7)? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and what is the description of the academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: What are the minimum department budget code and average total units for each department, where the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000 or the total units are at least 6, and the total units are between 6 and 21, for departments in Mathematics (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000) OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) ) AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 21 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

question: For each building that is used as a residence, give the building key and the total assignable area from building history records, for buildings whose total assignable area in history is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total assignable area across all buildings, and restrict the results to buildings at MIT. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH stats AS ( SELECT AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS mean_area, STDDEV(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ), res_buildings AS ( SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT rb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, rb.total_assignable_area FROM res_buildings rb CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE rb.total_assignable_area > s.mean_area + s.stddev_area ;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are regular terms, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: How many subjects offered in the same term as a TIP subject had "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" as the offering department, were not for graduate credit, and were also offered by the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_non_grad_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.HGN_CODE_DESC = 'Not for graduate credit' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry';

question: For each academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in IAP activities by the Mathematics department, considering only subjects that are offered in the January term and are not cancelled? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE LIKE '%JA' AND i.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, and the department is either Chemistry or Biology, provide the count of subjects and the minimum start date of the term. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: For each school, give the school name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school, but only include schools that have a department named "Political Science" and exclude subjects offered by the "Biology" department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH schools_with_ps AS ( SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ), subject_units AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total subject enrollment numbers per academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P', the total subject enrollment number is greater than 0, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and where the department is degree granting, but exclude the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department offering courses, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in Chemistry courses that have at least one library reserve material and are offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each type of space usage, what is the name of the space usage and the variance of the square footage of rooms used for that purpose in the Stata building, considering only rooms with more than 10 square feet and excluding usage types that include 'STORAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS variance_square_footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE;
domain_knowledge: "exclude usage types that include 'STORAGE'" is predicated by "TABLE.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'"

question: For subjects in the academic term with the term code '2019FA' that are in the Mathematics department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, total units, and the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student, have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: For each building type and campus sector, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area for buildings, considering only buildings with more than 10 rooms, a non-null building use, and that are residential buildings, using both the current and historical building data, and only including buildings that are owned? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, VARIANCE(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS var_assignable_area, STDDEV(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM ( SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING WHERE NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND BUILDING_USE IS NOT NULL AND BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' UNION ALL SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST WHERE NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND BUILDING_USE IS NOT NULL AND BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' ) AS all_buildings GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR;

question: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are degree-granting, have more than zero enrolled students, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique students and the minimum CIP program code among their courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For subjects in the academic term with term code '2009SP', show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, but only include subjects from the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the average and variance of the total subject enrollment numbers for subjects offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P', where the subject enrollment number is greater than 0, and the subject is offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS var_subject_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each building address in the city of Cambridge, show the building number, address purpose, city, state, postal code, the building name, building type, building use, and the maximum number of rooms from the building history for the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by building key, but only include buildings that are academic buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH building_hist_stats AS ( SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, GREATEST( fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0) ) AS max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' ) SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, STATE, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM building_hist_stats ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FISCAL_PERIOD;
domain_knowledge: "Cambridge" is a city in Massachusetts and is the primary location of MIT's campus, so filtering by t0.CITY = 'Cambridge' is a reasonable external constraint.

question: List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, showing each department's name and the count of subjects, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17) from the results and only include departments that grant degrees. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the minimum area of any room and the total number of rooms in buildings located in the WEST campus sector, with an access level code of 2, and that are academic buildings, excluding buildings used as a residence? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(fr.AREA) AS min_room_area, SUM(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS total_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'WEST' AND fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = 2 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' ;
domain_knowledge: "used as a residence" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'"

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by the Mathematics department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students for that subject, and what is the term description in which this maximum occurred, considering only subjects where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students, departments whose name is not null, and only include departments whose name is 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects in that year, considering only subjects with more than zero total units, where the term status indicator is 'P', and the subject is offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LOG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, what is the department's full name, and what are the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses that are degree granting, have a non-null CIP program code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME

question: For each academic year, what is the average and variance of the number of students enrolled in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have at least 1 enrolled student, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Please provide the academic year description, the average number of enrolled students, and the variance of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC;

question: List the top 10 degree-granting departments by the number of unique students named "Zoe" enrolled in their offered subjects, showing the department name and the count of unique student full names, for departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students and are not the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, but only for the Chemistry department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by subject code, and only include courses with materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each DLC name in the history department, what is the variance of the organization number among organizations associated with that DLC, excluding organizations '138' and '250'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fo.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY fo.DLC_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"

question: For academic buildings at MIT, show the building key, building name, fiscal period, and the running sum of assignable area within each campus sector, but only include buildings that are owned, and exclude the Stata building. Order the results by building key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD;

question: For each tip detail record in the Chemistry department, provide the tip material key, tip material status key, term code (formatted as YYYYTT), subject ID, and the subject title, offer department name, and the maximum total units for each tip detail considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by tip subject offered key, only including records where the total units are greater than 0 and the tip material status key is not 'NM'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
domain_knowledge: "TABLE.TERM_CODE" is formatted as "YYYYTT" where "YYYY" is the year and "TT" is the term. Terms can be "FA", "JA", "SP", and "SU" for fall, IAP, spring, and summer

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one material record and are offered by the Biology department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, that are degree-granting, show the subject title and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units, and restrict the results to subjects offered by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Course 6). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
domain_knowledge: "Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
"Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"

question: What are the minimum building number and average floor number for each building that is an academic building, where building numbers are between '14' and 'E62' or floor numbers are at least 2, and floor numbers are between 3 and 16, and the building is at MIT? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, MIN(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS min_building_number, AVG(ff.FLOOR) AS avg_floor_number FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND ( (fb.BUILDING_NUMBER >= '14' AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER <= 'E62') OR ff.FLOOR >= 2 ) AND ff.FLOOR BETWEEN 3 AND 16 GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NUMBER ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_NUMBER ;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area" at the "School of Science" level, excluding the Biology department, show the department name, department code, organization name, organization ID, and the average organization number within each department code group ordered by organization sort, and exclude organizations with IDs '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, AVG(t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_CODE ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_SORT) AS avg_org_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME = 'School of Science' AND LOWER(t0.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') AND t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

question: Count how many rooms with a square footage greater than 100 are used as "RESEARCH CENTER" and are located in the Stata building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS research_center_large_rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL JOIN SPACE_USAGE ON SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND SPACE_DETAIL.BUILDING_KEY = 32;
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"

question: What are the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, and for each, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, and the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many subjects offered in 2014 by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program in the Chemistry department had more than 5 students enrolled, according to the library subject offered records? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_2014_chemistry_subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2014%' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry';

question: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, considering only departments that have more than 5 rooms, are associated with a non-null DLC key, and are not the 'ADMISSIONS' department or the 'Political Science' department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC;

question: How many subjects offered in 2012 had the cluster type "SWE: School-Wide Electives", were offered by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, and were offered by the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS swe_harvard_chemistry_subjects_2012 FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = ss.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry';

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are Mathematics (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: Which are the top 3 organizations (by organization name) that are associated with the highest number of HR organizational units, what are their organization names and DLC names, and exclude organizations '138' and '250' that are not relevant to the analysis? Additionally, only include organizations whose DLC name is 'Biology'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

question: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree-granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, and the running sum of department budget codes within each school, ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: What is the minimum number of enrolled students and the total number of departments for subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, specifically excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology');
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: List the top 3 subjects that appear most frequently in the TIP_DETAIL table, and for each, provide the subject ID, subject title, the academic year description of the term in which it was offered, and only include subjects from the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 3;

question: For each academic term, give the term description and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all subjects offered during that term, considering only terms where at least one subject is offered in the fall term, the term is not cancelled, and the subjects are from the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap ON at.TERM_CODE = iap.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND (iap.IS_CANCELLED IS NULL OR iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') GROUP BY at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY at.TERM_DESCRIPTION

question: For each organization, provide the organization name and calculate the average and variance of the HR department codes for its associated HR org units, considering only organizations that are assignable, have a non-null HR department code, and are not the 'ADMISSIONS' organization. Additionally, exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS dept_code_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY dept_code_variance DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, and what is the term description for the corresponding term, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

question: For each department, give the department name and provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students per course in that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and courses that are undergraduate level, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(course_student_count) - MIN(course_student_count) AS student_count_range, VARIANCE(course_student_count) AS student_count_variance, STDDEV(course_student_count) AS student_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS course_student_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT ) course_stats ON scd.DEPARTMENT = course_stats.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE = course_stats.COURSE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count_range DESC;

question: For each subject title, what is the range and variance of library reserve catalog keys for that subject, considering only subjects offered by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, with a non-null subject ID in the library reserve material details, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) - MIN(lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_range, VARIANCE(lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lr ON so.TERM_CODE = lr.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND lr.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY catalog_key_range DESC;

question: For each department, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses that are offered this year, have a non-null total units value, and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, provide the department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, and what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject title and offering department name in terms that are regular, have more than 5 enrolled students, and are offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), give the number of reserved course materials and the minimum academic year, considering only courses with materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the department budget code for all subject codes associated with that department where the department is degree granting, but only include departments whose name is 'Mathematics'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY budget_range DESC;

question: For each department that offered at least one subject in the 2021FA term, what is the maximum total units among its offered subjects, and what is the department's full name, considering only degree-granting departments and excluding the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: Show the department name, department code, subject code, and subject code description, along with dense ranks over the school name ordered by school name, for departments that are degree granting, have the department name 'Political Science', and subject codes that have a non-null description. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.SCHOOL_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects that are offered in the Fall term, have at least 1 enrolled student, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units of all subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero total units, and are in the Mathematics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For course offerings in the term '2017JA' from the Chemistry department, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, number of enrolled students, material status key, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the subject ID from the TIP_DETAIL table, but only include courses that have materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY td.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS min_enrolled_students_window FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

question: How many subjects offered in 2019 by departments that are degree-granting, have a total units value greater than 9, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and are offered by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
