question: For each building, what is the building's long name and the variance of the area of its rooms, considering only buildings with more than 10 rooms, rooms with an access level of 1, and only including buildings that are academic buildings? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ORDER BY area_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one associated course material and are offered by the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of students in that department, considering only students whose student year is 'G', who have a non-null office phone number, and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and provide both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous', the material status is not 'NM', and the department is Mathematics (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON ss.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, where the subject enrollment number is greater than zero, and restricting to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ;

question: For each building type, what is the building type name and the geometric mean of the assignable area of its floors, considering only floors with assignable area greater than zero, and only for buildings at MIT? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_TYPE, EXP(AVG(LN(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA))) AS geometric_mean_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY geometric_mean_assignable_area DESC;
domain_knowledge: "CIS" is the MIT Course Information System

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and only for departments that grant degrees, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of students enrolled in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with at least one enrolled student, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: Which three departments, excluding the Mathematics department, have the highest number of associated subject codes, and what are their department codes, department names, and corresponding admin department names? (Exclude Mathematics, i.e., Course 18.) Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) DESC LIMIT 3;

question: For each building in the WEST campus sector with more than 10 rooms, that is used as a residence and is not the Stata building, give the building key, building name, building type, the number of rooms, and the total assignable area across all its floors. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS number_of_rooms, SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'WEST' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ;
domain_knowledge: "used as a residence" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'"

question: For each department, what is the department name and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: What are the minimum CIP program code and average department budget code for each department in the Mathematics department, where CIP program codes are between 120000 and 150000 or department budget codes are at least 90000, and department budget codes are between 90000 and 200000, and the department is degree-granting? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( (c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE BETWEEN 120000 AND 150000) OR (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: Which are the top 10 departments by the number of course materials assigned, restricted to the Chemistry department, and what are their department names? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_course_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code above 100000, and is not the Political Science department, give the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, and the total number of units for all those courses, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have at least one TIP material, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH tip_counts AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ), per_year_stats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) - MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS range_tip_materials, VARIANCE(tc.num_tip_materials) AS var_tip_materials, STDDEV(tc.num_tip_materials) AS stddev_tip_materials FROM tip_counts tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, range_tip_materials, var_tip_materials, stddev_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the Stata building (building 32), give the building key and the total area of all rooms in that building, considering only if the total area of rooms is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total room area across all buildings, and only include buildings at MIT. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH building_room_areas AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(total_room_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_room_area) AS stddev_area FROM building_room_areas ) SELECT bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bra.total_room_area FROM building_room_areas bra JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY CROSS JOIN stats WHERE bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND bra.total_room_area > stats.mean_area + stats.stddev_area ;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units greater than 1 and in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department (Course 6), show the subject title, department name, school name, academic year description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, and the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

"Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"

question: For each department that offered a subject, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects during terms in the academic year 2021 or later, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to the Chemistry and Biology departments (i.e., only include departments of Chemistry or Biology). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2021 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: How many subjects were offered in 2023 by departments that are degree-granting, have at least one course described as being at the graduate level, and are named "Political Science"? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2023 FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2023%' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' );

question: For each building, provide the building name, and give the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room areas in that building, but only include buildings that have more than 5 rooms, are located in the city of Cambridge, and are academic buildings. Additionally, exclude the Brown Building from the results. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5 ORDER BY area_range DESC;

question: For each organization, what is the highest HR department code (old) among its associated HR org units, and what is the HR department name, considering only organizations whose highest HR department code (old) is greater than 500000, and excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS max_hr_dept_code_old, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 500000;

question: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that start after January 1, 2010 and are regular terms, specifically for subjects in the Mathematics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each building type, what is the building type name and the geometric mean of the area of rooms (AREA) in buildings of that type, considering only rooms with area greater than 0 and buildings with more than 0 rooms, and only including buildings that are academic buildings and are located at MIT? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, EXP(AVG(LOG(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ;

question: For each academic year, what is the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects in the Mathematics department that had at least one required or optional material, including the academic year description? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each academic term parameter, provide the term description from ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER and calculate the average and variance of the total units of all subjects offered in the corresponding effective term, considering only subjects that are offered this year and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

question: How many subjects were offered in 2017 Fall by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program that were classified as "Not for graduate credit" and were in the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_non_grad_chem_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND sos.HGN_CODE_DESC = 'Not for graduate credit' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry';

question: For each school, give the school name and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for degree-granting courses offered by departments in that school, but only include courses from the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, STDDEV(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_stddev DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department's name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, but only include departments that are Mathematics (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of CIP program codes for all courses in that department where the department is degree granting, the CIP program code is greater than 0, and the department is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_cip DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department budget code, and what is the corresponding administrative department name, considering only departments that are degree granting, have a non-null budget code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of students per student year in that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN student_counts sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year, range_students_per_year, var_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that grants degrees, what is the department's full name and the variance of the number of unique subject codes offered by that department, considering only departments whose department code is not '7' (i.e., excluding Biology)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, VARIANCE(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) AS subject_code_count_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC;

question: What is the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject and the total number of enrolled students for all subjects offered by the 'Engineering' school during terms that are marked as the current term, excluding subjects offered by the Chemistry and Biology departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology');
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: For each academic year, what is the description of the academic year and the variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, have a term status of 'Previous', and are offered by the Mathematics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects offered by the School of Engineering in the term '2016SP', and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Political Science department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: Show the course description, department name, and school name for each course in the Mathematics department, along with dense ranks over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name, for courses that are degree granting, have a course level of 'G', and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ;

question: For each academic year, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the current term by the Mathematics department (Course 18), including the academic year description? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year, considering only years with more than 5 subjects offered, and only including subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ;

question: For each academic term in 2022, list the term code, term description, and the number of subjects offered along with the total lecture units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have at least 3 lecture units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(cso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ata.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY ata.TERM_CODE ;

question: For each building, give the building name and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area of its floors, considering only buildings that have more than one floor, are located on the MIT site, and are academic buildings. Additionally, exclude the Brown Building (building key 39) from the results. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '39' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 1 ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_NAME ;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students descending, along with the full name of the offering department, but only include courses that have course materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N';

question: For each department, provide the department's full name and calculate the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses, considering only departments that grant degrees and courses that are degree-granting, but exclude the Biology department (Course 7) from the results. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

question: For organizations whose parent organization is "S H&SS", and that are not "Cambridge-MIT Inst", show their organization names and the dense rank of their major organization, considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization level. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MAJOR_ORG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' AND t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')
domain_knowledge: "except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')"
"Cambridge-MIT Institute" is abbreviated as "CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST" in organization names

question: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered, including the subject title, department name, and the total count of materials, for subjects in regular academic terms that are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each building at MIT that is used as a residence and has more than 5 floors, what is the building name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the assignable area of its floors? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 5 ;
domain_knowledge: "used as a residence" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'"

question: For each academic term parameter, provide the term parameter name and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter, considering only terms that are regular terms and where the department is Mathematics. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: How many subjects offered in 2022 by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program and the Political Science department had a total of at least 6 units? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_2022_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND (ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' OR ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6;

question: For all rooms with an area greater than 400 in the Stata building, show the room key, building room, area, the subject title of the course meeting in that room that is offered by the Computer Science department, the academic year, and the rank of each room within its building (ordered by room key). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
domain_knowledge: "Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
"Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"
"Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not summer terms, are offered in the fall term, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC;

question: What is the minimum CIP program code and the total number of departments for courses in the School of Engineering, considering only degree-granting departments, including the corresponding administrative department names, and specifically for the Mechanical Engineering department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students and departments that grant degrees, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department that is degree-granting, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subject codes offered by that department, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subject code counts per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that grant degrees, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each subject, give the subject ID, the minimum number of enrolled students and the average lecture units for each subject in the Mathematics department, for subjects where the number of enrolled students is between 2 and 10 or the academic year is at least 2020, and the term start date is between '01-JAN-20' and '31-DEC-22'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 2 AND 10) OR (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2020) ) AND a.TERM_START_DATE BETWEEN '01-JAN-20' AND '31-DEC-22' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector values for all associated administrative departments, but only for departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Mechanical Engineering department (Course 2). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated material record, but only include departments that are either Chemistry or Biology. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) > 0 ;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: For each subject code and department name where the department is degree-granting and the department is Mathematics, give the number of students and the minimum student year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS min_student_year FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each school, give the school name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by departments in that school, but only include schools that have at least one department named "Political Science" or "Mathematics", and exclude any courses from the Chemistry department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH schools_with_target_depts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Political Science', 'Mathematics') ), school_course_units AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ) SELECT scu.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(scu.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(scu.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM school_course_units scu WHERE scu.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_target_depts) GROUP BY scu.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scu.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ;

question: For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the year 2019, and what is the full name of the department? Only include departments where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 10, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10

question: For each building, what is the building key and what are both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses held in rooms of that building, considering only courses that are offered this year, have more than 0 total units, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per subject in that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and departments that grant degrees, but only include the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each type of space usage, provide the space usage name and calculate the average and variance of the room square footage for all rooms with a room counter of 1 that are located in the Stata building and exclude usage types that include 'STORAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS sqft_variance FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_COUNTER = 1 AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY sqft_variance DESC;

question: For each IAP activity offered in the 2021 January term that is associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, what is the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, along with the activity title and the term description? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;

question: For each school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the current academic term, specifically for the Political Science department (Course 17)? Please show the school name along with these statistics. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, only for subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE ;

question: For each department, provide the department name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5

question: What is the minimum CIP program code and the total number of degree-granting courses for each department that is degree-granting, considering only courses that are also degree-granting, and only for the Mathematics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS total_degree_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Political Science department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

question: For each academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, but only include departments other than 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department code, department name, the number of library subjects offered, and the total number of students enrolled in TIP subjects for departments that had at least 5 students enrolled in TIP subjects in 2020FA, limited to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_library_subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_tip_enrollment FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 5;

question: For each department, what is the department's full name, and what are the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses, considering only degree-granting courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC;

question: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school, but only include the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the range and variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are marked as the current term and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_range DESC;

question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, term start date, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ;

question: For rooms with an area greater than 500 in the Stata building, excluding rooms whose major use description includes 'STORAGE', show the room key, building key, floor number, major use description, and the rank of each room within its building ordered by room key. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_rank_in_building FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.AREA > 500 AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND (fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IS NULL OR fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') ORDER BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, room_rank_in_building;
domain_knowledge: "exclude usage types that include 'STORAGE'" is predicated by "TABLE.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'"

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department, show the subject ID, subject title, the term description, the department name from the course catalog, and the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year, considering only terms with a term status indicator of 'P', subjects with total units greater than 0, and only for subjects in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' by departments that are degree granting and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students, and only include courses with materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ;

question: List the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years with the highest number of subjects offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 that is not "Political Science", what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations in that hierarchy level, excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'? Show the department hierarchy level 2 name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), only for hierarchy levels where the average organization number is greater than zero. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS department_hierarchy_level_2, STDDEV_SAMP(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) / AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON mdh.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON hou.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME HAVING AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) > 0

question: List the top 10 academic building names by the number of rooms they contain, along with the total number of rooms for each building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department, considering only years with more than 10 subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10 ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are current or previous terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For students whose year is 'G' and whose department is degree-granting and is 'Political Science', show their full name, email address, department name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by full name, including the subject code and subject code description for each student's department, and only include students whose department code is '17'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). question: For all subjects offered in the academic year 2024 by the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its term description group ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.

question: For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than zero, and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department, provide the department name and department code, and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered this year, considering only subjects that are letter graded and belong to the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.

question: For all course subjects in the catalog where the department code is 18 (Mathematics), the department name is 'Mathematics', and the subject is offered this year, show the subject code, subject number, department name, responsible faculty's full name, Moira list member, and the average office phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the responsible faculty's last name and ordered by the subject code. sql: SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER ( PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject number, subject title, department name, SIS admin department name, and rank within each SIS admin department name group ordered by subject number.
