question: For each building in Cambridge, MA, show the building key, building name, building type, the number of historical records, and the total assignable area across all historical records, considering only buildings with more than 1 room, with a non-null building name, and that are academic buildings. Additionally, only include buildings that are not the Stata building (building key 32). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_record_count, SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND a.STATE = 'MA' AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 1 AND b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE;

question: For each building at MIT, give the building key and the total assignable area across all its historical records, considering only those buildings whose total assignable area is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total assignable area for all buildings, and only include buildings that are academic buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH total_assignable AS ( SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fbh.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = fb.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(total_assignable_area) AS mean_assignable, STDDEV(total_assignable_area) AS stddev_assignable FROM total_assignable ) SELECT ta.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ta.total_assignable_area FROM total_assignable ta CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE ta.total_assignable_area > s.mean_assignable + s.stddev_assignable ;

question: For each department offering a subject, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student, have required course materials, and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department (i.e., Course 5 or Course 7). question: List the top 10 departments by the number of students, showing the department name, school name, and the count of students in each department, for departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department name, and are either the Mathematics department or the Physics department. question: For each building at MIT, provide the building name and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, considering only academic buildings with more than 10 rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC;

question: For each type of space usage, provide the space usage name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the room square footage for all rooms with a room counter of 1 that are located in the Stata building. Do not return any rounded answers.

question: What is the minimum department code and the total number of unique department names for degree-granting courses in the School of Engineering, excluding courses from the Physics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_department_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_unique_departments FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Physics';

question: For each building, provide the building's long name and calculate the range and variance of the area of rooms located in that building, considering only rooms with an access level of 1 or 2, and only include buildings that are academic buildings and are the Fairchild Building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG

question: For each department hierarchy, what is the department hierarchy name, and what are the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations within that hierarchy, considering only organizations that have a non-null description and excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"

question: List the top 10 department names along with the number of organizations associated with each, considering only departments that belong to the 'Standard Hierarchy', have a non-null description in their organizations, and excluding organizations with IDs '138' and '250'. Additionally, only include departments whose name is 'Political Science' (i.e., Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d ON f.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY organization_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, courses that have more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department code and the total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered by that department, considering only departments where the total enrollment is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total enrollment across all departments, and where the department is Mathematics (department code '18')? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) + STDDEV(total_enrollment) FROM ( SELECT SUM(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std2 ON tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) sub );

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total number of units greater than 1, in the Political Science department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school name group, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each building, give the building key and the total area of all rooms in that building, considering only buildings where the total area of rooms is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total area across all buildings, and restrict to buildings used as a residence and specifically include the Stata building. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH building_area AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(total_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_area) AS stddev_area FROM building_area ) SELECT ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ba.total_area FROM building_area ba CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE ba.total_area > s.mean_area + s.stddev_area OR ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' ;
domain_knowledge: "used as a residence" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'"

question: For each department, what is the department code and the total number of units for all courses in that department, considering only departments whose total units are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all departments, and only including departments that are degree-granting and whose department code is not '7' (Biology)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t );

question: Which three academic terms had the highest number of subjects offered by the Mathematics department, and for each, what is the term code, the term description, and the academic year description? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3;

question: For each department, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering during the 2019FA term, but exclude the Political Science department (department code '17'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only those academic years where the total lecture units are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total lecture units across all academic years? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) t );

question: For each academic year, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per academic term in that year for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH term_units AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev FROM term_units GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, considering only the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department, considering only years with more than 5 subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) > 5;

question: For students whose first name is 'Peter' and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show their last name, email address, student year, department name, school name, and the minimum department budget code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Peter' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are not the current term, have a term status indicator of 'P', and are offered by the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, offered in the 'Engineering' school, and excluding the 'Political Science' department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and provide both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and find the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in terms that started after January 1, 2000, and that are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_START_DATE > '2000-01-01' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;

question: For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, and what is the name of the school that department belongs to, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6, excluding the Mathematics department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Chemistry department (Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

question: For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: What is the minimum total units and the sum of lecture units for subjects offered in the Spring Term 2021 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: List the top 10 departments by the number of unique courses they offer, including the department name, school name, and the total number of courses, but only for departments that are degree granting, belong to a school with a non-null name, and are not the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show the department full name, subject title, subject code description, and school name, along with dense ranks over department code ordered by department code, for courses that have a non-null subject title, belong to departments that grant degrees, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

question: For each department, what is the maximum organization number and the name of the space unit associated with that department, considering only departments in the "Provost Area" with a maximum organization number greater than 50000, and excluding the "Political Science" department (Course 17)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_organization_number, su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 AND mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY mdh.DLC_NAME;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, the administrative department name, and the average department phone number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the administrative department name and ordered by the student's first name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

"Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '6'"

question: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses for which a responsible faculty member is also a member of a Moira list, considering only courses offered this year and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic term that is currently active, list the term code, term description, term start date, and for each department in that term, provide the department code, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, and the total subject enrollment number for subjects with more than 0 enrollments, but only include departments whose name is 'Political Science' (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.TERM_START_DATE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.TERM_START_DATE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year description and calculate the range and variance of the total number of students enrolled in subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) during that year, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and terms that are regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department that grants degrees and is the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department code, department name, the number of students in that department, and the total number of unique student years represented among those students? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by the Mathematics department, what is the maximum number of total units for that subject, and what is the department name from the course catalog, considering only subjects where the maximum total units is greater than 6? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6;

question: For each department, provide the department's full name and calculate the range and variance of the department budget codes for all subject codes associated with that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_code_range, VARIANCE(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_code_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY budget_code_range DESC;

question: List the top 10 organization names along with the number of HR organizational units associated with each, considering only organizations that are assignable, HR organizational units that have a non-null department name, and excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS' and 'ANTHROPOLOGY', as well as only including HR organizational units in the 'Political Science' department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('ADMISSIONS', 'ANTHROPOLOGY') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_org_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting, but only include departments whose name is 'Political Science' (i.e., Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '17' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the clearing cost collector values for that department, considering only departments where the clearing cost collector is greater than zero, and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Show the department name and the geometric mean. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

question: What is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and belong to the Mathematics department, considering only library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, considering only subjects offered in regular terms and only for subjects offered by the Chemistry or Biology departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: For each academic year and term parameter, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE s.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects where the responsible faculty member has a non-null email address, the subject is offered this year, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List the top 10 degree-granting departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in the 2022 academic year, including each department's name and the corresponding school name, but exclude the Department of Physics. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, what is the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, are not variable units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Show the academic year and these statistics. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: What is the minimum room square footage and the total number of rooms for all spaces used as research centers in the Stata building? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS min_square_footage, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32;
domain_knowledge: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'"

question: For each department, what is the maximum CIP program code among its courses, and what is the full department name, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the term 2017JA by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject title, offer department code, offer department name, department full name, and the average number of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by the number of enrolled students, but only include subjects that are Chemistry courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5'

question: How many subjects offered in 2017 as part of the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program and the Chemistry department had at least one required material listed? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_subjects_with_required_materials FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON sos.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ';

question: For each department, what is the department name, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each DLC in the history department, give the DLC name and calculate the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, considering only organizations that have a non-null organization number and a non-null DLC key, and excluding organizations '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT fodk.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_organization_number, VARIANCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS var_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY fodk.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME
domain_knowledge: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')"
"Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"

question: For students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department (Course 6) whose first name is "Kevin", show their full names and the dense rank of their office phone numbers, considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by office phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.OFFICE_PHONE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin'
domain_knowledge: "Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"

question: How many library reserve materials in the fall 2017 term had a material status of 'U', were associated with subjects offered by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program department, and were also offered by either the Chemistry or Biology departments, according to the subject offering summary? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology');
domain_knowledge: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')"

question: For each department except the Chemistry department, provide the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ;

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by each department in that school, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses with more than 0 total units, and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: How many subjects offered in the 2022 academic year are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form and are offered by the Political Science department? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science';
